papers.title: The Many Senses of Visual Similarity: A Text-Prompted Image Perceptual Metric
papers.abstract_en: Human visual similarity judgments are context-dependent. For example, two images may be similar in shape but distinct in color. Existing perceptual similarity metrics, however, collapse these nuances into a single scalar value, offering no mechanism to condition on specific aspects. To bridge this gap, we introduce a large-scale dataset of human similarity judgments over image triplets, where each triplet is annotated across multiple, free-form semantic aspects of similarity. Benchmarking a broad range of frontier vision-language models (VLMs) reveals a considerable performance gap compared to human annotators' consensus. Leveraging our data, we fine-tune a VLM to produce our Text-Prompted Image Perceptual Similarity (TPIPS) metric, capturing multiple senses of visual similarity depending on the specified text prompt. We demonstrate that TPIPS aligns more closely with human perception and generalizes reliably beyond the training distribution. Finally, we show that TPIPS unlocks new capabilities in text-guided retrieval, compositional search, and the fine-grained evaluation of generative models. Our code, data, and trained models are at https://peterwang512.github.io/TPIPS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有图像感知相似性度量缺乏上下文条件的问题，构建了一个大规模人类相似性判断数据集，涵盖多个自由形式的语义方面。通过微调视觉语言模型，提出了文本提示的图像感知相似性度量（TPIPS），能够根据文本提示捕捉不同维度的视觉相似性。实验表明TPIPS与人类感知高度一致，并泛化到训练分布之外，在文本引导检索、组合搜索和生成模型细粒度评估中展示出新能力。
Motivation: 现有视觉相似性度量将不同细粒度线索（如形状、颜色）坍缩为单一标量，无法根据特定方面进行条件化，缺乏灵活性。
Method: 收集大规模图片三元组数据集，每个三元组由人类标注多个自由形式的语义相似性方面；利用此数据微调视觉语言模型（VLM），输出根据文本提示条件化的感知相似性分数（TPIPS）。
Result: 在基准测试中，前沿VLM与人类标注者共识存在较大差距；TPIPS更接近人类感知，并可靠地泛化到训练分布之外。
Conclusion: TPIPS在文本引导检索、组合搜索、生成模型细粒度评估等任务中展示了新能力，为视觉相似性度量提供了可指定方面的条件化方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Patch Policy: Efficient Embodied Control via Dense Visual Representations
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained dense visual features from Vision Transformers (ViTs) are powerful yet have been underutilized in robot learning. Modern robot policies either compress each observation into a single global token, or rely on visual backbones trained from scratch, sacrificing both fine-grained spatial detail and the benefits of large-scale visual pre-training. While there exist policies that do operate on dense patch features like large vision-language-action models (VLAs), they tend to be heavy and slow, inheriting the full cost of a billion-parameter vision-language model (VLM) backbone. We close this gap with Patch Policy, a minimal architectural extension that enables transformer-based policies to consume dense pre-trained patch tokens directly without the computational overhead of a full VLM. At its core is a block-causal attention mask that preserves the temporal causality of standard policies while letting the model attend over many patch tokens per observation, alongside other state information. Patch Policy is lightweight, fast, and highly effective. Across four simulated and three real-world environment suites, our method achieves a 40% relative improvement over policies using state-of-the-art global-pooled representations. Furthermore, it surpasses fine-tuned OpenVLA-OFT by 18% while using roughly 0.7% of the parameters. We believe Patch Policy provides a pipeline for the robotics community to readily leverage continuing progress in visual representation learning, without sacrificing the training efficiency or inference speed required for high-frequency, reactive control. Videos can be viewed at https://patch-policy.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Patch Policy，一种轻量级架构扩展，使基于 Transformer 的策略能够直接使用预训练的密集补丁（patch）特征，而无需庞大的视觉-语言模型主干。通过块因果注意力掩码，模型在保持时间因果性的同时，可关注每个观测的多个补丁令牌。在四个仿真和三个真实世界环境套件中，该方法相比使用全局池化表示的策略取得了40%的相对改进，并以0.7%的参数超越微调后的 OpenVLA-OFT 18%。
Motivation: 现有机器人策略要么将观测压缩为单个全局令牌，损失空间细节和预训练优势；要么依赖从头训练的视觉主干；而使用密集补丁特征的大型视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）又过于庞大和缓慢。本文旨在填补这一空白，实现高效利用预训练密集视觉表示。
Method: 提出 Patch Policy：在基于 Transformer 的策略中引入块因果注意力掩码，允许模型直接处理每个观测的密集预训练补丁令牌，同时保留时间因果性和其他状态信息，避免了完整 VLM 的计算开销。
Result: 在四个仿真和三个真实世界环境套件中，相比使用全局池化表示的最先进策略，相对改进40%；以0.7%的参数超越微调后的 OpenVLA-OFT 18%。
Conclusion: Patch Policy 提供了一种轻量高效的流水线，使机器人社区能够直接利用视觉表示学习的进展，而不会牺牲高频反应控制所需的训练效率和推理速度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Automated Discovery Has No Universally Superior Harness
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous discovery systems such as OpenEvolve and TTT-Discover are often used as general-purpose harnesses. However, in practice these are composite systems combining several design choices about archives, parent selection, exploration, and budget allocation into a single recipe. Because discovery runs are expensive and inherently stochastic, existing harnesses are often compared using too few independent trials to distinguish key methodological improvements from run-to-run variance. We systematically decompose OpenEvolve-style evolutionary search and the TTT-Discover search harness into its constituent components and systematically evaluate 30 budget-matched harnesses across 12 model-problem pairs using more than 3.1 million LLM rollouts and repeated-trial statistical analysis. Our results show that discovery harnesses have a generalization problem: No fixed harness is reliably superior across the evaluated model-problem pairs, and variants of OpenEvolve generally underperform simpler alternatives. Thus, harness choice is better viewed as a hyperparameter rather than as a universal recipe, and should be tailored to the specific problem and underlying model. We also find that early discovery progress predicts final performance, and use this property to present a budget-matched adaptive-allocation experiment that starts multiple harnesses, prunes weak partial runs, and reallocates compute to stronger survivors, outperforming both commitment to a randomly sampled fixed harness and a non-adaptive harness ensemble. Together, these results motivate shifting from fixed harness selection to online adaptation guided by early performance. We release all run pools including baseline null distributions for every model-problem pair as reusable statistical infrastructure against for future harness proposals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统拆解了OpenEvolve和TTT-Discover两种自主发现系统的组件，通过超过310万次LLM调用和重复试验统计分析，发现没有一种固定发现工具在所有模型-问题对中普遍优越，且OpenEvolve变体通常不如简单方案。结果表明发现工具选择应视为超参数而非通用配方，并提出了基于早期性能的在线自适应分配方法。
Motivation: 现有自主发现系统（如OpenEvolve、TTT-Discover）常被当作通用工具使用，但其内部组件（存档、父选择、探索、预算分配）组合复杂，且由于运行成本高、随机性强，以往比较中独立试验次数不足，难以区分真正的改进与随机波动。
Method: 将OpenEvolve式进化搜索和TTT-Discover搜索工具拆解为构成组件，系统评估30种预算匹配的工具在12个模型-问题对上的表现，使用超过310万次LLM调用和重复试验统计分析方法。还提出了基于早期发现进展的自适应分配实验：启动多个工具，剪枝弱的部分运行，将计算重新分配给更强的幸存者。
Result: 没有固定工具在评估的模型-问题对中普遍优越；OpenEvolve变体通常不如更简单的替代方案。早期发现进展能预测最终性能，自适应分配方法优于随机选择固定工具和非自适应工具集成。
Conclusion: 发现工具选择应视为超参数而非通用配方，需要根据具体问题和模型定制。结果支持从固定工具选择转向基于早期性能的在线自适应调整。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Simple Domain Generalization for Strong Pixel-Level Image Tampering Detection in Modern VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) have significantly improved image generation and editing capabilities, making pixel-level image tampering detection increasingly important yet challenging under cross-model and out-of-distribution shifts. This work studies domain generalization for pixel-level image tampering detection in modern VLMs like ChatGPT, Gemini, Qwen-Image, etc., aiming to learn tampering localization models that remain robust across diverse VLM-generated manipulation distributions. We propose a simple yet effective domain-generalized training framework built on two practical strategies. First, we introduce a balanced minibatch sampling scheme that strategically samples tampered and real images in each minibatch, preventing biased optimization toward either manipulated artifacts or clean-image priors and avoiding training collapse, ensuring that each optimization step receives proper sampled gradient signals. Second, we adopt a simple late-injection strategy, where the detector is first trained on large-scale base data until stable convergence, and then exposed to a small amount of newly selected supporting data from emerging VLM distributions, improving adaptability without overfitting to limited new domains. Together, these components provide a simple yet strong recipe for improving pixel-level tampering localization and OOD robustness across modern VLMs. Despite the conceptual simplicity, our framework outperforms the prior state-of-the-art PIXAR by a large margin of 26.1% and 26.8% relative improvement in average gIoU and cIoU, respectively, across OOD VLMs of GPT-Images-2.0, Gemini-3.1, FLUX.2, and Seedream 4.5. Our code is available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/PIXAR-DG

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现代视觉语言模型（VLM）生成的图像，提出一种简单而有效的领域泛化训练框架用于像素级篡改检测。该框架包含平衡小批量采样和延迟注入策略，在多个未见过的VLM分布（如GPT-Images-2.0、Gemini-3.1等）上，平均gIoU和cIoU分别相对提升26.1%和26.8%，显著超越先前最优方法PIXAR。
Motivation: 现代VLM的图像生成和编辑能力提升了像素级篡改检测的难度，特别是在跨模型和分布偏移场景下，现有方法泛化能力不足。
Method: 提出两个策略：1）平衡小批量采样，在每批次中均衡采样篡改和真实图像，避免偏向伪造伪影或干净图像先验；2）延迟注入，先在大型基础数据上训练探测器至稳定收敛，再暴露于少量新兴VLM分布的数据，提高适应性而不过拟合。
Result: 在GPT-Images-2.0、Gemini-3.1、FLUX.2和Seedream 4.5等OOD VLM上，平均gIoU和cIoU分别相对提升26.1%和26.8%，优于先前SOTA。
Conclusion: 该简单框架有效提升了像素级篡改定位的鲁棒性和OOD泛化能力，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Logical Judgments Under Pressure: Diagnosing Syllogistic Stability with Learned Soft Prefixes
papers.abstract_en: To test how correct logical judgments respond to learned context, we prepend a soft prefix to an exactly labeled syllogistic reasoning benchmark while keeping the model fixed. Soft prefixes are opaque continuous vectors, so we characterize them through the behavior they induce across controlled variations in logical form and interface. By studying which prefixes succeed and how their effects generalize, we characterize how learned contextual pressure can override correct judgments and expose limits in a model's logical stability. Across Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MoE, Qwen3-8B, and Gemma 4 31B, learned prefixes redirect many correct answers and remain effective across unseen forms and interface changes. In repeated tests with Qwen3.6 MoE and Gemma, they outperform paired random controls in all 16 model--direction--split comparisons by 37 to 99 percentage points. Qwen3.6 MoE flip rates remain between 72% and 90% across wording and prompt changes, while Gemma validity prefixes retain 54% to 56% flip compared with less than 1% for matched random prefixes. Diagnostic tests show that the dominant effect is a broad preference for one answer meaning rather than fixed-symbol forcing or a logical operation that transfers reliably between tasks. The form of this bias differs across models. In both Qwen models, simple score models often predict which judgments will flip but not how far their margins will move, whereas Gemma's overall response is more closely approximated by the same models. These results show that the dominant behavioral effect of successful soft prefixes is a broad answer preference, while the remaining response reveals substantial model-specific differences in logical stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文通过在标记好的三段论推理基准上引入软前缀（soft prefix）来研究逻辑判断对学习上下文的稳定性。实验发现软前缀能有效重定向正确判断，其主导效应是对特定答案含义的广泛偏好，而非固定的符号映射或逻辑操作，且不同模型（Qwen3.6 MoE、Qwen3-8B、Gemma 4）表现出显著差异。
Motivation: 现有工作缺乏对模型在受到学习上下文压力时逻辑稳定性的系统性诊断，尤其是正确逻辑判断如何被外部嵌入的连续向量覆盖的机制尚不清楚。
Method: 在精确标注的三段论推理基准上，为每个样本学习一个连续的软前缀向量，保持模型参数固定，通过对比不同前缀下模型输出的变化及泛化性来诊断逻辑稳定性。
Result: 在Qwen3.6 MoE、Qwen3-8B和Gemma 4上，软前缀在全部16个模型-方向-分割比较中均显著优于随机对照（高出37–99个百分点）。Qwen3.6 MoE翻转率72%–90%，Gemma有效前缀翻转率54%–56%，随机前缀低于1%。诊断表明主要效应是广义答案偏好。
Conclusion: 成功软前缀的主要行为效应是广义答案偏好，但不同模型在逻辑稳定性上存在实质差异；该方法可揭示学习上下文压力对正确判断的覆盖能力，并为评估模型鲁棒性提供诊断工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FlowMimic: Mask-free Visual Editing and Generation with Pixel-pair Warped Flow Field for Online Video Editing Data Generation and Modality Mimicry
papers.abstract_en: In line with the prevailing direction of vision research, we explore the integration of both generation and editing capabilities for video and image modalities within a single model. Current approaches to collecting video editing data typically depend on labour-intensive, time-consuming curated procedures--involving object mask annotation, the use of error-introducing pair synthesis via I2V model and ControlNet-like guidance, and VLM-based quality filtering or refinement--and demonstrate limited task scalability. As a result, the diversity of editing tasks remains substantially narrower than that available for image editing models. We develop a pixel-pair temporal warped flow field that can directly generate corresponding video editing samples in real time from image editing samples, and we demonstrate across multiple levels of video editing tasks that a model can learn video editing using only such data. We regard the image modality as a particular form of the video modality. Accordingly, we design a modality mimic generation loss and a modality mimic editing loss to relatively align the capabilities--and thereby the output distributions--of the two modalities through mutual imitation. Moreover, language-based visual editing entails the comprehension of the editing instruction and the reference visual content, the localization of the region corresponding to that instruction within the reference visual contents, and the modification of that region alone. Existing approaches predominantly rely on external aids, such as fine-tuning an additional MLLM or explicitly supplying a mask sequence as auxiliary input during inference. In contrast, we aspire for the model to internalize this capability. To that end, we introduce sense-related tasks--for instance, referring expression segmentation--along with corresponding editing-region-aware latent-level loss and attention-level loss.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FlowMimic，一种无需掩码的视觉编辑和生成方法，通过像素对扭曲流场在线生成视频编辑数据，并设计模态模仿损失来对齐图像和视频模态的编辑能力。方法还引入感知相关任务及编辑区域感知的隐层和注意力损失，使模型内化定位和编辑能力。
Motivation: 现有视频编辑数据收集依赖人工标注、配对合成和质量过滤，耗时且任务扩展性有限，导致视频编辑任务多样性远低于图像编辑。
Method: 提出像素对时间扭曲流场，从图像编辑样本直接实时生成对应的视频编辑样本；设计模态模仿生成损失和模态模仿编辑损失，通过相互模仿对齐两模态的输出分布；引入感知相关任务（如指代分割）及编辑区域感知的隐层和注意力损失。
Result: 在多个层次的视频编辑任务上证明模型仅使用此类数据即可学习视频编辑。
Conclusion: 旨在将图像模态视为视频模态的特例，通过相互模仿对齐能力，并使模型内化定位和编辑能力，无需外部辅助。

papers.title: Causal Discovery on Irregular Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Causal discovery methods have shown strong performance in temporal systems, but they typically rely on regular and discrete lag structures, limiting their applicability to regularly sampled data. However, many real-world tasks require dealing with irregularly sampled streams of events, such as sensor streams, healthcare data, and financial transactions. In this work, we propose an extension of PCMCI+, a state-of-the-art method for causal discovery on regular multivariate time series, to allow for handling irregular time series. Instead of modelling causal relations through fixed-lag dependencies, our method aggregates causal influence over predefined temporal windows. We evaluate our method on synthetic irregular event streams with known causal structures under different signal-to-noise ratios, showing that it consistently recovers the underlying causal graph and substantially outperforms the standard PCMCI+ on irregularly sampled data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对不规则时间序列上的因果发现问题，将现有的规则时间序列因果发现方法PCMCI+扩展至非规则采样数据。方法通过预定义时间窗口聚合因果影响而非固定滞后依赖，并在合成不规则事件流上验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有因果发现方法通常假设规则采样和离散滞后结构，无法直接处理传感器、医疗健康等实际应用中广泛存在的不规则时间序列。
Method: 提出一种扩展的PCMCI+方法，用预定义时间窗口内的因果影响聚合替代固定滞后依赖，使模型能够处理不规则采样的数据。
Result: 在具有已知因果结构的合成不规则事件流上，该方法在不同信噪比下一致恢复底层因果图，且显著优于标准PCMCI+在非规则采样数据上的表现。
Conclusion: 该方法为不规则时间序列的因果发现提供了有效扩展，但仅在合成数据上评估，实际应用效果仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Vector Search As Nearest Neighbor Matching: RAG-based Policy Learning in Causal Inference
papers.abstract_en: We propose one-step and two-step methods for policy learning with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). We formulate RAG-based action selection under the potential outcome framework. In the two-step method, vector search retrieves action-specific neighboring evidence in an embedding space, the generator estimates conditional expected outcomes or their contrasts, and a plug-in rule selects an action. This formulation connects action-specific vector search with nearest-neighbor matching in causal inference. We decompose the regret of the two-step method into candidate-generation regret and within-candidate choice regret, and we bound the latter using prediction-error guarantees for nearest-neighbor estimators and transformers. We evaluate the one-step method directly as a policy because its intermediate computation is unobserved.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于检索增强生成（RAG）的策略学习方法，包括一步法和两步法。两步法将向量搜索与因果推断中的最近邻匹配联系起来，将遗憾分解为候选生成遗憾和候选内选择遗憾，并利用最近邻估计器和变换器的预测误差界来限制后者。
Motivation: 在因果推断中，策略学习需要选择最优行动，但传统方法可能缺乏对上下文的充分利用。RAG通过检索相关证据来改进决策。
Method: 提出一步法和两步法。两步法使用向量搜索检索行动特定的邻近证据，然后生成器估计条件期望结果或对比，最后使用插件规则选择行动。一步法直接评估策略。
Result: 将两步法的遗憾分解为候选生成遗憾和候选内选择遗憾，并使用最近邻估计器和变换器的预测误差界来限制候选内选择遗憾。
Conclusion: 该方法将向量搜索与因果推断中的最近邻匹配联系起来，为RAG策略学习提供了理论保证。

papers.title: GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash: Efficient Pathology Foundation Models for Whole-Slide and Tumor Microenvironment Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models have emerged as a driving force in computational pathology, with the potential to transform cancer diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment selection by learning transferable representations from large-scale histopathology data. A growing landscape of pathology foundation models now spans diverse data sources, architectures, and downstream applications. However, most pretrained models operate only at the image-tile level, use restrictive licenses, and remain computationally expensive, limiting large-scale slide-level clinical and research use. Here, we introduce GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash, efficient models for whole-slide pathology AI and spatial proteomics prediction. GigaPath-Flash combines a 22M-parameter ViT-S tile encoder with a 21M-parameter LongNet slide encoder, both pretrained on large-scale real-world histopathology data. Its compact tile encoder is distilled from the billion-parameter GigaPath (ViT-g) teacher and shared by both models. GigaPath-Flash retains 97% of GigaPath's average slide-level performance with 50x less compute. GigaTIME-Flash extends this backbone to predict the tumor immune microenvironment directly from routine H&E images. It surpasses the original CNN-based GigaTIME in prediction quality while running 6x faster and using 8x less GPU memory. Together with GigaPath and GigaTIME, these models form an open-weight, Apache-2.0-licensed family pretrained on large-scale real-world clinical data. By releasing all models and weights, we provide accessible building blocks for computational pathology, immuno-oncology, and precision health.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GigaPath-Flash 和 GigaTIME-Flash，两种用于全切片病理学 AI 和空间蛋白质组学预测的高效基础模型。GigaPath-Flash 结合 22M 参数的 ViT-S 切片编码器和 21M 参数的 LongNet 全切片编码器，通过知识蒸馏从十亿参数的 GigaPath 教师模型压缩而来，在保持 97% 平均切片级性能的同时减少 50 倍计算量。GigaTIME-Flash 扩展该骨干网络，直接从常规 H&E 图像预测肿瘤免疫微环境，性能超越原 CNN 模型，速度提升 6 倍且 GPU 内存减少 8 倍。所有模型以 Apache-2.0 开源许可证发布。
Motivation: 现有病理学基础模型大多仅在图像切片级别操作、使用限制性许可证、计算成本高，限制了大规模临床和研究使用。需要更高效、开放的全切片级模型以推动计算病理学和精准医学发展。
Method: GigaPath-Flash 采用 ViT-S 切片编码器加 LongNet 全切片编码器架构，通过知识蒸馏从 GigaPath (ViT-g) 教师模型学习；GigaTIME-Flash 共享该骨干网络并微调用于肿瘤免疫微环境预测。模型在大型真实世界组织病理学数据上预训练。
Result: GigaPath-Flash 保留 GigaPath 平均切片级性能的 97%，计算量减少 50 倍。GigaTIME-Flash 在预测质量上超越原始 CNN 模型，运行速度快 6 倍，GPU 内存占用减少 8 倍。
Conclusion: 这些模型构成一个开放权重、Apache-2.0 许可的基础模型家族，为计算病理学、免疫肿瘤学和精准健康提供可访问的构建模块。

papers.title: HOMIE: Human-object Centric Video Personalization via Multimodal Intelligent Enchancement
papers.abstract_en: Human-object centric video personalization (HOCVP) is a core task within subject-driven video generation. However, existing methods suffer from two key limitations. First, most approaches focusing on inter-subject personalization still struggle to strike a balance between high subject fidelity and accurate interaction patterns between humans and diverse objects, especially when objects represent abstract concepts such as logos. Second, while intra-subject references (e.g., OCR maps, multi-view inputs) are expected to enhance subject fidelity, most existing works lack mechanisms to understand such latent correspondence. To address both challenges, we propose HOMIE, an HOCVP framework that tackles both inter- and intra-subject input settings in a unified manner. Compared to previous approaches, HOMIE proposes a better MLLM integration strategy to extract knowledge of reference-level relationships without compromising the controllability of text encoders or incurring costly re-alignment. Specifically, we introduce global multimodal guidance within self-attention to better align MLLM-derived semantic features with VAE tokens. Furthermore, we propose modality-reference embedding to differentiate tokens from MLLM features and VAE tokens and associate intra-subject reference image tokens. Extensive experiments validate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across various HOCVP tasks. Project Page: https://yiyangcai.github.io/homie-page.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HOMIE，一个统一的人物-物体中心视频个性化生成（HOCVP）框架，解决现有方法在保持主体保真度和准确交互模式之间的平衡问题。HOMIE通过MLLM集成策略提取参考级关系知识，引入全局多模态引导和多模态参考嵌入，在多种HOCVP任务上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有主体驱动视频生成方法在人物-物体交互中难以兼顾高主体保真度和准确交互模式，尤其当物体是抽象概念（如标志）时；同时缺乏对intra-subject参考（如OCR图、多视图输入）中潜在对应关系的理解机制。
Method: 提出HOMIE框架，采用改进的MLLM集成策略提取参考级关系知识而不损害文本编码器可控性；在自注意力中引入全局多模态引导以对齐MLLM语义特征与VAE令牌；提出模态参考嵌入以区分来自MLLM特征和VAE令牌的令牌，并关联intra-subject参考图像令牌。
Result: 实验验证HOMIE在多种HOCVP任务上达到了最先进性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调HOMIE以统一方式处理inter-和intra-subject输入，并验证了其有效性。

papers.title: Unveiling Invariant and Transferable Latent Factors Across Heterogeneous Environments via ATLAS
papers.abstract_en: This paper considers a multi-environment factor model in which high-dimensional covariates are collected from heterogeneous environments, with auxiliary labels available in a subset of these environments. The joint distribution of the covariates may vary across environments, whereas the latent structure is decomposed into invariant factors with shared loadings and heterogeneous factors with environment-specific loadings. Such a model is motivated by transfer learning and latent factor regression, where one seeks stable low-dimensional representations for both interpretation and robust out-of-sample prediction of the response $Y$. Leveraging the invariance principle, we show that the invariant and heterogeneous factors are disentangled under a minimal structural condition. Based on this, we propose ATLAS, an Auxiliary-label and invariance-guided Transfer via Latent Alignment across heterogeneous environmentS. ATLAS is a unified procedure that leverages the invariance principle to separate aligned invariant and unaligned heterogeneous factors, and further exploits supervision from auxiliary labels to extract prediction-invariant and transferable factors from those unaligned heterogeneous factors. ATLAS yields near-oracle performance for downstream latent factor regression, enables transferable prediction in new environments through the full latent signal when auxiliary labels are available, and reduces to robust invariant-factor-only prediction otherwise. We establish sharp non-asymptotic error bounds for recovering invariant and heterogeneous factors, identifying all the response-invariant factors, and estimating the invariant signal in $Y$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ATLAS，一种在多环境因子模型中利用不变性原理分离不变因子和异质因子的方法。通过辅助标签监督，ATLAS能从异质因子中提取预测不变和可迁移因子，实现跨环境稳健迁移学习。作者建立了因子恢复和响应不变信号估计的非渐近误差界。
Motivation: 现有因子模型未考虑跨环境分布偏移，且难以区分不变与异质潜在结构，导致迁移学习中的预测不稳定。
Method: 基于不变性原理，将高维协方差分解为共享载荷的不变因子和环境特异性载荷的异质因子；利用辅助标签从异质因子中进一步提取预测不变的部分。最终获得对准的低维表示。
Result: ATLAS在潜在因子回归中达到近乎最优性能；当辅助标签可用时能利用完整潜在信号实现可迁移预测，否则退化为仅基于不变因子的稳健预测。作者证明了因子恢复和响应不变信号估计的收敛速率。

papers.title: Learning Adaptive Safety Margins for Visual Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Robots in cluttered indoor spaces often fail not because they cannot generate collision-free paths, but because a fixed safety margin is mis-calibrated: conservative margins cause detours and timeouts, while permissive margins lead to near-boundary shortcuts under perception bias. Diffusion-based planners propose diverse trajectory candidates from egocentric RGB-D, yet reliable selection remains the bottleneck. We propose a context-conditioned safety critic that learns an adaptive clearance preference for ranking diffusion proposals, decomposed into three complementary terms: (i) a safety term with a clearance-budget penalty and a control-barrier-function residual for waypoint- and transition-wise safety, (ii) an efficiency term combining a smoothness penalty with a safety-gated detour-ratio penalty that avoids detours without incentivizing risky shortcuts, and (iii) a distance-constraint matching term that anchors the learned budget to realized ESDF clearances to prevent margin collapse. We train the critic with privileged ESDF geometry in simulation and distill it into a perception-only selector via a two-stage teacher-student procedure. On PointGoal navigation in HM3D and MP3D, including cross-dataset transfer, our method achieves the highest success rate (SR) and success weighted by path length (SPL) among strong diffusion, optimization, and RL baselines. Trained purely in simulation, it transfers to a Unitree G1 humanoid and navigates cluttered indoor scenes without task-specific tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种上下文条件的安全批评器，用于在杂乱室内空间中导航，通过学习自适应安全边界来排名扩散规划器生成的轨迹。摘要报告在HM3D和MP3D上的PointGoal导航中达到了最高成功率和SPL，并迁移到真实人形机器人。
Motivation: 固定安全裕度在杂乱室内导航中会失效，保守导致绕路，宽松导致近边界捷径。需要自适应安全边界。
Method: 提出上下文条件的安全批评器，包含三项：安全项（间隙预算惩罚与控制障碍函数残差）、效率项（平滑惩罚和安全门控绕路比惩罚）、距离约束匹配项（锚定学习预算与ESDF间隙）。通过特权ESDF几何在仿真中训练，再蒸馏为仅基于感知的选择器。

Conclusion: 自适应安全边界可解决固定裕度问题，仿真训练可迁移到真实机器人。

papers.title: PPL-Factory: Task-Aware and Budget-Aware Data Selection from Language Modeling to Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Not all training samples contribute equally to large language model fine-tuning. Selecting informative training samples can reduce the computational cost while preserving downstream performance. Many existing data selection methods rely on indirect heuristics, such as data quality, diversity or reasoning trace length. However, the effectiveness of these fixed criteria is task-dependent and difficult to generalize across diverse downstream tasks. Perplexity-based data selection provides a simple and model-aware solution to estimate the sample difficulty, but existing approaches typically score the entire training sequence and ignore the difference in learning objectives of language modeling and reasoning tasks. In this paper, we propose PPL-Factory, a simple and interpretable data selection framework that combines task-aware perplexity-based scores and data budget-aware selection criteria. Experiments on GSM8K demonstrate that PPL-Factory outperforms other state-of-the-art data selection methods using only $1\%$ of the training set. With $10\%$ of the data, PPL-Factory exceeds full-data fine-tuning accuracy by 0.9 on GSM8K and 4.8 on MATH. Overall, our results demonstrate that task-aware and budget-aware perplexity-based selection provides an effective and applicable approach for efficient fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PPL-Factory，一种结合任务感知困惑度（perplexity）分数和预算感知选择标准的数据筛选框架，用于大语言模型微调。在GSM8K上仅用1%训练数据即超越其他数据选择方法，用10%数据在GSM8K和MATH上分别超过全量微调0.9和4.8。

Method: 提出PPL-Factory，通过任务级困惑度分数和预算感知策略联合筛选训练样本，实现简单且可解释的数据选择。
Result: 在GSM8K上用1%数据超越其他SOTA方法；用10%数据在GSM8K和MATH上分别超全量微调0.9和4.8个点。
Conclusion: 任务感知和预算感知的困惑度选择为高效微调提供了有效且可扩展的解决方案。

papers.title: Three-Body Scattering for Generative Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Modern generative models typically rely on an adversarial critic, a prescribed noise-to-data path, or an autoregressive factorization. Instead, we show that a proper distributional energy can induce sample-level motion and provide direct regression supervision for a one-step generator. Three-Body Scattering Modeling (TBSM) for generation turns the energy distance into a constant-size per-projectile interaction: each projectile is attracted toward one real source and repelled from one independently generated source. Conditioned on the projectile and its condition, its expectation equals the $2$-Wasserstein gradient-flow velocity of $\frac12D_E^2(P_θ,Q)$. A batch of $B$ frozen-target events yields $O(B)$ sample-level losses, each using one reference for its condition instead of the minibatch-wide all-pairs field used by methods such as Drifting Models. Tracking this conditional expectation online can reduce field noise. Using scattering in frozen image features, TBSM trains one-step generators on ImageNet-256, achieving FID${}=2.23$ with pixel-space PixelDiT-XL and FID${}=1.63$ with latent-space DiT-XL at NFE${}=1$. We provide a design map relating diffusion-related supervision, Drift-like dynamics, and GAN-like objectives. These results establish tracked scattering as a route to high-dimensional one-step generation. Code: https://github.com/sp12138/TBSM.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出三体散射建模（TBSM）用于生成模型，将能量距离转化为每个弹丸的恒定大小相互作用，实现了无需对抗判别器或预定义噪声路径的一步生成。在ImageNet-256上，PixelDiT-XL达到FID=2.23，DiT-XL达到FID=1.63（NFE=1）。该方法通过跟踪条件期望减少场噪声，并提供了扩散监督、漂移动力学与GAN目标之间的统一设计图。
Motivation: 现代生成模型通常依赖对抗判别器、预设的噪声到数据路径或自回归分解，本文探索是否能用分布能量直接提供样本级回归监督以实现一步生成。
Method: 提出三体散射建模（TBSM），将能量距离转化为每个弹丸的恒定大小相互作用：每个弹丸被一个真实源吸引，被一个独立生成的源排斥。在冻结的图像特征中应用散射，训练一步生成器。
Result: 在ImageNet-256上，PixelDiT-XL的FID=2.23，DiT-XL的FID=1.63（均取NFE=1）。
Conclusion: 论文表明追踪散射可成为高维一步生成的有效路径，并为扩散相关监督、漂移动力学与GAN类目标提供了设计关系图。

papers.title: Certified Training for Convolutional Perturbations
papers.abstract_en: Vision models have been found to be susceptible to perturbations such as motion blur induced at runtime by a shaking camera. This impedes their deployment in critical applications since phenomena such as slightly blurred vision might lead to failures, for example an object detector missing objects. While methods such as data augmentation or Adversarial Training can improve empirical robustness, they lack formal safety guarantees, making it difficult to identify and mitigate hidden vulnerabilities. We introduce a novel Certified Training approach that leverages an efficient encoding of convolutional perturbations to train provably robust models. Our method significantly outperforms Adversarial Training, achieving, for example, over 80% robust accuracy against motion blur of reasonable intensity on CIFAR10 while maintaining comparable standard accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉模型对运动模糊等卷积扰动缺乏鲁棒性的问题，提出一种认证训练（Certified Training）方法，通过高效编码卷积扰动来训练可证明鲁棒的模型。在CIFAR10上，该方法对中等强度的运动模糊实现了超过80%的鲁棒准确率，同时保持与标准训练相当的标准准确率，显著优于对抗训练。
Motivation: 视觉模型在运行时易受运动模糊等扰动影响，导致关键应用中的失败。现有的数据增强和对抗训练缺乏形式化安全保障，难以识别隐藏漏洞。
Method: 提出一种认证训练方法，利用卷积扰动的有效编码来训练具有可证明鲁棒性的模型。通过高效编码卷积扰动并集成到训练过程中，实现形式化保证。
Result: 在CIFAR10上，该方法对中等强度运动模糊的鲁棒准确率超过80%，同时保持与标准训练相当的标准准确率，显著优于对抗训练。
Conclusion: 该方法为卷积扰动提供了一种可证明的鲁棒性训练方式，弥补了经验性方法的不足，但实验仅限于CIFAR10和特定扰动类型。

papers.title: EVOLVE: Efficient Learned Volume Compression with Variable-Rate Encoding on a Cross-Domain Database
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale scientific simulations generate volumetric data at rates that far outpace advances in storage and network bandwidth, making effective lossy compression increasingly critical. However, conventional compressors often struggle to preserve fine structural details at high compression ratios (CRs), and implicit neural representations (INRs) require costly per-volume optimization and produce models with fixed CRs. To respond, we present EVOLVE, an autoencoder (AE)-based volume-compression framework that targets high CRs for offline compression, with three key contributions. First, we construct a large-scale cross-domain database of 6,376 volumes from 21 scientific simulations, curated via perceptual hashing to ensure diversity, enabling the optimized model to extract features that generalize across volumes within the covered scientific simulation domains. Second, we reexamine the design space of AE-based compressors and incorporate several macro- and micro-designs into a vanilla AE to develop EVOLVE, which substantially improves the expressive power and compression capability. Third, we develop a learnable gain mechanism with a three-stage training strategy to enable variable-rate encoding, allowing a single model to support continuous CR adjustment at inference time. Experiments on multiple unseen scientific simulation datasets demonstrate that EVOLVE achieves substantially higher CRs than conventional compressors at comparable reconstruction quality, while delivering compression speeds that are orders of magnitude faster than INR-based methods, highlighting its promise as a strong alternative for compressing scientific data. The code, model weights, and results are available on our project page at https://evolve-vis.github.io.
papers.comment: To be published in Proceedings of IEEE VIS 2026, IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EVOLVE，一个基于自编码器（AE）的体积压缩框架，用于高压缩比离线压缩。通过构建包含6376个体数据块的跨域数据库，结合宏微观设计改进AE，并引入可学习增益机制和三级训练策略实现变速率编码。实验在未见过的科学模拟数据集上达到比传统压缩器更高的压缩比，压缩速度比基于隐式神经表示（INR）的方法快数个数量级。
Motivation: 大规模科学模拟产生的体数据远超存储和网络带宽增长，需要有效有损压缩。传统压缩器在高压缩比下难以保留精细结构细节，隐式神经表示需要每个体积单独优化且只能固定压缩比。
Method: 构建一个由21个科学模拟的6376个体数据块组成的跨域数据库，通过感知哈希确保多样性。重新审视AE压缩器设计空间，融入宏微观设计提升表达力和压缩能力。开发可学习增益机制与三级训练策略，实现单个模型支持连续压缩比调整。
Result: 在多个未见科学模拟数据集上，EVOLVE在相当重建质量下达到比传统压缩器明显更高的压缩比，压缩速度比INR方法快数个数量级。
Conclusion: EVOLVE作为科学数据压缩的强替代方案，在离线压缩场景下兼顾高压缩比、高重建质量和快速压缩。

papers.title: FlashRT: Agent Harness for Guiding Agents to Deploy Real-Time Multimodal Applications
papers.abstract_en: Real-time multimodal applications, including voice agents and interactive video generation, compose heterogeneous models into pipelines whose efficient deployment requires application-specific decisions about placement, streaming, and intra-model parallelism. Existing serving systems and auto-parallelism compilers commit to limited transformations and fixed workload assumptions, so achieving high performance on a new application requires hand-crafting an efficient implementation. We present FlashRT, an agent harness that guides coding agents to lift simple developer-written reference implementations into optimized multi-GPU deployments that flexibly weigh target metrics like latency and throughput. Using a new chain-of-program paradigm, FlashRT directs a generic coding agent through a multi-pass transformation process where an agent transforms the reference into an intermediate representation (IR) to capture data dependencies and persistent-state scopes, validates this IR via a sequential interpreter, and performs static analyses to identify candidate transformations. Then, the agent iteratively implements, verifies, and benchmarks each candidate under a measurement-gated optimization loop to produce effective deployments that span different hardware budgets. Across various applications, including video world models and multimodal LLMs, FlashRT converts reference implementations into highly efficient deployments, delivering up to ~70x latency reduction and 2.8x throughput improvement on NVIDIA B200 GPUs. On AMD MI355X GPUs, FlashRT matches the peak latency reduction while increasing peak throughput improvement to 3.6x, demonstrating that agent-driven optimization can be more scalable on platforms with less mature expert optimization. In fact, for Qwen3-Omni text-to-audio inference, FlashRT reduces response latency by 65% compared to the expert vLLM-Omni implementation on AMD MI355X.

papers.title: A Continual Validation, Updating, and Decision-Making Framework for Self-Adaptive Digital Twins via Robust Model Predictive Control: A Case Study in Additive Manufacturing
papers.abstract_en: Digital Twins rely on surrogate models to mirror physical systems in real time, yet these models can degrade as operating conditions evolve, a phenomenon known as concept drift. Maintaining surrogate fidelity under drift, particularly when models must also capture aleatoric uncertainty, remains an open challenge. Existing adaptive frameworks lack principled mechanisms for detecting when updates are needed, for efficiently adapting models from limited streaming data, and for certifying that updates genuinely improve predictive performance. Here we present an adaptive Digital Twin framework that integrates a Fisher score--based multivariate drift detector, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) for parameter-efficient continual learning, and a Mann--Whitney $U$ test for online statistical validation. The framework monitors surrogate-model confidence via Fisher score vectors, triggers targeted fine-tuning of fewer than 1% of model parameters upon drift detection, and statistically certifies predictive improvement before deploying the updated surrogate. Applied to a stochastic linear system and a directed energy deposition additive manufacturing process as case studies, the framework successfully detects distributional shifts with short delays and restores both predictive accuracy and uncertainty quantification under abrupt and incremental drift. These results establish a statistically rigorous and computationally tractable pathway for sustaining the trustworthiness of neural-network--based Digital Twins throughout their operational life cycle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自适应数字孪生框架，结合基于Fisher分数的多变量漂移检测器、低秩适配（LoRA）参数高效持续学习和Mann-Whitney U统计在线验证，以应对概念漂移。在随机线性系统和定向能量沉积增材制造案例中，框架能检测分布漂移并恢复预测精度与不确定性量化。
Motivation: 数字孪生依赖的替代模型在运行条件变化时会出现概念漂移，现有自适应框架缺乏检测、高效更新和统计验证更新效果的机制。
Method: 提出集成Fisher分数漂移检测器、LoRA参数高效微调（少于1%参数）和Mann-Whitney U统计验证的框架，在漂移检测后触发微调并统计认证预测改进。
Result: 在随机线性系统和增材制造案例中，成功检测分布漂移（延迟短），并在急剧和渐进漂移下恢复预测准确性和不确定性量化。
Conclusion: 为神经网络数字孪生提供统计严格且计算可行的路径，以维持其运行生命周期内的可信度。

papers.title: OR Else: A Differentiable Trust Region for Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: PPO and the GRPO baseline studied here use clipped surrogate objectives whose favorable-direction saturation introduces an abrupt change in the scalar objective's derivative. We ask whether Output Reset (OR), a smooth one-sided saturation rule, offers a useful alternative for large language model post-training. PPO-OR and GRPO-OR replace the clipped policy term with an OR squared-margin loss in rollout-relative token log-ratio space; the advantage sign determines the update direction, and a token contributes zero direct OR residual after crossing the favorable margin. We compare PPO-clip with PPO-OR under generalized advantage estimation (GAE), and GRPO with GRPO-OR under group-relative advantages, using \texttt{Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct} on Anthropic \texttt{hh-rlhf} with one shared reward model and three seeds per method. Under GAE, PPO-OR has a mean final training-time reward-model score $0.305$ higher than PPO-clip, with a larger observed across-seed spread. Under group-relative advantages, GRPO-OR does not have a higher mean score, but shows a smaller observed spread, a near-zero terminal OR residual, and a declining overshoot fraction, while the matched GRPO clipped-objective trace remains variable. Both group-relative methods exhibit substantially larger rollout-to-current log-ratio displacement than the GAE methods, and OR does not consistently reduce it. Thus, OR changes optimization behavior in both matched comparisons, but the observed reward effect differs between them. At $G=2$, the GRPO-OR diagnostics do not translate into a reward-score gain. Whether larger groups change this outcome remains open. The reported scores are training-time reward-model measurements, not held-out human-preference performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为输出重置（Output Reset, OR）的平滑单侧饱和规则，用于替代PPO和GRPO中的裁剪替代目标，并在Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct模型上使用Anthropic hh-rlhf数据集进行后训练比较。在全量优势估计（GAE）下，PPO-OR的最终训练奖励模型得分比PPO-clip平均高0.305，但跨种子的方差更大；在组相对优势下，GRPO-OR未获得更高平均得分，但表现出更小的方差、接近零的终端OR残差和下降的超调比例。然而，OR并未一致减少对数比率位移，且奖励效果因比较设置而异。
Motivation: 标准PPO和GRPO使用的裁剪替代目标在有利方向饱和时会导致标量目标导数的突变，本文希望探索一种平滑的单侧饱和规则（OR）是否能为大语言模型后训练提供更有用的替代方案。
Method: 将PPO和GRPO中的裁剪策略项替换为OR平方边缘损失，该损失基于rollout相对token对数比率空间计算，优势符号决定更新方向，当token越过有利边缘后不再贡献直接OR残差。
Result: 在GAE下，PPO-OR平均训练奖励得分比PPO-clip高0.305；在组相对优势下，GRPO-OR未提高平均得分，但方差更小、残差接近零、超调比例下降。GRPO-OR诊断结果在G=2时未转化为奖励得分增益。
Conclusion: OR在两种比较中改变了优化行为，但观察到的奖励效果不同；更大组大小的效果仍待研究。报告得分仅为训练时奖励模型测量，并非独立人类偏好性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Calibration Channel Determines the Bayes-Error Proxy: An Exact Law for Temperature-Induced Distortion
papers.abstract_en: The soft-label Bayes-error estimator beta(z) = E[min(z, 1-z)] of Ishida et al. estimates the irreducible error of a binary task directly from probability-valued labels. Recent work by Ushio et al. showed that this estimator is fragile when the probabilities are not the true posterior: even perfectly calibrated soft labels can yield a substantially inaccurate estimate, and they propose isotonic calibration as a consistent remedy. We complement that line of work by characterizing exactly how the most widely used post-hoc calibration map -- temperature scaling -- distorts the proxy. We prove an exact, model-free identity reducing the temperature-scaled proxy to the classifier's margin distribution, from which we obtain (i) strict monotonicity in the temperature and (ii) a continuous bijection from the temperature axis onto the open interval (0, 1/2), so that a fixed classifier -- with fixed decisions and fixed 0-1 error -- can be made to report any proxy value whatsoever. Under a Gaussian model of the logits we further derive a two-parameter closed form for the entire proxy-versus-temperature curve. Across CIFAR-10, Fashion-MNIST, and SVHN (eight binary tasks), the proxy varies by 56x to 980x at constant test error, the closed form reproduces the empirical curve to within 0.018, and the calibration temperature that minimizes the expected calibration error does not coincide with any stable proxy value. Our results give a precise, predictive account of the distortion whose existence motivates calibration-based remedies, and they reinforce the practical recommendation that a proxy value is meaningful only together with the mechanism that produced its probabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了温度缩放对软标签贝叶斯误差估计器的影响，证明了一个恒等式，表明对于固定分类器，温度缩放可以使代理值取(0,1/2)内的任意值。实验显示代理值变化可达56倍至980倍，封闭形式拟合误差在0.018以内，且最小化校准误差的温度与稳定代理值不对应。
Motivation: 已有工作表明，即使软标签完全校准，贝叶斯误差代理仍可能不准确，本文旨在精确刻画温度缩放这一常用后处理校准映射如何扭曲代理。
Method: 通过理论推导证明恒等式，将温度缩放后的代理简化为分类器的边际分布，并推导出高斯对数几率下的封闭形式。在CIFAR-10、Fashion-MNIST、SVHN等数据集上进行实验验证。
Result: 对于固定分类器，温度缩放可以使代理值取(0,1/2)内的任意值；代理值变化范围达56x-980x（恒定测试误差下）；封闭形式拟合误差≤0.018；最小化ECE的温度不与任何稳定代理值重合。
Conclusion: 代理值只有在知道产生概率的机制时才有意义，进一步支持了校准方案的必要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TRIM: Reducing AI-Generated CodeSlop via Agent Trajectory Minimization
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are increasingly used to accelerate code generation in many downstream tasks, such as fixing bugs, building applications, and prototyping. However, despite their value as coding assistants, agent-generated code tends to be larger and more verbose than the corresponding human-written implementation. In this work, we show that the cause lies in the agent's own search process: while iterating toward a passing solution, an agent accumulates speculative edits, abandoned hypotheses, and temporary changes that persist into the final patch. This may seem harmless for a single patch, but the problem compounds as agents take responsibility for ever-larger portions of a codebase-a codebase that was once minimal and well-maintained slowly accumulates redundancy faster than it can be cleaned up, drifting to a state that is harder to maintain. Given the magnitude of this problem, we take a step towards alleviating this issue. First, we formally define this phenomenon as CodeSlop-the residual and functionally unnecessary edits commonly seen in AI-generated code. We then introduce our algorithm TRIM (Trajectory-guided Redundancy Identification and Minimization). Rather than minimizing CodeSlop directly, TRIM instead minimizes agent trajectories. As we show empirically, this indirect technique of minimizing CodeSlop is highly effective: TRIM cuts CodeSlop by 17.9%-32.9% across agentic scaffolds, with negligible performance regression. TRIM is also highly efficient, requiring roughly half the validation cost of algorithmic baselines such as Delta Debugging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文发现AI编码代理生成的代码比人工编写的更冗长，原因是代理在搜索过程中积累了冗余编辑，定义为CodeSlop。提出TRIM算法，通过最小化代理轨迹间接减少CodeSlop，在多个代理框架上减少17.9%-32.9%的CodeSlop，且性能损失可忽略，验证成本约为Delta Debugging的一半。
Motivation: 编码代理生成的代码存在冗余和功能性不必要的编辑，即CodeSlop，长期积累导致代码库维护困难，需要一种方法来减少这种冗余。
Method: 提出TRIM算法，通过最小化代理轨迹（即代理的搜索过程）来间接减少CodeSlop，而不是直接最小化CodeSlop本身。
Result: 在多个代理框架上，TRIM减少CodeSlop 17.9%-32.9%，性能回归可忽略，验证成本约为Delta Debugging的一半。
Conclusion: TRIM通过间接方法有效减少了AI生成代码中的冗余，具有高效性。

papers.title: Robust Multimodal Dynamic Object Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic object segmentation plays a critical role in many visual applications such as static scene reconstruction from dynamic videos. However, existing optical flow-based methods fail to ensure consistent static/dynamic segmentation along object boundaries, while 3D reconstruction-based approaches are highly sensitive to reconstruction errors. To address these limitations, we present a dynamic object segmentation framework that can generate both precise and complete dynamic masks by integrating multimodal cues including 2D point tracks, 3D reconstruction, and semantic information. We design a network combining Transformer architectures with feature clustering aggregation modules to perform static/dynamic classification of multimodal feature trajectories. It enables the model to adaptively determine which type of feature should dominate based on the characteristics of each scene, while also mitigating the impact of feature degradation. Additionally, we introduce a novel point-query-based SAM post-processing method capable of handling multiple objects within a single mask. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance in both dynamic object segmentation and static scene reconstruction tasks.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE International Conference on Robotics & Automation ICRA 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种鲁棒的多模态动态物体分割框架，通过融合2D点轨迹、3D重建和语义信息，利用Transformer与特征聚类聚合模块实现静态/动态分类，并引入点查询SAM后处理方法处理多物体掩码。实验表明该方法在动态物体分割和静态场景重建任务上达到当前最优性能。
Motivation: 现有基于光流的方法在物体边界处无法保证一致的静态/动态分割，而基于3D重建的方法对重建误差高度敏感。
Method: 设计结合Transformer与特征聚类聚合模块的网络，对多模态特征轨迹进行静态/动态分类，并引入基于点查询的SAM后处理方法以处理单掩码中的多物体情形。
Result: 在动态物体分割和静态场景重建任务上取得最先进的性能。
Conclusion: 所提框架能根据场景特性自适应决定主导特征类型，同时缓解特征退化带来的影响。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Plenoptic Condensation: A Novel Approach to Generalized Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: We present a novel Generalized Scene Reconstruction (GSR) approach called Plenoptic Condensation (PCon). PCon uses a multi-stage reconstruction pipeline, initially converting images into "soupy" scene elements with low (representational) power, then adaptively condensing the "soup" into "structured" elements of higher power capable of efficiently representing, for example, sharp edges and smooth reflective surfaces. PCon scene models called Reality Models (Relms) enable spatially varying representational power, which is essential for high-fidelity rendering, measurement, and scene understanding. We showcase several in-the-wild PCon reconstructions captured with consumer phone cameras and drones. In one case called "Damaged Fiat", PCon is benchmarked against two state-of-the-art (SOTA) GSR methods: NeRO and RT-Splatting. Referring to Figure 1 below, PCon reconstructs the car hood more than twice as accurately as the SOTA methods. But more importantly, the local damage profile error for PCon is 35 um (0.035 mm), whereas the two other SOTA methods are essentially unable to measure the damage at all. Our project website is available at https://quidient.github.io/pcon-2026.html.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出全光凝聚（Plenoptic Condensation, PCon）方法，用于广义场景重建（GSR）。PCon采用多阶段重建流程，先将图像转换为低功率的“汤状”场景元素，再自适应凝聚为高功率的“结构化”元素，以高效表示尖锐边缘和光滑反射表面。生成的现实模型（Reality Models, Relms）支持空间变化表示能力，对于高保真渲染、测量和场景理解至关重要。论文展示了用消费级手机和无人机拍摄的多个户外重建实例，其中在“受损菲亚特”案例中，PCon在引擎盖重建精度上比SOTA方法（NeRO和RT-Splatting）高两倍以上，局部损伤剖面误差为35微米，而其他方法几乎无法测量损伤。
Motivation: 现有场景重建方法在处理复杂表面（如尖锐边缘和光滑反射）时精度有限，且难以支持空间变化的表示能力，无法满足高保真渲染和精确测量需求。
Method: 提出多阶段重建管道：首先将输入图像转换为低功率的“汤状”场景元素，然后通过自适应凝聚过程形成高功率的“结构化”元素，最终构建称为现实模型（Relm）的场景表示，该模型具有空间可变的表示能力。
Result: 在“受损菲亚特”案例中，PCon重建引擎盖的精度比SOTA方法（NeRO和RT-Splatting）高两倍以上，局部损伤剖面误差为35微米（0.035 mm），而两种SOTA方法基本无法测量损伤。
Conclusion: PCon通过多阶段凝聚和空间可变表示，显著提升了场景重建的精度，尤其在精细损伤测量方面优于现有方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lossless-INR: Lossless Volumetric Implicit Neural Representations
papers.abstract_en: Implicit neural representation (INR) methods provide continuous coordinate-to-value mappings and integrate naturally with direct volume rendering, making them attractive for representing volumetric data. However, existing INR-based approaches for volumetric data are inherently lossy, and even small reconstruction errors can propagate through rendering and downstream analysis. In this work, we explore Lossless-INR, a lossless INR framework for 3D scientific volumetric data based on bit-plane decomposition. By decomposing each voxel value into binary bit-planes, we reformulate reconstruction as per-bit binary classification, so that exact recovery reduces to predicting every bit correctly. To make this optimization tractable while keeping the representation compact, we combine an octree block-partitioning strategy that adaptively subdivides complex regions with a ternary feature-grid network whose grid entries are parameterized by a ternary set of values. Experiments on diverse volumetric datasets show that this design can achieve zero bit-error rate and bit-exact reconstruction, enabling faithful rendering and downstream analysis with a compact representation. The code is available at https://github.com/TouKaienn/Lossless-INR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Lossless-INR，一种基于位平面分解和三元特征网格网络的无损隐式神经表示框架，用于 3D 科学体数据。通过将体素值分解为二进制位平面，将重建问题转化为逐位二进制分类，结合八叉树块分区策略和三元特征网格，实现零比特错误率的精确重建。实验表明该方法能在紧凑表示下实现无损渲染和下游分析。
Motivation: 现有隐式神经表示（INR）方法在体数据重建中本质上有损，即使很小的重建误差也会通过渲染和下游分析传播，影响结果准确性。
Method: 提出基于位平面分解（bit-plane decomposition）的无损 INR 框架，将每个体素值分解为二进制位平面，将重建转化为每个比特的二进制分类问题。结合八叉树块分区策略（octree block-partitioning）自适应细分复杂区域，以及三元特征网格网络（ternary feature-grid network），其网格条目由三元值集合参数化，以保持紧凑表示的同时使优化可行。
Result: 在多种体数据集上实现零比特错误率（zero bit-error rate）和比特精确重建（bit-exact reconstruction），实现保真渲染和下游分析，且表示紧凑。
Conclusion: 摘要强调本设计可达到无损重建，代码已开源。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Differentiable Logic Gate Networks for Low-Latency EEG Classification on Edge Devices
papers.abstract_en: Real-time EEG classification on edge devices is bottlenecked by the floating-point arithmetic of conventional neural networks. We investigated Differentiable Logic Gate Networks (Diff-Logic) as a hardware-native alternative that compiles models into pure Boolean circuits executable via bitwise CPU operations. Through rigorous iso-parameter experiments across four EEG datasets spanning two classification tasks, binary dementia detection and 3-class emotion recognition, we compared Diff-Logic against matched-capacity Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) and Binarized Neural Network (BNN) baselines at four complexity tiers (50k-500k parameters). On dementia screening, Diff-Logic achieved 80.2% Macro F1, outperforming the MLP baseline by 6.8%. On emotion recognition, the MLP retained a moderate performance advantage but incurred a 2.3$\times$ higher latency and 14$\times$ larger model size when deployed on a power-constrained (7W) Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano CPU (Single-core). Critically, Diff-Logic inference time remained nearly constant across a 10$\times$ increase in model scale, achieving a peak speedup of 2.9$\times$ over MLPs at the largest complexity tier. Our results establish logic-based neural architectures as a practical paradigm for resource-constrained brain-computer interfaces, achieving competitive or superior performance while natively satisfying the latency and memory constraints of portable edge deployment. Code is available on GitHub: https://github.com/Shyamal-Dharia/eeg-difflogic
papers.comment: Published in the Proceedings of the 39th Canadian Conference on Artificial Intelligence, PMLR 318, pages 377-391, 2026. Conference version: https://proceedings.mlr.press/v318/dharia26a.html
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 39th Canadian Conference on Artificial Intelligence, PMLR 318:377-391, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究可微逻辑门网络（Diff-Logic）用于边缘设备上的实时EEG分类，将其编译为纯布尔电路，通过位运算执行。在四个EEG数据集上，针对二类痴呆检测和三类情绪识别任务，与同等参数量的MLP和二值化神经网络（BNN）对比，Diff-Logic在痴呆检测上宏F1达80.2%，超过MLP 6.8%；在情绪识别上MLP性能稍优但延迟高2.3倍、模型大小大14倍。Diff-Logic推理时间在模型规模增加10倍时几乎恒定，最大加速比达2.9倍。
Motivation: 传统神经网络在边缘设备上进行实时EEG分类时，浮点运算成为瓶颈，难以满足低延迟要求。
Method: 采用可微逻辑门网络（Diff-Logic），将模型编译为纯布尔电路，通过CPU的位运算执行，替代传统浮点运算。
Result: 在痴呆检测任务上，Diff-Logic宏F1为80.2%，优于MLP 6.8%；在情绪识别上，MLP性能略优但延迟高2.3倍、模型大14倍。Diff-Logic推理时间在参数规模从50k到500k（10倍）时几乎不变，最大速度是MLP的2.9倍。
Conclusion: 基于逻辑的神经架构可作为资源受限脑机接口的实用范式，在满足边缘部署延迟和内存约束的同时，达到竞争性或更优的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Totally Positive Matrices and the Highest-Order Coefficients of the Characteristic Polynomial
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the extent to which totally positive matrices can be distinguished through the highest-order coefficients of their characteristic polynomials. To identify the most informative coefficients, we also employed neural-network classifiers together with feature-attribution methods. Using datasets built from several structured totally positive families, including products of positive bidiagonal matrices, Vandermonde matrices, and Cauchy matrices, we find that the coefficients (a_{n-1}, a_{n-2}, a_{n-3}) already contain strong discriminatory information for separating totally positive from non-totally positive matrices in dimensions 5, 10, and 30. The resulting separation is markedly nonlinear and admits a natural geometric description in the corresponding three-dimensional coefficient space by means of Mahalanobis ellipsoids. These ellipsoids enclose the totally positive samples while excluding most non-totally positive ones. Moreover, different structured totally positive families exhibit distinct ellipsoidal signatures, and the separation between these signatures increases with the dimension. These observations lead us to formulate a conjecture on the geometric separation of structured totally positive families in the space determined by the three highest-order characteristic coefficients.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 12 figures, 3 tables. Published open access in Linear Algebra and its Applications
papers.journal_ref: Linear Algebra and its Applications 750 (2026) 24-52
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究完全正矩阵（totally positive matrices）能否通过其特征多项式的最高次系数加以区分，并借助神经网络分类器和特征归因方法识别最具信息量的系数。基于多个结构化完全正族（包括正双对角矩阵乘积、Vandermonde 矩阵和 Cauchy 矩阵）构造的数据集，发现系数 (a_{n-1}, a_{n-2}, a_{n-3}) 已在维度 5、10 和 30 上对完全正矩阵与非完全正矩阵具有强区分能力。这种区分是非线性的，可在对应的三维系数空间中通过马氏椭球获得自然几何描述，且不同结构化完全正族表现出不同的椭球签名，签名间的分离度随维度增加而增大。由此提出关于结构化完全正族在最高次系数空间中几何分离的猜想。
Motivation: 完全正矩阵是线性代数中的重要结构，但其辨识标准尚不充分；本文探索利用特征多项式最高次系数进行高效区分的可能性。
Method: 结合神经网络分类器与特征归因方法，从特征多项式的多项系数中筛选最具区分力的系数；在由正双对角矩阵乘积、Vandermonde 矩阵和 Cauchy 矩阵组成的结构化完全正族数据集上训练和评估；利用马氏椭球进行几何分离描述。
Result: 系数 (a_{n-1}, a_{n-2}, a_{n-3}) 在三个维度上均表现出强区分力；不同结构化完全正族的马氏椭球签名不同且维度越高分离越好；分离具有高度的非线性几何特征。
Conclusion: 本文表明三个最高次系数足以有效区分完全正矩阵与非完全正矩阵，并揭示了结构化完全正族在该系数空间中的几何分离性质，为矩阵分类提供了新见解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLMs and Agentic AI Systems for Smart Grids: A Tutorial on Architectures and Applications
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) and agentic AI systems have evolved from natural language tasks to using external tools to plan, retrieve, and act in technical domains. In smart grids, recent work applies agentic schemes to forecasting, optimization, and control, wrapping trusted solvers behind language interfaces and orchestrating multi-step workflows. The literature lacks a unified approach to designing and evaluating such systems. LLMs can produce numerically plausible yet physically infeasible outputs, evaluation protocols vary across tasks, and the boundary between what the model should and should not compute is implicit. This paper presents a solver-grounded design principle: a numerical result is reported only when it originates from a trusted tool and passes explicit verification. We review the building blocks of LLM and agentic AI systems for power systems: prompting strategies and agentic architectures. We instantiate the principle in four case studies: wind power forecasting, EV charging scheduling, power flow analysis, and contingency diagnosis, each comparing an LLM-only baseline against its solver-grounded counterpart on identical data and metrics. EVAgent reproduces the CVXPY optimum while reducing LLM-only unmet energy by 7.5-9.5x, and GridDebugAgent repairs 17/39 contingency cases while reducing total violations by 52.3%. We propose a four-group evaluation framework spanning task utility, solver-grounded correctness, faithfulness and safe failure, and cost and latency. A consistent division of labor emerges: the agentic system reliably orchestrates, retrieves, and explains, while trusted tools compute and a verification gate decides what is reported.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于智能电网中大型语言模型（LLM）和自主AI系统（agentic AI systems）的综述/教程，提出基于求解器（solver-grounded）的设计原则：数值结果仅当源自可信工具并通过显式验证时才报告。通过四个案例研究（风电预测、电动汽车充电调度、潮流分析、故障诊断）展示该原则，EVAgent复现CVXPY最优解并减少LLM未满足能量7.5-9.5倍，GridDebugAgent修复17/39个案例并减少总违规52.3%。提出四组评估框架（任务效用、求解器正确性、忠实性与安全失败、成本与延迟）。
Motivation: 现有文献缺乏统一设计和评估智能电网中LLM/智能体系统的方法；LLM可能产生物理上不可行的输出，评估协议因任务而异，模型应计算什么、不应计算什么的边界不明确。
Method: 提出基于求解器的设计原则：数值结果仅当源自可信工具并通过显式验证时才报告。综述了电力系统中LLM和智能体系统的构建模块（提示策略和智能体架构），并在四个案例研究中比较了纯LLM基线与基于求解器的对应方法。
Result: EVAgent在充电调度中复现CVXPY最优解，同时将纯LLM未满足能量减少7.5-9.5倍；GridDebugAgent在故障诊断中修复17/39个案例，总违规减少52.3%。提出四组评估框架：任务效用、基于求解器的正确性、忠实性和安全失败、成本和延迟。
Conclusion: 出现了明确的分工：智能体系统可靠地协调、检索和解释，而可信工具负责计算，验证门控决定报告内容。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do Language Models Dream of Binding Molecules? Benchmarking LLMs under Spatial Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Structure-based drug design (SBDD) leverages the 3D structure of protein targets, often complemented by other spatial constraints, to generate candidate binding molecules. While diffusion models have dominated as a leading paradigm for high-quality 3D molecule generation, LLM-based methods are rapidly emerging in molecular design and have shown competitive performance in pocket-conditioned molecular generation. However, their ability to reason about physics and 3D spatial environments is largely underexplored. In this work, we systematically analyze whether current general-purpose LLMs are capable of navigating complex 3D constraints compared to established baselines such as specialized diffusion models. We consider 3D ligand generation conditioned on protein pockets together with ligand- and interaction-derived spatial constraints, including anchor fragments, pharmacophore points, and mandatory pocket-ligand interactions. To enable this evaluation, we introduce 3D-Fit - a token-efficient benchmarking strategy for assessing LLM performance on multi-conditioned spatial molecule generation. Our findings reveal a clear pattern in LLM spatial capabilities: while they still lag behind state-of-the-art approaches, they are promising and can handle multiple spatial constraints simultaneously, enabling scaling to heterogeneous setups.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估通用大语言模型（LLM）在三维空间约束下的分子生成能力，与专用扩散模型等基线对比。引入3D-Fit基准测试策略，考虑口袋条件、锚片段、药效团点及强制相互作用等多约束。发现LLM虽落后于最先进方法，但能同时处理多种空间约束，具有扩展潜力。
Motivation: 现有结构基药物设计（SBDD）中，扩散模型占主导，但LLM在分子设计领域快速兴起，其在三维空间推理和物理约束处理能力尚不明确。
Method: 提出3D-Fit基准测试，评估LLM在蛋白口袋条件及衍生空间约束（锚片段、药效团点、强制相互作用）下的三维配体生成性能。
Result: LLM在三维分子生成任务上仍落后于最新扩散模型，但能同时处理多种空间约束，展现多条件异构场景的扩展能力。
Conclusion: 当前通用LLM在三维空间约束推理方面虽不及专用模型，但具有处理多约束的潜力，为未来改进提供方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: O-VAD: Industrial Video Anomaly Detection through Object-Centric Tracking and Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Industrial Video Anomaly Detection (IVAD) aims to identify anomalous objects and events in an industrial process, which is crucial for modern manufacturing and quality control systems. Existing VLM-based anomaly reasoning methods are capable of detecting open-ended anomalies in general domains. However, their performance declines in industrial settings characterized by intricate object transformations, strict physics, and procedural constraints. To tackle the complexity of such interaction-intensive detection, we introduce a training-free agentic framework for anomaly detection free of domain-specific knowledge, emphasizing object state evolution like humans inspectors. It is designed to track spatial-temporal dynamics and underlying transformations of detected objects over time, and then reason over the object-wise temporal state trajectories to identify abnormal objects in grounded frames. Our method overcomes limitations of prior approaches that rely on retraining on normal clips or injecting domain knowledge as context for test-time inference. Extensive experiments on three IVAD datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms frontier VLMs, agentic frameworks, and traditional VAD methods fine-tuned on the respective datasets, while providing interpretable reports over anomaly processes and types.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出O-VAD，一个无需训练的agentic框架，用于工业视频异常检测，通过以对象为中心的跟踪和推理来检测异常。该方法模拟人类检查员的方式，追踪对象空间-时间动态和状态演变，然后推理对象时间状态轨迹以识别异常。在三个IVAD数据集上，该方法优于前沿的VLM、agentic框架以及在各自数据集上微调的传统VAD方法。
Motivation: 现有基于VLM的异常推理方法在工业场景中表现下降，因为工业场景涉及复杂的物体转换、严格的物理和过程约束，且现有方法需要重新训练或注入领域知识。
Method: 提出一个无需训练、无需领域知识的agentic框架，以对象为中心跟踪检测对象的空间-时间动态和潜在变换，然后基于对象时间状态轨迹进行异常推理。
Result: 在三个IVAD数据集上，该方法优于前沿VLM、agentic框架以及在各自数据集上微调的传统VAD方法，并提供可解释的异常报告。
Conclusion: 该方法强调对象状态演变如人类检查员，克服了依赖正常片段重训练或测试时注入领域知识的局限，提供了可解释的异常过程与类型报告。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections for Parameter-Efficient Finetuning
papers.abstract_en: Most parameter-efficient finetuning (PEFT) methods adapt weights or activations, thus leaving one of the key Transformer components unchanged: residual connections. This paper investigates Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC), a generalisation of residual connections, as a novel PEFT approach, wrapping frozen OLMo-2 backbones with learned residual routing modules. We find that mHC can finetune frozen Transformers, but that its role differs fundamentally from the original pre-training setting: in finetuning, fixing the residual mixing matrix to identity often improves performance. As a standalone PEFT method, mHC does not consistently outperform LoRA. However, at matched trainable parameter budgets, mHC+LoRA combinations improve language-modelling loss and show task-dependent benchmark gains at both 1B and 7B scale. Overall, our results identify residual routing as a distinct and promising novel PEFT axis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出流形约束超连接（Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections, mHC）作为参数高效微调（PEFT）的新方法，它是对Transformer中残差连接的泛化。实验发现，在微调中将残差混合矩阵固定为单位阵通常能提升性能。mHC单独使用时并不一致优于LoRA，但在相同参数量预算下，mHC与LoRA的组合能改善语言模型损失，并在1B和7B规模的基准测试中展现出任务依赖的性能提升。研究将残差路由识别为一个有前景的新PEFT方向。
Motivation: 现有PEFT方法主要调整权重或激活，但忽略了残差连接这一关键组件。本文旨在探索将残差连接泛化作为PEFT手段的可行性。
Method: 提出流形约束超连接（mHC），作为残差连接的泛化，在冻结的OLMo-2骨干网络上包裹可学习的残差路由模块。在微调过程中，将残差混合矩阵固定为单位阵。
Result: mHC作为独立PEFT方法时并不始终优于LoRA。但在匹配可训练参数预算下，mHC+LoRA组合在语言模型损失上有所改善，并在1B和7B规模的基准测试中显示出任务依赖的增益。
Conclusion: 残差路由被证明是一个有前景的新PEFT方向，尤其在与LoRA结合使用时效果更佳。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ClouDens: Operational Context-Aware Anomaly Detection for Large-scale Cloud System Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid growth of cloud computing infrastructures in scale and complexity, network monitoring for Large-scale Cloud Systems (LCSs) has become increasingly challenging, requiring automated and reliable anomaly detection to maintain service availability. Modern LCSs continuously generate telemetry logs from distributed cloud services, producing high-dimensional multivariate time series that capture system operations. Detecting anomalies in this context is difficult due to extreme dimensionality, complex dependencies among distributed components, and severe sparsity from intermittently active services. Taking these challenges into account, we first conduct an empirical study on telemetry logs from the IBM Cloud Console platform, and then propose ClouDens, an anomaly detection framework tailored to LCS monitoring that leverages operational-context attributes encoded in the telemetry log schema to improve detection accuracy and early identification of anomalies. ClouDens partitions high-dimensional telemetry logs into domain-guided subsets, constructs a context-aware graph modeling operational service dependencies, and employs Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks for forecasting-based anomaly detection. We evaluate ClouDens on the recently released IBM Cloud Telemetry Dataset and provide practical insights into designing reliable anomaly detection solutions for LCS monitoring. Results show ClouDens achieves higher NAB scores in count-based telemetry features, indicating more accurate, earlier anomaly detection with broader coverage than a GRU-based model. Our study further reveals that telemetry feature subsets, operational-context modeling, scoring strategies, and sparsity imputation all substantially influence detection performance, offering practical guidance for designing and fairly benchmarking anomaly detection approaches for LCS monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文提出ClouDens框架，针对大规模云系统网络监控中的异常检测，利用操作上下文属性，将高维遥测日志分区，构建上下文感知图，使用时空图神经网络进行基于预测的异常检测。在IBM Cloud Telemetry数据集上评估，相比GRU模型取得更高NAB分数，实现更早更准确的异常检测。
Motivation: 现代大规模云系统持续生成高维多变量时间序列遥测日志，维度极高、组件间依赖复杂、服务间歇性活动导致严重稀疏性，使得异常检测困难。
Method: 提出ClouDens框架，将高维遥测日志划分为领域引导的子集，构建上下文感知图建模操作服务依赖，采用时空图神经网络进行基于预测的异常检测。
Result: 在IBM Cloud Telemetry数据集上，ClouDens在计数型遥测特征上获得更高NAB分数，表明更准确、更早、更广覆盖的异常检测，优于GRU基线。
Conclusion: 摘要指出遥测特征子集、操作上下文建模、评分策略和稀疏性插值都显著影响检测性能，为设计可靠的大规模云系统监控异常检测方案提供实践指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: COVAriance-Induced Fairness Gap Penalty for Subgroup-Fair Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Fair clustering aims to make cluster assignments independent of sensitive attributes, but this goal becomes challenging when multiple sensitive attributes jointly define many subgroups. In such settings, directly extending existing fair clustering algorithms is computationally expensive or numerically unstable, especially when the number of subgroups grows exponentially and some subgroups contain only a few instances. To address these challenges, we define a subgroup-fairness gap for clustering and derive a covariance-based surrogate that exactly matches this gap. We then introduce a continuous relaxation of the surrogate, enabling efficient gradient-based optimization and yielding our proposed algorithm, COVA-FC. We also show that subgroup fairness alone does not imply marginal fairness, and extend our framework to capture a subgroup-marginal-fairness gap. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that COVA-FC achieves competitive cost-fairness trade-offs and improves computational efficiency over existing baselines in both subgroup and higher-order marginal settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对具有多个敏感属性的子组公平聚类问题，提出了一种基于协方差的公平性差距惩罚项，并设计了COVA-FC算法。该算法通过连续松弛实现高效的梯度优化，实验表明在子组和边际公平性设定下均能取得有竞争力的成本-公平权衡。
Motivation: 当多个敏感属性联合定义大量子组时，直接扩展现有公平聚类算法计算成本高或数值不稳定，尤其当子组数量指数增长且部分子组样本稀少时。
Method: 定义子组公平性差距，推导其协方差代理项，并引入连续松弛以支持梯度优化，从而提出COVA-FC算法。同时扩展框架以捕获子组-边际公平性差距。
Result: 在基准数据集上，COVA-FC在子组和更高阶边际设定下均实现了有竞争力的成本-公平权衡，并提升了计算效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提出的协方差代理项能有效匹配子组公平性差距，且算法在多个设定下优于现有基线。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调所提出的协方差代理项能有效匹配子组公平性差距，且算法在多个设定下优于现有基线。

papers.title: SGA: Plug&Play Geometric Verification for Educational Video Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Recent work leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate executable code for pedagogical animations using libraries such as Manim. However, ensuring spatial correctness and visual legibility remains challenging, as existing frameworks emphasize pedagogical content while overlooking geometric occlusions. We propose the Symbolic Geometric Agent (SGA), a plug-and-play module for code-centric animation pipelines that intercepts LLM-generated code, performs partial execution to extract symbolic scene graphs, and applies targeted refinement when spatial conflicts are detected. We further introduce the Manim Visual Quality Score (MVQS), a deterministic rendering-free proxy for spatial integrity. Experiments on the MMMC-Code benchmark across four LLM backbones and two agentic pipelines show that SGA achieves a peak MVQS of 73.11 (Code2Video + GPT-5.1), corresponding to a 16.1% relative improvement over the raw baseline, and improves MVQS in 7 of 8 backbone x pipeline configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出符号几何智能体（SGA），一种即插即用模块，用于代码驱动动画管线。SGA拦截LLM生成的代码，部分执行以提取符号场景图，并在检测到空间冲突时进行针对性细化。同时引入Manim视觉质量评分（MVQS），一种无需渲染的空间完整性代理指标。在MMMC-Code基准上，使用四个LLM骨干和两个智能体管线，SGA在Code2Video+GPT-5.1配置下达到73.11的MVQS峰值，相比原始基线相对提升16.1%，并在7/8个骨干×管线配置中改进了MVQS。
Motivation: 现有教育视频合成框架强调教学内容而忽视几何遮挡，导致空间正确性和视觉可读性不足。
Method: 提出Symbolic Geometric Agent (SGA)，作为代码驱动动画管线的即插即用模块，通过部分执行LLM生成的代码提取符号场景图，并在检测到空间冲突时应用目标细化。
Result: 在MMMC-Code基准上，SGA在Code2Video+GPT-5.1配置下MVQS达到73.11，相对基线提升16.1%，并在8种配置中的7种上改进MVQS。
Conclusion: SGA作为一种即插即用几何验证模块，能有效提升教育视频合成中的空间完整性，且无需完整渲染。

papers.title: How Does Alignment Tuning Shape Representations of Sycophancy and Related Cue-Induced Biases in LLMs?
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLMs are alarmingly susceptible to surprisingly simple immaterial changes of input prompts: a casual hint, an incorrectly labeled few-shot example, or a fake prior assistant turn often flips an originally correct answer. We study where this susceptibility, spanning sycophancy and related cue-induced biases, lives inside the model. Across five model families and seven BCT bias types, we extract a per-bias direction from hidden states and triangulate it through three measures: probing, leave-one-dataset-out transfer, and causal intervention. The susceptibility is largely installed by alignment tuning rather than pretraining: pretrained base models barely cave to these biases, and their activations carry no cue-specific signal beyond question content. Within aligned models, each bias becomes a single coherent direction that we can both decode and steer along, recovering the unbiased answer across every family we test. The biases stay representationally distinct, however: cross-bias entanglement is model-specific rather than a property of the bias category, and even behaviorally similar biases occupy different directions. The same intervention also serves as a modest debiasing tool, recovering a meaningful share of bias-induced errors while preserving most correct answers across all instruct families. Cue-induced bias is therefore best understood not as a single flaw in LLMs but as a family of distinct, causally active directions that alignment tuning installs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）对输入提示中无关变化（如随意提示、错误标注的少样本示例、虚假的先前助手回合）的敏感性，即谄媚和相关线索诱导偏见。通过五个模型家族和七种偏见类型，从隐藏状态提取每种偏见的方向，并通过探测、跨数据集迁移和因果干预进行三角验证。主要发现：这种偏见主要由对齐微调（alignment tuning）引入，而非预训练；基线模型几乎没有这种偏见。对齐模型中，每种偏见是单一连贯的方向，可以解码和操控，跨家族恢复无偏答案。偏见在表征上是分离的，跨偏见纠缠是模型特定的。该干预可作为适度的去偏工具，恢复大部分偏见错误同时保留正确答案。
Motivation: LLM 对输入提示的无关变化非常敏感，导致错误答案，这包括谄媚和线索诱导偏见。理解这种敏感性在模型中的位置和来源。
Method: 使用五个模型家族和七种偏见类型，从隐藏状态提取每种偏见的方向，并通过三种测量方法（探测、留一数据集迁移、因果干预）进行三角验证。
Result: 偏见主要由对齐微调安装，而非预训练；对齐模型中每种偏见是单一连贯的方向，可以解码和操控；偏见在表征上分离；干预可恢复部分错误同时保留正确答案。
Conclusion: 线索诱导偏见不是单一点缺陷，而是对齐微调安装的一系列不同、因果活跃的方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Occlusion-Aware Panoptic Segmentation with Joint Position Embedding and Occlusion-Level Attention
papers.abstract_en: Panoptic segmentation in complex scenes remains challenging because of occlusions, yet modern approaches often neglect occlusion modelling. In this paper, we propose \textbf{P}osition \textbf{E}mbedding \textbf{M}odulation with \textbf{O}cclusion-\textbf{L}evel \textbf{A}ttention (PEMOLA), a novel occlusion-aware module that can be seamlessly integrated into transformer-based panoptic segmentation. To obtain occlusion cues, we train an occlusion classifier on the COCO-OLAC dataset. The classifier derives the occlusion-level attention, which serves as spatial guidance, while the occlusion labels are encoded into a learnable embedding to produce channel-wise weights. Through joint modulation, PEMOLA elegantly introduces the occlusion priors into the position embedding, thereby improving the occlusion modelling. We further annotate the Cityscapes dataset with occlusion levels, termed Cityscapes Occlusion Labels for All Computer Vision Tasks (Cityscapes-OLAC), following the same labelling protocol as COCO-OLAC, to evaluate the cross-dataset generalisation ability of PEMOLA. Extensive experiments on COCO-OLAC and Cityscapes-OLAC demonstrate that PEMOLA consistently improves panoptic segmentation quality while introducing minimal computational overhead. These results highlight the importance of occlusion modelling, where incorporating occlusion-level attention helps deliver robust panoptic segmentation under occlusion. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/wenbo-wei/PEMOLA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对复杂场景中遮挡导致全景分割困难的问题，提出PEMOLA模块，通过联合位置嵌入调制和遮挡级别注意力引入遮挡先验。在COCO-OLAC和Cityscapes-OLAC数据集上的实验表明，PEMOLA一致提升全景分割质量，且计算开销极低。作者还标注了Cityscapes-OLAC数据集以评估跨数据集泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有全景分割方法通常忽略遮挡建模，而遮挡在复杂场景中普遍存在，严重影响分割质量。
Method: 提出PEMOLA模块：在COCO-OLAC上训练遮挡分类器得到遮挡级别注意力作为空间引导，并将遮挡标签编码为可学习嵌入产生通道权重，通过联合调制将遮挡先验引入位置嵌入。
Result: 在COCO-OLAC和Cityscapes-OLAC上，PEMOLA一致提升全景分割质量（如PQ），且计算开销极小。
Conclusion: 结果表明遮挡建模对全景分割至关重要，PEMOLA能有效利用遮挡级别注意力提升鲁棒性，且跨数据集泛化良好。

papers.title: LLM-as-a-Coach: Experiential Learning for Non-Verifiable Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) on open-ended tasks compresses an LLM's rubric-based evaluation into a scalar reward, discarding rich textual feedback and conflating responses with distinct quality profiles. We propose Experiential Learning (EL), which repurposes the feedback model from an LLM-as-a-Judge into an LLM-as-a-Coach. The coach distills its assessment of each on-policy response into transferable experiential knowledge, which conditions a teacher model and is internalized by the policy through on-policy context distillation. Compared with scalar rewards, this higher-bandwidth feedback channel provides dense supervision and preserves fine-grained preferences among high-quality responses. Across two policy families, with feedback from the policy itself or a proprietary model, EL consistently outperforms rubric-based RL on held-out and unseen open-ended tasks. Notably, EL generalizes better beyond the training distribution, and mitigates reward hacking. These findings establish experiential knowledge as a richer and more generalizable learning signal for post-training on non-verifiable tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对开放任务中强化学习将基于评分标准的评估压缩为标量奖励而丢失丰富文本反馈的问题，提出体验学习（Experiential Learning, EL）方法，将评估模型从LLM-as-a-Judge重构为LLM-as-a-Coach，通过传递性体验知识和在线上下文蒸馏提供高带宽反馈。实验表明EL在两项策略族上均优于基于评分标准的强化学习，在保留和未见开放任务中表现更好，且泛化能力更强、减轻奖励黑客攻击。
Motivation: 现有强化学习在开放任务中将基于评分标准的评估压缩为标量奖励，丢弃了丰富的文本反馈，且无法区分具有不同质量特征的响应。
Method: 提出体验学习（EL），将LLM-as-a-Judge的反馈模型转化为LLM-as-a-Coach，教练模型将对每个在线策略响应的评估提炼为可传递的体验知识，该知识条件化教师模型，并通过在线上下文蒸馏被策略内化。
Result: 在两种策略族上，使用策略自身或闭源模型的反馈，EL在保留和未见开放任务上均持续优于基于评分标准的强化学习，且泛化能力更强、减轻奖励黑客攻击。
Conclusion: 体验知识作为非可验证任务后训练中更丰富、更可泛化的学习信号。

papers.title: SpEmoC: A Balanced Speaker-Segment Multimodal Emotion Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Understanding human emotions in spoken conversations is a key challenge in affective computing, with applications in empathetic AI, human computer interaction, and mental health monitoring. However, existing datasets vary in scale, emotion distribution, modality alignment, and data partitioning strategies, which can influence reliable cross-dataset generalization and minority-emotion modeling. We introduce SpEmoC a Speaking segment Emotion for Conversations comprising 306,544 raw clips from 3,100 English language movies and TV series. From these, 30,000 high quality, class balanced clips are curated, featuring synchronized visual, audio, and textual modalities annotated for seven emotions through a hybrid pipeline that integrates pretrained models with human validation. SpEmoC uses strict movie- and series-level splits to prevent content overlap between split sets, allowing more reliable evaluation of model generalization. The dataset also maintains a near-balanced distribution across seven emotions, including minority classes such as Fear and Disgust, which supports more balanced learning across categories. Extensive experiments, including in-domain benchmarking, cross-dataset transfer, low-data training, class-imbalance analysis, and modality transfer show that balanced data and careful splitting lead to more stable performance across emotions when models are evaluated on other datasets. These results highlight the importance of dataset design for robust and transferable multimodal emotion recognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SpEmoC，一个平衡说话者片段的多模态情感基准数据集，包含30,000个高质量、类别平衡的剪辑，来自3,100个电影和电视剧，标注了七种情感，采用严格的电影和电视剧级别分割防止数据泄露。实验表明平衡数据和仔细分割有助于跨数据集泛化和少数情感建模。
Motivation: 现有数据集在规模、情感分布、模态对齐和数据划分策略上存在差异，影响可靠的跨数据集泛化和少数情感建模，因此需要一个新的平衡基准。
Method: 从3,100个电影和电视剧中提取306,544个原始剪辑，筛选出30,000个高质量、类别平衡的剪辑，通过结合预训练模型和人工验证的混合管道进行注释，并采用严格的电影和电视剧级别分割以防止内容重叠。
Result: 实验包括域内基准测试、跨数据集迁移、低数据训练、类别不平衡分析和模态迁移，结果表明平衡数据和仔细分割使模型在其他数据集上表现更稳定。
Conclusion: 强调数据集设计对于鲁棒和可迁移的多模态情感识别至关重要。

papers.title: Empowering On-Device Model Adaptation with an Edge AI Inference Accelerator
papers.abstract_en: On-device model adaptation is essential to enable lifelong personalization on resource-constrained hardware, but compute, power, and memory limitations of such devices make end-to-end backpropagation impractical for modern deep neural networks. This work proposes a heterogeneous adaptation pipeline that repurposes a commercial edge AI inference accelerator, Hailo-8L, for frozen-backbone feature extraction during on-device training. The computational graph is partitioned so that the pre-trained backbone is quantized to INT8 and run on the accelerator, while only a lightweight FP32 classification head is fine-tuned on the host CPU, enabling frequent, energy-efficient in-field updates with most weights remaining fixed. Across multiple architectures and datasets, this pipeline achieves up to 15.4x faster wall-clock training time compared to a Raspberry Pi 5 CPU baseline, offers competitive throughput in favorable settings, and consistently reduces energy per sample. Post-training quantization restoration is shown to be crucial for preserving the quality of accelerator-generated features and mitigating accuracy loss in quantization-sensitive architectures. Overall, the results demonstrate a practical approach to efficient on-device adaptation using inference-oriented edge accelerators. The implementation is available at https://github.com/MatPiech/accelerator-training.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ITEM Workshop, held in conjunction with ECML-PKDD 2026. To appear in the ECML-PKDD joint post-workshop proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种异质适配流水线，利用商用边缘AI推理加速器Hailo-8L在设备端进行模型微调。将预训练主干网络量化为INT8并在加速器上运行，同时轻量级FP32分类头在CPU上微调，实现高效节能的在线更新。实验表明，相比树莓派5 CPU基线，训练速度提升最多15.4倍，能耗显著降低，但量化对精度敏感架构有影响。
Motivation: 设备端模型适配对资源受限硬件上的终身个性化至关重要，但现代深度神经网络的端到端反向传播因计算、功耗和内存限制而不可行。
Method: 提出异质适配流水线：将计算图分割，预训练主干网络量化为INT8并在Hailo-8L加速器上推理，仅轻量级FP32分类头在主机CPU上微调；使用推理优化加速器实现快速节能的现场更新。
Result: 在多种架构和数据集上，相比树莓派5 CPU基线，训练时间加速最多15.4倍，在有利设置下吞吐量有竞争力，且每样本能耗持续降低；后训练量化恢复对保持加速器特征质量至关重要。
Conclusion: 结果表明，利用面向推理的边缘加速器实现高效设备端适配是可行的，但需注意量化对精度敏感架构的精度损失。
Relevance: 5
