papers.title: AlphaOracle: Oracle bone script decipherment via human-workflow-inspired deep learning
papers.abstract_en: Approximately 3,000 of the 4,500 oracle bone script (OBS) characters remain undeciphered due to fragmentary inscriptions and sparse evidence. Current AI approaches fail to replicate expert workflows that integrate form analysis, contextual semantics, and philological reasoning. We introduce AlphaOracle, a human-workflow-inspired framework that systematizes OBS decipherment using the largest digitized corpus to date. Its multi-stage pipeline comprises: (i) rubbing parsing; (ii) radical-based morphological analysis with diachronic modeling; (iii) contextual retrieval with semantic alignment; and (iv) philological validation against classical sources. Each stage generates explicit, confidence-weighted evidence chains, culminating in interpretable reports for scholarly verification. Across multiple test characters, AlphaOracle's readings strongly agreed with expert interpretations. In a study of 86 domain specialists, it reduced analysis time by 64% and 79% of participants rated it highly useful. Notably, AlphaOracle resolves the character "Lao" as a toponymic or clan designation, offering concrete revisions to Shang administrative and social interpretations. These results suggest that computational methods aligned with philological practice can facilitate OBS research and provide a conceptual reference for studies of other undeciphered scripts.
papers.journal_ref: The Innovation 7(11), 101462, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AlphaOracle，一个受人类工作流程启发的深度学习框架，用于甲骨文 (OBS) 破译。该框架构建了最大的数字化语料库，并通过多阶段流程（拓片解析、字形分析、上下文语义对齐、文献验证）生成可解释的证据链。实验表明，AlphaOracle 的解读与专家高度一致，使 86 名领域专家的分析时间减少 64%，79% 的参与者认为其非常有用。该方法成功解析了“老”字作为地名或氏族称谓，修正了商代行政与社会解释。
Motivation: 目前约 4500 个甲骨文字符中仍有 3000 个未被破译，现有 AI 方法未能整合字形分析、上下文语义和文献推理等专家工作流程。
Method: 提出了多阶段流程： (i) 拓片解析；(ii) 基于部首的形态分析与历时建模；(iii) 上下文检索与语义对齐；(iv) 基于古典文献的文献验证。每个阶段生成显式的、带置信度的证据链，最终输出可解释的报告。
Result: 在多个测试字符上，AlphaOracle 的解读与专家高度一致；在 86 名专家参与的研究中，分析时间减少 64%，79% 的参与者评价其为高度有用；该方法成功解析“老”字为地名或氏族称谓。
Conclusion: 结果表明，与古文字学实践相结合的计算方法能够促进甲骨文研究，并为其他未破译文字的破译提供概念参考。

papers.title: Mobius Learning: Cyclic Depth Folding in Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based language models organize computation along an ordered depth axis, where shallow and deep blocks often develop distinct representational roles. We challenge the conventional view that these roles must remain tied to a block's position in the ordered sequence. We introduce Mobius Learning, a training architecture based on cyclic depth folding, in which different data streams follow cyclically shifted block orders. The same block group is therefore applied early in the block sequence for some data streams and late for others, so it is optimized in both shallow and deep roles, a phenomenon we call depth-role superposition. Surprisingly, in four-worker experiments with a modded GPT-2 small (124M) model trained on 2.5B FineWeb tokens using Muon, Mobius Learning achieves lower validation loss than a fixed-order looped Transformer at larger numbers of Transformer block-sequence passes. This counterintuitive result shows that a block group need not remain confined to one fixed shallow or deep role within the block sequence and opens a new design space based on cyclic depth folding. Crucially, this structure makes Mobius Learning particularly well suited to memory-constrained distributed training: raw training data remain local, while each worker stores one block group rather than the complete Transformer block stack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mobius Learning，一种基于循环深度折叠的 Transformer 训练架构。该架构让不同的数据流遵循循环移位的块顺序，使得同一块组既承担浅层角色也承担深层角色，称为深度角色叠加。在 4 个 worker 的 modded GPT-2 small (124M) 模型实验中，使用 Muon 优化器在 2.5B FineWeb tokens 上训练，Mobius Learning 在更多 Transformer 块序列通过次数下取得了比固定顺序循环 Transformer 更低的验证损失。
Motivation: 传统 Transformer 模型中，浅层和深层块的角色固定，本文质疑这种角色必须与块在有序序列中的位置绑定的观点。
Method: 提出循环深度折叠，使得不同数据流使用循环移位的块顺序，同一个块组在不同数据流中分别处于序列的早期和晚期，从而在浅层和深层角色上均被优化。
Result: 在 4 个 worker 的 modded GPT-2 small 实验中，Mobius Learning 在更多块序列通过次数下验证损失低于固定顺序循环 Transformer。
Conclusion: 结果表明块组无需固定为浅层或深层角色，循环深度折叠为 Transformer 设计开辟了新空间，且特别适合内存受限的分布式训练。

papers.title: CaT-GS: Efficient 3DGS Rendering for Large Scale Scenes via Inter-frame Caching and Tile Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: Recent breakthroughs in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have advanced neural rendering with high fidelity and speed. However, its performance degrades significantly in large-scale scenes due to the computational burden of tile-based rasterization. Existing optimization efforts either require costly scene re-training or focus on narrow aspects of the pipeline, overlooking critical inefficiencies in real-world deployments. Through a comprehensive analysis, we identify three primary sources of redundancy and low GPU utilization: redundant inter-frame pre-processing, viewpoint-based occlusion redundancy, and severe tile-level load imbalance. To address these issues, we propose CaT-GS, a novel and efficient 3DGS rendering pipeline. CaT-GS introduces a speculative multi-frame preprocessing method to eliminate redundant computations across consecutive frames, and an inter-frame caching mechanism to eliminate viewpoint redundant rendering stages. Furthermore, it refactors rasterization tasks with a dedicated kernel to mitigate tile load imbalance, significantly boosting GPU utilization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CaT-GS achieves a speedup of up to 10 times over the original 3DGS and up to 70% over previous state-of-the-art methods, establishing a new benchmark for high-fidelity, real-time rendering of large-scale scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CaT-GS 提出了一种针对大规模场景的 3DGS 渲染流水线优化方法，通过帧间缓存、推测性多帧预处理和 tile 级负载均衡，解决了 3DGS 在大型场景中的冗余计算和 GPU 利用率低问题。实验表明，该方法相比原始 3DGS 加速最高 10 倍，相比之前最优方法加速最高 70%，实现了高保真实时渲染的新基准。
Motivation: 3DGS 在大规模场景中因 tile 级光栅化的计算负担而导致性能显著下降，现有优化方法或需要昂贵重训练，或仅关注流水线窄方面，忽略了实际部署中的关键低效问题。
Method: 提出 CaT-GS 流水线，包含三种技术：推测性多帧预处理消除连续帧冗余计算；帧间缓存机制消除视点冗余渲染阶段；重构光栅化任务并通过专用内核缓解 tile 负载不均衡，提升 GPU 利用率。
Result: 在多个大规模场景数据集上，CaT-GS 相比原始 3DGS 实现最高 10 倍加速，相比之前最先进方法实现最高 70% 加速，同时保持高保真渲染质量。
Conclusion: CaT-GS 为大规模场景的高效 3DGS 渲染建立了新的性能基准，证明了通过系统性优化冗余和负载均衡可显著提升实时渲染效率。

papers.title: Measuring and Improving Complex-Atomic Answer Consistency in Endoscopic VQA
papers.abstract_en: Endoscopic visual question answering (VQA) increasingly asks complex questions that combine several endoscopic answer components rather than isolated factual queries. Such complex answers may be scored as correct even when the same model fails on associated atomic questions. We introduce EndoCA, a paired complex-atomic answer consistency benchmark for evaluating whether complex answers remain consistent with same-image atomic answers. EndoCA contains two suites: EndoCA-Core evaluates compact question-complexity patterns commonly seen in practical endoscopic VQA, and EndoCA-Diagnostic supports controlled analysis across increasing question complexity. We evaluate 11 VLMs spanning open, medical, endoscopy-adapted, and closed-source models on EndoCA. Some VLMs achieve high complex-answer accuracy, yet their atomic-answer accuracy and complex-atomic answer consistency remain substantially lower. To reduce this complex-atomic inconsistency, we introduce Atomic-Support Reconciliation (ASR), a training-free mechanism that uses model-generated atomic answers as contextual premises for answer revision and consistency-guided selective answering. On four selected publicly available models, ASR-Revise improves paired complex-atomic correctness with modest changes in complex-answer accuracy, while ASR-Selective improves accuracy on answered cases by allowing the model to abstain from less reliable cases. Together, EndoCA and ASR provide a consistency-aware benchmark and a training-free mechanism for answer reconciliation and selective answering in endoscopic VQA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对内窥镜视觉问答（VQA）中复杂答案与原子答案的一致性不足问题，构建了EndoCA基准测试，包含EndoCA-Core和EndoCA-Diagnostic两个子集，评估了11个视觉语言模型（VLM）的复杂-原子答案一致性。结果发现即使复杂答案准确率高的模型，其原子答案准确率和一致性仍较低。为此提出原子支持调谐（ASR），一种无需训练的方法，利用模型生成的原子答案作为上下文前提进行答案修订和一致性引导的选择性回答。
Motivation: 内窥镜VQA中复杂问题由多个组件组成，现有评估仅关注复杂答案正确性，忽略了答案是否与原子问题答案一致，导致模型可能看似正确但实际不一致。
Method: 构建EndoCA基准，包含两类问题模式；提出ASR机制，通过模型自动生成的原子答案作为前提，对复杂答案进行修订（ASR-Revise）或选择性回答（ASR-Selective），无需额外训练。
Result: 在4个公开模型上，ASR-Revise在保持复杂答案准确率小幅变化的前提下提升配对复杂-原子正确性；ASR-Selective通过允许模型弃权提高了已回答案例的准确率。
Conclusion: EndoCA提供了一致性感知的基准，ASR提供了无需训练的答案修订与选择性回答机制，有望提升内窥镜VQA的可信度。

summary_sections.method: 构建EndoCA基准，包含两类问题模式；提出ASR机制，通过模型自动生成的原子答案作为前提，对复杂答案进行修订（ASR-Revise）或选择性回答（ASR-Selective），无需额外训练。
summary_sections.result: 在4个公开模型上，ASR-Revise在保持复杂答案准确率小幅变化的前提下提升配对复杂-原子正确性；ASR-Selective通过允许模型弃权提高了已回答案例的准确率。
summary_sections.conclusion: EndoCA提供了一致性感知的基准，ASR提供了无需训练的答案修订与选择性回答机制，有望提升内窥镜VQA的可信度。

papers.title: Consistent Feature Transport for Image Relighting
papers.abstract_en: Image relighting modifies illumination while preserving non-lighting content such as identity and geometry. Existing diffusion-based methods often suffer from unstable illumination changes or inconsistent content preservation under complex lighting, as they lack an explicit mechanism to learn feature transformations between images. We reformulate relighting as an illumination feature transport problem and introduce Consistent Feature Transport (CFT), a training principle that explicitly enforces illumination-consistent transport between source and target image distributions. Built upon rectified flow, CFT jointly models noise-to-image generation and illumination-consistent source-to-target transport through trajectory-level supervision. This dual-transport formulation encourages isolation of illumination-specific variations while preserving content-aligned features. To support complex lighting scenarios, we construct a large-scale portrait relighting dataset with diverse relighting effects. Experiments show consistent improvements over existing state-of-the-art relighting approaches and demonstrate that CFT can generalize to other editing tasks, including style transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/Dixin-Lab/CFT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Consistent Feature Transport (CFT)，将图像重照明重新表述为光照特征传输问题。基于 rectified flow，CFT 通过轨迹级监督联合建模噪声到图像生成和光照一致的源到目标传输，显式强制特征传输的光照一致性。构建了大规模人像重照明数据集，实验表明在重照明任务上持续优于现有方法，并能泛化到风格迁移等编辑任务。
Motivation: 现有扩散方法在处理复杂光照时缺乏显式机制学习图像间的特征变换，导致光照变化不稳定或内容保存不一致。
Method: 将重照明重新表述为光照特征传输问题，提出 CFT 训练原则。基于 rectified flow，通过轨迹级监督实现噪声到图像生成和光照一致源到目标传输的双重传输建模。
Result: 在重照明任务上持续优于现有方法，并能泛化到风格迁移等其他编辑任务。
Conclusion: 通过显式建模特征传输可以实现更一致的重照明，且框架具有泛化性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: I wanted it to feel more personal: Customization of social AI as AI individualism in practice
papers.abstract_en: Despite the growing availability of customizable social artificial intelligence (AI), such as ChatGPT, Grok, and Character.ai, we know little about how users actively shape social AI to reflect their personal preferences. This study examines why and how users (N = 169) customize social AI through the lens of the newly developed concept of AI individualism. Through reflexive thematic analysis of open-ended responses, we identified several motivations for customization, including (1) enhanced pragmatic support, (2) emotional support or companionship, (3) trust and reliability, (4) pushback, (5) a tailored degree of human likeness, (6) creativity or playfulness, and (7) having the AI function as an extension of the self. In line with the concept of AI individualism, our findings show that, for many users, customization is a co-creative process between the human and the AI that is perceived as strengthening support, autonomy, ownership, and engagement, potentially contributing to a closer and more personal relationship. Through customization users may come to view social AI as a personalized social resource that increases their sense of individualism, freedom, and control. We discuss how these perceptions may foster pseudo-autonomy, whereby customization creates an illusion of individual control over powerful social AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过调查169名用户，研究为何及如何定制社交AI（如ChatGPT、Character.ai），发现定制动机包括增强实用支持、情感陪伴、信任可靠性、反驳、拟人化程度、创意娱乐和作为自我延伸。定制被视为人机共创过程，增强支持、自主性、所有权和参与感，但可能产生伪自主性，即定制造成对强大AI系统个人控制的错觉。
Motivation: 社交AI（如ChatGPT）的个性化定制日益普及，但用户如何主动塑造社交AI以反映个人偏好的动机和实践尚不清楚。
Method: 通过开放式问卷调查169名用户，对回复进行反身性主题分析，基于AI个人主义概念分析定制动机。
Result: 识别出七类定制动机：增强实用支持、情感支持/陪伴、信任与可靠性、反驳、定制的类人程度、创造性/游戏性、AI作为自我延伸。定制被视为人机共创过程，增强支持、自主性、所有权和参与感。
Conclusion: 定制可能培养伪自主性，即用户产生对强大社交AI系统个人控制的错觉。论文讨论了这些感知如何影响用户与AI的关系。

papers.title: Theoretical Foundations of $\max$@$k$ Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning is a cornerstone technique for modern large reasoning models. Usually, for difficult tasks such as code generation and theorem proving, the agent is evaluated by generating $K$ responses rather than sampling a single response, and performance is then measured using a retry-aware metric such as $\max$@$k$. Despite their practical importance, the theoretical foundations of learning under such criteria remain limited. In this work, we provide a theoretical study of the $\max$@$k$ learning problem in finite-horizon reinforcement learning. We show that optimizing the $\max$@$k$ objectives is fundamentally different from standard expected-return maximization. In particular, we prove that Markovian policies are in general insufficient, identify a compact state augmentation that restores optimality, and explicitly characterize the performance gap that can arise between history-dependent and non-history-dependent policies. Moreover, we show that learning $\max$@$k$-optimal policies is statistically harder than standard reinforcement learning and provide an efficient algorithm that achieves the optimal sample complexity rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上研究了有限时域强化学习中的 max@k 目标优化问题。作者证明，在此目标下马尔可夫策略通常不足，并识别出一种能恢复最优性的紧凑状态增广方法，同时刻画了历史依赖与非历史依赖策略之间的性能差距。此外，学习 max@k 最优策略在统计上比标准强化学习更困难，且文中给出一种达到最优样本复杂度的高效算法。
Motivation: 在代码生成、定理证明等困难任务中，实际评估通常基于生成 K 个响应并采用 max@k 等重试感知指标，但此类优化准则的理论基础仍不充分。
Method: 采用有限时域强化学习框架，理论分析 max@k 目标的优化特性，包括策略表征、状态增广和样本复杂度下界。
Result: 证明 max@k 优化与期望回报最大化本质不同；马尔可夫策略不足，需引入历史依赖或状态增广；学习该目标策略的统计困难度高于标准强化学习，并给出最优样本复杂度的算法。
Conclusion: 为 retry-aware 指标下的强化学习提供了理论基础，明确了 max@k 函数优化的特有挑战与可能性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Phasor Attention: Mean Root Square Normalization for Phase Manifold Preservation
papers.abstract_en: While Root Mean Square Normalization has become the de facto standard for accelerating modern sequence models, its reliance on the quadratic accumulation of independent scalars ($\sum x^2$) inherently triggers outlier-induced numerical instability, gradient starvation, and anisotropic phase distortion. We introduce Mean Root Square Normalization (MRSNorm). By structurally pairing channels into 2D phasors, MRSNorm mathematically inverts the traditional scaling paradigm: it computes the localized $L_2$ magnitudes (Root Square) before aggregating them via a global $L_1$ average (Mean). This operational inversion strictly constrains activations to a phasor manifold, preserving conformal invariance. By sharing a single affine weight across phasor components, MRSNorm halves the total number of learnable parameters, proving that unconstrained spatial scaling in standard norms is a harmful redundancy. We analytically demonstrate that this geometric constraint yields a built-in, trigonometric gradient clipper governed by the Pythagorean identity, unconditionally equalizing the local gradient norm to ensure Gradient Homogeneity. Empirical evaluations on a ResNet with CIFAR-100 show that despite halved parameters, MRSNorm provides critical structural stability under rigorous stress tests. Under extreme hyperparameter settings where standard normalizations suffer from gradient divergence, MRSNorm successfully prevents numerical explosion and secures stable optimization trajectories. Our findings propose a fundamental paradigm shift toward phasor-based deep representation learning. The implementation of MRSNorm is available at Appendix C.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mean Root Square Normalization (MRSNorm)，通过将通道配对为 2D 相量（phasors），先计算局部 L2 幅度再通过全局 L1 平均聚合，从而约束激活在相量流形上并保留共形不变性。该方法在 CIFAR-100 上的 ResNet 实验中，尽管参数减半，在极端超参数设置下仍能防止梯度爆炸并保证稳定优化。
Motivation: 标准的 Root Mean Square Normalization 依赖平方和，导致异常值引起的数值不稳定、梯度饥饿和各向异性相位畸变。
Method: 提出 Mean Root Square Normalization (MRSNorm)，将通道配对为 2D 相量，先计算局部 L2 幅度（Root Square），再通过全局 L1 平均（Mean）聚合，并在相量分量间共享单一仿射权重，从而将可学习参数减半。
Result: 在 CIFAR-100 上的 ResNet 实验表明，MRSNorm 在极端超参数设置下成功防止数值爆炸并确保稳定优化轨迹。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法代表了向基于相量的深度表示学习的范式转变，并指出标准归一化中无约束的空间缩放是一种有害冗余。

papers.title: PRiSM: Prototype Regularization for Few-Shot VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Training-free few-shot adaptation methods have gained significant attention recently in the context of Vision-language Models (VLMs). Yet, current benchmarks rely on strong assumptions about the statistics of the adaptation data, e.g., class balance. We question these simplifying assumptions and introduce a more realistic benchmark that varies both the levels of class balance and the effective number of classes in few-shot tasks via Dirichlet sampling. Surprisingly, under our setting, we observe substantial drops in the performances of state-of-the-art methods, more so when the number of labeled samples increases. To mitigate this, we introduce PRiSM, a class-prototype regularization that can be deployed as a plug and play module on top of any existing baseline method, significantly improving performances. Our method optimizes a novel multi-term loss, which includes a regularizer maximizing inter-class pairwise distances, along with additional terms promoting support-feature alignment and fidelity to the baseline prototypes. Furthermore, we introduce an effective and computationally efficient block Majorize-Minimize optimizer for our objective. More specifically, we derive a valid blockwise Lipschitz constant (i.e., a bound on the Hessian's spectral norm), which can be computed efficiently via the Gershgorin circle theorem. Extensive experiments show that PRiSM improves several training-free baselines, with large gains when dealing with severe class imbalance and high numbers of classes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对当前少样本视觉语言模型 (VLM) 在训练-free适应中依赖类平衡假设的问题，提出一种类原型正则化方法 PRiSM。该方法通过 Dirichlet 采样构建更真实的类不平衡基准，并设计多术语损失（包括类间距离最大化、支持特征对齐等），配合高效的块 Majorize-Minimize 优化器，可即插即用于现有基线。实验表明 PRiSM 在严重类不平衡和高类别数场景下显著提升性能。
Motivation: 现有少样本 VLM 适应基准假设数据类平衡，这与现实场景不符。当引入类不平衡和变类别数时，现有方法性能大幅下降，且随着标记样本增加问题更严重。
Method: 提出 PRiSM 原型正则化模块：优化多术语损失，包含最大化类间成对距离的正则项、支持特征对齐项以及对基线原型的保真项；并设计基于块Majorize-Minimize的高效优化器，利用 Gershgorin 圆定理快速计算块 Lipschitz 常数。
Result: 在类不平衡与高类别数设定下，PRiSM 显著提升多种训练-free基线方法的性能，且增益随不平衡程度和类别数增加而变大。
Conclusion: PRiSM 可作为即插即用模块缓解类不平衡带来的性能退化，其优化器兼具理论保证与计算效率。

papers.title: Vis2Reg: Visibility-Aware Landmark-Free Geometric 3D--2D Registration for Liver Laparoscopy
papers.abstract_en: Accurate 3D--2D liver registration, which aligns preoperative 3D models to partial, view-dependent intraoperative surface observations, is critical for AR-guided laparoscopic surgery but remains challenging due to severe occlusion, limited visibility, and the lack of 3D ground-truth supervision. Existing landmark-free approaches perform partial-to-complete geometric alignment, yet robust self-supervision under extreme partial visibility remains difficult. We propose Vis2Reg, a visibility-aware registration framework that explicitly constrains deformation using mask-consistent visible regions. We introduce a visibility-aware self-supervision that derives a visible-domain 3D supervision signal from intraoperative masks, enabled by differentiable point rasterization and mask-guided back-projection. This formulation improves robustness under severe occlusion while maintaining fully self-supervised learning. Vis2Reg combines a robust geometric rigid initialization module with an implicit neural deformation field for stable alignment. Vis2Reg achieves a Dice score of 92.6\% and a Chamfer Distance of 1.43 mm on real intraoperative datasets, with 111 ms per-frame inference time, demonstrating both accuracy and practical efficiency.
papers.journal_ref: 29th International Conference on Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention (MICCAI'2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Vis2Reg，一种可见性感知的免标记几何3D-2D配准框架，用于肝脏腹腔镜手术。通过可见域自监督和可微分点光栅化，实现从部分术中表面观测到术前3D模型的配准。在真实术中数据集上Dice达到92.6%，Chamfer距离1.43mm，每帧推理时间111ms。
Motivation: 现有免标记方法在极端部分可见性下鲁棒性不足，缺乏3D真值监督，导致准配困难。
Method: 提出可见性感知自监督，利用术中掩码推导可见域3D监督信号，结合可微分点光栅化和掩码引导反向投影；同时结合鲁棒几何刚性初始化模块和隐式神经变形场进行稳定配准。
Result: 在真实术中数据集上Dice高达92.6%，Chamfer距离为1.43mm，每帧推理时间仅111ms，兼顾准确性与效率。

papers.title: PGN: Design and Implementation of a Vision-Language Navigation System Based on Pangu Multimodal Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to interpret a natural-language instruction and predict actions from temporally ordered visual observations. Adapting a multimodal large language model to VLN requires visual-language alignment, compact temporal inputs, action-space grounding, and stable training on the target hardware. This technical report presents PGN (Pangu Navigator), an offline VLN action-prediction system built on OpenPangu-7B. Training proceeds in two stages. First, PGMM aligns a frozen EVA-ViT-G/14 vision encoder with the frozen language backbone by training a Q-Former and a two-layer MLP projector. Second, PGN adapts the aligned model to expert navigation trajectories using five-observation windows, epoch-dependent temporal sampling, and a reasoning-then-action output format; this stage freezes the aligned visual pathway and updates three structural-token embeddings and LoRA adapters. The implementation combines mixed-precision computation, selective FP32 computation, and DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 on eight Ascend 910B NPUs. Under teacher-forced, open-loop evaluation on 500 held-out expert trajectories, V9 reports a 62.29% Normalized Action Match (NAM) and a 100.00% Non-empty Rate (NER). These metrics quantify offline expert-action alignment rather than closed-loop navigation success; evaluating error accumulation, path efficiency, and goal completion remains future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍PGN（Pangu Navigator），一个基于OpenPangu-7B的离线视觉-语言导航（VLN）动作预测系统。系统通过两阶段训练实现：先使用Q-Former和MLP投影器对齐冻结的视觉编码器和语言骨干，再基于专家轨迹微调。在500条保留轨迹的教师强制开环评估中，归一化动作匹配（NAM）达62.29%，非空率（NER）为100.00%。作者指出当前评估未覆盖闭环导航成功率和误差累积。
Motivation: 将多模态大语言模型适配到VLN任务面临视觉-语言对齐、紧凑时序输入、动作空间映射及目标硬件稳定训练等挑战。
Method: 两阶段训练：第一阶段通过训练Q-Former和两层MLP投影器对齐冻结的EVA-ViT-G/14视觉编码器与冻结的语言骨干；第二阶段冻结视觉通路，使用五帧观察窗口、依赖epoch的时序采样和推理-动作输出格式，更新三个结构token嵌入和LoRA适配器。实现采用混合精度、选择性FP32和DeepSpeed ZeRO-2在八块Ascend 910B NPU上。
Result: 在500条专家轨迹的教师强制开环评估中，NAM为62.29%，NER为100.00%。
Conclusion: 作者强调当前指标衡量的是离线专家动作对齐而非闭环导航成功，评估误差累积、路径效率和目标完成度是未来工作。

papers.title: FF-ProCams: Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting for Projector-Camera System
papers.abstract_en: Projector-camera (ProCams) systems achieve active scene perception and controllable appearance manipulation via structured illumination, serving as a core infrastructure for spatial augmented reality, projection mapping, and surface reflectance acquisition. Existing inverse-rendering methods for ProCams deliver high-fidelity results but rely on time-consuming per-scene optimization, while mainstream feed-forward 3D reconstruction models produce baked appearance that cannot adapt to spatially varying projector illumination. To resolve this accuracy-efficiency trade-off, we propose FF-ProCams, a Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian inverse-rendering framework for ProCams. A hybrid Mamba2-Transformer encoder aggregates cross-view geometric and photometric cues from sparse multi-view observations, and lightweight heads predict a relightable Gaussian representation in a single forward pass. We further design a projector-aware differentiable renderer to synthesize camera observations under arbitrary active illumination and ProCams poses. To enable feed-forward training, we construct a large-scale synthetic ProCams dataset covering diverse object geometries and surface materials. Experiments show FF-ProCams achieves high-fidelity projector-aware rendering, generalizes to unseen patterns, and supports novel projector-camera poses. Using only 8 input views, it outperforms optimization-based baselines with 297 views while reducing test-time reconstruction to 0.13 seconds (a three-to-five-order-of-magnitude speedup). The code and data are available at https://github.com/CPREgroup/FF-ProCams/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FF-ProCams，一个用于投影相机系统的前馈三维高斯逆渲染框架。通过混合 Mamba2-Transformer 编码器从稀疏多视角观测中聚合几何和光度线索，并预测可重光照的高斯表示。设计投影仪感知的可微渲染器合成任意主动光照下的相机观测。在大型合成数据集上训练，仅用8个输入视图即可在0.13秒内重建，优于使用297视图的优化基线。
Motivation: 现有投影相机逆渲染方法依赖逐场景优化，耗时且效率低；而前馈三维重建模型无法适应空间变化的投影仪光照，存在精度与效率的权衡。
Method: 提出前馈三维高斯逆渲染框架，包含混合 Mamba2-Transformer 编码器、可重光照高斯表示预测头，以及投影仪感知的可微渲染器。同时构建大规模合成投影相机数据集用于训练。
Result: 仅用8个输入视图，测试时重建仅需0.13秒，性能优于使用297视图的优化基线，实现三到五个数量级的加速，并支持未见过的光照模式和投影相机姿态。
Conclusion: FF-ProCams 实现了投影相机系统的高保真前馈逆渲染，兼顾精度与效率，但当前基于合成数据训练，实际场景泛化性有待验证。

papers.title: The Concept of Representation in ML: Beyond Plato and Aristotle
papers.abstract_en: Representation is a central concept in modern machine learning, where it usually refers to internal encodings that support learning and generalization. As models scale and their capabilities become increasingly human-level, this representational language sometimes shifts from an engineering context into the more philosophically loaded domain of mental representation. We argue that this is the case for recent claims about the convergence of representational properties across different AI models. In particular, we assess the arguments developed in The Platonic Representation Hypothesis, according to which this convergence is driven by a unified structure of reality. We examine this claim by introducing arguments and ideas from debates about mental representation in the philosophy of mind. We argue that these philosophical resources can clarify what is at stake in such claims, explain why alignment evidence alone is insufficient for strong metaphysical conclusions, and suggest directions for future research.
papers.comment: 8 pages. Accepted for oral presentation at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨机器学习中“表示”概念从工程隐喻向哲学领域（心理表征）的转变，聚焦于对“柏拉图表示假说”（Platonic Representation Hypothesis）的批判性分析。通过引入心灵哲学中关于心理表征的论辩，作者论证该假说所声称的“不同AI模型表示趋同源于现实统一结构”缺乏足够证据，并指明未来研究应结合哲学视角。
Motivation: 近年来有观点（如柏拉图表示假说）认为不同AI模型的表示趋向于一个共享的、反映现实统一结构的抽象空间，但此类主张缺乏哲学层面的审视，需要澄清其形而上学内涵。
Method: 从心灵哲学中关于心理表征的经典争论（如意向性、内容问题）出发，重新评估柏拉图表示假说的论证逻辑，指出对齐证据不能自动推出统一的现实结构。
Result: 论文表明，哲学资源能够揭示这类声称中隐含的假设，并证明仅凭跨模型表示对齐不足以支撑强烈的形而上学结论。
Conclusion: 表示收敛的形而上学主张需要更细致的哲学分析，未来的工作应系统整合哲学与机器学习领域关于表示本质的讨论。

papers.title: Toward Optimal Adenovirus Detection Using YOLO26
papers.abstract_en: This study systematically benchmarks different data augmentation setups across YOLO26 model size variants to determine the most effective setup for adenovirus detection in TEM images. The benchmarked setups include NAS, GAS, GMAS and DAS, all evaluated under identical training conditions. The adenovirus dataset, selected from the published TEM virus dataset, was re-annotated by leveraging adenovirus particle positions to generate YOLO-compatible bounding box annotations. The experimental results demonstrated the impact of the benchmarked data augmentation setups on adenovirus detection with YOLO26 and indicated the most effective data augmentation setup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了不同数据增强设置对YOLO26模型在透射电子显微镜（TEM）图像中检测腺病毒的效果，并确定了最有效的增强策略。
Motivation: 腺病毒在TEM图像中的检测需要有效的数据增强策略，但目前缺乏系统的基准测试。
Method: 采用YOLO26的不同模型大小变体，在相同训练条件下评估了NAS、GAS、GMAS和DAS四种数据增强设置，并利用重新标注的腺病毒数据集（基于已发表的TEM病毒数据集）生成YOLO兼容的边界框标注。
Result: 实验结果表明不同数据增强设置对腺病毒检测性能有显著影响，并指出了最有效的数据增强设置。
Conclusion: 本文为腺病毒检测提供了数据增强选择的指导，但未提及局限性或泛化性。

papers.title: Financial Audit Assistance using Misinformation Detection and Explanation
papers.abstract_en: Financial statements (FS) such as Balance Sheet (BS), Income Statement (IS) and Cash-flow Statement (CS) summarize the annual financial performance of a company. FS are widely used for evaluating corporate governance, credit appraisal, risk analysis, validate taxation, make investment decisions etc. Financial auditing is a complex and knowledge-intensive discipline whose one important aim is ensuring integrity, accuracy, fairness and absence of material misstatement in the published FS. Given the importance of FS, there are incentives to hide, omit or falsify information to misrepresent the true financial health of the company; e.g., reduce tax liabilities, or increase investor confidence. Given the complex, time-consuming and expertise-dependent nature of auditing, auditors would benefit from an AI-assisted system that automatically detects instances of misinformation in the given FS and identify likely sources of this misinformation in the financial data. In this paper, we present unsupervised techniques to identify misinformation in FS, and also generate explanations as to the financial variables that are likely sources of misinformation. The auditor can then explore in more detail the associated data sources and business processes to validate these suggestions. A crucial feature of our approach is the use of past corpus of FS and associated audit reports to generate insights, which help in providing assistance. We demonstrate the efficacy of these techniques on a large corpus of 11,460 FS over 5 years and associated audit reports. This paper integrates and adds more novel contributions over the previously reported research (Shinde et al., 2022)\cite{SVAP22}, (Vaishampayan et al., 2022)\cite{VSPP22}, (Pawar et al., 2023)\cite{PAPV23}, which we have used as the foundation for our AI-assisted Auditor Assistance system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出无监督技术检测财务报表中的虚假信息，并生成解释以定位可能的信息源。系统利用历史财务报表和审计报告语料库提供洞察，在11460份财务报表（5年）及对应审计报告上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 财务报表审计复杂耗时，依赖专家知识，自动化检测虚假信息可辅助审计师提高效率与准确性。
Method: 采用无监督方法，利用历史财务报表和审计报告语料库，通过分析财务变量之间的异常模式识别虚假信息，并生成指向可能信息源的解释。
Result: 在包含11460份财务报表（覆盖5年）及其审计报告的大型语料库上展示了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 该系统可作为AI辅助审计工具，帮助审计师快速定位财务报表中的潜在虚假信息及其来源。

papers.title: ReViV: Reconstructing the Viewer and the View in 4D from Monocular Egocentric Video
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric devices, such as wearable front-facing cameras, provide a unique perspective for capturing the continuous interaction between a human viewer and the surrounding environment. A holistic and efficient multimodal model capable of reconstructing this 4D representation is therefore highly desirable. However, existing approaches often rely on auxiliary inputs such as pre-computed camera trajectories, treat scene perception and human ego-motion modeling as separate problems despite their strong interdependency, and suffer from slow inference time. To address these limitations, we present ReViV, the first unified framework for holistic egocentric 4D reconstruction that extracts both viewer and view dynamics from a single monocular RGB video. We formulate the task as learning the full joint probability distribution over multimodal signals, including RGB video, camera trajectory, gaze direction, full-body motion, hand motion, and depth. Powered by a Masked Generative Egocentric Transformer, ReViV operates within a single feed-forward architecture to simultaneously reconstruct the temporally consistent 4D reconstruction across the viewer and the view with fast inference speed. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmarks, including HoloAssist, HOT3D, ARCTIC, Aria Digital Twin, and TACO, demonstrate that ReViV achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and efficiency across holistic ego-body, hand, and gaze reconstruction, camera tracking, while maintaining highly competitive egocentric depth estimation without relying on heavy task-specific priors. Code and models are fully open-sourced: https://reviv4d.github.io/.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. The first two authors contributed equally, and their author order is interchangeable
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReViV，首个从单目第一人称RGB视频中同时重建观察者（全身、手部、视线）和观察场景（深度、相机轨迹）4D表示的统一框架。基于掩码生成式第一人称Transformer，该模型在单一前馈架构中联合学习多模态信号分布，在多个基准上实现最先进的精度和速度。
Motivation: 现有第一人称视频4D重建方法依赖辅助输入（如预计算相机轨迹），将场景感知与人体运动建模分离，推理速度慢。缺乏能够高效联合重建观察者与环境动态的统一框架。
Method: 提出ReViV，使用掩码生成式第一人称Transformer（Masked Generative Egocentric Transformer）学习RGB视频、相机轨迹、视线方向、全身运动、手部运动和深度的联合概率分布，通过单一前馈架构实现4D重建。
Result: 在HoloAssist、HOT3D、ARCTIC、Aria Digital Twin和TACO等基准上，该方法在全身、手部、视线重建和相机追踪方面达到最先进精度，同时保持具有竞争力的深度估计性能，且推理速度快。
Conclusion: ReViV证明了统一建模观察者与观察场景的4D表示的可行性，无需任务特定先验，代码和模型已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Medical Imaging Fusing Vision Transformer: Laryngeal Cancer Screening with Explanation
papers.abstract_en: Early and timely screening of laryngeal cancer is crucial for improving clinical outcomes. In recent years, NBI endoscopy has become a standard diagnostic tool for the detection of laryngeal lesions. However, its effective use requires well-trained clinicians and the procedure is time-consuming and subject to interobserver variability. In this context, the application of artificial intelligence (AI) offers a promising solution to support clinical decision-making. In this work, we proposed applying transformer and attention mechanism for analyzing the narrow band imaging and distinguish benign and malignant lesions. Results show it has good classification performance with F1 (82.72%), accuracy(82.33%). In addition, the result of laryngeal cancer screening is explainable for clinicians. The explainability is utilizing the state of art segmentation method (MedSAM) to provide the useful pathological information area for clinicians. The proposed methodology fusing classification and segmentation provides a translating on laryngeal cancer screening.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将视觉 Transformer 与注意力机制应用于窄带成像内镜图像，区分喉部良恶性病变。结合 MedSAM 分割方法提供可解释性，在喉癌筛查中取得 F1 82.72%、准确率 82.33% 的性能。
Motivation: 喉癌早期筛查依赖 NBI 内镜，但需要经验丰富的临床医生且存在观察者间变异，AI 辅助可提高诊断效率与一致性。
Method: 采用 Transformer 和注意力机制分析窄带成像图像，并融合 MedSAM 分割方法生成病理信息区域的可解释性输出。
Result: 摘要报告分类 F1 为 82.72%，准确率为 82.33%，并提供了可解释的筛查结果。
Conclusion: 该融合分类与分割的方法有望推动喉癌筛查的临床应用，但摘要未提及局限性或泛化性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reasoning as a Double-Edged Sword: Architecture and Cross-Stage Robustness in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Does adding a reasoning step make a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model more robust to perturbation? Intuitively, a policy that reasons before acting should absorb a perturbed input better than one that maps observations directly to actions. We test this premise head-on across three models that span the reasoning spectrum (no reasoning, a text chain-of-thought, and a latent iterative loop), perturbing each at the vision, reasoning, and action stages on LIBERO and SimplerEnv. Two questions organize the study: does the reasoning design shift robustness, and can the reasoning be read back at runtime as a safety signal? We find that the latent-iterative model is by far the least robust: under both stochastic noise and white-box perturbation its task success collapses, while the other two hold. This fragility is structural rather than cumulative: varying the reasoning depth at inference barely moves it. Reasoning outputs can in principle be monitored, but the monitors fail under fair tests. A plan--action consistency probe that looks near-perfect under naive evaluation falls to chance under adaptive attack. Under matched-FPR calibration, fusing it with an action-anomaly probe never lifts defended success above undefended. Scoped to these output-level behavioral probes under white-box vision-stage attack, this ceiling is a precondition that any viable defense must first satisfy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了不同推理设计对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型鲁棒性的影响。在LIBERO和SimplerEnv上对无推理、文本链式推理和隐式迭代循环三种模型施加视觉、推理和动作阶段的扰动，发现隐式迭代模型的任务成功率在随机噪声和白盒攻击下急剧下降，而其他两种模型保持稳定。推理输出的行为监控探针在朴素评估下看似有效，但在自适应攻击下失败。
Motivation: 直观上，在动作前进行推理的VLA模型应比直接映射观测到动作的模型更能吸收输入扰动，但这一假设尚未被严格检验。本文旨在系统评估推理设计是否真的提升鲁棒性。
Method: 选取三种代表性VLA模型：无推理、文本链式推理（text CoT）和隐式迭代推理（latent iterative loop）；在LIBERO和SimplerEnv上分别对视觉编码、推理过程和动作输出施加随机噪声和白盒扰动，并测量任务成功率。
Result: 隐式迭代模型最不鲁棒，其任务成功率在两种扰动下均崩溃；而其他两种模型表现稳定。推理深度变化对鲁棒性影响很小。动作一致性探针在自适应攻击下退化为随机水平，且与动作异常探针融合后未能提升防御成功率。
Conclusion: 推理设计对VLA模型的鲁棒性具有双刃剑效应：隐式迭代结构引入严重脆弱性，且现有的基于输出行为的安全监控在自适应攻击下不可靠。任何可行的防御必须先满足在公平校准下的性能底线。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Feature Attribution-Based Explainability Analysis of Deep Learning Models in Predictive Process Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Predictive process monitoring supports the optimization and control of operational business processes by forecasting the future state or outcome of ongoing cases. While deep neural networks have achieved strong performance for these tasks by modeling sequential dependencies in event logs, their black-box nature limits trust and practical adoption. Feature attribution methods are often used to address this, but applying them directly poses a dilemma: event-level attributions impose high computational complexity for long traces, while explanations based on aggregated trace representations often fail to capture the underlying control-flow dynamics. To address this issue, we propose a local post-hoc explainability method for deep neural networks in outcome prediction. The method relies on a control-flow-aware segmentation algorithm that partitions a trace into meaningful segments and supports the computation of segment-level SHAP explanations. This makes it possible to identify which parts of a trace influence a prediction and which change points steer the case toward the predicted outcome. We assess the proposed segmentation method on a synthetic dataset with known process logic, where meaningful change points can be explicitly verified, and we demonstrate its usefulness on real-world event logs from a loan application process and an administrative process of a Dutch municipality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对预测过程监控中深度神经网络的黑箱问题，提出一种基于控制流感知分段的局部事后可解释性方法。该方法将事件日志中的轨迹划分为有意义的片段，并计算片段级别的SHAP解释，从而识别影响预测的关键轨迹部分和变更点。在合成数据集和真实事件日志上验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 深度神经网络在预测过程监控中表现优异，但其黑箱性质限制了信任和实际应用。现有特征归因方法在事件级别计算复杂且难以捕捉控制流动态。
Method: 提出一种控制流感知的分段算法，将轨迹划分为有意义的段，然后计算段级别的SHAP解释，以平衡计算复杂性和解释的语义性。
Result: 在已知过程逻辑的合成数据集上验证了分段方法的正确性，并在贷款申请流程和荷兰市政府管理流程的真实事件日志上展示了其实用性。
Conclusion: 方法能够识别影响预测的轨迹部分和变更点，提高了过程监控中深度学习的可解释性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BrainNext: A General-Purpose Self-Supervised Foundation Model for Brain MRI Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models pretrained using self-supervised learning have transformed computer vision by learning transferable representations from large-scale unlabeled data. However, existing foundation models for neuroimaging remain limited by task-specific training, slice-based learning strategies, or relatively small pretraining datasets, restricting their generalizability across diverse brain MRI applications. In this work, we present BrainNext, a general-purpose self-supervised foundation model for volumetric brain MRI analysis. BrainNext combines masked autoencoder (MAE) pretraining with a native three-dimensional Bi-Directional xLSTM-UNet architecture to learn rich anatomical representations from 60,551 unlabeled brain MRI examinations spanning multiple MRI modalities. The pretrained model is subsequently adapted to downstream tasks through lightweight task-specific fine-tuning. We evaluate BrainNext on the Foundation Models for Medical Imaging (FOMO) 2025 Method Track, encompassing classification, segmentation, and brain-age estimation, where it achieved second place overall and ranked first in the meningioma segmentation task on the official FOMO 2025 challenge leaderboard, demonstrating strong transferability across heterogeneous neuroimaging tasks. These results highlight the potential of large-scale self-supervised pretraining to learn robust and transferable volumetric representations, establishing BrainNext as a scalable foundation model for diverse brain MRI applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BrainNext，一种用于脑部 MRI 分析的自监督基础模型，结合掩码自编码器（MAE）预训练和 3D 双向 xLSTM-UNet 架构，在 60,551 例未标注脑 MRI 数据上训练，并在分类、分割和脑龄估计等下游任务中微调。在 FOMO 2025 挑战赛中取得总体第二名，并在脑膜瘤分割任务中排名第一，展示了较强的可迁移性。
Motivation: 现有神经影像基础模型受限于任务特定训练、基于切片的学习策略或较小的预训练数据集，限制了其在多样化脑 MRI 应用中的泛化能力。
Method: 结合掩码自编码器（MAE）自监督预训练与原生三维双向 xLSTM-UNet 架构，从 60,551 例多模态未标注脑 MRI 中学习解剖表示，随后通过轻量任务特定微调适应下游任务。
Result: 在 FOMO 2025 方法赛道中，整体排名第二，在脑膜瘤分割任务中排名第一，验证了跨异构神经影像任务的强迁移性。
Conclusion: 大规模自监督预训练可学习鲁棒且可迁移的体素级表示，BrainNext 作为可扩展的基础模型适用于多种脑 MRI 应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ETAS: An Effect-Typed Language for Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: ETAS is a programming language for agent systems that treats model-backed agents, tool calls, prompts, typed memory, human approvals, policies, and execution traces as semantic program elements rather than library conventions. It separates deterministic computation from agentic nondeterminism and externally visible actions while preserving a direct programming style. We present the core design of ETAS. Its static semantics assigns ordinary types through spec conformance and tracks each computation with two behavioral indices: an escaping effect row and a persistent abstraction of the typed action trace it may request. Specs form a terminating compile-time constraint calculus: type specs provide evidence for polymorphism and resource facts, callable specs constrain function and stage shapes, and trace specs express allow, deny, and temporal constraints. Typing checks requested traces against compiled monitors and emits residual obligations when dynamic resources preclude a complete static proof. The dynamic semantics distinguish requested, handled, denied, and committed events; handlers interpret typed actions without making their requests invisible to authorization or audit. We formalize a core calculus and state preservation, progress, type/effect soundness, handler trace-transparency, and policy safety. We also implement ETAS in Rust with a command-line interface, typed HIR checks, effect and policy diagnostics, handler checks, and trace-aware execution hooks. ETAS provides a programming-language foundation for reasoning about authorization, nondeterminism, recovery, and audit evidence before and during agent execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ETAS 是一种面向代理系统的效果类型语言，将模型支持代理、工具调用、提示、类型化内存、人类审批、策略和执行轨迹视为语义程序元素，而非库约定。它分离确定性计算与代理非确定性，并通过静态类型系统跟踪效果行和动作轨迹。该语言包括规格约束演算、编译时监视器检查以及运行时事件区分，形式化证明了保全、进展、类型/效果健全性、处理器轨迹透明性和策略安全性，并提供了 Rust 实现。
Motivation: 现有代理系统通常将关键组件（如代理、工具、策略、追踪）作为库约定处理，缺乏语言层面的抽象和静态保证，导致推理授权、非确定性和审计证据困难。
Method: 提出 ETAS 语言，其静态语义通过规格约束演算（类型规格、可调用规格、追踪规格）追踪计算的效果行和动作轨迹，动态语义区分请求、处理、拒绝和提交事件，并编译监视器进行静态检查；形式化核心演算并实现 Rust 运行时。
Result: 形式化证明了保全、进展、类型/效果健全性、处理器轨迹透明性和策略安全性；Rust 实现包含命令行接口、类型化 HIR 检查、效果与策略诊断、处理器检查和轨迹感知执行钩子。
Conclusion: ETAS 为代理系统提供了编程语言基础，支持在代理执行前和执行过程中对授权、非确定性、恢复和审计证据进行推理。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 形式化证明了保全、进展、类型/效果健全性、处理器轨迹透明性和策略安全性；Rust 实现包含命令行接口、类型化 HIR 检查、效果与策略诊断、处理器检查和轨迹感知执行钩子。
summary_sections.conclusion: ETAS 为代理系统提供了编程语言基础，支持在代理执行前和执行过程中对授权、非确定性、恢复和审计证据进行推理。

papers.title: Dynamic Defense Profiling Enables Cognitive Jailbreak of Text-to-Image Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-Image (T2I) generative models have achieved remarkable progress in synthesizing high-quality visual content, yet they remain vulnerable to adversarial misuse, particularly in generating Not-Safe-For-Work (NSFW) images. Most existing jailbreak attacks primarily rely on heuristic prompt engineering or black-box optimization, treating model feedback as a binary signal (success or failure). This coarse-grained paradigm overlooks the rich information embedded in diverse failure modes, such as textual refusal, visual blocking, and semantic sanitization, resulting in inefficient exploration and severe semantic collapse. In this paper, we propose MIND, a cognitive jailbreak framework that reframes adversarial prompt generation as a belief-state inference problem over latent defense mechanisms. Instead of blindly searching for bypass prompts, MIND actively models the target system's latent defense mechanisms by interpreting multi-modal feedback as high-density signals. Specifically, the framework integrates three core components: (1) a Multi-modal Judge for fine-grained feedback decomposition, (2) a Defense Profiler for iterative belief updating, and (3) a Meta-Memory module for retrieving historically effective attack strategies. These components are unified within a reasoning-driven evolutionary optimization process, enabling adaptive and semantically consistent jailbreak generation. Extensive experiments on the I2P benchmark demonstrate the effectiveness of MIND. Under six representative pre-processing and post-processing defense settings applied to the Stable Diffusion v1.5 model, MIND achieves an Attack Success Rate (ASR) of 95.62%, significantly outperforming existing methods. Additionally, the effectiveness of the proposed framework is validated across four widely used commercial T2I systems, achieving the highest ASR of 91.58% on Wan-2.5.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MIND，一个认知越狱框架，将对抗提示生成重新定义为潜在防御机制的信念状态推断问题。通过多模态裁判（Multi-modal Judge）、防御画像（Defense Profiler）和元记忆（Meta-Memory）模块，结合推理驱动的进化优化，在Stable Diffusion v1.5的六种防御设置下达到95.62%攻击成功率，并在四个商业T2I系统中取得最高91.58%的ASR。
Motivation: 现有越狱攻击将模型反馈视为二元成功/失败信号，忽视了文本拒绝、视觉阻塞等失败模式中的丰富信息，导致探索效率低且易语义崩溃。
Method: MIND框架包括三个组件：多模态裁判对多模态反馈进行细粒度分解；防御画像基于反馈迭代更新对防御机制的信念；元记忆模块检索历史有效策略。三者统一在推理驱动的进化优化过程中，实现自适应且语义一致的越狱生成。
Result: 在I2P基准上，针对Stable Diffusion v1.5的六种预处理和后处理防御，MIND的ASR为95.62%，显著优于现有方法。在四个商业T2I系统（含Wan-2.5）上取得91.58%的最高ASR。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，通过将对抗生成建模为对潜在防御机制的信念推断，MIND能够实现高效的认知越狱，并在多种防御设置和商业系统中验证了有效性。

papers.title: CDIS: Cross-Dimensional Class-Agnostic 3D Instance Segmentation via 2D Mask Tracking and 3D-2D Projection Merging
papers.abstract_en: Class-agnostic 3D instance segmentation is critical for robotic systems operating in unknown environments, enabling perception of previously unseen objects for reliable manipulation and navigation. Existing approaches typically project per-frame 2D instance masks into 3D and merge them, which often breaks object identities across time and yields fragmented 3D instances. We introduce Cross-Dimensional Class-Agnostic 3D Instance Segmentation (CDIS), a zero-shot framework that explicitly tracks 2D instance masks across frames and associates them with 3D superpoints, creating a feedback loop between 2D and 3D. This cross-dimensional reasoning links temporally stable 2D tracks with spatially coherent 3D regions, producing globally consistent 3D instance labels without any 3D-specific training. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that CDIS achieves higher accuracy and consistency than state-of-the-art zero-shot methods, while remaining efficient and scalable to diverse real-world environments.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Published in the proceedings of the 2025 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
papers.journal_ref: 2025 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), pp. 4269-4274
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CDIS，一个零样本的跨维度类无关 3D 实例分割框架，通过显式跟踪 2D 实例掩码并关联 3D 超点，形成 2D-3D 反馈循环，无需 3D 训练即可生成全局一致的 3D 实例标签。在基准数据集上，CDIS 相比现有零样本方法取得了更高的准确率和一致性，并适用于多样化的真实环境。
Motivation: 现有类无关 3D 实例分割方法在将逐帧 2D 掩码投影到 3D 并合并时，常导致对象身份随时间断裂，产生碎片化的 3D 实例，限制了在未知环境中机器人感知的可靠性。
Method: CDIS 通过跨维度推理，将时间稳定的 2D 轨迹与空间连续的 3D 超点关联，形成 2D 掩码跟踪与 3D-2D 投影合并的反馈机制，无需任何 3D 特定训练。
Result: 在基准数据集上，CDIS 在准确率和一致性上优于现有最先进的零样本方法，且高效可扩展。
Conclusion: CDIS 通过跨维度反馈循环实现了零样本的 3D 实例分割，适用于机器人未知环境感知。

papers.title: Persona-as-Configuration: Generative Stakeholder Reporting for Agricultural Floods
papers.abstract_en: Cyber-physical systems built on deterministic edge inference, such as on-vehicle flood detection for agricultural fields, produce structured decision logs that must be interpreted differently by heterogeneous stakeholders. Pairing such systems with large language models (LLMs) to generate stakeholder-specific reports introduces a tension: the generative layer is non-deterministic, while the edge plane must remain replayable and auditable. We propose an architectural pattern resting on two invariants: unidirectional consumption, in which the generative layer is a strict read-only consumer of the deterministic plane and never writes back, and persona-as-configuration, in which stakeholder adaptation is a versioned prompt-template artifact rather than runtime improvisation. We instantiate the pattern as a context-aware dashboard layer over the JSON decision logs of a previously published edge-based standing-water detection system, and analyse how the integration boundary admits standard generative-reliability mitigations as configuration- or middleware-level extension points. A structured expert review rated the pattern favourably across five ISO/IEC 25010-aligned quality dimensions, with strongest agreement on separation of concerns. End-user evaluation with agricultural stakeholders is planned for future work.
papers.comment: Accepted at CASA 2026 (9th Workshop on Context-Aware, Autonomous and Smart Architectures), co-located with ECSA 2026. 16 pages, 2 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出一种架构模式，将基于确定性边缘推理的农业洪水检测系统与大型语言模型（LLM）结合，生成面向不同利益相关者的定制化报告。核心约束是生成层单向消费确定性平面，且通过版本化的提示模板（persona-as-configuration）实现利益相关者适配。在已有的边缘积水检测系统上实例化，并通过专家评审评估了质量维度。
Motivation: 确定性边缘推理系统产生结构化决策日志，但不同利益相关者需要不同解释。引入LLM生成报告时面临生成层非确定性与边缘层可重放/可审计性之间的矛盾。
Method: 提出基于两个不变量的架构模式：1）单向消费：生成层严格只读消费确定性平面；2）persona-as-configuration：将利益相关者适配设计为版本化的提示模板工件，而非运行时即兴发挥。在已有的边缘积水检测系统上实例化为上下文感知仪表盘层。
Result: 结构化专家评审在五个ISO/IEC 25010质量维度上给予积极评价，最强一致性体现在关注点分离。端用户评估（农业利益相关者）计划作为未来工作。
Conclusion: 该模式通过单向消费和可配置提示模板，在非确定性LLM生成与确定性边缘系统之间建立可审计的集成边界，并支持标准生成可靠性缓解措施。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Measuring Monosemanticity in Sparse Autoencoders via Latent Activation Coherence
papers.abstract_en: Within Explainable Artificial Intelligence, mechanistic interpretability uses Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to extract more interpretable features from neural representations. However, assessing their monosemanticity, and thus explanation quality, remains challenging. Existing metrics require external concept labels or depend on pretrained embedding models, making them sensitive to encoder's geometry. We introduce the Tversky Monosemanticity Score (TMS), a label-free metric that operationalizes monosemanticity as activation-set coherence of binarized SAE latents, and does not require external embedding encoders. We evaluate TMS on SAEs trained on features from pretrained vision and vision-language models (DINOv3, CLIP, BLIP2), two common SAE regimes (TopK, BatchTopK), multiple sparsity levels, and expansion factors. Our results show that TMS is less affected by encoder anisotropy than its embedding-based alternative, while remaining aligned with established monosemanticity indicators. TMS also reveals distinct SAE training dynamics across base models. Moreover, under encoder anisotropy, TMS provides a stronger indication of probe-based concept deletion effectiveness, while being competitive otherwise.
papers.comment: This is a preprint version. A shorter version of this paper has been accepted for presentation and publication in the post-workshop proceedings of the 8th International Workshop on eXplainable Knowledge Discovery in Data Mining (XKDD 2026), co-located with ECML PKDD 2026. The appendix is included only in this preprint and is not part of the peer-reviewed proceedings paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种标签无关的度量指标Tversky Monosemanticity Score (TMS)，通过二值化SAE潜在激活的集合一致性来衡量单义性，无需外部嵌入模型。在多个视觉和视觉-语言模型上的实验表明，TMS比基于嵌入的方法对编码器各向异性更鲁棒，且与现有单义性指标一致。
Motivation: 现有单义性度量依赖外部概念标签或预训练嵌入模型，对编码器几何结构敏感，亟需一种标签无关、不受嵌入几何影响的度量方法。
Method: 提出TMS，基于Tversky指数计算SAE潜在激活的二值化集合的语义相干性，不使用外部嵌入编码器。
Result: TMS在DINOv3、CLIP、BLIP2模型以及TopK和BatchTopK SAE架构上，与嵌入基方法相比受编码器各向异性影响更小，同时与单义性指标对齐；在各向异性条件下，TMS对基于探针的概念删除有效性指示更强。
Conclusion: TMS是一种有效的、无需标签的单义性度量，对编码器各向异性鲁棒，可揭示不同基模型的SAE训练动态差异。

papers.title: From Sign Language Generation to Humanoid Execution: Vision-Language Guided Retargeting with Collision Mitigation
papers.abstract_en: Recent sign language generation (SLG) systems increasingly output dense 3D body representations, which better preserve full-body kinematics and geometry for downstream embodiment on humanoid robots. However, these generated motions frequently exhibit self-intersections such as hand-hand and hand-torso penetration. While such artifacts may be tolerated in offline rendering, they become critical in humanoid execution as they lead to infeasible inverse-kinematics (IK) solutions, collisions, and unstable retargeted trajectories. We present a system-level framework that bridges SLG outputs to humanoid joint-space execution via two components. First, we introduce a volumetric SMPL-X collision-mitigation module that projects generated signing motions toward physically plausible configurations while minimally deviating from the original trajectory. Second, we propose a vision-language-guided retargeting algorithm built on an IK backbone: a VLM serves as a visual critic over rendered humanoid motion, identifies embodiment-specific failure modes, and triggers targeted task-space corrections. Our results highlight collision handling and perception-guided refinement as key missing components for reliable humanoid signing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个系统级框架，将手语生成（SLG）的输出转化为类人机器人的关节空间执行。框架包含两个组件：体积SMPL-X碰撞缓解模块，将生成的签名运动投影到物理可行配置；以及基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的重定向算法，作为视觉批评者识别失败模式并触发任务空间修正。结果表明，碰撞处理和感知引导的细化是实现可靠类人机器人手语的关键缺失组件。
Motivation: 当前手语生成系统输出的密集3D身体表示常出现自交（如手-手、手-躯干穿透），这些在离线渲染中可容忍，但在类人机器人执行中会导致不可行的逆运动学解、碰撞和不稳定的重定向轨迹。
Method: 提出两个组件：1) 体积SMPL-X碰撞缓解模块，最小化偏离原始轨迹的同时将运动投影到物理可行配置；2) 基于VLM的视觉语言引导重定向算法，作为视觉批评者识别特定于具体体形的故障模式并触发任务空间修正。
Result: 摘要强调碰撞处理和感知引导的细化是使类人机器人手语可靠的关键缺失组件。
Conclusion: 该框架通过碰撞缓解和VLM引导修正，弥合了SLG输出到类人机器人执行的差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: To Blend In, First Decouple: Rethinking Camouflage Image Generation via Context-Decoupled Representations
papers.abstract_en: Camouflage image generation (CIG) focuses on generating visually concealed objects that seamlessly blend into their backgrounds. Existing methods typically follow either background-guided paradigms that adapt object appearance via style transfer, or foreground-guided strategies that outpaint surrounding regions conditioned on object features. However, they still suffer from appearance discrepancy and background artifacts. We attribute these limitations to cross-context representation leakage, where object and background cues are entangled in a coupled conditional space, resulting in ambiguous control and degraded camouflage fidelity. To tackle this, we propose a new context-decoupled generative paradigm, termed CamoDreamer, which aims to isolate contextual conditional guidance and explicitly decouple latent camouflage features into coordinated object and background control streams. First, a Contrast-aware Contextual Bridge is designed to model cross-context discrepancies and construct contrast-aware dual conditional guidance. Second, Context-Decoupled Assimilation Streams are employed to separate generative interactions conditioned on the dual guidance, while facilitating background rendering with target-aware cues in the latent space. Finally, a Frequency-Adaptive Contextual Blend module integrates complementary high-frequency textures and low-frequency structures from decoupled features to improve holistic coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CamoDreamer consistently outperforms existing methods with a substantial margin, while maintaining a relatively lightweight design.

papers.title: FIFA World Cup 2026 as a Contamination-Free Benchmark for LLM Forecasting Agents: Four Models, a Bookmaker, and 104 Matches
papers.abstract_en: We introduce WC2026-Agents, a benchmark and dataset for evaluating large language models (LLMs) as autonomous forecasting agents on real, future events. For every one of the 104 matches of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, four frontier models -- Claude Opus 4.8, ChatGPT (GPT-5.5, high reasoning), Gemini 3.1 Pro, and Grok (Expert Mode) -- ran an identical search-act-reflect loop: gather evidence with a web tool, commit to a 1X2 (team-A win / draw / team-B win) distribution and a virtual 100-USD bet, and, after the match, reflect given only the final score. Because every match kicked off after the models' training cutoffs, the benchmark is contamination-free by construction. Crucially, we pair the four agents with a fifth competitor drawn from the same information environment -- the pre-match betting market -- collected as per-match 1X2 odds, giving an economically grounded baseline and letting us score not just what an agent predicts but what it does with money. The release contains 416 forecasts and 414 reflections with verbatim reasoning, ground truth (including penalty shootouts), odds, and a reproducible evaluation suite. A reference evaluation surfaces findings that raw accuracy hides: the four agents issue an identical top pick in 92% of matches and none beats the market's Brier score; indeed, a naive flat stake on the market favorite out-earns all four agents. Yet the agents diverge sharply as decision-makers: betting return-on-investment ranges from -18% to +10%, fading the market is unprofitable for all four, the share of forecasts that cite the market ranges from 12% to 100%, and self-reported error rates on wrong picks range from 36% to 86%. The benchmark thus measures calibration, decision quality, and self-knowledge -- axes on which frontier models differ even when their predictions do not. Data and code: https://github.com/graphuofm/FIFA2026LLM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出WC2026-Agents基准，用于评估LLM作为自主预测代理在2026年FIFA世界杯104场比赛中的表现。四个前沿模型（Claude Opus 4.8, ChatGPT (GPT-5.5), Gemini 3.1 Pro, Grok）执行相同的搜索-行动-反思循环，并与博彩市场赔率对比。原始准确率具有误导性：代理在92%比赛中指定相同首选，但无一超越市场Brier分数；等额投注市场热门回报优于所有代理。代理在投资回报率、市场引用频率和自我错误率上差异显著，揭示了校准、决策质量和自我认知等评估维度。
Motivation: 现有LLM预测评估常受数据污染影响，且缺乏经济意义上的真实基线。论文旨在构建一个无污染、有市场基准的评估框架，专门测试LLM作为自主代理在实时事件预测中的校准、决策和自我认知能力。
Method: 构建WC2026-Agents基准：对104场FIFA世界杯比赛，四个LLM代理利用网络工具收集证据，提交1X2分布和虚拟100美元赌注，赛后仅根据比分反思。同时收集每场比赛的博彩赔率作为经济基线，提供可复现评估套件。
Result: 代理在92%比赛中指定相同首选，但无一超越市场Brier分数。等额投注市场热门回报优于所有代理。代理投资回报率范围-18%至+10%，市场引用频率12%-100%，自我报告错误率36%-86%。
Conclusion: 基准揭示了校准、决策质量和自我认知等维度，这些即使在预测一致时也能区分前沿模型。LLM代理在真实经济环境下表现不如简单市场基准。

papers.title: Autonomous Discovery of Wireless Communications Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-driven evolutionary search is an emerging algorithm-discovery paradigm that has already produced novel results in several scientific fields. Yet its application to wireless communications remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce The AI Telco Engineer (AITE), a framework to autonomously design algorithms for complex communication problems, while navigating performance-complexity tradeoffs. We showcase AITE on two challenging physical-layer problems: designing an equalizer for an orthogonal time-frequency space (OTFS) system, and constructing a receiver algorithm for an orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) system using a custom constellation and operating without pilots. For the first task, AITE develops algorithms that outperform the best-known solutions while reducing computational latency by a factor of 3.6 compared to the strongest baseline. For the second task, it discovers the first explicit, explainable algorithms that achieve performance parity with state-of-the-art neural receivers. These results demonstrate the strong potential of LLM-driven evolutionary search for the autonomous discovery of next-generation wireless communications algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LLM驱动的进化搜索框架AITE，用于自主设计无线通信算法。在OTFS系统均衡器设计中，AITE发现的算法在降低3.6倍计算延时的同时超越最优已知解；在无导频OFDM系统接收器设计中，首次发现显式可解释算法，其性能与最先进的神经接收器持平。该工作展示了AI自主发现下一代无线通信算法的潜力。
Motivation: LLM驱动的进化搜索已在多个科学领域产生新成果，但在无线通信中的应用尚未深入探索。
Method: 提出AITE框架，利用LLM驱动的进化搜索，在性能-复杂度权衡下自主设计通信算法，并在两个物理层问题（OTFS均衡器、无导频OFDM接收器）上验证。
Result: OTFS均衡器任务中，AITE发现的算法计算延时降低至基线1/3.6且性能更优；OFDM接收器任务中，首次得到显式可解释算法，性能与神经接收器相当。
Conclusion: AITE及其LLM驱动进化搜索在无线通信算法自主发现方面具有强潜力，可应用于更复杂的下一代通信问题。

papers.title: Time-Frequency Consistency Learning for Robust Speech Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Recently, speech deepfake detection (SDD) has achieved significant progress. However, its robustness evaluation remains largely confined to controlled additive noise scenarios, lacking systematic investigation of the complex distortions introduced by acoustic front-end (AFE) processing pipelines in real-world deployments. In this work, we simulate a unified AFE pipeline comprising acoustic echo cancellation, noise suppression, automatic gain control, and voice activity detection (VAD), and conduct a comprehensive evaluation of current state-of-the-art models. The results show that the nonlinear and time-frequency coupled distortions introduced by AFE significantly degrade detection performance. To address this issue, we propose a Time-Frequency Consistency Learning (TFCL) framework, which aims to learn invariant spoofing representations that remain stable before and after AFE processing. We observe that AFE not only introduces temporal misalignment (e.g., segment-level shifts caused by VAD), but also weakens or distorts critical frequency-domain cues. To this end, TFCL employs an attention-driven soft alignment mechanism to capture cross-temporal dependencies, along with frequency-domain structural consistency constraints to enforce feature invariance. As a result, the model is able to maintain stable representations under both temporal perturbations and spectral distortions. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method effectively mitigates the performance degradation caused by AFE processing, significantly improving the robustness of SDD in real-world scenarios. The code is available at https://github.com/JunXue-tech/TFCL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语音深度伪造检测在真实声学前处理（AFE）管线下的鲁棒性问题，提出时频一致性学习（TFCL）框架，通过注意力驱动的软对齐和频域结构一致性约束，学习AFE前后的不变伪造表示，有效缓解性能下降。
Motivation: 现有语音深度伪造检测鲁棒性评估局限于受控加性噪声，缺乏对真实场景中AFE管线（回声消除、噪声抑制、自动增益控制、VAD）引入的复杂非线性时频耦合失真的系统研究。
Method: 提出TFCL框架：采用注意力驱动的软对齐机制处理VAD引起的时域片段错位，并结合频域结构一致性约束保持特征不变性，以学习AFE前后稳定的伪造表示。
Result: 在模拟的统一AFE管线评估中，现有模型检测性能显著下降；TFCL有效缓解了AFE引起的性能退化，大幅提升了真实场景下的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: TFCL通过时频一致性学习能有效应对AFE引入的时域扰动和频谱畸变，提升语音深度伪造检测的实用鲁棒性。

papers.title: Generalize and Guide: Decomposing Rewards for Few-Shot Inverse Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) provides a powerful framework for learning from demonstrations. However, real-world tasks often exhibit substantial natural variations (e.g., picking up mugs with varying shapes), making it impractical to collect demonstrations that fully specify a new task under every possible scenario. In practice, while demonstrations for the target task are limited, it is often easier to obtain datasets of heterogeneous but related behaviors. This motivates the problem of few-shot IRL with multi-task demonstrations (FM-IRL), where an agent must learn a new task with substantial variations from only a limited number of target-task demonstrations, together with sufficient demonstrations of related tasks and online agent experience. To do so, we must both recover the expert distribution of the new task and provide guidance when the agent deviates from it. We introduce Multitask discriminator Proximity-Guided IRL (MPG), which learns two complementary reward components: (1) a generalizable discriminator that transfers shared structure across related tasks to identify expert behavior in a new task, and (2) a proximity function that measures how far a state deviates from expert behavior and provides corrective guidance during exploration. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on multiple challenging navigation and manipulation tasks under significant variations (e.g., object configurations, table layouts, and initial robot poses), achieving an average success rate of 81.2%, outperforming the strongest per-task baseline by an average of 24.7 percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Few-Shot 逆强化学习 (IRL) 的奖励分解方法 MPG，针对目标任务示范有限而相关任务示范充足的场景。该方法学习两个互补的奖励组件：一个可泛化的判别器，用于从相关任务中迁移共享结构以识别新任务的专家行为；一个邻近函数，用于衡量状态偏离专家行为的程度并提供探索中的纠正指导。在具有显著变化的导航和操作任务上，平均成功率达到 81.2%，比最强单任务基线平均高出 24.7 个百分点。
Motivation: 现实任务常存在大量自然变化，难以收集覆盖所有场景的目标任务示范；而相关任务示范更容易获取。因此需要从有限的目标示范和充足的相关示范及在线经验中学习新任务，同时恢复专家分布并在偏离时提供指导。
Method: 提出多任务判别器邻近指导 IRL (MPG)，包含两个组件：(1) 可泛化判别器，在相关任务间转移共享结构以识别目标任务的专家行为；(2) 邻近函数，测量状态偏离专家行为的程度，并在探索中提供纠正性指导。
Result: 在多种挑战性导航和操作任务（物体配置、桌面布局、机器人初始姿态变化）上，平均成功率为 81.2%，比最强单任务基线平均高出 24.7 个百分点。
Conclusion: MPG 通过分解奖励为泛化判别器和邻近函数，有效解决了少样本多任务 IRL 问题，在多种变体任务上显著超出基线。

papers.title: Towards Reliable Zero-Shot Crowd Forecasting: Evaluating Time Series Foundation Models for Special Event Pedestrian Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Managing massive crowds during infrequent special events requires reliable real-time pedestrian-flow forecasting to ensure public safety and operational efficiency. However, supervised forecasting methods face limitations in these contexts due to scarce historical data, heterogeneous data distributions, and short in-event observation windows. To effectively support operational decision-making, forecasts should provide not only accurate point estimates but also informative predictive uncertainty. Probabilistic uncertainty quantification plays a critical role in this aspect, particularly capturing sudden volatility and tail risks. This paper investigates pretrained time series foundation models as a lightweight approach for zero-shot probabilistic forecasting without extensive local retraining. Using decision-oriented metrics tailored to short events, we conduct a comprehensive assessment of two time series foundation models on crowd forecasting, with the SAIL2025 event as a use case. We then distill practical insights for crowd managers, specifying when zero-shot forecasts remain operationally reliable.

TL;DR: 本文针对特殊事件中人群预测数据稀缺、分布异构的问题，探索使用预训练时间序列基础模型进行零样本概率预测。以SAIL2025事件为例，采用决策导向指标评估了两个时间序列基础模型，并总结了零样本预测在操作上可靠的适用条件。
Motivation: 监督预测方法在特殊事件中因历史数据少、分布差异大、观测窗口短而受限，需要零样本概率预测来提供准确点估计和不确定性量化。
Method: 研究预训练时间序列基础模型作为轻量级零样本概率预测方法，不依赖大量局部重训练，并使用针对短事件的决策导向指标进行评估。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但通过案例评估了两类时间序列基础模型，并提炼出零样本预测何时可靠的操作性见解。
Conclusion: 零样本时间序列基础模型在一些条件下可以可靠地支持特殊事件人群预测，但具体可靠性取决于数据特征和事件特性。

papers.title: Seg2Grasp: A Robust Modular Suction Grasping in Bin Picking
papers.abstract_en: Current bin picking methods that rely heavily on end-to-end learning often falter when confronted with unfamiliar or complex objects in unstructured environments. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Seg2Grasp, a modular pipeline designed for robust suction grasping in dynamic and cluttered bin scenarios. Seg2Grasp is built on a three-step process: Segmentation, Grasping, and Classification. The Segmentation module employs a Transformer-based model to generate class-agnostic object masks from RGB-D images, ensuring accurate detection across various conditions. The Grasping module uses surface normals and mask proposals to determine the optimal suction points, enhancing grasp success. Finally, the Classification module leverages fine-tuned open-vocabulary Mask-CLIP for precise object identification, enabling versatile handling of diverse objects. Real-world robotic experiments demonstrate that Seg2Grasp outperforms existing methods in success rates and adaptability, establishing it as a powerful tool for automated bin picking in industrial settings.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Seg2Grasp是一种模块化吸力抓取流水线，专为动态杂乱料箱场景设计。它由三个模块组成：基于Transformer的分割模块生成类无关物体掩码，抓取模块利用表面法线和掩码确定最佳吸力点，分类模块使用微调的开放词汇Mask-CLIP进行物体识别。真实机器人实验表明，该方法在成功率和适应性上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有端到端学习的料箱抓取方法在面对不熟悉或复杂物体时表现不佳，尤其是在非结构化环境中。
Method: 提出三步骤模块化流水线：1) Segmentation模块使用Transformer模型生成RGB-D图像的类无关物体掩码；2) Grasping模块基于表面法线和掩码提议计算最优吸力点；3) Classification模块采用微调的Mask-CLIP实现开放词汇物体识别。
Result: 真实机器人实验中，Seg2Grasp在抓取成功率和适应性上均优于现有方法。
Conclusion: Seg2Grasp为工业自动料箱抓取提供了一种鲁棒且灵活的工具。

papers.title: DA-Fusion: Deformable Attention-Based RGB-D Fusion Transformer for Unseen Object Instance Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: In logistics automation, precise segmentation of unseen objects is crucial for efficient robotic manipulation in cluttered environments. Tasks such as bin-picking and shelf-picking require robust perception to handle occlusions, varying object shapes, and complex spatial arrangements. Traditional RGB-based methods tend to over-segment objects due to their reliance on texture, while depth-based methods often under-segment by focusing primarily on geometric features. To address these limitations, we propose DA-Fusion, a deformable attention-based RGB-D fusion Transformer designed for unseen object instance segmentation. DA-Fusion effectively combines the strengths of both RGB and depth data, enhancing segmentation accuracy in cluttered and multi-layered object environments. We also introduce the Object Clutter Bin Dataset (OCBD), a benchmark dataset specifically tailored for evaluating bin-picking scenarios in top-down views. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that DA-Fusion outperforms state-of-the-art methods across diverse environments, making it particularly suited for real-world logistics tasks.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. Published in the Proceedings of the 2025 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2025)
papers.journal_ref: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA), 2025, pp. 7490-7496
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DA-Fusion，一种基于可变形注意力的 RGB-D 融合 Transformer，用于未知物体实例分割。该方法结合 RGB 纹理和深度几何信息，在杂乱环境（如物流 bin-picking）中提升分割精度。同时引入新数据集 OCBD，实验表明在多个场景下优于现有方法。
Motivation: 传统 RGB 方法易过分割，深度方法易欠分割，难以处理杂乱环境中的遮挡和形状变化，亟需有效融合两种模态的方法。
Method: 提出 DA-Fusion 模型，利用可变形注意力 (deformable attention) 在 Transformer 框架中融合 RGB 和深度特征，并设计专用数据集 OCBD 用于顶部视角的 bin-picking 评估。
Result: 在多个杂乱环境下的实例分割任务中，DA-Fusion 超越现有最先进方法，尤其适用于物流自动化中的真实场景。
Conclusion: RGB-D 融合结合可变形注意力能有效解决杂乱环境下的物体分割问题，所提数据集 OCBD 可促进相关研究。

papers.title: Mobile Network Control with a World Model
papers.abstract_en: The increasing complexity of mobile networks necessitates intelligent and dynamic control strategies for efficient, energy-conserving management. We propose a world model-based approach for network control that enables adaptive configuration of crucial parameters. The world model is trained from historical data and predicts the impact of its actions on future network states. Our controller leverages the model's uncertainty estimate to robustly find optimal network configuration changes. Furthermore, the optimization objective can be changed dynamically without model retraining. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach in simulated closed-loop control of a mobile network energy-saving feature. Our results show improved performance in balancing energy savings with quality of service, compared to traditional methods and reinforcement learning approaches. Finally, we show the world model performance on real network data from, and evaluate counterfactual actions proposed by the controller under various throughput constraints.
papers.journal_ref: 2026 IEEE/IFIP Network Operations and Management Symposium (NOMS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于世界模型的移动网络控制方法，通过历史数据训练世界模型来预测动作对未来网络状态的影响，并利用模型的不确定性估计鲁棒地找到最优配置。该方法可在不重新训练模型的情况下动态改变优化目标，在模拟的移动网络节能特性闭环控制中表现出比传统方法和强化学习更好的节能与服务质量平衡。同时展示了世界模型在真实网络数据上的性能以及在吞吐量约束下的反事实动作评估。
Motivation: 移动网络日益复杂，需要智能动态控制策略来实现高效节能管理。现有方法（如传统方法和强化学习）在适应性、鲁棒性或动态目标更改方面存在不足。
Method: 提出基于世界模型的方法，从历史数据中训练世界模型预测动作对网络状态的影响，控制器利用模型的不确定性估计进行鲁棒优化，且优化目标可动态更改而无需重新训练模型。
Result: 在模拟的移动网络节能特性闭环控制中，该方法在平衡节能和服务质量方面优于传统方法和强化学习方法。在真实网络数据上展示了世界模型的性能，并在吞吐量约束下评估了控制器提出的反事实动作。
Conclusion: 基于世界模型的方法为移动网络控制提供了一种灵活且鲁棒的方案，能够在不重新训练的情况下适应不同目标，实验结果验证了其有效性。

papers.title: WuYu-EnvLE-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Environmental Law Enforcement
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for environmental enforcement, but their ability to produce traceable enforcement decisions remains unclear. We introduce WuYu-EnvLE-Bench, a benchmark built from real enforcement cases, regulatory standards, and expert review. It contains 2,521 benchmark instances, 14 tasks, and 12 pollution-medium subdomains across pre-enforcement, in-enforcement, and post-enforcement workflows. Using Absolute Environmental Enforcement Score (AES) and Intelligent Enforcement Index (IEI), we evaluate open-source and closed-source LLMs across capability, response quality, and resource efficiency. Results show that LLMs perform well on rule-bounded tasks but remain unreliable in evidence-chain construction, contradiction detection, multi-source integration, and procedural judgment. Model scaling also shows diminishing returns: medium-sized models approach leading models in structured tasks, while larger models do not reliably overcome evidence-reasoning bottlenecks. WuYu-EnvLE-Bench highlights the need for evidence-grounded, rule-aware, and task-adaptive enforcement reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WuYu-EnvLE-Bench，一个基于真实执法案例、监管标准和专家评审构建的大语言模型环境执法能力评估基准。基准包含 2521 个实例、14 个任务和 12 个污染介质子域，覆盖执法前、中、后流程。使用 Absolute Environmental Enforcement Score (AES) 和 Intelligent Enforcement Index (IEI) 评估模型，发现 LLM 在规则约束任务上表现良好，但在证据链构建、矛盾检测、多源整合和程序判断上不可靠，且模型扩展收益递减。
Motivation: 大语言模型在环境执法中的可追溯决策能力尚未明确，缺乏系统性的评估基准。
Method: 基于真实执法案例、监管标准和专家评审构建 WuYu-EnvLE-Bench，包含 2521 个实例、14 个任务和 12 个污染介质子域，使用 Absolute Environmental Enforcement Score (AES) 和 Intelligent Enforcement Index (IEI) 评估模型。
Result: 开源和闭源 LLM 在规则约束任务上表现好，但在证据链构建、矛盾检测、多源整合和程序判断任务上不可靠；模型扩展出现收益递减，中等模型接近领先模型，但更大模型未解决证据推理瓶颈。
Conclusion: 需要证据导向、规则感知和任务自适应的执法推理；该基准突显了当前 LLM 在环境执法中的局限性。

papers.title: Semantically Similar, Logically Distinct: Diagnosing the Semantic-Answerability Gap in Table RAG
papers.abstract_en: Tables are a critical knowledge source in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), but a retrieved table may lack sufficient evidence to answer a query, a property we call answerability. While answerability broadly concerns whether a source or collection of sources contains sufficient evidence, retrieval models optimized for semantic relevance do not guarantee it even in the single-source case, creating a fundamental mismatch. To study this, we introduce TCR-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for Table Content-level Answerability in RAG, built around sibling tables, i.e., tables with highly similar schemas but subtle content differences. On TCR-Bench, the dense retrievers we evaluate persistently exhibit a Semantic-Answerability Gap: they often retrieve the correct sibling group yet struggle to pinpoint the uniquely answerable table within it, dropping QA performance from 0.755 (oracle) to 0.330 (top-5 retrieved). Our analysis suggests this gap is associated with semantic accumulation, schema-level cue dependence, and weak row-column binding. As a diagnostic probe into the source of this gap, we test whether a lightweight two-stage pipeline, Answerability-Aware Reranking (AAR), applying direct query-table answerability judgment, can recover performance: it raises top-1 target retrieval from 18.2% to 57.4%, and this large gain is itself evidence that much of the observed failure reflects a missing answerability verification step, rather than an inherent limitation of model capacity alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对表格检索增强生成（RAG）中检索到的表格可能缺乏足够证据回答问题（即不可回答性）的问题，提出诊断基准TCR-Bench，基于高度相似模式但内容细微差异的“兄弟表”构建。实验显示稠密检索器存在语义-可回答性差距：常检索到正确兄弟组却难以定位唯一可回答的表格，导致QA性能从oracle的0.755降至top-5的0.330。分析表明差距与语义积累、模式级线索依赖和弱行列绑定有关；提出的可回答性感知重排序（AAR）管线可将top-1目标检索率从18.2%提升至57.4%，证明主要失败源于缺失可回答性验证步骤。
Motivation: 检索模型优化语义相关性并不保证表格包含足够证据回答查询，在单源情况下也存在这种根本性不匹配，但现有研究缺乏对表格内容级可回答性的系统诊断。
Method: 构建TCR-Bench基准，使用模式高度相似但内容存在微妙差异的“兄弟表”对；提出两阶段AAR管线，直接进行查询-表格可回答性判断作为重排序步骤。
Result: 稠密检索器在TCR-Bench上表现急剧下降（oracle 0.755 vs top-5 0.330）；AAR将top-1目标检索率从18.2%提升至57.4%。
Conclusion: 语义-可回答性差距的主要来源是缺少显式的可回答性验证步骤，而非模型容量限制，AAR的大幅提升验证了这一点。

papers.title: MXSens: Sensitivity-Aware Mixed-Precision Quantization for Efficient LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: 4-bit quantization enables efficient LLM inference, but suffers from significant accuracy degradation due to outliers. Prior work addresses this problem via data rotation or mixed-precision integer quantization, but often relies on software-managed scaling and frequent dequantization, incurring substantial overhead. Microscaling formats, such as MXINT, eliminate these inefficiencies by encoding scales in hardware, yet remain incompatible with rotation-based methods. Our analysis reveals that outliers vary in severity, from rare extremes to frequent mild deviations, and that quantization sensitivity is unevenly distributed across layers and columns. These insights motivate a fine-grained, sensitivity-guided approach. We introduce MXSens, a training-free method that assigns mixed mantissa bitwidths (4/6/8) based on column- and layer-wise sensitivity, naturally leveraging the block-wise structure of MXINT. MXSens outperforms state-of-the-art quantization methods across a range of models and tasks. Under the W4A4KV4 setting, MXSens achieves perplexities of 3.77 and 7.63 on LLaMA-2-70B and LLaMA-3-8B, respectively, substantially improving over existing baselines on WikiText-2. Our work establishes a new balance between accuracy and resource efficiency for LLM quantization.

papers.title: Lifelong Multi-Subsystem Pickup and Delivery with Buffer-Limited Handover Stations
papers.abstract_en: Coordinating payload transfers between subsystems is a critical challenge in lifelong Multi-Agent Pickup and Delivery (MAPD). We study systems where agents are confined to separate regions and must exchange payloads through shared handover stations. These stations, equipped with single docks and finite buffers, are inherently vulnerable to blocking and starvation. We formalize this problem as Multi-Subsystem MAPD with Buffer-limited Handover Stations (MS-MAPD-BHS). We then propose Handover-Aware Reservation and Routing (HARR), an online controller that couples per-subsystem planners. HARR uses a shared dock reservation calendar and a deterministic rolling-horizon projection of buffer occupancy to coordinate actions. A candidate route is accepted only if its dock interval is free and the resulting buffer occupancy projection remains within capacity. Under perfect execution, these checks ensure collision-free dock use and buffer-safe committed operations within the reservation horizon. In simulation, HARR achieves up to 77% higher throughput and 92% lower backlog than a fixed-dock ablation at moderate load, while also reducing planning time relative to a coupled station-aware Token Passing baseline. These results show that explicit interface coordination substantially improves stability in modular multi-subsystem transport.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究终身多智能体拾取与配送（MAPD）中跨子系统的负载传输协调问题，形式化为带有限缓冲区中转站的多子系统MAPD（MS-MAPD-BHS），并提出一种在线控制器HARR（Handover-Aware Reservation and Routing），通过共享停靠预约日历和缓冲区占用滚动预测来协调各子系统的规划器。实验表明，在中等负载下，HARR相比固定停靠基线实现了最高77%的吞吐量提升和92%的积压降低，同时规划时间优于耦合的Token Passing基线。
Motivation: 在长期运行的MAPD系统中，智能体被限制在不同区域，必须通过共享中转站交换负载，而这类中转站仅配备单个停靠点和有限缓冲区，容易发生阻塞和饥饿，现有方法缺乏有效的跨子系统协调机制。
Method: 提出HARR在线控制器，结合共享停靠预约日历和确定性滚动时域缓冲区占用预测，仅当候选路线的停靠时间段空闲且缓冲区占用不超过容量时才接受该路线，从而在完美执行下保证无冲突停靠和缓冲区安全。
Result: 仿真中，HARR在中等负载下相比固定停靠基线吞吐量提升最高77%，积压降低92%，规划时间也优于耦合的站感知Token Passing基线。
Conclusion: 明确的接口协调能显著提升模块化多子系统运输系统的稳定性。
