papers.title: Semantic Color Naturalness Breaker: Preventing Illegitimate Colorization via Content-Aware Color Priors
papers.abstract_en: Automatic image colorization enables large-scale and low-cost reuse of grayscale media (e.g., manga panels and archival photographs), facilitating unauthorized reuse and redistribution. Once released online, grayscale content can be readily turned into unauthorized colorized derivatives using off-the-shelf models, creating a practical need for proactive, content-side protection at publication time. Building on Uncolorable Examples (UE), which add imperceptible perturbations to released grayscale images to degrade unauthorized colorization, we propose Semantic Color Naturalness Breaker (SCNB) -- a semantic-level UE framework that drives colorization outputs toward content-inconsistent colors while preserving the visual fidelity of the released grayscale media. We further introduce Content-aware Color Distributional Distance (CaCDD), a ground-truth-free, content-aware measure of color plausibility derived from semantic color priors, used both as the optimization objective of SCNB and as an evaluation metric. Experiments on ImageNet show that our method remains effective under small perturbation budgets and common post-processing, supporting practical deployment in real-world content-sharing pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出语义颜色自然度破坏器 (SCNB)，一种基于语义级别的不可着色示例 (UE) 方法，通过在发布的灰度图像中添加不可感知的扰动，使自动着色模型生成内容不一致的颜色，从而防止未经授权的着色。同时引入内容感知颜色分布距离 (CaCDD) 作为优化目标和评估指标，实验表明在ImageNet上在小扰动预算和后处理下仍有效。
Motivation: 自动图像着色技术使得灰度媒体（如漫画、档案照片）容易被未经授权地着色和再分发，需要一种发布时的主动保护方法。现有不可着色示例方法缺乏语义级别的颜色不一致性，且缺乏无真值的颜色合理性评估指标。
Method: 提出语义颜色自然度破坏器 (SCNB)，基于内容感知颜色先验，通过优化内容感知颜色分布距离 (CaCDD) 生成扰动，使着色输出颜色与内容不一致。CaCDD无需真实着色参考，直接度量颜色合理性。
Result: 在ImageNet上，所提方法在小扰动预算和常见后处理（如JPEG压缩）下仍能有效破坏着色质量，支持实际部署。
Conclusion: SCNB提供了一种内容侧的保护手段，通过语义级别的颜色先验实现更自然的破坏效果，但仍需进一步研究对更先进着色模型的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Optimizing the Preconditioner: A Black-box Online-to-Nonconvex Conversion with Static Regret Minimization Oracles
papers.abstract_en: We study whether stochastic nonconvex optimization can be reduced to ordinary static regret minimization in online convex optimization in a black-box manner. For smooth nonconvex objectives, our reduction maintains a predictable gradient tracker, while a black-box online learner selects a preconditioner that determines how this tracker is transformed into the update direction. The learner receives linear convex losses and is evaluated against a single fixed comparator over one undiscounted online game. For a $β$-smooth objective with range bounded by $M$ and an unbiased stochastic-gradient oracle with variance bounded by \(σ^2\), we establish $$\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^T \mathbb E\!\left[\|\nabla f(x_t)\|_2^2\right] \lesssim \frac{σ\sqrt{Mβ}}{\sqrt T} + \frac{\sqrt{Mβ}\, \mathscr R_T(\mathcal A,I_d)}{T} + \frac{Mβ}{T}.$$ Consequently, any black-box OCO algorithm with $\mathscr R_T(\mathcal A,I_d)=O(\sqrt T)$ recovers the classical $O(\frac{1}{\sqrt{T}})$ convergence rate. We further show that the same black-box framework extends beyond the smooth setting to Lipschitz nonconvex objectives without Lipschitz continuous gradients. Importantly, this extension continues to rely only on an ordinary static-regret guarantee and requires no stronger notion of online regret. When the OCO oracle admits square-root static regret, the resulting conversion achieves the optimal $O(T^{-2/7})$ convergence rate for the corresponding Goldstein stationary point. These results resolve the open problem posed by Chen and Hazan (2024). More broadly, our framework separates optimizer design into gradient prediction and online preconditioner selection, providing a principled perspective on how adaptive optimization methods such as AdaGrad and Shampoo may be understood through static regret and applied in nonconvex optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究将随机非凸优化黑盒归约为在线凸优化中的静态遗憾最小化问题。对于一个β-光滑目标，若OCO算法具有平方根静态遗憾，则恢复经典O(1/√T)收敛率；对于Lipschitz非凸目标，达到最优O(T^{-2/7}) Goldstein驻点收敛。结果解决了Chen和Hazan (2024)的开放问题。
Motivation: 现有的自适应优化方法（如AdaGrad、Shampoo）在非凸优化中表现良好，但缺乏统一的理论理解。本文旨在将非凸优化归约为普通的静态遗憾最小化问题，从而通过OCO黑盒自动选择合适的预处理器。
Method: 提出一个黑盒框架，维护梯度追踪器并由在线凸优化算法选择预处理器，将追踪器转换为更新方向。OCO算法接收线性凸损失，与单个固定比较器比较，覆盖光滑和Lipschitz非凸目标。
Result: 对于β-光滑目标，平方梯度范数期望满足所给不等式；若OCO静态遗憾为O(√T)，则收敛率为O(1/√T)。对于Lipschitz非凸目标，若静态遗憾为平方根，则实现最优O(T^{-2/7}) Goldstein驻点收敛。
Conclusion: 该框架将优化器设计分解为梯度预测和在线预处理器选择，为AdaGrad等自适应方法在非凸优化中的应用提供了理论依据。

papers.title: Trustworthy Protein-Ligand Binding Affinity Prediction via Reliability-Aware Multi-Engine Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Accurate protein-ligand binding affinity prediction is central to computational drug discovery, yet modern docking engines frequently disagree without indicating which prediction to trust. Consensus scoring and ensemble methods improve mean accuracy but treat all predictions identically without interpretable confidence measures or uncertainty decomposition, ignoring the chemical context of each protein-ligand pair. To address this limitation, we introduce RELIABLE-BA (RELIABiLity-aware Evidential fusion for Binding Affinity), an evidential framework for multi-engine binding affinity prediction. Our model comprises three steps: (1) modeling each engine as an evidential expert via Normal-Inverse-Gamma distributions, (2) scaling epistemic uncertainty through learned reliability from molecular context while preserving each expert's predictive mean, and (3) fusing experts through closed-form aggregation that captures both individual uncertainty and inter-engine disagreement. Experiments on the PDBBind and BDB2020+ benchmarks demonstrate competitive point prediction with substantially improved uncertainty calibration, and additional validation on the SARS-CoV-2 Mpro dataset and 5HT2A receptor demonstrates applicability to clinically relevant drug targets. Crucially, these uncertainty estimates enable reliable filtering of protein-ligand pairs, reducing prediction error by up to 25% when retaining only high-confidence pairs. To our knowledge, RELIABLE-BA is the first multi-engine binding affinity prediction framework to combine evidential fusion with context-dependent reliability, offering a principled path toward trustworthy AI-guided drug discovery. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/yongchand/RELIABLE-BA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RELIABLE-BA，一个基于证据融合的多引擎结合亲和力预测框架，通过Normal-Inverse-Gamma分布建模每个引擎，学习上下文依赖的可靠性，并通过闭式聚合融合专家。在PDBBind和BDB2020+基准上取得竞争性点预测和更好的不确定性校准，在SARS-CoV-2 Mpro和5HT2A受体上验证。高置信度过滤可减少高达25%的预测误差。
Motivation: 现有对接引擎常给出不一致的预测且无置信度度量，集成方法虽提高平均精度但缺乏可解释的不确定性分解，忽略了每对蛋白质-配体的化学上下文。
Method: 三步：1) 通过Normal-Inverse-Gamma分布将每个引擎建模为证据专家；2) 通过分子上下文学习可靠性缩放认知不确定性，同时保留预测均值；3) 通过闭式聚合融合专家，捕获个体不确定性和引擎间分歧。
Result: 在PDBBind和BDB2020+上点预测具有竞争力且不确定性校准显著改善；在SARS-CoV-2 Mpro和5HT2A受体上验证临床相关性。高置信度过滤减少预测误差达25%。
Conclusion: 本文提出首个结合证据融合和上下文依赖可靠性的多引擎结合亲和力预测框架，为可信AI药物发现提供原则性路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ConsiSpace: Learning Geometric Consistency Matters for Video Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Video spatial reasoning is essential for navigation-oriented perception and long-video question answering, where models must infer spatial relations across long horizons under changing viewpoints. However, existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remain largely semantic-centric, and often fail to reliably aggregate consistent spatial evidence from redundant video observations, leading to inefficient or unstable reasoning. To address these issues, we propose ConsiSpace, a geometry-consistency-aware framework for geometry-sensitive video spatial reasoning that turns spatial consistency into both an evidence organization principle and an explicit post-SFT learning signal. We build a geometry-consistent memory (GCM) including implicit evidence tokens and explicit geometric cues, and leverage efficient organization strategies to compactly preserve task-related spatial evidence. Furthermore, we utilize unified consistency self-supervised reinforcement learning (UC-SSRL) after supervised fine-tuning to improve cross-view stability, with answer-, metric-, and topology-consistency rewards. Extensive experiments on three spatial-reasoning benchmarks, VSI-Bench, OSI-Bench, and MMSI-Video-Bench, show consistent gains, improving the average score by 12.6 points over the strongest baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ConsiSpace框架，通过几何一致性记忆（GCM）和统一一致性自监督强化学习（UC-SSRL）提升多模态大模型在视频空间推理中的跨视角稳定性。在VSI-Bench、OSI-Bench和MMSI-Video-Bench三个基准上，平均得分相比最强基线提升12.6个点。
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型在视频空间推理中难以可靠聚合来自冗余观测的一致空间证据，导致推理不稳定或低效。
Method: 构建几何一致性记忆（GCM），包含隐式证据标记和显式几何线索，并采用高效组织策略紧凑保留任务相关空间证据；在SFT后使用统一一致性自监督强化学习（UC-SSRL），通过答案、度量和拓扑一致性奖励提升跨视角稳定性。
Result: 在三个空间推理基准（VSI-Bench、OSI-Bench、MMSI-Video-Bench）上，相比最强基线平均提升12.6个点。
Conclusion: 将空间一致性转化为证据组织原则和显式学习信号可以有效提升视频空间推理性能。

papers.title: Is Progressive Disclosure All You Need for Long-Context Agents?
papers.abstract_en: Long-document question answering usually forces a choice between loading the whole document into the context window and bolting on a separate retriever. Agentic AI suggests a broader option, giving the agent the document path and letting it decide how and what to read. Agent Skills, a standard for packaging expertise into folders an agent loads on demand, supply a ready mechanism: progressive disclosure, which exposes only what a query needs, from a short description down to the specific passages. Practitioners rapidly adopted this pattern for book-length understanding tasks, but the evidence to support such choices has been anecdotal. We run the first controlled study of the pattern, comparing raw-document navigation and several designs of Agent Skills packs against a classical hybrid retriever across three agent harnesses and three model families on InfiniteBench. On a single book, the gain depends on the harness, running large when the agent navigates the raw document poorly but near zero when a strong agent harness already divides and retrieves on its own. When scaling up to tasks that span many books, raw-document navigation collapses while one-level progressive disclosure degrades more slowly and pulls ahead. A second, deeper routing level never helps and sometimes breaks accuracy outright, so one level is enough. Progressive disclosure buys context, not intelligence: it is redundant while a strong agent can locate the right passages itself, and decisive once the corpus grows too large to navigate by reading.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对长文档问答中的渐进式披露模式进行受控研究，比较原始文档导航、多种Agent Skills包设计与经典混合检索器在三个agent框架和三个模型族上的表现。实验表明，渐进式披露在单本书上收益取决于agent框架，而在多本书任务中原始文档导航崩溃，一级渐进式披露性能下降更慢并领先；二级深度路由从不帮助甚至破坏准确性。
Motivation: 长文档问答通常需要在加载全文或外挂检索器之间选择，而agent方法允许agent自主决定阅读内容，但渐进式披露模式虽有实践采用，缺乏系统证据支持。
Method: 设计受控实验，比较原始文档导航、多种Agent Skills包（实现渐进式披露）与经典混合检索器，在三个agent框架和三个模型族上，使用InfiniteBench基准评估。
Result: 单本书任务中，渐进式披露的收益取决于agent框架，当agent本身导航能力弱时收益大，强agent已能自主检索时收益近零。多本书任务中，原始文档导航崩溃，一级渐进式披露下降更慢并领先；二级路由无益甚至破坏准确性。
Conclusion: 渐进式披露提供的是上下文容量而非智能：当强agent能自主定位时冗余，当语料规模过大时则至关重要。

papers.title: Concentration and Mean-Square Bounds for Contractive Stochastic Approximation: A Unified Elementary Approach
papers.abstract_en: We establish mean-square and concentration bounds for stochastic approximation (SA) with arbitrary norm contractive mappings, under a multiplicative noise model where the noise may scale affinely with the norm of the iterates, and the iterates are potentially unbounded. These settings arise in reinforcement learning, where operators are often contractive in the $\ell_\infty$ norm and the noise scales with the iterates. To address the arbitrary norm, earlier works replace the non-smooth squared norm with a smooth Lyapunov function constructed via the generalized Moreau envelope. For concentration analysis, these works handle multiplicative noise and unbounded iterates through a multi-stage bootstrapping argument that starts from a time-varying worst-case bound and iteratively refines it. We instead present a unified and elementary analysis that yields both bounds. Using an averaged noise sequence and corresponding auxiliary iterates, we obtain a one-step Lyapunov drift inequality for the normed error directly, without smoothing the norm or constructing an envelope. For the mean-square bound, we combine this drift inequality with an induction argument showing that the iterates remain bounded in expectation. For the concentration bound, we develop a probabilistic induction over a sequence of "good" events on which the iterates are controlled, allowing the standard Azuma-Hoeffding bound to be applied. Our approach yields the first sub-Gaussian tailed maximal (all-time) concentration bound for SA under multiplicative noise, by allowing the stepsize to depend logarithmically on the confidence level. Beyond the specific setting considered here, we discuss the generalizability of these proof techniques to other noise models and iterative algorithms.
papers.comment: Submitted to Stochastic Processes and their Applications
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为一般压缩映射的随机逼近（SA）建立了均方界和集中界，处理乘性噪声和潜在无界迭代，适用于强化学习等场景。通过平均噪声序列和辅助迭代，直接得到范数误差的Lyapunov漂移不等式，无需平滑范数；利用概率归纳和Azuma-Hoeffding界，首次给出乘性噪声下SA的次高斯尾部最大集中界。
Motivation: 现有SA理论在任意范数、乘性噪声和无界迭代下缺乏统一且简洁的均方和集中界分析，之前的方法依赖平滑Lyapunov函数或多阶段自举论证，不够直接。
Method: 采用平均噪声序列和辅助迭代，直接推导范数误差的单步Lyapunov漂移不等式（无需平滑）；对均方界结合归纳证明迭代期望有界；对集中界通过概率归纳构造“好事件”，使标准Azuma-Hoeffding界适用，步长可对数依赖于置信水平。
Result: 摘要报告首次得到乘性噪声下SA的次高斯尾部最大（全时间）集中界，以及均方界；该方法统一并简化了现有分析。
Conclusion: 该方法具有一般性，可推广到其他噪声模型和迭代算法，但本文具体结果限于压缩映射和乘性噪声。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Miles: Metric Learning with Expandable Subspace for Pre-Trained Model-Based Class-Incremental Learning
papers.abstract_en: Class Incremental Learning (CIL) aims to learn new concepts consistently from a data stream without forgetting. Unlike typical CIL methods which need to learn a model from scratch, pre-trained model (PTM) can easily adapt to a new task with fine-tuning. However, existing PTM-based CIL methods fail to achieve a trade-off between performance and computational expenditure, i.e., they either adopt the same parameter space so that leading catastrophic forgetting, or expand a new branch for each task but adding more computational cost. To this end, we propose MetrIc Learning with Expandable Subspace (Miles) to harness the prior information within pre-trained knowledge, thereby orchestrating an efficient expansion of the parameter space through guided optimization. Specifically, it decouples the learnable modules with the pre-trained model, exploiting prior information from intermediate features of the backbone network to enable more flexible parameter expansion. Then, a central loss is adopted to guide the new category to cluster towards the corresponding prototype in the new task subspace while incorporating an auxiliary distance regularization term to maintain metric equilibrium across tasks. Extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets demonstrate that Miles achieves state-of-the-art performance in various CIL settings.
papers.comment: This work has been accepted by IEEE Transactions on Image Processing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对类增量学习（CIL）中预训练模型（PTM）的使用，提出了一种结合度量学习和可扩展子空间的方法（Miles）。该方法通过解耦可学习模块与预训练模型，利用骨干网络的中间特征实现灵活的参数扩展，并采用中心损失引导新类聚类到相应原型，同时加入辅助距离正则化以保持任务间度量平衡。在六个基准数据集上的实验表明，Miles在多种CIL设置下达到了最佳性能。
Motivation: 现有基于PTM的CIL方法难以平衡性能与计算开销：采用相同参数空间会导致灾难性遗忘，而为每个任务扩展新分支则增加计算成本。
Method: 提出Miles框架，解耦可学习模块与预训练模型，从骨干网络的中间特征中利用先验信息实现参数空间的高效扩展；使用中心损失引导新类别在任务子空间中聚类到对应原型，并引入辅助距离正则化项维持跨任务的度量均衡。
Result: 在六个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，Miles在各种CIL设置下达到了最先进的性能。
Conclusion: 通过解耦和基于先验的扩展策略，Miles在预训练模型基础上实现了高效的增量学习，平衡了遗忘与计算开销。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Detection, Attribution, Narration: An End-to-End Pipeline for Explainable Money Mule Identification
papers.abstract_en: Money mule accounts are critical facilitators of financial fraud, yet detecting them at scale remains challenging due to the heterogeneous nature of transactional and behavioural data. We present an end-to-end pipeline for customer-level mule detection comprising three stages: (1) a LightGBM classifier trained on 280 engineered features spanning transaction patterns, account demographics, network topology, and temporal behaviour; (2) a TreeSHAP attribution layer that decomposes each prediction into feature contributions; and (3) a large language model (LLM) module that converts SHAP attributions into analyst-facing natural-language narratives. We evaluate across three open-weight LLM families and assess explanation quality through analyst feedback. In a live production deployment, the system achieves a yield rate of 89%, up from 61% under the incumbent rule-based system, with monthly alert volume expanding from 211 to 302, reflecting broader true-positive coverage rather than increased noise. This corresponds to a 60% incremental adverse detection beyond existing review workflows, substantially outperforming the rule-based approach. Qualitative feedback from analysts indicates that LLM-generated narratives reduce cognitive load during alert triage. We further discuss implications of deploying LLM-augmented explainability in regulated financial environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个端到端的洗钱账户检测流水线，包含LightGBM分类器、TreeSHAP归因层和LLM生成的自然语言解释。系统在生产部署中达到89%的检出率，相比基于规则的系统（61%）有显著提升，同时月警报量从211增加到302，主要是真阳性覆盖扩大。分析师反馈表明LLM生成的叙述降低了告警分类的认知负荷。
Motivation: 洗钱账户是金融欺诈的关键环节，但大规模检测面临交易和行为数据异质性的挑战，现有规则系统检出率低且解释性不足。
Method: 三阶段流水线：①基于280个工程特征的LightGBM分类器；②TreeSHAP归因层分解预测贡献；③大语言模型将SHAP归因转换为面向分析员的自然语言叙述。
Result: 生产部署中检出率从61%提升至89%，月警报量从211增至302（真阳性扩大），额外发现60%增量恶意账户。分析师反馈LLM叙述降低了认知负荷。
Conclusion: LLM增强的可解释性在受监管金融环境中有效提升检出率及人工效率，但需注意部署中的监管合规问题。

summary_sections.method: 三阶段流水线：①基于280个工程特征的LightGBM分类器；②TreeSHAP归因层分解预测贡献；③大语言模型将SHAP归因转换为面向分析员的自然语言叙述。
summary_sections.result: 生产部署中检出率从61%提升至89%，月警报量从211增至302（真阳性扩大），额外发现60%增量恶意账户。分析师反馈LLM叙述降低了认知负荷。
summary_sections.conclusion: LLM增强的可解释性在受监管金融环境中有效提升检出率及人工效率，但需注意部署中的监管合规问题。

papers.title: Pixel-Space Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Latent diffusion models (LDMs) enable efficient high-resolution image synthesis by denoising in a VAE-compressed latent space. However, fixed visual tokenizers can discard fine textures and structural details, while separate representation and diffusion training creates a mismatch between reconstruction and generation objectives. These limitations have renewed interest in pixel-space diffusion, which models raw pixels directly, removes the VAE bottleneck, and supports end-to-end optimization. This formulation better matches the demands of high-fidelity generation but introduces challenges in high-dimensional modeling, including noise scheduling, loss weighting, token efficiency, and scalable architecture design. Pixel-space modeling also offers a promising basis for unified multimodal systems: raw pixels, text, and task conditions can be represented in a shared token space and jointly processed by a single Transformer, narrowing the gap between visual understanding and generation. This paper reviews Pixel-Space Diffusion Transformers (pDiTs) from the perspectives of model architecture, continuous generative mechanisms, and unified multimodal modeling. We summarize representative methods, identify key technical challenges, and discuss future directions toward high-fidelity, end-to-end vision foundation models that integrate generation and understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了像素空间扩散Transformer（pDiTs），从模型架构、连续生成机制和统一多模态建模的角度总结了代表性方法、关键挑战和未来方向。像素空间扩散直接在原始像素上建模，避免了VAE瓶颈，支持端到端优化，适合高保真生成和多模态系统。
Motivation: 潜在扩散模型（LDMs）依赖固定视觉分词器会丢失细节，且重建与生成目标不匹配，像素空间扩散可消除VAE瓶颈并支持端到端优化，但面临高维建模挑战。
Method: 将像素空间扩散Transformer分为模型架构、连续生成机制和统一多模态建模三个视角进行综述。
Result: 总结了代表性方法，识别了关键技术挑战（如噪声调度、损失权重、分词效率和可扩展架构设计），并讨论了未来方向。
Conclusion: 像素空间扩散Transformer为实现高保真、端到端的视觉基础模型（融合生成与理解）提供了有前景的路径。

papers.title: ANNLib: A Development Framework for Efficient Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
papers.abstract_en: Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (ANNS) plays a pivotal role in modern deep learning pipelines. Recently, many ANNS systems have been proposed to either provide broad functionality or reach high performance. However, it is yet difficult to achieve both with minimal programming efforts. We propose ANNLib to address the gap. ANNLib is a library that provides a programming framework for achieving high performance and flexible functionality in ANNS systems, based on popular graph-based ANNS algorithms. We carefully decouple and independently optimize both the algorithm and the data structure components of an ANNS system. In addition, we integrate state-of-the-art algorithms and data structures into ANNLib as modules, along with our new designs. Users can choose combinations of components to implement sophisticated settings with high performance, such as filter search, fully dynamic updates, and historical queries on snapshots. Our experiments show that our new solution provides a simple interface for various applications and achieves comparable or even better performance than previous work, specifically for each application.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了ANNLib，一个基于图的近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）开发框架，旨在同时实现高性能和灵活功能。通过解耦算法和数据结构组件并独立优化，集成先进算法和新设计，支持过滤搜索、全动态更新和快照历史查询等复杂场景。实验表明，ANNLib在多种应用中性能优于或媲美现有系统。
Motivation: 现有ANNS系统难以在最小编程努力下同时实现高性能和广泛功能，存在效率与灵活性之间的权衡。
Method: ANNLib将ANNS系统解耦为算法和数据结构组件并分别优化，集成最新算法和数据结构作为模块，提供组合选择以构建高性能应用。
Result: 实验证明ANNLib在过滤搜索、动态更新、快照查询等应用中达到与现有系统相当或更好的性能。
Conclusion: ANNLib以简单接口实现了高性能和灵活性，尤其适用于需要定制化ANNS功能的场景。

papers.title: Scalable Model-Assisted Multi-Target Estimation in Large Image Collections
papers.abstract_en: Computer vision models are increasingly used as measurement tools to estimate population-level quantities from large image collections, but prediction errors introduce bias and the resulting estimates lack statistical guarantees required in scientific applications. Prior work uses a Monte Carlo framework to combine model predictions with ground-truth annotations by sampling some images for humans to label and is able to provide unbiased estimates with controllable accuracy, but primarily addresses single-scalar estimation. We study the more general problem of multi-target estimation, where many quantities (e.g., class counts or proportions) must be estimated simultaneously, and adapt sampling and estimation strategies from survey sampling to this setting. Evaluations on five detection and segmentation datasets with 7-80 classes show that importance sampling excels with moderate annotation budgets or fewer targets, whereas uniform sampling with control variates is superior when estimating many targets or operating with minimal labels. Additionally, a subset-based ratio estimator remains highly competitive across all regimes. Ultimately, our framework effectively combines biased model predictions and limited human labels into rigorous scientific measurements.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大规模图像集合中多目标估计问题，提出结合模型预测与人工标注的蒙特卡洛框架，针对多个类别同时估计（如类计数或比例），在5个检测与分割数据集（7-80类）上评估了重要性采样、均匀采样结合控制变量以及基于子集的比率估计器三种策略。
Motivation: 现有计算机视觉模型用于估计群体层面数量时存在预测偏差且缺乏统计保证，先前工作仅针对单标量估计，无法直接扩展到多目标同时估计的场景。
Method: 借鉴调查抽样中的采样和估计策略，提出框架：通过从图像集合中采样一部分由人工标注，结合模型预测，设计重要性采样、均匀采样加控制变量、以及子集比率估计器三种方法，实现多目标的无偏估计。
Result: 实验表明：在中等标注预算或较少目标时重要性采样最优；在估计很多目标或极少标注时均匀采样加控制变量更优；子集比率估计器在所有情景下均具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 该框架将偏倚的模型预测与有限人工标签有效结合，提供有统计保证的科学测量结果，但适用范围限于图像集的多目标估计。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: A Dual-Hypothesis Reasoning Framework for LLM Guardrails
papers.abstract_en: We propose ARBITER, a novel LLM guardrail framework that introduces two key ideas: (i) dual-hypothesis reasoning, a reasoning method for LLM guardrails that explicitly considers both safe and unsafe interpretations of a prompt before making a safety decision, and (ii) multi-component supervised fine-tuning (MC-SFT), a structured training loss for reasoning-based guardrails that decomposes LLM outputs into logical components and weights them according to their importance. Existing reasoning-based guardrails often rely on expensive procedures, such as generating reasoning traces using larger or closed-source teacher models and applying full-parameter fine-tuning. In contrast, ARBITER uses a cost-effective self-generation strategy for reasoning traces and LoRA-based parameter-efficient fine-tuning while still achieving better performance than these expensive approaches. Additionally, ARBITER provides faithful evidence-phrase explanations for unsafe decisions, enabling a more transparent and interpretable guardrail method. Experiments on three safety moderation benchmarks show that ARBITER outperforms existing reasoning-based and non-reasoning guardrail baselines, with clear gains in out-of-domain evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ARBITER，一种基于双假设推理和组件加权监督微调的大语言模型护栏框架。该框架通过同时考虑安全和不安全两种解释进行推理，并采用低成本的自生成推理轨迹和LoRA微调，在安全审核基准上超越现有方法，同时提供可解释的证据短语。
Motivation: 现有基于推理的护栏方法依赖昂贵的大教师模型生成推理轨迹并进行全参数微调，成本高且不透明。
Method: 提出双假设推理（同时考虑安全与不安全解释）和多组件监督微调（MC-SFT）损失函数，结合自生成推理轨迹与LoRA参数高效微调。
Result: 在三个安全审核基准上，ARBITER优于现有基于推理和非推理的护栏基线，尤其在跨域评估上表现突出。
Conclusion: ARBITER通过低成本自生成推理和参数高效微调实现了更好的性能，并提供可解释的证据短语，增强了护栏方法的透明性。

papers.title: Predictive Training with Latent Imagination for Visual Quadruped Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement-learning navigation policies for legged robots select actions reactively from current observations and short-term memory, with limited capacity to anticipate how moving obstacles will evolve in the near future. In dynamic environments, this reactivity causes the robot to respond too late because collision risk depends on short-horizon scene structure rather than on current obstacle positions alone. Lightweight predictive supervision applied to the policy's recurrent state during training can encode anticipatory obstacle dynamics without modifying the inference-time controller. We augment a reactive LSTM-SRU navigation backbone with an auxiliary JEPA-style predictor and SIGReg regularization: during training, the predictor supervises the deterministic hidden state to anticipate its own next state; at inference, it is fully discarded, incurring zero additional computational cost. On simulated and real-world navigation benchmarks with dynamic obstacles, our method substantially improves navigation success while reducing collision rates through the predictive training signal alone, without additional inference-time parameters. Real-robot deployment on a Unitree Go2 demonstrates zero-shot sim-to-real transfer: the controller navigates cluttered indoor and dynamic outdoor environments without fine-tuning, with evasive behavior consistent with the collision reduction observed in simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对四足机器人在动态环境中的视觉导航问题，提出一种预测训练方法。通过辅助JEPA风格预测器和SIGReg正则化，在训练时利用潜在想象预测隐状态的下一时刻演变，推理时不增加额外计算。在仿真和真实动态障碍物导航基准上，该方法显著提升导航成功率并降低碰撞率；零样本迁移到Unitree Go2机器人上验证了效果。
Motivation: 现有强化学习导航策略基于当前观测和短期记忆进行反应式动作选择，缺乏对移动障碍物短期演变的预测能力，导致在动态环境中响应迟缓、碰撞风险高。
Method: 在反应式LSTM-SRU导航骨干上，添加一个辅助的JEPA风格预测器和SIGReg正则化：训练时预测器监督确定性隐状态预测其下一时刻状态；推理时完全丢弃，无额外计算开销。
Result: 在仿真和真实世界动态障碍物导航基准中，该方法相比基线显著提升导航成功率并降低碰撞率；在Unitree Go2上零样本sim-to-real迁移成功。
Conclusion: 通过预测性训练信号编码障碍物动态可以有效改善四足机器人在动态环境中的导航性能，且不增加推理时参数。

papers.title: AGG: Jacobian-Aggregated Group Gradient for Efficient GRPO Training of Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is a powerful reinforcement learning algorithm for aligning generative models with human preferences. While successful in large language models~\cite{shao2024deepseekmathpushinglimitsmathematical}, its extension to diffusion and flow matching models introduces a severe computational bottleneck: gradients must be back-propagated through the high-capacity DiT backbone at \emph{every} timestep of the sampling trajectory, making high-resolution text-to-image (T2I) training prohibitively expensive. Training-free DiT inference acceleration methods (e.g., $Δ$-DiT, ScalingCache) exploit the fact that DiT hidden states and velocity predictions vary \emph{smoothly and nearly linearly} along the trajectory. We ask whether the same linearity can reduce the backward-pass cost of DiT RL training, and answer affirmatively with \textbf{JAGG} (\textbf{J}acobian-\textbf{A}ggregated \textbf{G}roup \textbf{G}radient), which reduces full transformer backward passes from $W$ to $2$ per group of $W$ consecutive steps. JAGG approximates intermediate-step Jacobians via $t$-weighted interpolation of the endpoint Jacobians, then aggregates per-step upstream signals into two composite gradients applied through a single joint backward pass. We prove this interpolation is \emph{exact} when the velocity is linear in $(z,t)$, and a cosine-similarity routing rule (\texttt{jagg\_frac}) deploys JAGG only where the assumption holds. Experiments on T2I benchmarks show JAGG delivers $\sim$2$\times$ backward speedup with negligible quality degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散模型在组相对策略优化（GRPO）训练中反向传播计算成本过高的问题，提出 JAGG（Jacobian-Aggregated Group Gradient）方法。通过利用 DiT 隐藏状态沿轨迹线性变化的特性，JAGG 将每 W 个连续步骤的全变换器反向传播从 W 次减少到 2 次，使用端点雅可比矩阵的 t 加权插值近似中间步骤雅可比，并聚合上游信号。实验在文本到图像生成基准上实现约2倍反向传播加速，且质量下降可忽略。
Motivation: GRPO 在扩散模型训练中需要在每个采样时间步通过高容量 DiT 骨干反向传播梯度，导致高分辨率文本到图像训练计算成本极高。现有训练自由推理加速方法利用了隐藏状态的线性变化，但尚未用于降低反向传播成本。
Method: 提出 JAGG，将连续的 W 个时间步分组，仅对组内第一个和最后一个时间步执行完整反向传播，中间步骤的雅可比矩阵通过端点雅可比矩阵的 t 加权插值近似，然后聚合上游信号得到两个复合梯度，最后通过单个联合反向传播应用。同时引入余弦相似度路由规则（jagg_frac）仅在假设成立时使用 JAGG。
Result: 在文本到图像基准测试中，JAGG 实现约2倍的反向传播速度提升，且图像质量下降可忽略。
Conclusion: 证明了利用扩散轨迹的线性特性可以显著降低 GRPO 训练中 DiT 的反向传播成本，且 JAGG 在加速的同时保持生成质量。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对扩散模型在组相对策略优化（GRPO）训练中反向传播计算成本过高的问题，提出 JAGG（Jacobian-Aggregated Group Gradient）方法。通过利用 DiT 隐藏状态沿轨迹线性变化的特性，JAGG 将每 W 个连续步骤的全变换器反向传播从 W 次减少到 2 次，使用端点雅可比矩阵的 t 加权插值近似中间步骤雅可比，并聚合上游信号。实验在文本到图像生成基准上实现约2倍反向传播加速，且质量下降可忽略。
summary_sections.motivation: GRPO 在扩散模型训练中需要在每个采样时间步通过高容量 DiT 骨干反向传播梯度，导致高分辨率文本到图像训练计算成本极高。现有训练自由推理加速方法利用了隐藏状态的线性变化，但尚未用于降低反向传播成本。
summary_sections.method: 提出 JAGG，将连续的 W 个时间步分组，仅对组内第一个和最后一个时间步执行完整反向传播，中间步骤的雅可比矩阵通过端点雅可比矩阵的 t 加权插值近似，然后聚合上游信号得到两个复合梯度，最后通过单个联合反向传播应用。同时引入余弦相似度路由规则（jagg_frac）仅在假设成立时使用 JAGG。
summary_sections.result: 在文本到图像基准测试中，JAGG 实现约2倍的反向传播速度提升，且图像质量下降可忽略。
summary_sections.conclusion: 证明了利用扩散轨迹的线性特性可以显著降低 GRPO 训练中 DiT 的反向传播成本，且 JAGG 在加速的同时保持生成质量。

papers.title: A Weisfeiler-Leman Characterization of Global-Attention Graph Transformers for Mixed-Integer Linear Programs
papers.abstract_en: Graph foundation models (GFMs) with global attention are increasingly used to represent mixed-integer linear programs (MILPs), aiming to capture structure beyond the locality of standard graph neural networks. We study their expressive power through graph isomorphism testing, asking which MILP instances they map to identical representations. We prove that a broad class of hierarchical graph transformers combining global linear attention, edge-weighted cross-attention, and bipartite message passing is bounded by the one-dimensional Weisfeiler-Leman (1-WL) test: under any parameter setting, 1-WL-equivalent MILP graphs receive identical graph embeddings. Our compositional proof shows that each architectural component is a symmetric multiset function and thus preserves 1-WL equivalence. We validate this characterization across ten diverse graph encoders, including Graphormer-, GraphGPS-, Set-Transformer-, and Gasse-style models. Across model capacities, graph scales, and pooling operators, every tested encoder maps 1-WL-equivalent non-isomorphic graph pairs to numerically identical embeddings. Consequently, graph invariants that vary within a 1-WL equivalence class cannot be recovered from these representations. We further show that expressiveness beyond 1-WL arises from input encoding rather than attention: random-walk positional encodings separate the constructed pairs, while additional constructions expose the limits of this remedy. These results characterize the expressive power of global-attention GFMs and provide an encoder-agnostic diagnostic for detecting 1-WL-induced representation equivalence.
papers.comment: Accepted to Topology, Algebra, and Geometry in Data Science (TAG-DS) 2026 (20 pages, 10 figures) [Lightning Oral Presentation]
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了结合全局线性注意力、边加权交叉注意力和二分消息传递的分层图变换器在混合整数线性规划（MILP）上的表达能力。通过图同构测试，证明该类模型受限于1-WL测试：1-WL等价的MILP图产生相同的图嵌入。实验在十种编码器上验证，包括Graphormer、GraphGPS、Set-Transformer等，所有编码器都将1-WL等价但非同构的图对映射到数值相同的嵌入。超越1-WL的表达能力仅来自输入编码（如随机游走位置编码），而非注意力机制。
Motivation: 全局注意力图基础模型（GFM）广泛用于表示MILP，但其表达能力边界尚不明确。现有工作缺乏对这类模型区分不同MILP实例能力的理论刻画。
Method: 采用组合式证明方法，证明分层图变换器的每个组件（全局线性注意力、边加权交叉注意力、二分消息传递）都是对称多重集函数，从而保持1-WL等价性。实验验证了十个不同编码器在多种模型容量、图规模和池化算子下的表现。
Result: 所有测试的编码器均将1-WL等价的非同构图对映射到数值完全相同的嵌入，表明这些模型无法区分1-WL等价类内部的结构差异。随机游走位置编码可以分离构建出的图对，但存在局限性。
Conclusion: 全局注意力GFM的表达能力被1-WL测试界定；超越1-WL的表达能力来源于输入编码而非注意力架构。该结果提供了一个与编码器无关的诊断方法，用于检测1-WL引起的表示等价性。

papers.title: CoCurve: Cross-Module Co-Pruning Curvature for Training-Free Structured LLM Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Structured pruning compresses large language models (LLMs) by removing whole computational units, such as attention heads and feed-forward (FFN) channel groups. Most training-free methods, however, rank these units independently, implicitly treating the loss from pruning a set as the sum of its individual losses. This view fails for Transformers, whose sublayers are coupled through a shared residual stream. Two individually weak units can thus be jointly indispensable, yet independent scoring is blind to such dependence and removes them together. We introduce CoCurve (Cross-Module Co-Pruning Curvature), a calibration-only, fine-tuning-free method that prunes attention and FFN units jointly. A second-order Taylor expansion of the token-level KL between the frozen model and its masked copy yields a single Fisher matrix whose diagonal is classical node saliency and whose off-diagonal entries are co-pruning curvature edges: the extra damage of removing two units together. Under a single-ablation additivity approximation this matrix reduces to a Gram product of single-unit ablation features, so the full M x M interaction is recovered from M forward passes, with no pairwise sweeps or gradients. Pruning then reduces to one budgeted quadratic program, solved in a single shot under a shared attention--FFN budget, with no labels, fine-tuning, or recovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoCurve，一种无需训练的结构化剪枝方法，用于压缩大型语言模型。通过二阶泰勒展开计算跨模块（注意力头和 FFN 通道组）的协同剪枝曲率，并利用单次消融可加性近似，将剪枝转化为单次二次规划问题，无需标签或微调。
Motivation: 现有无训练剪枝方法独立评估每个单元的重要性，忽略了 Transformer 中跨模块耦合（如注意力头和 FFN 通过残差流共享）导致的联合重要性，导致共同移除关键单元时性能损失被低估。
Method: 基于冻结模型与其掩码副本之间的 token 级 KL 散度的二阶泰勒展开，构建包含经典节点显著度（对角）和协同剪枝曲率边（非对角）的 Fisher 矩阵；利用单次消融可加性近似，将 M×M 交互矩阵简化为单次消融特征的 Gram 积，仅需 M 次前向传播即可恢复完整交互信息，无需梯度或成对扫描。剪枝通过单次有预算的二次规划求解，在共享注意力-FFN 预算下联合剪枝。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，仅声称该方法可在无标签、无微调、无恢复训练的情况下有效剪枝。
Conclusion: CoCurve 将跨模块联合剪枝问题转化为单次二次规划，避免了传统独立评分方法的盲点。

papers.title: ZifaMem: Structured Memory for Persona, Preference, and Emotional Continuity in AI Companions
papers.abstract_en: AI companions are judged not only by single-turn fluency but by whether they sustain emotional continuity: remembering who the companion is, what the user prefers, and how the relationship has felt. We present ZifaMem, a structured memory system that organizes dialogue into session summaries, episodic memories, and a consolidated user model. Against a deployment-honest comparator that supplies the full raw dialogue history, and under a fixed LLM-as-a-judge protocol with route audits, structured memory raises pooled four-backbone emotional-intelligence scores by 11.4% (95% CI 6.3% to 17.1%), and persona grounding improves on all four backbones (Claude +42% relative). Multi-turn affect context wins a +39% net preference over a single-turn snapshot (exploratory), whereas an additional emotion state machine yields no measurable gain on any of five endpoints. Under an identical preregistered protocol, three memory systems (ZifaMem, Mem0, and filtered verbatim retrieval) each improve significantly over raw-history deployment, and ZifaMem and Mem0 are statistically equivalent within +/-5 points on the preregistered primary preference endpoint. The ZifaMem SDK, CLI, and portable Agent Skills are open-sourced at https://github.com/zifacorp/zifamem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ZifaMem，一种用于AI伴侣的结构化记忆系统，通过组织对话摘要、情节记忆和整合的用户模型来维持情感连续性。实验表明，相比提供完整原始对话历史的基线，ZifaMem在四个骨干模型上将情感智能分数平均提升11.4%（95% CI 6.3%-17.1%），其中Claude模型的人物一致性相对提升42%。多轮情感上下文比单轮快照获得+39%的净偏好，而额外的情绪状态机未带来可测量增益。与Mem0和过滤逐字检索相比，三者均显著优于原始历史，且ZifaMem与Mem0在主要偏好端点上统计等价（±5分）。
Motivation: 现有AI伴侣在单轮对话中表现良好，但难以跨轮次维持情感连续性，即记住用户身份、偏好和关系感受。
Method: 提出结构化记忆系统ZifaMem，包括会话摘要、情节记忆和整合的用户模型；使用固定LLM-as-a-judge协议并辅以路径审计进行评估。
Result: 在四个骨干模型上，结构化记忆将情感智能分数提升11.4%；Claude模型人物一致性相对提升42%；多轮情感上下文比单轮快照获得+39%净偏好；情绪状态机无额外增益；ZifaMem与Mem0在主要偏好端点上统计等价。
Conclusion: 结构化记忆系统能有效提升AI伴侣的情感连续性和人物一致性，情绪状态机可能不必要。代码已开源。

papers.title: FlexiGrad: Adaptive Gradient Modulation for Hierarchical Fine-Grained Classification
papers.abstract_en: Many fine-grained recognition tasks contain hierarchical labels such as order, family and species. Although this supervision should be beneficial, jointly optimising all levels often leads to unstable training because coarse and fine classifiers impose inconsistent gradients on the shared backbone. This hierarchical gradient conflict prevents the model from learning a coherent coarse-to-fine representation. In this paper, we propose FlexiGrad, a simple and parameter-free method that regulates gradient interactions during backpropagation. FlexiGrad removes only the harmful conflicting component when tasks disagree and reinforces the shared direction when they partially agree through a smooth hierarchy-aware weighting function. This produces stable optimisation and preserves both global structure and fine-grained discriminative cues. FlexiGrad integrates into existing architectures without modification while improves multi-granularity accuracy on CUB-200-2011, FGVC-Aircraft and Stanford Cars. The code will be available at PRIS-CV/FlexiGrad.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FlexiGrad，一种无需参数的方法，通过调节反向传播中的梯度交互来解决层级细粒度分类中的梯度冲突问题。FlexiGrad在粗粒度与细粒度分类器梯度不一致时移除冲突分量，在部分一致时增强共享方向，从而稳定训练并提升多粒度分类准确率。
Motivation: 层级细粒度分类任务中，联合优化不同层级（如目、科、种）会导致梯度冲突，影响共享骨干网络学习一致的粗到细表示。
Method: FlexiGrad通过一个平滑的层级感知权重函数，在反向传播中仅移除有害的冲突梯度分量，并在任务部分一致时增强共享方向，无需修改现有架构。
Result: 在CUB-200-2011、FGVC-Aircraft和Stanford Cars数据集上，FlexiGrad提升了多粒度分类准确率。
Conclusion: FlexiGrad是一种简单有效的梯度调节方法，可稳定层级细粒度分类训练，且易于集成到现有模型中。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning: From Algorithms To Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) provides a framework for sequential decision making under explicit objectives. In its classical form, RL studies how an agent should act to maximise long-term reward in a dynamic environment. In richer settings, the problem extends beyond a single agent and fixed environment: intelligent behavior may require strategic interaction, adaptation to uncertainty, and reasoning over high-dimensional worlds. This thesis studies RL from two perspectives: algorithms in games and RL in the era of foundation models. The first part focuses on multi-agent RL in games. It examines how incentives, policies, and equilibrium concepts interact in competitive and general-sum environments, spanning two-player zero-sum games, large-scale video games, and multi-player settings with general structure. These works investigate learning in multi-agent systems and the behavior of RL methods in interactive environments. The second part studies RL with generative and foundation models, motivated by the idea that prior knowledge can enrich sequential decision making. Pretrained generative models and learned world models serve as representation tools and structured priors for planning, control, and policy optimization. The thesis develops diffusion-based world models, investigates RL for efficient video generation, explores generative models as policy classes, and studies interactive video world models in which actions shape future observations. It also addresses long-horizon modeling through architectures with memory. Together, these contributions present a unified view of RL as objective-driven adaptation in complex sequential domains. From strategic games to generative world models, the thesis highlights how RL connects decision making, environment modeling, and emerging foundation-model capabilities, offering a broader perspective on the principles underlying intelligent behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该博士论文从两个视角研究强化学习（RL）：游戏中的多智能体RL以及基础模型时代的RL。第一部分考察竞争和一般和环境中激励、策略与均衡概念的交互；第二部分利用预训练生成模型和学习世界模型作为表征工具和结构化先验用于规划、控制和策略优化，并提出了扩散世界模型、研究RL用于高效视频生成、探索生成模型作为策略类，以及研究交互式视频世界模型。论文还通过带记忆的架构处理长时域建模。整体上，论文将RL视为复杂序列领域中目标驱动的适应，连接了决策制定、环境建模和基础模型能力。
Motivation: 经典RL局限于单智能体固定环境，而现实中智能行为需要策略交互、适应不确定性和高维世界推理。论文旨在拓展RL到多智能体博弈和基础模型相结合的更丰富场景。
Method: 论文分为两部分：第一部分研究多智能体RL在游戏中的算法，包括两人零和博弈、大规模视频游戏和一般结构的多玩家设置；第二部分提出扩散世界模型、将RL用于视频生成、将生成模型作为策略类、研究交互式视频世界模型，并采用记忆架构进行长时域建模。
Result: 该论文作为博士论文，总结了一系列贡献，没有具体数值结果。摘要中提到开发了扩散世界模型，研究了RL用于高效视频生成等，但未给出性能指标。

papers.title: COLIP-2: Olfaction-Vision-Language Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: The Contrastive Olfaction-Language-Image Pre-training 2 (COLIP-2) model is a multimodal embeddings space that places olfaction as a first-class citizen among vision and language. Molecular structure, gas-sensor readings, odor-descriptor language, and images are all trained into a single shared representation space, so that a robot can localize a detected aroma to objects in a scene probabilistically. No ImageNet-scale datasets of paired image-scent examples exists which warrants the need for their collection. Our intent with the release of COLIP-2 is to demonstrate the limit of what can be built for robotics with open-sourced olfactory data in order to ground the argument for why new methodologies and datasets are necessary in order to enable advanced olfactory-oriented perception capabilities. We enumerate results from internal testing of the COLIP-2 architecture and make necessary optimizations to run the model at the edge for real-time robotics applications. While developed with robotics in mind, the design of COLIP-2 has been influenced by experts across many disciplines of science in academia and industry, and we hope that the model can be useful in any multimodal domain requiring olfactory intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COLIP-2 是一种将嗅觉、视觉和语言对齐到统一嵌入空间的多模态模型。通过对比学习预训练（contrastive learning pretraining），将分子结构、气体传感器读数、气味描述语言和图像映射到共享表示，使机器人能够将检测到的气味与场景中的物体进行概率定位。由于缺乏大规模标注的气味-图像配对数据集，该模型旨在展示当前开放嗅觉数据的极限，并推动新方法与数据集的发展。内部测试验证了模型效果，并针对边缘端实时运行进行了优化。
Motivation: 现有缺乏 ImageNet 规模的气味-图像配对数据集，需要论证新方法和数据集的必要性以支持先进的嗅觉感知能力。
Method: 对比学习预训练，将分子结构、气体传感器读数、气味描述语言和图像训练到单一共享表示空间。
Result: 内部测试结果良好，并进行了模型优化使其能够在边缘端实时运行，适用于机器人应用。
Conclusion: 模型设计受多学科专家影响，希望用于任何需要嗅觉智能的多模态领域，但当前受限于开放数据的规模。

papers.title: Why Does Feedback-Augmented Self-Distillation Fail to Improve Retrieval-Interleaved Search Agents?
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers a promising approach for training large language models without relying on a separate teacher model. However, its effectiveness on complex agentic tasks remains largely unexplored. In this work, we instantiate Feedback-Augmented Self-Distillation (FA-SD), a self-distillation algorithm for agentic search that leverages successful demonstrations as privileged information. We identify that models can rely on recurring reasoning-and-search output templates, producing trajectories that appear diverse but are largely agnostic to the input question, making the KL-based self-distillation signal uninformative. We term this phenomenon decoding collapse, a failure mode that can be missed by existing evaluation metrics. To understand its underlying cause, we show that although the self-teacher achieves stronger performance, learning remains inherently unstable due to inconsistent supervision signals. We further decompose this inconsistency into model inconsistency and prompt inconsistency, and show that the latter can significantly degrade the quality of the supervision signal, limiting the effectiveness of self-teacher learning. To mitigate this inconsistency, we introduce an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher to stabilize the self-teacher and provide more consistent supervision signals. Although the EMA teacher requires a warm-up phase during which performance may temporarily regress, it ultimately improves model performance by providing more stable supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究反馈增强自蒸馏（FA-SD）在检索交错搜索代理任务中的失效原因。发现模型会生成与输入问题无关的重复推理-搜索输出模板，导致KL散度自蒸馏信号无效，这种现象称为解码坍缩（decoding collapse）。进一步指出学习不稳定性源于监督信号的不一致性，包括模型不一致和提示不一致，后者会严重降低监督信号质量。提出指数移动平均（EMA）教师模型来稳定自教师并提供更一致的监督信号。
Motivation: 自蒸馏在复杂智能体任务中的有效性尚不明确，尤其当模型依赖模板化输出时，自蒸馏信号可能失去信息量，导致性能无法提升。
Method: 实例化反馈增强自蒸馏（FA-SD）算法，利用成功演示作为特权信息；分析解码坍缩现象，分解不稳定性为模型不一致和提示不一致；引入指数移动平均（EMA）教师模型以缓解不一致性。
Result: 揭示了解码坍缩导致自蒸馏信号无效；EMA教师模型在预热阶段可能暂时性能回退，但最终通过提供更稳定的监督信号提升模型性能。
Conclusion: 反馈增强自蒸馏在检索交错搜索代理中可能因解码坍缩而失败，需要在监督信号一致性方面进行缓解，EMA教师模型是一种有效但需谨慎使用的策略。

papers.title: Volatility-Aware Extreme Event Detection in High-Frequency Financial Markets
papers.abstract_en: Predicting extreme price movements in high-frequency financial markets is a challenging task due to non-stationarity, heavy-tailed return distributions, and severe class imbalance. In particular, rare but impactful events are often difficult to detect using conventional modeling approaches, which typically treat extreme movements as isolated observations. This study proposes a volatility-aware approach for extreme event detection using high-frequency Bitcoin limit order book (LOB) data. Motivated by empirical evidence of volatility clustering, the target formulation is extended to incorporate both large future returns and high-volatility regimes. This redefinition increases the proportion of informative samples and aligns the learning objective with the underlying market dynamics. Using a tree-based model (XGBoost) with time-series cross-validation and imbalance-aware evaluation, the proposed method achieves a Precision-Recall AUC of approximately 0.40, significantly outperforming the baseline formulation with a PR-AUC of around 0.06. This represents more than a sixfold improvement in detecting rare events. The results highlight that target design plays a critical role in financial machine learning, often exceeding the impact of model complexity. By incorporating volatility structure into the labeling process, the proposed approach provides a more effective and realistic framework for extreme event detection in high-frequency cryptocurrency markets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高频金融市场极端价格波动预测中存在的非平稳性、重尾分布和类别不平衡问题，提出一种波动感知（volatility-aware）的极端事件检测方法。利用比特币限价订单簿（LOB）数据，将目标定义扩展为同时包含大未来回报和高波动率区间，从而增加信息样本比例。使用XGBoost模型与时序交叉验证，PR-AUC达到约0.40，相比基线（0.06）提升超过六倍。
Motivation: 高频金融市场的极端价格运动难以预测，传统方法将极端运动视为孤立观测，忽略了波动率聚类等市场动态特性。
Method: 提出波动感知的目标定义，结合大未来回报和高波动率区间来标记极端事件；采用XGBoost模型，配合时序交叉验证和不平衡感知评估。
Result: 在比特币LOB数据上，PR-AUC约为0.40，比基线（0.06）提升六倍以上。
Conclusion: 目标设计（target design）在金融机器学习中比模型复杂度更关键；纳入波动率结构可更有效地检测高频加密货币市场的极端事件。

papers.title: Hierarchy-Aware and Anatomy-Guided Learning for Lung Ultrasound Video Classification
papers.abstract_en: Lung ultrasound (LUS) is a bedside tool for assessing pulmonary edema in patients at risk due to heart failure or impaired kidney function. However, automated LUS analysis remains challenging because of speckle noise, imaging artifacts, and operator-dependent acquisition variability. In this work, we present a deep learning framework for multi-class LUS video classification that explores two components: hierarchy-aware training, and anatomy-guided learning. Starting from a strong baseline, we introduce hierarchical training strategies and then introduce pleural line mask supervision to guide model attention toward anatomically relevant regions. We study four clinically relevant classes--healthy, B-lines, consolidations, and mixed B-lines with consolidations--using an open-access dataset of 1,886 videos from 219 patients, evaluated with patient-level five-fold cross-validation. Results show that hierarchy-aware training improves pathological separation relative to flat classification, while mask-guided attention supervision achieves the highest mean macro-F1 of 65.7\% and produces more localized attention patterns. Transfer experiments on the external COVID-BLUeS dataset further show competitive and parameter-efficient adaptation while preserving pleural-focused attention behavior. These findings suggest that combining clinically structured objectives with anatomy-guided supervision is a practical approach to robust, interpretable LUS video analysis. Code and model implementations are available at https://github.com/Alya-Almsouti/LUS-video-classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于肺部超声（LUS）视频分类的深度学习框架，结合层级感知训练和解剖引导学习，在开放数据集上实现65.7%的平均宏F1分数，并在外部数据集上展示了参数高效的迁移能力。
Motivation: 自动LUS分析因斑点噪声、成像伪影和操作者依赖性而具有挑战性，现有方法缺乏对病理结构层级关系和解剖区域的显式建模。
Method: 从强基线出发，引入层级训练策略（hierarchy-aware training）以及胸膜线掩膜监督（pleural line mask supervision）来引导注意力到解剖相关区域，用于四分类（健康、B线、实变、混合）。
Result: 层级感知训练改善了病理区分，掩膜引导注意力监督达到最高平均宏F1 65.7%，并产生更局部的注意力模式；在COVID-BLUeS外部数据集上迁移学习也表现出竞争力和参数效率。
Conclusion: 结合临床结构化目标与解剖引导监督是实现鲁棒、可解释LUS视频分析的有效方法。

papers.title: Human-in-the-Loop User Feedback Affects Perceived Accuracy and Trust, but Task Subjectivity Matters
papers.abstract_en: While ML can produce complex models beyond those that a human could produce manually, incorporating human input can often improve performance beyond purely data-driven models. While this feedback could come from system designers or domain experts, in many cases, the end users who regularly use the system will naturally develop an understanding of its flaws and desire the ability to change the system's behavior based on their knowledge. While soliciting feedback from end users can result in significant model improvement over time, introducing these feedback techniques can also affect several human factors-such as trust or perception of system accuracy-that are not yet fully understood and have different effects reported in the existing literature. Therefore, we sought to build on the existing research to further explore how the act of providing feedback can affect user understanding of an intelligent system and its accuracy in different contexts. We present three controlled experiments that study the effects of interactive feedback collections on user impressions in domains with objective and subjective feedback. The results show that in a context where there is an objectively correct answer, providing HITL feedback lowered both participants' trust in the system and their perception of system accuracy, regardless of whether the system accuracy improved in response to their feedback. However, when the feedback being provided involved subjective opinion, no such negative bias was observed. Furthermore, in the objective context, participants distrusted the system over time, whereas participants in the subjective context mistrusted the system over time. These results highlight the importance of considering the effects of allowing different types of end-user feedback on user trust when designing intelligent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过三个控制实验研究人机交互中用户反馈对感知准确性和信任的影响，发现在客观正确任务中，提供反馈会降低用户对系统的信任和准确性感知，即使系统实际性能有所提升；而在主观意见任务中，这一负面偏差不显著。客观情境下用户随时间推移表现出不信任（distrusted），主观情境下则表现为误信（mistrusted）。
Motivation: 现有文献对用户反馈如何影响信任和感知准确性的理解不一致，且缺乏对不同任务情境的系统比较。
Method: 设计三个控制实验，分别在客观正确（如事实类）和主观意见（如审美类）两种情境下收集用户反馈，测量用户信任和感知准确性随时间的变化。
Result: 在客观任务中，提供反馈降低了参与者对系统的信任和准确性感知，且独立于系统是否因反馈而改进；主观任务中未观察到类似负面偏差。此外，客观情境下不信任随实验进程增加，主观情境下误信逐渐出现。
Conclusion: 允许用户反馈的类型（客观 vs 主观）对用户信任有显著不同影响，设计智能系统时应当谨慎考虑反馈机制对用户心理的作用。

summary_sections.conclusion: 允许用户反馈的类型（客观 vs 主观）对用户信任有显著不同影响，设计智能系统时应当谨慎考虑反馈机制对用户心理的作用。

papers.title: Retain or Consolidate? Budget-Dependent Operator Selection for Language Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Language agents depend on memory across interactions. However, the limited context windows of large language models (LLMs) and their inference costs constrain how much memory can be used at once. Existing systems mainly follow two strategies: memory retention and memory consolidation. Retention keeps raw records and preserves exact details, but relevant evidence may not fit under a tight budget; consolidation compresses and combines records, improving coverage per token but risking the loss of query-critical details. Neither strategy is universally preferable. This raises two central questions: when should consolidation replace retention, and which operator -- Merge, Abstract, or Rewrite -- should be selected? We formalize this decision by decomposing each operator's utility into a coverage effect on evidence omitted by retention and a signed replacement effect on raw evidence that already fits. Their balance explains why the preferred action changes with relative budget pressure. We implement this mechanism with Offline Abstraction-Safety (OAS), a lightweight learner that estimates action utilities from pre-generation features with held-out harm calibration. The public LongMemEval and LoCoMo benchmarks show the same budget-dependent pattern. On LongMemEval, consolidation improves absolute accuracy by up to 48% under tight budgets, whereas retention is preferable under loose budgets; LoCoMo replicates this crossover at a smaller budget, consistent with its shorter evidence. On both datasets, cross-note abstraction and merging generally outperform local rewriting when compression is necessary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言智能体在多轮交互中受限于LLM上下文窗口和推理成本的内存管理问题。现有记忆保留策略虽保持精确细节但预算紧张时相关证据可能无法容纳；记忆压缩策略虽提高每token覆盖率但可能丢失查询关键细节。作者将每个操作符的效用分解为对保留遗漏证据的覆盖效应和对已保留原始证据的替换效应，并据此解释偏好行动随预算压力变化的原因。该方法通过离线抽象安全(OAS)轻量学习器从预生成特征和校准中估计行动效用。在LongMemEval和LoCoMo基准上验证了预算依赖模式：紧预算下压缩将绝对准确率提升高达48%，松预算下保留更优。
Motivation: 现有语言智能体记忆策略中，记忆保留和记忆压缩各有优劣，但没有通用最优策略。核心问题是何时应用压缩以及选择哪种操作符（合并、抽象或重写）。
Method: 形式化每个操作符的效用分解为覆盖效应和替换效应，解释预算压力下的偏好变化。实现为离线抽象安全(OAS)轻量学习器，从预生成特征中估计行动效用并校准。
Result: 在LongMemEval上，紧预算下压缩提升绝对准确率高达48%；LoCoMo在更小预算下复制了交叉模式，支持短证据场景。跨笔记抽象和合并通常优于局部重写。
Conclusion: 预算依赖性表明没有一种普适策略，需根据预算压力动态选择操作符。OAS方法能有效估计效用。

papers.title: The Curvature Shadow: An Apparent Failure of Maximum-Entropy Equilibrium Selection is a Removable Artifact
papers.abstract_en: In two-player zero-sum games whose Nash equilibria form a convex set, regularized solvers such as Regularized Nash Dynamics (R-NaD) empirically select the maximum-entropy member: the information projection (I-projection) of a uniform reference onto the Nash set. On a panel of small games this match is exact, with one apparent exception: in Kuhn poker R-NaD lands at bluff coordinate 0.180 while the maximum-entropy member sits at 0.201, a coordinate gap of about 0.021, even though R-NaD attains 99.7 percent of the maximum entropy. We ask whether this gap is a genuine selection bias or an artifact, and answer it quantitatively. We show that for selection on a one-dimensional Nash manifold the coordinate gap factorizes as $\mathrm{gap} \approx \sqrt{2δ/κ}$, where $δ$ is the entropy shortfall of the solver and $κ$ is the curvature of the entropy landscape at its peak. Across five games this relation holds to within $2 \times 10^{-4}$ (under 1 percent relative error). The four matrix games have $δ\approx 0$ (R-NaD reaches the maximum-entropy member exactly) and therefore no gap regardless of curvature; only the sequential game (Kuhn) has $δ> 0$. A causal sweep of the magnet strength drives $δ\to 0$ and the gap toward zero along the predicted curve (fitted scaling exponent 0.50, $R^2 > 0.999999$, against the exact prediction of 1/2), until the dynamics destabilize at a stability floor: behavior consistent with a removable shortfall and inconsistent with a fixed bias. We quantify the curvature half of the law from measured curvatures and flag a moving-target pitfall in the natural Tsallis-entropy experiment. The Kuhn gap is thus the curvature shadow of a small, removable entropy shortfall on an unusually flat peak; the I-projection account is upheld up to a flatness-limited residual.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Diagnostic companion to arXiv:2606.28308. Fully reproducible: a single self-contained notebook regenerates every number, table, and figure
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究两人零和博弈中正则化求解器（如R-NaD）的最大熵均衡选择，发现Kuhn扑克中存在约0.021的坐标差距，但通过推导差距与熵短缺和曲率的关系，证明该差距是可移除的伪影，而非选择偏差。
Motivation: 在Kuhn扑克中R-NaD与最大熵成员之间存在微小差距，需判断是选择偏差还是可移除伪影。
Method: 推导一维Nash流形上坐标差距的因子化公式gap ≈ √(2δ/κ)，并在多个博弈中验证；通过磁强度扫描驱动δ→0来消除差距。
Result: 差距公式在五个博弈中误差小于2×10^{-4}；磁强度扫描中拟合指数0.50，R^2>0.999999，验证了预测。
Conclusion: 差距是曲率伪影，源于平坦峰值上的微小可移除熵短缺；最大熵投影成立，仅受平坦度限制。

papers.title: Program Synthesis for Simulation-Based Inference: Joint Model Selection and Parameter Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Neural simulation-based inference enables parameter estimation for complex models, but typically requires the user to specify a simulator encoding a fixed model structure. We present a framework for joint model selection and parameter estimation that combines large language models for program synthesis with neural simulation-based inference. Given a natural language description of the system and data under investigation, an LLM proposes candidate simulator programs which are iteratively refined via feedback-driven mutation and evaluated using neural density estimation. The approach enables simulation-based inference over a pool of models, not just parameters within a fixed model. On benchmarks spanning deterministic dynamics, stochastic epidemic models, and dark matter substructure inference from gravitational-lensing images, the method identifies plausible model families from open-ended prompts, with accuracy that reflects the information content of the data and identifiability of candidate models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个框架，结合大语言模型进行程序合成与神经模拟推理，实现联合模型选择和参数估计。给定系统自然语言描述和数据，LLM生成候选模拟程序，通过反馈驱动变异迭代优化，并使用神经密度估计评估。在确定性动力学、随机流行病模型和引力透镜暗物质子结构推断等基准上，该方法能从开放式提示中识别合理的模型族，准确度反映数据信息内容和候选模型的可辨识性。
Motivation: 传统神经模拟推理需要用户指定固定模型结构的模拟器，限制了模型选择。本文旨在通过程序合成自动提议和评估多个候选模型。
Method: 结合大语言模型生成候选模拟程序，通过反馈驱动变异迭代优化，使用神经密度估计评估似然。
Result: 在多个基准上验证，能从开放式提示中识别合理模型族，准确度反映数据信息内容和模型可辨识性。
Conclusion: 该方法实现了在模型池上进行模拟推理，而非仅限于固定模型内的参数估计。

papers.title: CommitLLM: A Fine-Tuned Pipeline for Git Commit Message Generation
papers.abstract_en: Developers frequently write uninformative git commit messages such as "fix" or "update stuff", degrading the value of version-control history for code review, debugging, and onboarding. We present CommitLLM, a three-stage pipeline that generates concise, Conventional Commits-compliant messages from code diffs using a fine-tuned small language model. The system combines (1) QLoRA fine-tuning of Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 on the CommitPackFT dataset, (2) constrained decoding to enforce brevity, and (3) deterministic post-processing to strip conversational artifacts and enforce format. On a 50-sample evaluation, CommitLLM achieves 98% format compliance (vs. 22% for vanilla Mistral), reduces average output length from 154.8 to 37.9 characters, and improves LLM-as-a-Judge scores from 1.97 to 3.68 out of 5. Notably, the post-processing layers contribute more to quality improvement than the fine-tuning itself, suggesting that for structured-output tasks, treating the LLM as a component in a deterministic pipeline is more effective than optimizing the model alone. The entire system runs on a single consumer GPU (NVIDIA T4, 16 GB VRAM).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CommitLLM，一个三阶段流水线，用于从代码差异（diff）生成符合Conventional Commits规范的简洁提交消息。系统结合了Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2的QLoRA微调、约束解码和确定性后处理。在50样本评估中，格式合规率达到98%，平均输出长度从154.8字符降至37.9字符，LLM-as-a-Judge评分从1.97提升至3.68（满分5）。后处理层对质量提升的贡献超过微调本身，表明在结构化输出任务中，将LLM作为确定性流水线的一环比单独优化模型更有效。整个系统可在单张消费者GPU（NVIDIA T4, 16GB VRAM）上运行。
Motivation: 开发者经常编写信息量不足的git提交消息（如"fix"或"update stuff"），降低了版本控制历史在代码审查、调试和入职培训中的价值。

Result: 在50样本评估中，格式合规率从22%（原生Mistral）提升至98%，平均输出长度从154.8字符降至37.9字符，LLM-as-a-Judge评分从1.97提升至3.68。后处理层对质量提升的贡献大于微调本身。

papers.title: Oracle Gap and Signal Fidelity: A Fixed-Pool Diagnostic for Test-Time Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Test-time collaboration, including self-consistency, best-of-N selection, critic models, and verifier pipelines, is often credited with broadly improving LLM reasoning, yet its gains are uneven and sometimes negative. We ask when training-free collaboration should be expected to help. For a fixed candidate pool, we decompose a selector or verifier's net gain into measurable factors: recoverable mass, verification-signal coverage, conditional selection quality, and harm to already-correct outputs. This reframes collaboration as a candidate-selection problem rather than as an intrinsic property of a multi-agent topology. Across LiveCodeBench, MATH Level-5 hard subjects, and GPQA-Diamond, gains are bounded first by the oracle gap and then by signal fidelity, which we measure directly as candidate-level agreement between verifier verdicts and official labels. On LiveCodeBench, a public-test verifier (MCC 0.825) gains +8.14 percentage points (pp) over a first-sample baseline; a generated-test verifier (MCC 0.248) improves by +2.70pp and is not statistically distinguishable from an LLM selector, but operates at near-zero harm versus the selector's 4.69% harm rate. On MATH, a symbolic answer-equivalence selector beats self-consistency by +4.67pp, while LLM selectors are negative. On GPQA-Diamond, recoverable mass is only 3.03% and 87.54% of candidate pools are answer-identical; a weaker model's pools shrink both further, suggesting that oracle gap is a joint property of task, model, and sampling configuration. Our framework yields a practical pre-deployment diagnostic: estimate the oracle gap, then measure coverage, signal fidelity, and harm before investing in collaboration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM推理时测试时协作（包括自一致性、best-of-N选择、评论者模型和验证器管道）的有效性，提出一个固定候选池的诊断框架，将协作收益分解为可恢复质量、验证信号覆盖、条件选择质量和对已正确输出的伤害。实验表明，在LiveCodeBench、MATH Level-5和GPQA-Diamond上，收益首先受限于oracle gap，其次受限于信号保真度。
Motivation: 测试时协作在LLM推理中普遍使用，但收益不均衡，有时甚至为负。作者希望确定何时这种无需训练的协作应该有效，并提供一个预部署诊断方法。
Method: 提出一个固定候选池的诊断框架，将选择器或验证器的净增益分解为可恢复质量、验证信号覆盖、条件选择质量和对已正确输出的伤害。通过直接测量验证器判决与官方标签之间的候选级一致性来量化信号保真度。
Result: 在LiveCodeBench上，公共测试验证器（MCC 0.825）比第一样本基线提升+8.14个百分点；生成测试验证器（MCC 0.248）提升+2.70个百分点，且与LLM选择器统计上无显著差异，但伤害率接近零（对比选择器的4.69%）。在MATH上，符号答案等价选择器超过自一致性+4.67个百分点，而LLM选择器为负。GPQA-Diamond的可恢复质量仅3.03%，且87.54%的候选池答案相同。
Conclusion: oracle gap是任务、模型和采样配置的联合属性。该框架提供了实用的预部署诊断：先估计oracle gap，再测量覆盖、信号保真度和伤害，再决定是否进行协作。

summary_sections.result: 在LiveCodeBench上，公共测试验证器（MCC 0.825）比第一样本基线提升+8.14个百分点；生成测试验证器（MCC 0.248）提升+2.70个百分点，且与LLM选择器统计上无显著差异，但伤害率接近零（对比选择器的4.69%）。在MATH上，符号答案等价选择器超过自一致性+4.67个百分点，而LLM选择器为负。GPQA-Diamond的可恢复质量仅3.03%，且87.54%的候选池答案相同。
summary_sections.conclusion: oracle gap是任务、模型和采样配置的联合属性。该框架提供了实用的预部署诊断：先估计oracle gap，再测量覆盖、信号保真度和伤害，再决定是否进行协作。

papers.title: Can AI Agents Really Complete RTL-to-GDS? Lessons from Benchmarking Tool-Interactive EDA Workflows
papers.abstract_en: LLM-driven agent systems have emerged as a promising paradigm for electronic design automation (EDA), demonstrating strong potential for automating complex design workflows. However, existing evaluations primarily examine individual language models on isolated EDA tasks, providing limited insight into how different agent systems perform across complete EDA flows. In this work, we present FluxBench, a systematic evaluation of AI agents on end-to-end EDA workflows under unified prompts, tool environments, and technology library settings. Our evaluation covers representative scenarios, including RTL generation with open-source toolchains and an RTL-to-GDS flow using closed-source commercial EDA tools for industrial applications. Through these workflows, we assess agents' capabilities in RTL code generation, iterative repair, tool-feedback utilization, logic synthesis, placement and routing (P&R), and Engineering Change Order (ECO) automation. To further characterize the efficiency of agent systems, we introduce Token ROI, a cost-efficiency metric that measures effective improvements in EDA artifacts relative to token usage and runtime cost. Experimental results show that, even when built on the same foundation model, different agent system architectures can exhibit performance gaps of up to 86.27%. Moreover, among systems with comparable task performance, Token ROI can differ by as much as $105.92\times$. In the RTL-to-GDS flow using PicoRV32 as a case study, FluxEDA achieves an end-to-end score of up to 97.94, outperforming Claude Code equipped with domain-specific EDA skills by up to $8.39\times$. These results indicate that domain-specific skills alone are insufficient to improve agent performance in large-scale EDA scenarios. Instead, both agent system design and foundation model capability play critical roles in enabling effective automated EDA workflows.

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一的基准测试框架 FluxBench，用于评估 AI 智能体在完整 EDA 工作流中的表现，涵盖 RTL 生成、迭代修复、工具反馈利用、逻辑综合、布局布线以及工程变更单自动化。实验发现，即使基于相同的基础模型，不同智能体架构的性能差异可达 86.27%，而 Token ROI 指标显示出高达 105.92 倍的差异。以 PicoRV32 为例的 RTL-to-GDS 流程中，FluxEDA 取得了 97.94 的端到端分数，优于配备领域技能的 Claude Code 多达 8.39 倍。
Motivation: 现有评估主要关注单个语言模型在孤立 EDA 任务上的表现，缺乏对完整 EDA 流程中不同智能体系统的统一比较。
Method: 设计了 FluxBench 基准，包含统一的提示词、工具环境和技术库设置，覆盖开源工具链的 RTL 生成和商业工具的 RTL-to-GDS 流程，并提出 Token ROI 成本效益指标。
Result: 不同智能体架构在相同基础模型上性能差距达 86.27%；Token ROI 差异达 105.92 倍；FluxEDA 在 RTL-to-GDS 流程中得分 97.94，优于 Claude Code 8.39 倍。
Conclusion: 领域特定技能不足以在大规模 EDA 场景中提升智能体性能，智能体系统设计和基础模型能力共同发挥关键作用。

papers.title: FlowSonic: Stable Zero-Shot Music Editing via High-Order Trajectory Integration
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot text-guided editing of real-world music recordings requires balancing semantic modification with faithful preservation of the original musical structure. Although recent diffusion transformers trained with rectified flow have achieved remarkable success in text-to-music generation, extending them to edit existing recordings remains challenging because editing requires accurate deterministic inversion, reliable structural preservation, and numerically stable integration throughout the inversion and generation processes. We present FlowSonic, a zero-shot music editing framework built upon a pretrained diffusion transformer trained with rectified flow. FlowSonic first deterministically inverts a real-world recording into the latent space and preserves its musical structure during editing by reusing cross-attention representations extracted during inversion. To improve the numerical reliability of inversion-based editing, we introduce a high-order ODE solver and systematically investigate how different numerical integration schemes influence trajectory stability, structural preservation, and semantic controllability. Comprehensive experiments on timbre-transfer and genre-modification tasks demonstrate that FlowSonic consistently outperforms existing music editing methods across semantic alignment, harmonic preservation, structural consistency, and perceptual audio quality. We further provide geometric and empirical analyses showing how the proposed numerical integration strategy improves latent trajectory stability and leads to more reliable music editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FlowSonic，一个基于预训练扩散Transformer的零样本音乐编辑框架，通过高阶ODE求解器提高反转和生成过程的数值稳定性，并在音色迁移和体裁修改任务上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有零样本文本引导音乐编辑面临精确确定性反转、结构保持和数值稳定性三大挑战。
Method: 利用预训练整流流扩散Transformer，通过确定性地将录音反转至潜空间并重用反转期间提取的交叉注意力表示来保持音乐结构，同时引入高阶ODE求解器改善轨迹稳定性。
Result: 在音色迁移和体裁修改任务上，FlowSonic在语义对齐、和声保持、结构一致性和感知音频质量方面一致优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 高阶数值积分策略能提高潜轨迹稳定性，从而实现更可靠的音乐编辑。

papers.title: FailureAtlas: A Taxonomy of Failure Modes in Multi-Provider LLM Serving Infrastructure
papers.abstract_en: Multi-provider LLM gateways reverse proxies that route, load-balance, and rate-limit requests across foundation-model APIs have become critical production infrastructure. Yet the failure modes specific to this architectural layer remain undocumented, scattered across issue trackers and post-mortems with no unifying framework. We introduce \fa{}, a two-axis taxonomy that classifies failures by their \emph{origin layer} (Network/Transport, Streaming/Protocol, State/Session, Model~Behavior, Governance/Cost) and their \emph{detectability} (Loud vs.\ Silent). We populate this taxonomy with five verified catalog entries sourced from public bug reports and first-hand stress testing, each accompanied by a mechanistic root-cause analysis. Three entries include standalone reproduction scripts. Our principal finding is that the most operationally severe failures are \emph{silent}: they return HTTP~200, pass every standard health check, and corrupt application state in ways that require semantic-level observability to detect. Two such silent failures a concurrency race condition causing history loss and a streaming index collision corrupting tool-call payloads were discovered first-hand during \cb{} evaluation campaigns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FailureAtlas，一个用于多提供商大语言模型服务基础设施的故障模式分类体系，基于两层维度：故障来源层（网络/传输、流/协议、状态/会话、模型行为、治理/成本）和可检测性（显式 vs 静默）。通过5个来自公开报告和压力测试的验证条目填充分类，发现最严重的故障是静默故障（返回HTTP 200、通过健康检查但破坏应用状态），包括并发竞态导致历史丢失和流索引冲突损坏工具调用负载。
Motivation: 多提供商LLM网关（反向代理、负载均衡、限流）已成为关键基础设施，但其特有的故障模式缺乏系统性文档，散落在问题跟踪和事后分析中，缺乏统一框架。
Method: 提出二轴分类法，按故障来源层和可检测性分类，并从公开bug报告和首次应力测试中收集5个验证条目，每个条目附带机制性根因分析，其中3个提供独立复现脚本。
Result: 主要发现：最具操作严重性的故障是静默故障——返回HTTP 200，通过标准健康检查，但以需要语义级可观测性才能检测的方式破坏应用状态，例如并发竞态导致历史丢失和流索引碰撞损坏工具调用负载。
Conclusion: 论文强调静默故障对多提供商LLM服务基础设施的威胁，并提供了分类体系和可复现的案例以推动更好的可观测性和防御机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Token-Level Off-Policy Learning for Faithful Generation Under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: We propose Token-Level Off-Policy Labeling (TOPL), an off-policy training paradigm that reframes post-training as a token-level correctness prediction task. Our key intuition is that by training the model to distinguish good and bad tokens in a response, we naturally guide the model towards generating good tokens, while avoiding the pitfalls that come with directly training the model to generate off-policy tokens. Experiments on document summarization tasks show that TOPL achieves strong out-of-distribution generalization across 11 datasets against a diverse set of sequence-level and token-level baselines. We further demonstrate that TOPL transfers effectively to machine translation, suggesting that its benefits generalize across different faithful generation tasks. Through ablation studies, we confirm that our token-level learning signal is critical to good performance; sequence-level analogues do not confer similar benefits. Finally, we show that TOPL induces interpretable model updates: the LoRA adapters learned through TOPL function as linear classification heads and steering vectors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Token-Level Off-Policy Labeling (TOPL)，一种将后训练重新定义为 token 级正确性预测任务的离线策略训练范式。通过在文档摘要和机器翻译任务上的实验，TOPL 在 11 个数据集上展现出强大的分布外泛化能力，且 token 级学习信号比序列级变体更关键。
Motivation: 现有方法在分布偏移下生成忠实文本时面临困难，直接训练模型生成离策略 token 可能导致性能下降。需要一种能够引导模型区分好与坏 token 并避免直接训练离策略 token 的方法。
Method: TOPL 将后训练重新定义为 token 级正确性预测任务，训练模型区分响应中的好 token 和坏 token，从而自然引导生成好 token，避免直接训练离策略 token 的缺陷。
Result: 在文档摘要任务上，TOPL 在 11 个数据集上实现了强分布外泛化，超越多种序列级和 token 级基线。该方法有效迁移到机器翻译，表明其益处泛化到不同忠实生成任务。消融研究确认 token 级学习信号是关键。
Conclusion: TOPL 是一种有效的离线策略训练方法，通过学习可解释的模型更新（LoRA 适配器作为线性分类头和转向向量），提升了忠实生成任务在分布偏移下的表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Thinking in Video: Can Video Generators Really Reason About the Real World?
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in world models and video generation have given rise to an emerging reasoning paradigm that leverages video generative models to simulate, predict, and reason about real-world dynamics. We redefine this paradigm as Thinking in Video, where video is not merely an output artifact but a medium for constructing, extending, and verifying causal thought. However, this promise remains unverified: convincing rollouts may reflect memorized appearances rather than causal understanding, while existing metrics separate perceptual fidelity from semantic logic. To evaluate whether video generators support such reasoning, we introduce the Causal-Generative Dual-Judge (CGDJ), auditing World Model Consistency from two perspectives. Explicit Causal Perception tests whether a generator reads a video scenario as a reasoning problem through spatio-temporal flattened visual question answering, while Implicit Generative Perception-Prediction Gap evaluates whether it renders the causal consequence as a consistent future video. Applying CGDJ to representative open- and closed-source generators reveals a clear Perception-Prediction Gap: open-source models produce plausible dynamics despite near-zero explicit causal perception, whereas advanced closed-source systems show stronger but still limited alignment between reasoning and generation. Further analysis exposes audio-visual misalignment, where models verbalize correct causal logic more reliably than they render it, challenging the "world simulator" narrative.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种称为Thinking in Video的新范式，认为视频不仅是生成结果，更是构建、扩展和验证因果思维的媒介。作者设计了因果-生成双重裁判（CGDJ）基准，从显式因果感知和隐式生成感知-预测差距两个维度审计视频生成器的世界模型一致性。实验发现开源模型虽有合理的动态生成但显式因果感知近乎为零，闭源系统虽有更好但有限的推理-生成对齐，同时存在音画错位——模型口头表述因果逻辑比视觉呈现更可靠，挑战了“世界模拟器”的叙事。
Motivation: 尽管视频生成模型被宣称具备世界模型能力，但现有评估将感知保真度与语义逻辑分开，无法判断生成是否反映因果理解而非记忆外观；需要统一框架来检测推理与生成之间的一致性。
Method: 提出Causal-Generative Dual-Judge (CGDJ)，包含两个部分：显式因果感知（通过时空展平视觉问答测试生成器是否将视频场景读取为推理问题）和隐式生成感知-预测差距（评估生成器是否将因果后果渲染为一致的未来视频）。
Result: 对开源和闭源视频生成器的评估揭示明显的感知-预测差距：开源模型产生看似合理的动态但显式因果感知接近零，高级闭源系统推理与生成对齐更强但仍有限；此外存在音画错位，模型口头逻辑正确但视觉渲染不一致。
Conclusion: 当前视频生成器尚未真正实现世界推理，其“世界模拟器”声称受到质疑；CGDJ提供了诊断推理-生成一致性的基准。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 当前视频生成器尚未真正实现世界推理，其“世界模拟器”声称受到质疑；CGDJ提供了诊断推理-生成一致性的基准。

papers.title: One-step lowest-variance selection in a Gaussian random-field model motivated by masked diffusion: Total correlation and a square root collision threshold
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by confidence-guided parallel unmasking in masked discrete diffusion, we study a single selection step in a stylized Gaussian random-field model. A locally dependent nonnegative score field represents position wise uncertainty, and the scheduler selects the K positions with the smallest scores. Dependence among the selected positions is measured through a distance-dependent Gaussian correlation model. This separation provides a tractable framework for quantifying how the geometry of low-score locations affects the dependence cost of factorized parallel decoding. We establish two complementary results. In a conservative sub-square-root regime, the conditional Gaussian total correlation of the selected block vanishes in probability. At the square-root scale, it remains non-negligible with positive asymptotic probability and admits a strictly positive expectation lower bound. Synthetic experiments support the predicted finite-size behavior. These results provide a rigorous stochastic-geometry baseline for understanding how budget size, score dependence, and spatial correlation jointly shape one-step confidence-based selection in masked discrete diffusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文受掩码离散扩散中置信度引导的并行解掩码启发，在一个高斯随机场模型中研究单步选择问题。作者通过距离相关高斯相关模型量化所选位置之间的依赖，并建立了平方根阈值下的总相关消失与不可忽略的两种互补结果。摘要认为该工作为理解掩码扩散中预算规模、分数依赖和空间相关性如何共同影响一步置信度选择提供了随机几何基线。
Motivation: 现有掩码离散扩散中的并行解掩码缺乏对所选位置依赖成本的严格量化，本文旨在通过一个简化的高斯随机场模型建立理论基线。
Method: 建立局部依赖非负得分场表示位置不确定性，调度器选择得分最小的K个位置；采用距离相关高斯相关模型刻画所选位置间的依赖，并利用高斯总相关（total correlation）作为度量。
Result: 在次平方根尺度下，条件高斯总相关概率趋近于0；在平方根尺度下，总相关以正渐近概率保持非零且期望有严格正下界；合成实验支持有限尺寸预测。
Conclusion: 本文提供了预算大小、得分依赖和空间相关性如何共同影响一步置信度选择的严格随机几何基线。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: After the Euclidean Highway: Hyperbolic Expert AI as the Next Innovation
papers.abstract_en: Expert domains are trees; the Euclidean transformer is not, diluting parent-child structure exponentially at depth. The hyperbolic turn left one question unasked: not how much of a network to curve, but where curvature may touch the gradient. Placement is a law, not a knob: the same geometry on a trainable adapter collapses training (seventeen training collapses, ~220 GPU-hours), yet at the loss layer alone it trains without one -- this is HySAT (Hyperbolic Structure-Aware Training), hyperbolic losses at the loss layer only. Across six expert SLMs we constructed and deployed (Llama 3.1 and EXAONE 3.5; four adapter strategies; 18.0M-sample corpus; zero NaN over ~317K optimizer steps), a matched four-arm ablation isolates the preserved manifold invariant, and three propositions and a lemma prove why loss-only placement is stable where adapter-on-manifold is not. Four models are operationally deployed (one live, consumer-facing), two open-weight, with per-step traces and a seventeen-incident failure ledger on Zenodo (CC-BY-4.0).
papers.comment: 40 pages, 11 figures. Supplementary Information included as an ancillary file. Data and code: Zenodo, concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21438499 (published, CC-BY-4.0)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出双曲结构感知训练（HySAT），将双曲损失仅应用于损失层，而非整个模型，从而避免训练崩溃。在六个专家小语言模型（SLM）上进行实验，包括Llama 3.1和EXAONE 3.5，使用四个适配器策略和1800万样本语料库，零NaN训练约317K步。理论证明损失层放置的稳定性，并提供了17次训练崩溃的记录。
Motivation: 双曲几何在树结构数据上有优势，但将整个网络曲率化会导致训练不稳定。现有工作未解决曲率放置位置这一关键问题。
Method: 提出HySAT，仅在损失层应用双曲损失，保持其余部分为欧几里得空间。通过四路消融实验隔离流形不变量，并用三个命题和一个引理证明损失层放置的稳定性。
Result: 在六个SLM上训练零NaN，约317K步无崩溃；四个模型投入运营（一个面向消费者），两个开放权重。
Conclusion: 双曲损失应仅放置在损失层，而非适配器或整个网络，这是稳定训练的关键。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Lightweight Wrappers for Adapting Time Series Foundation Models to Regional Drought Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Large \emph{Time Series Foundation Models} (TSFMs) demonstrate strong zero-shot forecasting capabilities across diverse domains. However, their application to regional climate forecasting faces practical challenges: model weights are often proprietary, local training records are limited, and computational budgets are constrained, making traditional fine-tuning approaches infeasible. To address these constraints, we introduce a lightweight, black-box adaptation framework (requiring no access to backbone parameters and no backbone fine-tuning) that enhances frozen TSFMs at inference time through two plug-and-play wrappers: \textbf{SMR\textsuperscript{2}} (Stationarity aware multi-resolution Residual), which decomposes the input into multi-resolution temporal views, learns stride specific residual corrections that capture regional dynamics, then adaptively ensembles them into a single forecast, and \textbf{MBB} (Moving Block Bootstrap), which preserves temporal dependencies through block resampling and ensembles over temporally coherent residual perturbations to stabilize the point forecast. Both wrappers instantiate the same bagging style principle: they build diverse views of the input or its residuals, forecast each with the same frozen backbone, and aggregate, so all adaptation comes from inference time ensembling rather than any weight update. Evaluated on one month ahead Standardized Precipitation Evapotranspiration Index (SPEI) prediction across multiple sites in South Australia, our framework consistently improves forecasting performance across several backbone models, demonstrating up to 26\% mean squared error (MSE) reduction over the corresponding frozen backbone while enabling practical deployment in resource constrained regional forecasting systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出轻量级、黑盒的适配框架，使用两个即插即用包装器（SMR²和MBB）增强冻结的时间序列基础模型（TSFM）在区域干旱预测中的性能。在南澳大利亚多站点一个月前标准化降水蒸散指数（SPEI）预测任务上，该方法在多个骨干模型上实现了最高26%的均方误差降低，无需访问模型参数或进行微调，适用于资源受限场景。
Motivation: 大型时间序列基础模型在零样本预测中表现优异，但应用于区域气候预测时面临模型权重专有、本地训练记录有限和计算预算受限的挑战，传统微调方法不可行。
Method: 提出轻量级黑盒适配框架，包含两个即插即用包装器：SMR²（平稳性感知多分辨率残差），将输入分解为多分辨率时间视图，学习步长特定的残差校正并自适应集成；MBB（移动块引导），通过块重采样保留时间依赖性，集成时间相干残差扰动以稳定预测。两者均基于袋装原则，通过推理时集成实现适应。
Result: 在南澳大利亚多站点一个月前SPEI预测任务上，该方法在多个冻结骨干模型上持续提升性能，最高实现26%的均方误差降低。
Conclusion: 该框架通过轻量级推理时集成，无需访问模型参数或微调，即可有效适配区域干旱预测，适用于资源受限的部署场景。
