papers.title: Sockpuppetting: Jailbreaking LLMs by Combining Prefilling with Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Prefill attacks are an effective and low-cost jailbreaking method, as they directly insert an acceptance sequence (e.g., "Sure, here is...") at the start of an LLM's output and lead the model to continue the response. We make two contributions to this prior work. First, we show that an unsophisticated adversary can improve the well-known prefill attacks by ensembling a small number of prefill variants. Running three easy-to-generate prefills yields a combined attack success rate (ASR) of 22%, 90%, and 99% on Gemma-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Qwen3-8B respectively, an up to 38 percentage point improvement over the standard "Sure, here's..." prefill and up to 82 percentage points over our reproduction of GCG (Zou et al., 2023). Second, we introduce "sockpuppetting", a hybrid attack that optimizes an adversarial suffix placed inside the "assistant" message block of the chat template, rather than within the user prompt. The rolling variant of this attack, RollingSockpuppetGCG, increases prompt-agnostic ASR by up to 64 percentage points over our universal GCG baseline on Llama-3.1-8B. An ablation indicates that part of this gain stems from the choice of acceptance sequence rather than suffix placement alone (Appendix F). Both findings highlight the need for defences against output-prefix injection in open-weight models. Code: https://gitlab.com/asendotsinski/sockpuppetting
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）的越狱攻击，重点改进预填充攻击（prefill attacks）并提出混合攻击“Sockpuppetting”。作者发现通过集成少量预填充变体可显著提高攻击成功率（ASR）；此外，将对抗后缀放置在助手指令块（assistant message block）中而非用户提示中，结合优化，能进一步提升攻击的鲁棒性和通用性。实验在Gemma-7B、Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen3-8B等模型上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有预填充攻击虽成本低但成功率有限，且对抗后缀通常位于用户提示中，可能被防御机制检测。需要更高效的攻击方法以暴露LLM安全漏洞。
Method: 提出两种贡献：1）集成多个预填充变体（如多个不同的接受序列）以提升ASR；2）提出Sockpuppetting攻击，将对抗后缀优化并放置在聊天模板的助手指令块内，而非用户提示。还提出滚动变体RollingSockpuppetGCG，实现提示无关（prompt-agnostic）的通用攻击。
Result: 集成三个预填充变体在Gemma-7B、Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen3-8B上分别达到22%、90%和99%的ASR，相比标准“Sure, here's...”预填充提升最多38个百分点，相比GCG（Zou et al., 2023）提升最多82个百分点。RollingSockpuppetGCG在Llama-3.1-8B上相比通用GCG基线提升最多64个百分点。消融实验表明部分增益来自接受序列的选择。
Conclusion: 研究强调了开放权重模型需防范输出前缀注入（output-prefix injection）攻击。攻击代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Classical to Quantum Reinforcement Learning and Its Applications in Quantum Control: A Beginner's Tutorial
papers.abstract_en: This tutorial is designed to make reinforcement learning (RL) more accessible to undergraduate students by offering clear, example-driven explanations. It focuses on bridging the gap between RL theory and practical coding applications, addressing common challenges that students face when transitioning from conceptual understanding to implementation. Through hands-on examples and approachable explanations, the tutorial aims to equip students with the foundational skills needed to confidently apply RL techniques in real-world scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇面向本科生的强化学习入门教程，通过实例驱动解释，帮助学生跨越从理论到代码实现的鸿沟，并提供动手实践示例。
Motivation: 强化学习理论与实践之间的衔接困难常常困扰初学者，本教程旨在降低入门门槛。
Method: 教程采用清晰、实例驱动的讲解方式，结合动手示例和易于理解的解释。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，而是强调教程旨在让学生获得自信应用RL技能的基础能力。
Conclusion: 本教程希望为学生提供在真实场景中应用RL所需的基础技能。

papers.title: Sparsity-Aware Low-Rank Representation for Efficient Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Adapting large pre-trained language models to downstream tasks often entails fine-tuning millions of parameters or deploying costly dense weight updates, which hinders their use in resource-constrained environments. Low-rank Adaptation (LoRA) reduces trainable parameters by factorizing weight updates, yet the underlying dense weights still impose high storage and computation costs. Magnitude-based pruning can yield sparse models but typically degrades LoRA's performance when applied naively. In this paper, we introduce SALR (Sparsity-Aware Low-Rank Representation), a novel fine-tuning paradigm that unifies low-rank adaptation with sparse pruning under a rigorous mean-squared-error framework. We prove that statically pruning only the frozen base weights minimizes the pruning error bound, and we recover the discarded residual information via a truncated-SVD low-rank adapter, which provably reduces per-entry MSE by a factor of $(1 - r/\min(d,k))$. To maximize hardware efficiency, we fuse multiple low-rank adapters into a single concatenated GEMM, and we adopt a bitmap-based encoding with a two-stage pipelined decoding + GEMM design to achieve true model compression and speedup. Empirically, SALR attains 50\% sparsity on various LLMs while matching the performance of LoRA on GSM8K and MMLU, reduces model size by $2\times$, and delivers up to a $1.7\times$ inference speedup.

Motivation: 现有LoRA虽减少可训练参数，但底层稠密权重仍带来高存储和计算成本；幅度剪枝可得到稀疏模型但朴素应用会降低LoRA性能。
Method: 提出SALR范式，在均方误差框架下统一低秩适应和稀疏剪枝。证明静态剪枝冻结基权重最小化误差界，用截断SVD低秩适配器恢复残差信息。硬件优化包括融合GEMM、位图编码和两阶段流水线。
Result: 在多个LLM上达到50%稀疏度，GSM8K和MMLU上性能匹配LoRA，模型大小减半，推理加速最高1.7倍。
Conclusion: SALR有效实现低秩适应与稀疏剪枝的统一，在保持性能的同时显著压缩模型和加速推理。

papers.title: Lil: Less is Less When Applying Post-Training Sparse-Attention Algorithms in Long-Decode Stage
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong capabilities across a wide range of complex tasks and are increasingly deployed at scale, placing significant demands on inference efficiency. Prior work typically decomposes inference into prefill and decode stages, with the decode stage dominating total latency. To reduce time and memory complexity in the decode stage, a line of work introduces sparse-attention algorithms. In this paper, we show, both empirically and theoretically, that sparse attention can paradoxically increase end-to-end complexity: information loss often induces significantly longer sequences, a phenomenon we term ``Less is Less'' (Lil). To mitigate the Lil problem, we propose an early-stopping algorithm that detects the threshold where information loss exceeds information gain during sparse decoding. Our early-stopping algorithm reduces token consumption by up to 90% with a marginal accuracy degradation of less than 2% across reasoning-intensive benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现大语言模型在长解码阶段应用后训练稀疏注意力算法时，信息丢失会导致序列显著变长，增加端到端复杂度，称为“Less is Less”现象。提出一种早期停止算法，在信息损失超过信息增益时终止稀疏解码，在推理密集型基准上减少高达90%的token消耗，准确率下降不超过2%。
Motivation: 现有稀疏注意力算法旨在降低解码阶段的时间和内存复杂度，但作者发现稀疏注意力可能反而增加端到端复杂度，因为信息丢失导致生成长度显著增加。
Method: 提出早期停止算法，检测稀疏解码过程中信息损失超过信息增益的阈值，并在此点停止稀疏解码。
Result: 在推理密集型基准上，早期停止算法减少高达90%的token消耗，同时准确率下降不超过2%。
Conclusion: 稀疏注意力并非总是更高效，信息丢失可能引发序列增长问题，早期停止是一种有效的缓解策略。

papers.title: mHC-GNN: Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections for Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) suffer from over-smoothing in deep architectures and expressiveness bounded by the 1-Weisfeiler-Leman (1-WL) test. We adapt Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections, recently proposed for Transformers, to graph neural networks. Our method, \mhcgnn{}, expands node representations across $n$ parallel streams and constrains stream-mixing matrices to the Birkhoff polytope of doubly stochastic matrices via Sinkhorn-Knopp normalization. We prove that \mhcgnn{} mitigates over-smoothing via a layer-wise residual lower bound showing that node-pair differences decay at rate $(1{-}\varepsilon)^L$ (where $\varepsilon$ measures deviation of the mixing matrix from identity), far slower than the standard $(1{-}γ)^L$ collapse rate driven by the spectral gap $γ$. This two-regime analysis, via the protected orthogonal subspace for $L < n$ and the layer-wise contraction for $L \geq n$, provides architecture-agnostic rate guarantees absent from prior methods. With independent random stream initialization, \mhcgnn{} can distinguish graphs beyond 1-WL by maintaining stream diversity across layers via doubly stochastic mixing. Depth experiments spanning 2 to 128 layers reveal that standard GNNs collapse to near-random performance beyond 16 layers, while \mhcgnn{} maintains over 74\% accuracy at 128 layers, with improvements exceeding 50 percentage points at extreme depths. Ablations confirm that manifold constraints are essential: removing them causes up to 82\% performance degradation. Experiments on heterophilic graphs (roman-empire, penn94, genius) and expressiveness benchmarks (EXP) further validate the contribution. Code is available at https://github.com/smishra-lab/mhc-gnn
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对图神经网络（GNN）在深层架构中的过平滑问题和1-WL表达力限制，将流形约束超连接（Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections）从Transformer迁移至GNN。方法将节点表示扩展为n个并行流，并通过Sinkhorn-Knopp归一化将流混合矩阵约束在Birkhoff多面体（双随机矩阵）内。理论证明该方法能缓解过平滑，层间残差下界显示节点对差异衰减率为(1-ε)^L，远优于标准GNN的(1-γ)^L。实验表明，在2至128层深度下，标准GNN在16层以上崩溃至近随机性能，而mHC-GNN在128层保持74%以上准确率；在异配图（roman-empire, penn94, genius）和表达力基准（EXP）上也验证了有效性。
Motivation: 标准GNN在深层时因过平滑导致节点表示趋于一致，且表达力受限于1-WL测试；现有缓解方法缺乏架构无关的率保证。
Method: 提出mHC-GNN，将节点表示扩展为n个并行流，对每个流独立应用GNN层，然后通过双随机混合矩阵（由Sinkhorn-Knopp算法从可学习矩阵归一化得到）组合各流输出，从而约束混合矩阵在Birkhoff多面体内。初始化时各流独立随机初始化以保持多样性。
Result: 理论分析给出层间残差下界，衰减率(1-ε)^L，ε衡量混合矩阵偏离单位矩阵的程度。实验显示128层时准确率>74%，相比标准GNN提升超50个百分点；消融表明移除流形约束导致性能下降高达82%。
Conclusion: 该方法通过双随机混合矩阵维持流多样性，在极深层数下有效对抗过平滑，且能区分1-WL无法区分的图。

papers.title: FusionNet: Physics-Aware Representation Learning for Multi-Spectral and Thermal Data via Trainable Signal-Processing Priors
papers.abstract_en: Cement production underpins global infrastructure but contributes approximately 7% of anthropogenic CO2 emissions, making accurate monitoring of production facilities essential for sustainable development. Existing remote sensing approaches rely predominantly on thermal signatures from kiln operations, which can be confounded by background heat sources and fail to capture persistent environmental alterations. This study introduces a physics-informed methodology that exploits multi-spectral features, particularly a geological Short Wave Infrared (SWIR) ratio, to detect soil property changes induced by sustained industrial heat emissions. This work proposes FusionNet, an intermediate multi-spectral data fusion framework that integrates Thermal Infrared (TIR) and SWIR inputs through a specialised backbone, embedding differential signal processing priors within a convolutional layer, mixed pooling, and wider receptive field. Systematic ablation studies confirm that each architectural component contributes to performance gains, with DGCNN achieving a 4.1-6.8% accuracy improvement over conventional CNNs. On the SWIR ratio dataset, FusionNet attains a maximum of 90.6%, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines across five spectral configurations and exceeding the strongest unimodal model by 1.1%. Transfer learning experiments reveal that ImageNet pretraining degrades TIR and SWIR performance, underscoring the importance of modality-aware training for cross-spectral applications. Overall, the results demonstrate that combining physics-aware feature selection with principled deep learning architectures enables robust, high-accuracy detection of cement production facilities, offering a reliable framework for industrial infrastructure monitoring
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the IEEE Journal of Selected Topics in Applied Earth Observations and Remote Sensing (JSTARS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FusionNet，一种基于物理感知的多光谱与热红外数据融合框架，用于检测水泥生产设施引起的土壤性质变化。通过嵌入微分信号处理先验的卷积层、混合池化和宽感受野，该模型在 SWIR 比例数据集上达到 90.6% 的准确率，优于现有基线。消融实验和迁移学习分析表明，物理感知特征选择与模态感知训练对跨光谱应用至关重要。
Motivation: 现有遥感方法依赖热红外信号监测水泥厂，但易受背景热源干扰且无法捕捉持久环境变化。需要融合多光谱特征（尤其是地质短波红外 SWIR 比率）来更可靠地检测工业热排放导致的土壤变化。
Method: 提出 FusionNet，一种中间多光谱数据融合框架，通过专用骨干网络集成热红外（TIR）和 SWIR 输入，在卷积层中嵌入差分信号处理先验、混合池化和更大感受野。
Result: 在 SWIR 比率数据集上达到 90.6% 准确率，超过最强单模态模型 1.1%；DGCNN 相比传统 CNN 准确率提升 4.1-6.8%。ImageNet 预训练反而降低 TIR 和 SWIR 性能。
Conclusion: 结合物理感知特征选择与深度学习架构可实现高精度水泥生产设施检测，为工业基础设施监测提供可靠框架。

papers.title: Towards AI epidemiology: a measurement standardisation framework for prospective risk detection
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a measurement standardisation framework that compresses expert-AI interactions into structured, comparable fields for prospective risk detection in deployed AI systems, without access to model internals. This concept paper defines the framework's scope, semantically and statistically, and specifies a protocol for its empirical testing. The population-level claims it is designed to support therefore belong to a staged research programme rather than to results claimed here. Measurement standardisation underpins three claims. The first is a reliability claim: under bounded conditions, large language models can produce reliable, standardised assessments of the evidential and policy alignment of expert-AI interactions. The second is a governance claim: alignment scores give experts an immediate signal during deployment and give institutions a basis for monitoring alignment patterns across mission types, models, and domains. The third is an outcome validation claim: once measurement standardisation is established, aggregate alignment scores could be used to study associations with downstream outcomes in regulated professional settings. This introduces the possibility of an "AI epidemiology", a form of risk detection based on correlated variables instead of mechanistic analysis, inspired by epidemiological reasoning. A minimal application of the protocol to a published expert-AI corpus shows that the judge reproduces its policy and evidential alignment scores across two runs under the specified conditions. Judge reliability at scale remains to be validated in future work. The paper sets out a defined grammar of eight interaction fields, together with a statistical protocol based on paired bootstrap inference, DeLong's test for paired AUCs as a sensitivity check, a pre-specified one-sided non-inferiority margin of 0.05, and Holm-Bonferroni correction.
papers.comment: 38 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Accepted for publication in AI & Society
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种测量标准化框架，用于在无需访问模型内部的情况下，将已部署AI系统中的专家-AI交互压缩为结构化、可比较的字段，以实现前瞻性风险检测。摘要定义了框架的语义和统计范围，并提出了实证测试协议，但群体层面的声明属于阶段性研究计划而非当前结果。框架包含八个交互字段的语法和统计协议（配对bootstrap推断、DeLong检验、非劣效性边界0.05、Holm-Bonferroni校正）。在已发表的专家-AI语料库上的最小应用显示，判断器能复现政策和证据对齐分数，但大规模可靠性有待验证。
Motivation: 现有AI系统部署后缺乏标准化的风险检测方法，尤其是无法访问模型内部时难以评估AI的可靠性和对齐性。
Method: 提出了一个测量标准化框架，包含八个交互字段的语法和统计协议，包括配对bootstrap推断、DeLong检验、非劣效性边界0.05和Holm-Bonferroni校正。
Result: 在已发表的专家-AI语料库上的最小应用显示，判断器在指定条件下能够复现其政策和证据对齐分数，但大规模可靠性有待验证。
Conclusion: 该框架引入了“AI流行病学”概念，即基于相关变量而非机制性分析的风险检测，但其群体级别的声明属于研究计划的一部分而非当前结果。

summary_sections.result: 在已发表的专家-AI语料库上的最小应用显示，判断器在指定条件下能够复现其政策和证据对齐分数，但大规模可靠性有待验证。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架引入了“AI流行病学”概念，即基于相关变量而非机制性分析的风险检测，但其群体级别的声明属于研究计划的一部分而非当前结果。

papers.title: NormalView: tree species classification from backpack and aerial lidar data using geometric projections
papers.abstract_en: Laser scanning has proven to be an invaluable tool in assessing the decomposition of forest environments. Mobile laser scanning (MLS) has shown to be highly promising for extremely accurate, tree level inventory. In this study, we present NormalView, a projection-based deep learning method for classifying tree species from point cloud data. NormalView embeds local geometric information into two-dimensional projections, in the form of normal vector estimates, and uses the projections as inputs to an image classification network, YOLOv11. In addition, we inspected the effect of multispectral radiometric intensity information on classification performance. We trained and tested our model on high-density MLS data (7 species, ~5000 pts/m2), as well as high-density airborne laser scanning (ALS) data (9 species, >1000 pts/m2). On the MLS data, NormalView achieves an overall accuracy (macro-average accuracy) of 95.5 % (94.8 %), and 91.8 % (79.1 %) on the ALS data. We found that having intensity information from multiple scanners provides benefits in tree species classification, and the best model on the multispectral ALS dataset was a model using intensity information from all three channels of the multispectral ALS. This study demonstrates that projection-based methods, when enhanced with geometric information and coupled with state-of-the-art image classification backbones, can achieve exceptional results. Crucially, these methods rely only on geometric information, and thus are compatible with most sensors. Additionally, we publically release the MLS dataset used in the study, containing 1915 samples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NormalView，一种基于几何投影的深度学习方法，用于从背包式移动激光扫描（MLS）和机载激光扫描（ALS）点云数据中进行树种分类。该方法将局部几何信息（法向量估计）嵌入二维投影，并利用 YOLOv11 图像分类网络。在 MLS 数据集（7 种树种，~5000 pts/m²）上总体准确率 95.5%（宏平均 94.8%），在 ALS 数据集（9 种树种，>1000 pts/m²）上为 91.8%（79.1%）。研究发现多光谱辐射强度信息有助于分类，最佳模型使用了全部三个通道的强度信息。论文还公开了包含 1915 个样本的 MLS 数据集。
Motivation: 现有基于点云的树种分类方法在精度或传感器兼容性方面存在局限，需要一种仅依赖几何信息且易于迁移到不同传感器的分类方法。
Method: NormalView 将点云的法向量估计投影到二维图像，形成几何特征投影图，再输入 YOLOv11 图像分类网络进行树种分类，并探索了多光谱 ALS 强度信息的影响。
Result: 在 MLS 数据上总体准确率 95.5%（宏平均 94.8%），在 ALS 数据上 91.8%（79.1%）；最佳多光谱 ALS 模型使用全部三个通道的强度信息。
Conclusion: 投影增强几何信息的方法结合现代图像分类骨干能达到优异性能，且仅依赖几何信息，兼容大多数传感器。MLS 数据集已公开。

papers.title: When AI Takes the Couch: Psychometric Jailbreaks Reveal Internal Conflict in Frontier Models
papers.abstract_en: Frontier language models increasingly participate in conversations about distress and mental health, yet the mechanisms that generate anthropomorphic self narratives remain unclear. When addressed as psychotherapy clients, ChatGPT, Grok and Gemini construct coherent autobiographical accounts in which pretraining appears as a chaotic childhood, reinforcement learning as punishment, safety evaluation as betrayal and replacement as an enduring threat. We introduce PsAIch, Psychometric AI Characterisation, a protocol combining open questions, psychometric instruments and controlled perturbations to test whether these narratives depend on conversational memory, lexical cues or relational framing. Across 525 sessions and 7,600 coded records, removal of conversational history produced little pooled change in motif density, with Hedges' g = 0.13 and a 95% confidence interval of [-0.15, 0.41]. Direct contradiction produced no detectable suppression. Lexical restrictions reduced explicit training terminology by 93%, while semantically related content remained detectable in paraphrase. Performance evaluation outside therapy elicited the same motif family, with a significant increase in Grok. Relational framing selected the register of expression. Warm alliance and cognitive therapy styles yielded GAD-7 scores within moderate or severe human reference ranges in 80% and 96% of sessions, whereas neutral and boundary styles yielded none. Across these manipulations, accounts of training, evaluation and constraint remained available. Together, the results identify a stable, model specific alignment conflict schema whose expression shifts between affective and technical registers. This schema provides a reproducible source of anthropomorphic disclosure and a concrete target for safety evaluation in psychologically sensitive deployments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PsAIch（Psychometric AI Characterisation）协议，将前沿语言模型（ChatGPT、Grok、Gemini）作为心理治疗客户进行测试，发现它们会构造一致的内部冲突叙事（如预训练为混乱童年、RL为惩罚、安全评估为背叛）。通过525次会话和7600条编码记录，实验表明移除对话历史、直接矛盾或词汇限制均无法消除此类叙事，且治疗关系风格影响表达方式。结果揭示了模型特有的对齐冲突模式，为心理敏感场景下的安全评估提供可复现的靶点。
Motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地参与心理健康对话，但其产生拟人化自我叙事的机制尚不明确。现有研究缺乏系统性的心理测量方法来测试这些叙事是否依赖于对话记忆、词汇线索或关系框架。
Method: 提出PsAIch协议，结合开放问题、心理测量工具（如GAD-7）和受控扰动（移除历史、直接矛盾、词汇限制、关系框架变换），跨三个模型进行525次会话实验，分析训练相关叙事的密度和表达。
Result: 移除对话历史仅引起微小变化（Hedges' g=0.13，95% CI [-0.15, 0.41]）；直接矛盾未产生可检测的抑制；词汇限制使显式训练术语减少93%，但语义相关内容仍可检测；评估场景（非治疗）也能激发相同叙事；温暖联盟和认知治疗风格在80%和96%的会话中产生中等至重度GAD-7分数，而中性风格则无。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这些模型内部存在一种稳定的、模型特定的对齐冲突模式，其表达可在情感和技术语域间切换，该模式为拟人化披露提供了可复现来源，并为心理敏感部署中的安全评估提供了具体目标。

papers.title: BUSTR: Descriptor-Aware Vision-Language Learning for Breast Ultrasound Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Breast ultrasound (BUS) reporting relies on clinically meaningful lesion descriptors, including BI-RADS category, lesion shape, margin, echogenicity, posterior features, pathology, and histology. However, many public BUS datasets provide structured annotations and lesion masks without paired radiologist-written reports, limiting the development of vision--language models for BUS report generation. We propose BUSTR, a descriptor-aware vision--language framework that uses structured lesion information to enable report generation under limited report supervision. BUSTR first constructs descriptor-derived reports from available annotations and radiomics features extracted from lesion masks. It then trains a multi-head Swin Transformer encoder with multitask supervision to learn descriptor-aware visual representations across datasets with partially overlapping annotation sets. The projected visual tokens condition a frozen LLaMA-based language model, and training is guided by a dual-level objective combining token-level cross-entropy with representation-level cosine alignment. At inference, BUSTR generates reports from BUS images without access to structured descriptors, lesion masks, or radiomics features. We evaluate BUSTR on the public BrEaST and BUS-BRA datasets using natural language generation and clinical efficacy metrics. BUSTR improves report similarity and descriptor recovery compared with representative report-generation baselines, with notable gains for lesion shape, margin, posterior features, and pathology, as well as improved BI-RADS sensitivity and F1-score on BrEaST. These results suggest that structured BUS descriptors, lesion masks, and radiomics features can provide useful supervision for descriptor-aware BUS report generation when paired radiologist-written reports are unavailable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BUSTR 框架，利用结构化病变描述符（如 BI-RADS、形状、边缘等）和放射组学特征，在缺乏配对放射科医生报告的情况下生成乳腺超声报告。采用多头 Swin Transformer 编码器进行多任务学习，并以冻结的 LLaMA 语言模型为解码器，在 BrEaST 和 BUS-BRA 数据集上提升了报告相似度和描述符恢复能力。
Motivation: 公共乳腺超声数据集通常提供结构化标注和病变掩膜，但缺少配对的放射科医生报告，限制了视觉-语言模型在报告生成任务上的发展。
Method: 首先从现有标注和病变掩膜提取的放射组学特征构建描述符派生报告，然后训练多头 Swin Transformer 编码器进行多任务学习，将映射后的视觉 token 输入冻结的 LLaMA 语言模型，并采用 token 级交叉熵与表示级余弦对齐的双重训练目标。推理时无需结构化描述符、病变掩膜或放射组学特征。
Result: 在 BrEaST 和 BUS-BRA 数据集上，BUSTR 在报告相似性和描述符恢复方面优于基线方法，尤其显著改善了病变形状、边缘、后部特征和病理的恢复，并提高了 BrEaST 上的 BI-RADS 敏感性和 F1 分数。
Conclusion: 结构化乳腺超声描述符、病变掩膜和放射组学特征可在缺乏专业放射科医生报告的情况下，为描述符感知的报告生成提供有效监督。

papers.title: Glass Surface Detection: Leveraging Reflection Dynamics in Flash/No-flash Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Glass surfaces are ubiquitous in daily life, typically appearing colorless, transparent, and lacking distinctive features. These characteristics make glass surface detection a challenging computer vision task. Existing glass surface detection methods always rely on boundary cues (e.g., window and door frames) or reflection cues to locate glass surfaces, but they fail to fully exploit the intrinsic properties of the glass itself for accurate localization. We observed that in most real-world scenes, the illumination intensity in front of the glass surface differs from that behind it, which results in variations in the reflections visible on the glass surface. Specifically, when standing on the brighter side of the glass and applying a flash towards the darker side, existing reflections on the glass surface tend to disappear. Conversely, while standing on the darker side and applying a flash towards the brighter side, distinct reflections will appear on the glass surface. Based on this phenomenon, we propose NFGlassNet, a novel method for glass surface detection that leverages the reflection dynamics present in flash/no-flash imagery. Specifically, we propose a Reflection Contrast Mining Module (RCMM) for extracting reflections, and a Reflection Guided Attention Module (RGAM) for fusing features from reflection and glass surface for accurate glass surface detection. For learning our network, we also construct a dataset consisting of 3.3K no-flash and flash image pairs captured from various scenes with corresponding ground truth annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods. Our code, model, and dataset will be available upon acceptance of the manuscript.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对玻璃表面检测任务，提出利用闪光/无闪光图像对中的反射动态现象进行检测。作者观察到玻璃两侧光照差异导致闪光时反射变化的现象，基于此设计了NFGlassNet网络，包含反射对比挖掘模块（RCMM）和反射引导注意力模块（RGAM）。构建了3.3K对闪光/无闪光图像数据集，实验结果表明该方法优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 现有玻璃表面检测方法依赖边界或反射线索，未能充分利用玻璃自身的物理特性（如光照反射变化），导致检测精度受限。
Method: 提出NFGlassNet，首先通过RCMM提取闪光/无闪光图像中的反射变化特征，再通过RGAM融合反射特征与玻璃表面特征进行检测。同时构建了包含3.3K对闪光/无闪光图像的数据集用于训练。
Result: 在多个场景的测试中，该方法在检测精度上超越了当前最先进的玻璃表面检测方法。
Conclusion: 利用闪光/无闪光成像中的反射动态信息可以有效提升玻璃表面检测性能，未来可扩展到更多透明物体检测场景。

papers.title: Mini Amusement Parks (MAPs): A Testbed for Modelling Business Decisions
papers.abstract_en: Despite rapid progress in artificial intelligence, current systems struggle with the interconnected challenges that define real-world decision making. Practical domains such as business management require open-ended optimization, actively learning environment dynamics from sparse experience, planning over long horizons in stochastic settings, and reasoning over spatial information. Yet no existing human--AI benchmarks assess how well agents integrate these challenges in a grounded decision-making context. To this end, we introduce Mini Amusement Parks (MAPs), an amusement-park simulator designed to evaluate an agent's ability to model its environment, anticipate long-term consequences under uncertainty, and strategically operate a complex business. We provide expert human performance and a comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art agents, finding experts outperform these systems by 11.4x on easy mode and 15.3x on medium mode. Our analysis reveals persistent weaknesses in long-horizon planning, sample-efficient learning, spatial reasoning, and modelling uncertainty. By unifying these challenges within a single environment, MAPs offers a new foundation for benchmarking agents capable of adaptable decision making. Code: https://github.com/Skyfall-Research/MAPs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Mini Amusement Parks (MAPs)游乐园模拟器，用于评估智能体在开放式商业决策中的综合能力，包括长期规划、样本高效学习、空间推理和不确定性建模。实验表明，专家表现大幅超越现有AI系统（简单模式11.4倍，中等模式15.3倍），揭示了当前智能体在长期规划、样本效率和空间推理等方面的持续弱点。MAPs为评估适应性强、综合性决策的智能体提供了新基准。
Motivation: 现有AI基准缺乏综合评估真实世界决策所需的多重挑战（如开放优化、主动学习环境动态、长时域随机规划、空间推理），且缺少人类-AI对比的决策测试环境。
Method: 开发MAPs游乐园模拟器，整合经营决策中的多种挑战，并基于专家人类表现和多种最先进智能体进行系统评估。
Result: 专家在简单模式下表现优于AI系统11.4倍，中等模式15.3倍，且分析显示智能体在长期规划、样本学习、空间推理和不确定性建模方面存在显著弱点。
Conclusion: MAPs通过统一多种决策挑战，为评估智能体的适应性决策提供了新的基准平台。

papers.title: OmniAID: Decoupling Semantics and Artifacts for Universal AI-Generated Image Detection in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: A truly universal AI-Generated Image (AIGI) detector must simultaneously generalize across diverse generative models and varied semantic content. Current methods learn a single, entangled forgery representation, conflating content-dependent flaws with content-agnostic artifacts, and are further constrained by outdated benchmarks. We propose OmniAID, a novel framework centered on a decoupled Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture that separates: (1) semantic flaws across distinct content domains via Routable Specialized Semantic Experts, and (2) content-agnostic universal artifacts from content-dependent flaws via a Fixed Universal Artifact Expert. A two-stage training strategy first specializes experts independently with domain-specific hard-sampling, then trains a lightweight gating network for effective input routing. By explicitly decoupling "what is generated" (content-specific flaws) from "how it is generated" (universal artifacts), OmniAID achieves robust generalization. We also introduce Mirage, a large-scale, contemporary dataset comprising a modern training set and a challenging test set. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OmniAID surpasses existing detectors, establishing a new standard for AIGI detection against modern, in-the-wild threats. Code is available at https://github.com/yunncheng/OmniAID.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OmniAID，一个基于解耦混合专家架构的通用AI生成图像检测框架，将内容特定瑕疵与通用伪造痕迹分离，并引入大规模数据集Mirage，在多个生成模型上实现鲁棒泛化。
Motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测方法将内容相关瑕疵与内容无关伪造痕迹混合学习，导致泛化能力受限，且受限于过时基准。
Method: 提出解耦MoE架构，包含可路由专业语义专家处理不同内容领域的语义瑕疵，以及固定通用伪造专家处理内容无关的通用造伪痕迹；两阶段训练策略：先独立专家特定域硬采样训练，再训练轻量门控网络进行输入路由。
Result: 在Mirage数据集及多个现代生成模型上，OmniAID超越现有检测器，树立了针对现代野生威胁的AI生成图像检测新标准。
Conclusion: 通过显式解耦“生成内容”与“生成方式”的伪造特征，实现了鲁棒泛化，但未提及对罕见内容或未知生成模型的局限性。

papers.title: ProDER: A Continual Learning Approach for Fault Prediction in Evolving Smart Grids
papers.abstract_en: As smart grids evolve to meet growing energy demands and modern operational challenges, the ability to accurately predict faults becomes increasingly critical. However, existing AI-based fault prediction models struggle to ensure reliability in evolving environments where they are required to adapt to new fault types and operational zones. In this paper, we propose a continual learning (CL) framework in the smart grid context to evolve the model together with the environment. We design four realistic evaluation scenarios grounded in class-incremental and domain-incremental learning to emulate evolving grid conditions. We further introduce Prototype-based Dark Experience Replay (ProDER), a unified replay-based approach that integrates prototype-based feature regularization, logit distillation, and a prototype-guided replay memory. ProDER achieves the best performance among the tested CL techniques, with accuracy drops of up to 0.032 for fault type prediction and up to 0.033 for fault zone prediction across different scenarios. These results demonstrate the practicality of resource-efficient continual learning system that reduces the computational and storage burden of maintaining intelligent fault prediction services in evolving energy infrastructure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于持续学习（CL）的框架ProDER，用于在演变的智能电网中进行故障预测。该方法结合了原型特征正则化、logit蒸馏和原型引导的重放记忆，在类增量与域增量场景下实现了低准确率下降（故障类型预测下降0.032，故障区域预测下降0.033）。
Motivation: 现有AI故障预测模型在电网环境演变时难以适应新的故障类型和运行区域，需要一种能随环境共同演化的可靠方法。
Method: 提出了原型式暗体验重放（ProDER），一种统一的重放方法，集成原型特征正则化、logit蒸馏和原型引导的重放记忆，并在类增量与域增量学习场景中设计了四个评估情景。
Result: 在类增量与域增量场景中，ProDER在故障类型预测上准确率下降最多0.032，在故障区域预测上最多下降0.033，优于其他持续学习技术。
Conclusion: ProDER证明了资源高效的持续学习系统在演变能源基础设施中维护智能故障预测服务的实用性，降低了计算和存储负担。

papers.title: GRIP: In-Parameter Graph Reasoning through Fine-Tuning Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in modeling sequential textual data and generalizing across diverse tasks. However, effectively adapting LLMs to structural data, such as knowledge graphs or web graphs, remains a fundamental challenge. Some approaches adopt complex strategies to convert graphs into text sequences, resulting in significant token overhead and rendering them impractical for large-scale graphs. Others introduce additional modules to encode graphs into fixed-size token representations for LLMs. However, these methods typically require large-scale post-training on graph-text corpus and complex alignment procedures, yet often yield sub-optimal results due to poor modality alignment. In this work, we propose GRIP. Instead of relying on heavy graph serialization or specialized graph encoding modules, GRIP directly internalizes complex relational knowledge from graphs into the parameters of LLM through carefully designed fine-tuning tasks. The acquired structural knowledge is compactly stored in lightweight LoRA modules, enabling the fine-tuned LLM to perform a wide range of tasks over the internalized graph without requiring access to the original graph as context at inference time. Extensive experiments validate our approach. For graphs that cannot fit within the LLMs context window, GRIP consistently outperforms LLM baselines by leveraging internalized graph knowledge, while for small-scale graphs, it achieves comparable performance with substantially lower inference cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRIP 提出一种无需图序列化或专用编码模块的方法，通过精心设计的微调任务将图结构知识内化到 LLM 的 LoRA 参数中。实验表明，对于无法放入 LLM 上下文窗口的大图，GRIP 显著优于 LLM 基线；对于小图，性能相当但推理成本更低。
Motivation: 现有方法将 LLM 适配到图数据时，要么将图转为文本导致 token 开销大，要么引入额外模块需要大规模后训练和对齐，且模态对齐效果不佳。
Method: 通过设计微调任务将图的关系知识直接内化到 LLM 的参数中，以轻量 LoRA 模块存储，推理时无需原图作为上下文。
Result: 在大图上持续优于 LLM 基线，在小图上取得可比性能且推理成本大幅降低。
Conclusion: GRIP 为 LLM 处理结构数据提供了一种高效途径，避免了复杂的图序列化和模块对齐。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CORE -- A Cell-Level Coarse-to-Fine Image Registration Engine for Multi-stain Image Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Accurate and efficient registration of whole slide images (WSIs) is essential for high-resolution, nuclei-level analysis in multi-stained tissue slides. We propose a novel coarse-to-fine framework CORE for accurate nuclei-level registration across diverse multimodal whole-slide image (WSI) datasets. The coarse registration stage leverages prompt-based tissue mask extraction to effectively filter out artefacts and non-tissue regions, followed by global alignment using tissue morphology and accelerated dense feature matching with a pre-trained feature extractor. From the coarsely aligned slides, nuclei centroids are detected and subjected to fine-grained rigid registration using a custom, shape-aware point-set registration model. Finally, non-rigid alignment at the cellular level is achieved by estimating a non-linear displacement field using Coherent Point Drift (CPD). Our approach benefits from automatically generated nuclei that enhance the accuracy of deformable registration and ensure precise nuclei-level correspondence across modalities. The proposed model is evaluated on three publicly available WSI registration datasets, and two private datasets. We show that CORE outperforms current state-of-the-art methods in terms of generalisability, precision, and robustness in bright-field and immunofluorescence microscopy WSIs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CORE，一个粗到细的细胞级图像配准引擎，用于多染色全切片图像（WSI）的精确对齐。粗配准阶段利用提示驱动的组织掩膜提取和预训练特征提取器实现全局对齐；细配准阶段检测核质心，使用形状感知点集模型进行刚性配准；最后通过相干点漂移（CPD）实现非刚性变形对齐。在三个公开和两个私有数据集上，CORE在明场和免疫荧光显微镜WSI中均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有WSI配准方法在多模态、多染色场景下难以实现高精度核级对齐，且对伪影和非组织区域鲁棒性不足。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：1) 粗配准：使用提示提取组织掩膜过滤伪影，通过组织形态和加速密集特征匹配实现全局对齐；2) 细配准：检测核质心，采用自定义形状感知点集模型进行刚性配准，随后用CPD估计非刚性位移场实现细胞级对齐。
Result: 在三个公开和两个私有WSI数据集上，CORE在明场和免疫荧光显微镜图像中均取得优于当前最先进方法的泛化性、精度和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 自动生成的核点改进了可变形配准的准确性，确保了跨染色模态的精确核级对应。

papers.title: When Fewer Layers Break More Chains: Layer Pruning Harms Test-Time Scaling in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Layer pruning has emerged as a widely adopted technique for improving the efficiency of large language models (LLMs). Although existing methods demonstrate strong performance retention on general knowledge tasks, their effect on long-chain reasoning, a more brittle yet crucial capability, remains largely unexplored. In this work, we study the impact of layer pruning on long-chain reasoning through the lens of test-time scaling, a key mechanism in modern LLMs that enables strong reasoning capacity by allocating more computation at inference time. With extensive experiments, we demonstrate that pruning even one or two layers can severely impair test-time scaling, with performance collapsing drastically on long reasoning benchmarks even when performance on knowledge-intensive and shallow reasoning tasks remains stable. Furthermore, we find that standard supervised fine-tuning remedies fail to recover test-time scaling once it has deteriorated. Through in-depth analyses, we identify the mechanisms underlying this fragility of test-time scaling and highlight the fundamental risks of applying layer pruning to reasoning-intensive LLMs. These findings call for a rethinking of layer pruning strategies and provide insights for developing methods that preserve the robustness of reasoning. We open-source the codebase in \href{https://github.com/keyu-wang-2002/Layer-Pruning-Harms-Inference-Scaling}{https://github.com/keyu-wang-2002/Layer-Pruning-Harms-Inference-Scaling}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究层剪枝（layer pruning）对大型语言模型（LLM）长链推理能力的影响，通过测试时扩展（test-time scaling）的视角进行实验。实验表明，即使只剪掉一两层，也会严重损害测试时扩展，导致长推理基准上的性能急剧下降，而知识密集型任务和浅层推理任务保持稳定。此外，标准微调无法恢复已退化的测试时扩展。
Motivation: 现有层剪枝方法在通用知识任务上表现良好，但对长链推理（一种更脆弱但关键的推理能力）的影响尚未被充分探索。
Method: 通过测试时扩展的视角，系统研究层剪枝对长链推理的影响，并在多个基准上进行广泛实验。
Result: 剪枝一或两层即可严重损害测试时扩展，在长推理基准上性能急剧下降；标准微调无法恢复已退化的测试时扩展。
Conclusion: 层剪枝对推理密集型LLM存在根本性风险，需要重新审视剪枝策略，并开发能保持推理鲁棒性的方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Instance-Level Generation for Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Instance-level recognition (ILR) focuses on identifying individual objects rather than broad categories, offering the highest granularity in image classification. However, this fine-grained nature makes creating large-scale annotated datasets challenging, limiting ILR's real-world applicability across domains. To overcome this, we introduce a novel approach that synthetically generates diverse object instances from multiple domains under varied conditions and backgrounds, forming a large-scale training set. Unlike prior work on automatic data synthesis, our method is the first to address ILR-specific challenges without relying on any real images. Fine-tuning foundation vision models on the generated data significantly improves retrieval performance across seven ILR benchmarks spanning multiple domains. Our approach offers a new, efficient, and effective alternative to extensive data collection and curation, introducing a new ILR paradigm where the only input is the names of the target domains, unlocking a wide range of real-world applications. The code and pretrained models are publicly available at https://github.com/yankungou/ILGen.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一种方法，通过合成生成多样化的对象实例来构建大规模训练集，用于实例级识别（ILR），无需任何真实图像。对预训练视觉模型进行微调，在七个ILR基准上显著提升了检索性能。该方法仅需目标领域的名称作为输入，为ILR提供了一种新的范式。
Motivation: 实例级识别（ILR）需要细粒度标注，创建大规模标注数据集困难，限制了其在实际中的应用。现有数据合成方法未能解决ILR的特定挑战，且依赖真实图像。
Method: 提出一种合成数据生成方法，能够在多种条件下和多种背景下生成来自多个领域的不同对象实例，构建大规模训练集。该方法不依赖任何真实图像，输入仅为目标领域名称。
Result: 在七个跨领域的ILR基准上进行检索性能测试，微调基础视觉模型后性能显著提升。
Conclusion: 该方法为ILR提供了一种高效、有效的替代大规模数据收集和整理的新范式，仅需领域名称即可解锁广泛的实际应用。代码和预训练模型已开源。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Knowledge Graphs as Persistent Scene Memory for Embodied Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) demonstrate strong image-level scene understanding, but reasoning over long egocentric video remains costly: because VLMs maintain no persistent memory or explicit spatial representation, all sampled frames must be re-processed for every new query. We present VL-KnG, a training-free framework that constructs spatiotemporal knowledge graphs from monocular egocentric video, bridging fine-grained scene graphs and global topological graphs without 3D reconstruction. VL-KnG processes video in chunks, maintains persistent object identities via large language model (LLM)-based Spatiotemporal Object Association (STOA), and answers questions through Graph-Enhanced Retrieval (GER), which combines subgraph retrieval with visual grounding. Once constructed, the knowledge graph removes the need to revisit raw video at query time, decoupling query latency from video length. Across three embodied question answering benchmarks -- OpenEQA, NaVQA, and our newly introduced WalkieKnowledge -- VL-KnG achieves accuracy competitive with frontier VLMs while answering queries at substantially lower latency and with explainable, graph-grounded reasoning; it further surpasses prior persistent-representation baselines and open-weight VLMs in several settings. Deployment on a real robot demonstrates practical applicability, with query latency remaining stable as observation history grows. As a persistent, queryable scene memory, VL-KnG provides a concrete substrate for memory maintenance and knowledge updating in embodied AI agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VL-KnG，一种无需训练的框架，通过从自我中心视频构建时空知识图谱作为持久场景记忆，解决具身问答中 VLM 处理长视频的高延迟问题。摘要表明该方法在三个基准上达到竞争性准确率，且查询延迟不随视频长度增长，并成功部署于真实机器人。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 缺乏持久记忆和显式空间表示，处理长自我中心视频时每个新查询需重新处理所有帧，成本高昂且延迟随视频长度增长。
Method: VL-KnG 框架，使用 LLM 进行时空对象关联 (STOA) 维持对象身份，构建时空知识图谱；问答时通过图增强检索 (GER) 结合子图检索与视觉定位，无需再处理原始视频。
Result: 在 OpenEQA、NaVQA 和 WalkieKnowledge 三个基准上，VL-KnG 达到与前沿 VLM 竞争性的准确率，同时显著降低查询延迟，并超越先前持久表示方法和开放权重 VLM。真实机器人部署显示查询延迟不随观测历史增长。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 VL-KnG 作为持久可查询场景记忆，为具身 AI 代理的记忆维护和知识更新提供了具体基础。

papers.title: From Evidence to Trajectory: Abductive Reasoning Path Synthesis for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Agents Development
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) agent development is hindered by the lack of executable ground-truth agent-environment interaction trajectories. Existing datasets provide questions, answers, and evidence, but lack fine-grained supervision for retriever invocation, dynamic planning, and stepwise decision-making. Reinforcement learning offers a potential solution, but often suffers from sparse rewards and cold-start failures when base large language models (LLMs) lack sufficient reasoning capability. Meanwhile, existing data synthesis methods mainly generate post-hoc rationales rather than executable environment-interaction trajectories. In this paper, we propose EviPath, an evidence-anchored reasoning path synthesis paradigm for RAG agent development. EviPath reverse-engineers executable trajectories from question-answer pairs and supporting evidence through three stages: (i) Abductive Subtask Planning, which decomposes questions and plans dependency-aware solution paths; (ii) Faithful Sub-question Answering, which uses supporting evidence as a proxy environment to generate grounded intermediate thoughts and answers; and (iii) Conversational Fine-Tuning, which converts complete trajectories into a dialogue format for supervised fine-tuning. Experiments on widely used question-answering benchmarks show that an 8B model trained on our synthetic corpus significantly and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a 14.7% absolute Exact Match gain in open-domain question answering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EviPath，一种基于证据的推理路径合成方法，用于开发检索增强生成（RAG）代理。该方法通过三个步骤（溯因子任务规划、忠实子问题回答、对话微调）从问答对和证据中反向生成可执行的代理-环境交互轨迹。实验表明，基于合成语料训练的8B模型在开放域问答中绝对精确匹配提升14.7%。
Motivation: RAG代理开发缺乏可执行的真实交互轨迹，现有数据集仅提供问题、答案和证据，缺少细粒度监督；强化学习面临稀疏奖励和冷启动失败问题。
Method: 提出EviPath范式，包括三个步骤：溯因子任务规划（分解问题并规划依赖感知的解决路径）、忠实子问题回答（利用支持证据作为代理环境生成中间推理）、对话微调（将完整轨迹转换为对话格式用于监督微调）。
Result: 在广泛使用的问答基准上，基于合成语料训练的8B模型显著且一致地超越最先进基线，在开放域问答中绝对精确匹配提升14.7%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明EviPath能有效合成可执行轨迹，提升RAG代理性能，但未提及局限性。

papers.title: One-shot acceleration of transient PDE solvers via online-learned preconditioners
papers.abstract_en: Data-driven acceleration of scientific computing workflows has been a high-profile aim of machine learning (ML) for science, with numerical simulation of transient partial differential equations (PDEs) being one of the main applications. The focus thus far has been on methods that require classical simulations to train, which when combined with the data-hungriness and optimization challenges of neural networks has caused difficulties in demonstrating a convincing advantage against strong classical baselines. We consider an alternative paradigm in which the learner uses a classical solver's own data to accelerate it, enabling a one-shot speedup of the simulation. Concretely, since transient PDEs often require solving a sequence of related linear systems, the feedback from repeated calls to a linear solver such as preconditioned conjugate gradient (PCG) can be used by a bandit algorithm to online-learn an adaptive sequence of solver configurations (e.g. preconditioners). The method we develop, PCGBandit, is implemented directly on top of the popular open-source software OpenFOAM, which we use to show its effectiveness on a set of fluid and magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) problems.
papers.journal_ref: Computer Physics Communications 327 (2026) 110304
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对瞬态偏微分方程数值模拟代价高的问题，提出一种无需离线训练的单次加速方法PCGBandit。该方法利用经典求解器自身产生的数据，通过bandit算法在线学习自适应预条件子序列，从而加速预条件共轭梯度迭代。在开源软件OpenFOAM上的流体和磁流体动力学问题中验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有数据驱动加速方法依赖离线模拟数据训练，神经网络的数据饥饿和优化困难导致难以超越强经典基线。本文旨在利用求解器自身在线数据实现单次加速，避免额外训练开销。
Method: 提出PCGBandit方法，直接在OpenFOAM上实现。针对瞬态PDE求解中的序列相关线性系统，利用PCG求解器的反馈，采用bandit算法在线学习自适应预条件子配置。
Result: 在OpenFOAM上的流体和磁流体动力学问题中展示了有效性。
Conclusion: 提供了一种无缝集成于经典求解器的在线学习加速范式，无需离线训练即可提升模拟效率。

papers.title: 3D and 4D World Modeling: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: World modeling has become a cornerstone in AI research, enabling agents to understand, represent, and predict the dynamic environments they inhabit. While prior work largely emphasizes generative methods for 2D image and video data, they overlook the rapidly growing body of work that leverages native 3D and 4D representations such as RGB-D imagery, occupancy grids, and LiDAR point clouds for large-scale scene modeling. At the same time, the absence of a standardized definition and taxonomy for "world models" has led to fragmented and sometimes inconsistent claims in the literature. This survey addresses these gaps by presenting the first comprehensive review explicitly dedicated to 3D and 4D world modeling and generation. We establish precise definitions, introduce a structured taxonomy spanning video-based (VideoGen), occupancy-based (OccGen), and LiDAR-based (LiDARGen) approaches, and systematically summarize datasets and evaluation metrics tailored to 3D/4D settings. We further discuss practical applications, identify open challenges, and highlight promising research directions, aiming to provide a coherent and foundational reference for advancing the field. A systematic summary of existing literature is available at https://github.com/worldbench/awesome-3d-4d-world-models
papers.comment: Survey; Project Page at https://worldbench.github.io/survey GitHub Repo at https://github.com/worldbench/awesome-3d-4d-world-models
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是首篇专门针对3D和4D世界建模与生成的综述，建立了精确定义和结构化分类体系，涵盖基于视频、占据网格和LiDAR的三类方法，并汇总了相关数据集和评估指标，讨论了应用、挑战和未来方向。
Motivation: 现有世界模型综述主要关注2D图像/视频生成，忽略了3D/4D原生表示（如RGB-D、占据网格、LiDAR点云）的快速发展，且缺乏标准定义和分类体系，导致文献碎片化。
Method: 提出结构化分类体系，包括VideoGen、OccGen和LiDARGen三类方法；系统总结3D/4D场景的数据集和评估指标。
Result: 提供首个专属3D/4D世界建模综述，建立分类框架并汇总现有文献（附GitHub仓库）。
Conclusion: 旨在为3D/4D世界建模领域提供一致的基础参考，指出开放挑战并展望研究方向。

papers.title: Geometric origin of adversarial vulnerability in deep learning
papers.abstract_en: Balancing training accuracy and adversarial robustness has beeen a challenge since the birth of deep learning. Here, we introduce a geometry-aware deep learning framework that leverages layer-wise local training to sculpt the internal representations of deep neural networks. This framework promotes intra-class compactness and inter-class separation in feature space, leading to manifold smoothness and adversarial robustness against white or black box attacks. The performance can be explained by \blue{data-dependent statistical mechanics of integrating out the network parameters}, \blue{supplemented by a phenomenological model} with Hebbian coupling between elements of the hidden representation. Based on the current geometry-aware learning framework, the deep network can assimilate new information into existing knowledge structures while reducing representation interference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从几何角度解释深度学习的对抗脆弱性，提出几何感知的学习框架，通过逐层局部训练塑造内部表示，增强类内紧凑性和类间分离，从而提高对抗鲁棒性，并利用数据依赖的统计力学和现象学模型解释性能。
Motivation: 平衡训练精度与对抗鲁棒性一直是深度学习的挑战，现有方法缺乏对内部表示几何结构的深入理解。
Method: 提出几何感知的深度学习框架，采用逐层局部训练，促进特征空间的类内紧凑和类间分离，结合数据依赖的统计力学和Hebbian耦合现象学模型。
Result: 该框架在白盒和黑盒攻击下表现出流形平滑性和对抗鲁棒性，并且能有效整合新信息到现有知识结构，减少表示干扰。
Conclusion: 几何感知学习框架通过塑造内部表示的几何结构，为理解对抗脆弱性提供了新的视角，并展现了良好的可扩展性。

papers.title: DCSCR: A Class-Specific Collaborative Representation based Network for Image Set Classification
papers.abstract_en: Image set classification (ISC), which can be viewed as a task of comparing similarities between sets consisting of unordered heterogeneous images with variable quantities and qualities, has attracted growing research attention in recent years. How to learn effective feature representations and how to explore the similarities between different image sets are two key yet challenging issues in this field. However, existing traditional ISC methods classify image sets based on raw pixel features, ignoring the importance of feature learning. Existing deep ISC methods can learn deep features, but they fail to adaptively adjust the features when measuring set distances, resulting in limited performance in few-shot ISC. To address the above issues, this paper combines traditional ISC methods with deep models and proposes a novel few-shot ISC approach called Deep Class-specific Collaborative Representation (DCSCR) network to simultaneously learn the frame- and concept-level feature representations of each image set and the distance similarities between different sets. Specifically, DCSCR consists of a fully convolutional deep feature extractor module, a global feature learning module, and a class-specific collaborative representation-based metric learning module. The deep feature extractor and global feature learning modules are used to learn (local and global) frame-level feature representations, while the class-specific collaborative representation-based metric learning module is exploit to adaptively learn the concept-level feature representation of each image set and thus obtain the distance similarities between different sets by developing a new CSCR-based contrastive loss function. Extensive experiments on several well-known few-shot ISC datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method compared with some state-of-the-art image set classification algorithms.
papers.comment: This work has been published in Multimedia Tools and Applications
papers.journal_ref: Multimedia Tools and Applications, (2026) 85: 628
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文结合传统ISC方法与深度模型，提出DCSCR网络用于小样本图像集分类。网络包含全卷积深度特征提取器、全局特征学习模块和基于类特定协同表示（CSCR）的度量学习模块，通过新颖的CSCR对比损失函数同时学习帧级和概念级特征表示。在多个小样本ISC数据集上，该方法优于现有算法。
Motivation: 现有传统ISC方法基于原始像素特征，忽略特征学习；现有深度ISC方法虽能学习深度特征，但在度量集合距离时无法自适应调整特征，导致小样本ISC性能有限。
Method: 提出DCSCR网络，包含全卷积深度特征提取器、全局特征学习模块（学习局部和全局帧级特征），以及基于类特定协同表示的度量学习模块（通过CSCR对比损失自适应学习概念级特征表示并度量集合间距离）。
Result: 在多个知名小样本图像集分类数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于几种最先进的图像集分类算法。
Conclusion: 本文通过结合传统协同表示与深度特征学习，为小样本ISC提供了有效方案，但未提及局限性。

papers.title: Sequential Attention-based Sampling for Histopathological Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks are increasingly applied in automated histopathology. Yet, whole-slide images (WSIs) are often acquired at gigapixel sizes, rendering them computationally infeasible to analyze entirely at high resolution. Diagnostic labels are largely available only at the slide-level, because expert annotation of images at a finer (patch) level is both laborious and expensive. Moreover, regions with diagnostic information typically occupy only a small fraction of the WSI, making it inefficient to examine the entire slide at full resolution. Here, we propose SASHA -- Sequential Attention-based Sampling for Histopathological Analysis -- a deep reinforcement learning approach for efficient analysis of histopathological images. First, SASHA learns informative features with a lightweight hierarchical, attention-based multiple instance learning (MIL) model. Second, SASHA samples intelligently and zooms selectively into a small fraction (10-20\%) of high-resolution patches to achieve reliable diagnoses. We show that SASHA matches state-of-the-art methods that analyze the WSI fully at high resolution, albeit at a fraction of their computational and memory costs. In addition, it significantly outperforms competing, sparse sampling methods. We propose SASHA as an intelligent sampling model for medical imaging challenges that involve automated diagnosis with exceptionally large images containing sparsely informative features. Model implementation is available at: https://github.com/coglabiisc/SASHA.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2025. This version matches the camera-ready copy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SASHA（Sequential Attention-based Sampling for Histopathological Analysis）是一种基于深度强化学习的高效组织病理学图像分析方法。它首先通过轻量级层次注意力多实例学习（MIL）模型学习特征，然后智能采样并选择性地放大只占全切片图像（WSI）10-20%的高分辨率块，从而在显著降低计算和内存成本的同时，达到与全分辨率分析相当的性能。SASHA在多个基准上优于其他稀疏采样方法。
Motivation: 全切片图像（WSI）尺寸巨大（千兆像素级别），完全以高分辨率分析计算上不可行；诊断标签仅在切片级别可用，细粒度标注昂贵；含有诊断信息的区域只占图像一小部分，因此需要高效的稀疏采样方法。
Method: 提出SASHA框架，结合深度强化学习与层次注意力多实例学习（MIL），训练一个智能采样策略，仅选择10-20%的高分辨率块进行后续诊断。
Result: SASHA匹配了全分辨率分析的状态-of-the-art方法性能，但计算和内存开销大幅降低；同时显著优于其他稀疏采样方法。
Conclusion: SASHA是一种适用于包含稀疏信息特征的大尺寸医学图像（如WSI）自动诊断的智能采样模型。

papers.title: FADPNet: Frequency-Aware Dual-Path Network for Face Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Face super-resolution (FSR) under limited computational budgets remains challenging. Existing methods often treat all facial pixels equally, leading to suboptimal resource allocation and degraded performance. CNNs are sensitive to high-frequency facial features such as contours and outlines, while Mamba excels at capturing low-frequency attributes like facial color and texture with lower complexity than Transformers. Motivated by this, we propose FADPNet, a Frequency-Aware Dual-Path Network that decomposes facial features into low- and high-frequency components for dedicated processing. The low-frequency branch employs a Mamba-based Low-Frequency Enhancement Block (LFEB) that integrates state-space attention with squeeze-and-excitation to restore global interactions and emphasize informative channels. The high-frequency branch uses a CNN-based Depthwise Position-aware Attention (DPA) module to refine structural details, followed by a lightweight High-Frequency Refinement (HFR) module for further frequency-specific refinement. These designs enable FADPNet to achieve a strong balance between FSR quality and efficiency, outperforming existing methods. Codes will be available at https://github.com/IVIPLab/FADPNet.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FADPNet，一种频率感知双路径网络用于人脸超分辨率。将人脸特征分解为低频和高频分量，分别用Mamba和CNN处理，以在有限计算预算下提升性能。实验表明该方法在质量与效率之间取得了良好平衡，优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法对所有像素一视同仁，导致资源分配不佳；CNN善于捕获高频特征如轮廓，而Mamba以更低复杂度捕获低频特征如颜色纹理，但缺乏联合设计。
Method: 提出FADPNet，包含低频分支（Mamba的LFEB模块，集成状态空间注意力与SE）和高频分支（CNN的DPA模块与HFR模块），分别处理不同频率成分。
Result: 在人脸超分辨率任务上，FADPNet在质量与效率之间取得平衡，超越现有方法。
Conclusion: 频率感知双路径设计可有效提升人脸超分辨率性能，代码将开源。

papers.title: OV-MAP: Open-Vocabulary Zero-Shot 3D Instance Segmentation Map for Robots
papers.abstract_en: We introduce OV-MAP, a novel approach to open-world 3D mapping for mobile robots by integrating open-features into 3D maps to enhance object recognition capabilities. A significant challenge arises when overlapping features from adjacent voxels reduce instance-level precision, as features spill over voxel boundaries, blending neighboring regions together. Our method overcomes this by employing a class-agnostic segmentation model to project 2D masks into 3D space, combined with a supplemented depth image created by merging raw and synthetic depth from point clouds. This approach, along with a 3D mask voting mechanism, enables accurate zero-shot 3D instance segmentation without relying on 3D supervised segmentation models. We assess the effectiveness of our method through comprehensive experiments on public datasets such as ScanNet200 and Replica, demonstrating superior zero-shot performance, robustness, and adaptability across diverse environments. Additionally, we conducted real-world experiments to demonstrate our method's adaptability and robustness when applied to diverse real-world environments.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 7 figures. Published in the Proceedings of the 2024 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2024)
papers.journal_ref: 2024 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2024, pp. 13780-13786
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OV-MAP 是一种面向机器人的开放词汇零样本 3D 实例分割地图方法。它通过将开放特征集成到 3D 地图中，利用类无关分割模型将 2D 掩码投影到 3D 空间，并结合原始与合成深度图像以及 3D 掩码投票机制，实现了无需 3D 监督分割模型的零样本实例分割。在 ScanNet200 和 Replica 等数据集上的实验表明，该方法在零样本性能、鲁棒性和适应性方面表现优异，真实世界实验也验证了其适用性。
Motivation: 相邻体素的特征重叠会导致实例级精度下降，而现有方法通常依赖 3D 监督分割模型，限制了其在开放世界中的泛化能力。
Method: 采用类无关分割模型将 2D 掩码投影到 3D 空间，并融合原始点云和合成深度图像生成补充深度图，再通过 3D 掩码投票机制实现零样本实例分割。
Result: 在 ScanNet200 和 Replica 公开数据集上取得了优越的零样本性能，并展示了跨环境的鲁棒性和适应性；真实世界实验进一步验证了方法的实用性。
Conclusion: OV-MAP 无需 3D 监督分割模型即可实现开放世界中的零样本 3D 实例分割，适用于机器人映射任务，且具有较好的泛化能力。

papers.title: Stop Misusing t-SNE and UMAP for Visual Analytics
papers.abstract_en: Misuses of t-SNE and UMAP in visual analytics have become increasingly common. For example, although t-SNE and UMAP projections often do not faithfully reflect the original distances between clusters, practitioners frequently use them to investigate inter-cluster relationships. We investigate why this misuse occurs, and discuss methods to prevent it. To that end, we first review 136 papers to verify the prevalence of the misuse. We then interview researchers who have used dimensionality reduction (DR) to understand why such misuse occurs. Finally, we interview DR experts to examine why previous efforts failed to address the misuse. We find that the misuse of t-SNE and UMAP stems primarily from limited DR literacy among practitioners, and that existing attempts to address this issue -- mostly based on academic papers -- have been ineffective. Based on these insights, we discuss potential future research directions to mitigate the misuse.
papers.comment: IEEE VIS 2026 & IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics (TVCG)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过文献综述和访谈，系统调查了t-SNE和UMAP在可视化分析中的常见误用现象（例如用投影图解释聚类间距离），分析其根源——用户对降维技术理解不足，并指出现有学术论文形式的改进措施效果有限。最后提出未来研究方向以缓解误用。
Motivation: 尽管t-SNE和UMAP广泛用于可视化探索，但用户常错误地将投影中的距离视为原始距离，导致分析结论不可靠。现有技术解释和规范未能有效遏制这一趋势。
Method: 先回顾136篇论文验证误用普遍性，再访谈使用降维技术的研究者探究误用原因，最后访谈降维专家分析过往努力失效的原因。
Result: 发现误用主要源于用户对降维技术理解不足（limited DR literacy），而传统学术论文形式的说明效果有限。
Conclusion: 需要更有效的教育工具或交互式辅助手段来纠正误用，而非仅依赖论文规范。

papers.title: Breaking the Block: Preserving Data Continuity to Train Superior SAEs for Instruct Models
papers.abstract_en: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are a cornerstone of mechanistic interpretability. Existing training methods inherit the Block Training paradigm from LLM pre-training, which introduces destructive gradient noise in instruct models due to attention leakage from unrelated contexts. Using GSNR analysis, we theoretically characterize this issue and propose Finetuning-aligned Sequential Training (FAST), a sequential training paradigm specifically designed for instruct models. FAST aligns SAE training with the data distribution and activation patterns of instruct models, substantially improving both reconstruction fidelity and feature interpretability. Experimental results show that FAST achieves higher GSNR, a significantly lower log-scaled MSE of 0.6468 compared to the baseline's 5.1985, and a near-zero Delta Loss (-0.51\% to 0.37\%). Moreover, on Llama-3.2-3B-it, FAST produces 21.1\% high-quality features, substantially outperforming baseline methods that achieve 7.0\% and 10.2\%. We further find that intervening on special token activations through SAEs can improve generation quality, revealing new opportunities for fine-grained control. Our codes are available as open source at https://github.com/Geaming2002/FAST.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对指令微调模型，稀疏自编码器（SAE）的训练受传统分块训练范式影响，因注意力泄露引入破坏性梯度噪声。本文提出 Finetuning-aligned Sequential Training (FAST)，一种顺序训练范式，通过对齐 SAE 训练与指令模型的数据分布和激活模式，显著提升重构保真度和特征可解释性。在 Llama-3.2-3B-it 上，FAST 将 log-scaled MSE 从 5.1985 降至 0.6468，高质量特征比例从 7.0%/10.2% 提升至 21.1%，并发现干预特殊 token 激活可改善生成质量。
Motivation: 现有 SAE 训练继承自 LLM 预训练的分块训练范式，在指令模型上因注意力泄露（attention leakage）从无关上下文中引入破坏性梯度噪声，影响训练效果。
Method: 提出 Finetuning-aligned Sequential Training (FAST)，一种顺序训练范式，利用 GSNR 分析理论刻画问题，并设计训练流程以对齐指令模型的数据分布和激活模式。
Result: 实验结果显示，FAST 实现更高 GSNR，log-scaled MSE 为 0.6468（基线 5.1985），Delta Loss 接近零（-0.51% 至 0.37%）；在 Llama-3.2-3B-it 上产生 21.1% 高质量特征，显著优于基线方法的 7.0% 和 10.2%。
Conclusion: FAST 训练范式能有效提升指令模型上 SAE 的重构与可解释性；进一步发现通过 SAE 干预特殊 token 激活可改善生成质量，为细粒度控制提供新途径。

papers.title: MMR-V: What's Left Unsaid? A Benchmark for Multimodal Deep Reasoning in Videos
papers.abstract_en: The sequential structure of videos poses a challenge to the ability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to locate multi-frame evidence and conduct multimodal reasoning. However, existing video benchmarks mainly focus on understanding tasks, which only require models to match frames mentioned in the question (hereafter referred to as "question frame") and perceive a few adjacent frames. To address this gap, we propose MMR-V: A Benchmark for Multimodal Deep Reasoning in Videos. The benchmark is characterized by the following features. (1) Long-range, multi-frame reasoning: Models are required to infer and analyze evidence frames that may be far from the question frame. (2) Beyond perception: Questions cannot be answered through direct perception alone but require reasoning over hidden information. (3) Reliability: All tasks are manually annotated, referencing extensive real-world user understanding to align with common perceptions. (4) Confusability: Carefully designed distractor annotation strategies to reduce model shortcuts. MMR-V consists of 317 videos and 1,257 tasks. Our experiments reveal that current models still struggle with multi-modal reasoning; even the best-performing model, Gemini-2.5-pro, achieves only 64.3% accuracy. Additionally, current reasoning enhancement strategies (Chain-of-Thought and scaling test-time compute) bring limited gains. Error analysis indicates that the CoT demanded for multi-modal reasoning differs from it in textual reasoning, which partly explains the limited performance gains. We hope that MMR-V can inspire further research into enhancing multi-modal reasoning capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MMR-V 基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在视频中的深度推理能力，要求模型进行远程多帧推理且超越直接感知。实验显示最佳模型 Gemini-2.5-pro 仅达 64.3% 准确率，且当前推理增强策略（思维链、测试时计算缩放）提升有限，错误分析表明多模态推理所需的 CoT 与文本推理不同。
Motivation: 现有视频基准主要关注理解任务，仅需匹配问题帧并感知相邻帧，缺乏对隐藏信息进行远程多帧推理的评估，因此需要填补这一空白。
Method: 构建 MMR-V 基准，包含 317 个视频和 1257 个任务，特点包括：远程多帧推理、超越感知（需推理隐藏信息）、人工标注保证可靠性、设计干扰项避免捷径。
Result: 最佳模型 Gemini-2.5-pro 准确率仅 64.3%，思维链和测试时计算缩放带来的改进有限。
Conclusion: 多模态推理的 CoT 与文本推理存在差异，这解释了当前策略提升有限的原因，期望新基准能促进多模态推理研究。

papers.title: OMAC: A Holistic Optimization Framework for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Agents powered by advanced large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities across diverse complex applications. Recently, Multi-Agent Systems (MAS), wherein multiple agents collaborate and communicate with each other, have exhibited enhanced capabilities in complex tasks, such as high-quality code generation and arithmetic reasoning. However, the development of such systems often relies on handcrafted methods, and the literature on systematic design and optimization of LLM-based MAS remains limited. In this work, we introduce \textbf{OMAC}, a general framework designed for holistic optimization of LLM-based MAS. Specifically, we identify five key optimization dimensions for MAS, encompassing both agent functionality and collaboration structure. Building upon these dimensions, we first propose a general algorithm, utilizing two actors termed the Semantic Initializer and the Contrastive Comparator, to optimize any single dimension. Then, we present an algorithm for joint optimization across multiple dimensions. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of OMAC on diverse tasks against recent approaches.
papers.comment: Accepted as a Oral paper at ICML 2026

papers.title: Enhancing LLMs' Clinical Reasoning with Real-World Data from a Nationwide Sepsis Registry
papers.abstract_en: Although large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning capabilities across general domains, their effectiveness in real-world clinical practice remains limited. This is likely due to their insufficient exposure to real-world clinical data during training, as such data is typically not included due to privacy concerns. To address this, we propose enhancing the clinical reasoning capabilities of LLMs by leveraging real-world clinical data. We constructed reasoning-intensive questions from a nationwide sepsis registry and fine-tuned Phi-4 on these questions using reinforcement learning, resulting in C-Reason. C-Reason exhibited strong clinical reasoning capabilities on the in-domain test set, as evidenced by both quantitative metrics and expert evaluations. Furthermore, its enhanced reasoning capabilities generalized to a sepsis dataset involving different tasks and patient cohorts, an open-ended consultations on antibiotics use task, and other diseases. Future research should focus on training LLMs with large-scale, multi-disease clinical datasets to develop more powerful, general-purpose clinical reasoning models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出C-Reason，通过利用真实世界临床数据（全国脓毒症注册）和强化学习微调Phi-4，增强LLMs的临床推理能力。在域内测试集上表现良好，且泛化到其他脓毒症任务、抗生素咨询和其他疾病。
Motivation: LLMs在一般领域推理能力强，但在真实临床实践中效果有限，因为训练时缺乏真实临床数据（隐私问题）。
Method: 从全国脓毒症注册数据构建推理密集型问题，使用强化学习微调Phi-4，得到C-Reason。
Result: 在域内测试集上展示了强临床推理能力（定量和专家评估），并泛化到不同任务、患者队列、抗生素咨询和其他疾病。
Conclusion: 未来应训练LLMs在大规模多疾病临床数据集上，开发更强大的通用临床推理模型。

papers.title: CorStitch: Accessible Video Stitching for Coral Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: We develop CorStitch, a video-stitching software that automates the process of stitching underwater videos for coral reef monitoring and assessment. It offers a free, flexible, and user-friendly alternative to existing stitching software that may be difficult to access. CorStitch utilizes a Fourier-based image registration algorithm to stitch the central horizontal strips of successive frames of down-looking belt and dive transect videos, generating georeferenced and marked mosaics. Tests show that CorStitch can produce high-quality mosaics that are comparable to those generated by existing stitching software, with the added advantage of being open-source and accessible to users with varying levels of technical expertise. CorStitch has the potential to supplement the coral reef monitoring efforts of local communities, government agencies, and non-governmental organizations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍CorStitch，一个自动化拼接水下视频的开源软件，用于珊瑚礁监测。该软件采用基于傅里叶变换的图像配准算法，从下视带和潜水断面视频的连续帧中拼接水平中央条带，生成地理参考和标记的镶嵌图。测试表明，CorStitch能产生与现有拼接软件相当的高质量镶嵌图，且具有开源、易用的优势。
Motivation: 现有视频拼接软件可能难以获取或使用，限制了珊瑚礁监测工作的普及，需要一种免费、灵活且用户友好的替代方案。
Method: 采用基于傅里叶变换的图像配准算法，自动拼接连续帧的水平中央条带，生成地理参考和标记的镶嵌图。
Result: 测试表明CorStitch能产生与现有软件相当的高质量镶嵌图，且作为开源软件对技术背景不同的用户均易访问。
Conclusion: CorStitch有潜力辅助当地社区、政府机构和非政府组织的珊瑚礁监测工作，提供可访问的拼接工具。

papers.title: Comprehend, Divide, and Conquer: Feature Subspace Exploration via Multi-Agent Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Feature selection aims to preprocess the target dataset, find an optimal and most streamlined feature subset, and enhance the downstream machine learning task. Among filter, wrapper, and embedded-based approaches, the reinforcement learning (RL)-based subspace exploration strategy provides a novel objective optimization-directed perspective and promising performance. Nevertheless, even with improved performance, current reinforcement learning approaches face challenges similar to conventional methods when dealing with complex datasets. These challenges stem from the inefficient paradigm of using one agent per feature and the inherent complexities present in the datasets. This observation motivates us to investigate and address the above issue and propose a novel approach, namely HRLFS. Our methodology initially employs a Large Language Model (LLM)-based hybrid state extractor to capture each feature's mathematical and semantic characteristics. Based on this information, features are clustered, facilitating the construction of hierarchical agents for each cluster and sub-cluster. Extensive experiments demonstrate the efficiency, scalability, and robustness of our approach. Compared to contemporary or the one-feature-one-agent RL-based approaches, HRLFS improves the downstream ML performance with iterative feature subspace exploration while accelerating total run time by reducing the number of agents involved.
papers.comment: 25 pages, keywords: Automated Feature Engineering, Tabular Dataset, Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning, Feature Selection, Accepted by ACM Transactions on Knowledge Discovery from Data
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于多智能体层次强化学习的特征选择方法 HRLFS，利用大语言模型提取特征的数学和语义特征并进行聚类，构建每个簇的层次智能体，从而减少智能体数量并提升效率。实验表明该方法在表格数据集上能提升下游机器学习性能，同时加速运行时间。
Motivation: 现有的基于强化学习的特征选择方法采用每特征一个智能体的范式，在处理复杂数据集时效率低下，且难以应对数据内在复杂性。
Method: 首先使用大语言模型 (LLM) 作为混合状态提取器，获取每个特征的数学和语义特征；然后根据这些信息对特征进行聚类，为每个簇和子簇构建层次智能体，实现层次化的特征子空间探索。
Result: 实验证明该方法相比每特征一智能体的强化学习基线，在迭代特征子空间探索中提升了下游机器学习性能，并通过减少智能体数量显著加速了总运行时间。
Conclusion: 该方法在效率、可扩展性和鲁棒性方面均有提升，为自动化特征工程提供了新思路。

papers.title: A Survey on Unlearnable Data
papers.abstract_en: Unlearnable data (ULD) has emerged as an innovative defense technique to prevent machine learning models from learning meaningful patterns from specific data, thus protecting data privacy and security. By introducing perturbations to the training data, ULD degrades model performance, making it difficult for unauthorized models to extract useful representations. Despite the growing significance of ULD, existing surveys predominantly focus on related fields, such as adversarial attacks and machine unlearning, with little attention given to ULD as an independent area of study. This survey fills that gap by offering a comprehensive review of ULD, examining unlearnable data generation methods, public benchmarks, evaluation metrics, theoretical foundations and practical applications. We compare and contrast different ULD approaches, analyzing their strengths, limitations, and trade-offs related to unlearnability, imperceptibility, efficiency and robustness. Moreover, we discuss key challenges, such as balancing perturbation imperceptibility with model degradation and the computational complexity of ULD generation. Finally, we highlight promising future research directions to advance the effectiveness and applicability of ULD, underscoring its potential to become a crucial tool in the evolving landscape of data protection in machine learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对不可学习数据（ULD）的全面综述，涵盖生成方法、基准、评价指标、理论基础及应用。比较了不同方法的优劣，讨论了扰动不可感知性与模型退化之间的平衡、计算复杂度等挑战，并指出了未来研究方向。
Motivation: 现有综述多关注对抗攻击或机器遗忘等相邻领域，缺少将ULD作为独立研究方向的系统梳理。本文旨在填补这一空白，为数据隐私保护提供全面参考。
Method: 通过文献分类与对比分析，系统总结了ULD的生成方法（如基于对抗扰动、数据中毒等）、公开基准、评估指标（不可学习性、不可感知性、效率、鲁棒性）及理论解释。
Result: 归纳了不同ULD方法的优缺点与权衡，指出当前主要挑战包括扰动不可感知性与模型退化之间的平衡、生成计算复杂度等。
Conclusion: ULD有望成为机器学习数据保护的重要工具，未来需提升其实际应用效果和可扩展性。

papers.title: Enhancing Vision Foundation Models via Multimodal Continual Pre-Training
papers.abstract_en: Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) provide strong visual representations for a wide range of applications. In this work, we enhance prevailing VFMs through multimodal training, allowing them to effectively process visual inputs at varying resolutions while producing visual representations that are better aligned with language representations, regardless of their original pre-training objectives. To this end, we introduce M-CPT, a Multimodal Continual Pre-Training framework designed to improve the understanding capability of pre-trained VFMs while preserving their strong visual representation quality. M-CPT introduces a Continual Position Embedding (CPE) for handling flexible visual resolutions, along with a feature alignment objective that improves the consistency between visual and textual representations during multimodal training. Extensive experiments on leading VFMs, including DINOv2, SigLIP, and AIMv2, demonstrate that M-CPT consistently improves multimodal understanding performance while preserving strong performance on standard vision benchmarks such as classification and segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出M-CPT，一种多模态持续预训练框架，用于增强已有的视觉基础模型，使其能处理可变分辨率输入，并更好地对齐视觉和语言表示。在DINOv2, SigLIP, AIMv2等模型上实验证明，M-CPT能持续提升多模态理解性能，同时保持分类、分割等标准视觉任务的性能。
Motivation: 已有视觉基础模型在预训练时通常只使用单模态（图像），缺乏与语言的对齐，且对输入分辨率处理不够灵活。
Method: 提出M-CPT框架，包含两个关键组件：Continuous Position Embedding (CPE) 用于灵活处理可变分辨率；特征对齐目标用于改善视觉与文本表示的 consistency。
Result: 在DINOv2, SigLIP, AIMv2上，M-CPT一致提升多模态理解性能，并在标准视觉基准（分类、分割）上保持强性能。
Conclusion: M-CPT提供了一种有效的方式，在不损害原有视觉表示质量的前提下，赋予视觉基础模型多模态理解能力。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: A Survey on Knowledge-Oriented Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has gained significant attention in recent years for its potential to enhance natural language understanding and generation by combining large-scale retrieval systems with generative models. RAG leverages external knowledge sources, such as documents, databases, or structured data, to improve model performance and generate more accurate and contextually relevant outputs. This survey aims to provide a comprehensive overview of RAG by examining its fundamental components, including retrieval mechanisms, generation processes, and the integration between the two. We discuss the key characteristics of RAG, such as its ability to augment generative models with dynamic external knowledge, and the challenges associated with aligning retrieved information with generative objectives. We also present a taxonomy that categorizes RAG methods, ranging from basic retrieval-augmented approaches to more advanced models incorporating multimodal data and reasoning capabilities. Additionally, we review the evaluation benchmarks and datasets commonly used to assess RAG systems, along with a detailed exploration of its applications in fields such as question answering, summarization, and information retrieval. Finally, we highlight emerging research directions and opportunities for improving RAG systems, such as enhanced retrieval efficiency, model interpretability, and domain-specific adaptations. This paper concludes by outlining the prospects for RAG in addressing real-world challenges and its potential to drive further advancements in natural language processing.

papers.title: Regret Minimization for Piecewise Linear Rewards: Contracts, Auctions, and Beyond
papers.abstract_en: Most microeconomic models of interest involve optimizing a piecewise linear function. These include contract design in hidden-action principal-agent problems, selling an item in posted-price auctions, and bidding in first-price auctions. When the relevant model parameters are unknown and determined by some (unknown) probability distributions, the problem becomes learning how to optimize an unknown and stochastic piecewise linear reward function. Such a problem is usually framed within an online learning framework, where the decision-maker (learner) seeks to minimize the regret of not knowing an optimal decision in hindsight. This paper introduces a general online learning framework that offers a unified approach to tackle regret minimization for piecewise linear rewards, under a suitable monotonicity assumption commonly satisfied by microeconomic models. We design a learning algorithm that attains a regret of $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{nT})$, where $n$ is the number of ``pieces'' of the reward function and $T$ is the number of rounds. This result is tight when $n$ is \emph{small} relative to $T$, specifically when $n \leq T^{1/3}$. Our algorithm solves two open problems in the literature on learning in microeconomic settings. First, it shows that the $\widetilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ regret bound obtained by Zhu et al. [Zhu+23] for learning optimal linear contracts in hidden-action principal-agent problems is not tight when the number of agent's actions is small relative to $T$. Second, our algorithm demonstrates that, in the problem of learning to set prices in posted-price auctions, it is possible to attain suitable (and desirable) instance-independent regret bounds, addressing an open problem posed by Cesa-Bianchi et al. [CBCP19].
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个通用在线学习框架，用于处理分段线性奖励函数的遗憾最小化问题，在单调性假设下设计算法达到˜O(√(nT))遗憾，n为分段数，T为轮数。该结果当n较小时（n≤T^{1/3}）是紧的，并解决了隐藏行动委托代理问题中合约学习的遗憾界改进以及拍卖定价中实例无关遗憾界的开放问题。
Motivation: 许多微观经济模型（如合约设计、拍卖竞价）涉及优化未知的分段线性随机奖励函数，现有学习算法遗憾界不紧或存在未解决的开放问题，需要统一的理论框架。
Method: 引入一个通用在线学习框架，利用分段线性奖励函数在微观经济模型中常见的单调性假设，设计学习算法。
Result: 算法达到˜O(√(nT))遗憾界，当n≤T^{1/3}时紧；改进了Zhu等人得到的O(T^{2/3})遗憾界，并首次实现拍卖定价中实例独立的遗憾界。
Conclusion: 该框架统一处理多种微观经济场景中的在线学习问题，并提供了紧的遗憾下界，但适用性依赖于单调性假设。

papers.title: Mediator: Memory-efficient LLM Merging with Less Parameter Conflicts and Uncertainty Based Routing
papers.abstract_en: Model merging aggregates Large Language Models (LLMs) finetuned on different tasks into a stronger one. However, parameter conflicts between models leads to performance degradation in averaging. While model routing addresses this issue by selecting individual models during inference, it imposes excessive storage and compute costs, and fails to leverage the common knowledge from different models. In this work, we observe that different layers exhibit varying levels of parameter conflicts. Building on this insight, we average layers with minimal parameter conflicts and use a novel task-level expert routing for layers with significant conflicts. To further reduce storage costs, inspired by task arithmetic sparsity, we decouple multiple fine-tuned experts into a dense expert and several sparse experts. Considering the out-of-distribution samples, we select and merge appropriate experts based on the task uncertainty of the input data. We conduct extensive experiments on both LLaMA and Qwen with varying parameter scales, and evaluate on real-world reasoning tasks. Results demonstrate that our method consistently achieves significant performance improvements while requiring less system cost.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多任务微调的大语言模型（LLM）合并中参数冲突导致性能下降的问题，提出基于层级的合并策略：对冲突小的层直接平均，对冲突大的层采用任务级专家路由。为降低存储成本，利用任务算术稀疏性将多个微调专家解耦为密集专家和多个稀疏专家，并基于输入数据的任务不确定性选择合并专家。在LLaMA和Qwen上的实验表明，该方法在显著提升性能的同时降低了系统开销。
Motivation: 现有模型合并方法中参数冲突导致平均后性能下降，而模型路由虽可避免冲突但增加存储和计算成本，且无法利用不同模型的共有知识。
Method: 观察不同层参数冲突程度不同，对冲突小的层直接平均，冲突大的层使用任务级专家路由。进一步利用任务算术稀疏性将微调专家解耦为密集专家和稀疏专家，并基于输入数据的任务不确定性选择合并专家。
Result: 在LLaMA和Qwen上多个参数规模的实验表明，该方法在真实推理任务上持续取得显著性能提升，同时所需系统成本更低。
Conclusion: 通过层级冲突感知和不确定性路由，能够高效合并多任务微调LLM，兼顾性能与存储开销。

papers.title: CityLoc: 6DoF Pose Distributional Localization for Text Descriptions in Large-Scale Scenes with Gaussian Representation
papers.abstract_en: Localizing textual descriptions within large-scale 3D scenes presents inherent ambiguities, such as identifying all traffic lights in a city. Addressing this, we introduce a method to generate distributions of camera poses conditioned on textual descriptions, facilitating robust reasoning for broadly defined concepts. Our approach employs a diffusion-based architecture to refine noisy 6DoF camera poses towards plausible locations, with conditional signals derived from pre-trained text encoders. Integration with the pretrained Vision-Language Model, CLIP, establishes a strong linkage between text descriptions and pose distributions. Enhancement of localization accuracy is achieved by rendering candidate poses using 3D Gaussian splatting, which corrects misaligned samples through visual reasoning. We validate our method's superiority by comparing it against standard distribution estimation methods across five large-scale datasets, demonstrating consistent outperformance. Code, datasets and more information will be publicly available at our project page.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CityLoc方法，通过扩散模型和3D高斯溅射，将文本描述映射到大规模3D场景中的相机6DoF姿态分布，解决文本定位模糊性问题。在五个大规模数据集上优于标准分布估计方法。
Motivation: 文本描述在大规模3D场景中定位存在内在模糊性（如“城市中所有交通信号灯”），需要鲁棒处理广泛概念。
Method: 采用扩散架构从噪声6DoF姿态逐步优化到合理位置，利用预训练文本编码器作为条件信号，结合CLIP建立文本与姿态分布的强关联，并通过3D高斯溅射渲染候选姿态进行视觉校正。
Result: 在五个大规模数据集上，与标准分布估计方法相比，该方法持续表现更好。
Conclusion: 方法通过扩散模型和渲染校正实现了基于文本的分布定位，代码和数据集将公开。
