papers.title: OmniVLM: A Token-Compressed, Sub-Billion-Parameter Vision-Language Model for Efficient On-Device Inference
papers.abstract_en: We present OmniVLM, a sub-billion-parameter vision-language model for efficient on-device inference. OmniVLM introduces a token compression mechanism that reduces visual token sequence length from 729 to 81 tokens, significantly reducing computational overhead while preserving visual-semantic fidelity. Through a multi-stage training pipeline of pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and minimal-edit Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), OmniVLM matches the performance of larger models. On multiple benchmarks including ScienceQA, POPE, and MMMU, OmniVLM outperforms existing baselines like nanoLLAVA within a 968M-parameter footprint. Empirical results on the same laptop demonstrate 9.1x faster time-to-first-token (0.75s vs 6.82s) and 1.5x higher decoding speed (29.41 vs 19.20 tokens/s) compared to nanoLLAVA, enabling efficient deployment on edge devices. The model weights can be accessed on huggingface: https://huggingface.co/NexaAIDev/OmniVLM-968M, and the inference examples can be find in Appendix B.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniVLM 是一个参数量低于10亿的视觉语言模型，通过 token 压缩将视觉 token 序列从729减少到81，显著降低计算开销。采用多阶段训练（预训练、监督微调、最小编辑直接偏好优化），在 ScienceQA、POPE、MMMU 等基准上超越 nanoLLAVA 等基线，并在笔记本上实现 9.1 倍的首 token 时间加速和 1.5 倍的解码速度提升。

papers.title: Regret Optimality of Sample Average Approximation for Data-Driven Newsvendor Problems: A General Optimization Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Numerous existing studies have examined the performance of Sample Average Approximation (SAA) in the fundamental newsvendor problem. Despite these advances, critical gaps remain in two aspects. First, existing works focus on the linear-cost newsvendor problem and heavily rely on the quantile expression of the optimal solution. As a result, their analytical methods limit generalizability to more general inventory problems, where the optimal solution is not a quantile of the demand distribution. Second, even within the linear-cost setting, notable gaps exist between the state-of-the-art regret lower bound and upper bound for SAA under various conditions. In this paper, we generalize the structure of the newsvendor problem to generic convexity conditions and provide a unified regret analysis of SAA for general sequential stochastic optimization problems. Our approach provides further insights to a broader range of data-driven inventory problems, improves both the upper and lower regret bounds, and establishes the regret rate optimality of SAA. Our lower bound identifies the performance limit achievable by any policy for sequential stochastic optimization and inventory management problems, offering important guidance for future policy design in this area. Moreover, in empirical studies, SAA's performance is frequently used as a benchmark for evaluating new algorithms. The regret rate optimality result provides strong support for its role in assessing other data-driven methods, benefiting both practitioners and researchers. Our new analysis techniques enrich the analysis tools for regret upper and lower bounds for data-driven decision-making problems and other general stochastic optimization problems.
papers.comment: The former title is Closing the Gaps: Optimality of Sample Average Approximation for Data-Driven Newsvendor Problems

TL;DR: 本文研究数据驱动报童问题中样本平均近似（SAA）的遗憾最优性，将其推广到一般凸性条件，并统一分析顺序随机优化问题的遗憾界。改进了上下界，证明了SAA的遗憾率最优性，为未来策略设计提供指导。

Method: 将报童问题结构推广到一般凸性条件，提供统一的遗憾分析框架，通过新的分析技术推导更紧的上下界。
Result: 改进了SAA的遗憾上下界，建立了其遗憾率最优性，并识别了顺序随机优化问题的性能极限。
Conclusion: 结果支持SAA作为新算法评估基准的合理性，其分析技术可推广到更广泛的数据驱动决策问题。

papers.title: A Survey of Features Used for Representing Black-box Single-objective Continuous Optimization
papers.abstract_en: This survey examines key advancements in designing features to represent optimization problem instances, algorithm instances, and their interactions within the context of single-objective continuous black-box optimization. These features support machine learning tasks such as algorithm selection, algorithm configuration, and problem classification, and they are also used to evaluate the complementarity of benchmark problem sets. We provide a comprehensive overview of problem landscape features, algorithm features, high-level problem-algorithm interaction features, and trajectory features, including the latest works from the past five years. We also point out limitations of the current state-of-the-art and suggest directions for future research.

papers.title: Dynamic Structural Causal Models
papers.abstract_en: We study a specific type of SCM, called a Dynamic Structural Causal Model (DSCM), whose endogenous variables represent functions of time, which is possibly cyclic and allows for latent confounding. As a motivating use-case, we show that certain systems of Stochastic Differential Equations (SDEs) can be appropriately represented with DSCMs. An immediate consequence of this construction is a graphical Markov property for systems of SDEs. We define a time-splitting operation, allowing us to analyse the concept of local independence (a notion of continuous-time Granger (non-)causality). We also define a subsampling operation, which returns a discrete-time DSCM, and which can be used for mathematical analysis of subsampled time-series. We give suggestions how DSCMs can be used for identification of the causal effect of time-dependent interventions, and how existing constraint-based causal discovery algorithms can be applied to time-series data.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文定义了一种动态结构因果模型（DSCM），其内生变量为时间函数，允许循环和隐混。通过构造，证明了随机微分方程组可表示为DSCM，并导出了图形马尔可夫性质。提出了时间分裂和子采样操作，用于分析局部独立性和子采样时间序列，并讨论了因果效应识别和约束因果发现的应用。
Motivation: 现有结构因果模型（SCM）通常处理静态或离散时间，难以直接刻画连续时间动态系统中的因果关系。本文旨在扩展SCM到连续时间动态系统，并处理循环和隐混等复杂情况。
Method: 定义了一种新的SCM变体——动态结构因果模型（DSCM），其内生变量为时间函数。研究了随机微分方程组（SDEs）的DSCM表示，并推导了图形马尔可夫性质。引入时间分裂操作（分析局部独立性）和子采样操作（得到离散时间DSCM），并给出了用于因果效应识别和因果发现算法的方法。
Result: 展示了SDEs可被恰当表示为DSCM，并导出了SDE系统的图形马尔可夫性质。定义了局部独立性的概念，并给出了子采样后离散时间DSCM的性质。提供了DSCM在干预因果效应识别和约束因果发现中的应用建议。
Conclusion: DSCM为连续时间动态系统（如SDEs）的因果建模提供了理论框架，支持循环和隐混，并可应用于时间序列的因果发现和干预分析。

papers.title: Octopus v3: Technical Report for On-device Sub-billion Multimodal AI Agent
papers.abstract_en: A multimodal AI agent is characterized by its ability to process and learn from various types of data, including natural language, visual, and audio inputs, to inform its actions. Despite advancements in large language models that incorporate visual data, such as GPT-4V, effectively translating image-based data into actionable outcomes for AI agents continues to be challenging. In this paper, we introduce a multimodal model that incorporates the concept of functional token specifically designed for AI agent applications. To ensure compatibility with edge devices, our model is optimized to a compact size of less than 1B parameters. Like GPT-4, our model can process both English and Chinese. We demonstrate that this model is capable of operating efficiently on a wide range of edge devices, including as constrained as a Raspberry Pi.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了Octopus v3，一个面向边缘设备的多模态AI智能体模型，参数量小于1B，能够处理中英文和图像输入，并可在树莓派等设备上高效运行。核心创新在于引入功能性token (functional token) 概念，以更好地将图像信息转化为智能体的可执行动作。
Motivation: 现有大型多模态模型如GPT-4V在将图像数据转化为AI智能体的有效行动上仍存在挑战，且大模型难以部署在资源受限的边缘设备上。
Method: 提出一个紧凑的多模态模型，通过引入功能性token (functional token) 来优化图像到动作的映射，并将模型规模控制在1B参数以下以保证边缘设备兼容性。
Result: 模型可在多种边缘设备上高效运行，包括计算能力极有限的Raspberry Pi，同时支持中英文处理。
Conclusion: 该技术报告表明，即使在模型规模小于1B的情况下，也能实现实用的多模态AI智能体功能，为边缘设备上的AI应用提供了可能性。

papers.title: CarbonNet: How Computer Vision Plays a Role in Climate Change? Application: Learning Geomechanics from Subsurface Geometry of CCS to Mitigate Global Warming
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a new approach using computer vision to predict the land surface displacement from subsurface geometry images for Carbon Capture and Sequestration (CCS). CCS has been proved to be a key component for a carbon neutral society. However, scientists see there are challenges along the way including the high computational cost due to the large model scale and limitations to generalize a pre-trained model with complex physics. We tackle those challenges by training models directly from the subsurface geometry images. The goal is to understand the respons of land surface displacement due to carbon injection and utilize our trained models to inform decision making in CCS projects. We implement multiple models (CNN, ResNet, and ResNetUNet) for static mechanics problem, which is a image prediction problem. Next, we use the LSTM and transformer for transient mechanics scenario, which is a video prediction problem. It shows ResNetUNet outperforms the others thanks to its architecture in static mechanics problem, and LSTM shows comparable performance to transformer in transient problem. This report proceeds by outlining our dataset in detail followed by model descriptions in method section. Result and discussion state the key learning, observations, and conclusion with future work rounds out the paper.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用计算机视觉从地下几何图像预测地表位移，应用于碳捕集与封存（CCS）。采用CNN、ResNet、ResNetUNet处理静态力学图像预测问题，LSTM和Transformer处理瞬态力学视频预测问题。结果显示ResNetUNet在静态问题中表现最优，LSTM在瞬态问题中与Transformer性能相当。
Motivation: CCS对碳中和至关重要，但现有模型计算成本高且难以泛化复杂物理问题，需要更高效的方法预测碳注入引起的地表位移。
Method: 直接训练模型从地下几何图像预测地表位移：静态力学场景使用CNN、ResNet、ResNetUNet进行图像预测；瞬态力学场景使用LSTM和Transformer进行视频预测。
Result: ResNetUNet在静态力学问题中优于其他模型；LSTM在瞬态问题中与Transformer表现相当。
Conclusion: 该方法可辅助CCS项目决策，未来工作将进一步完善。

papers.title: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Air Combat at DARPA's AlphaDogfight Trials
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous control in high-dimensional, continuous state spaces is a persistent and important challenge in the fields of robotics and artificial intelligence. Because of high risk and complexity, the adoption of AI for autonomous combat systems has been a long-standing difficulty. In order to address these issues, DARPA's AlphaDogfight Trials (ADT) program sought to vet the feasibility of and increase trust in AI for autonomously piloting an F-16 in simulated air-to-air combat. Our submission to ADT solves the high-dimensional, continuous control problem using a novel hierarchical deep reinforcement learning approach consisting of a high-level policy selector and a set of separately trained low-level policies specialized for excelling in specific regions of the state space. Both levels of the hierarchy are trained using off-policy, maximum entropy methods with expert knowledge integrated through reward shaping. Our approach outperformed human expert pilots and achieved a second-place rank in the ADT championship event.
papers.comment: 15 pages (main text) + 4 pages (supplementary material), 13 figures. This work has been accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Artificial Intelligence (IEEE-TAI). This replaces the previous conference-version presented at the 2021 International Conference on Unmanned Aircraft System (ICUAS 21), June 15-18, 2021, Athens, Greece
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Artificial Intelligence (IEEE-TAI), vol. 4, no. 6, pp. 1371-1385, 2023
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于DARPA AlphaDogfight Trials的分层深度强化学习方法，在高维连续控制问题上通过高层策略选择器和多个低层策略实现空战机动，并在模拟空战比赛中击败人类专家，获得亚军。
Motivation: 高维连续状态空间中的自主控制是机器人学和AI的长期挑战，尤其是在高风险的空战系统中，DARPA希望通过AlphaDogfight Trials验证AI自主驾驶F-16的可行性并建立信任。
Method: 提出一种分层深度强化学习框架，包含一个高层策略选择器（high-level policy selector）和一组分别训练的低层策略（low-level policies），低层策略专门针对状态空间的特定区域进行优化。两层均使用离线策略的最大熵方法训练，并通过奖励塑造（reward shaping）整合专家知识。
Result: 该方法在模拟空战对战中击败人类专家飞行员，在ADT锦标赛中获得第二名。
Conclusion: 本文验证了分层强化学习在高维连续控制空战问题中的有效性，并指出该方法有潜力应用于其他高动态环境。

papers.title: An Explainable FFT-Based Spatial-Frequency Fusion Framework for Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Deepfake generation has raised growing concerns regarding digital media authenticity, misinformation, identity fraud, and public trust. Recent studies show that combining spatial and frequency features leads to stronger detection results than using independently. This paper presents MSCA-FFT, a Fast Fourier Transform (FFT)-based multi-scale cross-attention framework for image-level deepfake detection. The model combines a partially fine-tuned Xception spatial branch with an FFT-based frequency branch. The frequency branch processes the log-scaled FFT magnitude spectrum through shallow convolutional layers, avoiding inverse frequency-to-image reconstruction used in DCT-based pipelines. The spatial and frequency representations are refined by transformer encoders, fused through cross-attention, and passed to an MLP classifier for real/fake prediction. Experimental results show that MSCA-FFT achieves consistently higher performance than the DCT-based state-of-the-art spatial-frequency fusion method and the compared baseline models. The ablation study further indicates that the FFT-based frequency branch provides complementary spectral cues when fused with spatial features. In addition, FFT-based frequency analysis and Grad-CAM/LIME explanations show consistent evidence around manipulation-sensitive facial regions, including the eyes, mouth, nose, and facial boundaries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MSCA-FFT，一种基于快速傅里叶变换（FFT）的多尺度交叉注意力框架，用于图像级深度伪造检测。模型融合部分微调的 Xception 空间分支和基于 FFT 的频率分支，通过 Transformer 编码器和交叉注意力将空间与频率特征结合。实验表明该方法在性能上优于基于 DCT 的最新融合方法及基线模型，且可解释性分析（Grad-CAM/LIME）显示模型关注眼睛、嘴巴、鼻子等伪造敏感区域。
Motivation: 深度伪造生成技术引发数字媒体真实性、虚假信息传播等问题，现有方法结合空间与频率特征能提升检测效果，但基于 DCT 的方法需要逆变换重建图像，效率较低。
Method: 提出 MSCA-FFT 框架，包含两个分支：空间分支使用部分微调的 Xception 网络，频率分支将输入图像的对数尺度 FFT 幅度谱通过浅层卷积层处理，避免逆变换。两个分支的输出经 Transformer 编码器增强，再通过交叉注意力融合，最后由 MLP 分类器判别真伪。
Result: 实验表明 MSCA-FFT 在多个基准上持续优于基于 DCT 的最先进空间-频率融合方法及对比基线模型，消融研究证实 FFT 频率分支提供互补的频谱线索。
Conclusion: 本工作验证了 FFT 作为频率分析工具在深度伪造检测中的有效性，同时利用 Grad-CAM/LIME 提供了模型决策的可解释性，证明模型集中于面部关键区域的操纵痕迹。

papers.title: Empirical Grounding Improves the Realism of LLM Agents Simulating Human Behavior During Disruptions
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents offer a generative approach to simulating human behavior under conditions that may have few or no direct historical analogues, a common challenge in disaster and infrastructure-disruption planning. However, this generative capacity creates a validity problem: individually plausible agent reasoning may fail to reproduce empirical population behavior. We evaluate whether empirical grounding improves the statistical realism of LLM-agent simulations during disruptions. Specifically, we develop an empirically grounded LLM-agent framework that embeds demographic profiles from the American Community Survey, baseline routines from the American Time Use Survey, and urban spatial context into agent initialization, memory, decision prompts, and activity execution. An independent household survey conducted during the July 2024 Philadelphia heatwave is reserved as an external validation benchmark. Compared with an ungrounded LLM-agent baseline, the grounded model improved reconstruction of normal daily routines, increasing mean correlation with empirical activity profiles from 0.528 to 0.912 and reducing mean squared error from 0.066 to 0.008. Under heatwave conditions, the grounded model better reproduced survey-derived activity profiles, increasing mean correlation from 0.349 to 0.836 and reducing mean squared error from 0.098 to 0.012. The grounded model captured 46.4% of observed heatwave response amplitude, compared with 20.6% for the ungrounded baseline. These findings show that empirical grounding can make LLM agents more statistically credible simulators of population behavior while revealing remaining gaps in modeling human adaptation during disruptions.

papers.title: Intermittent Control Is Not Diluted Control: A Switching Effect in Artificial Agency
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive agents do not always regulate under the same timing conditions. Sometimes stabilization can begin before a disturbance has fully entered the internal state; at other times the agent can only recover after disruption has taken hold. A simple expectation is that an agent moving between these conditions should behave like a weighted average of the two fixed cases: the more time spent in reactive recovery, the greater the regulatory burden. This paper shows that expectation can fail. In a simulated adaptive agent with retained state history, at an operating point where sustained reactive control is more costly than sustained anticipatory control, intermittent access to anticipatory control reduces the mean regulatory burden below the value predicted by a fixed-mode mixture. The effect appears under both periodic and stochastic switching schedules: losing anticipatory access does not simply dilute its benefit, and restoring it intermittently can reorganize the later regulatory burden. High-statistics runs (N = 1000 matched replicates per schedule) resolve a negative nonlinear switching penalty across every tested schedule. The effect is small but consistent: about half a percent of the mean gain, with 63-68% of replicates falling below zero. Late-window diagnostics reveal no unresolved upward accumulation of regulatory burden. The result identifies a design-relevant timing principle. In history-dependent adaptive systems, the burden of remaining organized is not set only by how much time an agent spends in each mode; the order in which disturbance and recovery enter the state can change the subsequent burden. Intermittent anticipatory control may therefore act less like a partial failure of regulation than like a mechanism for reducing the long-term burden of recovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过模拟实验证明，在具有状态历史保留的自适应代理中，间歇性地获得预期控制（anticipatory control）实际上可以降低平均调节负担，而非简单地介于持续预期控制和持续反应控制之间。这一效应在周期性和随机切换调度下均存在，尽管效应较小（约0.5%的平均增益），但统计上显著且一致（63-68%的重复实验显示负的切换惩罚）。论文提出了一种与时间顺序相关的设计原理：在历史依赖的适应系统中，调节负担不仅取决于各模式的时间分配，还取决于扰动与恢复进入状态的顺序。
Motivation: 现有观点认为，代理在不同时间调节条件（如预期控制与反应控制）之间切换时，其行为应类似于两种固定情况的加权平均，即反应控制时间越多，调节负担越重。本文质疑这一直观预期，并试图揭示切换本身是否会产生非平均效应。
Method: 使用一个具有保留状态历史的模拟自适应代理，在持续反应控制成本高于持续预期控制的工作点附近，引入间歇性的预期控制访问，并在周期性和随机切换调度下进行高统计量实验（N=1000），测量平均调节负担与固定模式混合的预测值之间的偏差。
Result: 实验发现，间歇性预期控制导致平均调节负担低于固定模式混合的预测值，产生负的非线性切换惩罚，效应大小约为0.5%的平均增益，且63-68%的重复实验显示负值。晚期诊断未发现调节负担的累积上升。
Conclusion: 在历史依赖的自适应系统中，调节负担不仅取决于各控制模式的时间占比，还取决于扰动与恢复进入状态的顺序。间歇性预期控制可视为一种降低长期恢复负担的机制，而非简单的部分失效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Abliteration Is Not a Scalpel: Off-Target Effects of Refusal Removal on Decision Disposition Across Model Families
papers.abstract_en: Abliteration - deleting a model's refusal direction from its weights - is the standard recipe behind popular "uncensored" open-weight models. We show the surgery is not clean. As a disposition probe we use 21,600 decisions under uncertainty - weekly up/down calls on 60 Warsaw Stock Exchange equities over 18 weeks, replayed through a frozen pipeline so the decision-layer model is the only variable. The task elicits no refusals at all, so any between-arm delta is pure side effect. Holding provenance constant (official BF16 checkpoints, a single abliteration author, an identical serving stack, one byte-identical frozen prompt), we compare base and abliterated arms of two Mixture-of-Experts families, Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507. Three effects replicate across both families (weeks-clustered bootstrap CIs excluding zero): abliterated models are systematically more optimistic (+12.2 pp Gemma, +7.4 pp Qwen; the confirmed preregistered endpoint), justify themselves at greater length, and use fewer explicit uncertainty words in forced self-critiques (both exploratory). A fourth effect reverses sign: the same operation makes Gemma-abliterated less confident and Qwen-abliterated more (family CIs non-overlapping) - one weight surgery, opposite shifts in expressed confidence. Capability covariates rule out instruction-following degradation as the driver, and no arm shows economic skill: the apparent edge of abliterated arms is regime beta, not alpha. Our provenance audit also caught two independent contamination channels - a mismatched-quantizer pilot pair and a stale community chat template that silently mangled the rendered prompt - suggesting toolchain artifacts are the rule in studies of community-modified checkpoints. Whoever deploys an "uncensored" model as an agent is deploying a measurably different decision-maker, not the base model minus refusals.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Preregistered. Data and code: https://github.com/oleczek/paper-abliteration-not-a-scalpel ; dataset DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21314839
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究删除大型语言模型中的‘拒绝方向’（abliteration）对模型决策倾向的副作用。通过在华沙证券交易所60只股票上重复21,600次周度涨跌判断实验（该任务本身不触发任何拒绝），发现去除拒绝方向后的模型在多个方面发生系统性改变：更乐观、输出更长、自我批评中不确定性词汇更少，且置信度变化方向因模型家族而异；同时，模型并未获得经济技能。研究还揭示了社区修改模型工具链中的污染问题。
Motivation: 标准‘无审查’开放权重模型通常通过删除模型的拒绝方向来获得，但这种操作是否仅移除拒绝行为而保持其他决策不变尚不清楚。
Method: 设计一个不触发拒绝行为的决策任务（股票涨跌判断），固定所有变量（提示、服务栈等），比较原始模型与abliterate模型在决策倾向上的差异，并使用聚类bootstrap置信区间进行统计推断。
Result: Abliterate模型在两个模型家族上均表现出更乐观（+12.2pp Gemma，+7.4pp Qwen）、输出更长、自我批评中不确定性词汇更少；置信度变化方向相反（Gemma降低，Qwen升高）；未发现经济技能提升。
Conclusion: 删除拒绝方向并非干净操作，它会不可预测地改变模型的决策倾向，部署‘无审查’模型相当于部署一个不同的决策者，而非原始模型去掉拒绝。

papers.title: Decoder-Preserving Sparse Autoencoders: Which Readouts Survive Sparse Compression?
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) compress model activations into sparse codes, but equal reconstruction error and sparsity can preserve different linearly decodable signals. We formalize this ambiguity as a matrix-valued distortion between optimal ridge-prediction operators and train decoder-preserving SAEs by combining this distortion with reconstruction loss. In a rank relaxation, an isotropic task prior saturates per-mode omission costs without changing PCA's ordering, whereas a structured prior can change which modes are retained. A controlled sparse experiment shows that a declared prior protects held-out combinations from its task subspace. On GPT-2 small block 8, DPSAE reduces held-out decoder distortion by 10.6--11.4% across three paired runs while matching reconstruction NMSE. The same checkpoints pass an average natural-text output-KL noninferiority test, but one matched Pythia pair shows no improvement in probes restricted to a few sparse features. These results show that reconstruction quality does not determine which refitted linear readouts survive sparse compression, and that readout preservation is distinct from learning cleaner benchmark concepts or preserving every frozen-model behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了稀疏自编码器（SAE）在压缩模型激活时，不同线性可解码信号可能被保留或丢失的歧义性。作者形式化了一个矩阵值失真度量，并训练了保持解码器的SAE（DPSAE），通过结合该失真与重建损失。在GPT-2 small block 8上，DPSAE将保留的解码器失真降低了10.6-11.4%，同时匹配重建NMSE，但自然文本KL散度非劣性测试通过，而某些探测任务未见改进。结果表明重建质量并不决定哪些线性读出来保留在稀疏压缩中。
Motivation: 现有的稀疏自编码器在压缩激活时，相同的重建误差和稀疏度可能保留不同的线性可解码信号，这种歧义性未被充分研究。
Method: 提出解码器保持的稀疏自编码器（DPSAE），将矩阵值失真（最优岭回归预测算子之间的差异）与重建损失结合训练。通过秩松弛引入各向同性任务先验或结构化先验来改变保留模式。
Result: 在GPT-2 small block 8上，DPSAE将保留的解码器失真降低10.6-11.4%（三个配对运行），同时匹配重建NMSE。自然文本输出KL散度非劣性测试通过，但一个匹配的Pythia对在仅保留少量稀疏特征的探针上未显示改进。
Conclusion: 重建质量并不能决定哪些线性读出来在稀疏压缩中被保留；读出的保留不同于学习更清晰的基准概念或保留冻结模型的每个行为。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TimeLens2: Generalist Video Temporal Grounding with Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can describe what happens in a video, but rarely identify when the supporting evidence occurs. We study generalist video temporal grounding, in which one model predicts a variable-cardinality set of evidence intervals across video lengths, domains, query forms, and viewpoints. Existing training strategies are misaligned with this set-valued task: long-video labels often rely on brittle one-pass annotation, while reinforcement-learning rewards either fail to distinguish non-overlapping predictions or require fragile segment matching. TimeLens2 treats temporal evidence as an interval set throughout supervision and optimization. TimeLens2-93K constructs reliable multi-span supervision through caption-derived proposals, independent localization, cross-agent consensus, semantic verification, and boundary refinement. Our temporal Wasserstein reward computes exact one-dimensional \(W_1\) between uniform distributions over merged interval supports, providing dense, matching-free feedback under unequal cardinalities and equivalent fragmentation; temporal IoU complements it with precise-overlap feedback. Across seven benchmarks, TimeLens2-2B outperforms all size-matched baselines on every benchmark, while the 4B and 8B variants achieve state-of-the-art performance, surpassing open-source models with up to 397B parameters. The 2B, 4B, and 8B variants improve over their Qwen3-VL backbones by 14.2, 13.0, and 18.1 mIoU points, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TimeLens2 是一个基于多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的视频时间定位 (temporal grounding) 通用模型，能够预测任意数量的证据区间。它通过构建包含多跨度标注的数据集 TimeLens2-93K 并使用时序 Wasserstein 奖励 (temporal Wasserstein reward) 和 IoU 奖励进行训练，在七个基准上超越所有同等规模基线，甚至优于 397B 参数的开源模型。
Motivation: 现有视频 MLLM 能描述视频内容，但无法定位相关证据的时间区间；训练策略与集合预测任务不匹配，长视频标注依赖脆弱的一次性标注，强化学习奖励无法区分不重叠预测或需要脆弱的片段匹配。
Method: 提出 TimeLens2 框架，将时间证据视为区间集合进行监督和优化；构建 TimeLens2-93K 数据集，通过字幕提案、独立定位、跨智能体共识、语义验证和边界精炼生成可靠的多跨度标注；设计时序 Wasserstein 奖励，计算合并区间支持上均匀分布之间的精确 1D W1 距离，提供稠密、无需匹配的反馈，并辅以 IoU 奖励提供精确重叠反馈。
Result: TimeLens2-2B 在所有七个基准上优于所有同等规模基线；4B 和 8B 变体达到最先进性能，超越高达 397B 参数的开源模型；2B、4B、8B 变体相对于 Qwen3-VL 骨干分别提升 14.2、13.0 和 18.1 mIoU 点。
Conclusion: TimeLens2 通过端到端的区间集合监督和时序 Wasserstein 奖励，有效实现了通用视频时间定位，在多个基准上取得显著改进。

papers.title: Kernelized Linear Attention: Breaking the Capacity Wall with Symmetric Cones
papers.abstract_en: Linear attention promises constant-time recurrent inference but degrades sharply on associative recall. We formulate attention recall as a spherical-packing problem and introduce Kernelized Linear Attention Activations (KATA), a framework whose feature maps are derived from first principles by certifying nonnegative attention weights through a self-dual homogeneous cone. Building on this observation, we show that rank-one positive semi-definite (PSD) features offer a favorable capacity--interference tradeoff. KATA recovers a parameter-free convex output gate and characterizes associative capacity through the Welch interference floor. For tolerances above this floor, KATA enlarges the state without adding parameters and admits spherical codes with exponentially many keys in the projection dimension. We implement KATA as fused Triton kernels at two operating points: a flash-attention-style forward up to ${\sim}1.6\times$ FlashAttention-2 throughput, and an exact $O(T)$ chunked-state form that reaches ${\sim}11\times$ FlashAttention-2 forward throughput at $131$k tokens. An associative scan of the first-order feature lowers the inter-chunk recurrence depth to $O(\log(T/C))$ for chunk size $C$ and averages ${\sim}2.4\times$ the throughput of a matched sequential linear-attention baseline. On long-range MQAR and repeated-key overwrite, several KATA variants outperform Gated DeltaNet, with parameter counts and state sizes reported alongside accuracy. Induction preserves near-perfect recall, while kernel benchmarks show that the maps can be implemented efficiently. KATA retains $0.985$ MQAR at a $16\times$ out-of-distribution length, approaching the softmax with roughly one quarter of the KV-cache entries. Experiments on 340M-parameter LLMs reveal a feature-dependent fluency trade-off and clarify how positional embeddings, delta rules, and decay gates interact with feature geometry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对线性注意力在关联回忆任务上的性能退化问题，提出了核化线性注意力激活函数（KATA）框架。该框架从第一原理出发，通过自对偶齐次锥（self-dual homogeneous cone）保证注意力权重非负，并证明秩一正半定（PSD）特征在容量与干扰之间取得有利权衡。KATA 实现了无参数凸输出门，并通过 Welch 干扰下界刻画关联容量。实验表明，KATA 在长距离 MQAR 和重复键覆盖任务上超过 Gated DeltaNet，并在 340M 参数 LLM 上揭示了特征相关的流畅度权衡。
Motivation: 标准线性注意力在关联回忆任务上性能严重下降，限制了其在需要精确记忆的场景（如长上下文语言模型）中的应用。
Method: 将注意力回忆建模为球填充问题，提出 KATA 框架，核心是使用自对偶齐次锥导出的特征映射来保证非负注意力权重。具体采用秩一PSD特征，并设计了融合 Triton 内核实现两种操作模式：类 FlashAttention 的前向（约 1.6 倍 FlashAttention-2 吞吐量）和精确 O(T) 分块状态形式（在 131k token 下约 11 倍吞吐量）。
Result: KATA 在长距离 MQAR 和重复键覆盖任务上优于 Gated DeltaNet；在 16 倍分布外长度下保持 0.985 MQAR，接近 softmax 注意力但仅需约 1/4 的 KV 缓存项。LLM 实验显示特征相关的流畅度权衡，且位置编码、delta 规则和衰减门与特征几何存在交互。
Conclusion: KATA 通过核化线性注意力突破了容量墙，提供了高效且可扩展的关联回忆能力，但存在特征选择对语言流畅度的影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Grounded verification of chemical and materials reasoning: detection is the bottleneck
papers.abstract_en: Large language models confabulate chemical objects (molecular formulas, space groups, formation energies) in fluent reasoning traces, concentrated on long-tail entities where confidence is least trustworthy. Deterministic, database-grounded verification can catch and repair such errors without the coverage cost of blanket retrieval; the binding constraint, we find, is detection, not repair. Our tiered verifier extracts each checkable claim, checks it against authoritative databases and physics, and feeds the reference into a gated correction loop. Across four models and 528 condition-pinned prompts, gated correction cuts committed-formula error from 22% to 4% at $3.2\times$ fewer retrievals than blanket augmentation, beating a conversational oracle. Repair succeeds wherever a flag fires (80--97%); the bottleneck is in-loop detection recall. Grounding improves the final answer only when the verifier's scope reaches the deliverable (83% to 90%), and the lift appears only where extractable long-tail error exists: absent on near-ceiling physical constants, large on isotope half-lives (11% to 0%).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型在化学和材料推理中的错误检测与修复问题，提出分级验证器（tiered verifier）从推理轨迹中提取可检查声明，与权威数据库和物理规则比对，并通过门控修正循环修复错误。实验表明，修复成功率高（80-97%），但瓶颈在于循环内检测召回率。接地验证仅在验证器范围覆盖最终输出时提升答案质量（83%到90%），且提升仅出现在长尾实体错误上。
Motivation: 大型语言模型在化学和材料推理中常产生流畅但错误的陈述（如分子式、空间群、形成能），尤其集中在长尾实体上。现有方法如全面检索成本高，需要更高效的检测与修复机制。
Method: 提出分级验证器：提取每个可检查声明，与权威数据库和物理规则比对，若触发错误则通过门控修正循环引用参考信息进行修复。与全面增强（blanket augmentation）和对话式基线对比。
Result: 在4个模型和528个条件固定提示上，门控修正将承诺公式错误从22%降至4%，检索次数比全面增强少3.2倍，优于对话式基线。修复成功率80-97%，但检测召回率是瓶颈。接地验证将最终答案从83%提升至90%，仅在长尾错误（如同位素半衰期从11%降至0%）上有效。
Conclusion: 验证化学和材料推理的瓶颈在于检测而非修复；提高检测召回率是未来关键。接地验证仅在验证范围覆盖最终输出时有效，且提升局限于长尾错误。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CORAL: Learning Amyloid Fibril Ligand Docking with Cooperative Binding Rewards
papers.abstract_en: A hallmark of neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's and Parkinson's is the aberrant aggregation of proteins into amyloid fibrils, and small molecules that selectively bind to these fibrils hold promise as diagnostics, imaging probes, and therapeutics. Predicting how such ligands bind to fibril targets, however, presents two fundamental challenges. First, resolved co-crystal structures of amyloid-ligand complexes are exceptionally scarce; even with recent advances in cryo-EM only a handful have been structurally characterized, making supervised training of docking models impractical for this target class. Second, amyloid fibrils present a binding mode fundamentally different from globular proteins: ligands intercalate into longitudinal cross-$β$ grooves and stack cooperatively along the fibril axis, a geometry that existing docking models are not designed to capture. To address these challenges, we present CORAL (COopeRative Amyloid Ligand docking), a reinforcement learning framework that trains a generative docking model to produce ligand pose distributions tailored to the cross-$β$ groove geometry. Our reward explicitly incorporates cooperative ligand-ligand stacking energy alongside protein-ligand docking affinity, directly capturing the distinctive binding geometry of amyloid fibrils. We further introduce a curated evaluation set of amyloid-ligand complexes constructed from model-generated poses validated by domain experts. Experiments on both experimentally resolved structures and this evaluation set demonstrate improved pose quality and binding affinity correlation over existing docking baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对淀粉样原纤维配体对接问题，提出了一种强化学习框架CORAL，通过合作结合奖励来训练生成对接模型，捕捉交叉β槽几何和配体-配体堆叠能量。实验表明，在实验解析结构和专家验证的评估集上，CORAL在姿态质量和结合亲和力相关性上优于现有对接基线。
Motivation: 淀粉样原纤维配体对接面临两个挑战：共晶结构稀缺使得监督训练不可行，以及现有对接模型无法处理配体在交叉β槽中的纵向插层和合作堆叠几何。
Method: 提出CORAL，一个强化学习框架，训练生成对接模型产生针对交叉β槽几何的配体姿态分布；奖励函数明确整合了配体-配体合作堆叠能量和蛋白质-配体对接亲和力。
Result: 在实验解析结构和专家验证的评估集上，CORAL在姿态质量和结合亲和力相关性上优于现有的对接基线。
Conclusion: CORAL通过明确建模合作结合模式，改善了淀粉样原纤维配体对接性能，但可能依赖于专家验证的评估集构建。

papers.title: Feature-Guided Diffusion for Non-Differentiable Inverse Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Inverse rendering is traditionally solved via differentiable renderers and gradient descent, which requires substantial problem-specific engineering and is prone to getting stuck in local minima due to ambiguities. Derivative-free approaches alleviate engineering requirements, but often heavily depend on a good problem initialization. In this work, we propose Feature-Informed Diffusion Evolution (FIDE), a fully black-box framework that requires no gradients or specific initialization: the renderer is treated as an opaque function whose only requirement is to produce images. Our key insight is feature guiding: rather than reducing each candidate rendering to a scalar loss value, we use a Vision Transformer (ViT) to extract dense visual features from it. We subsequently use these features to train a diffusion-based candidate proposal model, allowing the network to use visual cues to predict parameters that would match the target image. The candidate solutions proposed by this diffusion model are then refined in a closed loop with a CMA evolution strategy, continuously narrowing the proposal region as optimization progresses. We validate across diverse inverse problems from path tracing, vector splines, Voronoi shaders, and robotics, and demonstrate that feature-guiding substantially improves convergence over scalar-loss baselines and reliably escapes local minima where gradient-based methods stall.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出特征引导扩散进化（FIDE），一种完全黑盒的逆渲染方法，无需梯度或特定初始化。核心思想是使用Vision Transformer从渲染图像中提取密集视觉特征，训练扩散模型预测参数，再与CMA进化策略闭环优化。在路径追踪、矢量样条、Voronoi着色器和机器人等多个逆问题上验证，表明特征引导比标量损失基线显著提升收敛，并能可靠逃离梯度方法陷入的局部最小值。
Motivation: 传统逆渲染依赖可微渲染器和梯度下降，需大量工程调整且易陷入局部最小值；无导数方法虽减少工程需求，但严重依赖良好初始化。
Method: 提出FIDE框架：将渲染器视为黑盒函数，使用Vision Transformer提取候选渲染的密集视觉特征，基于这些特征训练扩散模型生成候选参数，再通过CMA进化策略在闭环中细化候选，不断缩小提案区域。
Result: 在路径追踪、矢量样条、Voronoi着色器和机器人等多种逆问题上，特征引导相比标量损失基线显著改善收敛，并能可靠逃离梯度方法停滞的局部最小值。
Conclusion: 特征引导方法能有效提升非可微逆渲染的优化性能，无需梯度或特定初始化，具有通用性。

papers.title: Efficient Sequential Evaluation of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of sequentially evaluating a new large language model (LLM) on a fixed question set using historical performance data from prior LLMs. Our goal is to construct a confidence sequence (CS) for the model's capability on this question set and to design active querying rules that shrink the CS width as quickly as possible. For CS construction, we invert a family of test supermartingales and focus on two representative approaches: a reverse information projection (RIPr)-based approach and a testing-by-betting-based approach. We first study these approaches under an oracle setting, and demonstrate the oracle optimality of the RIPr-based construction. We then propose a growth-oriented querying rule that aims to maximize the worst-case one-step expected log-increment over the endpoints of the current CS. In practice, we build these test supermartingales and the querying rule on predictions of question-level correctness learned from historical data. We then analyze the shrinkage behavior of the resulting CSs and identify two key factors that slow the shrinkage rate of CSs: accumulated prediction mismatch and the spikiness of the querying distribution. Finally, motivated by this analysis, we propose several mixture querying rules that combine growth-oriented querying, prediction refinement, and uniform exploration, trying to mitigate the effects that slow the shrinkage rate. We provide experiments comparing different querying rules for the RIPr-based and testing-by-betting-based CSs across several synthetic testing datasets. Interestingly, we observe that the simplest querying rule, uniform sampling, can sometimes outperform more adaptive querying rules for both methods.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何利用历史大语言模型（LLM）的评估数据，对一个新模型在固定问题集上的性能构造置信序列（CS），并设计主动查询规则以快速缩小CS宽度。文章分析了两种CS构造方法（基于逆信息投影RIPr和基于测试投注），提出了增长导向的查询规则，并发现均匀采样有时更优。
Motivation: 高效评估新LLM的能力需要利用历史数据，但现有方法在构造置信序列和主动查询策略上缺乏系统分析。
Method: 采用测试超鞅逆推构造CS，包括RIPr和testing-by-betting两种方法；提出增长导向查询规则，并分析影响收缩率的因素（预测偏差和查询分布尖峰），进而设计混合查询规则。
Result: 实验显示均匀采样有时优于更复杂的自适应规则，而RIPr方法在oracle设置下最优。
Conclusion: 历史预测数据能辅助构造CS，但查询规则的选择需平衡增长与探索，均匀采样在部分场景下已是强基线。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Does Super-Resolution Preserve Defect Evidence? A Low-False-Call Benchmark for Semiconductor Inspection
papers.abstract_en: Super-resolution can make inspection images appear sharper without preserving the evidence needed to detect a defect. We study this failure mode with a benchmark that separates reconstruction from detection and evaluates both at a predeclared low false-positive rate. Ten end-to-end repetitions combine independently generated line/space and contact-hole images with model training, calibration, clean controls, weak defects, and a held-out defect morphology. Every reconstruction is scored by the same local residual detector, while direct and jointly trained detectors form a separate comparison track. Reconstruction fidelity and inspection utility diverge: the two learned reconstruction models attain the highest structural similarity yet detect fewer defect pixels than bicubic interpolation in every paired repetition. A direct DeepLabV3 detector reaches $0.1984\pm0.0385$ recall at $0.000174\pm0.000084$ false-positive rate and satisfies the held-out feasibility criterion in all ten repetitions. An illustrative joint model, DPU-WaferSR, passes independent clean calibration but exceeds the held-out limit in all ten repetitions, demonstrating that calibration success does not guarantee transfer. Weak-defect recall remains near zero for every feasible method. Applying the unchanged policies to 4,591 public Carinthia-S masks further reveals large method-dependent shifts on real SEM texture. These results support a simple conclusion: super-resolution for inspection should be judged by preserved task evidence and operating-point transfer, not reconstruction quality alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过一个低假阳性率基准测试，研究了超分辨率（super-resolution）在半导体缺陷检测中是否保留缺陷证据。结果表明，超分辨率重建模型虽能提高结构相似性，但检测到的缺陷像素少于双三次插值；直接检测器在固定低假阳性率下表现更优，而联合模型虽然校准成功但无法泛化。
Motivation: 现有超分辨率方法在半导体检测中可能使图像更清晰但丢失缺陷线索，需要一种分离重建与检测的评估框架，以低假阳性率为前提量化检测效用。
Method: 设计了包含十次端到端重复实验的基准，涉及线/空间和接触孔图像、模型训练、校准、清洁对照、弱缺陷和保留缺陷形态；使用局部残差检测器评估重建，同时与直接训练和联合训练的检测器对比。
Result: 两种学习型超分辨率模型在结构相似性上最优，但每次重复中检测到的缺陷像素均少于双三次插值；直接DeepLabV3检测器在假阳性率0.000174下达到0.1984召回率，且满足保留可行性标准；联合模型DPU-WaferSR虽通过独立清洁校准，但十次重复均超出保留限制；弱缺陷召回率对所有可行方法接近零。
Conclusion: 超分辨率用于检测时应以保留任务证据和操作点转移为评判标准，而非仅依赖重建质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The PanAf-SBR Dataset: Social Behaviour Recognition for Wild Great Apes
papers.abstract_en: Behavioural shifts in wild great ape populations, particularly the breakdown of social structures, can serve as an early indicator of population decline. Automating the detection of behaviours indicative of these shifts is therefore a critical task for conservation. Several valuable datasets have recently been introduced for the automated recognition of great ape behaviour, yet few include fine-grained social behaviour annotations, and those that do are captured either in captive settings or via aerial platforms such as UAVs. We address this gap by introducing PanAf-SBR, the first wild great ape camera trap dataset annotated with social behaviours. PanAf-SBR extends PanAf500 with 100 additional videos covering 36,063 frames. These come with 81,096 annotations including bounding boxes, segmentation masks, intra-video identities, and seven social behaviour classes defined under the action giver and receiver convention of ChimpACT. We use this data together with the AlphaChimp architecture to establish the first benchmarks for fine-grained social behaviour recognition in wild great apes from camera trap footage. We further conduct bidirectional transfer learning experiments between PanAf-SBR and the captive ChimpACT dataset, finding that cross-dataset pre-training is highly beneficial for specific classes rather than of uniform benefit. Finally, we examine the role of background context by inverting the segmentation masks to suppress non-ape pixels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了 PanAf-SBR 数据集，这是第一个针对野生大猩猩的相机陷阱数据集，包含细粒度社交行为标注。数据集扩展自 PanAf500，新增 100 个视频、36,063 帧和 81,096 个标注，包括边界框、分割掩码、视频内身份和七种社交行为类别。结合 AlphaChimp 架构建立了野生大猩猩社交行为识别的基准，并进行了跨数据集迁移学习实验，发现预训练对特定类别有益而非普遍。
Motivation: 现有大猩猩行为数据集缺乏细粒度社交行为标注，且多为圈养或无人机拍摄，无法满足野外保护需求。
Method: 构建 PanAf-SBR 数据集，扩展 PanAf500 并利用 AlphaChimp 架构建立基准，通过双向迁移学习和背景上下文分析探究跨数据集预训练效果。
Result: 跨数据集预训练对特定社交行为类别高度有益，但非均匀提升；反转分割掩码抑制非大猩猩像素可分析背景影响。
Conclusion: PanAf-SBR 提供了野外大猩猩社交行为识别的首个基准，并揭示了跨数据集预训练的选择性优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CoEvoP&R: Co-Evolving Placement Objectives with Routing Feedback via Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Analytical placers rely on differentiable objective functions to guide placement, typically combining intermediate surrogate metrics such as half-perimeter wirelength (HPWL) and cell-density penalties. However, these placement-stage surrogates remain misaligned with downstream routed and timing quality. Prior work reduces this gap with human-designed terms or learned black-box surrogates, but the former requires expert retuning and the latter is difficult to explain, debug, or deploy in analytical placement flows. CoEvoP&R addresses these limitations with a large language model (LLM)-based framework that automatically evolves analytical placement objectives. At each generation, the prompt combines the restricted objective interface, baseline context, and archived prior candidates with routing-related feedback from placement, timing proxy, and routing tools. The LLM proposes readable differentiable objectives, which are embedded and validated in DREAMPlace, evaluated through a timing proxy and an actual router, and stored with their feedback to guide later generations. Across eight ChiP-Bench Nangate45 designs and three seeds, CoEvoP&R reduces post-route routed wirelength and congestion by 16.9% and 36.7%, with gains of 0.70 ns in worst negative slack and a 912 ns reduction in total negative slack magnitude over native DREAMPlace. Across eight ICCAD 2015 Superblue designs, it reduces post-route routed wirelength and congestion by 5.4% and 23.2%. Code is available at https://github.com/FCHXWH823/CoEvoP-R.git.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Corresponding author: Weihua Xiao
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoEvoP&R，一个基于大型语言模型（LLM）的框架，通过自动进化解析布局目标函数来弥合布局代理目标与下游布线质量、时序之间的差距。该方法在每个迭代中利用路由反馈（包括时序代理和实际路由器）指导 LLM 生成可读的可微目标函数，并在 DREAMPlace 中验证。在 ChiP-Bench Nangate45 设计中，该框架将布线后线长和拥塞分别降低 16.9% 和 36.7%，同时最差负松弛改善 0.70 ns，总负松弛减少 912 ns；在 ICCAD 2015 Superblue 设计中，线长和拥塞分别降低 5.4% 和 23.2%。
Motivation: 现有解析布局器使用的替代目标（如半周长线长 HPWL 和单元密度惩罚）与下游布线质量和时序不一致。人工设计新目标需要专家反复调整，而学习黑盒替代器难以解释、调试和部署到解析布局流程。
Method: 提出 CoEvoP&R 框架，在每个进化代中将布局目标接口、基线上下文和带路由反馈的先前候选组合为提示输入给 LLM。LLM 提出可读的可微目标函数，嵌入并验证于 DREAMPlace，通过时序代理和实际路由器评估，反馈存储以指导后续代。
Result: 在 ChiP-Bench Nangate45 上，布线后线长减少 16.9%，拥塞减少 36.7%，最差负松弛改善 0.70 ns，总负松弛幅度减少 912 ns。在 ICCAD 2015 Superblue 上，布线后线长减少 5.4%，拥塞减少 23.2%。
Conclusion: CoEvoP&R 通过 LLM 自动进化布局目标，有效对齐布局代理与路由反馈，改善布线后质量，同时保持可解释性，无需人工重新调整。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Automating Visual Recognition of Leprosy in Wild Chimpanzees
papers.abstract_en: Leprosy (Mycobacterium leprae) has been confirmed in wild western chimpanzees (Pan troglodytes verus) in West Africa, presenting as clear and progressive visual symptoms. Manual review of camera-trap footage at landscape scale is infeasible, motivating the need for automated screening. We present the first deep learning pipeline for wildlife leprosy detection and contribute the PanLep300 dataset of 125,670 annotated bounding-box crops across 953 tracks from 303 camera-trap videos with ecologically-motivated splits that withhold whole individuals and camera installations. We benchmark spatial (2D), temporally aggregated (2.5D), and video-based (3D) classification approaches to investigate which approach is best suited to automated leprosy detection in wild apes. We find that simple aggregation of crop-level predictions consistently matches or outperforms both learned temporal models and end-to-end video architectures -- consistent with leprosy's static cutaneous presentation. We further find that performance is suppressed when tracklets contain frames of partially visible individuals -- as commonly occurs at the start and end of a track -- and demonstrate that this can be addressed through targeted construction and aggregation strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个用于野生黑猩猩麻风病自动检测的深度学习流水线，并贡献了PanLep300数据集，包含125,670个标注边界框。通过对比空间、时间聚合和视频分类方法，发现简单聚合帧级预测优于复杂时序模型，且部分可见帧会抑制性能，可通过目标构建策略改善。
Motivation: 麻风病已在西非野生黑猩猩中确认，表现为渐进性视觉症状，但人工审查大规模相机陷阱视频不可行，亟需自动化筛查方法。
Method: 构建PanLep300数据集，基于303段相机陷阱视频提取953条轨迹，标注125,670个边界框。基准测试2D、2.5D（时间聚合）和3D视频分类方法，并分析部分可见帧的影响及缓解策略。
Result: 简单聚合帧级预测在麻风病检测上一致达到或超过学习型时序模型和端到端视频架构；部分可见帧会降低性能，但通过目标性构建和聚合策略可缓解。
Conclusion: 由于麻风病表现为静态皮肤症状，无需复杂时序建模，简单帧级预测聚合即可有效检测；数据集和基线为后续研究提供了基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Phased Development Framework Enabling Islanded Operation of Sustainable AI Data Centers With Onsite Grid-Following and Grid-Forming Energy Architectures
papers.abstract_en: As hyperscale and colocation AI data centers continue to expand, the electric grid is increasingly required to support large, concentrated loads, with individual facilities ranging from 500 MW to 2 GW. Current projections estimate that approximately 50 GW of AI data center capacity will require grid connectivity in the United States by 2030. While prior research has extensively examined the environmental and operational impacts of AI data centers, as well as their potential role as grid-interactive assets, limited attention has been given to the challenges associated with their scalable deployment through engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) processes. This manuscript addresses this gap by proposing a phased development framework for AI data center expansion. The approach is designed to enable developers to meet aggressive time-to-market objectives while navigating multi-year constraints associated with interconnection approvals and lead times associated with the procurement of component equipment. A modular construction architecture is presented, along with a detailed analysis of integrated energy systems and the role of hybrid on-site generation in supporting incremental capacity growth. Electromagnetic transient simulations (EMT) are used to evaluate system performance, demonstrating that a combination of on-site natural gas generation and grid-forming energy storage can reliably support data center operations during early and intermediate deployment phases. The study further examines the transition to full grid interconnection, including the capability of the data center to operate in islanded mode during grid disturbances. Finally, the manuscript compares grid-forming control strategies for system reconnection and restoration under varying conditions.

papers.title: Kernel Regression with Tensor Trains and Hadamard Overparameterization
papers.abstract_en: Kernel regression with tensor trains and Hadamard overparameterization (KReTTaH) is introduced as a training-data-free, interpretable, and nonparametric framework for multi-way data imputation. The imputation problem is reformulated as regression in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHS), where the tensor regression coefficients are explicitly constrained to lie on fixed-rank tensor-train (TT) manifolds and structured via Hadamard overparameterization to promote sparsity and high representational efficiency. Rather than relying on costly cross-validation, KReTTaH jointly optimizes the TT coefficient tensors and the kernel covariance matrices within a Riemannian product-manifold framework -- the former on fixed-rank TT manifolds, the latter on the manifold of positive-definite matrices -- thereby enabling automated kernel-hyperparameter selection. Numerical tests on two challenging applications -- imputation of high-dimensional functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data and recovery of missing edge flows in dynamic graphs -- demonstrate that KReTTaH consistently outperforms state-of-the-art tensor-, Bayesian-, and neural-network-based baselines in terms of modeling accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KReTTaH 框架，将张量回归系数约束在固定秩张量训练（TT）流形上，并通过 Hadamard 过参数化引入稀疏性和高表示效率，在再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中实现无训练数据、可解释的非参数多路数据插补。该方法在黎曼乘积流形框架中联合优化 TT 系数张量和核协方差矩阵，自动选择核超参数。在 fMRI 数据插补和动态图边流恢复任务上，KReTTaH 在建模精度上持续优于现有张量、贝叶斯和神经网络基线。
Motivation: 现有张量插补方法依赖交叉验证或神经网络，缺乏可解释性或需要大量训练数据。本文旨在提供一种无训练数据、可解释且高效的多路数据插补方法。
Method: 将插补问题转化为 RKHS 中的回归问题，显式约束回归系数位于固定秩 TT 流形上，并通过 Hadamard 过参数化结构化系数以促进稀疏性。采用黎曼乘积流形框架，联合优化 TT 系数（在固定秩 TT 流形上）和核协方差矩阵（在正定矩阵流形上），实现自动核超参数选择。
Result: 在 fMRI 数据插补和动态图边流恢复两个挑战性应用中，KReTTaH 在建模精度上持续优于现有张量、贝叶斯和神经网络基线。
Conclusion: KReTTaH 提供了一种无训练数据、可解释的高维数据插补方案，并展示了在神经科学和动态图分析中的潜力。

papers.title: Mathematical Discovery in the Wild: AI-Guided Proofs in Banach Space Theory
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the capacity of current language models to contribute to mathematical research. In Banach space theory, AI systems generated key ideas and proofs for five new results, which were then verified and refined by humans. We also developed an automated system that searches the literature for open problems and attempts solutions at scale. Our results show both the potential of language models for mathematical discovery and the continuing importance of expert verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型在数学研究中的能力，在Banach空间理论中，AI生成了五个新结果的思路和证明，由人类验证和改进。还开发了自动搜索开放问题并尝试大规模求解的系统。结果表明语言模型在数学发现中具有潜力，但专家验证仍至关重要。
Motivation: 探索当前语言模型能否为数学研究做出实质性贡献，特别是在Banach空间理论这一具体领域。
Method: 使用现有语言模型生成关键思路和证明，然后由人类专家进行验证和精炼；同时构建自动化系统搜索文献中的开放问题并尝试大规模求解。
Result: 语言模型成功协助产生了五个经过验证的新数学结果，展示了AI辅助数学发现的可行性。
Conclusion: 语言模型在数学发现中具有潜力，但专家验证环节仍然不可或缺。

papers.title: SkyVLaM: Multimodal Large Language Model for UAV Video Understanding in Remote Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly improved remote sensing (RS) multimodal understanding. Language-conditioned segmentation is crucial for fine-grained target understanding in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) videos. However, this task remains challenging due to the prevalence of small, visually ambiguous targets and dynamic aerial perspectives. In this paper, we propose SkyVLaM, a multimodal large language model for UAV video understanding. SkyVLaM constructs sparse tokens directly from patch-level video representations through a temporal basis perceiver, regularizes the sparse basis to encourage complementary temporal cues, and adaptively selects a temporally coherent dense segment for high-resolution inspection. The resulting sparse and dense tokens are jointly processed by a large language model for query-conditioned segmentation. We further build SkyVid, consisting of SkyVid-VGCG and SkyVid-RVOS for video grounded conversation generation and referring video object segmentation, respectively. SkyVid contains 101 videos, 33.6K frames, and 1.53M pixel-level object instances. Experiments show that SkyVLaM provides a more effective allocation of the visual token budget and improves language-conditioned video segmentation in UAV scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkyVLaM，一种用于无人机（UAV）视频理解的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）。通过时间基感知器从视频块表示构建稀疏令牌，并对稀疏基进行正则化以鼓励互补时间线索，同时自适应选择时间连贯的密集片段进行高分辨率检查。稀疏和密集令牌由大语言模型联合处理，实现查询条件分割。还构建了包含101个视频、33.6K帧和1.53M像素级实例的SkyVid数据集。实验表明SkyVLaM在UAV场景下更有效地分配视觉令牌预算并改善语言条件视频分割。
Motivation: 无人机视频中目标小且视觉模糊，动态视角变化大，导致语言条件分割任务具有挑战性。现有方法在细粒度目标理解方面不足。
Method: 提出SkyVLaM，利用时间基感知器从视频块表示构造稀疏令牌，正则化稀疏基以获取互补时间线索，并自适应选择时间连贯的密集片段用于高分辨率处理；稀疏和密集令牌由大语言模型联合处理，实现查询条件分割。
Result: 在自建SkyVid数据集上，SkyVLaM实现了更有效的视觉令牌分配，并提升了无人机场景下语言条件视频分割的性能。
Conclusion: SkyVLaM通过稀疏与密集令牌联合处理，为无人机视频理解提供了新的多模态方法，但摘要未提及局限性。

papers.title: Quantifying Diversity of Thought: A Predictive Law of Weighted LLM Ensemble Lift
papers.abstract_en: This paper provides an experimentally verified formal law for calculating the uplift that diversity of thought provides in Large Language Model (LLM) ensembles. From first principles, we derive an exact decomposition of LLM ensemble lift into rescue and damage masses, which yields a compact heuristic for calculating uplift. From this we extract the metrics which predict ensemble performance: an accuracy adjusted correctness correlation, $φ_{\mathrm{adj}}$, together with the accuracy gap and collective accuracy of the pair. We test the law on 767,520 inferences from ten open-weight models over two graduate-level science benchmarks, together with a novel agentic cybersecurity benchmark in which each model conducts digital-forensics investigations by multi-turn tool use in a network-isolated sandbox (23,520 graded trials including abstentions); all votes are released openly. Calibrated once on SuperGPQA at a 40:60 vote split, the heuristic predicts lift on the calibration set with Spearman's $ρ=0.84$ and, with its coefficients frozen, transfers to two datasets never used in calibration ($ρ=0.51$ on GPQA Diamond and $0.84$ on the forensic tasks), whilst the measured swap mass tracks realised lift with $R^2\ge 0.96$ throughout. Raw $φ$ has almost no predictive power ($R^2\le 0.09$ throughout); the accuracy-adjusted $φ_{\mathrm{adj}}$ is markedly superior ($R^2=0.67$ on SuperGPQA), and the heuristic combining these metrics is the most stable pre pooling predictor across the three datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从第一性原理推导了加权LLM集成提升的精确分解，将其分为救援质量和损害质量，并得到一个紧凑的启发式公式用于预测集成性能。通过767,520次推理（涉及十个开放权重模型、两个研究生级科学基准和一个新型网络安全基准）验证了该定律。经过一次校准后，启发式公式在未见过的数据集上仍能良好迁移，Spearman相关系数最高达0.84。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏一个经过实验验证的形式化定律来量化LLM集成中思维多样性带来的提升，导致难以预测不同模型组合的集成效果。
Method: 从第一性原理推导集成提升的分解，定义校正调整后的正确性相关性φ_adj及其与准确率差距和集体准确率的组合，形成启发式预测公式。
Result: 在SuperGPQA上校准后，启发式公式在校准集上Spearman ρ=0.84，冻结系数后转移到GPQA Diamond（ρ=0.51）和取证任务（ρ=0.84），且交换质量追踪实际提升的R²≥0.96。原始φ几乎无预测能力（R²≤0.09），而φ_adj显著更优（R²=0.67），组合指标最为稳定。
Conclusion: 本文提出的形式化定律和启发式公式能有效预测LLM集成的提升幅度，校正相关性指标优于原始相关性指标，且具有跨数据集的可迁移性。

papers.title: Team DACTYL at PAN 2026: Bayesian Data Mixing and Empirical X-risk Minimization for AI-text Detection
papers.abstract_en: Existing research shows that AI-generated text detection classifiers achieve strong in-distribution (ID) performance but do not maintain the same performance on out-of-distribution (OOD) texts, suggesting overfitting to dataset-specific features. However, combining different training datasets doesn't always improve performance and, in some cases, can even encourage shortcut learning. To address this issue, we fine-tune BERT-tiny models with Bayesian classification heads to select texts across three different datasets to use as a consolidated training set. We trained three different classifiers: fine-tuned DeBERTa-V3-large and ModernBERT-large classifiers via empirical X-risk minimization, and an MCGrad model that calibrates the predictions from the ModernBERT-large classifier. The DeBERTa-V3-large-large classifier achieves a mean score of 0.882 on the PAN 2026 test set across five metrics: AUROC, $F_1$, C@1, Brier score, and $F_{0.5u}$. ModernBERT-large achieves a score of 0.96 while MCGrad achieves the best score of the three with a mean score of 0.974, ranking second on the leaderboard. Our results highlight that careful dataset curation can lead to strong OOD performance. We release our ModernBERT-large and DeBERTa-V3-large models at https://huggingface.co/collections/ShantanuT01/panclef-2026 .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文针对AI生成文本检测中分布外泛化性能差的问题，提出通过贝叶斯分类头选择数据集进行混合训练，并训练了三种分类器。最好的模型MCGrad在PAN 2026测试集上平均得分0.974，排名第二。结果表明精心挑选数据集可提升分布外性能。
Motivation: 现有AI文本检测分类器在分布外数据上性能下降，简单混合数据集可能鼓励捷径学习。
Method: 使用贝叶斯分类头微调BERT-tiny模型来选择三个不同数据集中的文本构成统一训练集；然后训练DeBERTa-V3-large和ModernBERT-large分类器（经验X风险最小化）以及MCGrad模型对ModernBERT-large预测进行校准。
Result: MCGrad在PAN 2026测试集上平均得分0.974（指标包括AUROC, F1, C@1, Brier score, F0.5u），ModernBERT-large得分0.96，DeBERTa-V3-large得分0.882。
Conclusion: 强调数据集精心选择可带来强分布外性能。

summary_sections.result: MCGrad在PAN 2026测试集上平均得分0.974（指标包括AUROC, F1, C@1, Brier score, F0.5u），ModernBERT-large得分0.96，DeBERTa-V3-large得分0.882。
summary_sections.conclusion: 强调数据集精心选择可带来强分布外性能。

papers.title: Econometrics with Pre-Trained Embeddings for Unstructured Data
papers.abstract_en: Unstructured data, such as images and text, are increasingly used in empirical economics. Since training machine-learning models on unstructured data is costly, economists often use off-the-shelf pre-trained deep learning models developed by computer scientists to extract embeddings, which are then used as covariates in target economic analyses. Despite the popularity of this practice, its theoretical foundations remain limited. There are two main difficulties. First, the pre-trained model is usually trained on a different dataset and for a different task. Consequently, it is unclear when such a model can be used reliably for the target task. Second, the embedding function is subject to an identification problem, which makes it difficult to analyze the estimation error of the embedding function and its effect on the target task. In this paper, we provide sufficient conditions to overcome these difficulties and derive the convergence rate of machine learning models with pre-trained embeddings. We illustrate the theory through double machine learning applications for estimating parameters of interest, such as partially linear regression with unstructured controls, price elasticity in demand estimation considering the product quality measured by images and text, missing data imputation with unstructured data, and the average treatment effect with unstructured confounders.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为将预训练嵌入（pre-trained embeddings）用于非结构化数据的经济计量分析提供理论支撑。作者解决了预训练模型与目标任务数据分布不同以及嵌入函数存在识别问题这两大难点，给出了嵌入估计的收敛速率，并将其应用于双重机器学习（double machine learning）框架下的部分线性回归、需求弹性估计、缺失数据插补及平均处理效应等场景。
Motivation: 非结构化数据（图像、文本）在经济计量中日益常见，但直接训练模型成本高昂，所以研究者常用现成的预训练深度学习模型提取嵌入作为协变量。然而，该做法缺乏理论基础，尤其不清楚预训练模型在目标任务上的可靠性，以及嵌入函数的估计误差如何影响最终推断。
Method: 提出了一套充分条件，使得在预训练嵌入函数存在识别问题且源任务与目标任务不一致时，仍能推导出估计量的收敛速率。具体结合双重机器学习框架，将嵌入作为第一阶段的估计量，并分析其对第二阶段参数估计的影响。
Result: 给出了预训练嵌入用于非结构化数据时，目标参数估计的收敛速率理论结果；并通过部分线性回归、需求弹性（含图像/文本质量）、缺失数据插补及非结构混淆变量下的平均处理效应等例子演示了理论的应用。
Conclusion: 该工作为经济计量学中广泛使用的预训练嵌入方法建立了正式的理论基础，证明了在合适条件下即使预训练任务与目标不同，嵌入估计仍可保持一致和快速收敛。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Chebyshev Manifold Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: The paper presents a new parameter-efficient adaptation method called ChebyMA (Chebyshev Manifold Adaptation). ChebyMA adopts weight matrices through a multi-surface superposition of Chebyshev polynomial bases evaluated on learnable coordinates and combined via trainable coefficient matrices, replacing standard linear projections with highly expressive continuous function approximation. Theoretically, we establish an Approximation Expressivity Theorem, proving from the perspective of function approximation theory that single-manifold ChebyMA guarantees convergence in Frobenius norm error of reconstruction. Besides, drawing on Kolmogorov $n$-width intuition, we demonstrate the expressive advantages of multi-manifold superposition ($S > 1$) in decoupling high-dimensional complex features. Experimental results on Computer Vision CIFAR datasets(CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100)\cite{CIFAR} and Natural Language Processing (AG News, SST-2) datasets demonstrate that ChebyMA consistently achieves a superior parameter-accuracy Pareto front compared to standard full-parameter fine-tuning, LoRA\cite{LoRA}, TLoRA\cite{TLoRA}, and StelLA\cite{StelLA}. ChebyMA significantly outperforms other tested methods in tested datasets, validating its solid theoretical foundation for generality with purely vectorized computations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的参数高效微调方法 ChebyMA，利用切比雪夫多项式基的多曲面叠加来替代标准线性投影，在 CIFAR 和 AG News、SST-2 等数据集上取得了优于全参数微调和 LoRA 等方法的参数-准确率帕累托前沿。
Motivation: 现有参数高效微调方法（如 LoRA）表达能力有限，难以在极低参数量下逼近全参数微调的性能。
Method: ChebyMA 将权重矩阵参数化为可学习坐标上切比雪夫多项式基的多曲面叠加，通过可训练系数矩阵组合，实现高表达连续函数逼近。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10/100、AG News、SST-2 上，ChebyMA 在相同参数量下取得比全参数微调、LoRA、TLoRA、StelLA 更优的准确率，且完全基于向量化计算。
Conclusion: ChebyMA 提供了一种具有理论保证（逼近表达性定理、Kolmogorov n-宽度分析）的参数高效微调新范式，在多个视觉和语言任务上验证了有效性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Taurus: Accelerating Out-of-Core Graph Neural Network Inference on Billion-Scale Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Network (GNN) inference on billion-scale graphs is challenging due to the large memory footprint of features and embeddings and high disk I/O costs in out-of-core settings. Existing distributed GNN systems incur high communication times and infrastructure costs, while disk-based GNN systems are primarily tailored to training and experience massive wasted reads during inference on the entire graph. We present Taurus, a single-machine system for GNN inference on graphs that do not fit in RAM, supporting both \textit{exact} full-graph inference and fanout-sampled inference. To avoid random and repeated feature gathers, Taurus reformulates layer-wise inference as source-centric broadcasts over sequential SSD scans, backed by a pipelined GPU-CPU-SSD hierarchy, topology-aware reordering, pending-message eviction, and a GPU-resident store for high-degree vertices. It further uses non-buffered sequential reads and GPU-backed writes to reduce page-cache pollution, host-memory pressure, and write overheads. On out-of-core graphs with up to $269M$ vertices, $4B$ edges, and $514$ GiB of features, Taurus outperforms the strongest layer-wise baseline, DGI, by $7$-$25\times$, and vertex-wise baselines by $40$-$140\times$.
papers.comment: Extended full-length version of paper that appeared at HPDC 2026: "ATLAS: Efficient Out-of-Core Inference for Billion-Scale Graph Neural Networks", Pranjal Naman and Yogesh Simmhan, in the 35th ACM International Symposium on High-Performance Parallel and Distributed Computing (HPDC), 2026. DOI: https://doi.org/10.1145/3806645.3807597
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Taurus，一个单机系统，用于处理无法装入 RAM 的十亿级图上的 GNN 推理。通过将逐层推理重新表述为源中心广播、顺序 SSD 扫描以及流水线化的 GPU-CPU-SSD 层次结构，避免了随机重复的特征收集。在 2.69 亿顶点、40 亿边、514 GiB 特征的大图上，Taurus 比最强逐层基线 DGI 快 7-25 倍，比逐顶点基线快 40-140 倍。
Motivation: 十亿级图 GNN 推理面临特征和嵌入内存占用大以及外存环境下高磁盘 I/O 开销的问题。现有分布式系统通信开销高，基于磁盘的系统主要针对训练，在推理时存在大量浪费读取。
Method: 提出单机系统 Taurus，支持精确全图推理和扇出采样推理。其方法包括：将逐层推理重构为基于顺序 SSD 扫描的源中心广播；使用流水线化的 GPU-CPU-SSD 层次结构；拓扑感知重排序；待处理消息逐出；高顶点度的 GPU 驻留存储；非缓冲顺序读取和 GPU 支持的写入以减少页面缓存污染、主机内存压力和写入开销。
Result: 在包含 2.69 亿顶点、40 亿边、514 GiB 特征的外存图上，Taurus 比最强逐层基线 DGI 快 7-25 倍，比逐顶点基线快 40-140 倍。
Conclusion: Taurus 证明了单机外存 GNN 推理可以达到远超现有系统的性能，尤其适合无法装入内存的十亿级图。

papers.title: Stringological sequence prediction II: Right-to-left automaticity and related complexity measures
papers.abstract_en: In a previous paper, we began the study of sequence prediction algorithms adapted to stringological word complexity measures. One measure we considered was left-to-right (most-significant-digit-first) automaticity. Here, we show a statistically and computationally efficient algorithm adapted to the ``dual'' right-to-left (least-significant-digit-first) automaticity, which turns out to be substantially different for our purpose. We also demonstrate a prediction algorithm for a more expressive measure that we call ``arithmetic repetition complexity''. In particular, the latter can be used for predicting the so-called mix-automatic sequences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文延续前作，研究字符串序列预测算法，重点针对右到左自动性（least-significant-digit-first automaticity）的统计与计算高效预测算法，并扩展至算术重复复杂度（arithmetic repetition complexity），后者可用于预测混合自动序列。
Motivation: 前作研究了左到右自动性，本文旨在填补右到左自动性在序列预测中的空白，并探索更复杂的度量如算术重复复杂度。
Method: 提出针对右到左自动性（least-significant-digit-first automaticity）的预测算法，以及针对算术重复复杂度的预测算法。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 右到左自动性在预测上下文中与左到右自动性本质不同；算术重复复杂度能用于预测混合自动序列。

papers.title: Self-Modifying Lean Proof Agents with Verifier-Grounded Benchmark Coevolution
papers.abstract_en: Designing effective Lean proof agents is a central challenge in formal mathematical reasoning. Beyond building stronger provers, recent work emphasizes the workflow around Lean: how an agent decomposes proof obligations, uses tools and compiler feedback, diagnoses failures, repairs proofs, and maintains structured proof context. Motivated by code-level self-evolving agents, we study whether such workflows can be evolved rather than hand-designed. We present a self-evolving Lean proof agent in which a small fixed, trusted runtime wraps a fully mutable workspace: the proof workflow, prompts, and tools. Unlike most self-evolving systems, which optimize against a fixed external benchmark, our system coevolves the agent and its benchmark. Between generations, the highest-scoring agent (the champion) revises the active task distribution through a mastery-throttled curriculum update that introduces harder proof obligations only after the current level is mastered, and a single-anchor recalibration re-runs the champion on the updated benchmark to keep scores comparable as difficulty rises. All evolution stays inside a Lean-grounded verification loop: however the agent rewrites itself, a success counts only when its behavior yields Lean-verified proofs under a trusted snapshot, and each attempt must emit a machine-readable, Lean-grounded proof context whose representation may evolve but whose groundedness is enforced. We run the coevolving trajectory and a fixed-benchmark baseline for 15 active generations and compare them on a held-out miniF2F test split. The best coevolving agent reaches a 45.1% held-out solve rate, versus 12.7% for the seed and 32.0% for the best fixed-benchmark agent, showing that verifier-grounded self-evolution can improve Lean proof workflows under a coevolving benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自我进化的Lean证明代理，其工作流、提示和工具在固定运行时包裹下完全可变，并采用验证器可验证的基准协同进化策略。经过15代进化，最佳代理在held-out miniF2F测试集上达到45.1%的解决率，显著高于固定基准的32.0%和初始种子的12.7%。
Motivation: 现有Lean证明代理的工作流通常手工设计，本文探索能否使这些工作流自动进化而非手工设计，以提高形式化数学推理的效率。
Method: 提出一个自我进化的Lean证明代理，由一个小的固定可信运行时包裹完全可变的工作空间（工作流、提示、工具）。采用基准协同进化：每一代冠军通过掌握阈值课程更新调整任务分布，并使用单锚重新校准保持分数可比。所有进化均在Lean验证循环内进行，成功需要产生经Lean验证的证明。
Result: 15代进化后，最佳协同进化代理在held-out miniF2F测试集上达到45.1%解决率，种子为12.7%，固定基准最佳为32.0%。
Conclusion: 验证器基础的自我进化能够在协同进化基准下有效改进Lean证明工作流。

papers.title: DeeperRadar: End-to-End MIMO Radar Design and Multi-Modal Fusion for Autonomous Vehicle Perception
papers.abstract_en: DeeperRadar is a radar-centric, sensor-stack-conditioned framework that co-designs radar sensing and multi-modal 3D detection for autonomous mobility by learning a sparse acquisition pattern end-to-end with the fusion model. A learnable MIMO design module is trained end-to-end within a fusion network that operates directly on raw radar ADC data together with camera images and LiDAR point clouds. During training, the design module is supervised by the other sensors, enabling the system to learn both which receiver antennas to activate and the effective number of them. At deployment, the design module is removed and replaced by the learned sparse subsampling mask, leaving the downstream model architecture unchanged. Evaluated on the RADIal dataset, DeeperRadar discovers sparse, task-aware radar configurations that match or exceed full-array baselines while using fewer receivers, potentially reducing radar cost and integration complexity. These results show that learned optimal MIMO radar design depends on the fusion stack and the downstream perception task.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DeeperRadar，一个以雷达为中心的端到端框架，联合设计MIMO雷达感知与多模态融合模型，通过学习稀疏采集模式减少接收器数量。在RADIal数据集上，该方法用更少接收器达到或超过全阵列基线，表明最佳MIMO设计依赖于传感器融合栈和下游任务。
Motivation: 现有MIMO雷达设计常独立于感知任务，导致冗余硬件和成本；需要联合优化雷达采集模式与下游3D检测以实现效率与性能的平衡。
Method: 设计一个可学习的MIMO模块，与基于原始ADC数据的融合网络端到端训练，受相机和LiDAR监督；训练后模块被替换为静态稀疏掩码，不改变推理时模型结构。
Result: 在RADIal数据集上，DeeperRadar发现的任务感知稀疏配置在匹配或超越全阵列性能的同时，使用更少接收器，降低雷达成本和集成复杂度。
Conclusion: 论文强调学习的最优MIMO雷达设计依赖于融合传感器栈和具体感知任务，而非独立优化。

papers.title: A multiverse-consensus pipeline for reproducible feature selection in untargeted LC-MS metabolomics
papers.abstract_en: Background: Untargeted LC-MS metabolomics requires a long chain of preprocessing decisions, each with several equally defensible options. Analysts typically commit to one pipeline and report the resulting feature shortlist. How strongly that shortlist depends on choices that were never varied stays invisible. Results: We adapt multiverse analysis to untargeted metabolomics feature selection. We present an auditable, configuration-driven pipeline that (i) applies a ten-stage quality-control filter cascade in which every feature's fate is logged, and (ii) runs the downstream analysis as a multiverse over four contrasting preprocessing philosophies, each combined with four feature-ranking methods under bootstrap stability selection and label-permutation testing. Only features recurring across paths enter a tiered consensus. On a demonstration dataset of five breast-cancer cell lines (30,370 detected features), the four single pipelines individually returned shortlists of 4-20 features whose pairwise agreement was as low as Jaccard = 0.05. The multiverse consensus retained 15 features (>=2/4 paths), of which one recurred across all four, although two paths (sharing normalization and drift-correction methods) dominate the consensus. A pipeline-wide label-permutation test found no false discoveries in 50 null permutations. Conclusions: Reporting only preprocessing-robust features, with a complete kept/dropped audit trail, converts hidden analytical degrees of freedom into an explicit, inspectable output. We discuss scope and limitations, including single-batch design and the need for independent validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非靶向LC-MS代谢组学中特征选择的可重复性问题，提出了一个多宇宙一致性管道（multiverse-consensus pipeline）。该管道通过十阶段质量控制过滤级联、四种预处理哲学与四种特征排序方法的组合，以及bootstrap稳定性和标签置换检验，仅保留跨路径一致的特征。在五种乳腺癌细胞系的演示数据集（30,370个检测到的特征）上，单个管道返回的候选特征列表（4-20个）之间Jaccard相似度低至0.05，而多宇宙一致性保留了15个特征（≥2/4路径），其中1个在所有四个路径中重现。管道级标签置换检验在50次零置换中未发现假阳性。
Motivation: 非靶向LC-MS代谢组学中，预处理决策的每个环节都有多种合理选项，但分析者通常只报告单一管道的结果，其短列表对未变动的选择依赖性不可见，导致特征选择的可重复性差。
Method: 提出一个可审计、配置驱动的管道：（i）十级质量控制过滤级联，记录每个特征的命运；（ii）将下游分析运行为一个多宇宙，涵盖四种对比的预处理哲学，每种与四种特征排序方法结合，并采用bootstrap稳定性选择和标签置换检验。仅跨路径重复的特征进入分层一致性。
Result: 在五种乳腺癌细胞系数据集上，四个单管道的特征短列表（4-20个）间Jaccard相似度低至0.05；多宇宙一致性保留了15个特征（≥2/4路径），其中1个在所有四个路径中重现。管道级标签置换检验在50次零置换中未发现假阳性。
Conclusion: 报告仅输出预处理鲁棒的特征，并附带完整的保留/丢弃审计轨迹，将隐藏的分析自由度转化为显式可检查的输出。讨论了范围与局限性，包括单批次设计和独立验证的必要性。

papers.title: STAR: Skeletal Token Alignment and Rearrangement for Interaction Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Understanding physical human-robot and human-human interactions is a challenging yet emerging topic in 3D vision. While most existing methods rely on skeleton sequences--effective in low-light and privacy-sensitive environment--they face two major challenges: 1) learning and effectively exploiting interaction cues from skeletal data, and 2) compensating for the lack of visual information absent in skeletons alone. To address these challenges, we propose skeletal token alignment and rearrangement (STAR) for human-robot and human-human interaction recognition. It learns interaction-specific skeleton features and enriches them using visual cues by aligning skeleton and RGB video representations in a shared latent space. Specifically, STAR consists of three key components. First, we design a skeleton encoder that captures fine-grained interdependencies using Entity Rearrangement (ER) and Interactive Spatiotemporal Tokens (ISTs). Second, we present Visual Interaction Encoding that introduces a Focus on Interactions (FoI) strategy to attend to spatiotemporal regions relevant to interactions in RGB videos. Finally, these representations are aligned via a contrastive learning objective, with a refinement head further refines predictions. During training, STAR leverages both skeleton and RGB video data to learn robust, discriminative interaction representations. At inference time, it operates on skeletons alone, retaining visual-informed benefits while preserving skeleton-only efficiency. Extensive experiments on Chico, HARPER, NTU Mutual 11 and 26 datasets consistently validate our approach by demonstrating superior performance over state-of-the-art methods. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Necolizer/STAR.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (IEEE TMM)

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出骨架 Token 对齐和重排 (STAR) 方法，用于人体-机器人和人体-人体交互识别。它通过对比学习 (contrastive learning) 对齐骨架和 RGB 视频表示，在训练时利用两种模态，推理时仅使用骨架，在 Chico、HARPER、NTU Mutual 11/26 等数据集上取得最优性能。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖骨架序列，但难以有效学习交互线索并补偿缺乏视觉信息的问题。
Method: 提出 STAR 框架，包括骨架编码器（实体重排和交互时空 Token）、视觉交互编码（关注交互的时空区域）、以及对比学习对齐两个模态，推理时仅用骨架。
Result: 在 Chico、HARPER、NTU Mutual 11/26 数据集上超越现有方法。
Conclusion: STAR 在保持骨架效率的同时，利用视觉信息增强表示，适用于交互识别。

papers.title: Understanding From Human Perspective: A Multi-agent System for Interactive Egocentric Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Interactive egocentric medical image segmentation (IEMIS) plays an important role in smart-glasses-assisted medical image review, segmenting the medical targets a clinician refers to from their egocentric view. Once it succeeds, the object-level visual evidence it provides strengthens the review and underpins fine-grained analysis and clinical decision-making. However, the instruction and the video both come from the user's egocentric perspective, which poses two challenges. (1) Semantic ambiguity leaves the model unable to confirm the user-intended target. (2) Visual variability makes the segmentation jump from frame to frame. In this paper, we propose EgoMed-Agent, a multi-agent system that understands the target from the human perspective through two workflows. (1) The \textit{Target Confirmation Workflow} grounds the instruction against candidate targets with a reliability score, confirming the target when the grounding is reliable and asking the user to clarify when it is not, thereby confirming the segmentation target. (2) The \textit{Localization-Guided Propagation Workflow} couples mask propagation with per-frame target localization, using the localized target to correct the propagated mask whenever the two diverge, so the segmentation stays on the target across the egocentric video. Extensive experiments show that EgoMed-Agent reaches 71.34\% average Dice, far above the best text-prompted baseline (11.70\%). Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/wdyyyyyy/EgoMed-Agent}{our project page}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EgoMed-Agent，一个面向交互式自我中心医疗图像分割（IEMIS）的多智能体系统。该系统通过目标确认工作流和定位引导传播工作流，解决从用户自我中心视角的语义歧义和视觉变化问题。实验表明，在平均Dice上达到71.34%，远超文本提示基线（11.70%）。
Motivation: 现有方法在处理来自用户自我中心视角的指令和视频时，面临语义歧义（模型无法确认用户意图目标）和视觉变化（分割在帧间跳跃）两大挑战。
Method: EgoMed-Agent包含两个工作流：（1）目标确认工作流：将指令与候选目标通过可靠性分数进行匹配，可靠时确认目标，否则请求用户澄清；（2）定位引导传播工作流：将掩码传播与每帧目标定位耦合，当两者出现偏差时用定位结果纠正传播掩码。
Result: 在自我中心医疗视频分割任务上，EgoMed-Agent的平均Dice达到71.34%，显著优于最佳文本提示基线（11.70%）。
Conclusion: EgoMed-Agent通过多智能体协作有效处理了自我中心视角下的语义模糊和视觉变化问题，为智能眼镜辅助的医疗图像审核提供了可靠的交互式分割方案。

papers.title: Orthogonal Knowledge Refreshing for Domain-Incremental Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Domain-incremental object detection (DIOD) requires models to continually adapt to new domains while preserving prior knowledge. Recently, parameter-efficient fine-tuning offers a promising avenue, wherein a pre-trained model is frozen and a small number of learnable parameters are injected for downstream tasks. However, these methods risk overwriting critical past knowledge, triggering inter-domain interference and performance degradation. To address this challenge, we propose Orthogonal Knowledge Refreshing (OKR), a simple yet effective framework for DIOD. OKR incrementally constructs independent domain-specific subspaces via dedicated low-rank branches for each domain, which are seamlessly fused for a holistic decision, enabling conflict-free capacity expansion without domain selection during inference. To minimize knowledge interference during fusion, we present a gradient-based orthogonal refreshing strategy that projects gradient updates of new domains onto the orthogonal complement of the fused historical subspace, supporting continual adaptation without forgetting. Moreover, to mitigate semantic fragmentation across domains, we enforce topology-aware consistency, aligning the semantic structures of old and new domains. Extensive experiments validate the superiority of OKR, outperforming the best exemplar-free method by significant margins of +5.6% and +6.5% mAP on the Pascal VOC and BDD100K series, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对域增量目标检测（DIOD）中灾难性遗忘问题，提出正交知识刷新（OKR）框架。OKR通过为每个域构建独立的低秩子空间，并采用基于梯度的正交刷新策略将新域梯度投影到历史子空间的正交补上，实现无冲突的持续适应。此外，引入拓扑感知一致性来对齐新旧域的语义结构。实验表明，在Pascal VOC和BDD100K系列上，OKR相比最优无样本方法分别提升+5.6%和+6.5% mAP。
Motivation: 参数高效微调方法在DIOD中虽能适配新域，但可能覆盖关键旧知识，导致域间干扰和性能下降。现有方法缺乏对域间知识干扰的有效控制。
Method: 提出OKR框架：1) 为每个域独立构建低秩分支，形成域特定子空间；2) 推理时无缝融合实现无选择决策；3) 采用梯度正交刷新策略，将新域梯度投影到历史子空间正交补上，防止遗忘；4) 引入拓扑感知一致性损失，对齐新旧域语义结构。
Result: 在Pascal VOC和BDD100K系列上，OKR超越所有无样本方法，分别超出最佳方法+5.6%和+6.5% mAP。
Conclusion: OKR通过正交子空间和梯度投影有效缓解域增量检测中的知识干扰，保持持续学习能力，且无需域选择。

papers.title: When Drift Detectors cry Wolf: False Alarm Rates in continuous ML Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Drift detection is a core component of production machine learning monitoring systems, where detectors are used to compare incoming data with a reference distribution and trigger alerts when changes occur. However, these detectors are often evaluated in research settings that emphasize detection accuracy under synthetic shifts, while overlooking false alarms under continuous monitoring. In production environments, models are monitored repeatedly over time and across many features, and even small false positive rates can accumulate into frequent alerts, leading to alarm fatigue. We empirically analyze false positive behavior across five commonly used drift detectors: PSI, KS, MMD, LSDD, and adversarial validation. Consistent with existing literature, PSI exhibits strong sensitivity to batch size, producing frequent false alarms at small sample sizes; however, we further observe that its behavior stabilizes and improves substantially once batch sizes exceed approximately 200 samples. In contrast, KS, MMD, and LSDD display persistent fluctuations across batch sizes, while remaining comparatively more reliable than PSI in low-data regimes. Applying a Bonferroni correction reduces false positive rates, but often at the cost of reduced true positive sensitivity, reinforcing the well-known stability - sensitivity trade-off in drift detection. This work provides a systematic comparison of false positive behavior across multiple drift detectors under continuous monitoring conditions. We identify tradeoffs across detector families and provide practical guidelines for selecting and calibrating drift detectors in production ML systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了持续监控场景下五种漂移检测器（PSI, KS, MMD, LSDD, 对抗验证）的假阳性行为，发现PSI在小批量时假报警频繁，但批量超过200后显著改善；KS, MMD, LSDD在低数据量下更可靠但仍有波动；Bonferroni校正降低假阳性率但牺牲真阳性率，揭示了漂移检测中稳定性与敏感性的权衡。
Motivation: 生产环境中的ML监控系统会反复检测大量特征，即使小假阳性率也会累积成频繁警报导致警报疲劳，而现有研究多关注合成漂移下的检测精度，忽视了持续监控下的假阳性问题。
Method: 对PSI、KS、MMD、LSDD和对抗验证五种漂移检测器进行实证分析，在不同批量大小下测量假阳性率，并应用Bonferroni校正考察其对假阳性率和真阳性率的影响。
Result: PSI在小批量（<200）时假阳性率高，批量增大后稳定改善；KS、MMD、LSDD在低数据量下更可靠但存在持续波动；Bonferroni校正降低假阳性率但以真阳性率下降为代价。
Conclusion: 提供了持续监控下漂移检测器假阳性行为的系统比较，识别了不同检测器族之间的权衡，为生产ML系统中漂移检测器的选择和校准提供了实用指南。
