papers.title: Agentic ERP: Multi-Agent Large Language Model Architecture for Autonomous Enterprise Resource Planning
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems record transactions reliably but still delegate almost all operational decision-making to human specialists, because classical rule-based automation cannot reason about exceptions and monolithic AI assistants degrade when asked to coordinate across functional boundaries. This paper presents Agentic ERP, an expert-system architecture that combines role-aligned large-language-model (LLM) agents with a risk-tiered human-in-the-loop harness and a graph-based orchestrator to execute end-to-end business workflows on a production ERP backend. First, autonomous ERP operation is formulated as a constrained sequential-decision problem over a structured enterprise state, with a decomposition argument linking role-aligned agents to a measurable reduction in per-step tool-selection complexity. Second, a graph-based Planner--Executor--Reflector--Responder orchestration decouples generation from evaluation through externalised grading criteria and sprint contracts, packaging recent harness-engineering principles as inspectable expert-system artefacts. Third, the system is evaluated at three levels: a scenario-based task suite, a comprehensive comparison of six orchestration paradigms on cross-functional crisis tasks, and a 365-day agent-in-the-loop simulation against rule-based RPA and no-intervention baselines. Across these levels the proposed multi-agent method is significantly better than the baseline, and the system sustains a simulated year of operation with zero stockouts while the rule-based baseline accumulates hundreds under the same demand stream. The work shows that role-aligned LLM agents under human oversight can move an ERP system from passively recording transactions to actively executing operational decisions, and it provides a reference architecture and an evaluation protocol for autonomous enterprise resource planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Agentic ERP架构，将角色对齐的大语言模型智能体、风险分层的有人参与机制和基于图的编排器结合，在真实ERP后端上执行端到端业务流程。通过将自主ERP操作建模为结构化企业状态上的约束序列决策问题，并采用图化Planner-Executor-Reflector-Responder编排，在场景任务、跨职能危机任务比较和365天模拟中，多智能体方法显著优于基于规则的RPA和无干预基线，实现了零缺货而规则基线累积数百缺货。
Motivation: 传统ERP系统依赖人工决策，因为基于规则的自动化无法处理异常，单一AI助手在跨功能边界协调时效果不佳。
Method: 提出角色对齐的LLM智能体、风险分层的有人参与机制、图化编排（Planner-Executor-Reflector-Responder），将自主ERP操作形式化为约束序列决策问题，并通过分解论证降低每步工具选择复杂度。
Result: 在365天模拟中，多智能体方法实现零缺货，而基于规则的RPA基线在同需求流下累积数百缺货；在多种任务范式比较中也显著优于基线。
Conclusion: 角色对齐的LLM智能体在人类监督下可使ERP系统从被动记录交易转向主动执行运营决策，并提供了自主ERP的参考架构和评估协议。

papers.title: MIS-HCC: Hierarchical Channel Clustering for Efficient Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Medical image segmentation models require both high accuracy and lightweight design to accommodate real-world medical applications. The deployment of these models on resource-limited medical platforms remains a significant challenge due to their high computational and parameter requirements. Existing pruning methods for model compression mostly overlook the intrinsic connections and similarity between the internal structures of complex deep neural networks. As a result, compressed models may not effectively retain the basic features of the pretrained network. To solve this problem, we propose a hierarchical clustering compression method for medical image segmentation models (MIS-HCC). This approach employs hierarchical clustering to partition channels and fuse their parameters efficiently. Specifically, it leverages the Wasserstein distance to represent similarity of channels within layers of pre-trained network, forming a similarity matrix that guides the clustering process. Channels within each cluster are then fused to produce a compressed network. Experimental results on three medical image datasets application demonstrate that MIS-HCC outperforms the state-of-the-art methods in both accuracy and compression efficiency, offering an effective solution for deploying medical image segmentation models on resource-limited medical platforms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于层次聚类的医学图像分割模型压缩方法 (MIS-HCC)。该方法利用 Wasserstein 距离衡量预训练网络层内通道间的相似性，构建相似性矩阵指导层次聚类，进而融合聚类内的通道参数，得到轻量化网络。实验表明，该方法在三个医学图像数据集上相比现有剪枝方法实现了更高的准确率和压缩效率，有助于在资源受限的医疗平台上部署分割模型。
Motivation: 现有模型压缩方法（如剪枝）大多忽略深度神经网络内部结构的固有连接与相似性，导致压缩模型难以有效保留预训练网络的基本特征，影响精度。
Method: 提出层次聚类压缩方法：首先计算各层通道间的 Wasserstein 距离作为相似性度量，形成相似性矩阵；然后据此对通道进行层次聚类，将每个聚类内的通道参数融合，得到紧凑的压缩网络。
Result: 在三个医学图像数据集上，MIS-HCC 在分割精度和压缩效率（参数量/计算量）上均优于当前最优方法。
Conclusion: 该方法为资源受限医疗平台上的模型部署提供了兼顾精度与轻量化的有效方案。

papers.title: Interpreting Quantum Learning Models via Stochastic Processes
papers.abstract_en: Quantum machine learning models define probabilistic input--output maps through coherent quantum evolution and measurement. While such models can exhibit computational advantages, their internal functioning and decision making generally resists interpretation in terms of stochastic trajectories through intermediate configurations. In contrast to classical (Markovian) stochastic processes, quantum dynamics generically violates the Chapman--Kolmogorov divisibility condition, preventing a decomposition into probabilistically meaningful intermediate transitions. We develop a probabilistic framework for representing quantum learning models as stochastic processes over configuration spaces where the dynamics are modeled as linear maps on probability distributions. Starting from a fixed POVM, arbitrary quantum channels induce transition kernels on the associated probability representation. For informationally complete POVMs, and in particular SIC-POVMs, these kernels are Markovian but generally quasi-stochastic, with non-classicality appearing as negativity. By contrast, projective spaces admit positive stochastic kernels but generally require non-Markovian dynamics due to the failure of Chapman--Kolmogorov divisibility. This yields a trade-off between negativity and dependence on past configurations, i.e. quantum dynamics can be represented either by Markovian quasi-stochastic maps or by positive stochastic processes with higher Markov order. We discuss how such representations of quantum dynamics can be interpreted as stochastic walks through a memory space in the spirit of Projective Simulation, a model of learning and agency in which decisions arise from random walks over an episodic memory network. We further outline how finite-order stochastic kernels can approximate such quantum deliberation processes and show in what regimes the classical machine learning model is recovered.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对量子机器学习模型内部决策过程难以解释的问题，提出一个将量子学习模型表示为配置空间上随机过程的概率框架。通过固定POVM，任意量子通道可诱导出转移核；信息完备POVM下的核是马尔可夫但准随机的（负性体现非经典性），而投影空间下的核是正随机但非马尔可夫的（违反Chapman-Kolmogorov可分解性）。该框架与Projective Simulation模型中的记忆空间随机游走具有联系，并讨论了高阶随机核如何近似量子 deliberation 并恢复经典机器学习模型。
Motivation: 量子机器学习模型通过相干量子演化定义概率输入-输出映射，但其内部决策过程难以用经典随机轨迹解释，因为量子动力学通常违反Chapman-Kolmogorov可分解性条件，无法分解为概率上有意义的中间转移。
Method: 从固定的POVM（Positive Operator-Valued Measure）出发，将任意量子通道表示为概率表示上的线性映射，从而诱导出转移核。分别研究信息完备POVM（特别是SIC-POVM）得到马尔可夫但准随机的核，以及投影空间得到正随机但非马尔可夫的核。
Result: 揭示了量子动力学表示中的权衡：要么使用马尔可夫准随机映射（含负数概率），要么使用正随机过程但需要更高马尔可夫阶。
Conclusion: 该表示可类比为Projective Simulation中的记忆空间随机游走，高阶随机核能近似量子决策过程，并在一定条件下恢复经典机器学习模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking the Suitability of Reinforcement Learning Algorithms Under Practical Transfer Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Transfer-oriented reinforcement learning requires evaluating algorithms along dimensions that go beyond standard sample efficiency. We focus on two dimensions: practical efficiency, which asks whether conclusions about algorithm suitability change under wall-clock rather than interaction-based budgets, and robustness under dynamics mismatch, which asks how different learning paradigms respond to variability in the training distribution induced by domain randomization. We provide two insights to reinforcement-learning practitioners. First, comparing the sample efficiency of different algorithms is often an insufficient criterion in transfer-oriented settings. The wall-clock time required to train a decent policy is an important consideration for practitioners, and we find that the sample-inefficient PPO algorithm can produce a performant policy faster than relatively more sample-efficient algorithms such as SAC and TD-MPC2, validating the common understanding of massively parallel training paradigms. Second, domain randomization can help different kinds of algorithms learn robust policies. In particular, although PPO, SAC, and TD-MPC2 represent different RL paradigms - on-policy, off-policy, and model-based learning and planning, respectively - we find that domain randomization affects all three algorithms in a similar way. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first controlled comparison of the effect of domain-randomization coverage on PPO, SAC, and TD-MPC2 under the same transfer protocol. Taken together, these two insights highlight the importance of evaluating RL algorithms not only by sample efficiency, but also by practical considerations such as training time and the algorithms' ability to produce usable policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视强化学习算法在迁移约束下的适用性，强调除了样本效率外还应考虑实际效率（墙钟时间）和对动力学不匹配的鲁棒性。实验发现，在迁移场景下，样本效率较低的PPO算法能在更短墙钟时间内训练出有效策略，而领域随机化对PPO、SAC和TD-MPC2三种不同范式算法的影响相似。这是首次在相同迁移协议下系统比较领域随机化覆盖对这三种算法的影响。
Motivation: 现有的强化学习评估大多关注样本效率，但在迁移场景下，实际部署需要考虑训练耗时和算法对训练分布变化的鲁棒性。作者认为仅凭样本效率不足以判断算法适用性。
Method: 通过实验对比三种代表性算法（on-policy的PPO、off-policy的SAC和基于模型的TD-MPC2），在相同迁移协议下评估其墙钟时间效率和不同领域随机化覆盖下的鲁棒性。
Result: 样本效率低的PPO在墙钟时间内能更快获得可用的策略；领域随机化对三种算法的影响方式类似，并未因学习范式不同而产生显著差异。
Conclusion: 迁移强化学习的评估应综合考虑样本效率、训练时间以及算法产生可用策略的能力，而非仅依赖样本效率指标。

papers.title: From Perception to Assistance: Open-Vocabulary Shared Autonomy for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Teleoperating a robotic manipulator in industrial environments demands precision that camera-based interfaces alone struggle to deliver. The operator must align the end-effector with a target in clutter, under limited depth perception, and without colliding with the surrounding structures. This paper presents a shared-autonomy framework that assists the operator throughout this process. A single RGB-D camera captures the operator's arm motion and hand gestures without wearables, fiducials, or a calibration stage. The intended target is specified by a free-form text prompt, grounded by a vision-language model in the robot's gripper camera, and tracked across its onboard cameras by a promptable video-segmentation model, resulting in a grasp frame continuously separated from the obstacle map. Every commanded motion is executed by a GPU-accelerated model-predictive controller that enforces self- and environment-collision avoidance against an online volumetric reconstruction, while a potential field corrects the operator's reference toward the grounded target during the final approach. An autonomous mode can be gesture-triggered to complete the grasp on the same target without a separate perception pipeline. The framework is validated on a quadruped mobile manipulator. The interface achieves a positional RMSE of 59 mm relative to motion-capture ground truth, and the controller keeps the arm at least 18 cm from obstacles while the operator deliberately commands the arm into them by 6 cm. In an industrial valve manipulation and a pick-and-place task, the full framework succeeded in all trials, while ablating either the collision or the assistance module produced failures through complementary mechanisms, and autonomous execution succeeded in four of five trials per task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于RGB-D相机的开放词汇共享自主框架，用于机器人操作任务。操作者通过手臂动作和手势控制机械臂，利用视觉语言模型根据自由文本提示识别目标，并通过提示视频分割模型跟踪目标，模型预测控制器实现碰撞避免，势场在最终接近时校正操作者参考。自主模式可通过手势触发完成抓取。在四足移动机械臂上验证，相比运动捕捉系统位置RMSE为59mm，控制器保持机械臂离障碍物至少18cm。在工业阀门操作和拾取放置任务中全框架成功，消融碰撞或辅助模块则失败。
Motivation: 远程操作机器人机械臂在工业环境中面临精度挑战，基于摄像头的界面难以提供足够的深度感知和碰撞避免能力。
Method: 提出共享自主框架，包括：单RGB-D摄像头无标记手势和手臂运动捕捉；视觉语言模型根据文本提示定位目标；提示视频分割模型跟踪目标；GPU加速模型预测控制器实现自碰撞和环境碰撞避免；势场在最终接近时引导操作者；自主模式可手势触发完成抓取。

papers.title: TAPAS: Throughput-adaptive Perception for Autonomous Systems
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous systems rely on a perception module to navigate through dynamic environments. In real-world scenarios, the perception module's throughput requirements vary at runtime due to changes in scene complexity. However, existing perception strategies assume a fixed FPS and static model-to-cluster mapping, resulting in either over/under provision of throughput requirements or unnecessary energy consumption across diverse scenes. Addressing this challenge requires tightly coupled \textit{scene complexity awareness} to estimate an appropriate FPS target and \textit{dynamic model-to-cluster mapping} to deliver the required throughput at minimum energy. We propose a throughput-adaptive perception strategy for mobile/edge platforms, enabling intelligent runtime resource allocation based on varying FPS targets. We use Reinforcement Learning (RL) with RRM (Reward Reasoning Model) and a GRU (Gated Recurrent Unit) agent to orchestrate perception tasks across heterogeneous mobile/edge platforms. We evaluate TAPAS on Jetson Orin NX across KITTI and unseen nuScenes. On the \textit{KITTI} dataset's test sequences, TAPAS achieves 93-100% throughput met rate while saving energy by 76%. On the unseen \textit{nuScenes} dataset, TAPAS maintains 97% throughput met rate with 64% lower energy compared to \textit{SOTA} approaches, proving its robustness.
papers.comment: 15 Pages, 20 Figures, Accepted at ACM/IEEE International Conference on Codesign of Embedded Systems at Embedded Systems Week (ESWEEK-CODES), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TAPAS，一种面向自主系统的吞吐自适应感知策略，利用强化学习（RL）与GRU智能体在移动/边缘平台上动态分配资源，根据场景复杂度调整FPS目标，实现模型到集群的动态映射。在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，TAPAS达到了高吞吐满足率并显著节省能耗。
Motivation: 现有感知策略固定FPS和静态模型-集群映射，导致吞吐量过度或不足及能耗浪费，无法适应运行时场景复杂度的变化。
Method: 提出吞吐自适应感知策略，使用强化学习中的RRM（Reward Reasoning Model）和GRU（Gated Recurrent Unit）智能体协调异构移动/边缘平台上的感知任务，实现基于场景复杂度的FPS目标估计和动态模型-集群映射。
Result: 在Jetson Orin NX上，TAPAS在KITTI测试序列上达到93-100%的吞吐满足率，能耗降低76%；在未见过的nuScenes数据集上，吞吐满足率97%，能耗比SOTA低64%。
Conclusion: TAPAS证明了场景复杂度感知和动态映射的有效性，能够兼顾吞吐要求和能效，适用于资源受限的移动/边缘平台。

papers.title: Rationalizing Boltzmann Rationality: An Axiomatic Characterization of Entropy-Regularized Policies
papers.abstract_en: The softmax policy $π(a \mid s) \propto \exp(βQ(s,a))$ is the default model of stochastic choice in reinforcement learning (RL). Various justifications based on robustness, exploration, and optimization have been offered in the RL literature, but none uniquely derives the softmax form from first principles. This leaves a basic tension unresolved: the entropy bonus in the soft Bellman equation violates the Independence axiom that underwrites the Markov decision process (MDP) reward structure. We dissolve this tension by distinguishing two kinds of randomness: chance and choice. By restricting von Neumann-Morgenstern (VNM) Independence to environmental lotteries over base prospects, we show that imposing independence of irrelevant alternatives (IIA) and monotonicity on the policy and value functions at choice nodes uniquely determines the Boltzmann policy, the entropy-regularized representation, and the soft Bellman equation. The choice between the soft and hard Bellman equations thus reduces to a design decision: whether the agent values its own ability to choose. We develop RL-specific consequences, including return monotonicity and convergence under generalized discounting, and synthesize the independent lines from economics and information theory that arrive at the same structure, offering a normative assessment of when IIA is appropriate for agent design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: softmax策略是强化学习中的默认随机选择模型，但缺乏从第一性原理的唯一推导。本文通过区分随机性的两种类型（偶然和选择），限制von Neumann-Morgenstern独立性到基础前景的环境彩票，证明在决策节点上施加IIA和单调性唯一确定了Boltzmann策略、熵正则化表示和soft Bellman方程。soft和hard Bellman方程的选择归结为设计决策：智能体是否重视自己的选择能力。文章还发展了强化学习特定后果，包括广义贴现下的回报单调性和收敛性，并综合了经济学和信息论的独立线索。
Motivation: 现有强化学习文献中softmax策略的合理化基于鲁棒性、探索和优化，但没有从第一性原理唯一推导softmax形式，且soft Bellman方程中的熵奖励违反了支撑MDP奖励结构的独立性公理。本文旨在通过区分偶然和选择两种随机性来解决这一张力。
Method: 通过限制VNM独立性到基础前景的环境彩票，并在决策节点施加IIA和单调性，该方法唯一确定了Boltzmann策略、熵正则化表示和soft Bellman方程。
Result: 摘要宣称该方法唯一确定了这些形式，并发展了RL特定后果，包括广义贴现下的回报单调性和收敛性。
Conclusion: 本文综合了经济学和信息论的独立线索，提供了何时IIA适用于智能体设计的规范评估。

papers.title: The Optimization Trilemma: Efficiency, Comfort and Fairness in Decentralized Multi-agent Coordination
papers.abstract_en: The problem of fair multi-agent coordination in decentralized settings is one of the most pressing challenges for building efficient collaborative systems. Resource allocation is based on optimized collective arrangements accounting for agents' needs. Such coordination should not only be computationally efficient but also account for fairness, i.e., equitable redistribution of costs incurred by all agents. Recent literature has proposed several algorithms that efficiently determine optimal plan combinations balancing system-wide efficiency and individual discomfort of agents in a centralized setting. However, these works do not address equitable resource optimization in fully decentralized scenarios, specifically, the optimized redistribution of discomfort among coordinating agents so that none experiences a discomfort level that could lead to loss of incentive or polarization that can disrupt planned operations. In this work, we study the problem of optimizing three objectives: (i) system-wide efficiency, (ii) individuals' comfort and (iii) fairness (i.e., balancing of incurred discomfort costs) in decentralized multi-agent coordination. We design a novel model to optimize those three orthogonal objectives, without any substantial increase in communication and computational overhead. Through experiments on two real-world datasets, we validate the model and demonstrate that it can achieve fairer optimization outcomes, while satisfying agents' preferences and system goals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了去中心化多智能体协调中的三个优化目标：系统效率、个体舒适度和公平性（即不平衡成本再分配）。作者设计了一个新模型，在不显著增加通信和计算开销的前提下，同时优化这三个正交目标。在两个真实数据集上的实验表明，该模型能在满足个体偏好和系统目标的同时实现更公平的优化结果。
Motivation: 现有去中心化协调算法未充分解决公平的资源优化问题，特别是协调智能体之间不适成本的再分配，可能导致激励丧失或极化，破坏计划运行。
Method: 提出一个同时优化系统效率、个体舒适度和公平性的新模型，通过设计特殊的优化框架，避免了通信和计算开销的显著增加。
Result: 在两个真实数据集上的实验验证了模型的有效性，表明能在满足个体偏好和系统目标的同时实现更公平的优化结果。
Conclusion: 本文提出的模型能够在不显著增加开销的情况下平衡多智能体协调中的效率、舒适度和公平性。

papers.title: Learning-Driven Adaptive Audit Scheduling: A Sequential Decision Approach to Off-Chain Data Integrity
papers.abstract_en: We model cryptographic auditing of off-chain data as a Constrained MDP (CMDP) under partial observability: the storage node's hidden type and corruption state make the problem a POMDP, while a miss-rate ceiling rho imposes an explicit security constraint. We propose DRQN-CMDP, a Deep Recurrent Q-Network whose GRU layer maintains a belief over the latent node type, paired with Lagrangian dual ascent that adapts the miss-rate penalty lambda automatically. A pairing-free homomorphic-MAC primitive supplies O(1) on-chain verification cost. Across 13 methods--four DQN variants, PPO, A2C, PPO-Lagrangian, a stateful Bayesian heuristic, three fixed-rule baselines, and an oracle-informed heuristic--DRQN-CMDP achieves a favourable balance: 83% lower gas than fixed high-frequency auditing, single-digit miss rate (7.5%), and moderate detection latency--a combination no other method matches across all three objectives simultaneously.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对链下数据的加密审计问题，将其建模为部分可观测的约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP/POMDP），提出DRQN-CMDP方法。该方法使用深度循环Q网络（DRQN）结合GRU层维护对节点隐状态的信念，并通过拉格朗日对偶自适应调整漏检率惩罚因子。结合无配对的同态MAC实现O(1)链上验证成本。在13种基线方法中，DRQN-CMDP实现了gas消耗降低83%、漏检率仅7.5%且检测延迟适中的平衡，是唯一同时优化三个目标的方法。
Motivation: 现有链下数据审计方法难以处理存储节点类型和腐败状态的部分可观测性，同时需要满足严格的安全约束（如漏检率上限）。
Method: 提出DRQN-CMDP，利用GRU层维护对节点隐类型的信念，并使用拉格朗日对偶方法自动调整漏检率惩罚因子；搭配无配对的同态MAC实现O(1)链上验证。
Result: 在13种方法对比中，DRQN-CMDP达到gas消耗降低83%、漏检率7.5%以及中等检测延迟，三者综合最优。
Conclusion: DRQN-CMDP是首个在链下数据审计中同时实现gas、漏检率和检测延迟三者良好平衡的方法。

papers.title: WAR: Workload-Aware Rollouts for Synchronous Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon rollout generation has become the dominant systems bottleneck in agentic reinforcement learning (RL). As agents interact with environments over many turns, trajectories rapidly grow to tens of thousands of tokens, making synchronous RL training increasingly constrained by rollout. We propose WAR, a workload-aware rollout system that substantially accelerates synchronous agentic RL by jointly optimizing decoding and scheduling. WAR is built on a key observation: the optimal rollout optimization strategy depends on runtime load: (1) Under low load, WAR enables model-free speculative decoding with SuffixDecoding, which reuses suffix patterns from previously completed trajectories as speculative drafts for future rollouts. Unlike model-based drafters, SuffixDecoding introduces no additional draft model and avoids GPU contention with rollout generation. (2) Under high load, where saturated batched decoding leaves limited room for speculative speedup, WAR shifts the optimization focus to cache-aware scheduling. A global scheduler places requests across rollout replicas based on cache locality, trajectory progress and server load, reducing redundant KV-cache recomputation and mitigating load imbalance. By combining decoding-level suffix reuse with system-level rollout scheduling, WAR delivers robust throughput improvements across workload regimes without changing the underlying RL algorithm. WAR improves long-context agentic rollout throughput by 1.4x under low load and up to 1.6x under high load. These results show that WAR removes a major rollout bottleneck in synchronous agentic RL and provides a practical path toward scalable long-context agent training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WAR，一种工作负载感知的rollout系统，用于加速同步agentic强化学习中的长周期轨迹生成。WAR根据系统负载动态切换优化策略：低负载时采用无模型推测解码SuffixDecoding重用后缀模式，高负载时采用缓存感知调度减少KV-cache重计算。实验表明，WAR在低负载下提升吞吐量1.4倍，高负载下提升1.6倍，有效消除了同步agentic RL中的rollout瓶颈。
Motivation: 长周期rollout生成已成为agentic强化学习的系统瓶颈。随着agent与环境多轮交互，轨迹长度迅速增长至数万token，导致同步RL训练受限于rollout生成速度。
Method: 提出WAR，联合优化解码和调度。低负载时使用SuffixDecoding（无模型推测解码，复用已完成轨迹的后缀模式作为推测草稿）；高负载时切换至缓存感知调度（全局调度器根据缓存局部性、轨迹进度和服务负载分配请求，减少冗余KV-cache重计算并缓解负载不均）。
Result: WAR在低负载下将长上下文agentic rollout吞吐量提升1.4倍，在高负载下提升1.6倍。
Conclusion: WAR在不改变底层RL算法的情况下，消除了同步agentic RL中的主要rollout瓶颈，为可扩展的长上下文agent训练提供了实用路径。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出WAR，一种工作负载感知的rollout系统，用于加速同步agentic强化学习中的长周期轨迹生成。WAR根据系统负载动态切换优化策略：低负载时采用无模型推测解码SuffixDecoding重用后缀模式，高负载时采用缓存感知调度减少KV-cache重计算。实验表明，WAR在低负载下提升吞吐量1.4倍，高负载下提升1.6倍，有效消除了同步agentic RL中的rollout瓶颈。
summary_sections.motivation: 长周期rollout生成已成为agentic强化学习的系统瓶颈。随着agent与环境多轮交互，轨迹长度迅速增长至数万token，导致同步RL训练受限于rollout生成速度。
summary_sections.method: 提出WAR，联合优化解码和调度。低负载时使用SuffixDecoding（无模型推测解码，复用已完成轨迹的后缀模式作为推测草稿）；高负载时切换至缓存感知调度（全局调度器根据缓存局部性、轨迹进度和服务负载分配请求，减少冗余KV-cache重计算并缓解负载不均）。
summary_sections.result: WAR在低负载下将长上下文agentic rollout吞吐量提升1.4倍，在高负载下提升1.6倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: WAR在不改变底层RL算法的情况下，消除了同步agentic RL中的主要rollout瓶颈，为可扩展的长上下文agent训练提供了实用路径。

papers.title: DRNOISE: Benchmarking Deep Research Agents in Misleading Evidence Environments
papers.abstract_en: Deep research agents increasingly operate over the open web, where relevant records coexist with redundant summaries, outdated reports, and misleading documents. Existing evaluations offer limited insight into whether agents preserve sound evidential standards when an ordinary-looking false document is deliberately seeded into a searchable environment and offers a direct shortcut to a conflicting answer. We introduce DRNOISE, a 100-task benchmark for answer recovery under misleading evidence. Each task has a unique gold answer supported by two corroborating indirect record chains; the paired noisy condition adds one plausible document that states a conflicting answer directly. The benchmark spans ten families of evidence operations. Across agents with strong clean-task performance, this single intervention causes 66-88 percentage-point accuracy drops. Trace analyses identify verification inertia as the dominant failure mode: agents often retrieve truthful records but stop before completing and reconciling the evidence chain, instead deferring to the answer-like document. Generic verification prompts reduce but do not close this gap. The setting is especially relevant to open-web deployment, where plausible falsehoods arrive through ordinary-looking pages rather than explicit attacks. Reliable deep research therefore requires more than retrieval and citation; it requires active reconciliation of direct claims with record-level evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出DRNOISE基准，包含100个任务，测试深度研究代理在存在误导性证据（一篇看似合理但直接给出矛盾答案的文档）时的答案恢复能力。单次干预导致准确率下降66-88个百分点，主要失败模式是验证惯性（代理检索到真实记录但未完成证据链的整合，而是直接采纳了看似答案的文档）。
Motivation: 现有评估无法衡量代理在开放网络环境中面对看似正常的虚假文档时能否保持可靠的证据标准，而这类情况在真实部署中极为常见。
Method: 构建100个任务，每个任务有一个真实答案，由两条间接记录链支持；并在嘈杂条件下插入一篇直接给出矛盾答案的似是而非的文档。基准涵盖十类证据操作。
Result: 在无噪条件下表现良好的代理上，单次误导干预导致准确率下降66-88个百分点。轨迹分析表明主要失败模式是验证惯性：代理检索到真实记录，但未完成证据链的整合与核对，转而采纳了类似答案的文档。通用验证提示可缩小但未消除差距。
Conclusion: 可靠深度研究需要主动整合直接声明与记录级证据，而不仅仅是检索和引用；在开放网络部署中，看似普通的虚假页面比显式攻击更具挑战性。

papers.title: Lookahead Branching for Neural Network Verification
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we investigate the effect of lookahead branching strategies in neural network verification. We present a general recipe to integrate lookahead into any branch-and-bound verifier and demonstrate how one of the current state-of-the-art branching heuristics, FSB, can be viewed as a special instantiation of the lookahead branching strategy. We also describe how, in addition to improving the quality of branching decisions, lookahead can generate additional lemmas that accelerate verification. We instantiate the method in two representative branch-and-bound-based verifiers (Marabou and $α$-$β$-CROWN), and demonstrate that lookahead leads to consistent speedups in verification time and up to $57\%$ more solved instances. Code is available at https://github.com/ai-ar-research/lookahead-branching.
papers.comment: Accepted to IJCAI 2026. Lookahead branching is part of the Marabou and $α$-$β$-CROWN verifiers
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究前向分支策略在神经网络验证中的效果，提出一种将前向集成到任何分支定界验证器中的通用方法，并展示当前最先进的分支启发式FSB可视为前向分支策略的特例。前向不仅改善分支决策质量，还能生成额外引理加速验证。在两个代表性验证器（Marabou和α-β-CROWN）上实例化该方法，验证时间一致加速，最多可多解57%的实例。
Motivation: 现有分支定界验证器中的分支启发式大多基于局部信息，缺乏对后续搜索影响的考虑，导致分支效率不高。
Method: 提出前向分支策略的通用框架，通过临时扩展搜索树并评估子问题难度来选择分支变量，同时利用前向过程生成引理。该框架可集成到任意分支定界验证器中。
Result: 在Marabou和α-β-CROWN上实现后，验证时间显著缩短，最多可额外解决57%的验证实例。
Conclusion: 前向分支是一种有效的增强策略，可提升神经网络验证器的性能，且易于集成到现有工具中。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAGA: Synthetic Agentic Graph Architecture for Temporal Benchmark Generation
papers.abstract_en: High quality temporal graph benchmarks with rich semantics and ground-truth anomaly labels are essential for training graph neural networks, yet remain scarce due to privacy constraints and annotation costs. We present SAGA (Synthetic Agentic Graph Architecture), a system for generating large-scale, semantically rich temporal graphs via a four-phase pipeline. Our Skeleton-First, Semantics-Second architecture decouples structure from semantics: (S) an O(1)-per-edge skeleton generator produces power-law graphs; (A) a dispatcher partitions causally ordered time blocks for parallel execution; (G) LLM agents inject domain semantics using RAG-based rule bases across four domains; and (A) a state alignment engine resolves conflicts via temporal replay, yielding anomaly labels as natural byproducts. Unlike structural generators (e.g., LDBC SNB, Kronecker/R-MAT) or purely LLM-based approaches, SAGA achieves structural realism, semantic richness, and automatic anomaly labeling in a unified framework. On a single H100 GPU with vLLM batching, SAGA generates 500,000 temporal edges with controlled anomalies in under 90 minutes, scaling to 100,000 nodes while maintaining clustering coefficients above 0.99. The system supports real-time pipeline visualization, interactive multi-domain tuning (Finance/AML, Network/IDS, Cyber/APT, Transportation), and a CLI for large-scale GPU-based experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SAGA系统，用于生成大规模语义丰富的时序图基准，包含四阶段流水线：O(1)骨架生成、因果时间块并行调度、LLM注入领域语义（金融/反洗钱、网络入侵检测、网络攻击、交通）、状态对齐引擎自动产生异常标签。系统在单H100 GPU上90分钟内生成50万时序边，支持10万节点且聚类系数保持0.99以上。
Motivation: 高质量时序图基准稀缺，因隐私约束和标注成本高昂，现有结构生成器或纯LLM方法难以同时满足结构真实性、语义丰富性和自动异常标注。
Method: 采用Skeleton-First, Semantics-Second架构：骨架生成器以O(1)每边复杂度产生幂律图；调度器将因果有序时间块分区并行；LLM代理基于RAG规则库注入领域语义；状态对齐引擎通过时序回放解决冲突并自动生成异常标签。
Result: 单H100 GPU配合vLLM批处理，90分钟内生成50万时序边及受控异常，可扩展至10万节点，聚类系数大于0.99。支持实时流水线可视化和多领域交互式调优。
Conclusion: SAGA在统一框架中实现了结构真实、语义丰富和自动异常标注，适用于图神经网络对时序基准的需求。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Lossless but Not Free: An Empirical Anatomy of Speculative Decoding on Consumer Hardware
papers.abstract_en: Single-stream autoregressive decoding of large language models is bound by memory bandwidth: each generated token requires one full forward pass through the target model, and successive passes cannot be parallelized. Speculative decoding restructures this computation: a small draft model proposes $K$ tokens autoregressively, the target model scores all of them in one batched pass, and a rejection-sampling rule provably preserves the target model's output distribution. We present a from-scratch, device-agnostic (CUDA/MPS/CPU) implementation and an empirical study across five draft/target backend configurations on a consumer Apple-silicon laptop. Distribution equivalence is verified at three levels, culminating in a two-sample test over roughly 9,200 real-model tokens per method ($χ^2 = 162.5$, dof $= 200$, $p = 0.976$) and exact greedy-sequence agreement. The best configuration reaches a measured $1.61\times$ wall-clock speedup at $K=6$, on an acceptance profile declining from 69.7% at $K=1$ to 37.8% at the optimum, while three of five configurations decelerate, either because the draft fails to out-speed a small target or because the quantized Metal backend executes "parallel" verification serially, an effect we isolate and quantify. The failures are as instructive as the successes: speculative decoding pays off only when verification is genuinely batch-parallel and the draft/target latency gap is real.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code, benchmark harness, and all result artifacts: https://github.com/ParamChordiya/speculative_decoding_engine
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在消费级Apple Silicon笔记本电脑上实现了推测解码（speculative decoding）的从零编写、设备无关（CUDA/MPS/CPU）的框架，并通过五个草稿/目标后端配置进行实证研究。最佳配置在K=6时达到1.61倍墙钟加速，接受率从K=1的69.7%下降到最优点的37.8%；但五分之三的配置反而减速，原因包括草稿模型不够快或量化Metal后端串行执行验证。
Motivation: 自回归解码受限于内存带宽，每个token需一次完整前向传播且无法并行化。推测解码通过小模型草稿和大模型批处理验证来重新组织计算，但其在消费级硬件上的实际性能影响因素尚需系统分析。
Method: 提出一个设备无关（CUDA/MPS/CPU）的推测解码实现，包含从零编写的草稿→验证→拒绝采样流程。在Apple Silicon笔记本上测试五种草稿/目标后端组合，通过三层次分布等价性验证（包括约9200个真实模型token的双样本检验，χ²=162.5, df=200, p=0.976）和精确贪心序列一致。
Result: 最佳配置达到1.61倍墙钟加速（K=6），接受率从K=1的69.7%降至最优K值的37.8%。三组配置减速，原因包括草稿模型相对目标模型不够快，以及量化Metal后端将并行验证串行化。
Conclusion: 推测解码只有在验证真正批并行且草稿/目标延迟差距真实时才有收益；失败案例与成功案例同样具有启示意义。

papers.title: An Iterative Geometric Approach to Optimizing Separating Hyperplanes
papers.abstract_en: Given a binary-labeled linearly separable dataset, and the objective is to compute the maximum-margin separating hyperplane, also known as the hard-margin Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier. This paper investigates whether, if given an initial separating hyperplane, can it be exploited to reach this unique optimum more efficiently. We present a geometric approach that gradually improves the alignment of the hyperplane, starting from an initial separating hyperplane, while preserving separation and continuously increasing its margin until convergence to the global optimum. At each iteration, the method considers only local information, namely the current active set, and aims to re-align the hyperplane according to the optimal separating hyperplane of this reduced subset. Consequently, the original convex quadratic optimization problem is addressed through a sequence of smaller subproblems. The paper presents the algorithm in detail, together with a preliminary experimental evaluation and several theoretical findings. The results suggest that, when an initial separating hyperplane is available, the proposed method can be competitive on larger datasets and, in some cases, can outperform state-of-the-art approaches that solve the optimization problem directly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对二分类线性可分数据集，提出一种迭代几何方法来优化最大间隔分隔超平面（即硬间隔SVM）。该方法从任意初始分隔超平面出发，通过逐步调整超平面方向并保持分离性，不断增大间隔直至收敛到全局最优。每次迭代仅考虑当前活动集，将其上的最优超平面作为调整目标，从而将原始凸二次优化问题分解为一系列更小的子问题。初步实验表明，当初始超平面可用时，该方法在大数据集上具有竞争力，有时甚至优于直接求解优化问题的现有方法。
Motivation: 给定初始分隔超平面时，能否利用它更高效地计算最大间隔超平面？现有方法通常从头优化，但初始解可提供热启动优势。
Method: 提出几何迭代算法：从初始分隔超平面开始，每步基于当前活动集（支持向量）计算该子集上的最优超平面，并据此调整全局超平面方向，同时保持对所有样本的正确分类，逐步增大间隔直至收敛。
Result: 初步实验表明，该方法在较大数据集上具有竞争力，某些情况下优于直接求解优化问题的现有方法。
Conclusion: 当初始分隔超平面可用时，所提迭代几何方法能有效求解硬间隔SVM，尤其适合大规模问题。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 初步实验表明，该方法在较大数据集上具有竞争力，某些情况下优于直接求解优化问题的现有方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 当初始分隔超平面可用时，所提迭代几何方法能有效求解硬间隔SVM，尤其适合大规模问题。

papers.title: AIGB-R1: Self-Evolving Generative Auto-Bidding via Hierarchical Planner-Executor Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Auto-bidding plays an essential role in online advertising, automatically adjusting bids for advertisers to optimize their commercial goals. The emerging AI-Generated Bidding (AIGB) paradigm widely adopts generative modeling to optimize bidding strategies, yet suffers from the limited mode coverage of offline datasets and inadequate task-state understanding, hindering effective exploration of optimal strategies. Large Language Models (LLMs), with prior world knowledge and reasoning capabilities, offer a promising approach to overcome these limitations. However, directly applying LLMs to auto-bidding tasks faces inherent challenges in limited numerical precision, hallucinations, and inference latency. To address these limitations, we propose AIGB-R1, a hierarchical self-evolving auto-bidding framework aiming to enhance AI-Generated Bidding via LLMs' Reasoning capabilities, comprising a high-level Planner module for macro-level strategy planning and a low-level Executor module for fine-grained decision-making. Building upon this, we design an experience-driven self-evolving loop, enabling autonomous strategy exploration and optimization from accumulated experience. We adopt a two-stage pipeline of offline pre-training and post-training alignment, and build an interactive bidding simulation environment for strategy rollout. Furthermore, we propose Decoupled Group Relative Policy Optimization (D-GRPO) to achieve end-to-end optimization via advantage decoupling. Experimental results on a large-scale public dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of AIGB-R1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AIGB-R1，一种分层自演化自动出价框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力增强AI生成出价（AIGB）。该框架包含高层规划器和低层执行器，通过经验驱动的自演化循环实现策略探索与优化，并采用离线预训练和后训练对齐的两阶段流程，以及解耦组相对策略优化（D-GRPO）进行端到端优化。在大型公开数据集上的实验验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有AI生成出价（AIGB）范式因离线数据集模式覆盖不足和任务状态理解不足，难以有效探索最优策略；直接应用LLM面临数值精度有限、幻觉和推理延迟等挑战。
Method: 提出分层框架：高层规划器进行宏观策略规划，低层执行器负责细粒度决策。设计经验驱动的自演化循环，结合离线预训练和后训练对齐，并构建交互式出价模拟环境。提出解耦组相对策略优化（D-GRPO），通过优势解耦实现端到端优化。
Result: 在大型公开数据集上的实验结果表明AIGB-R1的有效性，但摘要未提供具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 本文表明，通过分层规划与自演化循环结合LLM推理能力，可有效提升自动出价策略的优化效果。

papers.title: The Resolution of Causal Heterogeneity
papers.abstract_en: Causal subgroup analyses often report a small number of groups summarizing treatment effect heterogeneity, as if that number were a well-defined estimand. Outside genuinely latent class populations, however, a ``true'' subgroup count is model dependent rather than a population functional. We replace it with a new population estimand, the resolution profile, a functional of the causal feature law giving the fewest groups explaining a prescribed fraction of causal heterogeneity, defined for every population without latent structure. Inference is organized around one cross-fitted Bayesian-bootstrap posterior for a single structured moment process, its scores corrected with influence functions, so that paths, profiles, fixed-resolution summaries, and subgroup effects follow by composition. A uniform conditional Bernstein--von Mises theorem over a loss class containing the nonsmooth quantization losses shows this posterior merges with the efficient Gaussian limit under stated nuisance-rate and margin conditions. Subgroup-number uncertainty is not model selection but threshold nonregularity, the profile being an integer-valued threshold of a continuous path, discontinuous in the law at each knot. At these knots no single-valued selector is locally uniformly consistent over root-$n$ neighborhoods, and the set-valued report obtained by inverting a simultaneous band retains locally uniform validity over exactly the same perturbations. Simulations support the approximations, and an analysis of the MineThatData e-mail experiment illustrates the resolution-indexed report, in which two to three groups summarize the visit response while finer structure falls below a noise-floor diagnostic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出因果异质性的分辨率剖面（resolution profile）作为新的总体估计量，用于描述治疗效应异质性中需要最少分组数来解释特定比例异质性的函数。通过交叉拟合贝叶斯自助法（cross-fitted Bayesian bootstrap）进行推断，并证明了在损失类上的均匀条件 Bernstein–von Mises 定理。文章指出亚组数量不确定性不是模型选择问题，而是阈值非正则性，并通过集值报告保持局部均匀有效性。模拟和 MineThatData 电子邮件实验验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有的因果亚组分析通常报告少数几个总结治疗效应异质性的组，但除了真正的潜在类别总体外，亚组数量是模型依赖的而非总体泛函。需要一个不依赖潜在结构的新总体估计量来刻画因果异质性。
Method: 引入分辨率剖面作为新的总体估计量，定义为能解释给定比例因果异质性的最少组数的函数。基于交叉拟合贝叶斯自助法（cross-fitted Bayesian bootstrap）构建单个结构化矩过程的后验，并用影响函数校正得分，从而获得路径、剖面、固定分辨率摘要和亚组效应。
Result: 证明了一个在包含非光滑量化损失的损失类上的均匀条件 Bernstein–von Mises 定理，表明后验在给定的 nuisance 率和边界条件下收敛到有效高斯极限。模拟支持近似，MineThatData 电子邮件实验显示亚组数约为 2–3 个即可总结访问响应，更细结构低于噪声下限阈值。
Conclusion: 亚组数量不确定性源于阈值非正则性而非模型选择，在临界点处单值选择器在根 n 邻域内不一致，而通过反转同步带获得的集值报告在相同扰动下保持局部均匀有效性。该方法为没有潜在结构的总体提供了处理因果异质性的新框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Between Safe Boundaries: Exploiting Temporal Consistency for Jailbreaking Text-To-Video Generation Models
papers.abstract_en: Recently, text-to-video (T2V) models have been widely deployed, sparking growing concerns over their robustness against jailbreak attacks. Existing jailbreak methods, mostly adapted from text-to-image attacks, suffer notable drawbacks when applied to T2V systems. They fail to fully leverage temporal consistency, an inherent characteristic of video generation. Besides, these methods demand heavy video query optimization, which is infeasible in practical black-box scenarios. Their adversarial prompt search is also driven by heuristic local signals, lacking principled structured exploration strategies. To tackle these limitations, we propose BSB, a structured, query-efficient jailbreak framework for T2V models. BSB harnesses temporal consistency by encoding harmful intent as the transition between two individually harmless boundary states. Under this paradigm, the attack targets boundary-state pairs whose interpolation tends to produce unsafe intermediate frames during video generation. Directly evaluating all candidate pairs within the video space incurs prohibitive computation cost. Instead, BSB conducts Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) in a cheaper textual proxy space and regularly calibrates search outcomes with sparse video-level evaluations. We conduct comprehensive experiments on mainstream commercial T2V models including Veo 3.1, Sora 2, Seedance and Kling v1. Results show BSB surpasses all existing jailbreak baselines, delivering an average 18.6% relative gain in attack success rate over the strongest competitor across evaluated models. Our findings identify temporal consistency as an understudied yet vital attack surface for T2V models and verify that structured search facilitates effective vulnerability discovery under constrained query budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BSB框架，利用时间一致性对文本生成视频模型进行越狱攻击。通过编码有害意图为两个无害边界状态之间的转换，并使用蒙特卡洛树搜索在文本空间高效搜索，以最小化视频级评估成本。在Veo 3.1、Sora 2等商用模型上，BSB平均攻击成功率比最强基线高18.6%。
Motivation: 现有文本生成视频模型的越狱攻击方法未能充分利用视频生成的时间一致性，且需要大量视频查询优化，在黑盒场景下不可行，对抗性提示搜索缺乏结构化探索策略。
Method: 提出BSB框架，将有害意图编码为两个边界状态之间的插值，利用时间一致性；在文本代理空间执行蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS），并用稀疏视频级评估校准搜索结果。
Result: 在Veo 3.1、Sora 2、Seedance和Kling v1上，BSB超越所有基线，平均攻击成功率相对提升18.6%。
Conclusion: 时间一致性是T2V模型未被充分研究的攻击面，结构化搜索可在有限查询预算下有效发现漏洞。

papers.title: Node4All: Learning Node Representation Beyond Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Node representation learning has advanced rapidly, yet most existing methods rely on per-dataset training and hyperparameter tuning. This dataset-specific optimization comes from the difficulty of designing reusable graph models that generalize across diverse graph datasets. In this work, we introduce Node4All, a node representation learner applicable to arbitrary graph datasets without any dataset-specific optimization. Node4All is built on two complementary ideas. At the architectural level, we introduce the Channel Graph Transformer (CGT), which enables a single fixed parameterization to process arbitrary graph datasets. At the learning level, we propose a self-supervised learning based on a series of synthetic graphs. Together, these components enable generalization beyond individual datasets, which is infeasible with existing architectures and learning frameworks. We extensively evaluate Node4All on node classification across 25 benchmarks against 21 baselines, covering both supervised and self-supervised methods. Despite all baselines being trained and optimized for each dataset, a single Node4All, applied uniformly across the datasets, achieves a competitive ranking of 5th among 21 baselines. Moreover, Node4All supports one-shot and in-context learning with an appropriate predictor and outperforms recent graph foundation models (GFMs) in these settings. These results demonstrate that Node4All not only achieves reusability across arbitrary graph datasets, but also remains an effective solution in practice. Code and model checkpoints are available in https://github.com/dooho00/node4all.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Node4All 是一个无需数据集特定优化的节点表示学习器，通过通道图Transformer（CGT）和基于合成图的自监督学习，在25个基准上进行了评估，在21个基线中排名第5，并支持一次性学习和上下文学习。
Motivation: 现有节点表示学习方法需要针对每个数据集进行训练和超参数调优，缺乏跨不同图数据集的通用性。
Method: 提出Node4All，包含两个组件：通道图Transformer（CGT）架构，使单一固定参数化能处理任意图数据集；以及基于一系列合成图的自监督学习框架。
Result: 在25个基准上的节点分类任务中，Node4All在21个基线中排名第5（所有基线均针对每个数据集优化），并在一次性和上下文学习中优于最近的图基础模型。
Conclusion: Node4All实现了跨任意图数据集的可重用性，同时保持了实际有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An Explicit World Model Based on Data-First Ontology: DaoQL Multimodal Storage Validation and Counterfactual Reasoning Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models encode world models implicitly in neural weights, which exposes four structural risks in high-precision domains such as medicine and finance: hallucination, frozen knowledge, poor explainability, and poor modifiability. This paper proposes data-first ontology: LLMs are treated as reasoning and language engines, while deterministic knowledge is moved into an explicit multimodal database, DaoQL. We formalize an explicit world model and show that, under rule independence, deterministic evaluation, and fixed conflict resolution, explicit models provide a sufficient condition for composable counterfactual decomposability; implicit models lack atomic read/delta semantics and therefore provide no comparable architectural guarantee. The implemented system focuses on DaoQL's verified storage layer and explicit Eval path, integrating graph, column, vector, and full-text engines within one process. KVCache graph nodes, expert hot updates, and the DaoQL-Agent runtime remain future work. On an embedded same-machine setup, DaoQL reports graph BFS at 1.20 ms, HNSW at 83.1 us, and a Fluent hybrid query at 105.8 us; these results indicate engineering potential but must be interpreted with deployment-shape differences from client-server systems. Exploratory measurements on LDBC SNB SF1 and ANN-Benchmarks further show 34/34 query coverage with interactive-class queries mostly in the sub-millisecond to millisecond range, but only 1.8 QPS overall due to long-tail BI/IC queries; ANN-Benchmarks reaches Recall@10 >= 99% at thousand-level QPS after a bridge-edge protection fix. In a five-domain counterfactual experiment (n = 1250), DaoQL+GPT-4o achieves 94% composable counterfactual decomposability, 49 percentage points above GPT-4o alone. The paper explicitly separates provable structure, preliminary empirical evidence, and architectural roadmap claims.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于数据优先本体论（data-first ontology）的显式世界模型，将确定性知识存储在显式多模态数据库DaoQL中，而LLM仅作为推理与语言引擎。DaoQL集成图、列、向量和全文引擎于同一进程，实验表明在嵌入式同机设置下可实现亚毫秒级查询，并在五领域反事实实验中（n=1250）达到94%的可组合反事实可分解性，比单独GPT-4o高49个百分点。论文清晰区分了可证明的结构、初步实证证据和架构路线图声明。
Motivation: 大语言模型在医学、金融等高精度领域存在幻觉、知识冻结、可解释性差和可修改性差四个结构性风险，亟需将确定性知识从隐式神经权重中剥离到显式数据库中。
Method: 提出数据优先本体论，将LLM作为推理与语言引擎，确定性知识存入显式多模态数据库DaoQL，后者在同一进程中集成图、列、向量和全文引擎，并形式化显式世界模型及其可组合反事实可分解性的充分条件。
Result: 嵌入式同机设置下，DaoQL的图BFS为1.20 ms，HNSW为83.1 μs，Fluent混合查询为105.8 μs；LDBC SNB SF1上34/34查询覆盖，交互类查询大多在亚毫秒到毫秒范围，但总体QPS仅1.8；ANN-Benchmarks在桥边保护修复后Recall@10≥99%且QPS达千级；五领域反事实实验中DaoQL+GPT-4o可组合反事实可分解性达94%，比GPT-4o高49个百分点。
Conclusion: 显式世界模型在可组合反事实可分解性上提供了架构性保证，而隐式模型缺乏原子读取/增量语义；DaoQL展示了工程潜力，但结果需考虑部署形态差异；KVCache图节点、专家热更新和代理运行时是未来工作。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出数据优先本体论，将LLM作为推理与语言引擎，确定性知识存入显式多模态数据库DaoQL，后者在同一进程中集成图、列、向量和全文引擎，并形式化显式世界模型及其可组合反事实可分解性的充分条件。
summary_sections.result: 嵌入式同机设置下，DaoQL的图BFS为1.20 ms，HNSW为83.1 μs，Fluent混合查询为105.8 μs；LDBC SNB SF1上34/34查询覆盖，交互类查询大多在亚毫秒到毫秒范围，但总体QPS仅1.8；ANN-Benchmarks在桥边保护修复后Recall@10≥99%且QPS达千级；五领域反事实实验中DaoQL+GPT-4o可组合反事实可分解性达94%，比GPT-4o高49个百分点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 显式世界模型在可组合反事实可分解性上提供了架构性保证，而隐式模型缺乏原子读取/增量语义；DaoQL展示了工程潜力，但结果需考虑部署形态差异；KVCache图节点、专家热更新和代理运行时是未来工作。

papers.title: PACE: Polar Axis-Conditioned Estimation for PairUAV Relative Localization
papers.abstract_en: PairUAV relative localization maps two UAV images to a polar navigation command. Although heading and range share the same pairwise pose context, treating them as homogeneous coordinates forces both outputs to use the same decoder evidence and optimization state. Controlled readout probes reveal a different structure: the two axes favor different decoder-depth combinations, their best checkpoints disagree on 80.8% of a validation trajectory, and range errors exhibit a distinct high-error tail. We introduce method, Polar Axis-Conditioned Estimation, which retains a shared Reloc3r-style pair representation while assigning axis-specific readout interfaces. Heading uses mid/late relational evidence, whereas range remains attached to a direct late metric path. On the official hidden test, the strongest released raw predictor scores 0.002460; the complementary PAAER predictor scores 0.002514 with a slightly lower angle error. Deterministic challenge packaging, reported separately from learned estimation, yields the final score of 0.001874. Code, checkpoints, predictions, and reconstruction tools are available at https://github.com/zerong7777-boop/PairUAV-PACE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对双无人机相对定位中航向与距离共享同一解码器导致的不一致问题，提出极轴条件估计（PACE）方法，通过保留共享配对表示的同时为不同轴分配独立的读出接口，在官方隐藏测试中取得0.001874的最终分数。
Motivation: 现有方法将航向和距离视为齐次坐标，使得两者被迫使用相同的解码器证据和优化状态，但实验发现它们偏好不同的解码器深度，且最佳检查点在80.8%的验证轨迹上不一致，导致距离误差出现高误差尾部。
Method: PACE保留共享的Reloc3r风格配对表示，但为航向和距离设计不同的读出接口：航向使用中晚期关系证据，距离保持直接晚期度量路径。
Result: 在官方隐藏测试中，该方法的原始预测器得分为0.002460，互补的PAAER预测器得分为0.002514（角度误差略低），最终确定性挑战封装得分为0.001874。
Conclusion: 实验表明将航向与距离的估计分离可以显著改善相对定位精度，代码、检查点和预测结果已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Debate-on-Graph: Reliable and Adaptive Reasoning of Large Language Model on Uncertain Knowledge Graph
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in natural language processing. However, LLMs often suffer from hallucinations and lack of relevant knowledge when dealing with question answering (QA) tasks. To mitigate these issues, knowledge graphs (KGs) have been utilized to enhance LLM reasoning. Nevertheless, KGs often contain noise and errors, while existing KG-enhanced LLM approaches are generally unable to identify and filter such noisy and erroneous content, which can instead amplify hallucinations and pose challenges for reliable reasoning. Uncertain knowledge graphs (UKGs), which associate each triple with a confidence score to quantify uncertainty, offer a promising direction to address this challenge. Compared with prior work, we investigate how to leverage UKGs to support LLMs for QA. We propose Debate-on-Graph (DoG), a new framework that enables LLMs and UKGs to collaborate adaptively for reliable reasoning. Specifically, we first design a heuristic search algorithm tailored for UKGs to extract reliable and question-relevant subgraphs, thereby reducing noise and errors in retrieved knowledge. We then introduce a Multi-Agent Debate mechanism, which yields reliable answers through adaptive adversarial debates, aiming to fully exploit the knowledge in UKGs while preserving the reliability of retrieved evidence. Extensive experiments on four benchmark QA datasets show that DoG achieves state-of-the-art performance over existing LLM reasoning methods and KG-based baselines, while enabling reliable and adaptive reasoning. Our code is available at https://github.com/seucoin/Debate-on-Graph.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Debate-on-Graph (DoG) 框架，结合大语言模型 (LLM) 与不确定知识图谱 (UKG) 进行可靠且自适应的问答推理。通过启发式搜索提取可靠子图，并引入多智能体辩论机制处理知识不确定性，在四个基准数据集上达到最优性能。
Motivation: 知识图谱中常含噪声和错误，现有 KG 增强 LLM 方法无法有效过滤，可能放大幻觉。不确定知识图谱 (UKG) 通过置信度量化不确定性，但如何利用其支持 LLM 问答仍待探索。
Method: 提出 DoG 框架：1) 针对 UKG 设计启发式搜索算法，提取可靠且与问题相关的子图；2) 引入多智能体辩论 (Multi-Agent Debate) 机制，通过自适应对抗辩论产生可靠答案。
Result: 在四个基准 QA 数据集上，DoG 达到超越现有 LLM 推理方法和 KG 基线的性能，实现可靠且自适应的推理。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DoG 能有效利用 UKG 中的不确定性信息，提升 LLM 在问答任务中的可靠性与适应性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Coordinated Disentanglement with Iterative Mode Discovery Under Hidden Correlations
papers.abstract_en: Disentangled representation learning is a powerful paradigm for robust attribute prediction. While recent methods address attribute correlations, hidden correlations remain underexplored, where data under the value of a certain attribute exhibit underlying modes correlated with other attributes. To preserve mode information and achieve disentanglement, we jointly discover modes and enforce mode-based conditional independence. Yet, the interdependency between these two modules may lead to error amplification under naive iterations. We propose Coordinated Disentanglement with Iterative mode Discovery (CoDID), an end-to-end framework featuring a dynamic architecture that adapts to evolving number of modes, and a coordination mechanism that mitigates error amplification via meta-optimization. Empirical results demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance on diverse tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对解缠表示学习中隐藏相关性（即某一属性值下的数据内部存在与其他属性相关的模式）的挑战，提出CoDID框架。该框架通过联合发现模式并施加基于模式的条件独立性来实现解缠，并引入协调机制（元优化）减少误差放大。摘要报告在多种任务上取得最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有解缠方法处理了显式属性相关性，但隐藏相关性（数据在某一属性值下存在与其他属性相关的潜在模式）仍未充分探索，影响解缠效果和属性预测鲁棒性。
Method: 提出CoDID（Coordinated Disentanglement with Iterative mode Discovery），包含动态架构自动适应模式数量变化，以及协调机制通过元优化缓解模式发现与条件独立性约束之间的迭代误差放大。
Result: 摘要声称在多种不同任务上取得最先进性能，但未提供具体数值或基准数据集。
Conclusion: 通过协调迭代模式发现与条件独立性约束，CoDID能够有效处理隐藏相关性，实现更鲁棒的属性解缠。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Asynchronous Multimodal Diffusion Policy Composition via Latency-Aware Guidance Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion policies have shown strong potential for robotic imitation learning, and recent extensions incorporate additional modalities to improve manipulation performance. However, these modalities often differ not only in information content but also in sensing rates and inference latencies. Existing multimodal diffusion policies typically rely on synchronous fusion or manually designed multi-frequency architectures, which either slow down high-frequency feedback or limit extensibility to new modality combinations. We propose LAG-Fusion, a latency-aware guidance fusion framework for asynchronous multimodal diffusion policy composition. LAG-Fusion allows modality-specific policies to operate at their native inference rates and contribute denoising guidance whenever available. To make asynchronous composition consistent, we derive a reference-frame rebasing rule for diffusion variables under relative action representations, enabling delayed guidance to be aligned before fusion. We instantiate LAG-Fusion in contact-rich manipulation by composing a low-frequency vision policy with a high-frequency force policy. Experiments under heterogeneous modality latencies show that LAG-Fusion improves policy responsiveness and task performance over synchronous fusion and specially designed force-aware baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LAG-Fusion，一种延迟感知的引导融合框架，用于异步多模态扩散策略组合。该框架允许不同模态的策略以各自的推理速率运行，并在可用时贡献去噪引导。通过推导相对动作表示下的参考帧重定基规则，实现延迟引导的对齐融合。在接触丰富的操作任务中，组合低频视觉策略与高频力策略的实验表明，LAG-Fusion 比同步融合和专门设计的力感知基线提高了策略响应性和任务性能。
Motivation: 现有多模态扩散策略通常依赖同步融合或手动设计的多频率架构，这会减慢高频反馈或限制新模态组合的可扩展性。
Method: 提出 LAG-Fusion 框架，包含两个关键组件：1) 允许模态特定策略以原生推理速率运行并贡献异步引导；2) 推导参考帧重定基规则，用于相对动作表示下延迟引导的对齐。
Result: 实验表明，在异质模态延迟下，LAG-Fusion 比同步融合和专门的力感知基线提高了策略响应性和任务性能。
Conclusion: LAG-Fusion 提供了一种有效的方式组合不同延迟的多模态扩散策略，无需手动设计多频率架构，具有良好的可扩展性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VecFontLLM: Anchor-Guided Direct Synthesis of Chinese Vector Fonts
papers.abstract_en: Direct generation of Chinese vector fonts is a challenging and ongoing problem. A Chinese vector glyph contains complex component structure, anchor layout, and Bézier curve details, which work at different scales, but a standard vector sequence writes them together in one long sequence, making the task of vector font synthesis challenging. Existing direct vector generators often fail on complex characters, while raster-domain methods must vectorize the synthesized glyph images afterward. To address the above-mentioned problem, this paper proposes VecFontLLM, an anchor-guided multimodal large language model for direct few-shot synthesis of Chinese vector fonts. Our key idea is to generate vector glyphs through anchors rather than a standard vector sequence. Specifically, the proposed VecFontLLM first predicts and refines an anchor scaffold that fixes the coarse layout of components and contours, and then completes Bézier control points to recover local curvature and style. At test time, a confidence-guided generation chain samples multiple component candidates and continues synthesis from the highest-confidence one, improving stability for complex glyphs. This work demonstrates, for the first time, high-quality few-shot synthesis of complex Chinese vector glyphs directly in the vector domain, without raster generation or vectorization. Experiments on several Chinese font datasets show substantial improvements over existing vector font synthesis methods, competitive glyph rendering quality against raster-domain baselines, and vector command distributions close to real fonts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VecFontLLM，一种基于锚点的多模态大语言模型，用于直接生成中文矢量字体。核心思想是通过预测锚点骨架确定组件布局和轮廓，再补全贝塞尔曲线控制点以恢复局部曲率和风格，实现从少量样本直接合成复杂矢量字形。实验表明该方法在矢量域生成质量优于现有矢量字体合成方法，且与栅格域方法渲染质量相当。
Motivation: 现有直接矢量生成器对复杂汉字常失败，而栅格域方法需要后向量化。中文矢量字形包含多尺度细节，标准矢量序列统一书写使得生成困难。
Method: 采用锚点引导的多模态大语言模型：先预测并细化锚点骨架固定组件粗布局和轮廓，再生成贝塞尔控制点；测试时使用置信度引导的生成链，从最高置信度的组件候选继续合成。
Result: 在多个中文字体数据集上，直接矢量域生成质量显著优于现有矢量字体方法，渲染质量与栅格域基线相当，矢量命令分布接近真实字体。
Conclusion: 首次实现直接矢量域的高质量少样本复杂中文矢量字形合成，无需栅格生成或矢量化。

papers.title: Distilled Reinforcement Learning for LLM Post-training
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) post-training is essential for improving reasoning, adaptation, and alignment. Existing methods mainly follow two paradigms: reinforcement learning (RL) and on-policy distillation (OPD). However, RL relies on coarse-grained outcome supervision, resulting in difficult credit assignment and limited capability to acquire new knowledge. OPD, meanwhile, unconditionally matches teacher logits through KL divergence, which creates a dilemma: similar teachers provide little new knowledge, while substantially different teachers often yield ineffective guidance, largely restricting OPD to within-family distillation. We propose Distilled Reinforcement Learning (Distilled RL), which integrates teacher supervision into the RL objective to provide fine-grained guidance, selectively transfer new knowledge and avoid unconditional imitation. Distilled RL contains three components: reverse importance sampling with clipping, negative sample reset, and sequence-level geometric normalization. Through a concise and interpretable case study, we demonstrate that Distilled RL can effectively transfer previously unavailable knowledge from a teacher model to a student model. Extensive experiments across both within-family and cross-family distillation settings show that Distilled RL substantially outperforms standard RL and OPD in terms of both pass@1 and pass@k. Our code is available at https://github.com/597358816/Distilled-RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出蒸馏强化学习（Distilled RL）用于大语言模型后训练，整合教师监督到RL目标中，提供细粒度指导并选择性迁移新知识，避免无条件模仿。通过反向重要性采样、负样本重置和序列级几何归一化三个组件，在同类和跨类蒸馏场景中均优于标准RL和在线策略蒸馏。
Motivation: 现有RL依赖粗粒度结果监督导致信用分配困难且难以获取新知识；在线策略蒸馏（OPD）无条件匹配教师logits，面临相似教师无新知识、差异教师指导无效的困境，限制其仅适用于同族蒸馏。
Method: 提出蒸馏强化学习（Distilled RL），将教师监督整合到RL目标中，包含三个组件：带裁剪的反向重要性采样、负样本重置、序列级几何归一化。
Result: 通过简洁可解释的案例研究证明Distilled RL能有效迁移教师模型中先前不可用的知识；在同类和跨类蒸馏设置下的广泛实验中，pass@1和pass@k均显著优于标准RL和OPD。
Conclusion: Distilled RL通过选择性迁移教师知识而非无条件模仿，有效解决了RL和OPD的局限，提高了LLM后训练中知识迁移的效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DynImmune-BERT: Dynamic Immune Repertoire Modeling with Neural ODE Driven Continuous Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Longitudinal T cell receptor repertoires contain signals of clonal expansion, contraction, disappearance, and reappearance after immune perturbation. Static repertoire language models usually summarize a sample as a bag of sequences, so the sampling interval, sequencing depth, and clone presence pattern are only weakly represented. This paper presents DynImmune-BERT, a continuous time repertoire model for patient level immune status prediction. The method combines depth adaptive centered log ratio initialization, clone presence gated Neural ordinary differential equation dynamics, bounded neighborhood self attention, event based state restart, and a hybrid transport objective that supervises dominant and rare clone mass. A low rank meta adapter initializes reappearing clonotypes while keeping the parameter count independent of the number of observed clones. The evaluation separates literature reported baselines from internally controlled temporal comparisons, reports uncertainty for small external cohorts, adds calibration and threshold diagnostics, and visualizes latent clone trajectories and attention neighborhoods. The results indicate that event aware temporal modeling can complement strong static encoders when longitudinal repertoire structure is available, while small external cohorts and protocol differences require cautious interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DynImmune-BERT，一种用于纵向T细胞受体库建模的连续时间模型，通过神经ODE驱动连续Transformer，结合深度自适应中心化对数比初始化、克隆存在门控神经ODE动态、有界邻域自注意力、事件基状态重启和混合运输目标，用于患者水平免疫状态预测。评估显示事件感知时间建模在纵向谱结构可用时能补充强静态编码器，但小外部队列和协议差异需要谨慎解读。
Motivation: 纵向T细胞受体谱系包含克隆扩增、收缩、消失和再出现信号，但静态模型仅将样本视为序列包，弱化了采样间隔、测序深度和克隆存在模式。
Method: 结合深度自适应中心化对数比初始化、克隆存在门控神经ODE动态、有界邻域自注意力、事件基状态重启、混合运输目标监督主导和稀有克隆质量，以及低秩元适配器初始化再出现克隆型，保持参数数量与观察克隆数无关。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但表明事件感知时间建模在纵向谱结构可用时能提升预测性能，同时报告不确定性、校准和阈值诊断。
Conclusion: 事件感知时间建模可以补充强静态编码器，但小外部队列和协议差异需要谨慎解释。

papers.title: LenGuard-GPC: Length Guarding with Guided-Prompt Consistency for Spatial Reasoning Reinforce Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view spatial reasoning requires vision-language models to compare visual evidence across images, align object correspondences, and infer spatial relations over long visual contexts, a setting where chain-of-thought reasoning tends to grow verbose without becoming more accurate. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is a natural fit for this task, but standard GRPO reward relies on sparse outcome-level feedback and gives no signal about where a reasoning trajectory goes wrong, nor any control over its length. We propose LenGuard-GPC, a dense reward framework that addresses both problems together. For each sampled trajectory, it compares the token-wise predictive distributions under a standard prompt and a guided prompt, and uses the resulting token-sum KL divergence as a dense reward signal. Since this KL penalty accumulates over tokens and would otherwise reward shorter responses regardless of their quality, we introduce a staged length bonus that keeps reasoning length within a controlled range without simply encouraging brevity. On six multi-view spatial reasoning benchmarks, LenGuard-GPC improves accuracy over vanilla GRPO while reducing average response length.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LenGuard-GPC，一种用于多视角空间推理的密集奖励框架，通过引导提示一致性(token-wise KL散度)和分阶段长度奖励来改进GRPO强化学习。在六个多视角空间推理基准上，该方法提升了准确率并降低了平均响应长度。
Motivation: 标准GRPO在空间推理中仅使用稀疏结果级奖励，无法指示推理轨迹的错误位置，也无法控制推理长度。
Method: 将每个采样轨迹在标准提示和引导提示下的逐token预测分布进行KL散度比较，作为密集奖励信号；同时引入分阶段长度奖励，将推理长度控制在合理范围内。
Result: 在六个多视角空间推理基准上，相比原始GRPO提升了准确率，并减少了平均响应长度。
Conclusion: 密集奖励和长度控制可以有效提升多视角空间推理中强化学习的效率和效果。

papers.title: A Large-Scale Measurement of AI Bill of Materials Completeness in Hugging Face Models
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained machine learning (ML) models help developers build ML-intensive software systems without training models from scratch. However, model repositories often provide incomplete machine-readable documentation about model provenance, licenses, datasets, limitations, and external references, creating transparency and governance gaps across the AI supply chain. Artificial Intelligence Bills of Materials (AIBOMs) address these gaps by documenting AI artifacts, including models, metadata, licenses, datasets, model-card information, and external references. Taking public Hugging Face (HF) model repositories as a case study, this paper empirically investigates AIBOM completeness, defined as the extent to which repositories provide AIBOM-relevant information for machine-readable AI supply-chain documentation. We examine approximately 97.5K AIBOM artifacts to assess the extent to which generated AIBOMs: (i) contain required structural and metadata fields, (ii) represent model identity, license, and external-reference information, (iii) capture model-card documentation such as datasets, limitations, safety-risk assessment, and environmental information, and (iv) vary in documentation coverage across repository and artifact characteristics such as task, license availability, dataset declaration, model family, and paper reference. Results indicate that generated AIBOMs provide complete coverage of required AIBOM structure but limited AI-specific documentation completeness. Required fields are fully represented, but model-card, metadata, responsible-use, environmental, limitation, and meaningful-description fields remain weakly represented or missing across generated artifacts. Our findings motivate improved model-card practices, repository-level traceability, and automated AIBOM validation to advance the generation and adoption of more complete AIBOMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对Hugging Face模型仓库中的AI物料清单（AIBOM）完整性进行了大规模实证测量，分析了约97.5K个AIBOM工件，发现生成的结构字段完整但AI特定文档（如模型卡、元数据、负责任使用、环境信息等）覆盖不足。
Motivation: 模型仓库通常提供不完整的机器可读文档，导致AI供应链透明度和治理存在缺口。AIBOM旨在通过记录AI工件（模型、元数据、许可证、数据集等）来解决这些问题，但缺乏对其完整性的系统评估。
Method: 以Hugging Face公共模型仓库为案例，定义AIBOM完整性为仓库提供AIBOM相关信息的程度，并检查生成AIBOM的结构字段、模型身份、许可证、外部引用、模型卡文档（数据集、限制、安全风险评估、环境信息）以及不同仓库和工件特征下的文档覆盖差异。
Result: 生成AIBOM在必需结构字段上覆盖完整，但AI特定文档完整性有限：模型卡、元数据、负责任使用、环境、限制和有意义的描述字段在生成工件中表现薄弱或缺失。
Conclusion: 研究结果呼吁改进模型卡实践、仓库级别可追溯性和自动化AIBOM验证，以推动更完整AIBOM的生成和采用。

papers.title: Constrained Path Reasoning: Measuring When Committed Stages Earn Their Cost
papers.abstract_en: When does a committed intermediate stage in an LLM reasoning pipeline earn its cost? Constrained Path Reasoning (CPR) pairs a source-aware path hypothesis with stage-level accounting. Search generates provisional states; trusted or validated invariants can constrain hard, while other proposals remain soft and revisable. CPR predicts that task-compatible commitments can factor transitions, concentrate candidate mass, induce regularity, and expose feedback when their gains exceed propagated error and execution cost. The formalism covers discrete commitments and continuous flows and measures effective branching, endpoint concentration, and cost per usable output. Across 1,180 generated QCQPs and 40 engineered degenerate polynomial instances (2,140 endpoints), residual triage recovers 63.0% of repair-all's additional feasible yield with 17.7% of its attempts. Fixed-LLM accounting (270 unique calls shared across nested arms) finds usable yield of 41.1% direct, 90.0% after formalization and deterministic execution, 20.0% after one-shot convexification, and 21.1% for the full path. In 120 paired-condition calls, a two-action rollback rule reaches 90% usable yield versus 36.7% for the feedback-conditioned selector. Two endpoint probes separate source from validation: a 72-output cross-trajectory transplant reduces entropy and acceptable mass; a 24-output same-call self-proposal pilot gives unchanged two-repeat collision entropy, 25.0% versus 8.3% usable yield, and 1/8 deterministically confirmed endpoint checks. Model-generated states supply hypotheses; trusted execution earns constraint strength.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Constrained Path Reasoning (CPR)框架，用于衡量LLM推理管线中提交中间阶段的成本效益。通过源感知路径假设和阶段级核算，CPR能有效约束搜索、集中候选质量、暴露反馈。实验表明，残差分类恢复了修复所有策略的63.0%额外可行产量且仅用17.7%尝试，固定LLM核算下全路径可用产量为21.1%等。该工作聚焦于推理路径优化，与降水预报等气象任务无关。
Motivation: 当前LLM推理管线中提交中间阶段是否值得其成本尚不明确，CPR旨在量化这种成本效益，通过约束路径推理来改善推理效率。
Method: 提出CPR框架，结合源感知路径假设与阶段级核算。搜索生成临时状态，利用可信不变式进行硬约束，其他提议保持软可回溯。支持离散承诺和连续流，度量有效分支、端点集中度及每可用输出成本。
Result: 在1180个QCQP和40个退化多项式实例上，残差分类恢复63.0%的修复所有额外可行产量且仅用17.7%尝试；固定LLM账户全路径可用产量为21.1%。两种端点探针（跨轨迹移植和自提议试验）均展示出可用产量和熵的变化。
Conclusion: CPR框架表明模型生成状态提供假设，可信执行赢得约束强度。该方法可评估提交中间阶段的实际收益，但摘要未提及与气象相关的应用可能性。

papers.title: A RFID Based Campus Wide Payment System
papers.abstract_en: This work titled "RFID Based Campuswide Payment System" introduces an innovative cashless payment solution for educational institutions. It uses RFID cards and a Raspberry Pi to enable hassle free payments for various campus services, such as cafeteria purchases, tuition fees, and library fines. A centralized database ensures real-time updates on transactions and account balances, accessible through a simple and user-friendly web interface. This work is involved in designing a secure system with object-oriented principles, setting up databases, and integrating hardware like RFID readers with a Raspberry Pi. The systems are proved to be a cost-effective and efficient alternative to traditional payment methods, enhancing convenience and security for students and administrators. The study also explored similar RFID applications, like smart parking and attendance systems, to identify challenges and improvements. Looking ahead, it envisions features like wearable RFID devices, voice-activated payments, and blockchain integration to boost security and usability. Results show that this system simplifies campus payments and has the potential for broader adoption in similar environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一种基于RFID技术的校园无现金支付系统。该系统使用RFID卡和树莓派实现校园内各种服务的便捷支付，如食堂、学费和图书馆罚款。集中式数据库确保交易和账户余额的实时更新，并通过用户友好的网页界面访问。系统设计遵循面向对象原则，集成了RFID读卡器和树莓派硬件。研究表明，该系统是传统支付方法的一种经济高效且安全的替代方案。
Motivation: 传统校园支付方式效率低、安全性差，需要一种便捷、安全的无现金支付解决方案。
Method: 采用RFID卡片和树莓派，结合集中式数据库和网页界面，设计并实现了一个面向对象的校园支付系统。
Result: 系统被证明是经济高效且安全的，简化了校园支付流程，并具有在类似环境中推广的潜力。
Conclusion: 该系统能够简化校园支付，未来可扩展至可穿戴RFID设备、语音激活支付和区块链集成。

papers.title: Rate-Distortion-Perception Theory: Redefining the Fundamental Limits of Information Representation
papers.abstract_en: Classical rate-distortion (RD) theory has long established the fundamental limits of lossy compression by quantifying the minimum number of bits required to represent a source under a prescribed distortion constraint. However, widely used distortion measures such as mean-squared error often fail to capture perceptual quality or semantic validity, which are increasingly central in modern learning-driven applications. Rate-distortion-perception (RDP) theory extends the RD framework by introducing perception as a third fundamental axis, quantified via distributional similarity between the source and reconstructed signals, leading to the rate-distortion-perception function (RDPF). This tutorial provides a structured overview of the coding principles underlying perception-aware lossy compression and surveys recent achievability results under different randomness assumptions. It then presents a unifying optimization viewpoint for computing the RDPF as defined by Blau and Michaeli, for both discrete and continuous sources under broad families of perceptual constraints, including f-divergences, alpha-divergences, and Wasserstein-based metrics. Special attention is given to computational tools such as alternating minimization schemes, Newton-based methods, and convex optimization formulations, as well as to analytically tractable cases such as Gaussian sources and the perfect-realism regime. Unlike recent broad surveys that emphasize generative architectures and AI-empowered communication systems, this tutorial focuses on the coding-theoretic and computational machinery needed to characterize, compute, and interpret the RDP limits. Finally, the tutorial outlines promising research directions at the intersection of information theory, neural compression, robust source coding, and perception-aware networked control systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本教程系统介绍了率失真感知（RDP）理论，该理论将感知质量作为第三维度引入经典率失真框架，通过源信号与重构信号之间的分布相似性量化感知质量，并定义了率失真感知函数（RDPF）。文章综述了不同随机性假设下的可达性结果，给出了基于优化的RDPF计算方法，涵盖了f-散度、α-散度和Wasserstein度量等感知约束，并讨论了交替最小化、牛顿法和凸优化等计算工具以及高斯源和完美现实主义等解析可解情形。
Motivation: 经典率失真理论中的均方误差等失真度量无法捕捉感知质量和语义有效性，而现代学习驱动应用对感知质量有更高需求，因此需要将感知作为独立维度纳入信息表示的基本极限分析。
Method: 采用优化视角统一计算Blau和Michaeli定义的率失真感知函数，针对离散和连续源，考虑f-散度、α-散度和Wasserstein度量等感知约束，利用交替最小化、牛顿法和凸优化等计算工具，并分析了高斯源和完美现实主义等特殊情形。
Result: 该教程提供了感知感知有损压缩的编码原理结构化概述，总结了不同随机性假设下的最新可达性结果，并给出了RDPF的计算框架和解析解。
Conclusion: 本教程聚焦于编码理论和计算机制以刻画、计算和解释率失真感知极限，并指出了信息论、神经压缩、鲁棒信源编码和感知感知网络控制系统等交叉领域的研究方向。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Specifying the Delegated-Autonomy Boundary: Requirements Engineering for Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems do not just predict or recommend; they plan, maintain state, and act in external environments with varying degrees of autonomy. This changes the requirements engineering problem in a specific and under-addressed way: it introduces what we call the delegated-autonomy boundary -- the set of decisions about what may be delegated to the system, under what graduated authority, with what oversight, and how control is returned. Current practices bury these decisions inside prompts, tool schemas, and runtime policies, even though they are requirements-level commitments. This paper proposes two complementary artifacts. First, an Agency Justification Record (AJR) helps teams decide when an agent is warranted over simpler alternatives. Second, an Agentic Delegation Policy (ADP) captures what must be specified for safe and effective development: purpose, authority, information, coordination, assurance, and evolution. Crucially, authority in the ADP is modelled as graduated, i.e., a tiered structure. We illustrate the framework with two contrasting examples: a safety-critical hospital discharge coordination agent and an automated code review agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对人工智能体系统的需求工程问题，提出委托-自主边界（delegated-autonomy boundary）概念，即哪些决策可委托给系统、在何种分级权限下、如何监督以及如何收回控制。作者提出两个互补工具：Agency Justification Record（AJR）帮助团队决定何时使用智能体而非简单方法；Agentic Delegation Policy（ADP）捕获安全有效开发所需规范：目的、权限、信息、协调、保证和演进。权限被建模为分级结构。通过医院出院协调智能体和自动代码审查智能体两个对比示例说明该框架。
Motivation: 现有智能体AI系统将委托决策埋设在提示、工具模式和运行时策略中，忽视了这些本质上是需求层面的承诺。需要明确规范委托-自主边界以确保安全有效的开发。
Method: 提出两个互补工件：Agency Justification Record（AJR）用于论证使用智能体的必要性；Agentic Delegation Policy（ADP）用于系统化捕获委托规范，包括目的、权限、信息、协调、保证和演进六大维度，其中权限采用分级模型。
Result: 通过安全关键型医院出院协调智能体和自动代码审查智能体两个对比示例展示了框架的适用性。
Conclusion: 需求工程是构建安全可靠智能体AI系统的关键环节，本文框架为系统化处理委托-自主边界提供了初步方法。

papers.title: Semantic Context Matters: Analysis of Color Names Across Domains
papers.abstract_en: Color naming is influenced not only by physical color values but also by the semantic context in which colors are used. This paper investigates context-dependent color naming by mapping color-name datasets from Cosmetics, Crayola, and Car-color vocabularies onto the 86 fuzzy color categories of the COLIBRI color model. Contextual variation is analyzed using category coverage, Shannon entropy, and maximum lift. The results show that the three contexts occupy the COLIBRI color space differently: Cosmetics covers 48 of 86 fuzzy categories, Crayola covers 50, and Car colors cover 40. The results demonstrated that Crayola provides the broadest and most balanced use of the fuzzy color space, Cosmetics is mainly concentrated around warm-tone regions, and Car colors are more specialized around blue and achromatic regions. These findings show that color naming cannot be fully explained by numerical color similarity alone and that semantic context plays an important role in human color interpretation. The proposed framework supports the development of context-aware color models for design analytics, product search, recommendation systems, and human-centered artificial intelligence.
papers.comment: Submitted to 2026 Joint 14th International Conference on Soft Computing and Intelligent Systems and 27th International Symposium on Advanced Intelligent Systems (SCIS&ISIS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究颜色命名受语义上下文的影响，将化妆品、Crayola 蜡笔和汽车颜色三个领域的颜色名称映射到 COLIBRI 颜色模型的 86 个模糊类别上，通过类别覆盖、香农熵和最大提升度分析上下文差异。结果表明 Crayola 覆盖最广最均衡（50/86），化妆品集中在暖色调（48/86），汽车颜色集中在蓝色和消色区域（40/86）。结论是颜色命名不能仅由数值颜色相似性解释，语义上下文起重要作用。
Motivation: 颜色命名受物理颜色值和语义上下文共同影响，但现有研究缺乏对不同领域的系统性对比，需要量化上下文变化。
Method: 将化妆品、Crayola 和汽车颜色数据集映射到 COLIBRI 的 86 个模糊颜色类别，使用类别覆盖、香农熵和最大提升度三个指标分析上下文变化。
Result: 化妆品覆盖 48 个模糊类别，Crayola 覆盖 50 个，汽车颜色覆盖 40 个；Crayola 覆盖最均衡，化妆品集中在暖色调，汽车集中在蓝色和消色区域。
Conclusion: 颜色命名不能仅由数值颜色相似性解释，语义上下文起重要作用；该框架支持上下文感知颜色模型用于设计分析、产品搜索、推荐系统和人类中心 AI。

papers.title: Auditing Question-Order Effects in Large Language Models with the QQ Equality: Mechanism Characterization and a Saturation Caveat
papers.abstract_en: Human survey respondents exhibit question-order effects that satisfy the QQ (quantum question) equality, an a priori, parameter-free prediction of the projective quantum question-order model. We develop the QQ equality into an audit criterion for sequential judgments of autoregressive large language models (LLMs). Theoretically, we characterize which mechanism classes satisfy it robustly: marginal-independent kernels satisfy QQ iff all four mismatch transition rates coincide (a class containing the 2D rank-1 projective model with a fixed measurement pair under state variation); a polarity- and position-dependent repetition family is characterized by an exact cross-symmetry condition with closed-form violations; QQ-satisfying behaviors are closed under order-matched mixing; and the rank-2 Contextuality-by-Default criterion translates into audit coordinates as $|\qQQ|\le\OSS$, where $\OSS$ (the order-sensitivity score) totals the order sensitivity of the two marginals. Methodologically, we develop a pre-specified, audit-logged pipeline applicable to any model exposing next-token log-probabilities; it combines worst-case robustness envelopes, sampling-consistency spot checks, full label counterbalancing, and a saturation diagnostic. Empirically, in a first-signal pilot on an open-weight instruction-tuned model under two framings, all pre-specified health gates passed, yet 17/18 and 7/8 item pairs, respectively, were saturated (near-deterministic), and no item was certified residually contextual. Forced-binary next-token log-probabilities were thus inadequate for distribution-level QQ audits under the tested model and prompting conditions; we recommend pre-specified saturation diagnostics whenever next-token distributions are treated as survey-response distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将量子问题顺序模型中的QQ等式发展为自回归大语言模型（LLM）顺序判断的审计标准。理论上刻画了满足等式的机制类，包括边缘独立核、极性-位置依赖重复族等，并给出上下文性-默认准则的审计坐标等价形式。方法上构建了预设的审计管线，结合最坏情况鲁棒性包络、采样一致性检查和饱和诊断。实验表明，在开源指令微调模型上，所有健康检查通过，但绝大部分项目对出现饱和（近确定性），无法通过残差上下文认证。
Motivation: 人类调查中存在问题顺序效应，而LLM在顺序判断中也可能表现出类似偏差，但缺乏系统的审计方法。
Method: 理论分析多种机制类（边缘独立核、重复族等）的QQ等式满足条件；开发预设审计管线，包括鲁棒性包络、标签平衡、饱和诊断，适用于暴露下一token对数概率的任何模型。
Result: 在开源指令微调模型的两个框架中，所有健康检查通过，但17/18和7/8的项目对饱和，未有任何项目通过残差上下文认证。
Conclusion: 在测试条件下，强迫二选一的下一token对数概率不足以进行分布级QQ审计；建议在将下一token分布视为调查响应分布时，加入预设饱和诊断。

papers.title: Induce to Empower: Improving Lightweight Baselines via Foundation Model Induction for Generalized Polyp Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Automated polyp segmentation in colonoscopy continues to pose challenges due to substantial appearance variations and indistinct polyp boundaries. Although emerging foundation models (FMs) such as DINOv2, SAM, and OneFormer, demonstrate remarkable generalization capabilities, their direct transfer to the polyp segmentation task and deployment in real-time clinical settings are difficult due to lack of large-scale labeled data and high computational demands. In addition, adopting multiple FMs together raises concerns, even though they encode complementary semantic and structural information. While lightweight models, including U-Net, PraNet and U-Net++, are computationally efficient, they often struggle to generalize across datasets due to limited representational capacity. To address this gap, we propose Lite-Polyp Inductor (Lite-Pi), a novel foundation model induction framework that significantly enhances lightweight polyp segmentation baselines. Our proposed framework generates FM-specific prototype representations and aligns them semantically with the corresponding foundation model priors through reconstruction-based supervision. Subsequently, transformer-based fusion is introduced to highlight the polyp relevant representations, including salient boundary information, while preserving complementary semantic cues. Extensive experiments across five polyp segmentation benchmark datasets demonstrate that Lite-π significantly improves lightweight baselines, achieving superior generalization performance with minimal computational overhead and thereby, offering a practical solution for generalized polyp segmentation. Our code is available at GitHub. https://github.com/lostinrepo/Lite-Pi
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Lite-Polyp Inductor (Lite-Pi)，一种利用基础模型（如 DINOv2、SAM、OneFormer）引导轻量级息肉分割基线模型（如 U-Net、PraNet）的框架。通过生成原型表示并与基础模型先验进行重构对齐，再通过 Transformer 融合强调息肉相关特征，在五个基准数据集上显著提升了轻量级模型的泛化性能，且计算开销小。
Motivation: 轻量级息肉分割模型因表示能力有限难以跨数据集泛化，而基础模型虽泛化强但计算成本高且缺乏标注数据，直接迁移困难。多基础模型编码互补信息但整合复杂。
Method: 提出基础模型诱导框架 Lite-Pi：生成基础模型特定的原型表示，通过重构监督与对应基础模型先验语义对齐；然后引入 Transformer 融合，突出息肉相关表示（包括边界信息）并保留互补语义信息。
Result: 在五个息肉分割基准数据集上，Lite-Pi 显著提升轻量级基线模型的泛化性能，且计算开销小。
Conclusion: Lite-Pi 提供了一种实用的通用息肉分割方案，通过基础模型诱导有效增强轻量级模型，兼顾性能与效率。
