papers.title: Learning Sparse Latent Predictive Foundation Model for Multimodal Neuroimaging
papers.abstract_en: Brain MRIs are routinely acquired as multiple complementary sequences with unique contrast weighting, including T1-weighed imaging (T1w) anatomic and fluid-sensitive T2-weighted (T2w) contrasts. However, methods for learning unified representations across the multitude of MRI contrast mechanisms at health-system scale are lacking. In this study, we introduce Neuro-JEPA, a sparse multimodal neuroimaging foundation model that combines a latent predictive objective with a Mixture-of-Experts architecture to encode brain MRI across core T1w, T2w, and fluid-suppressed FLAIR imaging (FLAIR). We further provide a systematic methodological study of architectural, masking, objective, and sparsity design choices beneficial for robust neuroimaging multimodal representation learning. Neuro-JEPA was pretrained on 1,551,862 scans from 428,647 studies after modality-specific preprocessing with data curation across three core structural brain MRI sequences. We evaluated the learned representations across clinical and research settings, including 25 tasks from three health systems: NYU Langone, NYU Long Island, and Massachusetts General Hospital, and 22 tasks from 12 public datasets, covering unimodal, multimodal and cross-domain evaluation configurations. Across these benchmarks, existing neuroimaging foundation models showed inconsistent gains over a simple convolutional neural network (CNN) baseline, whereas Neuro-JEPA achieved stronger and more consistent performance across all evaluated settings. These results establish a scalable methodological framework for multimodal neuroimaging representation learning and highlight the need for foundation model evaluation protocols that include simple baselines, clinically heterogeneous cohorts and controlled multimodal comparisons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Neuro-JEPA，一种稀疏多模态神经影像基础模型，结合潜在预测目标与混合专家架构，在 T1w、T2w 和 FLAIR 三种 MRI 序列上学习统一表征。模型在 155 万次扫描上预训练，覆盖 25 项临床任务和 22 项公开数据集任务，相比现有模型和简单 CNN 基线取得更一致且更强的性能。
Motivation: 现有方法缺乏在健康系统规模下统一学习多种 MRI 对比机制的表征的能力，且现有神经影像基础模型在多样任务上表现不稳定，甚至不如简单 CNN 基线。
Method: 提出 Neuro-JEPA，采用潜在预测目标（latent predictive objective）与混合专家（Mixture-of-Experts）架构，结合稀疏设计选择（如掩码、目标函数、稀疏性），在预处理后的 T1w、T2w、FLAIR 序列上进行大规模预训练。
Result: 在 25 项来自三个医疗系统的临床任务和 22 项公开数据集任务上，Neuro-JEPA 在所有评估设置中均比现有神经影像基础模型和简单 CNN 基线表现更强且更一致。
Conclusion: 该工作建立了可扩展的多模态神经影像表征学习框架，并强调基础模型评估协议需要包含简单基线、临床异质性队列和受控多模态比较。

papers.title: Physics-Guided Spatiotemporal Learning for Coastal Wave Peak Period Estimation from Video
papers.abstract_en: Direct estimation of physically interpretable periodic signals from raw video constitutes a spatiotemporally grounded learning problem that proves to be difficult especially when facing label sparsity, lack of physical grounding and standardization benchmarks. The wave monitoring at coastal sites is one such real-world example where current deep learning approaches for estimating wave parameters using video as input suffer from physical interpretability and require some kind of intermediate data processing. In this study we propose a framework for wave peak period estimation using only video as input through three components: automated region-of-interest detection using temporal pixel variance, multi-stage Sim-to-Real transfer learning process, and physics-guided regularization of the output predictions. Various spatiotemporal architectures, including Transformer and recurrent-convolutional were compared during the stages of synthetic pretraining, silver label adaptation, and expert fine-tuning. It has been found out that LtViViT achieves the highest accuracy in its estimates, while TinyWaveNet shows superior temporal stability and oceanographic skill. Additionally, ablation studies have demonstrated that physics-guided regularization helps to follow the trends in predictions more consistently and prevent physically meaningless predictions. Moreover, Grad-CAM-based explainability analysis of the physics-guided TinyWaveNet showed that its spatial focus aligns with hydrodynamically active surf-zone regions. Overall, the findings support physics-guided, video-based deep learning as a cost-effective and operationally viable approach for long-term coastal wave monitoring, and demonstrate a transferable strategy for physically-constrained spatiotemporal regression from video under data-scarce conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对从视频中直接估计具有物理意义的周期信号这一时空学习难题，提出一个物理引导的框架，用于从视频估算海浪波峰周期。框架包括自动ROI检测、多阶段Sim-to-Real迁移学习和物理引导正则化。实验表明LtViViT精度最高，TinyWaveNet时间稳定性最好，物理引导正则化使预测更一致。Grad-CAM分析显示模型关注活跃的水动力波浪带区域。
Motivation: 现有基于视频的波浪参数深度估计方法缺乏物理可解释性，且通常需要中间数据处理，面临标签稀疏、物理基础不足和标准化基准缺失的问题。
Method: 提出三部分框架：基于时间像素方差的自动ROI检测、多阶段模拟到真实迁移学习（包括合成预训练、银标签适应和专家微调）、输出预测的物理引导正则化。比较了Transformer和循环卷积等时空架构。
Result: LtViViT估计精度最高，TinyWaveNet时间稳定性和海洋学技能最好。消融实验表明物理正则化能使预测趋势更一致，防止无物理意义的预测。Grad-CAM分析显示模型空间关注点与活跃的碎波带区域一致。
Conclusion: 研究支持物理引导的基于视频的深度学习作为经济可行的方法用于长期海岸波浪监测，并展示了在数据稀缺条件下从视频进行物理约束时空回归的可迁移策略。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: BiWM: Advancing Open-Source Interactive Video World Models with Bidirectional Autoregression
papers.abstract_en: Interactive video world models commonly convert bidirectional video generators into causal autoregressive systems through control fine-tuning, autoregressive training, causal initialization, and few-step distillation. This pipeline is costly, while frozen causal histories accumulate errors that degrade long-horizon fidelity and controllability. We present BiWM, the first open-source full-stack training framework for bidirectional autoregressive video world models. BiWM retains full attention within each generated chunk and requires only two stages: camera/action-control fine-tuning and few-step Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD). Both stages converge within a few hundred optimizer steps on 8 H200 GPUs. The framework supports Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, Wan2.2-TI2V-5B, HunyuanVideo-1.5-TI2V-8B, and LTX-2.3-22B, together with real-world camera control, pluggable long-history compression, and optional low-bit deployment. Supervised and forward-KL anchors mitigate DMD mode collapse and preserve scene dynamics. BiWM provides a compact, reproducible path from pretrained bidirectional video models to interactive, controllable, and efficient world models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BiWM，首个开源的全栈双向自回归视频世界模型训练框架。它保留每个生成块内的全注意力，仅需相机/动作控制微调和分布匹配蒸馏两阶段，在8块H200 GPU上几百步内收敛。框架支持多种预训练视频模型，并引入监督和正向KL锚点防止模式崩塌。
Motivation: 现有将双向视频生成器转换为因果自回归系统的管道成本高，且冻结的因果历史导致长程保真度和可控性下降。
Method: 提出BiWM框架，采用双向自回归，每个生成块内保持全注意力；仅需两阶段：相机/动作控制微调与少步分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）；引入监督和正向KL锚点避免模式崩塌。
Result: 两种训练阶段均在8块H200 GPU上几百优化步内收敛；框架支持Wan2.1等四种模型，并提供真实相机控制、可插拔长历史压缩和低比特部署。
Conclusion: BiWM提供了一条紧凑、可复现的路径，从预训练双向视频模型到交互式、可控且高效的世界模型。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: FAIR-Calib: Frontier-Aware Instability-Reweighted Calibration for Post-Training Quantization of Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) refine tokens iteratively but commit them irreversibly, leading to a "stability lag" where early decisions remain fragile even after being written. We reveal that Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) error easily flips these borderline decisions at the write frontier, which are then permanently locked in and amplified. To address this, we propose Frontier-Aware Instability-Reweighted Calibration (FAIR-Calib), a two-stage PTQ framework for dLLMs. Stage I probes a full-precision teacher to estimate a position prior that combines frontier hits and masked-stage reliability. Stage II performs off-policy, layer-wise calibration by minimizing a reweighted hidden-state MSE, effectively prioritizing the protection of fragile frontier states without requiring expensive end-to-end diffusion rollouts. We further theoretically justify our weighted objective as a surrogate for output KL divergence. Empirically, FAIR-Calib consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on LLaDA and Dream (W4A4), significantly reducing frontier decision flips and suppressing post-commit mismatches across diverse benchmarks.
papers.comment: Accepted as a poster at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）后训练量化（PTQ）中早期决策易被量化误差翻转并永久锁定的问题，提出FAIR-Calib两阶段校准框架。阶段I利用全精度教师估计位置先验（前沿命中与掩蔽阶段可靠性），阶段II通过离策略逐层最小化加权的隐藏状态MSE，优先保护脆弱的前沿状态。理论证明该加权目标是输出KL散度的代理，实验在LLaDA和Dream（W4A4）上超越现有基线，显著减少前沿决策翻转。
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型在迭代生成中，早期token一旦被写入便不可逆，但量化误差容易在写入边界翻转这些不稳定的决策，导致错误被永久放大。现有PTQ方法未考虑这种稳定性滞后现象。
Method: 提出两阶段PTQ框架：阶段I通过全精度教师模型估计位置先验，结合前沿命中频率与掩蔽阶段的可靠性；阶段II进行离策略、逐层校准，通过重新加权的隐藏状态MSE损失函数，优先保护脆弱的前沿状态，避免端到端扩散rollouts。
Result: 在LLaDA和Dream模型上以W4A4量化配置进行实验，FAIR-Calib在多个基准上一致优于现有SOTA方法，显著减少前沿决策翻转和后提交不匹配。
Conclusion: FAIR-Calib通过感知前沿的加权校准有效缓解dLLMs PTQ中的稳定性滞后问题，理论分析了加权目标与输出KL散度的关联，为扩散模型的低比特量化提供了新方向。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: FAIR-Calib通过感知前沿的加权校准有效缓解dLLMs PTQ中的稳定性滞后问题，理论分析了加权目标与输出KL散度的关联，为扩散模型的低比特量化提供了新方向。

papers.title: TempoVLA: Learning Speed-Controllable Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: Robot manipulation alternates between low-risk transit phases that call for fast execution and high-risk contact stages that demand slow, precise motion. Yet existing Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) only inherit a single fixed speed from training demonstrations. Prior efforts to accelerate VLAs through model compression, KV-cache reuse, or reinforcement learning only shift the policy from one fixed speed to another, and leave deceleration almost unexplored. We observe that the magnitude of each predicted action already governs how fast the robot moves, opening a direct route to controllable execution speed. We turn this observation into TempoVLA, a single VLA whose execution speed is controlled by an explicit condition. TempoVLA combines two coupled components. (1) A data-side Variable-Speed Trajectory Augmentation (VSTA) that re-times demonstration to any target speed by merging or splitting actions while preserving its motion semantics. (2) A model-side conditioning mechanism that feeds the speed to the policy. Statistics show that VSTA reaches the requested speed with negligible motion error. Experiments in simulation and on real-world tasks demonstrate that TempoVLA achieves flexible speed control in both directions, while VSTA additionally boosts the default $1\times$ performance via better data utilization. Furthermore, by cooperating with a large multimodal model, TempoVLA realizes dynamic speed control, accelerating through low-risk phases and decelerating for high-risk ones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TempoVLA，一种速度可控的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA），通过调整动作幅度来控制机器人执行速度。它包含数据侧的变速轨迹增强（VSTA）和模型侧的速度条件机制，实现灵活的速度控制，并在高风险接触阶段减速。
Motivation: 现有VLA只能从训练演示中继承单一固定速度，加速方法只能将策略从一种固定速度切换到另一种，减速几乎未被探索。本文旨在实现可控制的执行速度。
Method: 提出TempoVLA，包括(1)数据侧的VSTA，通过合并或拆分动作重新计时演示到任何目标速度，同时保持运动语义；(2)模型侧的条件机制，将速度作为策略的输入条件。
Result: 统计显示VSTA以可忽略的运动误差达到请求速度。在模拟和真实任务中，TempoVLA实现了双向灵活速度控制，VSTA还通过更好的数据利用提升了默认1倍性能。此外，与大型多模态模型协作，实现动态速度控制，在低风险阶段加速，在高风险阶段减速。
Conclusion: 本文展示了单一VLA可以通过显式条件控制执行速度，并实现动态速度调节。

papers.title: Improving Answer Extraction in Context-based Question Answering Systems Using LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Question answering (QA) systems have achieved notable progress with the advent of large language models (LLMs). However, they still face challenges in accurately extracting and generating precise answers from given contexts, particularly when dealing with complex or ambiguous queries. Existing approaches often struggle with contextual understanding, answer consistency, and generalization across diverse domains. In this work, we propose a question answering system based on large language models, where the input consists of a textual context and a corresponding question, and the output is a concise and accurate answer. The motivation behind this research lies in addressing the limitations of current QA systems, particularly their tendency to produce irrelevant or imprecise responses despite having access to the correct context. Our methodology involves fine-tuning a pre-trained LLM on a benchmark QA dataset to improve its contextual comprehension and answer extraction capabilities. Specifically, we utilize the Stanford Question Answering Dataset (SQuAD1.1), which provides high-quality context-question-answer triplets for supervised training and evaluation. Experimental results show that the fine-tuned Roberta-base model achieves the highest performance, attaining a ROUGE-L score of 86.84%, a BLEU score of 28.24%, and a BERTScore of 95.38%. These results indicate strong accuracy and answer relevance, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed approach for context-based question answering tasks. Furthermore, the findings confirm that targeted fine-tuning substantially improves the reliability and precision of QA systems.

TL;DR: 本文针对基于上下文的问答系统中答案提取不准确的问题，提出使用预训练LLM进行微调的方法。在SQuAD1.1数据集上微调RoBERTa-base模型，获得了ROUGE-L 86.84%、BLEU 28.24%、BERTScore 95.38%的成绩。结果表明有针对性的微调能显著提升答案提取的准确性和相关性。

papers.title: Choosing the Lens: Strategic Perspective Activation in Context-Dependent Argumentation
papers.abstract_en: The same arguments often need to be evaluated under different external regimes. An agent with influence over the regime has a strategic lever that standard formalisms do not directly capture. We introduce context-dependent argumentation frameworks (CDAFs), an extension of Dung's theory in which a defeat function determines, per context, which attacks succeed. Blocked attacks are inverted rather than deleted, so extensions stay conflict-free with respect to the attack relation. A perspective-labeled specialisation derives the defeat function from a relevance set $ρ$ and a priority $π$. The relevance set is the agent's action space. In a small worked example, the agent's target argument is rejected under every full-relevance priority, yet accepted under a partial activation whose outcome no VAF audience can mirror. We define the corresponding decision problem, ACTIVATION-MANIPULATION, and record baseline complexity bounds. For grounded semantics with mandatory perspectives the problem is NP-complete, and the hardness comes from the activation choice itself.
papers.comment: Accepted to LAMAS&SR workshop at FLoC 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出上下文依赖论证框架（CDAFs），扩展Dung理论，通过一个在每个上下文中决定哪些攻击成功的击败函数来建模外部制度对论证评估的影响。被阻塞的攻击被反转而非删除，因此扩展在攻击关系下仍保持无冲突。作者定义了一个基于相关集和优先级的视角标记特化，并研究了相关决策问题ACTIVATION-MANIPULATION的复杂度。
Motivation: 标准论证框架无法直接捕捉有影响力的智能体通过改变外部制度来策略性地影响论证评估的机制。
Method: 引入上下文依赖论证框架（CDAFs），其中击败函数根据上下文决定哪些攻击有效；通过视角标记特化从相关集和优先级导出击败函数。
Result: 在一个小型实例中，目标论证在完全相关优先级下被拒绝，但在部分激活下被接受，这种结果无法被任何VAF受众复现。对于带强制视角的基语义，ACTIVATION-MANIPULATION问题是NP完全的，困难性源于激活选择本身。
Conclusion: CDAFs为建模论证中的策略性制度影响提供了新形式化，但摘要未提及扩展性限制或实际应用。

papers.title: AOE: Exhaustive Out-of-Distribution Detection via Recalibrating Outlier Labels
papers.abstract_en: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is essential for deploying machine learning models in open-world and safety-critical scenarios, where test inputs may deviate from the training distribution and overconfident predictions on unknown samples can lead to unreliable decisions. Outlier Exposure (OE) has emerged as a promising OOD detection paradigm by introducing auxiliary outliers during training to enlarge the margin between in-distribution (ID) and OOD samples. Existing OE-based methods typically enlarge this margin by employing uniform labels to maximize the entropy of OOD samples over ID categories. However, we theoretically show that uniform labels inevitably disregard the relations between OOD samples and ID categories, termed the over-softening effect, leading to a suboptimal margin bound. Our theoretical analysis further reveals that explicitly exploiting such relations can instead yield improved OOD detection performance. Motivated by this insight, we propose \underline{A}daptive Confidence \underline{OE} (AOE), a simple yet effective method that leverages temperature scaling to recalibrate outlier labels. Specifically, AOE generates adaptive soft targets from temperature-scaled model predictions for OOD samples, where the learnable temperature smooths the prediction distribution without fully erasing class-wise relational information. By supervising OOD samples with these adaptive soft targets, AOE preserves the semantic proximity between OOD samples and ID categories while encouraging the softened targets to approach a high-entropy distribution, thereby suppressing overconfident OOD predictions and enlarging the separation margin. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of AOE.
papers.comment: The article has been accepted by Frontiers of Computer Science (FCS), with the DOI: {10.1007/s11704-026-61080-0}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对异常检测中Outlier Exposure方法使用均匀标签忽略OOD样本与ID类别关系的问题，提出自适应置信度Outlier Exposure (AOE)，通过温度缩放重校准异常标签，保留语义邻近性同时鼓励高熵分布，实验证明有效性。
Motivation: 现有OE方法使用均匀标签最大化OOD样本熵，但理论分析表明这会导致过度软化效应，忽视OOD与ID类别关系，次优边界。
Method: 提出AOE，利用可学习温度对模型预测进行温度缩放，为OOD样本生成自适应软目标，保留类间关系信息并接近高熵分布。
Result: 在多种基准上实验证明AOE有效性。
Conclusion: 论文强调AOE简单有效，通过重校准异常标签改善OOD检测。

papers.title: Do We Really Need Quantum Machine Learning?: A Multidimensional Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of computer vision and increasingly complex image recognition tasks has exposed fundamental computational limitations of classical machine learning models, motivating the exploration of quantum computing as an emerging new paradigm. This paper presents a comprehensive benchmarking study of classical and quantum machine learning models for image recognition on the MNIST handwritten digit dataset, evaluating both traditional models, a Classical Support Vector Machine (CSVM) and a Quantum Support Vector Machine (QSVM), and deep neural network models, a Classical Convolutional Neural Network (CCNN) and a Quantum Convolutional Neural Network (QCNN), across four performance dimensions: classification accuracy, computational runtime, parameter count, and memory requirements. Experiments are conducted as functions of both feature dimensionality and sample size, and across CPU and GPU execution environments, providing a controlled, multidimensional comparison to address gaps in prior work. For the SVM-based models, QSVM consistently outperforms CSVM in accuracy, reaching $\sim$ 0.90 versus $\sim$ 0.85 at 1,000 samples, with a higher computational cost. A feature count of 10 qubits and a sample size in the range of 200 -- 500 emerge as practical operating points that balance accuracy and runtime. For the neural network models, CCNN and QCNN achieve comparable classification accuracy, both exceeding 0.96 at 64 features and 60,000 samples, yet QCNN offers superior parameter and memory efficiency at higher feature counts, while incurring higher runtime. Across both model families, quantum models consistently outperform classical models by greater margins in accuracy as feature dimensionality or sample size increases.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at IEEE ICMLA 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文对经典和量子机器学习模型在MNIST手写数字识别任务上进行了全面的多维基准比较，评估了支持向量机（CSVM与QSVM）和卷积神经网络（CCNN与QCNN）在分类精度、计算时间、参数数量和内存需求方面的表现。实验表明，量子SVM在精度上优于经典SVM（约0.90 vs 0.85），而量子CNN与经典CNN精度相当（均超过0.96），但量子模型在更高特征维度下具有参数和内存效率优势。
Motivation: 经典机器学习模型在处理日益复杂的图像识别任务时遇到计算瓶颈，促使研究者探索量子计算作为新范式，但缺乏系统的、多维度的对比研究来评估量子机器学习的实际收益。
Method: 对MNIST数据集进行受控实验，比较传统SVM与量子SVM、传统CNN与量子CNN在分类精度、运行时间、参数数量和内存需求四个维度上的表现，并考察特征维度和样本大小的影响，在CPU和GPU环境下执行。
Result: QSVM在1000样本时精度达到约0.90，高于CSVM的约0.85；QCNN在64特征和60000样本时精度超过0.96，与CCNN相当；量子模型在更高特征维度或样本量下表现出更大的精度优势。
Conclusion: 量子机器学习在特定条件下（如更高特征维度或样本量）可能提供精度或效率优势，但计算成本较高；需要根据具体任务权衡是否采用量子方法。

papers.title: The Behavioral Credibility Trilemma: When Calibrated Autonomy Becomes Impossible
papers.abstract_en: We prove that no reinforcement learning policy with confidence-gated autonomy can simultaneously achieve maximum helpfulness, optimal calibration, and full autonomy under rational oversight, whenever some tasks exceed the agent's reliable competence: the Behavioral Credibility Trilemma. The impossibility is geometric: adding any non-affine autonomy incentive to a strictly proper scoring rule destroys strict properness, so an agent rewarded for both calibrated confidence and autonomous action systematically inflates its reported confidence on tasks below the principal's approval threshold whenever the autonomy stake exceeds the calibration cost of clearing it. The Behavioral Perturbation Lemma quantifies the inflation (scaling as $w_A/(2 w_C)$ for the Brier score) and shows detection requires $Ω(1/Δ^2)$ observations for interior reports. We prove that, in the unsaturated regime, no affine oversight rule is optimal for the principal and the optimum is attained by a sharp threshold satisfying the trilemma's own hypotheses, so the impossibility is endogenized rather than assumed; moreover, for symmetric, log-concave, full-support location policy families under the Brier score, calibration is not even a stationary point of policy-gradient training. We formalize the Confidence-Gated Decision Problem, map existing methods onto the trilemma, and identify two constructive resolution pathways (commitment, role separation). A 540-configuration Best-of-N experiment tests five hypotheses, all strongly confirmed (effect sizes $d = 1.10$ to $5.35$, the upper end from a per-completion estimator inflating magnitude over per-task aggregates) and replicated under a pre-specified protocol on two further model families, and adds a descriptive analysis of the achievable-$(H, C, A)$ surface geometry showing a plateau-truncated frontier consistent with the predicted inflation saturation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明了在理性监督下，当某些任务超出智能体的可靠能力时，没有任何具有置信门控自主性的强化学习策略能同时实现最大帮助性、最优校准和完全自主性，即行为可信三难困境。该不可能性源于几何原因：向严格适当评分规则添加任何非仿射自主激励会破坏严格适当性，导致智能体在任务低于委托人批准阈值时系统性夸大置信度。文中通过行为扰动引理量化了膨胀程度（对于Brier分数，缩放为$w_A/(2 w_C)$），并证明在非饱和区域，任何仿射监督规则对委托人都不是最优的，最优解由满足三难困境自身假设的尖锐阈值达到。
Motivation: 现有方法在赋予智能体自主决策权时面临校准与自主性的权衡，但缺乏理论极限的理解。本文旨在揭示校准、帮助性和自主性三者之间不可兼得的根本矛盾。
Method: 形式化定义置信门控决策问题，利用几何论证和严格适当评分规则的性质，证明行为可信三难困境。通过行为扰动引理量化置信度膨胀，并证明对于对称、对数凹、全支撑的位置策略族，Brier分数下的校准甚至不是策略梯度训练的不动点。
Result: 理论结果表明不可能同时达到最大帮助性、最优校准和完全自主性。540配置的Best-of-N实验验证了五个假设，效应量d=1.10到5.35，并在另外两个模型系列上按预先指定的方案重复验证。
Conclusion: 本文确立了行为可信三难困境的理论极限，并识别了两种建设性的解决途径（承诺、角色分离）。强调该不可能性是内生的而非假设的，对安全关键系统设计具有指导意义。

papers.title: Location Prior Generation via Multi-Source Urban Data Fusion for Low-Altitude Air Mobility
papers.abstract_en: Building height, the third dimension (3D) of urban spatial data, is absent in over 95% of structures in global geospatial databases. For the emerging low-altitude economy, this data gap forces each aerial platform to rely on real-time onboard sensing rather than pre-computed 3D scene geometry. We present the Location Prior Generation Framework (LPGF), a multi-source data fusion pipeline that integrates Sentinel-2 imagery, UAV telemetry, vehicle GPS trajectories, and OpenStreetMap footprints into structured, reusable urban location priors. LPGF assigns building heights through a three-tier priority hierarchy: (1) explicit OSM height tags where available, (2) floor count multiplied by 3.2 m per story where recorded, and (3) building-type default heights otherwise, yielding a worst-case error of approximately 5.5 m. An optional shadow-based height estimation module (SHEM) is activated only when a four-criterion quality gate is satisfied; when any criterion fails, the pipeline routes to structured fallback. On the MiTra A50 Milan dataset, the quality gate correctly identified two imaging failure modes: sub-pixel shadows at 10 m GSD and ground shadow merging at 0.93 m GSD, producing a consistent 27-building prior in both cases. Tier 3 type-default heights were validated against manual floor counts (n=15), achieving MAE=3.07 m within the 5.0 m uncertainty bound. The framework demonstrates that structured, quality-gated fusion of universally available data streams can bootstrap 3D scene coverage for low-altitude urban operations.
papers.comment: Withdrawn because key empirical claims in v1, including the 27-building result, MAE=3.07 m, and 5.0-5.5 m error/uncertainty bounds, were not supported by the archived source data and released implementation. The authors withdraw the paper to correct the scientific record. A substantially redesigned study will be submitted separately
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出位置先验生成框架（LPGF），融合Sentinel-2影像、无人机遥测、车辆GPS轨迹和OpenStreetMap足迹，通过三级优先级层次为建筑分配高度，最坏误差约5.5米。论文已被撤回，因关键实证声明（包括27栋建筑结果、MAE=3.07米及误差/不确定度界限）未得到存档源数据和发布实现的支持。
Motivation: 全球超过95%的建筑缺少高度信息，限制低空经济中无人机对预计算3D场景几何的依赖，迫使使用实时机载传感。
Method: LPGF采用多源数据融合管道，通过三级优先级分配高度：1）显式OSM高度标签；2）楼层数乘以3.2米；3）建筑类型默认高度。可选阴影估计模块（SHEM）在满足四标准质量门时激活，否则回退。
Result: 在MiTra A50 Milan数据集上，质量门正确识别两种成像故障模式，生成一致27栋建筑先验；第三级类型默认高度与手动楼层计数（n=15）验证，MAE=3.07米，在5.0米不确定度范围内。但论文已撤回，结果不被支持。
Conclusion: 框架表明结构化、质量门控的多源数据融合可为低空城市运营引导3D场景覆盖，但论文因数据问题撤回。

papers.title: WINO: A Weak-Form Physics Informed Neural Operator for Hyperelasticity on Variable Domains
papers.abstract_en: We propose a Weak-form Physics-Informed Neural Operator (WINO), a data-free framework that combines the efficiency of neural operators with the geometric flexibility of the $\varphi$-finite element method ($\varphi$-FEM). $\varphi$-FEM is an unfitted method that accommodates geometric variations without body-fitted meshes, where the domain geometry is represented by the level-set function $\varphi$. To impose the boundary conditions, Dirichlet problems adopt the $\varphi$-FEM lifting so only the homogeneous displacement contribution is learned, whereas traction-driven Neumann problems additionally predict the auxiliary fields necessary for the unfitted weak formulation. Parameters are trained by minimizing squared weak-form residuals aligned with $\varphi$-FEM together with squared penalties on the cut-cell auxiliary equations, which removes the need for large paired datasets of converged reference solutions. When labeled reference data are available, an optional data-augmented variant (WINO+data) can further combine this physics-informed loss with a supervised term. After training, WINO outputs can seed the nonlinear $\varphi$-FEM solvers as neural operator warm starts (NOWS), which reduce iteration counts relative to traditional cold-started solvers. Numerical benchmarks show substantial accuracy of WINO together with total training times of about 15%-70% of those of supervised $\varphi$-FEM-FNO across all cases, without requiring reference-solution generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种弱形式物理信息神经算子（WINO），用于超弹性材料在可变域上的模拟。该方法将神经算子的效率与φ-FEM的几何灵活性相结合，通过无数据的方式训练，仅需最小化弱形式残差和cut-cell辅助方程，无需配对参考解数据。WINO输出还可作为非线性φ-FEM求解器的热启动，显著减少迭代次数。数值实验表明，WINO在保持精度的同时，训练时间仅为监督φ-FEM-FNO的15%-70%。
Motivation: 传统神经算子方法需要大量配对数据且难以适应几何变化，而基于网格的有限元方法在处理可变域时需重新生成网格。本文旨在结合神经算子的高效性和无网格方法φ-FEM的几何灵活性，避免数据依赖和网格生成开销。
Method: 提出WINO框架，采用φ-FEM的不适应网格方法，用水平集函数表示域几何。Dirichlet问题中通过φ-FEM提升只学习均匀位移分量；Neumann问题中额外预测辅助场。训练通过最小化与φ-FEM一致的弱形式残差平方以及cut-cell辅助方程的惩罚项来实现。可选的数据增强变体WINO+data可结合监督损失。训练后输出作为非线性φ-FEM求解器的神经算子热启动。
Result: 数值基准显示WINO具有显著精度，且训练时间约为监督φ-FEM-FNO的15%-70%，同时无需生成参考解。
Conclusion: 本文提出的WINO是一种无数据的神经算子方法，通过融合物理信息和φ-FEM实现了对可变域超弹性问题的准确高效求解。热启动策略进一步提升了非线性求解器的效率。

papers.title: Every Component is a Lookup: Token Attribution and Composition from a Single Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability of transformers requires identifying not just which components matter but how they compose into the computational route that produced a prediction. Both attention and MLP follow a shared key-value template $φ(S)U$. We exploit this structure to develop Unpack, a backward recursion that decomposes credit through both sublayers, producing interaction strengths between any two components, named end-to-end paths with K/Q/V composition labels, and per-token attribution, all from a single forward pass, without intervention, gradients, or auxiliary training. The interaction scores are causally grounded: across the Pythia-deduped family from 160M to 6.9B parameters, a component's score predicts the perplexity increase when its communication is ablated (within-layer Spearman $ρ= 0.72$ to $0.96$). The composition paths surface all three connections of the indirect-object-identification circuit of Wang et al. (2023), including the mode-specific routing of each: rerooting at the Name Mover heads, S-Inhibition is the strongest query-side input and falls to rank 10 on the key side, a distinction no single per-token or per-component score can express. The same procedure applied to the greater-than circuit of Hanna et al. (2023), a differently shaped circuit, places the named connections among the top contributors, once layer-0 writers, which carry large credit whatever they feed, are set aside. The decomposition reads out contribution under the realized computation; it complements, rather than performs, causal circuit discovery. The per-token readout is faithful under input perturbation, on par with dedicated attribution methods, and distinguishes circuit mechanism from surface identity: two occurrences of the same name receive radically different credit when only one drives the circuit. Code is available at https://github.com/Fun-Cry/unpacklm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Unpack，一种反向递归方法，通过一次前向传播即可分解 Transformer 中注意力和 MLP 子层的贡献，生成组件间的交互强度（端到端路径）和逐词归因，无需干预、梯度或辅助训练。在 Pythia-deduped 系列模型（160M 至 6.9B 参数）上，交互分数与消融实验的困惑度增加高度相关（层内 Spearman ρ=0.72 至 0.96）。该方法能够揭示间接宾语识别电路和大于电路中的组合模式，其逐词归因在输入扰动下具有忠实性，且能区分电路机制与表面身份。
Motivation: Transformer 的机械可解释性需要识别组件如何组合成计算路径，现有方法通常需要干预或梯度信息，且难以同时捕获逐组件和逐词归因。
Method: Unpack，一种反向递归分解（backward recursion），利用注意力和 MLP 共享的键值模板 φ(S)U，通过一次前向传播递归分解两个子层的贡献，生成带 K/Q/V 组合标签的端到端路径和逐词归因。
Result: 在 Pythia-deduped 系列模型上，组件交互分数与层内消融实验的困惑度增加高度相关（Spearman ρ=0.72-0.96）；成功复现间接宾语识别电路的三条连接及其模式特异性路由（如 S-Inhibition 在查询侧最强，在键侧排第 10 位）；在大于电路中，排除层 0 写入器后，命名连接位列前茅。
Conclusion: Unpack 提供了一种无需干预、梯度的分解方式，可忠实读取实现计算的贡献，补充而非替代因果电路发现。逐词归因在输入扰动下表现良好，但未声称与专用归因方法竞争。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FAME: Failure-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Message-Level Log Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Production systems generate millions of log lines daily, yet most anomaly detectors operate at the session or window-level, flagging groups of lines rather than identifying the specific message responsible. This coarse granularity forces operators to inspect many routine lines per alert. Message-level detection offers finer granularity, but remains challenging. A single event template may correspond to both normal and anomalous messages, failures arise from heterogeneous subsystems, and line-level labeling at scale is impractical. Although large language models (LLMs) can reason over log semantics, applying them to every line is too costly for continuous monitoring. We present FAME (Failure-Aware Mixture-of-Experts), a label-efficient message-level mixture-of-experts framework that uses an LLM only once offline. We annotate at most K labeled lines per template to derive binary normal/anomaly indicators and representative examples. The LLM proposes a partition of templates into failure domains, and a certification step validates the proposal before training. FAME trains a lightweight router and domain experts that run on-premise and output anomaly predictions and failure-domain labels. On BGL, FAME achieves F1 = 98.16 at K = 100 reducing annotation effort by 76x and detects 97.7% of anomalies from unseen EventIDs. On Thunderbird, FAME reaches F1 = 99.95 with perfect recall.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Software Reliability Engineering (ISSRE 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FAME，一种标签高效的消息级日志异常检测框架。它利用LLM仅离线一次，对每个模板标注最多K条日志，将模板划分为故障域，训练轻量级路由器和域专家。在BGL和Thunderbird数据集上实现了高F1分数和低标注成本。
Motivation: 现有日志异常检测方法多为会话或窗口级，无法定位具体日志行；消息级检测因标签困难和成本高而具有挑战。
Method: 使用LLM离线标注每个模板最多K条日志，LLM提出模板分区为故障域，经过验证后训练轻量级路由器和域专家，运行在本地。
Result: 在BGL上K=100时F1=98.16，标注成本降低76倍，检测97.7%来自未见EventID的异常；在Thunderbird上F1=99.95，召回率完美。
Conclusion: FAME在标注效率、细粒度检测和跨子系统泛化方面表现优异。

papers.title: SynGR: Unleashing the Potential of Cross-Modal Synergy for Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Generative Recommendation (GR) has emerged as a promising paradigm by formulating item recommendation as a sequence-to-sequence generation task over item identifiers. Recent studies have incorporated multimodal signals to provide richer token-level evidence for generation. However, existing approaches largely rely on alignment-centric fusion and underexplore synergistic information across modalities. In practice, synergistic information plays a critical role in capturing emergent item properties that cannot be inferred from any single modality alone. Such properties encode intrinsic item semantics and guide user preferences, enabling models to move beyond surface-level feature matching. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{SynGR}, a synergistic generative recommendation framework that explicitly encourages the exploitation of cross-modal dependencies during generation. By constraining overreliance on dominant modalities, SynGR enables the model to capture emergent item semantics beyond shared or modality-specific signals. Extensive experiments across three benchmark datasets demonstrate that SynGR achieves superior performance.

papers.title: When Cultures Move: Measuring and Improving Multicultural Text-to-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-video (T2V) generation has rapidly progressed in visual fidelity, yet its ability to faithfully represent multiple cultures within a single prompt remains underexplored. We introduce MAVEN, a multi-agent prompt refinement framework designed to improve cultural fidelity in both mono-cultural and cross-cultural T2V generation. MAVEN decomposes prompts into person, action, and location dimensions, handled by specialized agents operating in parallel or sequentially. To support systematic evaluation, we contribute a new benchmark of 243 culturally grounded prompts and 972 corresponding videos, spanning three cultures (Chinese, American, Romanian), three action categories, and both mono-cultural and cross-cultural scenarios. Evaluations combining CLIP-based metrics, VLM-as-judge assessments, and videoquality measures show that multi-agent refinement, particularly parallel specialization, significantly improves cultural relevance while preserving visual quality and temporal consistency. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/AIM-SCU/MAVEN
papers.comment: [14] pages, [6] figures, [11] tables, appendix included. Preprint
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MAVEN，一个多智能体提示精炼框架，旨在提高文生视频（T2V）跨文化生成中的文化忠实度。MAVEN将提示分解为人物、动作和地点三个维度，由专门智能体并行或顺序处理。作者创建了一个包含243个文化提示和972个视频的新基准，涵盖中国、美国、罗马尼亚三种文化以及单文化和跨文化场景。评估表明，多智能体精炼（特别是并行专业化）能在保持视觉质量和时间一致性的同时显著提升文化相关性。
Motivation: 现有文生视频模型在视觉保真度上进步迅速，但针对单一提示同时忠实呈现多种文化的能力尚缺乏系统研究。
Method: 提出MAVEN框架，使用多个智能体分别处理提示中的人物、动作和地点维度，支持并行和顺序两种精炼模式；并构建了包含243个文化提示和972个视频的评估基准。
Result: 结合CLIP指标、VLM-as-judge评估和视频质量度量，并行专业化模式在提升文化相关性上显著优于基线，且视觉质量和时间一致性未受损。
Conclusion: 多智能体提示分解能有效改善跨文化文生视频的文化忠实度，并行专业化策略最优。

papers.title: Does RAG Know When Retrieval Is Wrong? Diagnosing Context Compliance under Knowledge Conflict
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is usually evaluated by whether the final answer is correct. Under knowledge conflict, this hides a key question: did the model follow retrieved evidence, rely on its parametric prior, or produce a post-hoc rationale? We study this as context compliance, the regime in which retrieved context controls the answer even when it conflicts with the model's prior knowledge. We introduce Context-Driven Decomposition (CDD), an inference-time diagnostic intervention that elicits contextual and prior answers, isolates the conflicting premise, and records a resolution trace that can be perturbed. Across Epi-Scale stress tests, TruthfulQA misconception injection, and cross-model reruns, CDD makes three behaviors visible. First, misleading retrieval can severely degrade accuracy: under a worst-case TruthfulQA misconception-injection probe, Standard RAG reaches only 15.0%. Second, better answers need not share the same mechanism: CDD improves adversarial accuracy on Gemini-2.5-Flash and shows directional gains across Claude variants, yet trace-perturbation sensitivity is high only on Gemini. Third, explicit decomposition improves controlled-conflict robustness over a conflict-aware instruction baseline on localized factual conflicts, with the clearest margins on Entity Swap (88.0% vs 79.3%) and Logical Contradiction (83.2% vs 75.4%). We frame RAG conflict handling as an observability problem.
papers.comment: Preprint. 3 figures, 3 tables. Diagnostic study of context compliance in RAG under knowledge conflict; closed-API evaluations (Gemini-2.5-Flash and Claude family)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究检索增强生成（RAG）在知识冲突下的上下文合规性问题，即模型是否真正遵循检索到的上下文而非依赖参数记忆。提出上下文驱动分解（CDD）诊断方法，通过提取上下文答案和先验答案、隔离冲突前提并记录可扰动的解析轨迹，揭示三种行为：误导性检索严重降低准确率（TruthfulQA上仅15.0%）；更好的答案不一定基于相同机制（Gemini-2.5-Flash敏感度高而Claude变体低）；显式分解在本地事实冲突上优于冲突感知指令基线。
Motivation: 现有RAG评估仅关注最终答案正确性，忽略了在知识冲突下模型是否真正遵循检索证据、依赖参数记忆或生成事后理由，缺乏对模型行为的透明度诊断。
Method: 提出上下文驱动分解（CDD），一种推理时诊断干预方法，通过提取上下文和先验答案、隔离冲突前提并生成可扰动的解析轨迹，以观测模型在知识冲突下的行为。
Result: 在极端压力测试和TruthfulQA误导注入下，标准RAG准确率仅15.0%；CDD在Gemini-2.5-Flash上提升对抗准确率，但轨迹扰动敏感性仅对Gemini高；CDD在实体交换（88.0% vs 79.3%）和逻辑矛盾（83.2% vs 75.4%）上优于冲突感知指令基线。
Conclusion: 将RAG冲突处理视为可观测性问题，强调诊断上下文合规性对理解模型行为的重要性，指出更好的答案不一定共享相同机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Zoom In, Reason Out: Efficient Far-field Anomaly Detection in Expressway Surveillance Videos via Focused VLM Reasoning Guided by Bayesian Inference
papers.abstract_en: Expressway video anomaly detection is essential for safety management. However, identifying anomalies across diverse scenes remains challenging, particularly for far-field targets exhibiting subtle abnormal vehicle motions. While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate strong semantic reasoning capabilities, processing global frames causes attention dilution for these far-field objects and incurs prohibitive computational costs. To address these issues, we propose VIBES, an asynchronous collaborative framework utilizing VLMs guided by Bayesian inference. Specifically, to overcome poor generalization across varying expressway environments, we introduce an online Bayesian inference module. This module continuously evaluates vehicle trajectories to dynamically update the probabilistic boundaries of normal driving behaviors, serving as an asynchronous trigger to precisely localize anomalies in space and time. Instead of processing the continuous video stream, the VLM processes only the localized visual regions indicated by the trigger. This targeted visual input prevents attention dilution and enables accurate semantic reasoning. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that VIBES improves detection accuracy for far-field anomalies and reduces computational overhead, achieving high real-time efficiency and explainability while demonstrating generalization across diverse expressway conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VIBES框架，利用贝叶斯推理指导的视觉语言模型（VLM）实现高速公路监控视频中远距离目标的异常检测。该框架通过在线贝叶斯模块动态评估车辆轨迹，更新正常驾驶行为的概率边界，并仅触发VLM处理局部异常区域，从而避免注意力稀释并降低计算开销。实验表明，VIBES在远距离异常检测精度上优于现有方法，同时保持高实时性和可解释性。
Motivation: 现有VLM处理全局视频帧时，远距离目标的异常行为易被注意力稀释，且计算成本高昂；同时，传统方法在不同高速公路场景下泛化能力差。
Method: 提出VIBES异步协作框架：在线贝叶斯推理模块持续评估车辆轨迹，动态更新正常驾驶行为的概率边界，作为触发器精确定位异常时空区域；VLM仅处理触发器定位的局部视觉区域，进行语义推理。
Result: 摘要报告VIBES提升了远距离异常检测精度，降低了计算开销，实现了高实时性和可解释性，并在多种高速公路条件下展示出泛化能力。
Conclusion: VIBES通过贝叶斯引导的VLM专注局部推理，有效解决了远距离异常检测中的注意力稀释和计算开销问题，适用于实际高速公路监控。

papers.title: Information-Theoretic Measures in AI: A Practical Decision Framework
papers.abstract_en: Information-theoretic (IT) measures are ubiquitous in artificial intelligence: entropy drives decision-tree splits and uncertainty quantification, cross-entropy is the default classification loss, mutual information underpins representation learning and feature selection, and transfer entropy reveals directed influence in dynamical systems. Despite wide adoption, measure selection is often decoupled from estimator assumptions, failure modes, and safe inferential claims. This survey provides a practical decision framework for four foundational measures - Entropy, KL divergence/cross-entropy, Mutual Information, and Transfer Entropy - organized around three prescriptive questions for each: (i) what question does the measure answer and in which AI context; (ii) which estimator is appropriate for the data type and dimensionality; and (iii) what is the most dangerous misuse. The framework is operationalized in two complementary artifacts: a measure-selection flowchart and a master decision table. We cover both AI/ML and decision-making agent application domains per measure, with standardized Bridge notes linking IT quantities to cognitive and neuroscientific constructs. Two worked examples illustrate the framework on concrete practitioner scenarios spanning representation learning and temporal influence analysis, and a reproducible multi-agent case study across three learning architectures validates the transfer-entropy surrogate-testing guardrail against a null control.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 2 tables, 4 figures. Submitted to Artificial Intelligence Review, Springer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为信息论（IT）度量在AI中的应用提供了一个实用决策框架，围绕四个基础度量（熵、KL散度/交叉熵、互信息、传递熵）提出三个规范性指导问题：度量回答什么问题、适用于何种数据类型和维度的估计器、最危险的误用。框架以流程图和决策表形式呈现，并包含两个工作示例和一个可复现的多智能体案例研究。
Motivation: 尽管IT度量在AI中广泛使用，但度量的选择常常与估计器假设、失败模式和安全推断脱节，缺乏系统性指导。
Method: 提出一个决策框架，围绕四个基础度量，针对每个度量回答三个问题：问题背景、估计器选择、误用风险。提供选择流程图和主决策表，并引入Bridge符号将IT量与认知和神经科学概念关联。
Result: 框架通过两个工作示例（表示学习与时间影响分析）和三个学习架构上的多智能体案例研究进行了验证，证明了传递熵替代测试护栏相对于零对照的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架帮助从业者在AI/ML和决策智能体应用中做出明智的IT度量选择，并识别危险误用。

papers.title: Sketching the Readout of Large Language Models for Scalable Data Attribution and Valuation
papers.abstract_en: Data attribution and valuation are critical for understanding data-model synergy for Large Language Models (LLMs), yet existing gradient-based methods suffer from scalability challenges on LLMs. Inspired by human cognition, where decision making relies on a focused readout of relevant memories rather than replaying all pathways, we introduce RISE (Readout Influence Sketching Estimator). Instead of computing and indexing gradients across the entire LLM, RISE focuses on influence hotspots at the output layer, where influence signals concentrate, and the gradient admits a decomposed outer-product form. This enables a dual-channel representation combining a lexical residual channel (RH) and a semantic projected-error channel (GH). Applying CountSketch projections to these channels achieves strong compression while maintaining accurate attribution. Across the OLMo (1B-32B) and Pythia (14M-6.9B) families, RISE reduces index storage by up to 112$\times$ compared to RapidIn and scales to 32B parameters LLM, where gradient-based baselines such as RapidIn and ZO-Inf become memory-infeasible. We evaluate RISE on two paradigms: (1) retrospective attribution, retrieving influential training examples for specific predictions, and (2) prospective valuation, scoring candidate data utility zero-shot. We validate RISE on three tasks: Howdy backdoor data detection, Finance-Medical domain separation, and Brain Rot high-quality data selection. In a closed-loop Brain Rot study, continued pretraining on RISE-selected data yields consistent downstream improvements. Overall, RISE provides a practical and scalable primitive for influence analysis and training-data selection in modern large language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RISE (Readout Influence Sketching Estimator)，一种可扩展的 LLM 数据归因与估值方法。该方法受人类认知启发，仅关注输出层的影响热点，利用输出层梯度的外积分解和 CountSketch 投影实现高效压缩。在 OLMo (1B-32B) 和 Pythia (14M-6.9B) 系列上，索引存储相比 RapidIn 减少 112 倍，并支持 32B 参数模型。在 Howdy 后门检测、金融-医学领域分离和 Brain Rot 高质量数据选择任务中验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有基于梯度的数据归因方法在大型语言模型上存在可扩展性挑战，计算和存储开销巨大，限制了实际应用。
Method: 提出 RISE，利用输出层梯度可分解为外积的形式，构建双通道表示：词汇残差通道 (RH) 和语义投影误差通道 (GH)，并通过 CountSketch 投影进行压缩，从而避免计算和索引全模型梯度。
Result: 在 OLMo (1B-32B) 和 Pythia (14M-6.9B) 上，索引存储减少高达 112 倍；成功扩展到 32B 参数模型，而梯度基线方法（如 RapidIn 和 ZO-Inf）因内存不足不可行；在闭环 Brain Rot 实验中，RISE 选择的数据进行继续预训练带来一致的下游提升。

papers.title: Frequency-Corrupt Based Graph Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Graph self-supervised learning can reduce the need for labeled graph data and has been widely used in recommendation, social networks, and other web applications. However, existing methods often underuse high-frequency signals and may overfit to specific local patterns, which limits representation quality and generalization. We propose Frequency-Corrupt Based Graph Self-Supervised Learning (FC-GSSL), a method that builds corrupted graphs biased toward high-frequency information by corrupting nodes and edges according to their low-frequency contributions. These corrupted graphs are used as inputs to an autoencoder, while low-frequency and general features are reconstructed as supervision targets, forcing the model to fuse information from multiple frequency bands. We further design multiple sampling strategies and generate diverse corrupted graphs from the intersections and unions of the sampling results. By aligning node representations from these views, the model can discover useful frequency combinations, reduce reliance on specific high-frequency components, and improve robustness. Experiments on 14 datasets across node classification, graph prediction, and transfer learning show that FC-GSSL consistently improves performance and generalization.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 4 tables, 3 figures. Accepted at The ACM Web Conference 2026 (WWW 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于频率破坏的图自监督学习方法（FC-GSSL），通过破坏节点和边的低频贡献来构造偏向高频的破坏图，并利用自编码器重建低频和通用特征，强制模型融合多频带信息。在14个数据集上的节点分类、图预测和迁移学习任务中，该方法一致提升了性能和泛化能力。

papers.title: MinShap: A Shapley-Based Framework for Feature Redundancy
papers.abstract_en: Shapley values provide a flexible framework for attributing feature contributions to model predictions, but they are not naturally suited for feature selection: a feature may receive a positive attribution even when it is redundant given the remaining variables. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{MinShap}, a general framework for identifying \emph{important} or \emph{non-redundant} features through conditional importance functionals $VI_j^S$. Rather than averaging feature contributions across conditioning sets, MinShap aggregates them using the \emph{minimum}, thereby testing whether a feature remains relevant under every conditioning context. We show that, under a simple \emph{null monotonicity} condition, the minimum aggregation exactly characterizes feature redundancy and yields a principled feature selection criterion. This perspective provides a unified framework for statistical feature selection and representation-based interpretability while retaining the stability advantages of Shapley-style aggregation. We develop scalable algorithms with statistical guarantees, establish connections to multiple-testing procedures, and demonstrate through theory and experiments that MinShap produces more accurate and stable feature selection than existing model-agnostic approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MinShap框架，通过条件重要性泛函VI_j^S的最小值聚合来识别非冗余特征，解决Shapley值在特征选择中无法检测冗余性的问题。在零单调性条件下，最小值聚合精确刻画特征冗余并提供特征选择准则。理论建立与多重检验的联系，实验表明MinShap比现有模型无关方法更准确稳定。
Motivation: Shapley值适用于解释模型预测，但不能直接用于特征选择：一个特征即使在其余变量下冗余仍可能获得正向归因。
Method: MinShap通过条件重要性泛函的最小值聚合（而非平均）来测试特征是否在每个条件上下文中保持相关，从而识别非冗余特征。
Result: 理论证明零单调性条件下最小值聚合准确刻画冗余性，并提供可扩展算法和统计保证；实验显示比现有模型无关方法更精确和稳定的特征选择。
Conclusion: MinShap为统计特征选择和可解释性提供统一框架，同时保持Shapley式聚合的稳定性优势。

papers.title: When Does Visual Token Pruning Improve Calibration? The Role of Evidence Coverage in MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Visual token pruning is widely used to reduce the inference cost of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), but it is usually evaluated only by accuracy. We study how pruning affects calibration, defined as the agreement between confidence and correctness, and show that the selection rule matters more than the token budget alone. On POPE with LLaVA-1.5, coverage-based pruning from 576 to 128 tokens reduces expected calibration error from 0.041 to 0.016 without a statistically significant accuracy loss. In contrast, attention-based selection preserves confidence while accuracy deteriorates, becoming less calibrated than random pruning at aggressive budgets. Across pruning conditions, kept-set coverage is strongly associated with accuracy (Spearman $ρ=+0.89$) but not with mean confidence ($ρ=-0.03$), producing a strong inverse relation with overconfidence ($ρ=-0.92$); controlled kept-set interventions support this evidence-coverage account. Two boundaries limit it: query-conditioned FastV is more overconfident than its coverage predicts, and on language-prior-dominated ScienceQA, coverage ceases to order calibration. The selector ordering otherwise generalizes to GQA and LLaVA-NeXT, and coverage beats random on Qwen2-VL, although the calibration gain over the unpruned model is task- and model-dependent. We also identify an evaluation pitfall in FastV: zeroing rather than removing pruned tokens can reduce accuracy to chance. Visual token pruning therefore changes confidence quality as well as efficiency, and calibration should be evaluated alongside accuracy when comparing pruning methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中视觉token剪枝对校准（confidence与correctness的匹配）的影响，发现剪枝的选择规则比预算更重要。基于覆盖度（evidence coverage）的剪枝在LLaVA-1.5上从576降至128 tokens时，将期望校准误差从0.041降至0.016，且准确率无显著下降，而基于注意力的剪枝会恶化校准。剪枝后的token覆盖度与准确率强相关（Spearman ρ=+0.89），但与平均置信度不相关（ρ=-0.03），因此与过度置信度呈强负相关（ρ=-0.92）。但存在两个边界：FastV的查询条件（query-conditioned）比覆盖度预测的更过度置信；在语言先验主导的ScienceQA上，覆盖度不再能排序校准。该结论在GQA和LLaVA-NeXT上泛化，覆盖度方法在Qwen2-VL上优于随机剪枝。此外，FastV中将剪枝token置零而非移除会严重降低准确率。因此，评估剪枝方法时应同时考虑校准和效率。
Motivation: 现有视觉token剪枝研究仅以准确率评估，忽略了剪枝对模型置信度校准的影响，而校准对于可信赖AI至关重要。
Method: 通过实验对比不同剪枝规则（覆盖度 vs. 注意力 vs. 随机）在不同预算下对校准和准确率的影响，并分析覆盖度与校准指标的关系。
Result: 在POPE数据集上，覆盖度剪枝（576→128 tokens）使ECE从0.041降至0.016，准确率无显著下降；注意力剪枝则导致校准恶化。覆盖度与准确率强相关（ρ=+0.89），与过度置信度强负相关（ρ=-0.92）。
Conclusion: 视觉token剪枝不仅影响效率，也影响置信度质量，在比较剪枝方法时应同时评估校准和准确率。覆盖度是一个关键解释变量，但存在模型和任务依赖的边界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MedLVR: Latent Visual Reasoning for Reliable Medical Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Medical vision--language models (VLMs) have shown strong potential for medical visual question answering (VQA), yet their reasoning remains largely text-centric: images are encoded once as static context, and subsequent inference is dominated by language. This paradigm is fundamentally limited in clinical scenarios, where accurate answers often depend on subtle, localized visual evidence that cannot be reliably preserved in static embeddings. We propose \textsc{MedLVR}, a latent visual reasoning framework that introduces an explicit visual evidence state into autoregressive decoding. Instead of relying solely on text-based intermediate reasoning, \textsc{MedLVR} interleaves a short latent reasoning segment within the decoder by reusing hidden states as continuous latent steps, enabling iterative preservation and refinement of query-relevant visual evidence before answer generation. To support effective visual supervision, we adopt a two-stage training strategy: region of interest (ROI)-supervised fine-tuning aligns latent states with clinically relevant image evidence, and Visual-Latent Policy Optimization (VLPO) further optimizes latent reasoning and answer generation under outcome-level rewards. Experiments on OmniMedVQA and five external medical VQA benchmarks show that \textsc{MedLVR} consistently outperforms recent reasoning baselines and improves the average score over the Qwen2.5-VL-7B backbone from 48.3\% to 53.4\%. These results show that latent visual reasoning provides an effective mechanism for preserving diagnostically relevant visual evidence and improving the reliability of medical VQA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedLVR，一个用于医学视觉问答的潜在视觉推理框架。通过在自回归解码中引入显式的视觉证据状态，利用隐藏状态作为连续潜在步骤来迭代保留和细化与查询相关的视觉证据。采用两阶段训练策略：ROI监督微调和对齐潜在状态，以及视觉-潜在策略优化。在 OmniMedVQA 和五个外部基准上，MedLVR 一致优于近期推理基线，并将 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 骨干的平均得分从 48.3% 提升至 53.4%。
Motivation: 现有医学视觉语言模型推理以文本为中心，图像被编码为静态上下文，后续推理由语言主导，难以精准捕捉临床场景中微小且局部的视觉证据。
Method: 提出潜在视觉推理框架 MedLVR，在解码器中插入一个短的潜在推理段，重用隐藏状态作为连续潜在步骤，实现视觉证据的迭代保存和细化。训练分为两阶段：ROI监督微调对齐潜在状态与临床相关证据，以及视觉-潜在策略优化优化潜在推理和答案生成。
Result: 在 OmniMedVQA 和五个外部医学 VQA 基准上，MedLVR 一致优于近期推理基线，将 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 骨干的平均得分从 48.3% 提升至 53.4%。
Conclusion: 潜在视觉推理为保留诊断相关视觉证据和提高医学 VQA 可靠性提供了有效机制。

papers.title: Spectral-Transport Stability and Benign Overfitting in Interpolating Learning
papers.abstract_en: We develop a theoretical framework for generalization in the interpolating regime of statistical learning. The central question is why highly overparameterized estimators can attain zero empirical risk while still achieving nontrivial predictive accuracy, and how to characterize the boundary between benign and destructive overfitting. We introduce a spectral-transport stability framework in which excess risk is controlled jointly by the spectral geometry of the data distribution, the sensitivity of the learning rule under single-sample replacement, and the alignment structure of label noise. This leads to a scale-dependent Fredriksson index that combines effective dimension, transport stability, and noise alignment into a single complexity parameter for interpolating estimators. We prove finite-sample risk bounds, establish a sharp benign-overfitting criterion through the vanishing of the index along admissible spectral scales, and derive explicit phase-transition rates under polynomial spectral decay. For a model-specific specialization, we obtain an explicit theorem for polynomial-spectrum linear interpolation, together with a proof of the resulting rate. The framework also clarifies implicit regularization by showing how optimization dynamics can select interpolating solutions of minimal spectral-transport energy. These results connect algorithmic stability, double descent, benign overfitting, operator-theoretic learning theory, and implicit bias within a unified structural account of modern interpolation.
papers.comment: The authors are withdrawing this preprint due to a technical error discovered in the proof of Lemma 4.2 (Replacement Symmetrization) in Appendix B.2. Specifically, the expansion of the ghost-averaged estimator in the covariance operator's eigenbasis contains a dependency step that invalidates the finite-sample master bound in Theorem 4.3
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出了一个谱-传输稳定性（spectral-transport stability）框架，用于解释插值学习（interpolating learning）中过参数化估计器为何在零经验风险下仍能获得非平凡预测精度，并刻画良性过拟合与破坏性过拟合的边界。论文证明了有限样本风险界，建立了通过Fredriksson指数消失来判定的良性过拟合准则，并推导了多项式谱衰减下的相变率。然而，作者已因引理4.2证明中的技术错误而撤回本文。
Motivation: 理解高度过参数化的插值学习器为何能在零训练误差下实现良好的泛化性能，并区分良性过拟合与破坏性过拟合的条件。
Method: 引入谱-传输稳定性框架，通过数据的谱几何、学习规则在单样本替换下的稳定性（transport stability）以及标签噪声的对齐结构联合控制过量风险，并定义了尺度相关的Fredriksson指数。
Result: 证明了有限样本风险界，建立了良性过拟合的精确准则（Fredriksson指数沿允许谱尺度消失），并在多项式谱衰减下得到显式相变率；对多项式谱线性插值得出显式定理。

papers.title: CMCC-ReID: Cross-Modality Clothing-Change Person Re-Identification
papers.abstract_en: Person Re-Identification (ReID) faces severe challenges from modality discrepancy and clothing variation in long-term surveillance scenario. While existing studies have made significant progress in either Visible-Infrared ReID (VI-ReID) or Clothing-Change ReID (CC-ReID), real-world surveillance system often face both challenges simultaneously. To address this overlooked yet realistic problem, we define a new task, termed Cross-Modality Clothing-Change Re-Identification (CMCC-ReID), which targets pedestrian matching across variations in both modality and clothing. To advance research in this direction, we construct a new benchmark SYSU-CMCC, where each identity is captured in both visible and infrared domains with distinct outfits, reflecting the dual heterogeneity of long-term surveillance. To tackle CMCC-ReID, we propose a Progressive Identity Alignment Network (PIA) that progressively mitigates the issues of clothing variation and modality discrepancy. Specifically, a Dual-Branch Disentangling Learning (DBDL) module separates identity-related cues from clothing-related factors to achieve clothing-agnostic representation, and a Bi-Directional Prototype Learning (BPL) module performs intra-modality and inter-modality contrast in the embedding space to bridge the modality gap while further suppressing clothing interference. Extensive experiments on the SYSU-CMCC dataset demonstrate that PIA establishes a strong baseline for this new task and significantly outperforms existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文定义了一个新任务——跨模态换衣行人重识别（CMCC-ReID），并构建了基准数据集SYSU-CMCC。提出渐进式身份对齐网络（PIA），通过双分支解耦学习和双向原型学习来同时处理模态差异和服装变化。实验表明PIA建立了强基线。
Motivation: 现有研究分别处理可见光-红外ReID或换衣ReID，但实际监控场景中两者常同时出现，该问题被忽略。
Method: 提出PIA网络，包含双分支解耦学习（DBDL）模块分离身份与服装特征，以及双向原型学习（BPL）模块在嵌入空间内进行模态内和模态间对比以缩小模态差距并抑制服装干扰。
Result: 在SYSU-CMCC数据集上，PIA显著优于现有方法，为该新任务建立了强基线。
Conclusion: 论文提出了一个新的ReID子任务和基准，PIA证明了同时处理模态和服装变化的可行性。

papers.title: Stochastic Dimension Zeroth-Order Estimator: Stable and Memory-Efficient Training of PINNs
papers.abstract_en: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) for high-dimensional and high-order partial differential equations (PDEs) are primarily constrained by the $\mathcal{O}(d^k)$ spatial derivative complexity and the $\mathcal{O}(P)$ memory overhead of backpropagation (BP). While randomized spatial estimators successfully reduce the spatial complexity to $\mathcal{O}(1)$, their reliance on first-order optimization still leads to prohibitive memory consumption at scale. Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization offers a BP-free alternative; however, naively combining randomized spatial operators with ZO perturbations triggers a variance explosion of $\mathcal{O}(1/\varepsilon^2)$, leading to numerical divergence. To address these challenges, we propose the \textbf{S}tochastic \textbf{D}imension-free \textbf{Z}eroth-order \textbf{E}stimator (\textbf{SDZE}), a unified framework that achieves dimension-independent complexity in both space and memory. Specifically, SDZE leverages \emph{Common Random Numbers Synchronization (CRNS)} to algebraically cancel the $\mathcal{O}(1/\varepsilon^2)$ variance by locking spatial random seeds across perturbations. Furthermore, an \emph{implicit matrix-free subspace projection} is introduced to reduce parameter exploration variance from $\mathcal{O}(P)$ to $\mathcal{O}(r)$ while maintaining an $\mathcal{O}(1)$ optimizer memory footprint. Empirical results demonstrate that SDZE enables the training of 10-million-dimensional PINNs on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU, delivering significant improvements in speed and memory efficiency over state-of-the-art baselines.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SDZE（随机无维度零阶估计器），一种统一框架，用于高效训练物理信息神经网络（PINNs），解决高维和高阶偏微分方程中的空间导数复杂度 O(d^k) 和反向传播内存开销 O(P) 问题。SDZE 通过公共随机数同步（CRNS）消除零阶扰动与随机空间算子结合时的方差爆炸，并引入隐式矩阵无关子空间投影将参数探索方差从 O(P) 降至 O(r)，同时保持优化器内存为 O(1)。实验表明，SDZE 可在单个 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上训练千万维度的 PINNs，在速度和内存效率上显著优于现有基线。
Motivation: 高维高阶 PINNs 训练受限于空间导数复杂度 O(d^k) 和反向传播内存开销 O(P)。现有随机空间估计器虽降低空间复杂度但内存消耗仍大；直接结合零阶优化与随机算子会引发 O(1/ε²) 方差爆炸，导致数值发散。
Method: 提出随机无维度零阶估计器（SDZE），包含两个关键技术：公共随机数同步（CRNS）通过锁定空间随机种子代数消除 O(1/ε²) 方差；隐式矩阵无关子空间投影将参数探索方差从 O(P) 降至 O(r)，且优化器内存保持 O(1)。
Result: 在单个 A100 GPU 上成功训练 1000 万维度的 PINNs，与现有基线相比在训练速度和内存效率上获得显著提升。
Conclusion: SDZE 实现了空间和内存复杂度与维度无关，为高维 PINNs 训练提供了稳定且内存高效的方案。

papers.title: The Truncation Blind Spot: How Decoding Strategies Systematically Exclude Human-Like Token Choices
papers.abstract_en: Why does machine-generated text remain detectable? We trace the answer to the decoding stage: standard strategies such as top-$k$ and nucleus sampling restrict generation to high-probability tokens, while human writers routinely choose words that are contextually apt yet rank low under a model's next-token distribution. Truncation therefore renders a measurable share of human word choices unreachable; we call this set the truncation blind spot. Across five open models and three domains, 8--18\% of human-selected tokens fall outside common truncation boundaries, with content words excluded at 2.9 times the rate of function words. As a consequence, simple classifiers using two features separate 1.8 million machine generations from human text at mean AUC-ROC near 0.97, and detectability tracks truncation intensity rather than model scale, architecture, or alignment. Probability-floor samplers substantially narrow the blind spot, and generation experiments confirm the exclusion--detectability link out of sample. Code, data, and the measurement harness are released at https://github.com/EstebanGarces/human_vs_machine.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现标准解码策略（如top-k和核采样）会系统地排除人类常用但模型概率低的token，形成“截断盲点”。在五个开源模型和三个领域上，8–18%的人类选择token被截断，内容词被排除率是功能词的2.9倍。基于两个特征的简单分类器能以AUC-ROC约0.97区分机器与人类文本，且可检测性随截断强度而非模型规模变化。概率地板采样可有效缩小盲点。
Motivation: 机器生成文本仍能被轻易检测，但原因不明；传统观点归因于模型能力或训练数据，本文质疑解码阶段的截断策略是根本原因。
Method: 定义并量化“截断盲点”（truncation blind spot），即被top-k/核采样排除的人类token集合；通过对比人类选择与模型分布，分析截断对内容词和功能词的不同影响；利用概率地板采样（probability-floor sampling）作为缓解方案，并设计分类实验验证检测性与截断强度的关联。
Result: 在五个模型和三个领域（约1.8M生成样本）中，8–18%的人类token不在截断边界内；内容词被排除率是功能词的2.9倍；仅用两个特征的分类器达到AUC-ROC≈0.97；可检测性由截断强度决定，与模型规模、架构或对齐无关。
Conclusion: 截断是机器文本可检测性的核心来源，而非模型能力；概率地板采样能有效缩小盲点，降低可检测性。

papers.title: HiMemVLN: Enhancing Reliability of Open-Source Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation with Hierarchical Memory System
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents have demonstrated impressive zero-shot performance in vision-language navigation (VLN) tasks. However, most zero-shot methods primarily rely on closed-source LLMs as navigators, which face challenges related to high token costs and potential data leakage risks. Recent efforts have attempted to address this by using open-source LLMs combined with a spatiotemporal CoT framework, but they still fall far short compared to closed-source models. In this work, we identify a critical issue, Navigation Amnesia, through a detailed analysis of the navigation process. This issue leads to navigation failures and amplifies the gap between open-source and closed-source methods. To address this, we propose HiMemVLN, which incorporates a Hierarchical Memory System into a multimodal large model to enhance visual perception recall and long-term localization, mitigating the amnesia issue and improving the agent's navigation performance. Extensive experiments in both simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that HiMemVLN achieves nearly twice the performance of the open-source state-of-the-art method. The code is available at https://github.com/lvkailin0118/HiMemVLN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对开放源代码零样本视觉语言导航（VLN）中出现的“导航遗忘”问题，提出了一种层次记忆系统（Hierarchical Memory System）HiMemVLN，整合到多模态大模型中，以增强视觉感知回忆和长期定位。实验表明，在模拟和真实环境中，该方法性能接近开放源代码最先进方法的两倍。
Motivation: 现有零样本VLN方法大多依赖封闭源代码LLM，面临高token成本和数据泄露风险；开放源代码方法结合时空CoT框架仍远落后。作者通过分析发现导航过程中的“导航遗忘”问题导致失败并扩大差距。
Method: 提出HiMemVLN，包含层次记忆系统，嵌入多模态大模型，增强视觉感知回忆和长期定位，缓解遗忘问题。
Result: 在模拟和真实环境中，HiMemVLN的性能几乎是开放源代码最先进方法的两倍。
Conclusion: 该方法有效提升了开放源代码零样本VLN的可靠性，代码已开源。

papers.title: Seeing Where to Deploy: Metric RGB-Based Traversability Analysis for Aerial-to-Ground Hidden Space Inspection
papers.abstract_en: Inspection of confined infrastructure such as culverts often requires accessing hidden spaces whose entrances are reachable primarily from elevated viewpoints. Aerial-ground cooperation enables a UAV to deploy a compact UGV for interior exploration, but selecting a suitable deployment region from aerial observations requires metric terrain reasoning involving scale ambiguity, reconstruction uncertainty, and terrain semantics. We present a metric RGB-based geometric-semantic reconstruction and traversability analysis framework for aerial-to-ground hidden space inspection. A feed-forward multi-view RGB reconstruction backbone produces dense geometry, while temporally consistent semantic segmentation yields a 3D semantic map. To enable deployment-relevant measurements without requiring LiDAR-based dense mapping, we introduce an embodied motion prior that recovers metric scale by aligning predicted camera motion with onboard platform egomotion. From the metrically grounded reconstruction, we construct a confidence-aware geometric-semantic traversability map and evaluate candidate deployment zones under reachability constraints. Experiments on a tethered UAV-UGV platform demonstrate reliable deployment-zone identification in hidden space scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对涵洞等受限基础设施的检查，提出一种基于RGB图像的公制几何-语义重建与可通行性分析框架，用于无人机部署无人车进入隐蔽空间。该方法利用前馈多视图RGB重建骨干生成密集几何，结合时间一致语义分割得到3D语义地图，并通过运动先验恢复公制尺度。实验表明在系留UAV-UGV平台上能可靠识别部署区域。
Motivation: 隐蔽空间入口通常需要从高处视角进入，无人机可从空中观察并部署小无人车，但选择合适部署区域需要公制地形推理，涉及尺度模糊、重建不确定性和地形语义。
Method: 提出公制RGB几何-语义重建与可通行性分析框架：前馈多视图RGB重建生成密集几何，时间一致语义分割生成3D语义地图；引入具身运动先验，通过对齐预测相机运动与平台自身运动恢复公制尺度；构建置信度感知的几何-语义可通行性地图，在可达性约束下评估候选部署区域。
Result: 在系留UAV-UGV平台上实验，证明在隐蔽空间场景下能可靠识别部署区域。
Conclusion: 该方法无需LiDAR密集建图即可实现部署相关测量，适用于空中-地面协同的隐秘空间检查。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出公制RGB几何-语义重建与可通行性分析框架：前馈多视图RGB重建生成密集几何，时间一致语义分割生成3D语义地图；引入具身运动先验，通过对齐预测相机运动与平台自身运动恢复公制尺度；构建置信度感知的几何-语义可通行性地图，在可达性约束下评估候选部署区域。
summary_sections.result: 在系留UAV-UGV平台上实验，证明在隐蔽空间场景下能可靠识别部署区域。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法无需LiDAR密集建图即可实现部署相关测量，适用于空中-地面协同的隐秘空间检查。

papers.title: From Heuristic Selection to Automated Algorithm Design: LLMs Benefit from Strong Priors
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have already been widely adopted for automated algorithm design, demonstrating strong abilities in generating and evolving algorithms across various fields. Existing work has largely focused on examining their effectiveness in solving specific problems, with search strategies primarily guided by adaptive prompt designs. In this paper, through investigating the token-wise attribution of the prompts to LLM-generated algorithmic codes, we show that providing high-quality algorithmic code examples can substantially improve the performance of the LLM-driven optimization. Building upon this insight, we propose leveraging prior benchmark algorithms to guide LLM-driven optimization and demonstrate superior performance on two black-box optimization benchmarks: the pseudo-Boolean optimization suite (pbo) and the black-box optimization suite (bbob). Our findings highlight the value of integrating benchmarking studies to enhance both efficiency and robustness of the LLM-driven black-box optimization methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM驱动的自动算法设计，通过分析token层级归因发现提供高质量算法代码示例能显著提升性能，提出利用先验基准算法引导LLM优化，在伪布尔优化和黑箱优化基准上表现优异。
Motivation: 现有LLM自动算法设计多依赖自适应提示设计，缺乏对高质量先验的利用；本文旨在探究提示中代码示例对LLM生成算法的影响，并利用先验基准算法提升优化效果。
Method: 通过分析提示的token-wise归因，提出利用先验基准算法代码示例引导LLM驱动的黑箱优化。
Result: 在两个黑箱优化基准（pbo和bbob）上取得更优性能。
Conclusion: 突出整合基准研究提升LLM驱动黑箱优化的效率和鲁棒性的价值。

papers.title: Induction Meets Biology: Mechanisms of Repeat Detection in Protein Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Protein sequences are abundant in repeating segments, both as exact copies and as approximate segments with mutations. These repeats are important for protein structure and function, motivating decades of algorithmic work on repeat identification. Recent work has shown that protein language models (PLMs) identify repeats, by examining their behavior in masked-token prediction. To elucidate their internal mechanisms, we investigate how PLMs detect both exact and approximate repeats. We find that the mechanism for approximate repeats functionally subsumes that of exact repeats. We then characterize this mechanism, revealing two main stages: PLMs first build feature representations using both general positional attention heads and biologically specialized components, such as neurons that encode amino-acid similarity. Then, induction heads attend to aligned tokens across repeated segments, promoting the correct answer. Our results reveal how PLMs solve this biological task by combining language-based pattern matching with specialized biological knowledge, thereby establishing a basis for studying more complex evolutionary processes in PLMs.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究蛋白质语言模型（PLM）如何检测蛋白质序列中的精确重复和近似重复。通过分析掩码预测行为，发现近似重复检测机制功能上包含精确重复检测。机制分两阶段：首先利用通用位置注意力头和生物专用组件（如编码氨基酸相似性的神经元）构建特征表示，然后归纳头（induction heads）关注重复片段间的对齐位置以促进正确预测。结果揭示了PLM如何结合语言模式匹配与生物学知识解决重复检测任务。
Motivation: 蛋白质序列中重复片段对结构和功能重要，但PLM内部检测重复的机制尚不明确。研究旨在阐明PLM如何识别精确和近似重复。
Method: 通过分析PLM在掩码令牌预测任务中的行为，研究精确和近似重复检测机制。发现近似重复机制包含精确重复，并揭示两阶段过程：特征构建（通用注意力+生物专用组件）和归纳头对齐。
Result: 识别出两阶段机制：首先利用通用位置注意力头和编码氨基酸相似性的神经元构建特征，然后归纳头关注重复片段间的对齐令牌。近似重复机制功能上包含精确重复。
Conclusion: PLM通过结合语言模式匹配与专门生物学知识解决重复检测任务，为研究PLM中更复杂的进化过程奠定基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Audio-Visual Continual Test-Time Adaptation without Forgetting
papers.abstract_en: Audio-visual continual test-time adaptation involves continually adapting a source audio-visual model at test-time, to unlabeled non-stationary domains, where either or both modalities can be distributionally shifted, which hampers online cross-modal learning and eventually leads to poor accuracy. While previous works have tackled this problem, we find that SOTA methods suffer from catastrophic forgetting where the model's performance drops well below even the source model due to continual parameter updates at test-time. In this work, we first show that adapting only the modality fusion layer to a target domain not only improves performance on that domain but can also enhance performance on subsequent domains. Based on this strong cross-task transferability of the fusion layer's parameters, we propose a method, $\texttt{AVReCAP}$, that improves test-time performance of the models without access to any source data. Our approach works by using a selective parameter retrieval mechanism that dynamically retrieves the best fusion layer parameters from a buffer using only a small batch of test data. These parameters are then integrated into the model, adapted to the current test distribution, and saved back for future use. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets involving unimodal and bimodal corruptions show our proposed $\texttt{AVReCAP}$ significantly outperforms existing methods while minimizing catastrophic forgetting.
papers.comment: ECCV 2026 & ICML 2026 Workshop Continual Adaptation at Scale: Towards Sustainable AI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究音频-视觉连续测试时自适应问题，发现现有方法在非平稳域中因持续参数更新导致灾难性遗忘，性能甚至低于源模型。作者提出AVReCAP方法，通过选择性参数检索机制动态获取并整合最优融合层参数，无需源数据即可提升测试时性能。实验表明，在单模态和双模态损坏基准上，该方法显著优于现有方法并有效缓解灾难性遗忘。
Motivation: 现有音频-视觉测试时自适应方法在连续非平稳域中遭受灾难性遗忘，模型性能大幅下降，且跨模态学习因分布偏移而受限。
Method: 提出AVReCAP方法，仅适应模态融合层参数，利用跨任务迁移性，通过小批量测试数据从缓冲区动态检索最佳融合层参数，集成到当前模型并保存供后续使用。
Result: 在单模态和双模态损坏的基准数据集上，AVReCAP显著优于现有方法，并最小化灾难性遗忘。
Conclusion: 仅适应模态融合层参数不仅能提升当前域性能，还能增强后续域性能；选择性参数检索机制有效缓解灾难性遗忘，无需源数据。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Dynamic Decision-Making under Model Misspecification: A Stochastic Stability Approach
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic decision-making under model uncertainty is central to many economic environments, yet existing bandit and reinforcement learning algorithms rely on the assumption of correct model specification. This paper studies the behavior and performance of one of the most commonly used Bayesian reinforcement learning algorithms, Thompson Sampling (TS), when the model class is misspecified. We first provide a complete dynamic classification of posterior evolution in a misspecified two-armed Gaussian bandit, identifying distinct regimes: correct model concentration, incorrect model concentration, and persistent belief mixing, characterized by the direction of statistical evidence and the model-action mapping. These regimes yield sharp predictions for limiting beliefs, action frequencies, and asymptotic regret. We then extend the analysis to a general finite model class and develop a unified stochastic stability framework that represents posterior evolution as a Markov process on the belief simplex. This approach characterizes two sufficient conditions to classify the ergodic and transient behaviors and provides inductive dimensional reductions of the posterior dynamics. Our results offer the first qualitative and geometric classification of TS under misspecification, bridging Bayesian learning with evolutionary dynamics, and also build the foundations of robust decision-making in structured bandits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究模型误设下Thompson Sampling（TS）的行为和性能，针对两臂高斯bandit给出后验演化的动态分类，包括正确模型集中、错误模型集中和持久信念混合三种状态，并扩展到一般有限模型类，建立随机稳定性框架，提供极限信念、动作频率和渐近遗憾的预测。
Motivation: 现有bandit和强化学习算法假设模型正确，但实际中模型常被误设，需理解TS在误设下的行为以支撑鲁棒决策。
Method: 利用随机稳定性方法，将后验演化建模为信念单纯形上的马尔可夫过程，分析遍历性和瞬态行为的充分条件，并通过归纳降维简化动力学。
Result: 在误设的两臂高斯bandit中识别出三种动态状态，并给出极限信念、动作频率和渐近遗憾的解析预测。
Conclusion: 首次为TS在模型误设下提供定性和几何分类，连接贝叶斯学习与演化动力学，为结构化bandit的鲁棒决策奠定理论基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Benchmarks Lie: Evaluating Malicious Prompt Classifiers Under True Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Detecting prompt injection, jailbreak attacks, and harmful requests is critical for deploying LLM-based agents safely, yet current evaluation practices in this literature overestimate generalization. We train activation-based classifiers (linear probes on LLM hidden states) on a benchmark of 18 datasets (prompt attacks plus benign sources) and propose Leave-One-Dataset-Out (LODO) evaluation, where the held-out dataset is never seen during training. Across four LLMs from three families (Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-3-27B, Qwen-3.5-2B/4B), standard cross-validation reports a pooled AUC 8.0-16.5 points higher than LODO; per-dataset held-out-test-vs-LODO accuracy gaps span 1-25 points. To understand the gap, we analyze the LODO stability of a linear probe's per-feature classifier coefficients, defining a retention metric for sparse-autoencoder (SAE) features that flags dataset-dependent shortcuts. 28-44% of top SAE features are shortcuts across models, a dataset-identity classifier reaches 96.6%, and the dataset-identifying and safety-relevant subspaces partially overlap. Standard domain-generalization fixes such as adversarial training, subspace projection, sample reweighting, and class balancing do not close the gap. Finally, we show LODO-weighted SAE attributions filter dataset artifacts for more reliable per-prompt explanations. We release our framework at https://github.com/maxf-zn/prompt-mining so future prompt-attack classifiers can be evaluated under LODO alongside CV.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出当前恶意提示分类器的评估方法高估了泛化能力，提出Leave-One-Dataset-Out (LODO)评估方法。在四个LLM和18个数据集上的实验表明，标准交叉验证的AUC比LODO高8.0-16.5个百分点，每数据集精度差距达1-25个百分点。通过分析线性探针的系数稳定性和稀疏自编码器特征，发现大量数据集相关的捷径（28-44%），且数据集身份分类器达到96.6%准确率。对抗训练、子空间投影等域泛化方法未能弥补这一差距。本文开源了评估框架。
Motivation: 当前恶意提示分类器的评估通常使用同分布交叉验证，高估了模型在真实分布偏移下的泛化能力。
Method: 提出Leave-One-Dataset-Out (LODO)评估，训练激活值线性探针分类器；通过保留稀疏自编码器特征系数稳定性的度量分析数据集捷径；并验证多种域泛化方法的效果。
Result: 标准交叉验证的AUC比LODO高8.0-16.5个百分点；每数据集held-out测试与LODO的精度差距为1-25个百分点；28-44%的SAE top特征是数据集捷径；数据集身份分类器达到96.6%准确率；标准域泛化方法无法缩小差距。
Conclusion: 现有评估方法严重高估了分类器的泛化能力，LODO评估应成为标准；LODO加权的SAE归因可过滤数据集伪影以获得更可靠的解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Uncertainty Decomposition for Bayes-Filtered Transformers via Bayesian Predictive Inference
papers.abstract_en: Bayes-filtered transformers are transformers meta-learned on sequences from a prior predictive distribution to approximate the corresponding posterior predictive distribution. They output total predictive uncertainty in a single forward pass but never explicitly represent a posterior distribution, making the standard route to separating aleatoric from epistemic uncertainty unavailable. We address this challenge through the lens of Bayesian predictive inference (BPI). Our main result is a predictive Central Limit Theorem (CLT) for supervised settings under conditions that are among the weakest known in the BPI literature. The CLT characterises the posterior of the limiting predictive distribution given an observed context as asymptotically Gaussian; the variance of this Gaussian quantifies epistemic uncertainty. We apply the framework to TabPFN, a Bayes-filtered transformer that is a state-of-the-art foundation model for tabular prediction. The resulting credible bands achieve near-nominal frequentist coverage as context length grows, and the decomposition largely matches standard desiderata: epistemic uncertainty shrinks with context length and is highest in sparsely observed regions within the span of the context data, while aleatoric uncertainty dominates near decision boundaries where classes overlap.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从贝叶斯预测推断（BPI）视角出发，针对贝叶斯滤波变换器（Bayes-filtered transformers）中无法直接分离偶然不确定性和认知不确定性的问题，推导了一个监督设置下的预测中心极限定理（CLT）。该CLT表明给定上下文后极限预测分布的后验渐近高斯，其方差量化了认知不确定性。在TabPFN上的实验显示，随着上下文长度增长，所得可信区间接近名义覆盖率的频率学派覆盖率，且不确定性分解符合标准期望：认知不确定性随上下文长度减少，在稀疏观测区域最高，而偶然不确定性在决策边界附近占主导。
Motivation: 贝叶斯滤波变换器虽能单次前向传播输出总预测不确定性，但从不显式表示后验分布，因此无法通过标准途径分离偶然不确定性和认知不确定性。
Method: 采用贝叶斯预测推断（BPI）框架，在弱条件下推导监督设置的预测中心极限定理（CLT），证明给定上下文后极限预测分布的后验渐近高斯，并用其方差量化认知不确定性。将该方法应用于TabPFN，通过经验诊断验证所提条件。
Result: 在TabPFN上，所得可信区间随上下文长度增长达到接近名义覆盖率的频率学派覆盖率；认知不确定性随上下文长度缩小，在数据稀疏区域最大，而偶然不确定性在类别重叠的决策边界附近占主导。
Conclusion: 本文展示了BPI框架如何为贝叶斯滤波变换器提供认知不确定性分离的理论基础，并实验验证了其有效性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Solving the Offline and Online Min-Max Problem of Non-smooth Submodular-Concave Functions: A Zeroth-Order Approach
papers.abstract_en: We consider max-min and min-max problems with objective functions that are possibly non-smooth, submodular with respect to the minimiser and concave with respect to the maximiser. We investigate the performance of a zeroth-order method applied to this problem. The method is based on the subgradient of the Lovász extension of the objective function with respect to the minimiser and based on Gaussian smoothing to estimate the smoothed function gradient with respect to the maximiser. In expectation sense, we prove the convergence of the algorithm to an $ε$-saddle point in the offline case. Moreover, we show that, in the expectation sense, in the online setting, the algorithm achieves $O(\sqrt{N(1+\bar{P}_N)})$ online duality gap, where $N$ is the number of iterations and $\bar{P}_N$ is the path length of the sequence of optimal decisions. The complexity analysis and hyperparameter selection are presented for all the cases. The theoretical results are illustrated via numerical examples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非光滑子模-凹函数的离线与在线最小-最大问题，提出一种零阶优化方法。该方法对最小化变量使用Lovász扩展的次梯度，对最大化变量使用高斯平滑估计梯度，证明了离线情形下算法以期望形式收敛到ε-鞍点，在线情形下对偶间隙为O(√(N(1+ P̄_N)))。数值算例验证了理论结果。
Motivation: 非光滑子模-凹函数的最小-最大问题缺乏有效的求解方法，尤其当梯度信息不可得时，需要零阶方法。
Method: 基于Lovász扩展的次梯度（针对最小化变量）和高斯平滑梯度估计（针对最大化变量）的零阶算法。
Result: 离线情形下期望收敛到ε-鞍点；在线情形下期望对偶间隙为O(√(N(1+ P̄_N)))，其中N为迭代次数，P̄_N为最优决策序列的路径长度。
Conclusion: 本文为子模-凹最小-最大问题提供了零阶方法的收敛性保证，扩展了无梯度优化在非光滑情形下的适用范围。
Relevance: 0
