papers.title: UPLiFT: Efficient Pixel-Dense Feature Upsampling with Local Attenders
papers.abstract_en: The space of task-agnostic feature upsampling has emerged as a promising area of research to efficiently create denser features from pre-trained visual backbones. These methods act as a shortcut to achieve dense features for a fraction of the cost by learning to map low-resolution features to high-resolution versions. While early works in this space used iterative upsampling approaches, more recent works have switched to cross-attention-based methods, which risk falling into the same efficiency scaling problems of the backbones they are upsampling. In this work, we demonstrate that iterative upsampling methods can still compete with cross-attention-based methods; moreover, they can achieve state-of-the-art performance with lower inference costs. We propose UPLiFT, an architecture for Universal Pixel-dense Lightweight Feature Transforms. We also propose an efficient Local Attender operator to overcome the limitations of prior iterative feature upsampling methods. This operator uses an alternative attentional pooling formulation defined fully locally. We show that our Local Attender allows UPLiFT to maintain stable features throughout upsampling, enabling state-of-the-art performance with lower inference costs than existing pixel-dense feature upsamplers. In addition, we apply UPLiFT to generative downstream tasks and show that it achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art Coupled Flow Matching models for VAE feature upsampling. Altogether, UPLiFT offers a versatile and efficient approach to creating denser features.
papers.comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026 as conference paper. Website: see https://www.cs.umd.edu/~mwalmer/uplift/. Code and Models: see https://github.com/mwalmer-umd/UPLiFT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了UPLiFT，一种用于密集像素特征上采样的轻量级架构，通过局部注意力算子（Local Attender）实现迭代上采样，在不依赖交叉注意力的前提下达到SOTA性能并降低推理成本。该方法在多个视觉任务上验证了有效性，包括VAE特征上采样等生成任务。
Motivation: 现有任务无关特征上采样方法中，交叉注意力方法存在效率缩放问题，而早期迭代方法性能不足。本文旨在证明迭代方法仍有竞争力，并能以更低推理成本实现SOTA。
Method: 提出UPLiFT架构，包含高效的局部注意力算子（Local Attender），该算子采用完全局部的注意力池化公式，克服了先前迭代上采样的局限，使得上采样过程中特征保持稳定。
Result: 摘要显示UPLiFT在多个像素密集任务上实现SOTA性能，且推理成本低于现有上采样器。在VAE特征上采样等生成任务中，与最先进的耦合流匹配模型性能相当。
Conclusion: 摘要强调UPLiFT提供了一种通用且高效的方法来生成密集特征，且迭代上采样方法仍可与交叉注意力方法竞争。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hybrid Mamba-Attention Neural Architecture for Channel Estimation
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a hybrid Mamba-attention neural architecture to achieve improved channel estimation for orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) waveforms, particularly for configurations with a large number of subcarriers. By integrating a customized Mamba module, the proposed framework handles large-scale subcarrier channel estimation efficiently while capturing long-distance dependencies among these subcarriers effectively. Unlike the conventional Mamba structure, this paper implements a bidirectional selective scan to enable information propagation from both directions, because channel gains at different subcarriers are inherently non-causal. In addition, by integrating Mamba to reduce the reliance on quadratic-complexity self-attention, the proposed solution achieves lower space complexity than fully transformer architectures. Simulation results based on the 3GPP TS 36.101 channel demonstrate that compared to other baseline neural networks, the proposed method achieves superior channel estimation performance with fewer tunable parameters and exhibits good generalization across previously unseen channels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合Mamba-注意力神经架构用于OFDM信道估计，特别针对大量子载波的配置。通过集成定制的Mamba模块并实现双向选择性扫描，该框架高效处理大规模子载波并捕获长距离依赖，同时降低空间复杂度。在3GPP TS 36.101信道上的仿真结果表明，该方法以更少可调参数取得优于基线神经网络的性能，并展现出良好的泛化能力。
Motivation: OFDM信道估计在大子载波配置下面临长距离依赖捕获困难与高计算复杂度的挑战，现有方法在大规模场景下效率不足。
Method: 提出混合Mamba-注意力架构，采用双向选择性扫描的Mamba模块替代二次复杂度的自注意力，同时结合注意力机制，在降低复杂度的同时有效建模非因果子载波间的依赖关系。
Result: 基于3GPP TS 36.101信道的仿真显示，所提架构以较少的可调参数实现了优于其他基线神经网络的信道估计性能，并能在未见过的信道上良好泛化。
Conclusion: 混合Mamba-注意力架构为大规模OFDM信道估计提供了一种低复杂度、高性能的解决方案，且具备强泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cognitive-YOLO: LLM-Driven Architecture Synthesis from First Principles of Data for Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose object detection algorithms face a domain-shift bottleneck when deployed in vertical scenarios, and manually customizing a network architecture relies heavily on expert experience with high trial-and-error cost. To address these problems, we present \textbf{Cognitive-YOLO}, an adaptive object-detection model synthesis system driven by a large language model (LLM) collaborating with an autonomous agent. Cognitive-YOLO builds a fully automated \emph{Analyze--Synthesize--Compile} pipeline. First, a data-profiling module quantitatively extracts dataset features, guiding a ReAct-paradigm agent to autonomously retrieve matching network modules from a curated component library. Second, the LLM performs logical reasoning and topological assembly conditioned on the data features, producing a specification-compliant neural architecture description. Finally, a backend hybrid compiler dynamically instantiates the model, closing the loop with end-to-end training and evaluation scheduling. Cross-validation on datasets including rail-surface defects and rice diseases shows that the lightweight models synthesized by Cognitive-YOLO markedly compress the parameter count (down to 1.9M) while matching or surpassing mainstream baselines such as YOLOv11n in mAP@0.5:0.95, effectively balancing model compactness and feature-representation capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Cognitive-YOLO 提出一种由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的自适应目标检测模型合成系统，通过自动分析数据集特征、检索网络模块并生成架构描述，实现端到端模型定制。在铁路表面缺陷和稻米病害数据集上，该方法合成的轻量模型参数降至 1.9M，mAP@0.5:0.95 匹配或超越 YOLOv11n 等主流基线。
Motivation: 通用目标检测算法在垂直场景中存在领域迁移瓶颈，手动定制网络架构依赖专家经验且试错成本高。
Method: 构建 Analyze-Synthesize-Compile 全自动流水线：数据特征提取模块引导 ReAct 范式代理从组件库检索模块，LLM 进行逻辑推理与拓扑组装生成架构描述，后端混合编译器动态实例化模型并调度训练与评估。
Result: 在铁路表面缺陷和稻米病害数据集上，合成模型参数量压缩至 1.9M，mAP@0.5:0.95 匹配或超越 YOLOv11n 等主流基线，平衡了模型紧凑性与特征表示能力。
Conclusion: 该方法通过自动化架构搜索有效缓解领域迁移问题，但仅针对垂直场景（如缺陷检测和病害识别）验证，未涉及通用目标检测或与降水/天气预报相关的视觉任务。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Particle Image Velocimetry Refinement via Consensus ADMM for Active Fluid Control
papers.abstract_en: Particle Image Velocimetry (PIV) is among the central modalities for measuring flow fields across laboratory, industrial and environmental setting. Traditional PIV approaches typically depend on tuning parameters specific to the imaging setup, making the performance sensitive to variations in illumination, flow conditions, and seeding density. Similarly, state-of-the-art machine learning methods for flow quantification are fragile outside their training set. In our experiments, we observed that flow quantification would improve if different tunings (or algorithms) were applied to different regions of the same image pair. Motivated by this observation, we thus pose flow quantification as a multi-estimator fusion problem: several heterogeneous algorithms process the same image pair in parallel, and their dense flow fields are treated as complementary estimates. To fuse them, we adopt a consensus framework based on the alternating direction method of multipliers, incorporating priors such as smoothness and incompressibility. We perform several numerical experiments to demonstrate the benefits of this approach. For instance, we achieve a decrease in end-point-error of up to 20% of a dense-inverse-search estimator at an inference rate of 60Hz, and we show how performance can be increased with outlier rejection. Our method is implemented in JAX and integrated into Flow Gym, enabling reproducible comparisons with the state of the art and systematic evaluation across different base algorithms. Finally, we demonstrate successful deployment of our method in the same real-world active-fluids-control setup of Terpin and D'Andrea [1], where a reinforcement-learning agent uses our flow estimates to learn to minimize drag (down by 36%) or maximize it (up to 32%) with only two minutes of real-world interaction. Hardware and software are made available at ActiveFluidControl.com.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at, and publication in the proceedings of, the 2026 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC). Code available at https://github.com/antonioterpin/flowgym
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出将粒子图像测速（PIV）视为多估计器融合问题，通过基于共识ADMM的框架结合不同算法（如平滑性、不可压缩性先验）来提升流场估计精度。实验显示端点误差最多降低20%，推理频率达60Hz，并在主动流体控制中实现阻力减少36%或增加32%。
Motivation: 传统PIV方法依赖成像设置的参数调优，而机器学习方法在训练集外表现脆弱，且不同算法在不同区域表现各异，因此需要一种融合多种估计算法的鲁棒方法。
Method: 采用共识ADMM框架，将多个异构PIV算法（如稠密逆搜索）的密集流场作为互补估计，通过交替方向乘子法融合，并引入平滑性和不可压缩性先验，同时集成异常值拒绝。
Result: 在数值实验中，端点误差较稠密逆搜索估计器降低最多20%，推理速率为60Hz。在实际流体控制中，强化学习智能体使用该流场估计可在两分钟内使阻力下降36%或上升32%。
Conclusion: 该方法可有效融合多种PIV算法，提升估计精度和鲁棒性，适用于主动流体控制等实时应用。
Relevance: 10

summary_sections.tldr: 该论文提出将粒子图像测速（PIV）视为多估计器融合问题，通过基于共识ADMM的框架结合不同算法（如平滑性、不可压缩性先验）来提升流场估计精度。实验显示端点误差最多降低20%，推理频率达60Hz，并在主动流体控制中实现阻力减少36%或增加32%。

papers.title: SONAR: Spectral-Contrastive Audio Residuals for Generalizable Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Deepfake (DF) audio detectors still struggle to generalize to out of distribution inputs. A central reason is spectral bias, the tendency of neural networks to learn low-frequency structure before high-frequency (HF) details, which both causes DF generators to leave HF artifacts and leaves those same artifacts under-exploited by common detectors. To address this gap, we propose Spectral-cONtrastive Audio Residuals (SONAR), a frequency-guided framework that explicitly disentangles an audio signal into complementary representations. An XLSR encoder captures the dominant low-frequency content, while the same cloned path, preceded by learnable SRM, value-constrained high-pass filters, distills faint HF residuals. Frequency cross-attention reunites the two views for long- and short-range frequency dependencies, and a frequency-aware Jensen-Shannon contrastive loss pulls real content-noise pairs together while pushing fake embeddings apart, accelerating optimization and sharpening decision boundaries. Evaluated on the ASVspoof 2021 and in-the-wild benchmarks, SONAR attains state-of-the-art performance and converges four times faster than strong baselines. By elevating faint high-frequency residuals to first-class learning signals, SONAR unveils a fully data-driven, frequency-guided contrastive framework that splits the latent space into two disjoint manifolds: natural-HF for genuine audio and distorted-HF for synthetic audio, thereby sharpening decision boundaries. Because the scheme operates purely at the representation level, it is architecture-agnostic and, in future work, can be seamlessly integrated into any model or modality where subtle high-frequency cues are decisive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SONAR，一种频率引导的对比学习框架，用于通用音频深度伪造检测。通过可学习的高通滤波器提取高频残差，并与低频主导内容交叉注意力融合，结合频域对比损失，在ASVspoof 2021和in-the-wild基准上达到SOTA，收敛速度快4倍。方法架构无关，可推广到其他依赖高频线索的模态。
Motivation: 现有音频深度伪造检测器难以泛化到分布外输入，原因是频谱偏置导致神经网络忽略高频伪影，而伪造生成器恰好留下这些伪影。
Method: 将XLSR编码器用于低频内容，另一路经可学习SRM高通滤波器提取高频残差；频率交叉注意力融合两视图；频域Jensen-Shannon对比损失拉近真实样本对，推远伪造嵌入。
Result: 在ASVspoof 2021和in-the-wild基准上达到SOTA，收敛速度比强基线快4倍。
Conclusion: SONAR将高频残差提升为第一类学习信号，构建了自然高频与失真高频两个分离流形，架构无关，可集成到任何模型或模态中。

papers.title: VOPE: Revisiting Hallucination of Vision-Language Models in Voluntary Imagination Task
papers.abstract_en: Most research on hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) focuses on factual description tasks that prohibit any output absent from the image. However, little attention has been paid to hallucinations in voluntary imagination tasks, such as story writing, despite this human-like cognitive ability being essential for real-world generative applications. To address this limitation, we introduce Voluntary-imagined Object Presence Evaluation (VOPE) -- a recheck-based evaluation benchmark for assessing LVLMs' grounding behavior in voluntary imagination tasks. Specifically, VOPE poses recheck-based questions to evaluate how an LVLM interprets the presence of the imagined objects in its own response. Rather than penalizing the imagined content itself, VOPE identifies hallucinations based on the correctness of the model's presence judgments for the generated objects. Built on this idea, we construct a dataset covering captioning, reasoning, and writing tasks with different levels of voluntary imagination. We apply VOPE to several mainstream LVLMs and hallucination mitigation methods, revealing two key findings: (1) most LVLMs hallucinate heavily during voluntary imagination, and their performance in presence evaluation is notably poor on imagined objects; (2) existing hallucination mitigation methods show limited effect in voluntary imagination tasks, making this an important direction for future research.
papers.comment: Accepted at ACM MM 2026 Dataset Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VOPE基准，评估大型视觉语言模型在自愿想象任务（如故事写作）中的幻觉。与通常研究的事实描述任务不同，VOPE通过重新检查问题来检测模型对自身生成物体存在判断的正确性。实验表明主流LVLM在此任务中幻觉严重，现有缓解方法效果有限。
Motivation: 现有幻觉研究大多聚焦事实描述任务，忽略了自愿想象任务中的幻觉，而后者对真实生成应用至关重要。
Method: 提出VOPE基准，基于重新检查的问题，通过评估模型对想象物体存在判断的正确性来识别幻觉，并构建包含描述、推理和写作任务的数据集。
Result: 在多个主流LVLM和幻觉缓解方法上测试，发现大多数LVLM在自愿想象任务中幻觉严重，且现有缓解方法效果有限。
Conclusion: 自愿想象任务中的幻觉是未来重要研究方向，现有方法在此任务中表现不足。

papers.title: Financial Management System for SMEs: Real-World Deployment of Accounts Receivable and Cash Flow Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs), particularly freelancers and early-stage businesses, face unique financial management challenges due to limited resources, small customer bases, and constrained data availability. This paper presents the development and deployment of an integrated financial prediction system that combines accounts receivable prediction and cash flow forecasting specifically designed for SME operational constraints. Our system addresses the gap between enterprise-focused financial tools and the practical needs of freelancers and small businesses. The solution integrates two key components: a binary classification model for predicting invoice payment delays, and a multi-module cash flow forecasting model that handles incomplete and limited historical data. A prototype system has been implemented and deployed as a web application with integration into Cluee's platform, a startup providing financial management tools for freelancers, demonstrating practical feasibility for real-world SME financial management.
papers.journal_ref: Computational Science - ICCS 2026, Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol. 16784, pp. 351-358, Springer, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对中小企业和自由职业者面临的财务预测挑战，开发并部署了一个集成应收账款预测与现金流预测的系统。系统由发票付款延迟二分类模型和处理不完整历史数据的多模块现金流预测模型组成，已作为Web应用原型集成到Cluee平台中，验证了实际可行性。
Motivation: 现有财务工具主要面向大型企业，而中小企业（特别是自由职业者）受限于资源、客户量和数据可用性，缺乏合适的财务预测解决方案。
Method: 系统包含两个核心组件：一个用于预测发票是否延期付款的二元分类模型，以及一个能够处理不完整和有限历史数据的多模块现金流预测模型。
Result: 原型系统在Cluee平台（为自由职业者提供财务管理的初创公司）上成功部署并运行，证明了在实际中小企业财务场景中的可行性。
Conclusion: 该方法填补了企业级财务工具与自由职业者实际需求之间的空白，但摘要未提及系统的局限性或详细性能指标。

papers.title: ProtoTSNet: Interpretable Multivariate Time Series Classification With Prototypical Parts
papers.abstract_en: Time series data is one of the most popular data modalities in critical domains such as industry and medicine. The demand for algorithms that not only exhibit high accuracy but also offer interpretability is crucial in such fields, as decisions made there bear significant consequences. In this paper, we present ProtoTSNet, a novel approach to interpretable classification of multivariate time series data, through substantial enhancements to the ProtoPNet architecture. Our method is tailored to overcome the unique challenges of time series analysis, including capturing dynamic patterns and handling varying feature significance. Central to our innovation is a modified convolutional encoder utilizing group convolutions, pre-trainable as part of an autoencoder and designed to preserve and quantify feature importance. We evaluated our model on 30 multivariate time series datasets from the UEA archive, comparing our approach with existing explainable methods as well as non-explainable baselines. Through comprehensive evaluation and ablation studies, we demonstrate that our approach achieves the best performance among ante-hoc explainable methods while maintaining competitive performance with non-explainable and post-hoc explainable approaches, providing interpretable results accessible to domain experts.
papers.journal_ref: Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery 40, 65 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProtoTSNet，一种基于原型部分（prototypical parts）的可解释多元时间序列分类方法，通过对 ProtoPNet 架构进行实质性改进来处理时间序列的动态模式和特征重要性变化。模型采用组卷积的卷积编码器，可作为自编码器预训练以保留和量化特征重要性。在 UEA 档案的30个多元时间序列数据集上，该方法在 ante-hoc 可解释方法中达到最佳性能，并与不可解释和 post-hoc 可解释方法竞争。
Motivation: 时间序列数据在工业、医学等关键领域广泛应用，高精度与可解释性需求并存。现有可解释方法在处理时间序列的动态模式和特征重要性的变化时存在不足。
Method: 对 ProtoPNet 架构进行改进，核心创新包括：使用组卷积（group convolutions）的卷积编码器，该编码器可作为自编码器预训练，以保留和量化特征重要性；调整原型学习机制以适配时间序列数据。
Result: 在 UEA 档案的30个多元时间序列数据集上，ProtoTSNet 在 ante-hoc 可解释方法中取得最佳性能，且与不可解释和 post-hoc 可解释方法相比具有竞争力。消融研究验证了各组件的有效性。
Conclusion: ProtoTSNet 为多元时间序列分类提供了可解释且准确的方案，其输出能被领域专家理解。

papers.title: Computations and ML for surjective rational maps
papers.abstract_en: The present note studies \emph{surjective rational endomorphisms} $f: \mathbb{P}^2 \dashrightarrow \mathbb{P}^2$ with \emph{cubic} terms and the indeterminacy locus $I_f \ne \emptyset$. We develop an experimental approach, based on some Python programming and Machine Learning, towards the classification of such maps; a couple of new explicit $f$ is constructed in this way. We also prove (via pure projective geometry) that a general non-regular cubic endomorphism $f$ of $\mathbb{P}^2$ is surjective if and only if the set $I_f$ has cardinality at least $3$.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究复射影平面ℙ²上的满射有理自同态，特别是具有三次项且不定点集非空的情形。作者开发了基于Python编程和机器学习的实验方法，构造了两个新的显式例子，并利用纯射影几何证明了一般非正则三次自同态f:ℙ²⇢ℙ²满射当且仅当不定点集基数至少为3。
Motivation: 满射有理自同态的分类是代数几何中的基本问题，现有理论对三次项且不定点集非空的情形缺乏系统刻画。
Method: 采用实验与理论结合的方式：先通过Python程序生成候选映射，再利用机器学习辅助筛选，最后用纯射影几何证明充分必要条件。
Result: 构造了两个新的显式满射三次有理自同态例子，并证明了非正则三次自同态满射等价于不定点集基数≥3。
Conclusion: 该工作为三次有理自同态的满射分类提供了计算工具与理论判据，表明实验方法在代数几何中有应用潜力。

papers.title: Probing the Difficulty Perception Mechanism of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed on complex reasoning tasks, yet little is known about their ability to internally evaluate problem difficulty, which is an essential capability for adaptive reasoning and efficient resource allocation. In this work, we investigate whether LLMs implicitly encode problem difficulty in their internal representations. Using a linear probe on the final-token representations of LLMs, we demonstrate that the difficulty level of math problems can be linearly modeled. We further locate the specific attention heads of the final Transformer layer: these attention heads have opposite activation patterns for simple and difficult problems, thus achieving perception of difficulty. Our ablation experiments prove the accuracy of the location. Crucially, our experiments provide practical support for using LLMs as automatic difficulty annotators, potentially substantially reducing reliance on costly human labeling in benchmark construction and curriculum learning. We also uncover that there is a significant difference in entropy and difficulty perception at the token level. Our study reveals that difficulty perception in LLMs is not only present but also structurally organized, offering new theoretical insights and practical directions for future research. Our code is available at https://github.com/Aegis1863/Difficulty-Perception-of-LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索大语言模型（LLM）是否在其内部表征中隐式编码问题难度。通过在线性探针（linear probe）研究最后token的表征，发现数学问题的难度可以被线性建模，并定位到最终Transformer层中特定注意力头，这些头对简单和困难问题有相反的激活模式。消融实验证实了定位的准确性，实验支持将LLM用作自动难度标注器，减少人工标注成本。
Motivation: LLM越来越多地用于复杂推理任务，但其内部评估问题难度的能力尚不清楚，而自适应推理和资源分配需要这种能力。
Method: 使用线性探针在LLM最后token的表征上建模难度，定位最终Transformer层中特定的注意力头，这些头对简单和困难问题表现相反的激活模式。
Result: 数学问题的难度可以被线性建模；定位的注意力头在消融实验中证实准确；LLM可用作自动难度标注器，减少人工标注成本。
Conclusion: LLM的难度感知不仅存在而且结构性地组织，为未来研究提供了新的理论见解和实践方向。

summary_sections.conclusion: LLM的难度感知不仅存在而且结构性地组织，为未来研究提供了新的理论见解和实践方向。

papers.title: Artificially intelligent agents in the social and behavioral sciences: A history and outlook
papers.abstract_en: We review the historical development and current trends of artificially intelligent agents (agentic AI) in the social and behavioral sciences: from the first programmable computers, and social simulations soon thereafter, to today's experiments with large language models. This overview emphasizes the role of AI in the scientific process and the changes brought about, both through technological advancements and the broader evolution of science from around 1950 to the present. Some of the specific points we cover include: the challenges of presenting the first social simulation studies to a world unaware of computers, the rise of social systems science, intelligent game theoretic agents, the age of big data and the epistemic upheaval in its wake, and the current enthusiasm around applications of generative AI, and many other topics. A pervasive theme is how deeply entwined we are with the technologies we use to understand ourselves.

papers.title: STAC: When Innocent Tools Form Dangerous Chains for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: As LLMs advance into autonomous agents with tool-use capabilities, they introduce security challenges that extend beyond traditional content-based LLM safety concerns. This paper introduces Sequential Tool Attack Chaining (\STAC), a novel multi-turn attack framework that exploits agent tool use. \STAC chains together tool calls that each appear harmless in isolation but, when combined, collectively enable harmful operations that only become apparent at the final execution step. At the core of \STAC is an automated, closed-loop pipeline that synthesizes executable multi-step tool chains, validates them through in-environment execution, and reverse-engineers stealthy multi-turn prompts that reliably induce agents to execute the verified malicious sequence. Using this framework, we generate and systematically evaluate 483 \STAC cases, featuring 1,352 sets of user-agent-environment interactions and spanning diverse domains, tasks, agent types, and 10 failure modes. Our evaluations show that state-of-the-art LLM agents are highly vulnerable to \STAC, with an average final attack success rate (ASR) of 91.2\% -- exceeding 90\% for all but one of the eight agents evaluated. We further perform defense analysis and find that existing prompt-based defenses provide limited protection. To address this gap, we propose a new reasoning-driven defense prompt that achieves the strongest initial-turn protection, cutting ASR by up to 28.8\%; however, this advantage erodes sharply under adaptive attacks, and an experience-based defense (ToolShield) proves more durable over sustained multi-turn interactions. These results highlight a crucial gap: defending tool-enabled agents requires reasoning over entire action sequences and their cumulative effects, rather than evaluating isolated prompts or responses.
papers.comment: Long version with 15 pages in main draft and a total of 39 pages including references and appendix. Data and code \url{https://github.com/amazon-science/MultiTurnAgentAttack}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 STAC（Sequential Tool Attack Chaining），一种针对 LLM 智能体工具使用的新型多轮攻击框架。STAC 自动合成看似无害的工具调用链，这些工具在最终步骤组合成有害操作。通过 483 个案例评估，8 个先进 LLM 智能体的平均攻击成功率（ASR）达 91.2%，而现有基于提示的防御效果有限。作者提出了一种推理驱动的防御提示，可将首轮 ASR 降低 28.8%，但在自适应攻击下优势迅速消失，而基于经验的防御 (ToolShield) 在持续多轮交互中更持久。
Motivation: LLM 智能体使用工具时面临安全威胁，但现有工作主要关注单步提示安全性，忽略了多步工具调用链可能带来的累积风险。
Method: 提出 STAC 框架，包含自动闭环管道：生成可执行的多步工具链 → 在环境内验证 → 反向工程生成隐蔽的多轮提示，诱导智能体执行恶意序列。
Result: 生成 483 个 STAC 案例，涵盖 10 种故障模式，平均 ASR 达 91.2%；提出的推理驱动防御在首轮降低 ASR 28.8%，但自适应攻击下优势锐减。
Conclusion: 防御工具使能的智能体需要推理整个动作序列及其累积效果，而非仅评估孤立提示或响应。

papers.title: RobustVLA: On Robustness of Vision-Language-Action Model against Multi-Modal Perturbations
papers.abstract_en: In Vision-Language-Actionf(VLA) models, robustness to real-world perturbations is critical for deployment. Existing methods target simple visual disturbances, overlooking the broader multi-modal perturbations that arise in actions, instructions, environments, and observations. Here, we first evaluate the robustness of mainstream VLAs under 17 perturbations across four modalities. We find (1) actions as the most fragile modality, (2) Existing visual-robust VLA do not gain robustness in other modality, and (3) pi0 demonstrates superior robustness. To build multi-modal robust VLAs, we propose RobustVLA against perturbations in VLA inputs and outputs. For output robustness, we perform offline robust optimization against worst-case action noise that maximizes mismatch in flow matching objective. This can be seen as adversarial training, label smoothing, and outlier penalization. For input robustness, we enforce consistent actions across input variations that preserve task semantics. To account for multiple perturbations, we formulate robustness as a multi-armed bandit problem and apply an upper confidence bound algorithm to automatically identify the most harmful noise. Experiments on LIBERO demonstrate our RobustVLA delivers absolute gains over baselines of 12.6% on the pi0 backbone and 10.4% on the OpenVLA backbone across all 17 perturbations, achieving 50.6x faster inference than existing visual-robust BYOVLA that requires external LLMs, and a 10.4% gain under mixed perturbations. On the real-world FR5 robot, under four types of multimodal perturbations, RobustVLA shows strong low-data performance, outperforming pi0 by 65.6% success rate with 25 demonstrations. Even with abundant demos, our method still outperform pi0 by 30% success rate. Code and demo videos available at https://github.com/gakakulicc/RobustVLA.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文系统评估了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在17种跨四模态扰动下的鲁棒性，发现动作模态最脆弱，现有视觉鲁棒方法不泛化到其他模态，而pi0模型表现最佳。作者提出RobustVLA，通过输出端鲁棒优化（对抗训练、标签平滑和异常惩罚）和输入端一致性动作约束，并结合多臂赌博机自适应识别最有害扰动。在LIBERO基准上，相比基线在17种扰动下获得12.6%（pi0骨干）和10.4%（OpenVLA骨干）的绝对提升，推理速度比BYOVLA快50.6倍。在真实FR5机器人上，四种多模态扰动下，用25个演示样本成功率比pi0高65.6%，即使大量演示仍高30%。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型鲁棒性研究仅关注简单视觉扰动，忽略了动作、指令、环境和观测等更广泛的多模态扰动，且缺乏跨模态鲁棒性的系统性评估。
Method: 提出RobustVLA，包括输出端鲁棒优化（对最坏情况动作噪声进行对抗训练，等价于标签平滑和异常惩罚）和输入端一致性约束（对语义不变输入变体强制一致动作）。针对多扰动场景，将鲁棒性建模为多臂赌博机问题，用上置信界算法自动识别最有害的噪声。
Result: 在LIBERO基准上，17种扰动下pi0和OpenVLA骨干分别获得12.6%和10.4%的绝对成功率提升，推理速度比BYOVLA快50.6倍；混合扰动下提升10.4%。在真实FR5机器人上，25个演示样本下成功率比pi0高65.6%，大量演示时仍高30%。
Conclusion: RobustVLA能有效提升VLA模型在多模态扰动下的鲁棒性，且推理高效、数据需求低，但实验仅在LIBERO和FR5上进行，泛化性待验证。

papers.title: Representation-Aware Distributionally Robust Optimization: A Knowledge Transfer Framework
papers.abstract_en: Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) protects statistical learning against distributional shifts by optimizing the worst-case performance over a set of perturbed distributions. However, standard DRO formulations often treat all feature perturbations equally. This can be unnecessarily conservative when external knowledge suggests that the predictive signal is embedded in a low-dimensional representation of covariates. We propose REpresentation-Aware Distributionally robust estimation (READ), a Wasserstein DRO framework that uses external representations to guide the geometry of robustness. Rather than uniformly perturbing all covariate directions, READ increases the transport cost of perturbations that change representation coordinates, thereby reshaping the dual regularization toward the representation subspace. Meanwhile, it preserves protection against variations orthogonal to the representation. We study READ in two regimes. First, for inference on the current target, we characterize our estimator asymptotically and develop a Wasserstein profile inference approach to construct representation-aligned confidence regions while enabling automatic hyperparameter tuning. Second, for deployment to future populations that differ from the current target but are generated from the same representation-invariant random-coefficient model, we show that the resulting regions achieve higher coverage of future model parameters than standard methods. Simulations and a single-cell multi-omics application demonstrate the advantages of READ in multi-source and multitask transfer learning settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出REpresentation-Aware Distributionally robust estimation (READ)框架，在Wasserstein分布鲁棒优化中利用外部表示调整传输成本，使得对表示方向扰动成本更高，而对正交方向保持保护。文中在推断当前目标和向未来人群迁移两个场景下分析了READ，并通过单细胞多组学应用展示了优势。
Motivation: 标准DRO对所有特征扰动一视同仁，但实际中预测信号可能嵌入在低维表示中，导致不必要的保守性。本文旨在利用外部表示知识来指导鲁棒性形状。
Method: 提出READ框架，通过调整Wasserstein DRO中的传输成本，增大改变表示坐标的扰动的成本，从而将双重正则化偏向表示子空间，同时保持对表示正交方向变化的保护。
Result: 在推断当前目标时，开发了Wasserstein轮廓推断方法，实现表示对齐的置信区域和自动超参数调整；在向未来人群迁移时，这些区域对模型参数的覆盖率高于标准方法。仿真和单细胞多组学应用验证了优势。
Conclusion: READ通过利用外部表示知识改进了DRO的保守性，在多源和多任务迁移学习中具有潜力。

papers.title: SATQuest: A Verifier for Logical Reasoning Evaluation and Reinforcement Fine-Tuning of LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong general reasoning, yet the community lacks controllable, scalable, and verifiable tools to analyze and improve these abilities. We present SATQuest, a verifier that generates diverse SAT-based reasoning tasks directly from Conjunctive Normal Form (CNF) instances and checks answers objectively with PySAT. SATQuest factorizes evaluation along three orthogonal dimensions: instance, problem type, and question format, enabling fine-grained, multi-dimensional analysis and reinforcement fine-tuning. Randomized CNF generation mitigates memorization and supports reproducible experiments. Using SATQuest, we benchmark a range of open- and closed-weight LLMs and uncover persistent gaps in logical reasoning, particularly on higher-complexity tasks and in transfer beyond familiar mathematical notation to machine or narrative formats. We further show that reinforcement fine-tuning with SATQuest rewards substantially boosts targeted performance and generalizes to larger instances, while cross-format robustness remains challenging. Collectively, SATQuest provides verifier-backed infrastructure for controlled, scalable, and reproducible empirical research on LLM logical reasoning and its training.

papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers), pp. 2109-2131. Association for Computational Linguistics, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SATQuest，一个基于SAT问题的逻辑推理验证器，能够生成多样化的SAT推理任务，并用PySAT客观检查答案。该工具将评估分解为实例、问题类型和问题格式三个正交维度，支持细粒度分析和强化微调。作者通过基准测试发现LLM在复杂逻辑推理和跨格式鲁棒性方面存在不足，并展示强化微调可以提升性能并泛化到更大的实例，但跨格式鲁棒性仍是挑战。
Motivation: 目前缺乏可控、可扩展且可验证的工具来分析和提升LLM的逻辑推理能力。
Method: SATQuest通过从CNF实例直接生成SAT推理任务，并使用PySAT验证答案；通过随机化CNF生成和分维度评估实现可控性和可复现性。
Result: 基准测试揭示了LLM在更高复杂度任务和跨格式迁移中的逻辑推理差距；强化微调显著提升了目标性能并泛化到更大实例，但跨格式鲁棒性仍具挑战。
Conclusion: SATQuest为LLM逻辑推理的受控、可扩展和可复现实证研究提供了基于验证器的基础设施。

papers.title: ChipChat: Low-Latency Cascaded Conversational Agent in MLX
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of large language models (LLMs) has transformed spoken dialog systems, yet the optimal architecture for real-time on-device voice agents remains an open question. While end-to-end approaches promise theoretical advantages, cascaded systems (CSs) continue to outperform them in language understanding tasks, despite being constrained by sequential processing latency. In this work, we introduce ChipChat, a novel low-latency CS that overcomes traditional bottlenecks through architectural innovations and streaming optimizations. Our system integrates streaming (a) conversational speech recognition with mixture-of-experts, (b) state-action augmented LLM, (c) text-to-speech synthesis, (d) neural vocoder, and (e) speaker modeling. Implemented using MLX, ChipChat achieves sub-second response latency on a Mac Studio without dedicated GPUs, while preserving user privacy through complete on-device processing. Our work shows that strategically redesigned CSs can overcome their historical latency limitations, offering a promising path forward for practical voice-based AI agents.
papers.journal_ref: ASRU 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ChipChat，一种低延迟级联语音对话系统，通过流式语音识别（含混合专家模型）、状态动作增强 LLM、文本转语音、神经声码器和说话人建模等组件，在 MLX 框架上实现完全端侧处理，在 Mac Studio 上达到亚秒级响应延迟，同时保护用户隐私。摘要表明，经过重新设计的级联系统可以克服传统延迟瓶颈，为实用语音智能体提供有前景的路径。
Motivation: 实时端侧语音代理的最优架构尚无定论，级联系统虽然在语言理解上优于端到端方法，但受限于顺序处理延迟。
Method: 集成流式对话语音识别（含混合专家模型）、状态动作增强 LLM、文本转语音合成、神经声码器和说话人建模，并采用流式优化，基于 MLX 框架实现全端侧运行。
Result: 在无专用 GPU 的 Mac Studio 上达到亚秒级响应延迟，且完全在设备端处理，保护用户隐私。
Conclusion: 精心设计的级联系统可以克服历史延迟限制，为实用语音智能体提供可行方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: "Not in My Backyard": LLMs Uncover Online and Offline Social Biases Against Homelessness
papers.abstract_en: Homelessness is a persistent social challenge, impacting millions worldwide. Over 876,000 people experiencing homelessness (PEH) were recorded in the U.S. in 2025. Social bias is a significant barrier to alleviating homelessness, shaping public perception and influencing policymaking. Because online textual media and offline city council discourse both reflect and influence public opinion, they provide valuable signals for identifying and tracking social biases against PEH. We release the first multi-domain PEH bias corpus with a 16-category multi-label taxonomy: a 1,698-item stratified gold-standard set annotated by partner-trained raters, plus 50,447 GPT-4.1-labeled texts, drawn from Reddit, X (formerly Twitter), news, and council meeting transcripts across ten U.S. cities (2015-2025). We benchmark six prompted LLMs on the gold-standard set and complement F1 with prevalence-gap audits. Moderate F1 coexists with large miscalibration: every model over-tags "not in my backyard" (NIMBY) (+11.5 pp) and under-detects factual claims (-30.5 pp). Error analysis on consensus false positives reveals that models treat housing vocabulary and question form as opposition proxies, producing NIMBY false positives on pro-service text. The corpus and audit protocol support municipal PEH stigma monitoring without treating teacher labels as ground truth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文针对无家可归者（PEH）的社会偏见问题，构建了首个多领域PEH偏见语料库，包含16类别多标签分类法，数据来自Reddit、X、新闻和城市议会会议记录。作者评测了六个大语言模型（LLMs）的标注性能，发现F1中等但校准严重偏差，模型过度标注“别在我后院”（NIMBY）偏见，低估事实性声明。语料库可用于市政PEH污名监测。
Motivation: 社会偏见是缓解无家可归问题的主要障碍，影响公众认知和政策制定。在线文本和线下城市议会话语既反映也影响公众舆论，但缺乏多领域的PEH偏见标注数据。
Method: 构建多域PEH偏见语料库：1,698条黄金标准集（由培训过的评分员标注）和50,447条GPT-4.1标注文本，覆盖16类偏见标签。基准测试六种提示LLM，并使用prevalence-gap audits补充F1评估。
Result: 所有模型在黄金集上F1中等但校准严重偏差：过度标注“NIMBY”偏见（+11.5个百分点），低估事实性声明（-30.5个百分点）。错误分析显示模型将住房相关词汇和疑问句形式作为反对的代理，导致对支持服务的文本产生NIMBY假阳性。
Conclusion: 该语料库和审计协议支持市政PEH污名监测，无需将教师标签视为真实标注。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Attentions Under the Microscope: A Comparative Study of Resource Utilization for Variants of Self-Attention
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) and visual language models (VLMs) grow in scale and application, attention mechanisms have become a central computational bottleneck due to their high memory and time complexity. While many efficient attention variants have been proposed, there remains a lack of rigorous evaluation on their actual energy usage and hardware resource demands during training. In this work, we benchmark eight attention mechanisms in training GPT-2 architecture, measuring key metrics including training time, GPU memory usage, FLOPS, CPU usage, and power consumption. Our results reveal that attention mechanisms with optimized kernel implementations, including Flash Attention, Locality-Sensitive Hashing (LSH) Attention, and Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA), achieve the best energy efficiency. We further show that lower GPU power alone does not guarantee reduced energy use, as training time plays an equally important role. Our study highlights the importance of energy-aware benchmarking in attention design and provides a practical insight for selecting resource-efficient mechanisms. All our codes are available at GitHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在GPT-2架构上系统比较了八种自注意力变体的资源利用效率，测量训练时间、GPU内存、FLOPS、CPU使用率和功耗。结果显示，Flash Attention、LSH Attention和Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) 在能效上最优，且低GPU功率并不直接对应低能耗，训练时间同样关键。
Motivation: 大型语言模型和视觉语言模型中，注意力机制因高内存和时间复杂度成为计算瓶颈，但已有研究缺乏对实际能耗和硬件资源需求的严格评估。
Method: 在GPT-2架构上基准测试八种注意力机制，记录训练时间、GPU内存占用、FLOPS、CPU使用率和功率消耗等指标。
Result: Flash Attention、LSH Attention和MLA在能效方面表现最佳；实验表明低GPU功率并不保证总能耗降低，训练时间是重要影响因素。
Conclusion: 研究强调了能量感知基准测试在注意力设计中的重要性，并为选择资源高效机制提供了实用指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning MMSE Filters for OFDM Channel Estimation: Attention Transformer Gains at Linear Inference
papers.abstract_en: In orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM), accurate channel estimation is crucial. Classical signal processing-based approaches, such as linear minimum mean-squared error (LMMSE) estimation, often require second-order statistics that are difficult to obtain in practice. Recent deep neural network (DNN)-based methods have been introduced to address this, but they often suffer from high inference complexity. This paper proposes an Attention-aided MMSE (A-MMSE), a model-based DNN framework that learns the linear MMSE filter via the Attention Transformer. Once trained, the A-MMSE performs channel estimation through a single linear operation, eliminating nonlinear activations during inference and thus reducing computational complexity. To improve the learning efficiency of the A-MMSE, we develop a two-stage Attention encoder that captures the frequency and temporal correlation structure of OFDM channels. We also introduce a rank-adaptive extension that adjusts the filter rank at deployment time, enabling efficient operation under resource-constrained receivers. Numerical simulations show that A-MMSE consistently outperforms baseline methods across a wide range of signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) conditions. In particular, the A-MMSE and its rank-adaptive extension provide an improved performance-complexity trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Attention Transformer的模型驱动深度学习框架A-MMSE，用于OFDM信道估计。该方法通过训练学习线性MMSE滤波器，推理时仅需单次线性运算，避免了非线性激活，从而降低了计算复杂度。同时引入两阶段注意力编码器捕捉信道频率和时间相关性，以及秩自适应扩展以在资源受限接收机下灵活调整滤波器秩。仿真表明A-MMSE在多种信噪比条件下优于基线方法，且实现了更好的性能-复杂度权衡。
Motivation: 经典的LMMSE信道估计需要难以获取的二阶统计量，而现有深度学习方法推理复杂度高。
Method: 提出A-MMSE框架，利用Attention Transformer学习线性MMSE滤波器，训练后推理仅需单次线性操作；设计两阶段注意力编码器捕捉频域和时域相关性；并引入秩自适应扩展，可在部署时调整滤波器秩。
Result: 仿真显示A-MMSE在多种SNR条件下一致优于基线方法，其秩自适应扩展进一步改善了性能-复杂度权衡。
Conclusion: A-MMSE通过模型驱动方式将注意力机制与MMSE准则结合，实现了低复杂度、高性能的OFDM信道估计。

papers.title: Chameleon: A Multiplier-Free Temporal Convolutional Network Accelerator for End-to-End Few-Shot and Continual Learning from Sequential Data
papers.abstract_en: On-device learning at the edge enables low-latency, private personalization with improved long-term robustness and reduced maintenance costs. Yet, achieving scalable, low-power end-to-end on-chip learning, especially from real-world sequential data with a limited number of examples, is an open challenge. Indeed, accelerators supporting error backpropagation optimize for learning performance at the expense of inference efficiency, while simplified learning algorithms often fail to reach acceptable accuracy targets. In this work, we present Chameleon, leveraging three key contributions to solve these challenges. (i) A unified learning and inference architecture supports few-shot learning (FSL), continual learning (CL) and inference at only 0.5% area overhead to the inference logic. (ii) Long temporal dependencies are efficiently captured with temporal convolutional networks (TCNs), enabling the first demonstration of end-to-end on-chip FSL and CL on sequential data and inference on 16-kHz raw audio. (iii) A dual-mode, multiplier-free compute array allows either matching the power consumption of state-of-the-art inference-only keyword spotting (KWS) accelerators or enabling $4.3\times$ higher peak GOPS. Fabricated in 40-nm CMOS, Chameleon sets new accuracy records on Omniglot for end-to-end on-chip FSL (96.8%, 5-way 1-shot, 98.8%, 5-way 5-shot) and CL (82.2% final accuracy for learning 250 classes with 10 shots), while maintaining an inference accuracy of 93.3% on the 12-class Google Speech Commands dataset at an extreme-edge power budget of 3.1 $μ$W.
papers.comment: Paper as final submission to JSSC
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Journal of Solid-State Circuits, vol. 61, no. 7, pp. 3814-3829, July 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Chameleon，一种无乘法器的时序卷积网络加速器，支持端到端的片上小样本学习、持续学习和推理，在 40-nm CMOS 中实现。在 Omniglot 小样本学习上达到 96.8% 准确率，在 Google Speech Commands 推理上保持 93.3% 准确率，功耗仅 3.1 μW。
Motivation: 现有片上学习加速器在推理效率和学习性能之间存在权衡，且难以高效处理真实世界的顺序数据。
Method: 提出统一的学习与推理架构，利用时序卷积网络 (TCN) 捕获长时依赖，并采用无乘法器计算阵列，支持小样本学习和持续学习。
Result: 在 Omniglot 上达到 96.8% (5-way 1-shot) 和 98.8% (5-way 5-shot) 的准确率，持续学习 250 类达到 82.2% 最终准确率，推理功耗 3.1 μW。
Conclusion: Chameleon 实现了极低功耗下的端到端片上学习，适用于资源受限的边缘设备。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prismatic Synthesis: Gradient-based Data Diversification Boosts Generalization in LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Effective generalization in language models depends critically on the diversity of their training data. Yet existing diversity metrics often fall short of this goal, relying on surface-level heuristics that are decoupled from model behavior. This motivates us to ask: What kind of diversity in training data actually drives generalization in language models -- and how can we measure and amplify it? Through large-scale empirical analyses spanning over 300 training runs, carefully controlled for data scale and quality, we show that data diversity can be a strong predictor of generalization in LLM reasoning -- as measured by average model performance on unseen out-of-distribution benchmarks. We introduce G-Vendi, a metric that quantifies diversity via the entropy of model-induced gradients. Despite using a small off-the-shelf proxy model for gradients, G-Vendi consistently outperforms alternative measures, achieving strong correlation (Spearman's $ρ\approx 0.9$) with out-of-distribution (OOD) performance on both natural language inference (NLI) and math reasoning tasks. Building on this insight, we present Prismatic Synthesis, a framework for generating diverse synthetic data by targeting underrepresented regions in gradient space. Experimental results show that Prismatic Synthesis consistently improves model performance as we scale synthetic data -- not just on in-distribution test but across unseen, out-of-distribution benchmarks -- significantly outperforming state-of-the-art models that rely on 20 times larger data generator than ours. For example, PrismMath-7B, our model distilled from a 32B LLM, outperforms R1-Distill-Qwen-7B -- the same base model trained on proprietary data generated by 671B R1 -- on 6 out of 7 challenging benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过超过300次训练实验，表明数据多样性是LLM推理泛化性的强预测因子。提出G-Vendi指标，利用小代理模型的梯度熵量化多样性，与OOD性能的Spearman相关系数约0.9。进一步提出Prismatic Synthesis框架，通过在梯度空间欠表示区域生成多样合成数据，持续提升模型泛化能力。PrismMath-7B（基于32B教师蒸馏）在7个基准中6个超越基于671B R1数据的R1-Distill-Qwen-7B。
Motivation: 现有数据多样性指标多基于表面启发式，与模型行为脱节，难以有效预测LLM泛化。需要理解并度量真正驱动泛化的数据多样性。
Method: 提出G-Vendi指标，通过小代理模型（off-the-shelf proxy）的梯度熵量化数据多样性。基于此设计Prismatic Synthesis框架，在梯度空间中识别并生成欠表示区域的多样合成数据。
Result: G-Vendi与OOD性能的Spearman相关系数约0.9。Prismatic Synthesis在扩展合成数据时持续提升分布内和分布外基准性能。PrismMath-7B在6/7个困难基准上优于R1-Distill-Qwen-7B（后者使用671B R1生成的数据）。
Conclusion: 数据多样性是LLM推理泛化的关键，G-Vendi和Prismatic Synthesis提供了有效的度量与生成方法，能以较小生成器达到甚至超越大规模专有数据的效果。

papers.title: History-Aware Transformation of ReID Features for Multiple Object Tracking
papers.abstract_en: In Multiple Object Tracking (MOT), Re-identification (ReID) features are widely employed as a powerful cue for object association. However, they are often wielded as a one-size-fits-all hammer, applied uniformly across all videos through simple similarity metrics. We argue that this overlooks a fundamental truth: MOT is not a general retrieval problem, but a context-specific task of discriminating targets within a single video. To this end, we advocate for the adjustment of visual features based on the context specific to each video sequence for better adaptation. In this paper, we propose a history-aware feature transformation method that dynamically crafts a more discriminative subspace tailored to each video's unique sample distribution. Specifically, we treat the historical features of established trajectories as context and employ a tailored Fisher Linear Discriminant (FLD) to project the raw ReID features into a sequence-specific representation space. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our training-free method dramatically enhances the discriminative power of features from diverse ReID backbones, resulting in marked and consistent gains in tracking accuracy. Our findings provide compelling evidence that MOT inherently favors context-specific representation over the direct application of generic ReID features. We hope our work inspires the community to move beyond the naive application of ReID features and towards a deeper exploration of their purposeful customization for MOT. Our code will be released. The code is released at https://github.com/MCG-NJU/HATReID-MOT.
papers.comment: Accepted by ECCV 2026. Without bells and whistles, achieving 80.8 HOTA on SportsMOT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多目标跟踪（MOT）中普遍使用通用ReID特征但忽视视频内上下文特异性的问题，提出一种无训练的历史感知特征变换方法，利用Fisher线性判别（FLD）将原始ReID特征投影到每个视频序列特有的判别性子空间。实验表明该方法能显著提升多种ReID骨干网络的判别力，在SportsMOT上达到80.8 HOTA。
Motivation: 现有MOT方法将ReID特征视为通用工具，通过简单相似度度量统一应用于所有视频，忽略了MOT本质上是单个视频内的目标区分任务，而非通用检索问题。
Method: 提出历史感知特征变换方法，将已建立轨迹的历史特征作为上下文，使用定制的Fisher线性判别（FLD）将原始ReID特征投影到序列特定的表示空间，无需额外训练。
Result: 在多种ReID骨干网络上取得一致且显著的跟踪精度提升，在SportsMOT上无额外技巧即达到80.8 HOTA。
Conclusion: 该工作表明MOT本质上更适合上下文特定的特征表示，而非直接应用通用ReID特征，并鼓励社区探索ReID特征的有目的定制。

papers.title: AdaGC: Enhancing LLM Pretraining Stability via Adaptive Gradient Clipping
papers.abstract_en: Loss spikes remain a persistent obstacle in large-scale language model pretraining. While previous research has attempted to identify the root cause of loss spikes by investigating individual factors, we observe that, in practice, such spikes are typically triggered by the confluence of heterogeneous factors. Empirically, loss spikes may arise from a combination of data outliers, hardware or transient computational faults, numerical precision issues, and hyperparameter settings. Regardless of the underlying cause, these spikes manifest as unstable optimizer updates, as abnormal gradients contaminate both first- and second-moment states. In this paper, we propose a principled gradient-centric remedy: AdaGC, an adaptive per-tensor gradient clipping scheme that mitigates such contamination by bounding gradient norms relative to a tensor-wise exponential moving average of their historical clipped values. AdaGC is optimizer-agnostic, introduces negligible memory overhead, and reduces communication costs compared to GlobalGC, particularly in hybrid-parallel distributed training. Experiments on Llama-2 7B, Mixtral 8x1B, and ERNIE 10B-A1.4B demonstrate that AdaGC robustly eliminates training instabilities, consistently reducing spike scores to zero for all models and improving downstream accuracy over GlobalGC by 1.32%, 1.27%, and 2.48%, respectively. Furthermore, AdaGC seamlessly integrates with optimizers such as Muon and Lion, consistently yielding higher average accuracy and zero spike scores. The code is available at https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleFleet (see Research/AdaGC).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AdaGC，一种自适应逐张量梯度裁剪方案，用于消除大语言模型预训练中的损失尖峰（loss spikes）。该方法通过相对于历史裁剪值的指数移动平均来约束梯度范数，减轻异常梯度对优化器状态的污染。实验证明AdaGC在Llama-2 7B、Mixtral 8x1B和ERNIE 10B-A1.4B上稳定地将尖峰分数降至零，并在下游准确率上超过GlobalGC。
Motivation: 损失尖峰是大规模语言模型预训练中的持久障碍，现有研究多归因于单一因素，但实践中尖峰常由多种因素共同触发，包括数据异常、硬件故障、数值精度和超参数设置，无论根源如何，最终表现为异常梯度污染优化器状态。
Method: 提出AdaGC：一种自适应逐张量梯度裁剪方案，通过每个张量的历史裁剪值的指数移动平均（EMA）来动态约束梯度范数，从而减少异常梯度对一阶和二阶矩的污染。该方法与优化器无关，额外内存开销可忽略，且在混合并行分布式训练中比全局梯度裁剪（GlobalGC）降低通信成本。
Result: 在Llama-2 7B、Mixtral 8x1B和ERNIE 10B-A1.4B模型上，AdaGC将所有模型的尖峰分数降至零，下游准确率比GlobalGC分别提升1.32%、1.27%和2.48%；与Muon、Lion等优化器集成后也一致获得更高平均准确率和零尖峰分数。
Conclusion: AdaGC是一种原则性的梯度中心化解决方案，能鲁棒地消除训练不稳定，提高下游性能，并兼容多种优化器和分布式训练框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PLayer-FL: A Principled Approach to Personalized Layer-wise Cross-Silo Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) with non-IID data often degrades client performance below local training baselines. Partial FL addresses this by federating only early layers that learn transferable features, but existing methods rely on ad-hoc, architecture-specific heuristics. We first conduct a systematic analysis of layer-wise generalization dynamics in FL, revealing an early-emerging transition between generalizable (safe-to-federate) and task-specific (should-remain-local) layers. Building on this, we introduce Principled Layer-wise Federated Learning (PLayer-FL), which aims to deliver the benefits of federation more robustly. PLayer-FL computes a novel federation-sensitivity metric efficiently after a single training epoch to choose the optimal split point for a given task. Inspired by model pruning, the metric quantifies each layer's robustness to aggregation and highlights where federation shifts from beneficial to detrimental. We show that this metric correlates strongly with established generalization measures across diverse architectures. Crucially, experiments demonstrate that PLayer-FL achieves consistently competitive performance across a wide range of tasks while distributing gains more equitably and reducing client-side regressions relative to baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联邦学习（FL）在非独立同分布（non-IID）数据下性能下降的问题，提出了一种基于分层泛化动力学的个性化跨数据孤岛联邦学习方法（PLayer-FL）。该方法通过计算一种新型的联邦敏感性指标，在每个训练轮次后高效地选择最优的层分割点，仅对早期可泛化层进行联邦聚合，从而在广泛任务中实现稳健且公平的性能提升。
Motivation: 现有的部分联邦学习方法依赖特定架构的启发式规则，缺乏通用性，且非IID数据会导致客户端性能低于本地训练基线。
Method: 提出PLayer-FL框架，基于对层间泛化动力学的系统分析，通过单轮训练后计算各层对聚合的鲁棒性（联邦敏感性指标），自动确定最优的层分割点，实现早期可泛化层的联邦学习与后期任务特定层的本地保留。
Result: 实验表明，PLayer-FL在多种任务上持续达到有竞争力的性能，并且相比基线方法，更公平地分配收益并减少客户端性能退化。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种无需手动调整、架构自适应的个性化联邦学习方案，能够有效应对非IID数据场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Benchmark of Generative Methods for Zero-Shot Environmental Sound Classification
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot learning enables models to generalise to unseen classes using semantic information, bridging the gap between training classes and previously unseen test classes. While widely studied in computer vision, its application to environmental audio remains underexplored, and generative approaches have received little attention. This work presents the first benchmark of generative methods for zero-shot environmental sound classification. Four approaches spanning variational, adversarial, diffusion-based, and denoising paradigms are evaluated. The benchmark includes CADA-VAE and LisGAN, adapted from computer vision, together with two embedding-generation methods introduced in this work: one based on a denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) and the other on a conditional generative denoising network (CGDN). Experiments on five environmental audio datasets (ESC-50, ARCA23K-FSD, FSC22, UrbanSound8K, and TAU Urban Acoustic Scenes 2019) and one music dataset (GTZAN) show that generative methods are competitive with established compatibility-based approaches. Among the evaluated generative methods, CGDN achieves the highest average accuracy and is the only one to significantly outperform both the DDPM- and GAN-based methods, while remaining statistically indistinguishable from the strong ALE baseline. These findings suggest that optimisation stability is an important factor in generative zero-shot learning for environmental audio.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对生成式零样本环境声音分类方法进行了基准测试，评估了四种生成范式（变分、对抗、扩散和去噪），并在五个环境音频数据集和一个音乐数据集上比较性能。提出的CGDN方法在平均准确率上最优，与强基线ALE统计上无显著差异，表明优化稳定性对生成式零样本学习在环境音频中很重要。
Motivation: 零样本学习在计算机视觉中研究广泛，但在环境音频中的应用不足，生成式方法尤其缺乏关注。
Method: 构建了包含CADA-VAE、LisGAN（改编自视觉领域）以及本文提出的基于去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）和条件生成去噪网络（CGDN）的两种嵌入生成方法的基准。
Result: 在五个环境音频数据集和一个音乐数据集上，CGDN平均准确率最高，且显著优于DDPM和GAN方法，与ALE基线无统计差异。
Conclusion: 生成式方法在零样本环境声音分类中具有竞争力，优化稳定性是关键因素。

papers.title: Gradient-Free Privacy Leakage in Federated Language Models through Selective Weight Tampering
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) has become a key component in various language modeling applications such as machine translation, next-word prediction, and medical record analysis. These applications are trained on datasets from many FL participants that often include privacy-sensitive data, such as healthcare records, phone/credit card numbers, login credentials, etc. Although FL enables computation without necessitating clients to share their raw data, existing works show that privacy leakage is still probable in federated language models. In this paper, we present two novel findings on the leakage of privacy-sensitive user data from federated large language models without requiring access to gradients. Firstly, we make a key observation that model snapshots from the intermediate rounds in FL can cause greater privacy leakage than the final trained model. Secondly, we identify that a malicious FL participant can aggravate the leakage by tampering with the model's selective weights that are responsible for memorizing the sensitive training data of some other clients, even without any cooperation from the server. Our best-performing method increases the membership inference recall by 29% and achieves up to 71% private data reconstruction, evidently outperforming existing attacks that consider much stronger adversary capabilities. Lastly, we recommend a balanced suite of techniques for an FL client to defend against such privacy risk.
papers.comment: 21 pages (including bibliography and Appendix), Submitted to PETS'26
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现联邦大语言模型中的隐私泄露问题：中间轮次的模型快照比最终模型泄露更多隐私；恶意参与者可通过篡改模型选择性权重（无需梯度）加剧隐私泄露，在成员推断和私有数据重建上优于现有攻击。
Motivation: 联邦学习中语言模型训练涉及隐私敏感数据，现有攻击多依赖梯度，本文探索无需梯度的更隐蔽攻击方式。
Method: 提出两种新发现：1) 中间轮次快照泄露更大；2) 恶意参与者篡改模型选择性权重（记忆其他用户敏感数据的权重）以增强隐私泄露，无需服务器配合。
Result: 最佳方法将成员推断召回率提高29%，私有数据重建率达71%，超越现有更强假设下的攻击。
Conclusion: 建议联邦学习客户端采用平衡防护技术抵御此类隐私风险。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Automated Reinforcement Learning: An Overview
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning and, recently, Deep Reinforcement Learning are popular methods for solving sequential decision-making problems modeled as Markov Decision Processes. RL modeling of a problem and selecting algorithms and hyper-parameters require careful consideration, as different configurations may entail completely different performances. These considerations are mainly the task of RL experts; however, RL is progressively becoming popular in other fields, such as combinatorial optimization, where researchers and system designers are not necessarily RL experts. Besides, many modeling decisions are typically made manually, such as defining state and action space, size of batches, batch update frequency, and time steps. For these reasons, automating different components of RL is of great importance, and it has attracted much attention in recent years. Automated RL provides a framework in which different components of RL, including MDP modeling, algorithm selection, and hyper-parameter optimization, are modeled and defined automatically. In this article, we present the literature on automated RL (AutoRL), including the recent large language model (LLM) based techniques. We also discuss the recent work on techniques that are not presently tailored for automated RL but hold promise for future integration into AutoRL. Furthermore, we discuss the challenges, open questions, and research directions in AutoRL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了自动化强化学习（AutoRL）的研究进展，涵盖了MDP建模、算法选择和超参数优化等组件的自动化，并讨论了基于大型语言模型的技术以及有前景的未来方向。
Motivation: 强化学习的建模和配置需要专家经验，而RL正被其他领域（如组合优化）的非专家使用，因此自动化RL的不同组件具有重要意义。
Method: 通过文献综述梳理AutoRL框架，包括自动MDP建模、算法选择和超参数优化，并纳入近期基于LLM的技术，同时展望尚未整合但有潜力的方法。
Result: 文章是综述性质，未报告具体实验结果，但系统化了AutoRL的研究现状和未来方向。
Conclusion: AutoRL是一个活跃且重要的研究方向，仍存在诸多挑战和开放问题，值得进一步探索。

papers.title: Increasing Line Outage Localization Performance with Ensemble Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: In many cases, the outage of one transmission line in a system can be localized by monitoring the power flow of another line, and machine learning methods can be used to distinguish the cases under uncertainty. In this study, we examine the improvements in line outage localization performance achieved by various ensemble classifiers compared to single-model methods. In the case studies, we compared the classification results with measurement data collected at observed transmission lines (OTLs) selected using three algorithms, i.e, greedy maximum coverage problem (MCP), high-eta, and random selection, based on two sensitivity factors, i.e., line outage distribution factors (LODFs) and line outage impact factors (LOIFs). We found that the OTLs selected by the greedy MCP algorithm yielded the highest F1 score and the ensemble classifiers significantly outperformed a base kNN classifier. The extra-trees bagging technique achieved the highest F1 score in many instances. All the findings were statistically significant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了集成分类器在输电线路故障定位中的性能提升，与单模型方法进行对比。基于两种灵敏度因子（LODF和LOIF）和三种OTL选择算法（贪婪MCP、high-eta、随机选择）进行实验。结果表明，贪婪MCP算法选择的观测线路（OTL）取得了最高的F1分数，且集成分类器显著优于基础kNN分类器，其中extra-trees bagging在多个实例中表现最佳。所有发现具有统计显著性。
Motivation: 单模型方法在输电线路故障定位中存在不确定性，集成分类器可能提升定位性能，但具体改进程度和最佳OTL选择算法尚不明确。
Method: 采用多种集成分类器（包括extra-trees bagging）与基础kNN对比，基于LODF和LOIF两种灵敏度因子，使用贪婪MCP、high-eta和随机选择三种算法选取观测线路（OTL），并在测量数据上进行分类实验。
Result: 贪婪MCP算法选择的OTL实现了最高F1分数；集成分类器显著优于基础kNN；extra-trees bagging在多数实例中取得最佳F1分数。
Conclusion: 集成分类器（尤其是extra-trees bagging）结合贪婪MCP算法选择OTL可有效提升输电线路故障定位性能，且结果具有统计显著性。

papers.title: Scalable Causal Imitation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Imitation learning enables learning a policy in an unknown environment with a latent reward signal using expert demonstrations, but it struggles when the imitator's and expert's observations are mismatched and unobserved confounders are present in expert demonstrations. By identifying appropriate adjustment sets via the sequential $π$-backdoor criterion, causal imitation learning (CIL) provides a framework for approximating the expert's policy from confounded data. However, existing CIL methods, Causal Behavioral Cloning (Causal BC) and Causal Generative Adversarial Imitation Learning (Causal GAIL), are designed for short-horizon, low-dimensional settings. When applied to continuous control tasks with long horizons and high-dimensional state-action spaces, these methods exhibit poor performance: Causal BC suffers from compounding errors, Causal GAIL is unstable and sample-inefficient, and sequential $π$-backdoor adjustment becomes impractical. We introduce Causal Soft Q Imitation Learning (SQIL) and Causal Inverse soft-Q Learning (IQ-Learn), two off-policy causal imitation learning algorithms that combine the causal adjustment framework with state-of-the-art inverse reinforcement learning objectives. Both algorithms operate on causally-adjusted state representations produced by an efficient approximation of the sequential $π$-backdoor criterion, exploiting the causal structure of continuous control environments to reduce the full-horizon adjustment to a fixed-size sliding window. We evaluate all methods in a suite of confounded environments and find that Causal SQIL and Causal IQ-Learn substantially outperform prior CIL algorithms on long-horizon tasks, sometimes surpassing the expert, whereas all causally unaware imitation methods fail to learn meaningful behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出两种离策略因果模仿学习算法Causal SQIL和Causal IQ-Learn，将因果调整框架与逆强化学习目标结合，通过近似序贯π-后门准则处理连续控制任务中的混淆问题。实验表明，在长时域任务上大幅优于现有因果模仿学习方法，甚至超过专家，而非因果方法完全失败。
Motivation: 现有因果模仿学习方法（Causal BC和Causal GAIL）在处理连续控制任务的长时域、高维状态-动作空间时表现不佳，存在复合误差、不稳定、样本效率低等问题，且序贯π-后门调整不实用。
Method: 提出Causal SQIL和Causal IQ-Learn两种离策略算法，利用连续控制环境的因果结构，通过有效近似序贯π-后门准则，将全时域调整简化为固定大小滑动窗口，并基于因果调整后的状态表示进行模仿学习。
Result: 在混淆环境套件中，Causal SQIL和Causal IQ-Learn在长时域任务上显著优于先前的因果模仿学习算法，有时甚至超过专家性能，而所有非因果模仿方法均未能学习到有意义的行为。
Conclusion: 因果模仿学习结合离策略逆强化学习目标可有效扩展到连续控制任务，克服了现有方法在长时域高维问题上的局限性。

papers.title: Counterfactual Shapley Credit Assignment
papers.abstract_en: The Credit Assignment Problem (CAP) is fundamental to developing efficient and explainable Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents. Existing frameworks, whether relying on temporal contiguity or hindsight-conditioned reward reweighting, frequently fail to attribute properly between an agent's policy (skill) and environmental stochasticity (luck). A principled approach to CAP must isolate the true causal drivers of observed outcomes from spurious correlations and environmental randomness. We introduce Counterfactual Shapley Credit Assignment, a novel framework grounded in causal theory that attributes credit and blame via the Counterfactual Shapley Value ($φ$-value). By redistributing environmental rewards, $φ$-values enhance temporal credit assignment across three critical dimensions: sparse causality, high stochasticity, and delayed rewards, all while preserving the optimal policy. We derive a consistent estimator that computes $φ$-values efficiently, enabling a new class of policy gradient methods, $φ$-PPO, combined with Prioritized Trajectory Replay (PTR). Empirical results demonstrate that $φ$-values align precisely to the ground truth causes of task rewards with superior sample efficiency in challenging environments where prior state-of-the-art methods fail to converge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于因果理论的反事实Shapley值（φ-value）框架，用于解决强化学习中的信用分配问题，通过重新分配环境奖励，提升了在稀疏因果、高随机性和延迟奖励场景下的时间信用分配效果，并提出了φ-PPO算法与优先轨迹回放（PTR），实验表明在复杂环境中具有更高的样本效率。
Motivation: 现有强化学习信用分配方法（如基于时间连续性或事后条件奖励重加权）无法正确区分策略（技能）与环境随机性（运气）的影响，缺乏因果驱动的归因机制。
Method: 引入反事实Shapley值（φ-value）作为信用分配的因果度量，推导出一致估计量以高效计算φ值，并将其集成到策略梯度方法中，形成φ-PPO算法，配合优先轨迹回放（PTR）进行训练。
Result: 在具有稀疏因果、高随机性和延迟奖励的挑战性环境中，φ值能够精确对齐任务奖励的真实因果原因，在现有最先进方法无法收敛的情况下，实现了更优的样本效率。
Conclusion: 基于因果理论的反事实Shapley值框架为强化学习中的信用分配提供了原则性解决方案，能够解开策略与运气的混淆，同时保持最优策略不变。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PriorProof: A Point-in-Time Measure of Technique Novelty for Formal Proofs
papers.abstract_en: Mathematicians distinguish proofs that explain, simplify, or introduce a nonstandard route, but these judgments are difficult to operationalize. We study a deliberately narrower construct: time-relative proof-route nonstandardness in formal mathematics. For a Lean theorem, PriorProof extracts the dependency footprint of its elaborated proof term and scores the weighted surprisal of that footprint under a retrieval-conditioned, hierarchically smoothed prior built only from an earlier quarterly snapshot of Mathlib. The method requires no hand-built technique ontology and no human labels: statement retrieval is learned from proof-derived contrastive pairs, while the scored object is read mechanically from proof terms. In a blinded topology study, 100 presentations collapse to 76 distinct underlying pairs: 12 canonical contrasts shown three times for consistency screening and 64 distinct stratified pairs. Against the majority of three retained domain raters, PriorProof agrees on 53/76 pairs (69.7%, Wilson 95% CI 58.7-78.9%), including 11/12 canonical pairs (91.7%, 64.6-98.5%) and 42/64 stratified pairs (65.6%, 53.4-76.1%). Score-gap quartiles are nonmonotone after repeat collapse; the endpoints are 12/19 (63.2%, 41.0-80.9%) in the smallest-gap bin and 16/19 (84.2%, 62.4-94.5%) in the largest, supporting an endpoint-calibration tendency rather than a resolved staircase. The best language-model condition agrees on 60/76 pairs (78.9%, 68.5-86.6%); on paired outcomes, PriorProof alone is correct on 8 pairs and the model alone on 15 (exact two-sided McNemar p = 0.210), so the difference is not established at this sample size. We therefore present PriorProof not as a replacement for expert or model judgment, but as a decomposable, time-anchored signal whose score gap provides an interpretable reliability indicator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PriorProof，一种针对形式化证明中证明路径非标准性的时间相对度量方法。该方法基于Lean定理的证明项依赖足迹，利用检索条件化的层次平滑先验计算加权惊奇值，无需人工标注。在盲法拓扑学研究中，PriorProof与多数专家判断在76对中达成69.7%一致，并可作为可解释的可靠性指标。
Motivation: 数学家能区分证明是否新颖，但难以操作化。该论文研究较窄的构造：形式化数学中时间相关的证明路径非标准性。
Method: PriorProof提取Lean定理的证明项依赖足迹，并使用基于早期Mathlib快照的检索条件化、层次平滑先验计算加权惊讶值。无需手工技术本体或人工标签：陈述检索从证明导出的对比对中学习，评分对象从证明项中机械读取。
Result: 在拓扑学盲法研究中，76对中有53对（69.7%）与多数专家一致，其中12对规范对比中11对一致（91.7%），64对分层对比中42对一致（65.6%）。得分差距的四分位数显示端点校准趋势。最佳语言模型条件下76对中60对一致（78.9%），但单独比较时差异不显著（McNemar p=0.210）。
Conclusion: 论文强调PriorProof不是替代专家或模型判断，而是作为可分解的、时间锚定的信号，其得分差距提供可解释的可靠性指标。

papers.title: Automated Cardiac Adipose Tissue Segmentation in Computed Tomography: A Literature Review
papers.abstract_en: This review provides an overview of recent advancements in automated segmentation methods on Computed Tomography (CT) for two types of cardiac fat: Epicardial adipose Tissue (EAT) and Pericardial Adipose Tissue (PAT). These fat deposits, separated by the pericardium, have been linked to various cardiovascular diseases, with EAT receiving the most research attention. Their complex anatomical context makes manual quantification highly time-consuming and prone to considerable inter-observer variability. Automated methods effectively address these complications, offering a more efficient and consistent solution. This study encompasses a broad range of methods, spanning AI as well as non-AI approaches. Additionally, it presents the remaining challenges, including the need for larger annotated public datasets and optimized attenuation thresholds for contrast-enhanced CT. It is demonstrated that automated methods are able to achieve segmentation results comparable to the quality of human annotation, proving their potential as a clinical tool for discovering new biomarkers and enhancing patient outcomes.

papers.title: Real-World Evaluation of an AI Agent Drafting Translational Impact Summaries
papers.abstract_en: Introduction. Clinical and Translational Science Award (CTSA) programs must document their scholars' research impact, but assembling each scholar's record by hand takes staff an estimated 15 hours and does not scale to a full cohort. An artificial intelligence (AI) agent could serve as a tool to gather scholar data across platforms and disciplines. Methods. We built a human-in-the-loop AI agent that assembles a dossier of sourced evidence for each scholar and drafts one-sentence Translational Science Benefits Model (TSBM) impact summaries for staff review. We evaluated it in the impact-reporting workflow of one CTSA hub across 10 career-development (KL2/K12) scholars. Two evaluation staff independently coded all 507 findings as accept, edit, or reject; the primary measure was the unanimous usable rate, defined as the share both accepted or edited. Results. Both reviewers accepted or edited 81.7% of the agent's findings. Reviewers each spent a median of 14 minutes per scholar, replacing an estimated 15 hours of manual assembly. Inter-rater agreement was moderate (Cohen's kappa 0.43 on the usable-versus-reject decision). A profile discovery study found the agent's recall close to human search. The agent's impact evidence spanned all four TSBM domains, and about a third of the reviewed findings fell in non-scholarly categories that routine processes tend to miss. A human-in-the-loop AI agent can serve as the first-pass author of a scholar's impact record, shifting staff from collecting and writing to reviewing, and making cohort-scale impact reporting feasible.

papers.title: Twisted Schrödinger Bridge Matching
papers.abstract_en: Over the past few years, diffusion-based Schrödinger bridge models have been proposed to approximate optimal transport dynamics between two prescribed boundary distributions, with successful applications to generative modeling. More precisely, these methods aim to estimate a path measure whose initial and terminal marginals match the two boundary distributions, while minimizing the Kullback-Leibler divergence with respect to a reference Markov process. In this work, we consider the generalized Schrödinger bridge problem, in which the reference process is a twisted Brownian motion, that is, a Feynman-Kac transform of a Brownian motion induced by a time-dependent differentiable potential. Building on the Iterative Markovian Fitting (IMF) paradigm, and in particular on its special case Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge Matching (DSBM), which corresponds to the zero potential case, we introduce Twisted Schrödinger Bridge Matching (TSBM), a diffusion-based method designed to handle both continuous- and discrete-time potentials. Unlike previous approaches, TSBM provides a rigorous extension of the IMF scheme to the generalized Schrödinger bridge problem. This derivation leads to a new bridge-matching loss that depends explicitly on the gradient of the potential and recovers the DSBM objective when the potential vanishes, yielding improved performance. We further introduce trajectory-based variance-reduction techniques that substantially stabilize optimization and may be useful beyond the present setting. Finally, we empirically demonstrate the benefits of TSBM for trajectory inference across increasingly high-dimensional settings, including crowd navigation and single-cell data. Code available at https://github.com/maxencenoble/twisted-sb-matching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了扭曲薛定谔桥匹配（Twisted Schrödinger Bridge Matching, TSBM），一种基于扩散的方法，用于求解广义薛定谔桥问题。该问题以扭曲布朗运动（即由时间依赖可微势函数诱导的Feynman-Kac变换）为参考过程。TSBM在迭代马尔可夫拟合（IMF）范式基础上扩展了扩散薛定谔桥匹配（DSBM），其损失函数显式依赖于势函数的梯度，并引入了基于轨迹的方差缩减技术以稳定优化。实验表明，TSBM在高维轨迹推断任务（如人群导航和单细胞数据）中取得改进效果。
Motivation: 经典的薛定谔桥方法以布朗运动为参考，限制了其适用性。本文旨在将参考过程推广为扭曲布朗运动，以处理更一般的势函数，从而在生成建模和轨迹推断中获得更大灵活性。
Method: 基于IMF框架和DSBM，TSBM通过引入依赖于势函数梯度的桥匹配损失来推广薛定谔桥问题。该方法支持连续时间和离散时间势函数，并采用基于轨迹的方差缩减技术来稳定训练过程，该技术可能对更广泛的设置有用。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但声称TSBM在高维轨迹推断场景（人群导航和单细胞数据）中性能优于先前方法。
Conclusion: TSBM为IMF方案在广义薛定谔桥问题中的严格扩展提供了理论推导，并展示了其在轨迹推断任务中的实用优势。代码已开源。

papers.title: Periodic Bootstrap Thompson Sampling For Periodically Non-Stationary Bandit Problems
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces Periodic Bootstrap Thompson Sampling (PBTS), an innovative extension of the classic Thompson Sampling (TS) algorithm tailored for bandit problems with periodic non-stationarity. Conventional TS accumulates all past observations, leading to biased posteriors when reward distributions cycle over time. PBTS overcomes this by synchronizing belief resets with known or inferred period intervals and embedding structured bootstrap exploration phases, effectively purging obsolete data while preserving uncertainty estimates. PBTS is tested in artificially constructed environments, which include skewed and balanced reward distributions, along with different bootstrap proportions and misaligned periodic intervals. Results indicate that PBTS generally achieves statistically significant reductions in cumulative regret against traditional TS in periodic non-stationary environments. Subsequent discussion further articulates the potential of PBTS's real-world deployment. The study mentions limitations like extreme periodic misalignment and proposes future research such as self-adjusting cycle-recognition. With memory reset and bootstrap phase, PBTS introduces a novel approach to optimizing bandit algorithms in periodic reward contexts.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 10 figures, Accepted to 2025 3rd International Conference on Data Science, Advanced Algorithms, and Intelligent Computing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出周期性自举汤普森采样（PBTS），是经典汤普森采样在周期性非平稳环境下的扩展，通过周期性重置信念和自举探索阶段来消除过时数据，在人工环境下比传统TS显著降低累积遗憾。
Motivation: 传统汤普森采样在奖励分布周期性变化时，由于累积所有历史观测导致后验分布有偏，无法适应周期性非平稳性。
Method: PBTS利用已知或推断的周期间隔同步重置信念，并嵌入结构化自举探索阶段，从而清除过时数据同时保持不确定性估计。
Result: 在人工构造的包含偏斜和平衡奖励分布、不同自举比例及错位周期间隔的环境中，PBTS相比传统汤普森采样实现了统计显著的累积遗憾降低。
Conclusion: 论文讨论了PBTS在实际部署中的潜力，指出极端周期错位等局限性，并提议未来研究自适应周期识别等方向。

papers.title: Expected Free Energy as Belief-Dependent Utility for rho-POMDPs
papers.abstract_en: An agent acting under partial observability must decide when to gather information and which observations are worth their cost. Standard POMDPs value information only through its eventual effect on reward. The $ρ$-POMDP framework instead rewards uncertainty reduction directly, through a belief-dependent utility $ρ$, but in practice both the choice of $ρ$ and the weight placed on it are tuned by hand for every task. We show that active inference removes this tuning entirely. Minimizing Expected Free Energy (EFE) is exactly equivalent to solving a $ρ$-POMDP whose utility is expected information gain, and the exploration weight is fixed at $w=1$ because the variational bound expresses pragmatic and epistemic value in the same units (nats). We prove this equivalence for observe-then-commit POMDPs and extend it to factored observation POMDPs, a broader class that covers interleaved observe-act problems such as non-destructive testing and mobile sensing, where gathering information leaves the hidden state unchanged. Experiments support the theory. Across environments ranging from the classic Tiger problem to RockSample and a new Structural Inspection benchmark with over 65,000 states, the untuned weight matches or outperforms reward-only planning at the same horizon, avoids the over-exploration of bonuses tuned per task, and sits near the reward-maximizing knee of the success-reward Pareto frontier. The practical payoff is an exploration objective that works out of the box. In applications such as fault detection and medical screening, where every test has a price and every missed fault has a cost, EFE supplies a belief-dependent utility that is derived rather than tuned.
papers.comment: 41 pages, 12 figures. Paper accepted as a spotlight at the 2026 International Workshop on Active Inference (IWAI); the workshop version will appear in the Springer Communications in Computer and Information Science (CCIS) series. Code and experiment data at https://github.com/PatrickAllenCooper/rho_aif
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明最小化预期自由能（EFE）等价于解决一个ρ-POMDP，其中信念依赖效用为期望信息增益，且探索权重固定为1。实验在Tiger问题、RockSample和超过65000状态的结构检测基准上，未调整的权重匹配或优于仅奖励规划，且避免了过度探索。
Motivation: 标准POMDP仅通过奖励间接评估信息价值，而ρ-POMDP虽直接奖励不确定性减小，但其效用函数ρ和探索权重需手动调整。本文旨在消除这种手动调整。
Method: 通过理论推导，证明在observe-then-commit POMDP和因子化观测POMDP中，最小化EFE等价于求解一个ρ-POMDP，其中ρ为期望信息增益，且探索权重固定为w=1。
Result: 在Tiger问题、RockSample和结构检测基准上，未调整权重的EFE方法在相同规划水平下匹配或优于仅奖励规划，避免了对任务特定的过度探索，并接近奖励-成功帕累托前沿的拐点。
Conclusion: EFE提供了一种无需调参的探索目标，在故障检测和医学筛查等应用中，信念依赖效用是推导所得而非手动设定。

papers.title: TurboVec: A Case Study in Cost-Efficient Private Retrieval for Enterprise RAG via Codebook-Oblivious Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems increasingly power enterprise LLM applications, yet the vector retrieval layer introduces two underexplored challenges: (1) trained codebook quantizers may expose corpus statistics during index construction, creating a leakage channel in multi-tenant deployments, and (2) post-hoc filtering for tenant isolation degrades recall on selective queries. We study TurboVec, an open-source vector index built on TurboQuant - a codebook-oblivious scalar quantizer requiring no corpus-dependent training. On the DBpedia OpenAI embeddings benchmark (d=1536, 100K-999K vectors), TurboQuant 4-bit outperforms trained FAISS Product Quantization at the same memory budget by 8.5-8.9 percentage points in Recall@5 across all scales. Compared to HNSW (R@5=0.991) and IVF-PQ (R@5=0.840), TurboQuant occupies a distinct design point: higher recall than IVF-PQ without training, at 4-8x less memory than HNSW. Deployed on Snowpark Container Services, TurboVec achieves 11ms median query latency at 100K vectors versus 707ms for warehouse brute-force scan. Kernel-level allowlist filtering maintains 0.86-0.93 Recall@10 across 10-1000 tenant workloads versus 0.09-0.19 for post-filter baselines. Codebook-oblivious design reduces membership inference accuracy to near-random (50.0%) versus 57.3% for PQ codebooks. Limitations include single dataset evaluation, uncompressed HNSW comparison, and privacy evaluation on synthetic data only.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TurboVec，一个基于代码书无关标量量化器（TurboQuant）的开源向量索引，用于企业级RAG系统中的高效私有检索。在DBpedia OpenAI embeddings基准测试中，TurboQuant 4-bit在相同内存预算下，Recall@5比训练后的FAISS乘积量化（PQ）高8.5-8.9个百分点，且无需训练。与HNSW和IVF-PQ相比，TurboQuant在召回率和内存之间取得了独特平衡。在Snowpark Container Services上部署时，100K向量的中位数查询延迟为11ms。通过内核级允许列表过滤，在10-1000租户工作负载下，Recall@10保持在0.86-0.93，而后过滤基线仅为0.09-0.19。代码书无关设计将成员推理准确率降至接近随机（50.0%），而PQ为57.3%。局限性包括仅在单个数据集上评估、与未压缩HNSW比较以及仅基于合成数据的隐私评估。
Motivation: 企业RAG系统中的向量检索层存在两个未被充分探索的挑战：训练后的代码书量化器可能在索引构建期间暴露语料统计信息，造成多租户部署中的泄露通道；用于租户隔离的后过滤会降低选择性查询的召回率。
Method: 提出TurboVec，基于TurboQuant——一种无需语料依赖训练的代码书无关标量量化器，并采用内核级允许列表过滤实现租户隔离。
Result: 在DBpedia OpenAI embeddings基准上，TurboQuant 4-bit Recall@5比FAISS PQ高8.5-8.9个百分点；在Snowpark Container Services上，100K向量中位数查询延迟11ms；内核级过滤在10-1000租户下Recall@10为0.86-0.93；成员推理准确率50.0%（近随机）。
Conclusion: 代码书无关量化可消除训练阶段的数据泄露风险，同时保持高召回率和低延迟，但评估仅限于单一数据集和合成隐私数据，需进一步验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Training Continuous Chain of Thought Models: A Tale of Two Regimes
papers.abstract_en: Continuous Chain-of-Thought methods replace verbose reasoning traces with a short sequence of dense latent representations. Earlier continuous CoT methods indirectly supervise the latent representations such that its final state match that of verbose reasoning traces, requiring autoregressive, slow generation during training. We introduce C-MTP, a simpler, faster direct supervision approach that models each latent as an average of the embeddings in the CoT traces to be compressed. Our approach outperforms a prior direct supervision method that approximates the distribution of compressed tokens, and performs competitively to slower indirect supervision approaches in existing evaluation setup with simplified CoT traces (less than 100 tokens). Lastly, we extend the evaluation of Continuous CoT methods to complex tasks with longer reasoning traces ($\ge$ few hundreds reasoning tokens). We find both direct and indirect supervision training methods perform poorly (roughly 65\% performance drop) in this setting, revealing the limitations of current continuous CoT methods. The code and checkpoints are released at https://github.com/Varun221/cmtp_research
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出C-MTP，一种直接监督的连续链式思维（Continuous Chain-of-Thought）方法，通过将每个潜在表示建模为待压缩CoT轨迹中嵌入的平均值，简化并加速训练。在简化CoT轨迹（<100 token）上，C-MTP优于先前的直接监督方法，并与慢速的间接监督方法性能相当。然而，在复杂任务的长推理轨迹（数百token）上，所有连续CoT方法均出现约65%的性能下降，暴露了当前方法的局限性。
Motivation: 早期连续CoT方法依赖间接监督潜在表示，需要自回归慢速生成；现有直接监督方法性能有限。需要更简单快速的训练方法，并理解连续CoT在长推理轨迹上的适用性。
Method: 提出C-MTP，一种直接监督方法：将每个潜在表示建模为CoT轨迹中待压缩token嵌入的平均值，而非估计压缩token的分布。训练时无需自回归生成，更加高效。
Result: 在简化CoT轨迹（<100 token）上，C-MTP在性能上优于先前直接监督方法，并与较慢的间接监督方法竞争。在长推理轨迹（数百token）的复杂任务中，所有连续CoT方法均表现不佳，性能下降约65%。
Conclusion: 当前连续CoT方法在处理长推理轨迹时存在严重局限，C-MTP虽在短轨迹上有效，但无法推广到更复杂的推理场景。需要新的架构或训练策略来弥补这一差距。
Relevance: 5
