papers.title: Can Experts Adapt Without Training? On Test-Time Modality Generalization in MVLMs
papers.abstract_en: Medical vision-language models (MVLMs) promise broad zero-shot generalization, yet their reliability collapses when confronted with unseen modalities and domains, precisely where clinical robustness matters most. To address this gap, we revisit test-time modality generalization from the perspective of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) and ask: can experts route-and-adapt without any optimization during inference? We identify a fundamental specialization-generalization dilemma at test time, where blindly aggregating modality experts dilutes modality-specific knowledge, while selecting one highly confident expert risks mismatch under shift. To address this, we propose MoBE: a fully optimization-free framework that performs dynamic expert selection and adaptation at test time. MoBE combines entropy-guided dynamic routing in MoE settings with expert-wise Bayesian adaptation, enabling experts to update their confidence and adapt online without gradient updates. Without parametric updates, MoBE augments a static MVLM with test-time routing and online statistics, achieving average accuracy gains of +4.72, +7.17, and +4.3 over state-of-the-art TTA methods across seen, unseen, and heterogeneous medical benchmarks, highlighting the effectiveness of training-free expert adaptation for robust modality generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医学视觉-语言模型在测试时面对未见模态和领域时可靠性下降的问题，提出MoBE框架，无需训练即可在测试时进行动态专家选择和适应。MoBE结合熵引导动态路由与专家级贝叶斯适应，使专家无需梯度更新即可在线调整置信度。在seen、unseen和heterogeneous医疗基准上，平均准确率比现有测试时适应方法分别提升+4.72、+7.17和+4.3，展示了无训练专家适应在模态泛化中的有效性。
Motivation: 现有MVLM在零样本泛化上表现良好，但在面临未见过的模态和领域时可靠性急剧下降，而临床鲁棒性要求极高。本文探索能否在不进行任何优化的情况下，在测试时实现专家路由和适应。
Method: 提出MoBE框架，一种完全无需优化的测试时模态泛化方法。它利用熵引导的动态路由（entropy-guided dynamic routing）和专家级贝叶斯适应（expert-wise Bayesian adaptation），使专家能够在不更新参数的情况下在线调整置信度。
Result: 在seen、unseen和heterogeneous医疗基准上，MoBE平均准确率比最先进的TTA方法分别高出+4.72、+7.17和+4.3。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，无需参数更新的测试时专家适应策略能够有效提升MVLM在未见模态和领域上的鲁棒泛化能力。

papers.title: Semi-Supervised Conditional Generative Learning through Stochastic Interpolation and Sufficient Representations
papers.abstract_en: Conditional generative modeling remains a challenging problem in semi-supervised settings where labeled data is scarce but unlabeled samples are abundant. To effectively leverage structural information embedded within the unlabeled dataset and compensate for sparse conditioning signals, we propose a semi-supervised framework combining conditional stochastic interpolation with low-dimensional latent representations. RepG decomposes generation into two stages: label-dependent latent sampling and high-dimensional reconstruction. This isolates the supervised learning of conditional dependencies to a low-dimensional space, requiring few labels while utilizing the abundant unlabeled data purely for reconstruction. Theoretically, we establish an error decomposition showing that the Kullback-Leibler divergence of RepG comprises stage-wise estimation errors and a structural bias quantified by conditional mutual information. For deep neural network estimators, we derive non-asymptotic convergence rates proving that RepG significantly improves sample complexity. By confining the supervised estimation burden to the low intrinsic dimension of the latent representation, RepG achieves a strictly faster convergence rate. Complemented by a minimax lower bound, our theoretical results demonstrate that this method effectively mitigates the curse of dimensionality inherent in direct ambient-space generative modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RepG 半监督条件生成框架，通过随机插值 (stochastic interpolation) 和低维潜在表示将生成分解为标签依赖的潜在采样和高维重建两步。理论分析表明其 KL 散度误差由阶段估计误差和条件互信息度量的结构偏差组成，并推导了深度神经网络的非渐近收敛率，证明该方法通过将监督估计负担限制在低维潜在空间，实现了更快的收敛速度，有效缓解了环境空间直接生成中的维度灾难。
Motivation: 半监督条件生成建模中，标签数据稀少而未标签数据丰富，如何有效利用未标签数据的结构信息补偿稀疏的条件信号是一个挑战。
Method: 提出 RepG 框架，结合条件随机插值与低维潜在表示，将生成过程分解为两个阶段：首先在低维空间进行标签依赖的潜在采样（监督学习），然后利用大量未标签数据进行高维重建（无监督学习）。
Result: 理论推导了 KL 散度的误差分解，包含阶段估计误差和条件互信息结构偏差；对于深度神经网络估计器，证明了非渐近收敛率，表明 RepG 显著改善了样本复杂度，且收敛速度严格快于直接环境空间建模。还给出了极小下界。
Conclusion: 通过将监督学习约束在潜在表示的低本征维度上，RepG 有效缓解了环境空间条件生成中的维度灾难，理论结果支撑了其高效性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Half the Experts, All the Code: One-Shot Domain Pruning of Mixture-of-Experts LLMs for Coding
papers.abstract_en: The strongest open-weight coding models are mixture-of-experts (MoE) networks: most of their size comes from large pools of "expert" subnetworks, of which only a few act on any token. That pool is why these models do not fit on the machines most developers own, yet for a user who only wants coding help, most experts encode abilities that will never be invoked. We ask how many experts can be removed, and which, by pruning two recent open-weight MoE models from different families (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and Gemma-4-26B-A4B) under five selection strategies, judged the way a user would: by whether the model still writes correct code. Half the experts can be removed from either model with no statistically detectable loss on the primary code benchmark, and the damage lands almost entirely on abilities outside coding, the intended trade. But the winning strategy flips between the two models, so a recipe validated on one family cannot be assumed to work on another. We further show that perplexity, the metric much of the pruning literature leans on, can rate a broken model above an intact one; that a lightweight fine-tune recovers about half of what aggressive pruning loses; and that against quantizing the full model to the same memory, pruning wins only where quantization would have to drop below 3 bits per weight. Five attempts to overturn that crossover, with failure criteria fixed in advance (better calibration, guarded selection, causal expert importance, failure attribution, and an agentic evaluation letting each model repair its failures from execution feedback), all leave it standing; the last shows single-shot benchmarks overstate compression penalties broadly, as one repair turn erases the 2-bit quantization penalty entirely. Expert pruning works, but it demands per-model validation on the task the model will actually serve.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 3 figures. Code and pruned checkpoints: github.com/anik-jha/moep
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从混合专家（MoE）LLM中为编程任务进行单次域剪枝，移除一半专家仍能保持编程基准性能，但最优策略随模型族而异；困惑度可能误导剪枝评估；剪枝在内存约束下仅当量化低于3 bits/weight时优于量化；轻量微调可恢复一半损失。
Motivation: 大型MoE模型因其大量专家子网络难以部署在个人机器上，但用户仅需编程能力时多数专家能力未被使用，因此需要确定可移除的专家及其数量。
Method: 对Qwen3.6-35B-A3B和Gemma-4-26B-A4B两种MoE模型，采用五种剪枝策略，以编程正确性为评价标准进行单次域剪枝。
Result: 两个模型均可移除一半专家而编程基准性能无统计显著下降，能力损失集中在非编程领域；最优剪枝策略因模型而异；困惑度可能将损坏模型评为优于完整模型；轻量微调恢复约一半损失；剪枝仅在量化低于3 bits/weight时优于量化。
Conclusion: 专家剪枝有效但需针对具体任务和模型族进行验证；单次基准可能夸大压缩惩罚，一次修复回合即可消除2-bit量化惩罚。

papers.title: Effects of width-dependent model hyperparameters and $\ell_2$-regularization on the loss landscape of two-layer ReLU networks
papers.abstract_en: Understanding deep neural networks remains a central challenge in machine learning. In particular, the theoretical properties of even two-layer ReLU networks, especially in the presence of weight decay, remain poorly understood. To this end, we derive a sufficient condition on the hyperparameter settings under which the global minima collapse to the zero solution. Interestingly, our experiments reveal that using AdamW as an optimizer prevents the collapse of the learned parameters, whereas using SGD does not, which may help explain the success of AdamW in deep learning training. In addition, when restricting the input dimension to one, we derive an analytical solution for the globally optimal parameter sets of two-layer ReLU networks and show that $\ell_2$-regularization has a width-invariant effect on connectivity, but its dimensionality-reducing effect becomes stronger as the network width increases. These results provide insight into how width-dependent hyperparameters influence the geometry of regularized loss landscapes.
papers.comment: ICML2026 4th Workshop on High-dimensional Learning Dynamics (HiLD)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了宽度相关的超参数和L2正则化对两层ReLU网络损失景观的影响。推导了全局最小值坍塌到零解的超参数充分条件，实验发现AdamW优化器可防止坍塌而SGD不能。在输入维度为一时，解析求解了全局最优参数集，表明L2正则化对连通性具有宽度不变效应，但其降维效应随宽度增加而增强。
Motivation: 理解深度神经网络的理论性质仍是挑战，特别是两层ReLU网络在权重衰减下的性质尚不清楚。
Method: 通过理论推导超参数的充分条件，实验对比AdamW与SGD优化器，并在输入一维情形下解析求解全局最优参数集。
Result: 推导了超参数条件使全局最小值坍塌到零解；实验表明AdamW可防止坍塌而SGD不能；一维解析解显示L2正则化对连通性有宽度不变效应，但降维效应随宽度增加而增强。
Conclusion: 这些结果提供了宽度依赖超参数如何影响正则化损失景观几何的洞察。

papers.title: A Causal Markov Condition for Value
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a causal independence principle for value -- the value Causal Markov Condition (v-CMC) -- and develops the conceptual and mathematical foundations of a "causal value theory" linking causality and utility. After motivating a local formulation of the v-CMC, we introduce a probability-value duality that translates standard causal-inference results into the value setting. In particular, we formulate local, global, and decomposition versions of the v-CMC and prove their equivalence. We also define v-separation and show that it is sound and complete for conditional value independence. Furthermore, we derive a Bellman-type recursion as a special case of the v-CMC, thereby generalizing standard Bellman recursion from linear chains to causal DAGs. Finally, we show how the v-CMC supports modular transfer and updating of utility information across causal contexts and develop algorithms for causally structured utility elicitation and canonical influence-diagram construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出价值因果马尔可夫条件（v-CMC），建立因果价值理论（causal value theory）的数学基础，将因果关系与效用联系起来。通过概率-价值对偶，将标准因果推断结果转化为价值设定，证明局部、全局和分解版本的v-CMC等价，定义v-separation并证明其对条件价值独立性的完备性。此外，推导出Bellman型递归作为v-CMC的特例，将标准Bellman递归从线性链推广到因果有向无环图，并展示如何在不同因果上下文中模块化转移和更新效用信息。
Motivation: 现有因果推断框架主要关注概率关系，缺乏将因果结构直接与价值（utility）或奖励（reward）统一处理的通用原则。本文旨在建立一种因果马尔可夫条件在价值设定下的版本，使得因果图能够直接表示价值独立性关系，从而支持更高效的效用推理和决策。
Method: 提出v-CMC（value Causal Markov Condition），引入概率-价值对偶（probability-value duality），形式化局部、全局和分解版本并证明其等价性；定义v-separation概念；推导Bellman型递归；设计因果结构化的效用启发（causally structured utility elicitation）和规范影响图构建算法。
Result: 证明v-separation对于条件价值独立性是完备的；将Bellman递归推广到任意因果DAG；展示v-CMC支持跨因果上下文的模块化效用转移与更新。
Conclusion: v-CMC为因果价值理论提供了核心原则，使得因果图可同时用于推断概率和效用，有助于提升决策分析和影响图构建的模块化与可迁移性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RECON: Benchmarking Agent Memory for Compositional Reasoning over Long Contexts
papers.abstract_en: Large language models and LLM-based agents are widely used as personal chat assistants, enterprise copilots, and autonomous workflow agents. In all these applications, memory (the ability to retain, access, and reason over information accumulated over long contexts and multiple interactions) plays a crucial role in determining the reliability of any agent. We introduce RECON (Reasoning over Extended Contexts with Obfuscated Narratives), a benchmark for evaluating compositional reasoning over long contexts. RECON spans 24 case files across three domains (criminal, medical, and financial), each ranging from 50k to 100k tokens, and tests agents on six memory intensive tasks: reconstructing multi-hop evidence chains, propagating cascading invalidations, resolving source conflicts, counterfactual reasoning, satisfying temporal constraints, and temporal fact retrieval. Recent memory benchmarks evaluate whether agents can retrieve scattered facts or detect if a fact has changed whereas RECON evaluates what happens after the change, whether agents can trace which downstream conclusions are affected, which survive through independent support, and how alternative timelines would have unfolded. Our evaluation reveals substantial limitations across current architectures: even the strongest non-Oracle system reaches only 22.4% Accuracy, with retrieval and reasoning each surfacing as challenges.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RECON是一个用于评估大语言模型代理在长上下文中组合推理能力的基准。它包含24个案例文件，横跨刑事、医疗和金融三个领域，每个案例长度为50k到100k token，测试代理在六种记忆密集型任务上的表现。评估结果显示，当前最强非Oracle系统仅达到22.4%的准确率，检索和推理都构成挑战。
Motivation: 现有记忆基准主要评估代理能否检索分散事实或检测事实是否变化，但缺少对事实变化后下游推理影响的评估。RECON填补了这一空白，专注于代理在信息变更后追踪结论影响、独立支持及替代时间线的能力。
Method: RECON基准包含24个案例文件，每个案例包含长上下文（50k-100k token）和六类任务：重建多跳证据链、传播级联无效化、解决源冲突、反事实推理、满足时间约束和时间事实检索。
Result: 最强非Oracle系统在RECON上仅达到22.4%的准确率，表明当前架构在组合推理上存在显著局限。
Conclusion: RECON揭示了现有LLM代理在长上下文组合推理中的不足，检索和推理都是主要瓶颈，为未来研究提供了方向。

papers.title: Tractable Query Answering under Epistemic Confidentiality Policies in DL Ontologies (extended version)
papers.abstract_en: We study Controlled Query Evaluation (CQE), a declarative approach to confidentiality-preserving data access, in the context of Description Logic (DL) ontologies, and for confidentiality policies expressed through Epistemic Dependencies (EDs). We first address the problem of answering queries (specifically, Boolean unions of conjunctive queries) under known semantics for CQE (GA- and IGA-entailment). Our results show that if the TBox is expressed in $\text{DL-Lite}_{\mathcal{R}}$, CQE is computationally intractable in general. Moreover, in the presence of EDs, the IGA semantics has recently been proven not to satisfy an important confidentiality preservation property known as indistinguishability. With the goal of defining computationally easier and confidentiality-preserving forms of CQE, we introduce a new semantics for CQE, based on the notion of minimal policy violation (MPV). We show that the new semantics provides a sound approximation of the previous ones, while satisfying the indistinguishability property. We also prove that, in the case of $\text{DL-Lite}_{\mathcal{R}}$ ontologies, query entailment under the MPV semantics can be decided in polynomial time in data complexity. Finally, we present a software implementation of our framework that we used to evaluate the feasibility of this new approach using an existing benchmark for OWL 2 QL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了描述逻辑本体中受控查询评估（CQE）的保密性问题，针对以认知依赖（ED）表达的保密策略。首先证明了在DL-Lite_R本体下，CQE在计算上通常是难解的。为了满足不可区分性并降低复杂度，提出了基于最小策略违反（MPV）的新语义，该语义可多项式时间判定查询蕴含，且是之前语义的可靠近似。最后实现了原型系统并用OWL 2 QL基准测试验证了可行性。
Motivation: 现有CQE语义（如GA-和IGA-entailment）在DL-Lite_R中计算困难，且IGA语义不满足不可区分性保密属性，需要更高效且保密的语义。
Method: 提出基于最小策略违反（MPV）的新CQE语义，通过定义一种更受限制的违规概念来近似先前语义，同时保证不可区分性。
Result: 在DL-Lite_R本体下，MPV语义下的查询蕴含可在数据复杂度多项式时间内判定；MPV语义是GA-和IGA-entailment的可靠近似。
Conclusion: MPV语义为DL本体中的CQE提供了一种计算上可行且满足不可区分性的解决方案，未来可扩展到更丰富的语言。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DS@GT ARC at eRisk 2026: Hybrid Multi-Agent LLM System with Structured Algorithmic Guidance for Conversational Depression Screening
papers.abstract_en: We describe DS@GT's submission to the eRisk 2026 Task 1 challenge on conversational depression screening, in which systems interview LLM personas that simulate individuals with varying depression profiles and produce a Beck Depression Inventory II (BDI-II) score plus four key symptoms per persona, without directly asking sensitive mental health questions. Our pipeline evolved through three stages: a monolithic single-model prototype to start off, a baseline multi-agent architecture that separates conversational interviewing from BDI-II scoring under a coordinating orchestration layer, and a final hybrid configuration that replaces the paid GPT-5-nano interviewer with the open-source Gemma 27B. To offset the model's weaker reasoning and instruction-following, the hybrid adds three algorithmic components: a precomputed dialogue tree that standardizes interview openers and follow-ups, a reliability-weighted consensus aggregation inspired by the Weaver framework, and a cluster-based imputation step for unprobed symptoms. We submitted three fully automated runs across all 20 personas, with Run 1 from the paid baseline and Runs 2 and 3 from the hybrid. Hybrid Run 3 achieved an ADODL of 0.9063, ranking 3rd among all complete-submission runs and placing DS@GT 2nd among the 21 teams overall, while outperforming our paid baseline Run 1 (0.8841) at roughly one-quarter of the per-persona API cost. These results support our central hypothesis that with sufficient algorithmic supervision, a weaker open-source model can compete with a stronger proprietary model in the conversational interviewer role. Our source code is available at https://github.com/dsgt-arc/erisk-task1-2026.
papers.comment: Conference and Labs of the Evaluation Forum (CLEF), 19 pages, 5 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文描述了DS@GT团队在eRisk 2026任务1上的系统，用于对话式抑郁症筛查。系统通过访谈模拟不同抑郁症特征的LLM角色，生成贝克抑郁量表II评分和四个关键症状，而不直接询问敏感问题。系统经历了三个阶段：单模型原型、多智能体基线、以及混合配置，后者用开源Gemma 27B替代付费GPT-5-nano作为访谈者，并添加了对话树、可靠性加权共识和聚类插补等算法组件。混合系统在排名中位列第3（ADODL 0.9063），整体团队排名第2，且成本仅为付费基线的大约四分之一。
Motivation: 在对话式抑郁症筛查中，直接询问敏感问题可能引发伦理问题，且付费GPT模型成本高。论文探索用开源模型在算法指导下达到类似或更好效果。
Method: 提出混合多智能体系统：使用开源Gemma 27B作为访谈者，结合预计算对话树标准化访谈流程、可靠性加权共识（借鉴Weaver框架）聚合评分，以及基于聚类的插补处理未探测症状。系统分三个运行：运行1为付费基线，运行2和3为混合系统。
Result: 混合系统运行3的ADODL为0.9063，在所有完整提交中排名第3，团队整体排名第2（共21个团队），优于付费基线运行1（0.8841），同时每角色API成本降低约75%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，在充分的算法监督下，较弱开源模型可以在对话式访谈角色中与较强付费模型竞争。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OFD-Net: Teacher-Free Reliable Semi-supervised Medical Image Segmentation with Orthogonal Feature Disentanglement Net of Foreground-Background
papers.abstract_en: Semi-supervised learning (SSL) is an effective solution for medical image segmentation with limited annotations. Existing SSL methods mainly rely on pseudo-labels generated by teacher-student supervision or cross-network consistency. However, these methods lack an explicit structural reference for judging pseudo-label quality. Low-quality pseudo-labels may lead to unreliable training, error accumulation and confirmation bias when processing unlabeled data with substantial appearance variations. To address this issue, we proposed OFD-Net, a teacher-free single-network framework for reliable semi-supervised medical image segmentation. OFD-Net employs an Orthogonal Feature Disentanglement Module (OFDM) to capture OFD features for reliable SSL by disentangling unlabeled data into background and foreground representations with a reliable structural distribution, thereby effectively reducing error accumulation and alleviating confirmation bias among unlabeled data. Specifically, OFD-Net explicitly employs a Disentanglement Guidance Module (DGM) to inject the resulting structural priors of foreground-background into the decoder by deformable convolution processing, and outputs predictions with clearer foreground representations. Based on DGM and the OFDM, we further develop a reliability-aware pseudo-label learning mechanism that evaluates unlabeled supervision according to the structural consistency between the main prediction and the disentangled foreground-background responses, and then down-weights unreliable regions during training. Extensive experiments on four public medical image segmentation benchmarks, namely ISIC-2016, Kvasir-SEG, Synapse, and ACDC, validate the effectiveness of OFD-Net. These results confirm that orthogonal foreground-background disentanglement enables OFD-Net to establish an efficient and reliable training paradigm within a teacher-free single-network framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OFD-Net，一种无教师单网络半监督医学图像分割框架。通过正交特征解耦模块（OFDM）将未标注数据解耦为背景和前景表示，减少错误累积和确认偏差。在四个医学图像分割基准（ISIC-2016、Kvasir-SEG、Synapse、ACDC）上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有半监督方法依赖伪标签，缺乏明确结构参考，低质量伪标签导致训练不可靠、错误累积和确认偏差。
Method: 采用正交特征解耦模块（OFDM）提取解耦特征；使用解耦引导模块（DGM）通过可变形卷积将前景-背景结构先验注入解码器；提出可靠性感知伪标签学习机制，根据结构一致性评估未标注监督并对不可靠区域降权。
Result: 在四个医学图像分割基准上的实验验证了 OFD-Net 的有效性。
Conclusion: 正交前景-背景解耦使得 OFD-Net 能够在无教师单网络框架内建立高效可靠的训练范式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Semi-Supervised Conditional Diffusion via Label Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Conditional diffusion models have become a powerful and flexible framework for learning complex conditional distributions from labeled data. In practice, however, acquiring high-quality labels is costly and time-consuming, leaving large volumes of unlabeled data unused. To address this, we introduce label-augmented conditional diffusion (LACD), a simple and effective approach that incorporates unlabeled examples by assigning them a designated trivial label and performing joint denoising score matching over the augmented dataset. We provide sufficient conditions guaranteeing population-level identifiability of the target conditional distribution under this scheme. Moreover, we establish rigorous statistical guarantees: when sufficiently many unlabeled samples are available, the sampling distribution produced by LACD converges strictly faster than the purely supervised estimator in total variation distance, and at least as fast in Wasserstein-1 distance. Extensive experiments on synthetic, image, and tabular benchmarks corroborate our theory and show substantial gains in sample efficiency and generative performance compared with the purely supervised estimator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出标签增强条件扩散（LACD），通过为无标签数据分配一个特殊trivial标签并将其与有标签数据联合进行去噪分数匹配，实现半监督条件扩散模型训练。理论分析给出了总体水平上目标条件分布可识别的充分条件，并证明当无标签样本足够多时，LACD生成的采样分布在总变差距离上严格优于纯监督估计器，在Wasserstein-1距离上至少不差。合成数据、图像和表格基准的实验验证了样本效率和生成性能的显著提升。
Motivation: 高质量标注数据获取成本高、耗时长，大量无标签数据未被利用，限制了条件扩散模型在标注稀缺场景下的应用。
Method: 提出LACD方法，为每个无标签样本赋予一个指定的trivial标签，然后将有标签和无标签数据合并为增强数据集，在该数据集上执行联合去噪分数匹配来训练条件扩散模型。
Result: 理论证明在一定条件下目标条件分布可识别，且当无标签样本充分多时，LACD的采样分布在总变差距离上收敛速度严格快于纯监督估计器，Wasserstein-1距离上至少不慢。实验表明在合成、图像和表格数据上样本效率和生成性能均优于纯监督方法。
Conclusion: LACD是一种简单有效的半监督条件扩散方法，具有理论可识别性和统计收敛保证，能够充分利用无标签数据提升生成质量。

papers.title: Building a Neural Network from Scratch: Implementation, Evaluation, and Optimization
papers.abstract_en: The widespread adoption of high-level deep learning libraries, while accelerating model development, has increasingly abstracted away the internal mechanics of neural networks, creating a gap between practical usage and fundamental understanding. To address this, the paper presents a self-contained neural network framework implemented entirely from scratch -- without relying on automatic differentiation or pre-built deep learning modules. The implementation encompasses all essential components, including multi-layer architectures, diverse activation functions, regularization techniques, and state-of-the-art optimizers. Beyond serving as a pedagogical instrument that demystifies forward/backward propagation, gradient dynamics, and optimization landscapes, the framework demonstrates robust performance when applied to a multi-class classification task, successfully validating its correctness, numerical stability, and generalization across varied configurations. The extensible design and clean modularity further position it as a reliable baseline for educational purposes and future research exploration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从零构建了一个自包含的神经网络框架，不依赖自动微分或预构建深度学习模块，涵盖多层架构、多种激活函数、正则化技术和先进优化器。作为教学工具阐明了前向/反向传播和梯度动力学，并在多类分类任务上验证了正确性、数值稳定性和泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有高级深度学习库抽象了神经网络内部机制，造成实践与基础理解之间的鸿沟。本文旨在通过从零实现来弥补这一差距。
Method: 作者从零实现了一个神经网络框架，包含多层架构、多种激活函数、正则化技术和优化器，不使用自动微分或预构建模块。
Result: 在多类分类任务上，该框架展示了稳健的性能，验证了正确性、数值稳定性和泛化能力。
Conclusion: 本文框架具有可扩展性和模块化，可作为教学工具和未来研究探索的可靠基线。

papers.title: A Framework for Early Sepsis Prediction via Self-Supervised (JEPA) and Federated Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Early sepsis prediction from electronic health records is challenged by irregular sampling, high missingness, and class imbalance. We systematically compare four modeling paradigms -- self-supervised Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) via masked latent prediction, self-supervised VICReg (variance-invariance-covariance regularization) with two-view augmentation, semi-supervised fine-tuning of a VICReg-pretrained encoder, and supervised Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) -- alongside raw-feature baselines. All models share a common preprocessing pipeline of hourly binning with forward-fill imputation applied to 7 biomarkers selected via sparsity analysis from the MIMIC-III dataset. Our best model (JEPA + XGBoost + mean pooling) achieves AUPRC 0.636 at the time of onset (H0), approaching the SupMix benchmark (0.667) while using 83\% fewer biomarkers. The Tier 1 pipeline -- VICReg pretraining followed by semi-supervised fine-tuning and XGBoost -- achieves AUPRC 0.510 at H0, a 3.1$\times$ improvement over the raw-feature baseline (0.165) and a 7.6\% improvement over the end-to-end supervised TCN (0.474). Crucially, the fine-tuned VICReg encoder exhibits the most temporally persistent representations, degrading only 16.8\% from H0 to H10 compared to 47.5\% for supervised TCN and 65.3\% for JEPA, demonstrating that self-supervised pretraining with task-aware fine-tuning yields features that are both sharp near onset and robust across prediction horizons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了四种建模范式（自监督JEPA、自监督VICReg、半监督微调VICReg、监督TCN）用于早期脓毒症预测。基于MIMIC-III数据集，最佳模型JEPA+XGBoost+mean pooling在发病时刻AUPRC达0.636，仅用SupMix基准17%的生物标记物。微调VICReg编码器在时间维度上表示最持久，从H0到H10仅退化16.8%。
Motivation: 电子健康记录中早期脓毒症预测面临不规则采样、高缺失率和类别不平衡的挑战，现有方法多依赖大量特征或监督学习，缺乏对时间鲁棒性的关注。
Method: 采用共同预处理流程（每小时分箱、前向填充），比较JEPA（掩码潜在预测）、VICReg（方差-不变性-协方差正则化）、半监督微调VICReg以及监督TCN，最终使用XGBoost作为分类器。
Result: JEPA+XGBoost+mean pooling在H0时刻AUPRC为0.636，逼近SupMix基准0.667且使用83%更少特征；半监督VICReg管线AUPRC为0.510，较原始特征基线提升3.1倍，较监督TCN提升7.6%。
Conclusion: 自监督预训练结合任务感知微调能够产生在发病时刻尖锐且跨预测时间窗口鲁棒的特征，为临床早期预警提供了一种数据高效且可部署的方案。

papers.title: The Value of Depth in Message Passing on Sparse Graphs: A Kesten-Stigum Dichotomy
papers.abstract_en: How deep does a graph neural network need to be on a sparse graph? We study its purest statistical form: node classification on the sparse contextual stochastic block model (CSBM) with average degree $Δ=O(1)$, whose local weak limit is a broadcast-labelled Poisson Galton-Watson tree. Prior work derived a message-passing classifier $h_\ell$ that aggregates from each vertex at distance $k\le\ell$ the attenuated evidence $2\operatorname{artanh}(γ^k t(X_v))$, with $γ$ the edge signal and $t$ a bounded likelihood-ratio transform of the feature. We prove that the value of depth is governed by a single number, the Kesten-Stigum ratio $κ=γ^2Δ$. Below the threshold ($κ<1$), the error sequence is Cauchy at a geometric rate, $|\mathcal{E}(\ell)-\mathcal{E}(\ell')|\le Cκ^{(\ell+1)/3}$ for all $\ell'>\ell$, so all layers beyond depth $O(\log(1/ε))$ change the error by less than $ε$; conversely, under mild regularity each sufficiently deep layer still flips the decision with probability at least $cκ^{\ell/2}$, the empirically sharp exponent. Above the threshold ($κ>1$), depth is geometrically productive: $\mathcal{E}(\ell)$ is driven to a branching-process floor of order at most $1/(κ-1)$ at any geometric rate $κ^{-s\ell}$, $s<1$ (this bound has content only for $κ>17$). No local classifier of any depth beats the universal floor $e^{-Δ}Φ(-ζ)$ set by isolated roots ($ζ$ the feature signal-to-noise ratio), while the first layer provably helps by an explicit total-variation amount. Simulations with an exact belief-propagation baseline on the same trees show that the pairwise rule's error curve is mildly non-monotone in $\ell$, so an optimal finite depth exists (an exact instance is certified in the appendix), while BP saturates strictly faster, at an effective per-layer ratio below $κ$ that we identify.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究稀疏图上消息传递的深度价值，证明在稀疏上下文随机块模型（CSBM）中，深度效果由Kesten-Stigum比值κ=γ²Δ决定：低于阈值时深度影响呈几何衰减，高于阈值时深度显著提升性能。模拟显示精确信念传播基线的误差曲线在层数上轻度非单调。
Motivation: 图神经网络在稀疏图上需要多少层？论文通过纯统计形式研究节点分类问题，并分析深度带来的边际收益。
Method: 基于消息传递分类器h_ℓ，在每个顶点距离k≤ℓ处聚合衰减证据2 arctanh(γ^k t(X_v))，并利用Kesten-Stigum比率κ=γ²Δ刻画深度的影响。
Result: 低于阈值（κ<1）时误差序列呈几何级数收敛，层数超过O(log(1/ε))后误差变化小于ε；高于阈值（κ>1）时深度有效，误差以几何速率κ^{-sℓ}降低至O(1/(κ-1))，且第一层贡献显著。
Conclusion: 无局部分类器能超越由孤立根设定的通用下限e^{-Δ}Φ(-ζ)，而精确信念传播基线显示最优有限深度存在，误差曲线在ℓ上轻度非单调。

papers.title: Isotonic Conformal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: A point prediction that is well calibrated on average can still be systematically biased conditional on its own value, undermining its use in downstream decision-making. We consider two objectives for reliable uncertainty quantification: self-calibration, requiring a point prediction to be unbiased conditional on its own value, and prediction-conditional validity, requiring a prediction interval to attain nominal coverage conditional on the prediction. Self-Calibrating Conformal Prediction (SC-CP) attains both objectives exactly in finite samples, but requires refitting its calibrator for every candidate outcome, which is computationally prohibitive for continuous outcomes. We propose Isotonic Conformal Prediction (ICP), a framework that decouples calibration from prediction-set construction by fitting a single isotonic recalibration map and constructing prediction intervals within strata of similar recalibrated predictions. Within this framework we develop two procedures. Split Isotonic Conformal Prediction (SICP) attains prediction-conditional validity in finite samples and self-calibration asymptotically, at the computational cost of split conformal prediction. Transductive Isotonic Conformal Prediction (TICP) attains both objectives exactly in finite samples through a per-test-point inner loop that avoids refitting the isotonic calibrator. On synthetic heteroscedastic regression problems and a real-world healthcare-utilization dataset, both procedures match the coverage of SC-CP at substantially lower computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出等渗共形预测（ICP）框架，通过拟合单个等渗再校准映射并在分层中构建预测区间，实现自校准和预测条件有效性。SICP和TICP两种程序在有限样本或渐近意义上达到目标，计算成本显著低于SC-CP。
Motivation: 现有SC-CP方法虽能同时实现自校准和预测条件有效性，但需为每个候选结果重拟合校准器，计算开销大，尤其不适合连续结果。
Method: 提出等渗共形预测（ICP），解耦校准与预测集构建：先拟合一个等渗再校准映射，然后在相似再校准预测值的分层内构造预测区间。开发了分裂等渗共形预测（SICP）和直推等渗共形预测（TICP）。
Result: 在合成异方差回归问题和真实医疗利用率数据集上，SICP和TICP以更低计算成本达到与SC-CP相当的覆盖率。SICP有限样本下达到预测条件有效性，渐近下自校准；TICP有限样本下两者皆精确满足。
Conclusion: ICP框架在保持理论保证的同时大幅降低计算成本，适用于需要高效不确定性量化的场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CLDRoute: Conditional Latent Diffusion for Routability Map Generation in Physical Design
papers.abstract_en: Accurate routability estimation during physical design is important for reducing costly post-routing iterations. Prior learning-based methods treat this task as deterministic prediction, mapping placement-stage features to a single congestion or DRC outcome. We instead formulate routability estimation as a conditional generation problem, where both routing congestion and DRC violations are modeled as spatially structured routability fields. Our framework, Conditional Latent Diffusion for Routeability estimation (CLDRoute), uses physics-aware conditioning and task-specific latent modeling to handle the different characteristics of congestion and DRC maps. This allows our method to supports sample-based inference, producing both a mean prediction and a spatial uncertainty estimate for the same input design. On CircuitNet 2.0 (N28), our method achieves, for DRC violation generation, an SSIM of 0.9678, an MAE of 0.0028, and a TopK@1% of 0.3494; for congestion generation, it achieves an SSIM of 0.9031, an MAE of 0.0286, and an NZ-Pearson of 0.3692. Overall, our framework provides a more practical view of routability at placement by generating both the expected outcome and its uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CLDRoute，将物理设计中的可路由性估计视为条件生成问题，使用条件潜在扩散模型生成路由拥塞和DRC违规地图，并提供不确定性估计。在CircuitNet 2.0 (N28)上，DRC违规生成SSIM达0.9678，拥塞生成SSIM达0.9031。
Motivation: 物理设计中的精确可路由性估计对减少后布线迭代至关重要，现有学习方法将其视为确定性预测，忽略了不确定性。
Method: 将可路由性估计建模为条件生成问题，使用物理感知条件（physics-aware conditioning）和任务特定的潜在建模，支持基于样本的推理，输出均值预测和空间不确定性。
Result: 在CircuitNet 2.0 (N28)上，DRC违规生成SSIM 0.9678、MAE 0.0028、TopK@1% 0.3494；拥塞生成SSIM 0.9031、MAE 0.0286、NZ-Pearson 0.3692。
Conclusion: 该框架通过同时生成预期结果和不确定性，提供了更实用的可路由性视图。

summary_sections.result: 在CircuitNet 2.0 (N28)上，DRC违规生成SSIM 0.9678、MAE 0.0028、TopK@1% 0.3494；拥塞生成SSIM 0.9031、MAE 0.0286、NZ-Pearson 0.3692。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架通过同时生成预期结果和不确定性，提供了更实用的可路由性视图。

papers.title: Foundation-Assisted Active Learning for Object Detection Annotation
papers.abstract_en: The annotation cost for remote sensing object detection is high, while existing active learning methods still face several challenges in object detection scenarios, including the coupling of localization and classification uncertainty, severe localization noise in the cold-start stage, and pseudo-diversity caused by high-recall candidate proposals. To address these issues, we propose a foundation-model-collaborative active learning and semi-automatic annotation framework for efficient construction of remote sensing object detection datasets. We build a dual-source mechanism consisting of a reference localization source (SA-source) based on UPN+SAM2 and a detector prediction source (OD-source), and further propose a Foundation-model-enhanced Dual-Source Uncertainty estimation to improve sample selection quality in the cold-start stage by jointly modeling localization consistency and classification confidence. Furthermore, we propose Object-Centric Diversity Sampling, which constructs object-level representations using DINOv2 features and SAM2 masks to improve sample coverage while suppressing pseudo-diversity. To address geometric noise in the semi-automatic annotation stage, we design Dual-Source Box Switching, which replaces noisy detector boxes with matched refined boxes from the SA-source, thereby reducing the manual burden of box refinement. Experiments on DIOR, HRSC2016, DOTAv2, and FAIR1M show that our method achieves superior or comparable results under most annotation budgets, with notably stronger cold-start sample efficiency in the low-budget regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个基于基础模型协同的主动学习和半自动标注框架，用于遥感目标检测数据集的高效构建。通过双源不确定性估计和对象中心多样性采样改进样本选择质量，通过双源框切换减少人工标注负担。在四个遥感数据集上验证了有效性，尤其在低预算下冷启动效率较高。
Motivation: 遥感目标检测标注成本高，现有主动学习方法在目标检测场景中面临定位与分类不确定性耦合、冷启动阶段定位噪声大、高召回候选框导致伪多样性等问题。
Method: 提出基础模型辅助的主动学习与半自动标注框架：构建基于UPN+SAM2的参考定位源和检测器预测源的双源机制；提出基础模型增强的双源不确定性估计，联合建模定位一致性和分类置信度；提出对象中心多样性采样，利用DINOv2特征和SAM2掩码构建对象级表示以抑制伪多样性；设计双源框切换，用匹配的SA源精炼框替换噪声检测框。
Result: 在DIOR、HRSC2016、DOTAv2和FAIR1M上，该方法在多数标注预算下达到优于或相当的结果，低预算下冷启动样本效率显著更强。
Conclusion: 提出了一种有效降低遥感目标检测标注成本的主动学习与半自动标注方法。

papers.title: OpenLanguageModel: Readable and Composable Small-Language-Model Pretraining for Education and Research
papers.abstract_en: OpenLanguageModel (OLM) is an open-source PyTorch library for building and pretraining small language models while keeping their machinery visible. In OLM, model code reads like the architecture: components are ordinary modules, while Block, Residual, Repeat, and Parallel describe how they are wired. The resulting model can move unchanged from a teaching notebook to a complete pretraining run or a research ablation. OLM connects this readable model layer to tokenizers, local and streaming datasets, optimization, mixed precision, callbacks, checkpoints, and hardware-aware CPU, single-GPU, and single-node multi-GPU execution. We demonstrate the full path by tracing GPT-2 from diagram to code, launching a FineWeb-Edu training script, replacing one attention component, and letting AutoTrainer configure the available machine. The package includes 27 presets across nine familiar model families and documentation that progresses from LM fundamentals to architecture research. Validation shows close agreement with independent reference implementations, 90.6% four-GPU weak-scaling efficiency for a 348M-parameter workload, compact architecture edits, and positive early usability results. OLM is MIT-licensed and available through PyPI, GitHub, and its documentation site.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, and 1 table. Website: https://openlanguagemodel.github.io/openlanguagemodel/. Code: https://github.com/openlanguagemodel/openlanguagemodel
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OpenLanguageModel (OLM) 是一个开源 PyTorch 库，用于构建和预训练小语言模型，其设计强调代码可读性，使模型代码直接反映架构。OLM 将可读的模型层与分词器、数据集、优化、混合精度、回调、检查点以及多 GPU 执行等组件连接起来，支持从教学笔记本到完整预训练或研究消融实验的无缝迁移。论文通过 GPT-2 示例展示了完整流程，并报告了与参考实现的一致性和 90.6% 的四 GPU 弱扩展效率。
Motivation: 现有小语言模型预训练框架通常复杂且不透明，不利于教育和研究中的理解和修改。
Method: 提出 OLM 库，核心组件包括 Block、Residual、Repeat、Parallel 等可组合模块，配合 AutoTrainer 自动配置硬件，并内置 27 种模型预设和渐进式文档。
Result: 验证显示与独立参考实现高度一致，348M 参数模型在四 GPU 上达到 90.6% 弱扩展效率，支持紧凑架构编辑，并获得初步可用性积极反馈。
Conclusion: OLM 以 MIT 许可证开源，旨在降低小语言模型预训练门槛，促进教育和架构研究。

papers.title: Amortized Inference for Sampling Distributions Where the Bootstrap Fails
papers.abstract_en: Efron's bootstrap is the default tool for estimating the sampling distribution of a statistic, yet it is provably inconsistent for maxima of bounded-support distributions, means under infinite variance, extreme quantiles, and tail-index estimators. The classical remedies, the m-out-of-n bootstrap and subsampling, require rate corrections that depend on unknown parameters and behave erratically at realistic sample sizes. We propose an amortized alternative: a neural network is trained on simulated datasets drawn from a prior over a distribution family, using single independent draws of the root T_n - T(F) scored by the pinball loss, a proper scoring rule whose population minimizer is the posterior-predictive law of the root. At test time, a single forward pass maps one dataset of n = 200 observations to its full sampling-distribution estimate, from which confidence intervals follow directly. On four canonical bootstrap-failure problems (bounded-support maximum, alpha-stable mean, Pareto tail index, and 99% value-at-risk under tempered stable returns), the method attains nominal 95% coverage, beats every feasible classical method in Wasserstein distance to the true sampling distribution, and captures over 97% of the achievable improvement where the exact Bayes-optimal answer is computable. For the value-at-risk problem no distribution-free method can reach nominal coverage at all; the learned method attains 94.7%. A single universal network with a statistic token matches all four specialists, and on real daily market returns the unchanged model averages 0.87 coverage against 0.73 for the bootstrap, as predicted by our out-of-family analysis.
papers.comment: 6 figures, 10 tables. Code and reproducible experiments: https://github.com/akashdeepo/Bootstrap_Backprop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对bootstrap在边界支撑最大值、无限方差均值、极端分位数等场景下不一致的问题，提出一种基于神经网络的摊销推断替代方案。通过在前验分布族上模拟数据集，用pinball损失训练网络，使其输出后验预测分布。在四个经典bootstrap失败问题上，该方法达到名义95%覆盖，Wasserstein距离优于所有可行经典方法，并在VaR问题上达到94.7%覆盖。单一通用网络可匹配多个专家，并在真实市场回报上表现优于bootstrap。
Motivation: Bootstrap在若干重要场景（如最大值、无限方差均值、极端分位数、尾指数估计）中不一致，而经典补救方法（m-out-of-n bootstrap和subsampling）需要依赖未知参数的速率校正，在现实样本量下表现不稳定。
Method: 提出摊销推断方法：使用神经网络，在从分布族先验中采样的模拟数据集上训练，以单次独立抽样的根统计量T_n-T(F)的pinball损失作为评分规则，网络输出为根的后验预测分布。测试时，单次前向传播即可从n=200的观测数据得到完整抽样分布估计，进而直接导出置信区间。
Result: 在四个bootstrap失败问题（边界支撑最大值、alpha稳定均值、Pareto尾指数、99%风险价值）上，该方法达到名义95%覆盖，在所有可行经典方法中Wasserstein距离最小，并在可计算贝叶斯最优时捕获超过97%的改进。在风险价值问题上，无分布自由方法可达名义覆盖，而该方法达到94.7%。单一通用网络（使用统计token）匹配四个专家模型，在真实日市场回报上平均覆盖0.87，而bootstrap为0.73，符合跨族分析预测。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，该摊销推断方法有效解决了bootstrap在特定问题上的不一致性，且单一通用网络可匹配多个专门任务，并具有出族泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multimodal Attention-based Deep Learning for Emergency Triage with Electronic Health Records
papers.abstract_en: Accurate emergency triage decision is critical to avoid clinical deterioration, morbidity, and mortality. Machine learning-based triage system involves acquiring the main presenting complaint in text form and assessing vital signs in numerical data, enabling an automated and efficient analysis of patient information for timely and accurate prioritization of medical attention. However, modelling the intricacies of both data types requires a comprehensive understanding of the temporal structure and dependencies within the data. Thus, the aim of this study is to propose a multimodal deep learning architecture that can effectively handle both tabular and textual data. Furthermore, the proposed model exploits self-attention to to capture both local and global relationships between the features. A dataset consisting of 11,102 triage data collected from emergency department of Hospital Universiti Sains Malaysia is used for model development and validation. The proposed model demonstrated an increase of 1.95% in accuracy, 2.49% in F1-score, and 1.41% in ROC AUC compared to the baseline model. The experimental results demonstrated the potential of the proposed model in predicting triage decisions.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于多模态注意力的深度学习架构，用于处理急诊分诊中的表格数据和文本数据。模型利用自注意力捕捉局部和全局关系，在来自马来西亚理科大学医院急诊科的11,102条分诊数据上训练和验证。与基线模型相比，准确率提升1.95%，F1分数提升2.49%，ROC AUC提升1.41%。
Motivation: 急诊分诊决策至关重要，但现有方法难以同时有效处理主诉文本和生命体征数值数据，需要捕捉时序结构和依赖关系。
Method: 提出多模态深度学习架构，结合表格数据和文本数据，利用自注意力机制捕捉特征间的局部和全局关系。
Result: 在11,102条分诊数据上，模型准确率提升1.95%，F1分数提升2.49%，ROC AUC提升1.41%。
Conclusion: 实验结果表明该模型在预测分诊决策方面具有潜力。

papers.title: How Do You Choose Your AI Component? An Interview Study of Secure AI Integration in Practice
papers.abstract_en: The increasing adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) as AI components in modern software systems introduces distinct security risks to the software supply chain. While many considerations and safety mechanisms are in place for components of the traditional software supply chain, the recent rapid adoption of AI components and platforms has overlooked these hard learned lessons. Selecting and integrating AI models without clear guidance on how these choices affect system security may leave applications vulnerable to threats, such as malicious components, data leakage, and unintended behavior. The goal of this study is to understand practitioners' decision making process and security considerations in selecting and integrating AI components through an exploratory semi-structured interview study. Toward this goal, we conducted semistructured interviews with 22 software developers, architects, and AI practitioners across diverse organizations about how they integrate AI components into their software. Our analysis finds that practitioners' model selection is predominantly driven by functional criteria, including performance, accuracy, cost, and specific features, e.g., tool calling or multimodal support, while security is rarely considered as an evaluation criterion. We observe a consistent lack of security concern throughout the AI component integration process, with established software supply chain lessons overlooked or ignored. The industry is repeating the historically costly mistakes of early software dependency management, prioritizing rapid reuse and availability over security and provenance. We distill our findings into actionable recommendations for AI adopters, model providers, and researchers, advocating for a proactive, security-by-design approach that integrates security evaluation into component selection and sustains it throughout the software development lifecycle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过对22名软件开发者、架构师和AI从业者的半结构化访谈，研究他们在集成AI组件（如LLM）时的决策过程和安全考量。结果显示，模型选择主要由功能标准（性能、准确率、成本等）驱动，安全几乎不作为评估标准；行业正在重复早期软件依赖管理的错误，忽视安全与来源。论文提出将安全评估融入组件选择的全生命周期建议。
Motivation: AI组件在软件系统中的快速采用忽视了传统软件供应链的安全教训，缺乏对安全选择的指导，可能导致恶意组件、数据泄露等风险。
Method: 采用探索性半结构化访谈方法，对22名不同组织的从业者进行访谈，分析其AI组件选择与集成中的安全考量。
Result: 从业者模型选择主要基于功能标准（性能、准确率、成本、工具调用或多模态支持等），安全很少被考虑；集成过程中普遍缺乏安全意识，传统软件供应链的安全教训被忽略。
Conclusion: 建议采取安全设计方法，将安全评估纳入组件选择标准，并贯穿软件开发生命周期。

papers.title: DORS: Dynamic Attention Routing for Diffusion-based Object Removal in Dense Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Object removal aims to eliminate target objects specified by a mask while preserving visual consistency with the surrounding regions. Existing methods typically rely on contextual information from surrounding regions. However, in dense scenes where the surrounding regions contain instances visually similar to the removal target, such reliance often leads to semantic interference, resulting in incomplete removal. This problem arises from erroneous information propagation in the attention space, where masked queries tend to align with such instances due to global similarity matching in self-attention. To address this challenge, we propose a Diffusion-based Object Removal framework for dense Scenes, dubbed DORS, built upon a Dynamic Attention Routing mechanism comprising two complementary components: Instance-Filtered Attention (IFA), which suppresses misleading semantic information from similar instances through dynamically constructed mask-guided attention constraints, and Context-Guided Routing (CGR), which dynamically routes complementary scene information to maintain visual consistency. We further introduce DOR-Bench, a benchmark tailored for object removal in dense scenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DORS outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly in reducing incomplete removal and duplicate artifacts. The code will be available at https://github.com/httang1224/DORS.

papers.title: Position: Explanation Stability Is a Property of the Model Method Pair, Not the Model
papers.abstract_en: This position paper argues that claims about explanation stability are scientifically invalid without cross method validation. Just as statistical significance requires the test statistic to be specified, stability should either be evaluated across multiple attribution paradigms or explicitly scoped to the computational objective of a single method. In controlled chest X ray experiments, DenseNet201, ResNet50V2, and InceptionV3 achieved AUC values above 99%, yet their stability rankings reversed across attribution methods. LayerCAM ranked InceptionV3 as the most stable model, with an IoU of 0.777, whereas GradCAM++ favored DenseNet201 and reduced InceptionV3 stability score by 17.3%. These findings demonstrate that explanation stability is an emergent property of the model method pair rather than an intrinsic characteristic of the model alone. We therefore argue that explanation based claims should be validated across multiple attribution methods and that regulatory submissions should explicitly specify the attribution operators used to avoid creating illusory safety assurances.
papers.journal_ref: Forty-third International Conference on Machine Learning Position Paper Track, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出，解释稳定性（explanation stability）并非模型的固有属性，而是模型与归因方法（attribution method）组合的涌现性质。通过在胸部X光片实验中使用DenseNet201、ResNet50V2和InceptionV3，发现不同归因方法（如LayerCAM和GradCAM++）给出的稳定性排名完全相反，因此呼吁跨方法验证并明确说明使用的归因算子。
Motivation: 当前关于解释稳定性的声明通常仅基于一种归因方法（attribution method），缺乏跨方法验证，可能导致误导性的安全保证。
Method: 在胸部X光分类任务上，对DenseNet201、ResNet50V2和InceptionV3三种模型，分别使用LayerCAM和GradCAM++两种归因方法，计算解释之间的交并比（IoU）作为稳定性指标。
Result: LayerCAM将InceptionV3评为最稳定模型（IoU=0.777），而GradCAM++则偏好DenseNet201，并使InceptionV3的稳定性得分降低17.3%。模型在AUC上均超过99%，但稳定性排名完全取决于所选的归因方法。
Conclusion: 论文主张解释性声明应跨多个归因方法进行验证，监管提交材料必须明确指定使用的归因算子，以避免产生虚假的安全感。

papers.title: DRIFT: Difficulty-aware Rectified Flows for Through-plane MRI Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is often acquired with anisotropic resolution to reduce scan time, producing stair-step artifacts along the through-plane direction. In through-plane MRI super-resolution, an efficiency-fidelity trade-off arises: feed-forward regressors are fast but oversmooth at large slice-thicknesses, while sampling-based methods improve fidelity at high inference cost. We propose DRIFT, a two-stage thickness-conditioned rectified flow framework for through-plane MRI super-resolution with continuous input slice-thickness. Stage 1 employs an Anatomical Projection Network (APN) to map low-resolution patches to a coarse high-resolution manifold, providing a deterministic anatomical initialization that shortens the residual transport of Stage 2 and stabilizes slice-wise refinement. Stage 2 refines details via rectified flow and introduces a Physics-Aware Difficulty (PAD) metric derived from slice-thickness induced through-plane bandwidth deficit to guide an Adaptive Integration Scheduler (AIS), allocating ODE steps by thickness. A Consistent Endpoint Trajectory Alignment (CETA) loss enforces thickness-consistent reconstructions. Experiments show that DRIFT outperforms super-resolution baselines while reducing inference cost. Code, models, and interactive demos are available at https://yoonseokchoi-ai.github.io/drift-eccv2026/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DRIFT，一种基于难度感知的整流流（rectified flow）框架，用于解决MRI各向异性分辨率导致的穿层伪影问题。该方法采用两阶段策略：第一阶段通过解剖投影网络（APN）提供粗分辨率初始化，第二阶段利用整流流进行细节细化，并引入物理感知难度（PAD）指标来动态调整ODE步数。实验表明DRIFT在超分辨率性能和推理成本之间取得了更好的平衡。
Motivation: MRI通常通过各向异性采集来缩短扫描时间，但会导致穿层方向的阶梯伪影。现有方法在效率和保真度之间存在权衡：前馈回归器速度快但在大层厚情况下过度平滑，而基于采样的方法保真度高但推理成本高。
Method: 提出两阶段厚度条件化整流流框架：第一阶段使用解剖投影网络（APN）将低分辨率块映射到粗略高分辨率流形，提供确定性初始化；第二阶段通过整流流细化细节，并利用基于层厚导致的穿层带宽缺陷的物理感知难度（PAD）指标，指导自适应积分调度器（AIS）按厚度分配ODE步骤。还提出了一致性端点轨迹对齐（CETA）损失以强制厚度一致性重建。
Result: 实验表明DRIFT优于超分辨率基线方法，同时降低了推理成本。
Conclusion: DRIFT通过两阶段设计和物理感知调度，在穿层MRI超分辨率中实现了效率与保真度的更好平衡，并降低了推理成本。

papers.title: Falsification-Based Verification of LLM-Generated Optimization Models: Sound Test Batteries and Their Detection Limits
papers.abstract_en: Large language models now translate natural-language descriptions of decision problems into solver-ready optimization models, but they fail silently. A generated model often runs and still formulates the wrong problem. This paper develops a theory of falsification-based verification for this setting. Every numeric quantity in the description is a typed slot, and a candidate model is tested only through solver calls on slot-transformed instances; no reference model or label is consulted. From duality, comparative statics, and polyhedral limit arguments we derive a battery of test classes covering directions, curvature, crush probes, prohibitive limits, annihilation, and exchange. Every test is sound, so a violation certifies unfaithfulness and the false-positive rate is zero by design. We characterize what such verification can never see, give conditions under which the canonical error classes are detected with certainty, and prove that no fixed-threshold perturbation tester is simultaneously sound and nontrivial. Experiments on 326 ground-truth models from NL4OPT and four benchmark families confirm the theory. The battery attains a 0.0% false-positive rate against 54.9% for a threshold tester, detects 70.0% of certified conditional-class mutants, convicts 40.4% of the mutants invisible to execution-accuracy scoring, and reproduces the predicted detectability pattern including its zeros.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型将自然语言决策问题转化为优化模型时可能出现的隐式错误，提出了一套基于反例验证（falsification-based verification）的检验理论。作者从对偶性、比较静态和多面体极限等理论出发，推导出一系列测试类别（包括方向、曲率、压缩探测、禁止极限、湮灭和交换），每个测试都是可靠的（sound），即违规即证明模型不忠实，且假阳性率为零。实验在NL4OPT等基准上验证了该方法的有效性。
Motivation: 大语言模型生成的优化模型即使能运行，也可能公式化错误的问题，而现有验证方法缺乏理论保证，需要一种无需参考模型或标注的可靠验证方法。
Method: 基于反例验证理论，将数值量视为类型插槽，通过求解器调用变换后的实例进行测试；利用对偶性、比较静态和多面体极限等理论设计六类测试（方向、曲率、压缩探测、禁止极限、湮灭和交换），确保每类测试的可靠性。
Result: 在326个真实模型上，该方法的假阳性率为0.0%，而阈值测试器为54.9%；能检测70.0%的条件类变异体，并定罪40.4%的执行精度评分无法识别的变异体，且复现了预测的可检测性模式。
Conclusion: 该工作为LLM生成优化模型的验证提供了理论基础，并证明了不存在既可靠又非平凡的固定阈值扰动测试器。实验确认了理论预测的可检测性界限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DARA: Degradation-Aware Low-Rank Residual Adaptation with Original-to-Corrupted Distillation for Corruption-Robust Animal Re-Identification
papers.abstract_en: Animal re-identification (Re-ID) relies on fine-grained identity cues that can be disrupted by blur, noise, compression, and other visual degradations. Existing robustness strategies based on degradation-augmented training or pixel-level restoration improve robustness indirectly, but do not explicitly repair shifts in the identity retrieval space. We study corruption-robust animal Re-ID as input-conditioned feature-space repair and introduce DARA, a lightweight retrofit for compact Re-ID models. DARA freezes the fine-tuned backbone and learns routed low-rank residual experts to adapt degraded-input embeddings without corruption-type annotations. To stabilize this adaptive repair, original-to-corrupted distillation uses an original-image teacher to preserve individual embeddings and retrieval relations. Experiments on ATRW, FriesianCattle2017, MPDD, and SeaStarReID2023 show that DARA improves corrupted-query retrieval over standard and augmentation-based fine-tuning, generalizes to unseen corruptions and cross-domain evaluation, and recovers 77.0% of the corrupted-query mAP gap to full corrupted fine-tuning while adding only 0.49% parameters and 0.05% FLOPs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对动物重识别中因模糊、噪声、压缩等退化导致的关键身份线索丢失问题，提出一种轻量级退化感知低秩残差适配方法 DARA。该方法冻结微调后的主干网络，学习路由低秩残差专家以修复退化嵌入，并通过原始图像教师蒸馏稳定训练。在多个数据集上，DARA 仅增加 0.49% 参数和 0.05% 计算量，即恢复 77.0% 退化查询 mAP 与全微调之间的差距。
Motivation: 现有基于退化增强训练或像素级修复的鲁棒策略不能直接修复身份检索空间的偏移，且需要退化类型标注。
Method: 冻结微调后的主干，学习路由低秩残差专家（routed low-rank residual experts）自适应修复退化嵌入，无需退化类型；采用原始到退化蒸馏（original-to-corrupted distillation）用原始图像教师保持个体嵌入和检索关系。
Result: 在 ATRW、FriesianCattle2017、MPDD、SeaStarReID2023 上，DARA 提升退化查询检索性能，泛化到未见退化和跨域评估，恢复 77.0% 退化查询 mAP 与全微调差距，仅增加 0.49% 参数和 0.05% 计算量。
Conclusion: DARA 是一种轻量有效的退化鲁棒动物重识别方法，无需退化标注即可修复检索空间偏移。

papers.title: Diversity-Oriented Fine-Tuning for Uncertainty-Based Hallucination Detection
papers.abstract_en: Existing hallucination detection methods are typically conducted at the inference stage, without making any modifications to the model itself. In this paper, we are interested in exploring fine-tuning strategies that enhance the detectability of hallucinations in the resulting model. Focusing on semantic-entropy-based detection, we observe that many erroneous outputs remain undetected because the model produces nearly identical incorrect answers across multiple runs. To address this, we propose diversity-oriented fine-tuning to encourage more varied generations. We introduce two specific strategies: one based on Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and the other on Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). Extensive experiments are conducted to evaluate our approach and analyze the behavior of the models before and after fine-tuning. We find that after adopting our fine-tuning methods, the models become less likely to produce low semantic entropy responses for hallucinated answers, thereby improving the effectiveness of hallucination detection, eventually yielding results better than or comparable with state of the art methods. The code will be publicly released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多样性导向微调（diversity-oriented fine-tuning）来增强基于语义熵的幻觉检测。作者发现模型在多次生成中重复相同错误答案导致检测失效，因此通过SFT和DPO两种策略鼓励生成多样性，使幻觉答案的语义熵降低，提升检测效果。实验表明该方法达到或超越现有最佳方法。
Motivation: 现有幻觉检测方法多在推理阶段进行，未修改模型本身，且基于语义熵的检测常因模型对错误答案产生一致的低熵输出而漏检。
Method: 提出两种多样性导向微调策略：基于监督微调（SFT）和基于直接偏好优化（DPO），旨在鼓励模型生成更多样化的输出，降低对幻觉答案的语义熵一致性。

Conclusion: 该工作说明通过有针对性的微调可以增强模型本身的可检测性，为幻觉检测提供了模型修改的新视角。

papers.title: De-floored Principal Component Regression: When Rank Selection Alone Is Insufficient for Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Principal component regression (PCR) regularizes high-dimensional prediction by choosing a spectral cutoff, but rank selection cannot correct systematic inflation of the retained empirical eigenvalues. We study clean Gaussian random designs in which the aggregate covariance tail creates a nearly scalar sample-space floor comparable to the predictive head scale. De-floored principal component regression (dPCR) retains the cutoff and subtracts an estimated floor from the retained denominators. We prove an ordinary-PCR prediction-risk lower bound uniform over all ranks and a high-probability dPCR upper bound. When the floor is sharp and inexpensive to remove in population prediction risk, the conditional risk of dPCR is asymptotically negligible relative to that of the best ordinary PCR rank. An exact risk decomposition explains the separation: denominator inflation is governed by first spectral mass, whereas the clean prediction cost of correction is governed by squared spectral mass. A same-sample trimmed-mean floor estimate attains the oracle dPCR upper-bound rate at a prespecified rank, and the separation persists under approximate predictive alignment when the tail prediction-energy fraction vanishes. Separate pointwise fixed-aspect formulas show that the risk-optimal positive scalar correction improves rank-$1$ PCR, whereas mean-floor subtraction is generally not optimal for a broad Marchenko--Pastur bulk.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对主成分回归（PCR）中秩选择无法纠正特征值膨胀的问题，提出去地板主成分回归（dPCR），通过从保留分母中减去估计的协方差尾部地板来改进预测风险。在清洁高斯随机设计下，论文证明了普通PCR的风险下界和dPCR的上界，并给出风险分解揭示分母膨胀与校正成本的不同谱控制机制。
Motivation: 标准PCR的秩选择无法校正保留特征值的系统性膨胀，当协方差尾部产生与预测头部相当尺度的样本空间地板时，预测风险显著劣化。
Method: 提出dPCR：保留截断秩后，从保留的特征值分母中减去一个估计的地板值（通过同一样本的修剪均值估计），从而修正分母膨胀。
Result: 证明了dPCR的高概率预测风险上界，且当尾部地板尖锐时，dPCR的条件风险渐近可忽略于最优普通PCR秩；风险分解显示分母膨胀由第一谱质量控制，校正成本由平方谱质量控制。
Conclusion: dPCR能有效去除地板效应，且修正成本渐进可忽略；但均值地板减法对广义Marchenko-Pastur分布不是最优的，而最优标量校正可改进秩1 PCR。

papers.title: TopoTuner: Topological Finetuning of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Full fine-tuning remains a strong way to adapt pretrained LLMs, but it updates all weights and can be expensive. LoRA reduces the number of trainable parameters, but it does not directly answer which pretrained components should be trained and which can be frozen during adaptation. We introduce TopoTuner, a topology-guided fine-tuning framework for selective freezing of attention projection matrices. \method treats each projection matrix as a row cloud and uses Wasserstein distances between persistence diagrams to measure how its topology changes during fine-tuning. TopoTuner learns a reusable freezing profile from a source dataset and transfers it to efficiently fine-tune models on out-of-domain datasets, evaluating whether task-specific topological drift generalizes across question answering and sentiment analysis tasks. Across LLaMA-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, and Qwen3-8B-Base, TopoTuner is competitive with full fine-tuning while training only 1-2\% of the model parameters, and outperforms LoRA in 7 out of 9 model-dataset settings, which can change up to 39.57\% of the projection parameters. Along with minimized updates, TopoTuner reduces training time by 20.4\% relative to full fine-tuning and 5.5\% relative to LoRA on average. TopoTuner opens a new direction for reusable freezing profiles, where fine-tuning behavior learned on one dataset can be shared across multiple tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TopoTuner，一种基于拓扑引导的大语言模型微调框架，通过 Wasserstein 距离衡量注意力投影矩阵在微调中的拓扑变化，学习可复用的冻结策略。在 LLaMA-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B-v0.3 和 Qwen3-8B-Base 上，TopoTuner 仅训练 1-2% 参数即可与全微调竞争，并在 9 个模型-数据集设置中 7 次优于 LoRA，同时平均训练时间较全微调减少 20.4%。
Motivation: 全微调更新所有权重且昂贵，LoRA 虽减少参数量但未指导哪些组件应被训练，TopoTuner 旨在通过拓扑分析实现选择性冻结。
Method: 将每个注意力投影矩阵视为行点云，利用持久性图之间的 Wasserstein 距离度量微调中拓扑变化，从源数据集学习可复用的冻结配置并迁移至目标域。
Result: 在 LLaMA-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B-v0.3 和 Qwen3-8B-Base 上，TopoTuner 以 1-2% 可训练参数达到与全微调相当的性能，在 9 个设置中 7 次超过 LoRA，最高改变 39.57% 投影参数，平均训练时间较全微调减少 20.4%，较 LoRA 减少 5.5%。
Conclusion: TopoTuner 展示了可复用冻结配置的有效性，即一个数据集上学到的微调行为可迁移至其他任务，为高效微调提供了新方向。

papers.title: TellTale: Blending Multi-Instance LoRA Text Encoders and a Zero-Shot LLM Judge for Ambivalence/Hesitancy Recognition in Videos
papers.abstract_en: We present TellTale, a text-only approach to ambivalence/hesitancy (A/H) recognition in interview videos, evaluated on the BAH dataset as part of the 3rd A/H Video Recognition Challenge (11th ABAW Workshop, ECCV 2026). Although the dataset provides video, audio, facial crops, and transcripts, TellTale relies on the transcript alone and combines three probability streams. Two text encoders, multilingual-e5-large and mDeBERTa-v3-base, are fine-tuned with parameter-efficient LoRA adapters under a multiple-instance learning (MIL) objective, in which transcript chunks are scored individually and pooled with a smooth maximum so that only the video-level label is needed for supervision. The third stream requires no training: a quantized 14B instruction LLM is prompted, zero-shot, to rate each transcript for A/H. The three probabilities are combined by a weighted average and a single decision threshold, both selected on participant-grouped cross-validated predictions. On the organizer-scored private test set of 152 videos from unseen participants, TellTale achieves a Macro-F1 of 0.7364 and an average precision of 0.7940, compared with 0.2827 Macro-F1 for the official vision-based baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TellTale，一种仅依赖转录文本的视频犹豫/矛盾（A/H）识别方法。它结合了两个经过多实例学习（MIL）微调的LoRA文本编码器（ multilingual-e5-large 和 mDeBERTa-v3-base ）和一个零样本14B指令LLM的评分，通过加权平均和决策阈值融合三重概率流。在BAH数据集的私有测试集上，TellTale达到Macro-F1 0.7364和平均精度0.7940，远超官方视觉基线（Macro-F1 0.2827）。
Motivation: 现有基于视觉的A/H识别性能较低（官方基线Macro-F1仅0.2827），而转录文本可能包含更丰富的矛盾信号。
Method: 使用三个概率流：两个LoRA微调的文本编码器（MIL目标下训练，用平滑最大值池化转录块分数）和一个零样本14B LLM的提示评分；通过加权平均和单一阈值融合，权重和阈值在参与者分组交叉验证中选择。
Result: 在152个未见参与者视频的私有测试集上，Macro-F1为0.7364，平均精度0.7940，显著优于官方视觉基线（Macro-F1 0.2827）。
Conclusion: 文本仅方法在A/H识别上有效，但仅依赖转录，未利用视频/音频模态，可能错过多模态线索。

papers.title: CLOSER-Bench: Evaluating Budgeted Cross-Stage Design Closure for Hardware Agents
papers.abstract_en: Hardware engineering exposes coding agents to a form of long-horizon work that is difficult to capture with pass-at-k: progress is continuous, tool feedback is delayed and heterogeneous, and a backend failure may require revising RTL rather than tuning another physical-design parameter. Existing benchmarks measure RTL generation, repository repair, verification, PPA evolution, or physical implementation, but their different designs and oracles make it hard to determine where an agent succeeds or fails across abstraction boundaries. We introduce CLOSER-Bench, a controlled evaluation protocol for budgeted cross-stage design closure. For one design and one hidden objective, it pairs spec-to-RTL, RTL-to-GDS, and spec-to-GDS tasks, records every simulator, synthesis, STA, and place-and-route invocation, and measures final quality, anytime progress, tool cost, and cross-stage recovery. The benchmark is built on open-source Verilator, Yosys, OpenROAD, KLayout, Sky130, and the Harbor agent harness. A ten-task pilot spanning RTL repair, mutation-based verification, coverage, PPA optimization, design-space exploration, cross-model debugging, and security establishes the executable harness and exposes a sharp completion--closure gap: three agents solve a localized AXI repair task, while the matched verification-closure task separates a frontier agent from two otherwise successful baselines. We further validate a full RTL-to-GDS flow and construct a macro-based AXI/DMA streaming accelerator for the stage-paired evaluation. These results motivate treating hardware closure as a budgeted sequential decision problem rather than a collection of independent code generation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CLOSER-Bench，一个用于评估硬件智能体在预算约束下跨阶段设计收敛（从spec到RTL到GDS）的基准协议。该基准采用开源工具链，包含十个初始任务，揭示了完成（completion）与闭包（closure）之间的显著差距，并验证了从RTL到GDS的完整流程。结果表明硬件闭包应该被视为一个预算约束的序列决策问题，而不是独立的代码生成任务。
Motivation: 现有硬件工程基准难以捕捉跨抽象边界的智能体失败模式，因为硬件设计是长期工作，工具反馈延迟且异构，后端失败可能需要修改RTL而不是调整物理设计参数。需要一个统一的、可控的跨阶段评估协议。
Method: 构建CLOSER-Bench，对每个设计配对spec-to-RTL、RTL-to-GDS、spec-to-GDS任务，记录工具调用（模拟、综合、STA、布局布线），测量最终质量、随时进展、工具成本和跨阶段恢复。基于开源工具Verilator, Yosys, OpenROAD, KLayout, Sky130和Harbor智能体框架。包含十个初始任务：RTL修复、突变验证、覆盖率、PPA优化、设计空间探索、跨模型调试和安全。
Result: 三个智能体解决了一个局部的AXI修复任务，而匹配的验证闭包任务区分出了一个前沿智能体和两个原本成功的基线。验证了完整的RTL-to-GDS流程，并构建了一个基于宏的AXI/DMA流加速器用于阶段配对评估。
Conclusion: 这些结果激励将硬件闭包视为一个预算约束的序列决策问题，而不是独立的代码生成任务。

papers.title: A Research Prototype for Closed-Loop Generative Design of Customized Foot Orthoses via Semantic-Physics Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Translating unstructured clinical prescriptions into patient-specific foot orthoses (FOs) is hindered by a semantic-physical misalignment: high-level clinical intent is not mapped deterministically onto the 3D geometric parameters of the orthosis, and existing design workflows remain dependent on manual expertise with no instantaneous biomechanical validation. We present TANS-FO, a research prototype-a modular pipeline with closed-loop feedback for computational design automation of customized FOs, not a clinically validated therapeutic device. A Text-Aligned Neural Surrogate (TANS) uses cross-attention to project clinical-text embeddings onto a continuous lattice-density field, while a Graph Neural Network (GNN) surrogate predicts plantar stress in real time as a substitute for Finite Element Analysis (FEA). The framework is anchored on the open-access PicoFoot-5K anthropometric database (5,230 subjects; 30+ anatomical parameters). Under standardized quasi-static loading, the GNN surrogate agrees with an Abaqus reference solver (R^2 = 0.94), and the full pipeline synthesizes manufacturing-ready lattice insoles within minutes. On the Male 18-40 cohort, the proposed system attains a surrogate-predicted peak-pressure reduction of 34.7% over parametric CAD, with a fit error of 0.42 mm. Separately, an exploratory feasibility observation (n = 12; 2-week follow-up; no control group) using VAS pain reporting indicates short-term comfort improvement (VAS 6.4 -> 2.1), but this data is explicitly classified as preliminary observational evidence only-not evidence of clinical efficacy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TANS-FO研究原型，一个用于定制足部矫形器（FO）的闭环生成设计管道。通过文本对齐神经代理（TANS）将临床文本嵌入映射到连续晶格密度场，并利用图神经网络（GNN）代理实时预测足底应力以替代有限元分析。在PicoFoot-5K数据库（5230名受试者）上，GNN代理与Abaqus参考求解器达到R²=0.94，全管道可在数分钟内生成制造就绪的晶格鞋垫。在男性18-40岁队列中，代理预测的峰值压力比参数化CAD降低34.7%，拟合误差0.42mm。一项小规模探索性观察（n=12，无对照组）显示VAS疼痛评分从6.4降至2.1，但被明确归类为初步观察证据，而非临床有效性证据。
Motivation: 从非结构化临床处方到患者特定足部矫形器的转化受限于语义-物理错位：高层临床意图无法确定性地映射到3D几何参数，现有设计工作流依赖人工经验且缺乏即时生物力学验证。
Method: 提出TANS-FO模块化管道，包含两个核心组件：Text-Aligned Neural Surrogate (TANS) 利用交叉注意力将临床文本嵌入投影到连续晶格密度场；图神经网络 (GNN) 代理在准静态加载下实时预测足底应力，替代计算昂贵的有限元分析。
Result: GNN代理与Abaqus参考求解器高度一致（R²=0.94）；全管道在数分钟内合成制造就绪的晶格鞋垫。在男性18-40岁队列中，代理预测的峰值压力比参数化CAD降低34.7%，拟合误差0.42mm。独立的探索性观察（n=12，2周随访）显示VAS疼痛评分从6.4降至2.1，但明确声明为初步观察证据，非临床有效性证据。
Conclusion: 摘要强调TANS-FO是一个研究原型，尚未经过临床验证，但展示了通过语义-物理对齐实现定制足部矫形器计算设计自动化的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SPARE-GS: Structural Parsimony and Resource Efficiency for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) achieves high-fidelity novel view synthesis in real-time; however its training efficiency and representation compactness are hindered by excessive primitive proliferation. To address this challenge, we formulate the structural evolution of 3DGS as a global budget-constrained optimization problem and derive an optimality condition, which requires the marginal utility of structural resources to be balanced across spatial regions under a finite primitive budget. Based on this formulation, we propose SPARE-GS, a general plug-and-play framework that dynamically aligns the distribution of 3D Gaussian primitives with regional representational demand. SPARE-GS estimates capacity-normalized regional demand, assigns adaptive target quotas, and uses regional budget deviations to coordinate densification, pruning and adaptive termination toward a more balanced structural allocation. Extensive experiments across standard, accelerated, and structure-enhanced 3DGS pipelines demonstrate that SPARE-GS reduces the Gaussian count and training time by an average of 30.38% and 23.81%, respectively, while improving the average PSNR. Moreover, the resulting compact representations reduce downstream processing time and improve the rate-distortion performance of diverse compression and pruning methods, demonstrating the broad applicability of global structural budget regulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）中基元过度增殖导致训练效率低和表示不紧凑的问题，提出SPARE-GS框架。该框架将结构演化建模为全局预算约束优化，通过估计容量归一化的区域需求、分配自适应目标配额并协调致密化、剪枝和自适应终止，实现基元分布的动态平衡。实验表明，SPARE-GS在标准、加速和结构增强等多种3DGS流水线上平均减少高斯数量30.38%和训练时间23.81%，同时提升平均PSNR，并改善下游压缩和剪枝方法的率失真性能。
Motivation: 现有3DGS方法因原始基元过多导致训练效率低下和表示冗余，缺乏对基元分布的结构化约束。
Method: 提出全局预算约束优化问题，推导最优性条件；基于此设计SPARE-GS框架，动态估计区域需求、分配目标配额，并通过预算偏差协调致密化、剪枝和自适应终止。
Result: 在多种3DGS流水线上，高斯数量减少30.38%，训练时间减少23.81%，平均PSNR提升，下游压缩和剪枝的率失真性能改善。
Conclusion: 全局结构预算调控能有效提升3DGS的紧凑性和效率，且具有通用性，可集成到不同流水线。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Privacy Cost as Equity Input: A Group Fairness Criterion for Differentially Private Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Differential privacy (DP) is increasingly deployed to limit membership inference risk in machine-learning systems. Prior work has shown that DP-SGD can widen accuracy disparities across demographic groups, but this framing treats fairness as a purely outcome-side concern. We argue that privacy cost, the information leakage borne by each group, is itself a form of harm, and adopt a compensatory-fairness framework in which a group that involuntarily bears greater privacy exposure is owed proportionally greater benefit from the system. From this principle we derive the \emph{Privacy-Cost Equity Ratio} (PCER), a group fairness metric defined as a group's positive prediction rate normalized by its per-group overfitting gap. By a standard membership inference bound, this overfitting gap upper-bounds each group's vulnerability to inference attacks, making PCER a conservative measure of benefit relative to exposure. PCER needs only per-group train and test accuracy (no shadow models), making it a practical post-hoc audit tool. We evaluate PCER alongside standard fairness metrics across six benchmark--attribute combinations spanning tabular and NLP domains, under DP-SGD at a range of privacy budgets, and validate the overfitting-gap proxy against a direct threshold membership-inference attack. The results reveal patterns that outcome-based metrics miss. On COMPAS, PCER uncovers a persistent double disadvantage: the protected group bears both greater privacy exposure and worse predictive outcomes, something demographic parity gap masks entirely. Sensitivity analysis shows very strong privacy guarantees collapse both groups' overfitting to a numerical floor, rendering exposure-based audits uninformative in that regime. Together, these findings show that fairness audits of privacy-preserving systems must account for who bears the cost of protection, not only who benefits from its outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的群体公平性指标——隐私成本权益比 (PCER)，用于评估差分隐私机器学习中不同群体承受的隐私泄露与其获得收益的匹配程度。PCER 通过每组过拟合间隙归一化的正预测率来衡量公平性，只需每组训练和测试准确率即可计算。在多个基准上的实验表明，PCER 能揭示传统基于结果的公平性指标忽略的持续性双重劣势模式。
Motivation: 现有工作将差分隐私中的公平性视为结果端问题，忽略了隐私成本本身对不同群体的不平等负担。需要一种能反映群体间隐私暴露与收益之间补偿性公平的指标。
Method: 基于补偿性公平框架，定义 PCER 为群体的正预测率除以其过拟合间隙（通过成员推理攻击上界近似）。该指标不需要影子模型，仅需各组训练和测试准确率，适用于事后审计。
Result: 在 COMPAS 数据集上，PCER 揭示了受保护群体同时承受更高隐私暴露和更差预测结果的双重劣势，而传统人口统计均等性指标无法发现。高隐私预算下过拟合间隙趋近数值下限，使得基于暴露的审计失效。
Conclusion: 隐私保护系统的公平性审计必须同时考虑谁承担保护成本，而不仅仅是谁受益于结果。PCER 提供了一种实用的工具来揭示这种不对称性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DataFlow-Harness: A Grounded Code-Agent Platform for Constructing Editable LLM Data Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to automate data-processing workflows, yet coding agents typically produce scripts that are not automatically materialized as persistent, editable platform artifacts. We call this disconnect the \textit{NL2Pipeline gap}. To bridge it, we introduce \textsc{DataFlow-Harness}, a platform that guides an LLM agent to construct platform-native directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) through typed, incremental mutations rather than free-form scripts. The platform combines \textsc{DataFlow-Skills} for procedural guidance, a Model Context Protocol (MCP) layer that exposes the live operator registry and current pipeline state, and \textsc{DataFlow-WebUI}, which synchronizes conversational authoring with a visual DAG editor. On a 12-task data-engineering benchmark, \textsc{DataFlow-Harness} achieves a 93.3\% observed end-to-end pass rate. Relative to Vanilla Claude Code, it reduces measured monetary cost by 72.5\% and generation latency by 49.9\%; its observed pass rate is within 0.9 percentage points of the Context-Aware Claude Code baseline while its cost is 42.8\% lower. Per-task analysis indicates that Skills are most useful when construction depends on implicit procedural knowledge. These results show that live platform grounding can produce persistent, editable workflow artifacts with an observed reliability close to script-generation baselines and with lower measured construction cost and latency.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, and 5 tables. Technical report
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DataFlow-Harness平台，通过LLM代理以类型化增量突变方式构建平台原生有向无环图（DAG），而非自由形式脚本，从而弥合自然语言到管道（NL2Pipeline）的鸿沟。平台结合DataFlow-Skills过程指导、模型上下文协议（MCP）层和可视化DAG编辑器的WebUI。在12个数据工程任务基准上，端到端通过率达93.3%，相比Vanilla Claude Code成本降低72.5%，延迟降低49.9%，且通过率仅比上下文感知的Claude Code基线低0.9个百分点，但成本低42.8%。
Motivation: 现有编码代理生成的脚本无法自动持久化为可编辑的平台工件，导致NL2Pipeline差距，阻碍工作流的可复现和可编辑性。
Method: 提出DataFlow-Harness平台，包含：1) DataFlow-Skills提供过程指导；2) MCP层暴露实时运算符注册表和当前管道状态；3) DataFlow-WebUI同步对话式创作与可视化DAG编辑器。代理通过类型化增量突变构建DAG。
Result: 在12任务基准上端到端通过率93.3%；相比Vanilla Claude Code成本降低72.5%，延迟降低49.9%；与上下文感知的Claude Code基线相比通过率仅低0.9个百分点，成本低42.8%。任务分析表明Skills在依赖隐式过程知识时最有用。
Conclusion: 实时平台接地（live platform grounding）可以产生持久、可编辑的工作流工件，其可靠性接近脚本生成基线，且构建成本和延迟更低。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Backpropagation-Free Trunk Training via the Split Forward Gradients
papers.abstract_en: Backpropagation makes training deep networks memory intensive because it must store intermediate activations. Forward-mode methods avoid this cost, but their gradient estimates become increasingly noisy as the number of trained parameters grows. We introduce Split Forward Gradient (Split-FG), which splits a network at an intermediate representation: it computes the output head gradient exactly and estimates only the trunk gradient with a Jacobian--vector product. This reduces estimator variance and requires no backward pass through the trunk, while retaining an Adam-style convergence guarantee. Our experiments reveal an important practical failure mode. On WikiText-103, naive forward-gradient training of the trunk performs worse than leaving a randomly initialized trunk frozen, likely because Adam updates every noisy, under-determined trunk coordinate too aggressively. Simply using a much smaller learning rate for the trunk reverses this result: a $16$M-parameter GPT-2-style model reaches validation perplexity $387$, compared with $668$ for the frozen-trunk control and $2{,}885$ for a matched pure forward-gradient baseline (backpropagation reaches $150$). Split-FG also produces the strongest backprop-free results on our tabular benchmarks and reaches $60.5\%$ on CIFAR-10 and $35.2\%$ on CIFAR-100 with a heavy-head design. It reduces peak memory by up to $35\%$ relative to matched backpropagation, although the performance gap widens as the forward-mode trunk grows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出分裂前向梯度 (Split-FG)，通过将网络在中间表示处分裂，精确计算输出头梯度，仅用雅可比-向量积估计主干梯度，从而降低前向模式梯度估计的方差，避免反向传播的内存开销。实验发现，朴素的前向梯度训练主干效果不如冻结随机主干，但调整学习率后，16M参数的GPT-2模型在WikiText-103上达到困惑度387，优于冻结主干（668）和纯前向梯度基线（2885），同时峰值内存较反向传播降低35%。在CIFAR-10/100上分别达到60.5%和35.2%的准确率。
Motivation: 反向传播因需存储中间激活而内存密集，前向模式方法虽避免此成本，但梯度估计随参数增多而噪声增大。现有方法在深度网络无反向传播训练中表现受限。
Method: Split-FG将网络在中间表示处分裂，对输出头使用精确梯度，对主干使用雅可比-向量积估计梯度，无需反向传播通过主干，并利用Adam风格优化器保证收敛。
Result: 在WikiText-103上，16M参数GPT-2模型验证困惑度387，优于冻结主干（668）和纯前向梯度基线（2885），但劣于反向传播（150）。CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100准确率分别为60.5%和35.2%，峰值内存较反向传播降低35%。
Conclusion: Split-FG实现了最强的无反向传播结果，但性能差距随主干增大而扩大，表明前向模式梯度在大型主干上仍有局限。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: Split-FG将网络在中间表示处分裂，对输出头使用精确梯度，对主干使用雅可比-向量积估计梯度，无需反向传播通过主干，并利用Adam风格优化器保证收敛。
summary_sections.result: 在WikiText-103上，16M参数GPT-2模型验证困惑度387，优于冻结主干（668）和纯前向梯度基线（2885），但劣于反向传播（150）。CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100准确率分别为60.5%和35.2%，峰值内存较反向传播降低35%。
summary_sections.conclusion: Split-FG实现了最强的无反向传播结果，但性能差距随主干增大而扩大，表明前向模式梯度在大型主干上仍有局限。

papers.title: Just A Rather Very Intelligent Spoken Agent
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon AI agents are becoming increasingly capable, yet their interaction with users remains surprisingly thin. In most workflows, users give an initial instruction, receive only selective textual updates, and lose a clear sense of what the agent is doing or when to step in. This leaves a missing part in the current agent ecosystem: an always-on Jarvis-style mediator that keeps the agent continuously reachable to the user. Such a mediator should support real-time spoken interaction with the user, answer questions without interrupting the worker, proactively report progress or confusion, and inject user guidance back into the agent's execution when useful. In this work, we introduce JarvisBench, a benchmark for measuring the dual value of mediation in long-horizon agent workflows. JarvisBench contains two complementary tracks: an agent-collaboration track that measures whether mediation improves downstream task completion, and a user-interaction track that measures whether mediation makes ongoing execution more understandable, responsive, and accessible to users. We instantiate the benchmark with a modular reference Jarvis prototype and evaluate it on 34 text-only WildClaw tasks executed in OpenClaw. Preliminary results with GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.7, Gemini-based, and GPT-based worker agents suggest that Jarvis-style mediation can provide trace-grounded responses to user questions and improve task performance when sparse user guidance is injected at appropriate moments. The results also show that effectiveness depends strongly on the mediator's LLM brain, highlighting both the promise of this missing middle layer and the need for broader community effort. Demo page https://cchen1436.github.io/jarvis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出JarvisBench基准，用于评估长时域AI代理工作流中的语音中介的二元价值，包括代理协作和用户交互两个维度。初步实验表明，Jarvis式中介能提供可追溯的回应并在适当时刻注入用户指导以提升任务性能，但效果高度依赖于中介的LLM大脑。
Motivation: 当前长时域AI代理与用户交互薄弱，缺乏始终在线、支持实时语音交互的中介层，导致用户难以理解代理行为或适时干预。
Method: 构建JarvisBench基准，包含代理协作和用户交互两个轨道；设计模块化参考原型Jarvis，在34个文本任务上评估GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.7、Gemini和GPT等代理。
Result: Jarvis式中介能提供基于跟踪的回应，并在适当时刻注入稀疏用户指导时改善任务性能；有效性强烈依赖于中介的LLM能力。
Conclusion: 中介层在长时域代理工作流中有潜力，但需要社区进一步研究来提升其鲁棒性和泛化性。

papers.title: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Understand OCT?
papers.abstract_en: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) imaging is essential for the diagnosis and treatment of retinal diseases. Although multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated considerable potential in medical image analysis, existing benchmarks largely reduce OCT understanding to coarse-grained disease classification or isolated visual question answering, leaving the complete cognitive process from visual perception to clinical reasoning insufficiently evaluated. To address this limitation, we introduce OCT-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark dedicated to OCT image understanding. OCT-Bench comprises 10,076 high-quality multiple-choice questions constructed from 4,137 OCT images across seven public datasets. Following the real-world clinical interpretation workflow, we establish a hierarchical capability taxonomy consisting of 20 fine-grained tasks across three dimensions: Perception, Cognition, and Reasoning. These tasks cover a broad range of capabilities, including imaging attributes, retinal anatomy, lesion characteristics, spatial relationships, disease assessment, therapeutic decision-making, and prognostic management. We systematically evaluate 20 representative MLLMs, including proprietary models, open-source general-purpose models, and medical-domain models. Experimental results demonstrate that current models remain substantially short of reliable OCT understanding. Moreover, neither medical-domain adaptation nor increased model scale consistently improves performance across capability levels. OCT-Bench enables comprehensive and fine-grained evaluation of MLLMs, providing a foundation for identifying capability bottlenecks and advancing clinically grounded OCT understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OCT-Bench，一个用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在OCT图像理解能力的基准，包含10076道多选题，涵盖感知、认知、推理三个维度的20个细粒度任务。对20个代表性MLLM的评估显示，当前模型在OCT理解上远未达到可靠水平，且医学领域适应或增大模型规模并不总能提升各能力层面的性能。
Motivation: 现有基准主要将OCT理解简化为粗粒度疾病分类或孤立的视觉问答，未能充分评估从视觉感知到临床推理的完整认知过程。
Method: 构建OCT-Bench基准，包含从7个公共数据集4137张OCT图像生成的10076道高质量多选题，设计了20个细粒度任务，分为感知、认知、推理三个层次。
Result: 对20个MLLM的系统评估表明，当前模型在OCT理解上远未达到可靠水平，且医学领域适应或增大模型规模并不总能提升各能力层面的性能。
Conclusion: OCT-Bench能够全面细粒度评估MLLMs，为识别能力瓶颈和推进临床实用的OCT理解提供基础。
