papers.title: PAVXploreRL: Physical-Action-Visual World Model Reinforcement Learning with Action Exploration
papers.abstract_en: Action-conditioned world models are a key component of embodied AI, serving as scalable policy evaluators that reduce reliance on expensive real-world rollouts. To accurately capture diverse action-induced dynamics, such models should satisfy three key objectives-Physical Plausibility (P), Action Adherence (A), and Visual Fidelity (V), collectively referred to as PAV-while remaining robust to both in-distribution (ID) expert demonstrations and out-of-distribution (OOD) actions. However, existing methods primarily rely on ID action-video pairs and pixel-level reconstruction losses, which do not explicitly optimize PAV objectives and generalize poorly beyond expert data. To address this, we propose PAVXploreRL, a reinforcement learning framework built on a pretrained latent world model that explicitly optimizes PAV objectives through reward-driven training. To improve action generalization, our method jointly leverages ID trajectories and noise-driven OOD action exploration, without paired video supervision. Experiments show that PAVXploreRL consistently outperforms pretrained baselines, achieving a 5.6% average gain across benchmarks and producing higher-quality PAV properties. As a policy evaluator, it also yields more reliable performance estimates and reduces the overestimation bias of prior expert-only world models such as Ctrl-World. Code: https://github.com/Social-AI-Studio/PAVXploreRL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PAVXploreRL，一个基于强化学习的框架，用于优化动作条件世界模型的物理合理性、动作遵循性和视觉保真度（PAV目标）。该方法在预训练潜在世界模型上，通过奖励驱动训练，并结合分布内轨迹和噪声驱动的分布外动作探索，无需配对视频监督。实验表明，PAVXploreRL在多个基准上平均提升5.6%，并减少过估计偏差。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖分布内动作-视频对和像素级重建损失，未能显式优化PAV目标，且对专家数据之外的分布外动作泛化能力差。
Method: 基于预训练潜在世界模型，采用强化学习框架，通过奖励驱动训练显式优化PAV目标；联合利用分布内轨迹和噪声驱动的分布外动作探索，无需配对视频监督。
Result: PAVXploreRL在多个基准上平均提升5.6%，生成更高质量的PAV属性，并作为策略评估器减少过估计偏差。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能有效提升世界模型对动作泛化的鲁棒性和PAV属性的质量，减少对专家数据的依赖。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FST.ai 2.5: Explainable and Uncertainty-Aware AI for Olympic and Para-Taekwondo Decision Support, Athlete Digital Twins, and Federation-Scale Analytics
papers.abstract_en: The rapid digitalisation of elite sport has created new opportunities for integrating artificial intelligence (AI), performance analytics, and decision-support systems into athlete development and competition management. However, existing solutions remain fragmented, typically addressing isolated tasks such as performance analysis, athlete monitoring, or referee support. This paper presents \textbf{FST$\cdot$ai~2.5}, an explainable, uncertainty-aware, and secure AI framework for Olympic and Para-Taekwondo. \textbf{FST$\cdot$ai~2.5} introduces a unified digital ecosystem integrating athlete intelligence, competition analytics, federation-scale data management, AI-assisted decision support, athlete and event digital twins, explainable performance indicators, and adaptive training recommendations. The framework supports World Taekwondo (WT), Member National Associations (MNAs), coaches, referees, analysts, and athletes through transparent, secure, and federation-aware governance. By combining multi-source competition data, athlete-performance information, and contextual evidence, \textbf{FST$\cdot$ai~2.5} provides tactical diagnostics, longitudinal athlete monitoring, performance forecasting, personalised development planning, and federation-wide benchmarking using explainable and uncertainty-aware AI. Prototype deployments demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed framework. Although developed for Olympic and Para-Taekwondo, the methodology is broadly applicable to explainable AI, digital twins, and trustworthy decision support in combat sports and other high-performance sporting environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FST·ai 2.5，一个面向奥运会和残奥会跆拳道的可解释、不确定性感知且安全的 AI 框架。该框架整合了运动员智能、比赛分析、联合会级数据管理、AI 辅助决策支持、运动员及赛事数字孪生、可解释性能指标和自适应训练建议。原型部署证明了框架的可行性。
Motivation: 现有精英体育的数字解决方案通常碎片化，仅针对性能分析、运动员监测或裁判支持等孤立任务，缺乏统一集成的生态系统。
Method: FST·ai 2.5 引入了一个统一的数字生态系统，结合多源比赛数据、运动员表现信息和情境证据，提供战术诊断、纵向监控、性能预测、个性化发展规划和联合会级基准测试。框架强调透明、安全且符合联合会治理的 AI。
Result: 原型部署验证了所提框架的可行性。
Conclusion: 虽然专为跆拳道开发，但该方法论可推广到击类运动及其他高绩效运动环境中的可解释 AI、数字孪生和可信决策支持。

papers.title: Learning from World Feedback: Why Model Uncertainty Fails as a Risk Signal in Model-Based RL
papers.abstract_en: The RLxF programme argues that learning signals should come from world feedback rather than from internal model proxies. We instantiate this position in safe model-based control and distil it into three concrete design principles. Empirically, across four world-model architectures spanning a 2x MSE range, MPC planning is statistically equivalent (TOST, n=200), and dynamics-based uncertainty penalties increase collision rates from 26% to 34%: the standard MBRL safety proxy is anti-correlated with safety in this regime. Replacing the model-internal proxy with three world-feedback signals (a sensor-derived margin via minimum lidar, a temporal signal via time-to-collision, and an outcome-supervised feedback model g_psi trained on prior collision labels, structurally analogous to outcome-trained reward models in RLHF) reduces collisions to 1-14% without retraining the world model or the planner. The mechanism is structural: model uncertainty has support over state-prediction space, whereas task risk has support over constraint boundaries, with empirical correlation r < 0.15. From this we extract three RLxF principles (ground risk in world outcomes, validate proxies before deployment, and substitute outcome-trained feedback models when direct world signals are unavailable) and argue they apply equally to model-based control and to verifier-based or RLHF approaches in LLM alignment.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Reinforcement Learning from X Feedback (RLxF). 14 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文批判性地分析了基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）中广泛使用的模型不确定性作为安全风险信号的做法，发现其与实际安全存在反相关（碰撞率从26%上升至34%）。作者提出“RLxF”原则，主张从世界反馈（而非内部模型代理）中学习信号，并设计了三种世界反馈信号（激光雷达最小距离、碰撞时间、基于结果训练的反馈模型），在不重训练世界模型或规划器的情况下将碰撞率降至1-14%。机制分析表明模型不确定性的支持域在状态预测空间，而任务风险的支持域在约束边界，两者相关系数r<0.15。
Motivation: 现有MBRL方法通常利用模型不确定性（如动力学模型方差）作为安全风险代理，但作者怀疑这种内部模型代理可能并非安全信号的有效替代，甚至可能误导决策。
Method: 提出三个RLxF设计原则：（1）将风险植根于世界结果；（2）部署前验证代理；（3）当直接世界信号不可用时，使用结果训练的反馈模型。在MPC规划中，用三种世界反馈信号（激光雷达最小距离、碰撞时间、基于先前碰撞标签训练的监督反馈模型g_psi）替代模型不确定性惩罚。
Result: 在四种世界模型架构（MSE范围2倍）上，MPC规划表现统计等价（TOST, n=200），但模型不确定性惩罚使碰撞率从26%恶化至34%；而世界反馈信号将碰撞率降低至1-14%。模型不确定性与任务风险的相关性r<0.15。
Conclusion: 作者认为RLxF原则不仅适用于基于模型的控制，也适用于LLM对齐中的验证器或RLHF方法，强调应避免依赖内部模型代理作为风险信号。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Digital measurement of droplet flame diameter in microgravity combustion images using Segment Anything Model 2 with automatic prompt selection
papers.abstract_en: Flame diameter is a key measurable parameter in microgravity droplet combustion, but its extraction from self-illuminated frames remains difficult because soot tails, blurred luminous boundaries, chamber reflections, and droplet drift introduce substantial measurement bias and operator dependence. This work presents an AI-enabled digital measurement workflow for automated flame diameter from combustion images. The workflow integrates automatic prompt-point generation into Segment Anything Model 2, employing Random Sample Consensus (RANSAC)-based circle fitting. The automatic prompt strategy removes subjective manual point selection, while the video memory mechanism maintains temporal consistency for drifting droplets, and the RANSAC fitting rejects soot-tail pixels as geometric outliers. The method is validated by 19,537 flame images of n-heptane, n-decane, and n-octane droplets with varying initial diameters. Compared with manual-reference measurements, the proposed workflow achieves a mean relative agreement of 96.9%, a mean absolute percentage error of 3.1%, and substantially outperforms conventional Hough circle detection, which performed worse under the same evaluation conditions. The results also show that the measurement accuracy improves with increasing droplet size. The proposed workflow has a combined standard uncertainty of 8.54% and achieves approximately a 229-fold improvement in efficiency over manual measurement. These results demonstrate that the proposed SAM2-based workflow provides a reproducible, fully automated, and metrologically characterized digital measurement system for extracting flame diameter from challenging combustion images. The approach supports high-throughput combustion diagnostics and illustrates that AI-based segmentation can be integrated into quantitative measurement workflows for digitalized image-based metrology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) 与自动提示点生成的数字化工作流，用于微重力燃烧图像中液滴火焰直径的自动测量。该方法利用随机采样一致性 (RANSAC) 圆拟合剔除烟尾像素，并通过视频记忆机制维持时间一致性。在19,537张正庚烷、正癸烷和正辛烷液滴火焰图像上验证，平均相对一致率达96.9%，平均绝对百分比误差3.1%，效率较人工测量提升约229倍。
Motivation: 传统方法从自发光燃烧图像中提取火焰直径时，因烟尾、模糊边界、反射和液滴漂移导致测量偏差和操作者依赖性，缺乏自动化且可重复的计量学表征方法。
Method: 将自动提示点生成集成到SAM2中，结合RANSAC圆拟合和视频记忆机制，形成全自动数字测量流程。
Result: 在三个燃料（正庚烷、正癸烷、正辛烷）的19,537张图像上，平均相对一致率96.9%，平均绝对百分比误差3.1%，显著优于霍夫圆检测；测量精度随液滴尺寸增大而提高；组合标准不确定度8.54%，效率提升约229倍。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个可重复、全自动、经计量学表征的火焰直径数字测量系统，支持高通量燃烧诊断，展示了AI分割可集成到定量测量工作流中。

papers.title: Harnessing disorder to decouple extension and shear in kirigami metamaterials
papers.abstract_en: Kirigami turns stiff sheets into compliant, shape-morphing structures, but its reliance on periodic cut patterns comes at a cost: correlated panel rotations couple extension to shear, so stretching one axis drives a parasitic shear that cannot be suppressed, and also confine anisotropic stiffness to a narrow, discrete set of responses that cannot be tuned independently. Biological tissues overcome an analogous constraint through controlled disorder, such as graded fiber orientations in skin and hierarchical anisotropy in myocardium, achieving direction-dependent mechanics unavailable to regular architectures. Here, we show that engineered disorder is a design degree of freedom for kirigami, with stochastic kirigami accessing a continuous and far broader region of mechanical response than periodic patterns. This includes programmable anisotropy with near-complete elimination of extension-shear coupling. Because disordered patterns lack a simple parameterization, we navigate this design space with a geometry-aware graph neural network (GNN) that maps cut topology to the full nonlinear, bidirectional stress-strain response, coupled to a genetic algorithm that inverse-designs patterns reproducing target responses along two perpendicular axes. The GNN trains an order of magnitude faster and more accurately than image-based models. Fabricated elastomer samples reproduce the predicted nonlinear, anisotropic responses, closing the loop from design to physical component. By turning disorder into a variable to control directional stiffness, this work develops architected materials that stretch without parasitic shear, from soft actuators to tissue-interfacing devices matched to the anisotropy of living tissue.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明工程无序（engineered disorder）是剪纸超材料（kirigami metamaterials）的一个设计自由度，通过随机剪纸图案实现比周期性图案更连续、更广泛的力学响应区域，包括几乎完全消除拉伸-剪切耦合的可编程各向异性。结合几何感知图神经网络（GNN）和遗传算法，实现了从切割拓扑到非线性应力-应变响应的逆向设计，并在弹性体样品中验证了预测的非线性各向异性响应。
Motivation: 周期性剪纸图案导致拉伸与剪切耦合，且各向异性刚度局限于狭窄离散响应，无法独立调谐。生物学组织通过受控无序克服类似约束，启发作者将无序作为设计自由度来拓展剪纸材料的力学响应空间。
Method: 提出一种几何感知图神经网络（GNN），将切割拓扑映射到完整的非线性双向应力-应变响应，比图像模型训练快一个数量级且更准确；耦合遗传算法逆向设计图案，实现沿两个垂直轴的目标响应。
Result: 随机剪纸图案实现了可编程各向异性并几乎完全消除拉伸-剪切耦合；GNN训练速度比图像模型快一个数量级且更准确；制造的弹性体样品重现了预测的非线性各向异性响应。
Conclusion: 通过将无序转化为可控的设计变量，实现了无寄生剪切的拉伸响应，为软体致动器、组织接口设备等需要与生物组织各向异性匹配的应用提供了途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Autonomous VR-Based Risk Detection for Situational Awareness in Dangerous Settings
papers.abstract_en: In high-risk environments such as disaster response, situational awareness depends not only on detecting hazards but also on communicating them clearly to human operators. Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong potential for scene understanding in safety-critical settings, yet their value as part of human-facing robotic systems remains underexplored. We present a VR-based Human Robot Interaction framework for studying how VLM-assisted robots can support situational awareness in simulated hazardous environments. In our system, a robot explores a virtual scene and queries a VLM to identify potential hazards and annotate user-facing points of interest. These annotations are presented to a human operator through an immersive VR interface. This framework enables controlled evaluation of both robotic hazard identification and the communication of safety-critical information to users. Results from our study indicate that the annotated VR interface was preferred over the unannotated baseline and that participants reported high clarity, usefulness, and comfort when interacting with the system. These findings suggest that combining VLM-based robotic perception with immersive visualization is a promising approach for supporting situational awareness in hazardous settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于VR的人机交互框架，利用视觉语言模型(VLM)辅助机器人在模拟危险环境中识别并标注危险源，并通过沉浸式VR界面呈现给人类操作员。实验表明，标注的VR界面比无标注基线更受用户青睐，用户报告了较高的清晰度、有用性和舒适度。该工作探索了VLM与VR结合在灾难响应等高风险场景中支持情境感知的潜力。
Motivation: 在高风险环境中，情境感知不仅依赖于危险检测，还需要向人类操作员清晰传达危险信息。现有研究较少探索VLM作为人类面对机器人系统的一部分在安全关键场景中的应用。
Method: 构建了一个包含机器人探索虚拟场景、调用VLM识别潜在危险并标注感兴趣点的系统，这些标注通过沉浸式VR界面呈现给操作员，从而实现对机器人危险识别和安全信息传达的受控评估。
Result: 用户研究显示，标注的VR界面比无标注基线更受偏好，参与者报告了高清晰度、有用性和舒适度。
Conclusion: 结合VLM的机器人感知与沉浸式可视化是支持危险环境中情境感知的有前景的方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CNS-Edit++: Category-Agnostic 3D Editing with Coupled Neural Shape Representation
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a latent-space 3D shape editing framework built upon a coupled neural shape (CNS) representation and a neural feature volume optimization. This work extends CNS-Edit, built on Coupled Neural Shape optimization, to CNS-Edit++, by generalizing the category-specific coupled representation to category-agnostic 3D shape editing with foundation models. The Coupled Neural Shape (CNS) representation couples a global latent code that captures high-level shape semantics with a 3D neural feature volume that provides spatial context for local shape manipulation. Then we formulate a coupled neural shape optimization procedure that co-optimizes these two components subject to a given editing operation. Our framework can be instantiated on both the category-specific 3D inversion model and category-agnostic 3D foundation models. We provide various shape editing operators, including copy, resize, delete, mix, point-wise drag, and region-wise drag, each of which is formulated as an objective to guide the CNS optimization. To preserve regions outside the editing area, we further introduce two complementary region-wise control mechanisms, i.e., KV-cache replacement and latent feature regularization. Extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations across different 3D generative models demonstrate the strong capabilities of our approach over state-of-the-art solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CNS-Edit++，一种基于耦合神经形状（CNS）表示的类别无关3D形状编辑框架。该方法将全局潜在编码与3D神经特征体积耦合，通过优化流程实现多种编辑操作（复制、缩放、删除、混合、点拖动、区域拖动），并引入KV-cache替换和潜在特征正则化以保护编辑区域外的部分。在多种3D生成模型上的评估表明，该方法优于现有最优技术。
Motivation: 现有3D形状编辑方法大多局限于特定类别，缺乏类别无关的通用编辑能力，且难以同时利用全局语义和局部空间信息。
Method: 提出耦合神经形状（CNS）表示，包括全局潜在编码和3D神经特征体积，并通过联合优化过程适应编辑操作。支持类别特定和类别无关的基础模型，并设计多种编辑操作的目标函数及区域保留机制。
Result: 在多种3D生成模型上的定量和定性评估显示，该方法在编辑质量和保真度上超越现有最优方法。
Conclusion: CNS-Edit++通过耦合表示和优化实现了类别无关的通用3D形状编辑，具备强大的编辑能力和区域保持效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mapping Order in Semicrystalline Polymers using Machine Learning of Nanobeam Electron Diffraction
papers.abstract_en: Organic mixed ionic electronic conductors (OMIECs) are a promising class of polymer materials for applications spanning neuromorphic computation to energy efficient electronics and bioelectronics. Despite being highly tunable, the relationship between structural features and key performance properties such as charge carrier mobility is poorly understood. Scanning nanodiffraction in the transmission electron microscope (TEM) is a powerful probe for elucidating this structure-property relationship, but produces large, noisy datasets that are difficult to interpret because polymer reflections exhibit several distinct morphologies. To address the complexity, we trained a machine learning (ML) model to detect these polymer diffraction peaks and their intensities from synthetic data. Compared to correlative peak detection algorithms, the conventional method for analyzing nanobeam 4D scanning transmission electron microscopy (4DSTEM) data, we show that the ML model is significantly faster and outperforms correlative algorithms in almost all cases, opening up the possibility of near-live visualization of 4DSTEM experiments.
papers.comment: Submitted to ACS Macromolecules. Main text is 13 pages and 5 figures, 23 pages and 15 figures with supporting information
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用机器学习处理纳米束电子衍射数据，实现对半结晶聚合物中结构有序性的快速映射。针对传统相关峰检测算法在处理聚合物复杂衍射图案时的速度慢和准确性不足问题，作者训练了一个基于合成数据的机器学习模型来检测聚合物衍射峰及其强度。与相关峰检测算法相比，该ML模型在速度上显著提升，并且在大多数情况下检测性能更优，为近实时可视化4D扫描透射电子显微镜实验提供了可能。
Motivation: 有机混合离子电子导体（OMIECs）的结构与性能关系尚不明确，扫描纳米衍射虽然能揭示结构-性能关系，但产生的数据集大且噪声多，且聚合物反射峰形态多样难以解释。
Method: 利用合成数据训练一个机器学习模型，用于检测聚合物衍射峰及其强度。
Result: 该ML模型相比传统相关峰检测算法速度更快，且在几乎所有情况下检测性能更优。
Conclusion: 该方法有望实现近实时可视化4DSTEM实验，加速对半结晶聚合物结构有序性的理解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exact Network Surgery: Functional Invariance and Gradient Plasticity in Reactive Computational Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Function-preserving network growth techniques such as Net2Net and progressive stacking expand a model's capacity without destroying its learned function, but existing formulations either tolerate numerical perturbations or require a full rebuild of the training program. We formalize Exact Network Surgery: the in-place insertion of a residual block into a live computational graph such that (i) the network function is preserved -- bit-exactly under explicit floating-point hypotheses -- and (ii) inserted parameters remain trainable immediately after insertion. We prove an identity-morphism theorem for gated residual blocks, a structural-locality theorem showing that a reactive invalidation engine recomputes exactly the downstream cone of the insertion point, leaving every other node's value and optimizer state untouched, and an escape-from-initialization proposition showing that the Gradient Shadowing gate alpha, initialized at zero over a randomly initialized branch, receives a generically non-zero gradient at insertion time. We identify a degenerate configuration -- zero-initialized output projections combined with a zero gate -- that is an exact saddle point gradient descent cannot escape. Every claim is validated on the reference implementation in NeuroDSL, a reactive graph engine in Julia: grafting is bit-exact on every logit tested (0 mismatches out of 1600); the gate escapes zero at the first optimizer step and unlocks branch gradients at the second, exactly as predicted; the degenerate configuration exhibits gradients identically zero for the entire 600-step run; surgery cost tracks downstream cone size with r = 0.9992 while graft-plus-invalidation bookkeeping is constant (about 0.75 ms) across insertion depths; and training resumes bit-identically across a real process restart. A flagged preliminary appendix reports first single-seed observations on post-insertion gate dynamics.

TL;DR: 本文形式化精确网络手术（Exact Network Surgery），即在保持函数不变的前提下，在实时计算图中原地插入残差块，并保证插入参数立即可训练。作者证明了门控残差块的单位态射定理、结构局部性定理以及梯度阴影逃逸初始化命题。在NeuroDSL上的实验验证了位精确性、梯度逃逸、退化配置及手术开销的线性关系。
Motivation: 现有功能保持网络增长技术（如Net2Net）要么容忍数值扰动，要么需要完全重建训练程序，缺乏精确的原地插入方法。
Method: 定义精确网络手术，通过位精确浮点假设保持网络函数，并利用反应式失效引擎仅重新计算插入点的下游锥体，不扰动其他节点。证明门控残差块的单位态射性质，以及梯度阴影门（初始化为零）在插入时获得非零梯度。识别零初始化输出投影与零门组合的退化鞍点配置。
Result: 在NeuroDSL上的实验：1600个logit中0个位不匹配；门在第一步优化后逃逸零点，第二步解锁分支梯度；退化配置在600步内梯度保持为零；手术开销与下游锥体大小相关系数0.9992，簿记恒约0.75ms；训练在进程重启后位一致。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该形式化方法实现了位精确的功能保持网络增长，并揭示了退化配置的存在。附注附录报告了首次单种子观察。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ReqGenX: An Empirical Study of Atomic Decomposition, Artifact Regeneration, and Reconstruction for Legacy SRS Documents
papers.abstract_en: Background: Evaluating automated Software Requirements Specification (SRS) generation is challenging because few datasets provide fine-grained traceability between source requirements, intermediate elicitation artifacts, and generated specifications. Aims: We aim to study whether legacy SRS documents can be transformed into traceable synthetic pre-SRS artifacts that support fine-grained evaluation of LLM-based SRS generation. Method: We conduct an empirical study using ReqGenX, a controlled pipeline that decomposes SRS sections into source-grounded atomic statements, routes atoms to standards-inspired artifact types through multi-LLM plurality voting, and generates artifacts using constrained prompts with iterative judge-guided refinement. We evaluate ReqGenX on seven PURE SRS documents using grounding, quality, information retention, and downstream reconstruction analyses. Results: ReqGenX produces faithful and usable atoms, with median AlignScore values typically between 0.96 and 0.99 and Prometheus scores ranging from 4.34 to 4.85. Generated artifacts remain strongly grounded in their source atoms, with AlignScore values typically between 0.80--0.94 and judge pass rates near 100%; stricter Prometheus evaluation yields pass rates from 54.8% to 97.1%. In a downstream SRS reconstruction case study, artifact-backed atoms remain recoverable from generated SRSs, with SBERT means between 0.69 and 0.75 and AlignScore medians between 0.76 and 0.84. Conclusions: Traceable synthetic pre-SRS artifacts can support more fine-grained evaluation of LLM-based SRS generation, while exposing tradeoffs among faithfulness, information retention, and artifact completeness.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过实证研究评估了将遗留SRS文档转换为可追溯的合成预SRS工件的可行性，使用ReqGenX管道进行原子分解、工件生成和下游重构。在七个PURE SRS文档上的实验表明，生成的原子忠实且可用，下游重构中工件可恢复，但存在忠实性、信息保留和工件完整性之间的权衡。
Motivation: 自动SRS生成的评估缺乏细粒度可追溯性，阻碍了LLM生成能力的可靠评估。本研究旨在探索是否可以通过分解和重构遗留SRS文档来创建支持细粒度评估的合成预SRS工件。
Method: 提出了ReqGenX管道，包括：将SRS章节分解为源接地的原子语句；通过多LLM多数投票将原子路由到标准启发式工件类型；使用约束提示和迭代法官引导精炼生成工件。评估采用接地性、质量、信息保留和下游重构分析。
Result: 原子生成中位数AlignScore 0.96-0.99，Prometheus分数4.34-4.85；工件接地AlignScore 0.80-0.94，法官通过率近100%，Prometheus通过率54.8%-97.1%；下游重构中SBERT均值0.69-0.75，AlignScore中位数0.76-0.84。
Conclusion: 可追溯的合成预SRS工件能够支持更细粒度的LLM生成SRS评估，但需要平衡忠实性、信息保留和工件完整性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Modalities to Propositions: A Language-Centric Framework for Multimodal Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: We propose a language representation for multimodal data in which any observation, whether image, video, or text, is expressed as a bag of atomic propositions, simple statements about the entities, actions, and relations in a scene. A global semantic codebook unifies these into a shared vocabulary of canonical atomic propositions, placing every modality and observation into one interpretable space that spans fine grained facts to high level concepts and composes into richer ones. This brings interpretability with reasoning, cross-modal understanding and retrieval, and compositionality that enables complex multimodal understanding, rich data curation and complex structured retrieval. We demonstrate the framework on autonomous driving and open-world data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于语言的多模态数据表示方法，将图像、视频、文本等观测表达为原子命题的集合，并通过全局语义码本将其统一为规范原子命题的共享词汇表，从而实现可解释推理、跨模态理解和组合性。该方法在自动驾驶和开放世界数据上进行了验证。
Motivation: 现有多模态模型缺乏统一的解释性表示，难以进行推理和跨模态理解，尤其在复杂场景中需要组合细粒度事实与高层概念。
Method: 提出语言中心框架，将多模态观测编码为原子命题（实体、动作、关系）的包，通过全局语义码本映射到共享规范空间，支持事实、概念及其组合。
Result: 在自动驾驶和开放世界数据上展示了框架在可解释推理、跨模态检索、结构化数据生成等方面的能力，但摘要未提供量化指标。
Conclusion: 该框架为多模态智能提供了一种统一、可解释且组合的语言表示，但其局限性（如扩展性、真实世界噪声处理）未在摘要中讨论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: QuReC: All-in-One Image Restoration with Query-Specific Guidance and Local-Global Response Calibration
papers.abstract_en: All-in-one image restoration aims to recover clean images degraded by multiple corruption types using a single unified model. Existing methods typically rely on image-level prompts or shared guidance to handle diverse degradations. However, such a paradigm becomes inadequate when degradations are spatially heterogeneous or even coexist in mixed forms within a single image. Yet spatially adaptive guidance alone is not sufficient, since accurate restoration also requires each spatial query to reliably aggregate complementary information from local neighborhoods and global contexts. To this end, we propose QuReC, a unified framework for all-in-one image restoration. QuReC consists of a Degradation-Guided Query Reconstruction Module (DQRM) and a Local-Global Response Calibration Module (LGRCM). Specifically, DQRM matches each spatial query against a degradation prototype space to reconstruct a query-specific degradation-aware representation, thereby providing fine-grained spatially adaptive restoration guidance. To further stabilize this query-wise matching process, we introduce a weakly supervised prototype matching learning strategy to improve optimization stability and degradation semantic consistency. Meanwhile, LGRCM performs local-global dual-branch aggregation and calibrates the aggregated responses with learnable priors, improving the reliability of feature aggregation and the coordination between local detail modeling and global context modeling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that QuReC achieves superior performance on multiple all-in-one image restoration benchmarks. The code is released at https://github.com/zhoushen1/QuReC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出QuReC，一种针对多种退化类型的统一图像恢复框架。包含退化引导查询重建模块（DQRM）和局部全局响应校准模块（LGRCM），通过查询特定的退化感知表示和局部-全局双分支聚合校准，实现了空间自适应的恢复。在多个全一体化图像恢复基准上取得优越性能。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖图像级提示或共享引导，难以处理空间异质或混合退化。空间自适应引导不足，且需要每个查询可靠地聚合局部和全局信息。
Method: 提出QuReC，包含DQRM和LGRCM。DQRM将每个空间查询与退化原型空间匹配，重建查询特定的退化感知表示；引入弱监督原型匹配学习策略。LGRCM进行局部-全局双分支聚合，并用可学习先验校准响应。
Result: 在多个全一体化图像恢复基准上取得优越性能。
Conclusion: QuReC通过查询特定的退化引导和局部-全局响应校准，有效处理空间异质和混合退化，实现高质量统一恢复。

papers.title: Show Me How You Reason and I'll Tell You Who You Are: Reasoning Graphs for Robust LLM Authorship Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Given the current trend to employ large language models (LLMs) in almost any imaginable context, LLM-generated text detection and authorship attribution have become a pressing issue. Prior work has primarily focused on surface-level linguistic features, an approach shown to be susceptible to paraphrasing and other obfuscation techniques. In this paper, we go beyond the linguistic surface, extracting and analysing reasoning structures in LLM-generated texts with the goal of capturing more complex signals of LLM authorship. We propose a graph neural network approach that leverages reasoning graphs extracted by an argument mining pipeline, demonstrating improved robustness and generalisation over a traditional Longformer baseline. Our approach outperforms the baseline by up to 27 percentage points under the obfuscation attacks such as paraphrasing and backtranslation, and 19 percentage points when evaluated on the texts generated by the unseen model versions, simulating real-world conditions in which new LLM versions are continuously released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用推理图进行LLM生成文本作者归属的方法。通过论证挖掘流水线提取推理结构，并用图神经网络分析，以捕捉超越表面语言特征的复杂署名信号。实验表明，在释义和回译等混淆攻击下，该方法比传统Longformer基线提升高达27个百分点，在未见过的模型版本上提升19个百分点。
Motivation: 现有LLM文本检测和作者归属方法多依赖表面语言特征，易受释义等混淆技术影响，需要更鲁棒的方法来应对不断更新的LLM版本。
Method: 提出一个基于图神经网络的框架，利用论证挖掘流水线从文本中提取推理图，通过图结构学习作者署名特征。
Result: 在混淆攻击（如释义和回译）下比Longformer基线提升高达27个百分点；在未见过的模型版本评估中提升19个百分点。
Conclusion: 推理图能够捕捉更复杂的署名信号，提供更强的鲁棒性和泛化能力，适应现实场景中LLM版本持续更新的挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SmartRAG: Native Graph-Based RAG for Mobile Device
papers.abstract_en: Deploying large language models (LLMs) as personal assistants on mobile devices demands privacy, low latency, and offline availability, yet the computational cost of giant models clashes with strict edge-hardware budgets. We argue that this tension cannot be resolved by model compression alone; it requires decomposing on-device intelligence into complementary functional roles. We present SmartRAG, a fully on-device framework that organizes an intelligent assistant around four coordinated modules -- Perception, Memory, Focus, and Thinking. At the core of SmartRAG is EvoNER, a continually learnable named-entity recognizer that incrementally expands its label inventory through teacher-distilled updates, enabling the system to absorb previously unseen entity types without retraining the backbone LLM. Extracted knowledge is stored in MRGraph, a three-layer provenance-preserving knowledge graph, and retrieved at query time through a hybrid pipeline combining graph traversal, lexical matching, and dense semantic search. The on-device LLM is invoked only for high-value semantic operations -- labeling, planning, and answer synthesis -- keeping inference costs bounded. Experiments on four QA benchmarks (TriviaQA, Natural Questions, HotpotQA, MultiHopQA) show that SmartRAG with a quantized 1.7B-parameter backbone achieves multi-hop reasoning performance competitive with models up to 18$\times$ larger, while running entirely on commodity smartphones within practical memory and latency envelopes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SmartRAG，一个完全在移动设备上运行的基于图的检索增强生成框架，将智能助手组织为感知、记忆、焦点和思考四个模块。其核心是EvoNER，一个持续可学习的命名实体识别器，通过教师蒸馏增量扩展标签库，避免重训练骨干LLM。知识存储在三层MRGraph中，查询时通过图遍历、词汇匹配和密集语义搜索混合检索。在TriviaQA、Natural Questions、HotpotQA、MultiHopQA四个QA基准上，使用量化1.7B参数的骨干模型，达到与18倍大模型相当的多跳推理性能，同时完全运行在商用手机上。
Motivation: 在移动设备上部署大型语言模型作为个人助手需要隐私、低延迟和离线可用性，但巨大模型的计算成本与严格的边缘硬件预算冲突，仅靠模型压缩无法解决。
Method: 提出SmartRAG框架，包含四个协调模块：感知、记忆、焦点和思考。核心是EvoNER，通过教师蒸馏实现持续学习，动态扩展实体标签库；知识存储于三层MRGraph（支持可溯源）；查询时采用混合检索管道（图遍历、词汇匹配、密集语义搜索），仅对高价值语义操作（标记、规划、答案合成）调用设备端LLM。
Result: 在四个QA基准（TriviaQA, Natural Questions, HotpotQA, MultiHopQA）上，使用量化1.7B参数的骨干模型，多跳推理性能与18倍大的模型相当，且完全运行在商用手机上，满足实际内存和延迟约束。
Conclusion: 提出的一种完全在设备端运行的检索增强生成框架，通过模块化设计和持续学习的NER，在不牺牲隐私和低延迟的前提下实现了与大规模模型竞争的性能。

summary_sections.motivation: 在移动设备上部署大型语言模型作为个人助手需要隐私、低延迟和离线可用性，但巨大模型的计算成本与严格的边缘硬件预算冲突，仅靠模型压缩无法解决。
summary_sections.method: 提出SmartRAG框架，包含四个协调模块：感知、记忆、焦点和思考。核心是EvoNER，通过教师蒸馏实现持续学习，动态扩展实体标签库；知识存储于三层MRGraph（支持可溯源）；查询时采用混合检索管道（图遍历、词汇匹配、密集语义搜索），仅对高价值语义操作（标记、规划、答案合成）调用设备端LLM。
summary_sections.result: 在四个QA基准（TriviaQA, Natural Questions, HotpotQA, MultiHopQA）上，使用量化1.7B参数的骨干模型，多跳推理性能与18倍大的模型相当，且完全运行在商用手机上，满足实际内存和延迟约束。
summary_sections.conclusion: 提出的一种完全在设备端运行的检索增强生成框架，通过模块化设计和持续学习的NER，在不牺牲隐私和低延迟的前提下实现了与大规模模型竞争的性能。

papers.title: SportD: Can VLMs Physically Strategize?
papers.abstract_en: Vision--language models have become increasingly capable of interpreting visual scenes, but it remains unclear whether they can use information to make strategically effective decisions. We investigate this question in soccer, where models observe the seconds preceding an on-ball decision and must choose whether to shoot or pass to a specific teammate. Unlike conventional visual-understanding tasks, soccer enables decisions to be evaluated quantitatively by estimating the value of every available action. We introduce SportD, a benchmark comprising 478 on-ball decisions from the 2022 FIFA World Cup. Each model choice is evaluated against a possession-value model that estimates the action that most increases the attacking team's probability of scoring, allowing us to measure both optimal-action accuracy and the value forfeited by suboptimal decisions. Across three frontier VLMs, the best selects the highest-valued action on 31.4% of events, compared with 38.9% for the professional players, and all models incur significantly greater regret. Further analysis reveals a systematic preference for lower-variance and lower-reward actions: VLMs shoot less often and select substantially less progressive passes than either the optimal policy or the real players. The models also reproduce the player's specific action above chance even when that action is suboptimal, suggesting partial imitation of familiar play patterns rather than consistent evaluation of counterfactual alternatives. SportD provides a value-grounded testbed for measuring physical strategic reasoning in VLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇论文研究了视觉语言模型（VLMs）在足球场景中能否进行战略性决策。作者构建了SportD基准，包含2022年世界杯478个持球决策时刻，用控球价值模型评估模型选择的最优动作准确率和后悔值。结果显示最佳VLM只达到31.4%的最优动作准确率，低于职业球员的38.9%，且模型倾向于选择低方差、低回报的动作，并部分模仿球员行为而非评估反事实选项。
Motivation: 尽管VLMs在视觉理解上越来越强，但它们在需要物理策略推理的任务中能否做出有效决策尚不清楚。足球提供了一个可量化评估决策的环境。
Method: 作者从2022年世界杯视频中提取478个持球决策时刻，让VLM观察此前几秒并选择射门或传球给特定队友。每个选择由控球价值模型评估，该模型估计最能增加进攻方得分概率的动作，从而衡量最优动作准确率和次优决策损失的后悔值。
Result: 最佳VLM在31.4%的事件中选择了最高价值动作，而职业球员为38.9%。所有VLM的后悔值显著更高。模型倾向于更少射门，选择更不具侵略性的传球，并部分模仿球员的具体动作（即使该动作并非最优）。
Conclusion: SportD为评估VLM的物理策略推理提供了一个基于价值的测试基准。当前VLMs在策略决策上远不如职业球员，且存在系统性的保守偏差和模仿行为。

papers.title: Open-AoE: An Open Egocentric Manipulation Dataset and Toolchain for Embodied Learning
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric videos of human manipulation provide scalable supervision for embodied intelligence, yet existing resources rarely combine low-cost continuous capture, manipulation-level structured annotations, and reusable tools for robot learning. We present Open-AoE, an open, community-oriented egocentric manipulation dataset and toolchain spanning the full pipeline from smartphone capture to model training. Its first release contains approximately 2,000 hours of manipulation video collected in natural environments by 500+ contributors using 400+ smartphones. The dataset provides text annotations, MANO-based hand poses, camera trajectories, and temporally localized atomic actions. Open-AoE further includes a data processing pipeline that transforms raw recordings into structured samples through temporal action segmentation, semantic annotation, hand reconstruction, and camera trajectory reconstruction. Meanwhile, we provide a separate downstream toolchain supports visualization, cross-embodiment retargeting, model-specific data conversion, and training recipes for VLA policies, WAMs, and World Models. By integrating scalable capture, structured processing, and downstream adaptation, Open-AoE reduces the barriers to both data contribution and reuse, providing practical open infrastructure for embodied model training, human-to-robot transfer, and world modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Open-AoE 是一个面向具身学习的开源自我中心操控数据集与工具链，包含约 2000 小时的自然环境操控视频，提供文本标注、手部姿态、相机轨迹和原子动作标注，并配套数据处理与下游模型训练工具链。
Motivation: 现有自我中心操控数据集缺乏低成本连续采集、操控级结构化标注和可复用工具链的结合，阻碍了具身学习的数据贡献与复用。
Method: 构建从智能手机采集到模型训练的完整工具链：包括时间动作分割、语义标注、手部重建和相机轨迹重建的数据处理管线，以及面向 VLA 策略、WAM 和世界模型的下游适配工具。
Result: 首个版本包含 500+ 贡献者使用 400+ 智能手机采集的约 2000 小时视频，提供文本、MANO 手部姿态、相机轨迹和原子动作标注。
Conclusion: Open-AoE 通过可扩展采集、结构化处理和下游适配，降低了具身模型训练、人机迁移和世界建模的数据壁垒。

papers.title: Semantic Anchoring for Robotic Action Representations
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models inherit rich semantic representations from pretrained Vision-Language Models, yet fine-tuning on limited robot demonstrations degrades this structure and undermines generalization. A fundamental question therefore arises: what constitutes a good action representation? Inspired by the mirror neuron theory's insight that observation and execution share an intention-level encoding, we examine whether a robot's action representations preserve the semantic structure captured by pretrained encoders. Systematic probing confirms that this structure erodes during finetuning, and that its quality synchronizes with both task success and out-of-distribution generalization. We further introduce a plug-and-play method that anchors action representations to a semantic manifold while decomposing representations into a shared semantic channel and a private channel, all discarded at inference, leaving the deployed model unchanged. Validated on different VLA backbones across simulation and real-world benchmarks, our method yields up to +18.7% on real-world in-distribution tasks and +21.5% on out-of-distribution generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文探究视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人动作表示中语义结构退化的问题。受镜像神经元理论启发，作者通过系统性探测确认微调会侵蚀预训练编码器的语义结构，且该结构与任务成功和泛化相关。提出一种即插即用方法，将动作表示锚定到语义流形，并分解为共享语义通道和私有通道，推理时丢弃，不改变部署模型。在模拟和真实世界基准上，方法在分布内任务上最高提升+18.7%，在分布外泛化上提升+21.5%。
Motivation: 微调VLA模型时，丰富的语义结构会退化，损害泛化能力。需要明确什么是良好的动作表示。
Method: 提出语义锚定方法，将动作表示锚定到语义流形，并分解为共享语义通道和私有通道，推理时丢弃私有通道，不改变模型。
Result: 在不同VLA骨干上，真实世界分布内任务提升+18.7%，分布外泛化提升+21.5%。
Conclusion: 语义锚定方法能有效保持动作表示的语义结构，提升泛化能力，且即插即用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Boogu-Image-0.1: Boosting Open Agentic Multimodal Generation via Understanding under a Minimal Budget
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Boogu-Image-0.1, an open-source unified multimodal understanding and generation model family, comprising Base, Turbo, Edit, and Edit-Turbo variants. It delivers competitive performance in high-quality text-to-image generation, fast inference, instruction-based editing, and bilingual (Chinese-English) text rendering. Closed-source multimodal systems like Nano-Banana-Pro and GPT-Image-2 achieve strong performance through system-level integration rather than a single model, yet their internal practices remain largely undisclosed. In this work, we demonstrate that strengthening the understanding capability of the system, through a stronger multimodal encoder, agentic prompt rewriting, and related techniques, together with improvements in data quality, training pipelines, and agentic inference-time scaling, can substantially enhance generation and editing performance even under highly constrained compute budgets. Comprehensive evaluations show that Boogu-Image-0.1 consistently matches or surpasses other open-source models across standard benchmarks, and achieves results approaching leading closed-source systems. Notably, this is accomplished with only 208.62 million unique images. The base model's theoretical training cost is only approximately \$400K. We share practical discussions that we believe are valuable to the broader research community, and release weights, code, and recipes under Apache 2.0 to advance the open ecosystem for unified multimodal understanding and generation. Our code is available here: https://github.com/Boogu-Project/Boogu-Image.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Boogu-Image-0.1，一个开源的多模态理解与生成模型家族，包含Base、Turbo、Edit和Edit-Turbo变体。通过增强系统的理解能力（更强的多模态编码器、代理提示重写等）以及改进数据质量、训练流程和推理时扩展，在有限计算预算（仅208.62百万张图像，理论训练成本约40万美元）下实现了接近闭源系统的性能。在标准基准上匹配或超越其他开源模型，并开源权重、代码和配方。
Motivation: 闭源系统如Nano-Banana-Pro和GPT-Image-2通过系统级集成取得强性能，但内部实践未公开。本文旨在开源框架下展示在有限预算下通过增强理解能力可以显著提升生成和编辑性能。
Method: 通过更强的多模态编码器、代理提示重写（agentic prompt rewriting）、数据质量改进、训练管道优化和代理推理时扩展（agentic inference-time scaling）来增强系统的理解能力。
Result: 在标准文本到图像生成、指令编辑和双语文本渲染基准上匹配或超越其他开源模型，达到接近Nano-Banana-Pro和GPT-Image-2等闭源系统的结果。训练仅使用208.62百万张图像，理论训练成本约40万美元。
Conclusion: 本文分享了有价值的实践讨论，并开源权重、代码和配方（Apache 2.0），以推进统一多模态理解和生成的开源生态系统。

papers.title: Mixed-Timescale Differential Coding for Downlink Model Broadcast in Wireless Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: In standard federated learning systems, the parameter server broadcasts the global model to the participating devices in every iteration. Motivated by the temporal correlation between consecutive global models, differential coding can be applied to global model dissemination to reduce the information magnitude, thereby enabling communication with fewer quantization bits. However, due to wireless link failures, devices may occasionally miss differential updates and consequently fail to reconstruct the global model. As a result, they either continue local training based on an outdated model or remain idle until the next full-model broadcast becomes available. To address this challenge, we propose a mixed-timescale differential coding (MTDC) scheme that performs differential coding at two different levels by adjusting the reference model. With MTDC, a device can reconstruct the latest global model between two full-model broadcasts even if it misses a differential update. We provide a convergence analysis that motivates the design of an age-aware variant of MTDC, along with a device scheduling policy to further improve communication efficiency. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed MTDC schemes achieve superior learning performance compared to baseline methods under similar communication resource budgets in the presence of downlink transmission failures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合时间尺度差分编码（MTDC）方案，用于解决无线联邦学习中因下行链路失败导致设备丢失差分更新而无法重建全局模型的问题。MTDC通过调整参考模型在两个层面进行差分编码，使得设备能在两次全模型广播之间重建最新全局模型。提供收敛分析并设计年龄感知变体和设备调度策略，仿真表明在类似通信资源下性能优于基线。
Motivation: 标准联邦学习中，全局模型广播可能因无线链路失败导致设备错过差分更新，从而使用过时模型或闲置。现有差分编码无法有效应对这种丢失问题。
Method: 提出混合时间尺度差分编码（MTDC），在两个不同时间尺度上进行差分编码，通过调整参考模型使设备即使丢失某些差分更新也能重建最新全局模型。进一步设计年龄感知变体和设备调度策略。
Result: 仿真表明，在下行传输失败的情况下，所提MTDC方案在类似通信资源预算下相比基线方法取得更优的学习性能。
Conclusion: MTDC有效缓解无线联邦学习中差分更新丢失导致的模型重建问题，提升通信效率和鲁棒性。

papers.title: Visual Access Boundaries in Vision-Language Model Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting is widely used as a test-time scaling strategy for Vision-Language Models (VLMs), but it remains unclear what is extended when VLMs generate longer reasoning traces. We ask whether CoT requires continued access to image tokens, or whether it mainly operates over visual information already made available earlier in the forward pass. We introduce Visual Access Sweep, a causal intervention that masks attention from generated-token queries to image-token keys along layer depth and generation time, and define the Visual Access Boundary (VAB) as the minimal access region that preserves task accuracy. Across six model configurations from Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3, both no-CoT direct answering and CoT prompting exhibit finite VABs. In Qwen2.5-VL-32B and InternVL3 at 14B and 38B scales, when CoT is evaluated against the no-CoT full-access target, its VAB layer differs from the no-CoT boundary by at most two layers, despite substantially longer generations. This suggests that CoT does not primarily improve performance by prolonging direct image-token access throughout the reasoning trace, but by extending language-side computation over image-derived hidden-state information. We further show that CoT gains are constrained by perceptual readout. CoT helps when the queried visual attribute can be reliably read out by the model, but not when that readout is unreliable. A symbolic-attribute oracle shows that CoT can improve counting once ground-truth attributes are supplied as text, while a single-object probe-vs-decode check shows that hard attributes can be linearly recoverable from hidden states yet difficult for the model itself to output. Together, these analyses place the bottleneck at readout rather than counting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型 (VLM) 中链式思维 (CoT) 推理时是否需要持续访问图像 token。通过引入因果干预 Visual Access Sweep 定义视觉访问边界 (VAB)，发现 CoT 并不通过延长直接的图像访问来提高性能，而是通过语言侧计算利用隐藏状态信息。CoT 增益受限于感知读取能力。
Motivation: CoT 提示在 VLM 中被广泛使用，但尚不清楚 VLM 生成更长推理轨迹时扩展的是什么。需要明确 CoT 是否依赖对图像 token 的持续访问。
Method: 引入 Visual Access Sweep 因果干预方法，在层深度和时间步上遮蔽从生成 token 查询到图像 token 键的注意力，定义最小访问区域 (VAB) 以保持任务准确率。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL 和 InternVL3 的六个模型配置上，无论是否使用 CoT，VAB 都是有限的。CoT 的 VAB 层与 no-CoT 边界最多相差两层，尽管生成长度更长。CoT 增益受限于模型可靠读取视觉属性的能力。
Conclusion: CoT 不主要通过延长直接图像访问来提高性能，而是通过语言侧计算扩展。视觉属性读取是瓶颈而非计数本身。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spectral Heat Flow for Conservative Token Condensation in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are costly at inference time because they must process long sequences of visual tokens. Existing token pruning methods often degrade under high compression by blindly discarding information, breaking spatial structure or collapsing diversity. We propose SpecFlow, a training-free framework that shifts the paradigm from destructive pruning to conservative condensation, strictly enforcing spatial coverage and statistical conservation to ensure stability. Treating visual tokens as nodes in a $k$NN graph, SpecFlow (i) computes a stable importance field via spectral heat flow to preserve structural coherence, (ii) allocates budgets via adaptive spatial partitioning to guarantee coverage, and (iii) aggregates discarded information into coreset sinks to maintain statistical conservation. The method is plug-and-play, requires no fine-tuning, and is compatible with FlashAttention. Experiments confirm that our SpecFlow outperforms SOTA methods across tasks, VLM architectures, and pruning ratios. Notably, LLaVA-1.5 with SpecFlow retains 95.6% of original performance despite pruning 88.9% of visual tokens, offering an exceptional efficiency-accuracy balance. Code is available at https://github.com/Lzy-dot/SpecFlow
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出SpecFlow框架，将视觉语言模型中的视觉标记压缩从破坏性剪枝转向保守聚合，通过谱热流保持结构一致性、自适应空间划分保证覆盖、核集汇保持统计守恒。在LLaVA-1.5上剪枝88.9%标记仍保留95.6%性能，无需微调。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型推理时视觉标记序列长、成本高，而现有剪枝方法在高压缩率下会盲目丢弃信息、破坏空间结构或导致多样性坍缩。
Method: 基于kNN图的谱热流计算稳定重要性场，自适应空间划分分配预算，并将丢弃信息聚合到核集汇中实现统计守恒。无需训练，即插即用。
Result: 在多种任务、架构和剪枝率下超越现有方法。LLaVA-1.5在剪枝88.9%标记时保持95.6%原始性能。
Conclusion: SpecFlow提供了一种高效的训练免费标记压缩方法，兼顾效率与精度。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Adaptive Compute in Latent World Models: When Depth Helps, Hurts, or Doesn't Matter
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive compute for world models -- early-exit or mixture-of-depths predictors that spend variable depth per rollout step -- presumes that extra depth buys better predictions. In autoregressive rollouts, where planning actually happens, that premise requires depth's per-step precision to survive composition. We test it directly with one pre-registered instrument, the shallow penalty rho = err(shallowest-exit rollout)/err(full-depth rollout), on nine DeepMind Control tasks under matched single-step (K=1) and multi-step (K=4) training, eight seeds each. Three regimes emerge: depth helps (intrinsic, 6/9 tasks, rho up to 8x), depth actively hurts (inversion, 2/9, rho down to 0.87x), or depth barely matters (flat). The inversion is created by training, not the dynamics: supervising early exits only at the first rollout step erases it (Delta=+0.28, n=8, non-overlapping distributions) -- a routability catch-22: the per-step deep supervision that makes exits routable also trains them to out-roll the full stack. The regime is predictable: a frozen dimensionality-only classifier, committed before training, labels held-out tasks correctly out-of-sample, including an extreme extrapolation. The inversion reproduces under a transformer predictor, yet its manifestation is configuration-dependent, shifting with metric space, horizon, encoder, backbone, and -- most strongly -- training data: on the two tasks we retrained, competent-policy data removes both the inversion and the intrinsic tradeoff, loss unchanged. In a CEM planner, rho predicts whether planning benefits from depth. Every threshold and gate was committed before the corresponding compute, including a pre-registered negative for the motivating hypothesis. Whether more compute helps a world model is not a task property; it is a property of the operating configuration, with a stable, predictable, mechanism-backed core.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过预注册实验（浅层惩罚 rho）在九个 DeepMind Control 任务上系统检验了深度世界模型中自适应计算（早期退出或混合深度）的效果。发现三种模式：深度有帮助（6/9 任务，rho 高达 8x）、深度有害（2/9，rho 低至 0.87x）以及深度几乎无关。有害模式（反转）由训练引起，可通过仅在第一步监督早期退出消除，且该现象可被预先预测（包括极端外推）。结论是更多计算是否有帮助并非任务固有属性，而是取决于运行配置，存在稳定、可预测的核心机制。
Motivation: 自适应计算假设额外深度能带来更好的预测，但在自回归 rollout 中，深度的单步精度可能无法在组合后保持。本文直接检验该假设是否成立。
Method: 使用预注册的浅层惩罚 rho = err(最浅退出 rollout)/err(全深度 rollout) 作为指标，在九个 DeepMind Control 任务上进行单步（K=1）和多步（K=4）训练（各八种种子），并分析深度帮助、有害或无关的条件。通过控制实验（如仅在第一步监督早期退出）揭示反转机制。
Result: 在 6/9 任务上深度有帮助（rho 高达 8x），2/9 上深度有害（rho 低至 0.87x），其余任务上深度无关。反转由训练造成且可被消除（Delta=+0.28，分布不重叠）。该现象可预测（包括极端外推），在变换器预测器下可复现但依赖具体配置，尤其是训练数据：使用 competent-policy 数据可同时消除反转和内在权衡，损失不变。
Conclusion: 世界模型中更多计算是否有帮助并非任务属性，而是运行配置的属性，存在稳定、可预测且机制支撑的核心。rho 可预测 CEM 规划器是否受益于深度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TSRouter: Dynamic Modality-Model Selection for Time Series Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Time series reasoning is essential for real-world problem-solving. While both Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can reason about time-series data, their capabilities are complementary: LLMs process time series as text sequences and thus preserve exact numerical understanding, but struggle with global patterns, whereas VLMs efficiently capture these patterns by visualizing time series but may lose fine-grained details. Moreover, models vary significantly in task-specific expertise and inference costs. Dynamically selecting the most suitable modality and model for each query is therefore crucial, yet challenging because it requires modeling the complex interactions among tasks, queries, modalities, and models, which carry rich contextual signals. To this end, we introduce TSRouter, a graph-based dynamic routing framework. TSRouter constructs a heterogeneous graph of task, query, modality, and model nodes to contextualize the interactions among query characteristics, modality attributes, and model capabilities. TSRouter formulates routing as a candidate scoring problem, where each modality-model pair is evaluated based on user-defined performance-cost preferences to select the optimal candidate. Comprehensive evaluations on 4 distinct time series reasoning tasks reveal that TSRouter substantially outperforms diverse baselines with 16\% to 46\% relative improvements. Furthermore, TSRouter demonstrates robust zero-shot plug-and-play generalization to unseen models and novel tasks and preserves high performance while reducing computational overhead through cost-aware optimization. Our code is available at https://github.com/tianyi-lab/TSRouter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TSRouter，一个基于图的动态路由框架，用于时间序列推理任务中动态选择最合适的模态（文本或视觉）和模型（LLM或VLM）。它构建包含任务、查询、模态和模型节点的异构图，通过候选评分选择最优模态-模型对。在4个时间序列推理任务上，相对基线提升16%-46%，并展现零样本泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有方法中，LLM和VLM对时间序列推理各有优劣，且不同模型在不同任务上表现和成本差异大。需动态选择最优模态和模型组合，但缺乏有效建模任务-查询-模态-模型交互的方法。
Method: TSRouter构建异构图表征任务、查询、模态和模型节点的交互，将路由问题转化为候选评分问题，根据用户定义的性能-成本偏好评估每个模态-模型对，选择最优候选。
Result: 在4个不同时间序列推理任务上，相对多种基线方法提升16%至46%，并展示出对未见模型和新任务的零样本泛化能力，同时通过成本感知优化降低计算开销。
Conclusion: TSRouter是一个有效的动态路由框架，能根据查询自适应选择模态和模型，在性能和成本间取得平衡，且具备泛化能力。
Relevance: 50

papers.title: EHR-MPC: Inference-Time Control for Sepsis Treatment with Generative Patient Digital Twins
papers.abstract_en: Sepsis is a leading cause of mortality, yet optimal treatment policies remain contested. Existing reinforcement learning (RL) approaches learn fixed strategies for sepsis treatment, limiting adaptability to changing clinical objectives during inference. We propose EHRMPC, a framework that decouples learning patient dynamics from optimizing treatment by training a patient digital twin in the form of a generative electronic health record (EHR) model. The digital twin predicts clinical trajectories under interventions and enables model predictive control (MPC) to optimize treatments via inference-time planning over simulations. We evaluate EHR-MPC on a multicenter ICU sepsis cohort spanning 8 hospitals in the Mass General Brigham health system using both off-policy importance sampling and on-policy simulation-based evaluation. Relative to RL baselines, EHR-MPC achieves comparable off-policy performance and improved simulation performance. Unlike RL, this work frames sepsis treatment optimization as inference-time control over learned patient dynamics, establishing a general framework for decision making with generative clinical models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EHR-MPC框架，通过训练生成式EHR模型作为患者数字孪生来预测临床轨迹，并利用模型预测控制（MPC）在推理时优化脓毒症治疗策略。在多中心ICU脓毒症队列上评估，离策略性能与强化学习基线相当，模拟性能更优。
Motivation: 现有强化学习方法学习固定治疗策略，难以适应推理时变化的临床目标。
Method: 训练生成式EHR模型作为患者数字孪生，用于预测干预下的临床轨迹，然后通过MPC在推理时进行规划以优化治疗。
Result: 在Mass General Brigham健康系统8家医院的多中心ICU脓毒症队列上，离策略重要性采样评估表现与RL基线相当，在策略模拟评估中表现更优。
Conclusion: 该工作将脓毒症治疗优化重新定义为对学习到的患者动态的推理时控制，为生成式临床模型决策提供了通用框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLM-Guided Task-Semantic Field Factorization for Industrial Process Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Process industries rely on time-series forecasting and soft sensing to estimate quality variables that are hard to measure online. Labeled data are scarce, operating regimes change frequently, and retraining models or rebuilding alignment pipelines for each scenario is costly. Such settings often provide variable tables and process documents that record variable names, units, physical meanings, and process roles. However, standard time-series backbones usually treat inputs as anonymous numerical columns. Existing text-enhanced methods also rarely make the semantic-logical relations between input variables and the prediction target available to the model within each numerical window. To address this problem, this article proposes Task-Semantic Field Factorization (TSF), a large language model (LLM)-guided framework. TSF builds a task-semantic field from task protocols and variable documents before training and uses the LLM only for offline semantic construction. Online training and inference are handled by conventional time-series backbones. During training and inference, the current numerical window activates variable semantics, so semantic information participates in each prediction and supports adaptation to different prediction targets and operating shifts. Across multiple complex industrial forecasting and delayed soft-sensing tasks, TSF reduces MAE by 3.6\% on average. Across all dataset--backbone pairs, the macro-average reduction is 2.9\%, with a maximum reduction of 24.9\%. It adds only about 0.7--4.3k parameters, with less than 8\,$μ$s/sample of additional online inference overhead. These results show that TSF turns existing process documents into measurable forecasting gains across backbones and semantic generators while remaining lightweight for deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于大语言模型引导的任务语义场分解（TSF）方法，用于工业过程预测。该方法离线利用LLM从任务协议和变量文档构建任务语义场，在线预测时通过数值窗口激活变量语义，使语义信息参与每次预测。在多个复杂工业预测和延迟软测量任务上，TSF平均降低MAE 3.6%，仅增加0.7-4.3k参数和小于8μs/样本的在线推理开销。
Motivation: 工业过程中标签数据稀缺、工况变化频繁，现有时间序列模型将输入视为匿名数值列，文本增强方法也未能将变量与预测目标之间的语义逻辑关系融入每个预测窗口。
Method: 提出Task-Semantic Field Factorization (TSF) 框架，利用LLM离线从任务协议和变量文档构建任务语义场，在线训练和推理时，当前数值窗口激活变量语义，使语义信息参与每次预测。
Result: 在多个复杂工业预测和延迟软测量任务上，TSF平均降低MAE 3.6%；在所有数据集-骨干网络组合上，宏平均降低2.9%，最大降低24.9%。仅增加0.7-4.3k参数，在线推理额外开销小于8微秒/样本。
Conclusion: TSF能够将现有过程文档转化为可衡量的预测增益，且轻量级，适合部署。

papers.title: Do GUI Agents Believe Their Eyes? Diagnosing State-Belief Reliance on Pixels versus Structure
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal GUI agents read an interface through two redundant channels: the rendered pixels of a screenshot and a serialized structure such as a document object model or accessibility tree. Before acting, an agent forms a belief about the current interface state, but existing benchmarks score task success, element grounding, or attack resistance and do not ask whether that belief is drawn from the pixels. We formalize visual state reliance, the attribution of a state belief to pixels, structure, or priors, and measure it with paired single-channel interventions over 735 probes spanning real web, mobile, and desktop interfaces, of which 225 are zero-edit divergences mined from live production websites, all scored by deterministic forced choice with no model judge. Our central metric is the Perception-Fusion Gap (PFG), the fraction of probes a model perceives correctly yet resolves toward structure under conflict; a stricter variant that re-verifies perception on a tight crop of the target region leaves the gap intact. Across models from four vendors, textual state beliefs defer to structure while image-only accuracy stays near ceiling, and on unedited stale snapshots from live pages the same models follow the outdated structure on up to 0.88 of probes. A white-box ablation traces the textual effect to a single copied structural value, and gradient attribution shows the visual evidence is processed yet overridden. In live multi-step environments, one mis-sourced belief at the first step compounds into task failure with a self-recovery rate of at most 0.03. Comparing four mitigations on identical probes, prompt-level cues fail at the action level, certificate checks buy safety with refusals, and a training-free consistency gate is alone in reducing both hijack and task error. Visual state reliance thus gives a measurable diagnostic of whether agent state beliefs are visually grounded.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文诊断多模态GUI代理的状态信念是来源于截图像素还是文本结构（如DOM）。作者提出视觉状态依赖概念，通过735个探针（含225个来自真实网页的零编辑分歧）测量感知融合差距（PFG），发现文本状态信念强烈偏向结构，纯图像准确率接近上限，且在未编辑的旧快照上模型最多88%遵循过时结构。在实时多步任务中，初始误源信念导致失败，自我恢复率仅3%；比较四种缓解措施，仅一致性门控同时减少劫持和任务错误。
Motivation: 现有GUI代理基准仅评估任务成功或元素定位，不追问代理形成的状态信念是否基于视觉像素，导致无法诊断信念的视觉基础。
Method: 形式化视觉状态依赖，用配对单通道干预（阻断像素或结构通道）测量信念来源；主要指标为感知融合差距（PFG），即模型正确感知却向结构化解的探针比例；包含225个来自真实网站的零编辑分歧探针。
Result: 跨四个供应商模型，文本信念顺从结构，纯图像准确率保持上限；在未编辑的旧快照上模型最多88%探针遵循过时结构；单步误源信念导致任务失败，自我恢复率≤3%；提示级缓解无效，证书检查带来拒绝，仅一致性门控同时降低劫持和任务错误。
Conclusion: 视觉状态依赖提供可测量的诊断指标，用于判断代理的状态信念是否真正基于视觉信息。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Multilingual Averages: MTEB-PT, a Benchmark for Portuguese Sentence Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Portuguese remains underrepresented in text embedding evaluation, despite being one of the most widely spoken languages in the world. As a result, embedding models are often selected based on English or multilingual metrics, while their effectiveness in Portuguese remains unclear. We present MTEB-PT, a Portuguese benchmark constructed from a subset of MMTEB, comprising 14 existing datasets across Semantic Textual Similarity (STS), classification, retrieval, and reranking. We use this benchmark to evaluate 17 open- and closed-source embedding models under a unified protocol. Our results show that Portuguese performance is strongly task-dependent: multilingual rankings do not reliably predict Portuguese-specific performance across task families, no single model dominates all settings, and models with stronger long-context capacity are particularly advantageous on longer-input tasks such as retrieval and reranking. The benchmark also shows that language-specific fine-tuning still improves model performance in Portuguese, especially on task types that match the adaptation data most closely. To examine this effect, we fine-tune three representative backbone models with Portuguese contrastive supervision and Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL). These benchmark-informed baselines yield their strongest gains on STS, consistent with the predominantly symmetric supervision used during training, while also improving retrieval and remaining competitive under dimensional truncation. We release the MTEB-PT benchmark, the fine-tuned models, and the training and evaluation code.
papers.comment: Accepted at BRACIS 2026 - 36th Brazilian Conference on Intelligent Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了葡萄牙语句子嵌入评估基准MTEB-PT，包含14个数据集，评估17个模型，发现多语言排名不能可靠预测葡萄牙语性能，语言特定微调在STS等任务上仍有提升。
Motivation: 葡萄牙语在文本嵌入评估中代表性不足，模型常基于英语或多语言指标选择，实际葡萄牙语性能不明确。
Method: 从MMTEB子集选取14个数据集构建MTEB-PT基准，覆盖STS、分类、检索、重排序，统一协议评估17个模型，并对三个模型进行葡萄牙语对比监督和Matryoshka表示学习微调。
Result: 葡萄牙语性能任务依赖性强，多语言排名不可靠；无单一模型主导所有任务；长上下文模型在检索和重排序上更优；语言特定微调在STS上提升最大。
Conclusion: 公开了MTEB-PT基准、微调模型及代码，可用于评估和提升葡萄牙语句子编码器。

papers.title: When Can You Debias an LLM Judge? Identifiability Limits, a Test, and Designs for Top-k Ranking
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as cheap, scalable judges that compare candidate outputs pairwise. Because such judges prefer verbose or well-formatted answers, the natural fix is to add bias covariates to a Bradley--Terry model and estimate the bias away. We show this cannot work as advertised: the quality/bias split is \emph{not identified} by pairwise comparisons, and the failure is exact -- across $48$ real judge-pools the profile likelihood over the coefficient is flat to $\mathbf{0.0000}$ \textbf{nats}, and scaling the comparisons $26\times$ buys none. A ``debiased'' score is selected by the prior, not recovered from data. Our contribution is accordingly not a better estimator but a characterization of \emph{when prior-based correction is justified}, plus designs that supply the missing information when it is not. The assumption the prior encodes -- quality is a priori uncorrelated with the covariate -- pays only while $\mathrm{corr}(θ,x)$ stays below a crossing point (configuration-dependent, $0.22$--$0.60$), which is what makes the same model help on LLMBar and hurt on SummEval and Nectar. We give two escapes: a \textbf{trusted-anchor gate} that decides per (judge, covariate, task) (no false enables in $6{,}000$ decisions at $K\ge10$ anchors, a rate our sample bounds at $\le6\%$), and a \textbf{paired rendering design}. Across fifteen real LLM judges bias is heterogeneous and capability-dependent: correction improves \topk{} recall by $0.20$--$0.32$ on five biased-but-competent cheap judges and is a no-op on frontier ones (Spearman $ρ{=}{-}0.84$ between competence and gain over the $14$ competent judges, $p{<}10^{-3}$), concentrating the benefit where at-scale evaluation happens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM作为裁判时偏好冗长或格式规整答案的偏差问题。作者证明，通过Bradley-Terry模型添加偏差协变量无法识别质量与偏差的分离，因为配对比较下似然函数平坦（48个真实裁判池中剖面似然系数平坦至0.0000 nats，扩大26倍比较也无改善）。因此“去偏差”分数由先验而非数据选择。论文刻画了先验校正何时合理，并提出了两种补充缺失信息的方案：可信锚门控（trusted-anchor gate）和配对渲染设计（paired rendering design）。实验显示，偏差因裁判能力和异构性而异；校正将廉价但有偏差裁判的Top-k召回率提高0.20-0.32，但对前沿裁判无影响（能力与收益的Spearman ρ=-0.84）。
Motivation: 现有LLM作为裁判时存在对格式和长度的偏好，通常通过添加偏差协变量到Bradley-Terry模型来校正，但作者发现这种校正无法识别——质量与偏差的分离由先验决定而非数据。因此需要明确何时以及如何合理进行偏差校正。
Method: 通过理论分析和真实裁判池实验，证明偏差校正的不可识别性；提出可信锚门控（每对裁判、协变量、任务判断是否校正）和配对渲染设计（供应缺失信息）两种方案。
Result: 在48个真实裁判池中，剖面似然函数平坦至0.0000 nats；比较规模扩大26倍无效。可信锚门控在K≥10锚点时无错误启用（6000次决策中0次），错误率上界≤6%。校正使五个有偏见但有能力的廉价裁判的Top-k召回率提高0.20-0.32，而前沿裁判无增益（能力与收益Spearman ρ=-0.84）。
Conclusion: 作者强调，偏差校正不可识别，现有实践实质由先验驱动；只有当先验假设（质量与协变量先验不相关）成立时校正才有益，且阈值取决于具体配置（相关系数0.22-0.60）。所提供的门控和设计可在校正无效时补充信息。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards transferable lightweight neuromorphic computing through a model-free temporal-switch framework
papers.abstract_en: Lightweight neuromorphic computing offers a promising route to efficient AI, with particular benefits for resource-constrained edge deployments. However, its scalable deployment that can reliably transfer the expected performance has long been hindered by device-to-device variations, which necessitate costly and repeated re-training on new copies and undermine the practical advantages. To address this issue, we introduce a model-free temporal-switch (TS) framework to improve the direct transfer performance, without post-training calibration or adjustment. The TS framework provides a methodology to incorporate a broader spectrum of devices in the training process. In the validation using memristor-based reservoir computing, it enables high performance on unseen devices with a directly transferred readout. It achieves improved prediction in the representative Mackey--Glass benchmark, and the accuracy of 92.4% in spoken digit classification. Its efficacy is validated across different memristor families and RC configurations. Theoretical analysis not only reveals the general computational mechanism underlying its efficacy, but also underlines its potential applicability to other physical platforms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对轻量级神经形态计算中器件差异导致迁移性能下降的问题，提出一种无模型时序开关（temporal-switch, TS）框架。该框架在训练阶段融入更广泛的器件变体，使基于忆阻器的储备池计算（reservoir computing）能在未见过的器件上直接迁移使用，无需后训练校准。在Mackey-Glass基准测试中提升预测性能，并在口语数字分类任务上达到92.4%的准确率。理论分析揭示了其通用计算机制，并指出可推广至其他物理平台。
Motivation: 轻量级神经形态计算在资源受限的边缘部署中优势显著，但器件间的差异导致在新器件上需要昂贵的重复训练才能保证性能，这阻碍了其大规模部署。
Method: 提出一个模型无关的时序开关框架，通过在训练过程中引入更广泛的器件变体，使网络学习到对器件差异鲁棒的表示，从而直接迁移至新器件而无需后训练调整。
Result: 在基于忆阻器的储备池计算验证中，该方法在未见过的器件上实现了高性能的直接迁移；在Mackey-Glass基准测试中预测精度提升，口语数字分类准确率达到92.4%；并在不同忆阻器系列和RC配置下均验证了有效性。
Conclusion: 理论分析不仅揭示了该框架有效性的通用计算机制，也强调了其可推广至其他物理平台的潜力。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在基于忆阻器的储备池计算验证中，该方法在未见过的器件上实现了高性能的直接迁移；在Mackey-Glass基准测试中预测精度提升，口语数字分类准确率达到92.4%；并在不同忆阻器系列和RC配置下均验证了有效性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 理论分析不仅揭示了该框架有效性的通用计算机制，也强调了其可推广至其他物理平台的潜力。

papers.title: From Scene-Centric to Observer-Centric: Modeling Observer-Aware Relations for 3D Scene Graph Generation
papers.abstract_en: 3D Scene Graph Generation (3DSGG) represents 3D scenes as structured object--relation--object graphs for spatial understanding. In observer-centric spatial perception, the same scene may be expressed under different local observer frames while its structure remains unchanged. However, existing models typically assume a fixed scene-aligned reference frame and may produce semantically inconsistent predictions when the scene is re-expressed in another observer frame. We attribute this failure to the heterogeneous frame dependency of relational predicates. Directional predicates such as $\textit{left}$, $\textit{front}$, $\textit{right}$, and $\textit{behind}$ are $\textbf{Observer-Dependent Relations}$, whereas most contact, support, and semantic predicates, such as $\textit{standing on}$ and $\textit{attached to}$, are approximately $\textbf{Observer-Independent Relations}$. Conventional models do not distinguish these frame responses, leading to degraded relation prediction under observer-frame reorientation. We introduce $\textbf{Observer-Aware Relations (OAR)}$, which combines observer-aware geometric encoding and relation specialization, supported by frame-stable object encoding, for unified multi-label predicate prediction. Experiments on 3DSSG show that OAR consistently outperforms baselines across controlled observer-frame reorientations without training-time frame-reorientation augmentation, while remaining competitive on the standard benchmark. The project page is available at https://oar-predicate.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有3D场景图生成（3DSGG）方法在观察者框架重定向时预测不一致的问题，提出Observer-Aware Relations (OAR)。该方法通过区分观察者相关谓词（如left, front）和无关谓词（如standing on），结合观察者感知几何编码和关系特化，实现框架稳定的多标签谓词预测。实验表明，OAR在3DSSG数据集上无需训练时数据增强即可在框架旋转下优于基线，并在标准基准上保持竞争力。
Motivation: 现有3DSGG模型假设固定场景对齐参考框架，在观察者框架重定向时产生语义不一致预测，因为未区分对框架异构依赖的谓词类型（观察者相关 vs. 观察者无关）。
Method: 提出OAR框架，包含观察者感知几何编码（编码观察者视角下的相对位置）和关系特化（将谓词分为两类分别处理），并采用框架稳定的对象编码作为基础，实现统一的多标签谓词预测。
Result: 在3DSSG数据集上，OAR在受控观察者框架重定向场景下持续优于现有基线，且无需训练时的框架重定向增强；在标准基准（固定框架）上也保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 通过显式建模谓词对观察者框架的依赖关系，可以在框架变化下提升3DSGG的鲁棒性，而不牺牲标准设置下的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Fold: prizewinning solution at LeHome Challenge 2026 (1st place online, 2nd offline)
papers.abstract_en: I describe my solution to the LeHome Challenge 2026, an ICRA 2026 competition on bimanual garment folding. The system placed 1st of 62 teams in the online (simulation) round and 2nd in the real-world final. It improves a vision-language-action (VLA) policy with a reinforcement-learning loop. The policy is its own value function: the same network that predicts actions also predicts success, progress, and a few task-relevant future quantities, and those predictions drive advantage estimation, live failure detection, and candidate selection. The work mostly recombines existing RL ideas with engineering and optimization contributions that can be used together as one recipe or individually: AWR + RECAP combined for flow-matching VLA; an asynchronous distributed training / rollout pipeline through HuggingFace Hub; inference-time hyperparameters optimization via Thompson sampling; a sim-to-real recipe with camera-alignment tooling, heavy augmentation and DAgger-like HIL data collection.
papers.comment: Solution of the LeHome Challenge at ICRA 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了作者在ICRA 2026举办的LeHome Challenge双人服装折叠竞赛中的解决方案。该系统在在线（模拟）轮次中排名第一（62支队伍），在真实世界决赛中排名第二。该方法改进了一个视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，并加入了强化学习循环，策略网络自身同时预测动作、成功概率、进度等，用于优势估计、实时故障检测和候选选择。工作主要是将现有RL想法（AWR + RECAP用于流匹配VLA，异步分布式训练/回滚管道，推理时超参数优化通过Thompson采样，以及包含相机对齐工具、大量增强和DAgger式人机循环数据采集的sim-to-real方案）与工程和优化贡献进行重组，可以整体或单独使用。
Motivation: 参与ICRA 2026的双人服装折叠竞赛，目标是在仿真和真实环境中高效完成服装折叠任务。
Method: 提出一个基于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的系统，该策略同时也是自身的价值函数，预测动作、成功概率、进度等，通过强化学习循环进行训练。结合AWR + RECAP的流匹配方法、异步分布式训练/回滚管道、Thompson采样的推理时超参数优化，以及带有相机对齐工具和DAgger式人类在环数据采集的sim-to-real配方。
Result: 在线（模拟）轮次在62支队伍中排名第一，真实世界决赛中排名第二。
Conclusion: 该方法通过重组现有RL思想和工程优化，在仿真和真实环境中均取得了优异表现，其各个组件可单独使用或组合应用。

papers.title: Data-driven Machine Learning Cannot Reach Symbolic-level Logical Reasoning -- The Limit of the Scaling Law
papers.abstract_en: By promoting vectors to spheres and enabling explicit model construction, neural networks can perform symbolic-level syllogistic reasoning without training data. We identify two fundamental limitations that prevent conventional data-driven machine learning systems from achieving this capability: training data generated by the combination table cannot distinguish all 24 valid syllogism types, and end-to-end premise-to-conclusion mapping creates contradictory targets within neural components. Experiments with two representative conventional systems, GPT-5 using linguistic inputs and Euler Net using visual inputs, support this analysis. ChatGPT GPT-5 may reach 100% accuracy in syllogistic reasoning, but with hallucinations. Because the learning process terminates upon reaching 100% accuracy, the system cannot progress beyond empirical accuracy to symbolic level reasoning. Random test data reduced Euler Net's accuracy to 56%. Repeatedly expanding the training set increased its accuracy to 97%, with perfect performance on 8 syllogism types. However, because unintended inputs cannot be exhaustively covered, even 100% test accuracy does not imply symbolic-level reasoning. Since syllogistic reasoning underpins logical reasoning and human rationality, these results suggest that increasing data and training time alone cannot ensure symbolic level logical reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证了数据驱动的机器学习无法达到符号级的逻辑推理能力，即使扩大数据规模或训练时间。通过将向量提升为球体并允许显式模型构建，神经网络可以无需训练数据执行符号级三段论推理。实验表明，GPT-5 和 Euler Net 在推理中分别出现幻觉和准确率不足的问题，即使达到 100% 测试准确率也不能保证符号级推理。
Motivation: 当前数据驱动的机器学习系统无法实现符号级逻辑推理，但原因未被明确揭示。文章旨在识别其根本限制，并指出仅靠扩大数据和训练时间无法克服这些限制。
Method: 通过理论分析指出两类根本限制：组合表生成的训练数据无法区分所有 24 种有效三段论类型；端到端的前提-结论映射在神经组件内产生矛盾目标。并用 GPT-5 和 Euler Net 的对比实验验证。
Result: GPT-5 在推理中可能出现幻觉；Euler Net 随机测试准确率仅 56%，通过反复扩展训练集可达 97%，但对未见过输入仍无法保证正确。
Conclusion: 由于三段论推理是逻辑推理和人类理性的基础，研究结果表明仅靠增大数据和训练时间无法确保达到符号级逻辑推理。

papers.title: Curvature-Adaptive Consistency Flow Matching: Autonomous Trajectory Optimization via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Consistency distillation has significantly accelerated diffusion-model inference, but its sampling dynamics remain underexplored. We reveal an asymmetry: although Logit-Normal sampling priors work well for standard iterative generation, consistency distillation exhibits a different difficulty profile (e.g., U-shaped), with optimization bottlenecks concentrated at the boundary stages rather than intermediate steps. To address the limitations of static sampling under evolving learning demands, we propose Curvature-Adaptive Consistency Flow Matching (CACFM). By formulating distillation as a dynamic decision process, CACFM uses a lightweight reinforcement learning agent to probe Probability Flow ODE trajectories and construct an efficiency-oriented curriculum that prioritizes critical regions without manual scheduling. Combined with Flow-adapted DMD and adversarial consistency objectives, our RL-based scheduler achieves state-of-the-art results on large-scale models such as FLUX and SDXL, mitigating structural deformities and preserving high-frequency details in extreme few-step regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了扩散模型中一致性蒸馏的采样动力学不对称性，指出优化瓶颈集中在边界阶段而非中间步骤。提出曲率自适应一致性流匹配（CACFM），通过强化学习代理动态构建有效率的课程学习，结合流适配DMD和对抗一致性目标，在FLUX和SDXL等大模型上实现极低步数下的最优结果，缓解结构畸形并保留高频细节。
Motivation: 现有一致性蒸馏方法忽略了采样动力学的不对称性，静态采样策略难以适应训练过程中不断变化的学习需求，导致边界区域优化不足。
Method: 将蒸馏过程建模为动态决策问题，使用轻量级强化学习代理探测概率流ODE轨迹，自动构建重点区域的效率导向课程；结合流适配DMD和对抗一致性损失。
Result: 在FLUX和SDXL等大规模模型上，极低步数下取得最先进结果，减少结构畸形并保留高频细节。
Conclusion: 强化学习驱动的自适应调度有效缓解了一致性蒸馏中的边界优化瓶颈，适用于高保真度快速生成。

papers.title: Position: Coding Benchmarks Are Misaligned with Agentic Software Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents have become a major mode of software engineering, but the benchmarks we use to compare them were designed in a pre-agent era: they collapse model, harness, and environment into a single end-to-end score, typically computed against one reference solution, with no component-level signal for iteration. We argue that current coding benchmarks are misaligned with agentic software engineering. A coding agent in practice is not a model: it is a system harness -- a composite of models, harnesses, contexts, environments, and feedback signals, any one of which can move the benchmark score by margins comparable to those between adjacent model generations. We discuss three symptoms: (i) benchmark scores conflate the model with the rest of the harness; (ii) grading against a single reference solution penalises equally valid alternatives; and (iii) the absence of signal at the level of individual harness components makes the end-to-end system score difficult to iterate on.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇观点文章，论证当前编码基准测试与智能体软件工程不匹配。作者认为，实际中的编码智能体是一个系统整体（模型、工具、环境、反馈信号等），但基准测试将模型与整个系统混为一谈，且通常仅针对单个参考答案评分，缺乏组件级信号，导致难以迭代改进。
Motivation: 现有的编码基准测试设计于智能体出现之前，无法反映智能体软件工程的实际需求，导致基准分数受系统组件影响大，无法有效指导模型或系统的改进。
Method: 通过分析三个症状（分数混淆模型与系统、单一参考答案不公、缺乏组件信号）来论证基准测试的不对齐，并提出了重新设计基准测试的必要性。
Result: 论文指出，任何单个组件（如模型、工具、环境）的变动都可能使基准分数产生相当于几代模型之间差距的变化，表明当前基准对智能体系统的评估不准确。
Conclusion: 呼吁社区从端到端分数转向组件级信号，以更好地评估和迭代智能体软件工程系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spectral Adaptive Conformal Prediction for Structured Non-Exchangeable Data
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction gives prediction intervals with finite-sample coverage when the data are exchangeable. Many time-indexed datasets are not exchangeable: they have seasons, recurring regimes, changing frequencies, or other forms of structured dependence. This paper studies a simple way to use that structure. We propose spectral adaptive conformal prediction, a method that forms weighted conformal quantiles using local spectral similarity and then updates the target miscoverage level online. The spectral weights choose calibration residuals that look relevant to the current test point. The adaptive update corrects the long-run miss rate when uncertainty changes over time. The theory makes both parts controllable. We give an approximate coverage bound that splits the error into a spectral mismatch term and an effective-sample-size term, prove that kernel spectral weighting never increases the mismatch term relative to uniform weighting, show that a bandwidth of order N^(-1/(d+2)) balances the two terms, and establish an unconditional long-run calibration bound for the adaptive update that holds for every sample path without independence or stationarity. Simulations with recurring regimes and slowly changing frequencies, together with four real-data examples spanning monthly, weekly, and daily U.S. and European series, show when the hybrid method improves on strong adaptive baselines and when it does not, and an effective-sample-size safeguard, computable at prediction time without outcomes, detects and repairs the one observed failure.

TL;DR: 本文针对结构化非交换数据（如含季节性和周期性的时间序列）提出谱自适应共形预测（spectral adaptive conformal prediction），通过局部谱相似性加权校准残差并在线调整目标错误覆盖率。理论证明该方法能在有限样本下提供近似覆盖保证，并通过模拟和四个真实数据集（美国/欧洲的月、周、日序列）验证效果。
Motivation: 标准共形预测要求数据可交换，但许多时间序列数据具有结构依赖性（如季节、周期性），导致覆盖失效。
Method: 提出谱自适应共形预测：基于局部谱相似性构建加权共形分位数，同时在线更新目标错误覆盖率以纠正长期误率。
Result: 理论给出覆盖误差分解为谱失配项和有效样本量项，证明核谱加权不增加失配项，且自适应更新提供无条件长期校准界。实验表明在周期性变化数据上优于强自适应基线，且有效样本量保护机制可检测失败情况。
Conclusion: 该方法为结构化非交换数据提供了一种可控制的共形预测框架，并给出了理论和实践指导。

papers.title: AI Contagion in Social Networks
papers.abstract_en: We study how artificial intelligence (AI) interacts with social communication networks to shape the stability of collective knowledge. Agents exchange information through a network while AI systems generate content and retrain on the aggregate informational environment they influence. This interaction creates a recursive feedback loop in which informational distortions diffuse through society and subsequently feed back into future AI outputs. Despite the high dimensionality of the environment, we show that the long-run dynamics admit a two-dimensional representation whose spectral radius completely characterizes the stability of AI-mediated information systems. We derive a sharp regulatory frontier identifying the minimum filtering required for stability and show how homophily and core-periphery network structures shape systemic informational risk.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究AI在社交网络中与人类通信的交互如何影响集体知识的稳定性。AI生成内容并基于其影响的总信息环境重新训练，形成递归反馈。尽管环境高维，长期动态可简化为二维表示，其谱半径完全刻画AI中介信息系统的稳定性。推导出稳定所需的最小过滤监管边界，并展示同质性和核心-边缘网络结构如何塑造系统性信息风险。
Motivation: 理解AI与社交网络交互如何影响集体知识的稳定性，特别是在AI生成内容和反馈循环的背景下，为信息系统的监管提供理论基础。
Method: 建立AI与社交网络交互的数学模型，通过谱半径分析长期动态的二维表示，推导稳定所需的最小过滤条件。
Result: 揭示了稳定AI中介信息系统所需的最小过滤边界，并指出同质性和核心-边缘网络结构对系统性信息风险的影响。
Conclusion: 强调监管需根据网络结构调整过滤强度以维持信息稳定性，网络拓扑是关键因素。

papers.title: RoVE: Rotary Value Embeddings Attention for Relative Position-dependent Value Pathways
papers.abstract_en: Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) make attention scores position-relative but leave the value pathway position-blind: the message sent by a value token is the same regardless of its distance from the query. We propose RoVE, a parameter-free modification that makes values position-sensitive by rotating them simultaneously with keys, and show that it turns RoPE attention into attentive convolution. This new perspective unifies several independent formulations of the same operation across computer vision, robotics, and modern LLM architectures. Trained 124M and 354M GPT-2 models show consistent empirical gains over RoPE on few-shot in-context learning, out-of-distribution perplexity, and long-context retrieval, with the clearest improvements on tasks that require long-range aggregation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RoVE，一种无参数修改，通过旋转值嵌入使注意力机制中的值路径感知相对位置，将RoPE注意力转化为注意力卷积。该方法在124M和354M GPT-2模型上，在少样本上下文学习、分布外困惑度和长上下文检索上持续优于RoPE，尤其在需要长程聚合的任务上改进最明显。
Motivation: RoPE使注意力分数相对位置感知，但值路径是位置盲的：值token发送的消息与其到查询的距离无关。
Method: 提出RoVE，通过同时旋转值和键，使值位置敏感，从而将RoPE注意力转化为注意力卷积。
Result: 在124M和354M GPT-2模型上，RoVE在少样本上下文学习、分布外困惑度和长上下文检索上持续优于RoPE，尤其在需要长程聚合的任务上改进最明显。
Conclusion: 该方法统一了计算机视觉、机器人和现代LLM架构中同一操作的多种独立公式。
