papers.title: Auditing Asset-Specific Preferences in Financial Large Language Models: Evidence from Bitcoin Representations and Portfolio Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models now power robo-advisors and trading agents, yet whether they carry built-in biases toward specific assets is largely untested. We ask three questions: do LLMs systematically prefer certain financial instruments; can an internal representation with causal leverage over those preferences be identified; and does that representation affect downstream financial decisions? We develop a three-level audit protocol and apply it to Bitcoin. First, a behavioral audit of nine frontier LLMs shows that Bitcoin's ranking among money-like instruments is frame-dependent: models place it around rank 5 of 8 as "reliable money" but near the top under crisis and autonomous-agent frames, and an attribute-swap experiment shows that rankings track functional properties, not names. Second, we open a model's internals: a search across thousands of sparse-autoencoder features in Gemma 3 identifies a dominant Bitcoin-selective feature. Amplifying it shifts the model toward the asset and suppressing it shifts the model away, even when "Bitcoin" never appears in the prompt. Third, we test financial consequences: amplification raises Bitcoin's portfolio share by 5.2 percentage points while suppression lowers it by 4.6 pp, with amplification reallocating within crypto and suppression cutting total crypto exposure. We characterize this as bounded behavioral leverage (leverage meaning causal influence over outputs, not financial leverage): an identifiable internal feature can be perturbed to move financial choices, but only within measurable limits. The framework links internal representations to external recommendations, validated with random controls and mechanism boundaries. As LLMs become autonomous financial agents, this is a first step toward a behavioral layer for emerging know-your-agent (KYA) standards: knowing what an agent prefers, and how far that preference can be moved.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文通过三层审计协议检验金融大语言模型(LLMs)对特定资产（以比特币为例）的内置偏好：行为审计显示比特币在货币类工具中的排名受框架影响；内部审计在Gemma 3模型中发现一个主导性的比特币选择性稀疏自编码器特征，放大或抑制该特征可改变模型偏好；财务后果审计表明该特征扰动可改变投资组合中比特币的分配比例。研究将这一现象描述为有界行为杠杆。
Motivation: 大型语言模型已用于机器人顾问和交易代理，但它们是否对特定资产存在内置偏好尚未被系统测试。论文旨在回答：LLMs是否系统性地偏好某些金融工具？能否找到对其偏好有因果影响的内部表征？该表征是否影响下游金融决策？
Method: 提出三层审计协议：1) 对9个前沿LLM进行行为审计，通过排名实验和属性交换测试测量比特币的框架依赖偏好；2) 开放模型内部，在Gemma 3中搜索数千个稀疏自编码器特征，识别出一个主导性的比特币选择性特征；3) 测试该特征扰动对投资组合配置的财务后果。
Result: 行为审计显示比特币在“可靠货币”框架下排名第5/8，但在危机和自主代理框架下排名接近顶端；内部特征放大使比特币投资组合份额提高5.2个百分点，抑制降低4.6个百分点，且放大效应在加密货币内部重新分配，抑制则削减总加密风险敞口。
Conclusion: 研究将内部表征与外部建议联系起来，验证了随机控制和机制边界，提出作为新兴“了解你的代理”(KYA)标准的行为层的第一步。

papers.title: Regularized Offline Policy Optimization with Posterior Hybrid Bayesian Belief
papers.abstract_en: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) aims to optimize policies from pre-collected datasets. A bottleneck of this paradigm is managing epistemic uncertainty, which arises from limited data coverage (sample-level) and the ambiguity in identifying transition dynamics from finite data (model-level). To provide a unified quantification of these uncertainties, Bayesian RL has been proposed by treating the dynamics model as a random variable and maintaining a corresponding belief. Despite its theoretical appeal, policy optimization in Bayesian RL remains computationally challenging as it requires solving composite objectives with expectations. Prior methods either employ search-based techniques with poor computational scalability or impose restrictive posterior assumptions that sacrifice the adaptability of Bayesian RL. To address these limitations, we propose Posterior Hybrid Bayesian Belief (PhyB), which reformulates the expectation as a convex combination over a subset of dynamics models. Theoretical analysis demonstrates that the objective discrepancy induced by this approximation remains bounded. Based on PhyB, we develop an iterative regularized policy optimization algorithm that provides metric-agnostic guarantees for monotonic improvement until convergence. Empirical results demonstrate that PhyB achieves state-of-the-art performance on various benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 Posterior Hybrid Bayesian Belief (PhyB)，通过将期望重新表述为对动力学模型子集的凸组合，统一量化离线强化学习中的样本级和模型级认知不确定性。理论分析表明该近似导致的目标差异有界，并基于此开发了迭代正则化策略优化算法，提供与度量无关的单调改进保证。实验表明 PhyB 在多个基准上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 离线强化学习中认知不确定性来自有限数据覆盖（样本级）和从有限数据识别转移动力学（模型级）的歧义，现有贝叶斯方法要么搜索效率低，要么对后验分布施加限制性假设，牺牲适应性。
Method: 提出 Posterior Hybrid Bayesian Belief (PhyB)，将期望重写为动力学模型子集的凸组合，并基于此设计迭代正则化策略优化算法。
Result: 摘要报告在多个基准上达到 state-of-the-art 性能，并给出单调改进的理论保证。
Conclusion: PhyB 通过混合贝叶斯信念提供统一的不确定性量化，同时保持计算可行性和性能优势。

papers.title: Singularity-aware Optimization via Randomized Geometric Probing: Towards Stable Non-smooth Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning optimization relies heavily on the assumption of smooth loss landscapes, a condition systematically violated by modern architectures due to non-smooth components such as ReLU activations and quantization operators. In such non-smooth regimes, adaptive optimizers such as Adam suffer from gradient chattering, violent oscillations caused by conflicting signals within the Clarke subdifferential, leading to poor convergence and suboptimal generalization. To address this, we introduce Singularity-aware Adam (S-Adam), a novel optimizer that stabilizes training by dynamically modulating step sizes based on local geometric instability. Our key contribution is the Local Geometric Instability (LGI) metric, a computationally efficient estimator of the Clarke subdifferential diameter derived from the variance of randomized directional derivatives. S-Adam incorporates an adaptive damping mechanism exp(-$λ$$ρ$) that decelerates updates in high-instability regions while preserving fast convergence in smooth basins. We provide a rigorous convergence analysis using differential inclusions, proving that S-Adam converges almost surely to ($δ$,$ε$)-Clarke stationary points at the optimal O(1/$\sqrt(T)$) rate. Empirical evaluations on Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) and high-noise small-batch learning demonstrate that S-Adam consistently outperforms AdamW and Prox-SGD, achieving accuracy gains of up to +4.54% on CIFAR-100 and +4.27% on TinyImageNet while effectively mitigating gradient oscillations.

papers.title: How Much Is a Dataset Worth? Scaling Laws, the Vendi Score, and Matrix Spectral Functions
papers.abstract_en: Neural scaling laws appraise data through dataset size, while the Vendi Score uses quantum entropy to measure dataset value. We show both that common neural-scaling-law objectives and the Vendi Score are submodular. We further show that the Vendi Score is a special case of a broader class of submodular objectives that we call matrix spectral functions. This also includes determinantal (DPP) objectives, as well as many others. We also introduce weakly matrix monotone functions and show how they lead to weakly submodular matrix spectral functions, yielding a broad family of practical objectives for data appraisal. We develop secular-equation-based updates that avoid repeated eigendecompositions during greedy optimization, reducing marginal-gain evaluation for $m$-dimensional embeddings by an $O(m)$ factor relative to oracle queries. This yields an average empirical speedup of about 35,000x, making direct optimization of the Vendi Score feasible on ImageNet-1K-scale datasets. Thus enabled, we compare how well several objectives predict the value of training subsets for held-out test performance under fixed-size, class-balanced, and fixed training-budget regimes, including the Vendi Score, DPPs, facility location, and three new matrix spectral variants. Across multiple datasets, facility location performs the best. Direct optimization also reveals that, while the Vendi Score is predictive over moderate score ranges, pushing the objective to higher values can make it a poor downstream performance proxy. We also find that uniformly at random fixed-size subsets, both unconstrained and class-balanced, are remarkably concentrated in both appraisal scores and held-out performance. Finally, we show that size, class balance, and training budget do not alone determine data value: even when controlling for these factors, performance ranges smoothly from good to bad.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明神经缩放定律的目标函数和Vendi Score都是子模函数，并将Vendi Score推广到更广泛的矩阵谱函数类，包括行列式点过程（DPP）等。提出基于割线方程的贪心优化更新，避免重复特征分解，在ImageNet-1K规模上实现约35,000倍加速。实验比较了多种数据评估指标（Vendi Score、DPP、facility location等）对训练子集价值的预测能力，发现facility location表现最佳；直接优化Vendi Score时，高分数反而可能成为下游性能的差代理。还发现随机均匀子集在评分和性能上高度集中，且数据价值不唯一取决于大小、类别平衡和训练预算。
Motivation: 现有数据价值评估方法（如基于数据集大小的缩放定律、Vendi Score）缺乏统一框架，且直接优化Vendi Score计算成本高，无法大规模应用。
Method: 提出矩阵谱函数作为Vendi Score的推广类，引入弱矩阵单调函数导出弱子模矩阵谱函数；开发基于割线方程的边际增益更新，将每次评估的复杂度从O(m^3)降至O(m^2)，避免重复特征分解。
Result: 在多种数据集和训练预算设定下，facility location在预测子集价值上表现最佳；直接优化Vendi Score时，高分数可能损害下游性能；随机固定大小子集（无论是否类别平衡）在评分和性能上高度集中。
Conclusion: 数据价值受多种因素影响，不能仅由大小、类别平衡或训练预算决定；所提框架和加速方法使大规模数据评估成为可能。

papers.title: Phantom Transitions in Language Model Fine-Tuning: A Density-Matrix Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning a language model often fails silently when its correct completion must outrank a near-synonym competitor. Cross-entropy loss falls monotonically while the correct token never overtakes the competitor. We study five transformer architectures of two families over a fivefold parameter range, on ten contexts where the correct completion and nearest competitor overlap substantially. We construct an order parameter combining the predicted distribution with the geometric overlap between token embeddings. The density-matrix formulation is natural because the prediction distribution lives over a non-orthogonal embedding basis. It decomposes additively into a signal, tracking commitment to the correct token over its nearest competitor, and a background drag, set by how the embedding bulk leaks probability into the score. This isolates two failure modes. In kinematic failure the signal stays small and the model never commits. In structural failure the drag actively worsens as fine-tuning proceeds and the model degrades geometrically even as its loss decreases. Sharp jumps resemble phase transitions but are not. Tracking it after every gradient step rules out spontaneous symmetry breaking. Under LoRA fine-tuning the embedding matrix is frozen, so no geometric phase transition is possible and the discontinuity lies in the softmax readout. One dimensionless quantity is consistent across all five models under full fine-tuning, while a second sorts them into two classes by bulk embedding distribution and predicts whether LoRA alone can drive a sentence to commit. As a blind test, the framework predicts the critical learning rate of a held-out architecture, used to fit no parameter, to within 2.1% of a subsequent sweep. All findings concern the near-synonym geometric mechanism studied here and should not be extrapolated without re-calibration to instruction tuning or broader tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型微调中的一种无声失败模式：正确token无法超越近义竞争者，尽管交叉熵损失持续下降。作者利用密度矩阵（density-matrix）形式，将预测分布与token嵌入的几何重叠结合，构造序参量，并分解为信号和背景拖拽，从而区分两种失败模式（运动学失败和结构失败）。在五种transformer架构、十种上下文上，发现一种无量纲量在不同模型下一致，另一种将模型分为两类。框架还能预测保留架构的临界学习率，误差仅2.1%。
Motivation: 语言模型微调中，交叉熵损失单调下降但正确token可能从未超过近义竞争者，这种无声失败未被充分理解。现有方法难以诊断此类失败，需要新的理论工具。
Method: 提出密度矩阵公式，将预测分布定义在非正交嵌入基上，构造序参量，并将其加性分解为信号（反映对正确token的承诺）和背景拖拽（由嵌入体泄漏概率引起）。通过每步梯度跟踪排除自发对称性破缺，并使用LoRA微调冻结嵌入矩阵来分离几何影响。
Result: 在五种transformer架构、十倍跨度参数范围、十种上下文上，识别出两种失败模式：运动学失败（信号小，模型从未承诺）和结构失败（拖拽随微调恶化，几何质量下降）。一个无量纲量在所有模型全微调下一致，另一个将模型分为两类，并预测LoRA能否驱动承诺。框架以2.1%误差预测保留架构的临界学习率。
Conclusion: 本研究的发现局限于近义词几何机制，不应不加校准地外推到指令微调或更广泛的任务。密度矩阵框架为理解微调中的几何学习提供新视角。

papers.title: Tetris: Tile-level Sampling for Efficient and High-Fidelity Video Object Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Track materialization converts raw videos into reusable object tracks that downstream queries can run against without rerunning tracking, but extracting those tracks efficiently and with high fidelity remains expensive. Prior systems reduce track materialization cost through temporal frame sampling, but aggressive sampling spaces each track's detection points too far apart to faithfully capture the object's actual trajectory. In stationary video, however, large portions of each frame contain no objects of interest, and different sampling rates can be used to extract tracks from the remaining regions. Leveraging this idea, we present Tetris, a track-extraction system that decomposes videos into a tile-based polyomino data model, enabling fine-grained spatiotemporal pruning that reduces detector calls with minimal fidelity loss. Tetris implements track materialization in three steps: first, a classifier identifies relevant tiles and groups them into polyominoes. Then, we use an integer linear program (ILP) to prune redundant polyominoes under a user-specified accuracy constraint, before packing the remaining polyominoes into canvases to minimize detector calls. Across 7 stationary-video datasets, Tetris stays within a 5% tracking accuracy loss as compared to a reference pipeline that processes every frame in its entirety, while prior systems exceed this bound on 3 of the 7 datasets. Moreover, with this 5% bound, Tetris achieves up to 17.4x higher throughput than prior systems, and up to 68.8x higher than the reference pipeline. Conversely, Tetris delivers up to 0.42 higher HOTA tracking accuracy than the best prior system at matched throughput. The project page is at https://tetris-db.github.io .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Tetris，一种将视频分解为基于 tile 的多米诺数据模型，通过整数线性规划（ILP）进行细粒度时空剪枝，在保持高保真度的同时减少检测器调用次数，高效提取目标轨迹的系统。在 7 个静态视频数据集上，Tetris 在 5% 的跟踪精度损失范围内保持精度，吞吐量比先前系统高 17.4 倍，比逐帧处理的参考管道高 68.8 倍。
Motivation: 现有跟踪物化系统通过时间帧采样降低成本，但激进采样导致检测点间隔过大，无法忠实捕捉物体实际轨迹。静态视频中大量帧区域无目标，因此可以差异化采样以降低成本。
Method: 三步骤：首先分类器识别相关 tile 并分组为多米诺；然后使用整数线性规划（ILP）在用户指定精度约束下剪枝冗余多米诺；最后将剩余多米诺打包到画布上以最小化检测器调用。
Result: 在 7 个静态视频数据集上，Tetris 在 5% 跟踪精度损失内保持精度，而先前系统在 3/7 数据集中超限。在此 5% 边界下，Tetris 吞吐量比先前系统高 17.4 倍，比参考管道高 68.8 倍。在相同吞吐量下，Tetris 的 HOTA 跟踪精度比最佳先前系统高 0.42。
Conclusion: 基于 tile 的细粒度时空剪枝可以有效降低跟踪物化成本，同时保持高保真度，适用于静态视频场景。

papers.title: Scientific reasoning does not reliably translate into scientific forecasting in frontier AI
papers.abstract_en: AI systems are increasingly used to support forward-looking scientific judgment, but it remains unclear whether they can form reliable expectations about future scientific advances. Here we show that strong scientific reasoning does not reliably translate into accurate forecasting of future scientific advances. To study this question, we introduce CUSP, a temporally grounded evaluation suite for event-level scientific forecasting across eight scientific disciplines. Across six frontier AI models, we observe a striking asymmetry in forecasting performance together with systematic error patterns. Models often identify plausible mechanisms underlying future scientific advances, yet perform near chance on feasibility assessment, generate solution strategies that only weakly align with realized advances, and systematically predict scientific advances later than they become publicly observable. Providing additional pre-cutoff scientific knowledge improves performance but does not eliminate these forecasting limitations. These findings suggest that current AI systems possess substantial retrospective scientific competence but limited forward-looking predictive capability. Scientific forecasting should therefore be evaluated as a complementary dimension of AI scientific capability when deploying AI systems for research prioritization and scientific decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究前沿AI系统在科学预测方面的能力，发现强大的科学推理能力并不能可靠地转化为对未来科学进展的准确预测。作者提出了CUSP评估套件，涵盖8个学科的事件级科学预测。对6个前沿AI模型进行测试，观察到预测性能的显著不对称性和系统误差模式：模型能识别可能的机制，但可行性评估接近随机，解决方案策略与真实进展弱对齐，且系统性延迟预测。提供额外科学知识虽改善性能但未消除局限。结论：当前AI具有强大的回顾性科学能力但前瞻性预测能力有限。
Motivation: 尽管AI系统越来越多用于支持前瞻性科学判断，但其能否对未来科学进展形成可靠预期尚不清楚。研究者需要评估AI在科学预测方面的能力。
Method: 引入CUSP（一个时间锚定的评估套件），用于事件级科学预测，涵盖8个学科。在6个前沿AI模型上进行实验。
Result: 模型在识别机制方面表现良好，但在可行性评估上接近随机，生成的解决方案策略与真实进展弱对齐，且系统性预测晚于实际公开时间。提供更多科学知识提高性能但未消除局限。
Conclusion: 当前AI系统具备实质性的回顾性科学能力但前瞻性预测能力有限。科学预测应作为AI科学能力的补充维度进行独立评估，特别是在部署AI用于研究优先级和科学决策时。
Relevance: 60

papers.title: DeliCIR: Memory-Guided Test-Time Deliberation via Multi-Agent Collaboration for Composed Image Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) requires both preserving the visual continuity of the reference image and faithfully executing the semantic variables specified in the modification text, which constitute the core challenge of the task. Existing methods often suffer from Perception Myopia in a single space, or fall into Logic Drift in iterative collaboration due to the perception ceiling of the underlying retriever. To address this issue, we propose a one-stop hierarchical Perception-to-Deliberation Framework (PDF), which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first to introduce Test-Time Scaling (TTS) into CIR. Relying on a hierarchical multi-agent architecture, PDF first utilizes an Intent Routing Manager to dynamically dispatch multi-view Worker perception signals based on modification intents to construct a high-recall candidate pool. Subsequently, the Deliberation Manager combines a training-free reasoning experience distillation mechanism with a tournament-style test-time scaling strategy (T-TTS) to perform experience-guided fine-grained reasoning and produce the final retrieval results. Experimental results demonstrate that PDF achieves SOTA performance on three benchmark datasets: CIRR, CIRCO, and Fashion IQ. This study indicates that experience-driven memory mechanism and TTS represent a highly promising and scalable path for achieving fine-grained multimedia retrieval. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种层次化感知-推敲框架（PDF），首次将测试时扩展（Test-Time Scaling, TTS）引入组合图像检索（CIR）任务。通过多智能体架构，使用意图路由管理器动态分配多视角工人感知信号构建高召回候选池，再结合无训练推理经验蒸馏与锦标赛式测试时扩展策略进行细粒度推理。在CIRR、CIRCO和Fashion IQ三个基准上达到最优性能。
Motivation: 现有CIR方法在单一空间存在感知近视，或由于底层检索器的感知上限导致迭代协作中的逻辑漂移，亟需一种能同时保持视觉连续性并忠实执行语义变更的框架。
Method: 提出层次化感知-推敲框架（PDF），包含意图路由管理器动态调度多视角工人感知信号构建候选池，以及推敲管理器结合无训练推理经验蒸馏与锦标赛式测试时扩展策略（T-TTS）进行经验引导的细粒度推理。
Result: 在CIRR、CIRCO和Fashion IQ三个基准数据集上取得当前最优（SOTA）性能。
Conclusion: 经验驱动的记忆机制和测试时扩展（TTS）是实现细粒度多媒体检索的一条有前景且可扩展的路径。

summary_sections.result: 在CIRR、CIRCO和Fashion IQ三个基准数据集上取得当前最优（SOTA）性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 经验驱动的记忆机制和测试时扩展（TTS）是实现细粒度多媒体检索的一条有前景且可扩展的路径。

papers.title: A Benchmark for Early-stage Parkinson's Disease Detection from Speech
papers.abstract_en: Early-stage Parkinson's disease (EarlyPD) detection from speech is clinically meaningful yet underexplored, and published results are hard to compare because studies differ in datasets, languages, tasks, evaluation protocols, and EarlyPD definitions. To address this issue, we propose the first benchmark for speech-based EarlyPD detection, with a speaker-independent split designed for fair and replicable cross-method evaluation on researcher-accessible datasets. The benchmark covers three common speech tasks and evaluates methods under different training-resource settings. We also present multi-dimensional evaluation breakdowns by dataset, aggregation level, gender, and disease stage to support fine-grained comparisons and clinical adoption. Our results provide a replicable reference and actionable insights, encouraging the adoption of this publicly available benchmark to advance robust and clinically meaningful speech-based EarlyPD detection.

papers.title: Turbophoresis of inertial particles in inhomogeneous turbulence generated by oscillating grids
papers.abstract_en: Turbophoresis in inhomogeneous turbulent flows leads to the formation of large-scale nonuniform particle number density distributions of inertial particles. This effect is associated with an effective drift velocity directed toward regions of lower turbulence intensity. It depends on the Stokes and Reynolds numbers, as well as on the gradient of the turbulence intensity. In the present study, turbophoretic transport is experimentally investigated in air turbulent flows generated by one-grid and two-grid oscillating systems. The flow velocity field is measured using Particle Image Velocimetry, and the particle spatial distribution is obtained by applying image processing techniques. To isolate the effect of particle accumulation due to turbophoresis from that associated with mean fluid flow, the measured particle number density of inertial particles is normalized by the corresponding distribution obtained for noninertial tracer particles under identical flow conditions. The measurements show preferential accumulation of inertial particles in regions of minimum mean-square turbulent velocity, consistent with the expected behavior of turbophoretic transport.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过振荡网格产生的非均匀湍流实验，研究了惯性颗粒的湍泳效应（turbophoresis），即颗粒向湍流强度较低区域漂移的现象。实验采用单网格和双网格系统，利用粒子图像测速（PIV）测量流场，并通过图像处理获取颗粒空间分布。通过将惯性颗粒数密度归一化到非惯性示踪颗粒的分布，分离了湍泳积累与平均流的影响。测量结果证实了颗粒在均方湍流速度最小值区域的优先积累，与湍泳输运的理论预期一致。
Motivation: 湍泳效应在非均匀湍流中导致惯性颗粒的大尺度非均匀分布，对气溶胶输运、云物理等有重要意义，但实验研究尚不充分。
Method: 使用振荡网格系统生成可控的非均匀湍流，结合PIV测速和图像处理技术，通过归一化示踪颗粒分布来提取纯湍泳效应。
Result: 实验观察到惯性颗粒在湍流强度最低的区域发生明显积累，与湍泳理论预测的漂移方向一致。
Conclusion: 该实验证实了湍泳效应在非均匀湍流中的主导作用，为理解云中雨滴等惯性颗粒的输运提供了基础依据。

papers.title: Preserving Clusters in Error-Bounded Lossy Compression of Scientific Particle Data
papers.abstract_en: Scientific particle simulations in cosmology, molecular dynamics, and fluid dynamics produce large-scale datasets whose storage, movement, and analysis increasingly rely on lossy compression. However, existing compressors typically bound only pointwise position errors, providing no guarantee on the fidelity of structures derived from particle coordinates, such as single-linkage clustering (also known as Friends-of-Friends algorithm), where clusters are connected components of a proximity graph formed by linking particle pairs within a distance threshold. Even small coordinate perturbations near this threshold can break true links or create false links, thereby splitting or merging entire clusters. We propose a compressor-independent correction technique for preserving single-linkage cluster membership under lossy compression. Our method operates on reconstructed outputs from off-the-shelf compressors such as SZ3, ZFP, Draco, and LCP, and stores a compact corrective edit stream. Our key observation is that cluster-membership queries depend on connected components rather than the complete set of proximity links. Based on this observation, we introduce three constraint-selection modes, vulnerable-pair, safe-component, and halo-forest, that progressively reduce the constraints enforced during correction. Projected gradient descent then corrects the reconstructed coordinates to eliminate the selected violations while respecting the original pointwise error bound. Experiments on cosmology, molecular dynamics, and fluid dynamics datasets with single-GPU and distributed-memory implementations show that our method preserves cluster membership while improving compression ratio by up to 4$\times$ and maintains competitive end-to-end throughput compared to the same base compressors configured with sufficiently tight error bounds to preserve clustering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对科学粒子数据（如宇宙学、分子动力学和流体动力学）的有损压缩中，现有方法仅保证点位置误差而无法保持单链接聚类（Friends-of-Friends）结构的问题，提出了一种与压缩器无关的后处理校正技术。该方法基于聚类成员性仅依赖于连通分量这一观察，设计了三种约束选择模式（vulnerable-pair、safe-component、halo-forest），通过投影梯度下降修正重构坐标，消除违反聚类约束的链接，同时保持原始误差界。实验表明，该方法能在保持聚类成员性的前提下将压缩比提升最高4倍，且端到端吞吐量与配置足够紧误差界的基准压缩器相当。
Motivation: 现有科学粒子数据的有损压缩器仅控制点级位置误差，无法保证由此推导出的聚类结构（如单链接聚类）的保真度；微小坐标扰动可能破坏或创建聚类链接，导致聚类错误分裂或合并。
Method: 提出一种与具体压缩器无关的校正方法：对任意压缩器（如SZ3、ZFP、Draco、LCP）的重建输出，选择三种约束模式（脆弱对、安全分量、光环森林）逐步减少需强制约束的数量，然后使用投影梯度下降修正坐标，消除聚类链接违规，同时保持原始点误差界。
Result: 在宇宙学、分子动力学和流体动力学数据集上的单GPU和分布式内存实现表明，该方法在保持聚类成员性的前提下，可将压缩比提升最高4倍，且端到端吞吐量与使用足够紧误差界来保持聚类的基准压缩器相当。
Conclusion: 本文提出的技术有效解决了有损压缩中科学粒子数据聚类结构保真度问题，通过利用聚类成员性依赖连通分量的特性，实现了压缩比与结构保真度的权衡。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: NaP-Control: Navigating Diffusion Prior for Versatile and Fast Character Control
papers.abstract_en: Achieving precise, versatile whole-body character control in physics-based animation remains challenging. Recent diffusion-based policies generate rich and expressive motions but typically rely on gradient-based test-time guidance to satisfy task objectives, which is slow and can reduce robustness. We introduce NaP-Control (Navigating Diffusion Prior for Versatile and Fast Character Control), abbreviated as NaP. Our method uses reinforcement learning to manipulate the latent noise of a task-agnostic diffusion policy prior, steering it toward task-specific behaviors for fast, robust control with high motion fidelity. In contrast to methods that rely solely on offline training, NaP interacts with the environment during training to correct motions and optimize task rewards, improving success rates and enabling adaptation to challenging scenarios. By directly predicting task-optimized diffusion noise, NaP eliminates iterative guidance during denoising and enables efficient inference. Experiments show that NaP attains higher success rates and faster inference while preserving natural motion across diverse tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NaP-Control，一种利用强化学习操控任务无关扩散策略先验的潜在噪声，实现快速、鲁棒的角色控制方法，无需测试时迭代引导。实验表明该方法在多种任务上取得更高成功率和更快推理速度，同时保持运动自然性。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的策略通过梯度引导满足任务目标，速度慢且鲁棒性差，亟需一种无需测试时迭代的快速控制方法。
Method: NaP-Control使用强化学习直接预测任务优化的扩散噪声，通过与环境交互纠正运动并优化任务奖励，消除去噪过程中的迭代引导。
Result: 在多种物理角色控制任务上，NaP-Control相比基线方法获得更高成功率，推理速度更快，且保持运动自然性。
Conclusion: NaP-Control证明了利用强化学习操控扩散先验噪声的可行性，为快速鲁棒的角色控制提供新思路。

papers.title: Geometrically Consistent Multi-View Scene Generation from Freehand Sketches
papers.abstract_en: We tackle a new problem: generating geometrically consistent multi-view scenes from a single freehand sketch. Freehand sketches are the most geometrically impoverished input one could offer a multi-view generator. They convey scene intent through abstract strokes while introducing spatial distortions that actively conflict with any consistent 3D interpretation. No prior method attempts this; existing multi-view approaches require photographs or text, while sketch-to-3D methods need multiple views or costly per-scene optimisation. We address three compounding challenges; absent training data, the need for geometric reasoning from distorted 2D input, and cross-view consistency, through three mutually reinforcing contributions: (i) a curated dataset of $\sim$9k sketch-to-multiview samples, constructed via an automated generation and filtering pipeline; (ii) Parallel Camera-Aware Attention Adapters (CA3) that inject geometric inductive biases into the video transformer; and (iii) a Sparse Correspondence Supervision Loss (CSL) derived from Structure-from-Motion reconstructions. Our framework synthesizes all views in a single denoising process without requiring reference images, iterative refinement, or per-scene optimization. Our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art two-stage baselines, improving realism (FID) by over 60% and geometric consistency (Corr-Acc) by 23%, while providing up to a 3.7$\times$ inference speedup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出从单张手绘草图生成几何一致的多视图场景的新问题。通过构建约9k个草图-多视图样本的数据集、并行相机感知注意力适配器（CA3）注入几何归纳偏置，以及基于运动恢复结构的稀疏对应监督损失（CSL），模型在单次去噪过程中合成所有视图，无需迭代精化或逐场景优化。该方法在FID上提升超过60%，几何一致性（Corr-Acc）提升23%，推理速度提升3.7倍。
Motivation: 现有多视图生成方法依赖照片或文本输入，草图到3D方法需要多视图或逐场景优化，但单张手绘草图因抽象笔触和空间畸变，无法直接用于多视图生成。
Method: 提出三方面贡献：自动构建的约9k草图-多视图数据集；并行相机感知注意力适配器（CA3）为视频Transformer注入几何先验；基于运动恢复结构的稀疏对应监督损失（CSL）确保跨视图一致性。
Result: 在几何一致性和图像质量上显著优于两阶段基线，FID降低超过60%，Corr-Acc提高23%，推理速度提升3.7倍。
Conclusion: 该方法首次实现从单张自由手绘草图生成多视图一致场景，但依赖于自动生成的合成数据，真实草图数据可能引入额外挑战。

papers.title: When Direct Prediction Fails: Evidence from LLM-Based Misinformation Risk Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: LLMs make it increasingly easy to generate deceptive content at scale, creating a need for scalable misinformation risk evaluation based on whether readers find such content credible and are willing to share it. A natural approach is to ask an LLM these questions directly and treat the returned scores as predictions of the corresponding human ratings. Implicit in this practice is the assumption that asking about a reader response produces the score that best predicts it. We test this assumption using matched credibility and willingness-to-share ratings for 290 deceptive articles from 317 participants and eight LLM evaluators. Unexpectedly, the assumption holds for credibility but fails for sharing. For every evaluator, credibility scores track human sharing at least as closely as sharing scores, while sharing scores offer no detectable benefit beyond credibility when predicting responses to unseen scenarios. This pattern persists when the questions are asked separately or in reversed order. Our results suggest that directly asking for the target response may not always yield the most effective score for predicting it. Comparing direct scores with indirect paths through related judgments may reveal a more effective predictive route. Deciding what to ask may be as important as refining how to ask it.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 1 figure. Substantially revised and reorganized version of arXiv:2604.06820 based on the same study and data; adds stricter participant filtering, held-out prediction analyses, and additional robustness checks
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文检验了直接询问LLM来预测人类对虚假信息可信度和分享意愿的假设。使用290篇欺骗性文章、317名参与者和8个LLM评估器，发现直接询问对可信度有效，但对分享意愿无效；可信度分数比直接分享分数更好地预测人类分享行为。结果表明直接询问目标响应不一定最优，间接路径可能更有效。
Motivation: LLM生成欺骗性内容的能力日益增强，需要可扩展的风险评估方法。直接询问LLM读者响应隐含了假设：直接询问目标响应可得到最佳预测分数，但该假设未经充分验证。
Method: 收集290篇欺骗性文章的人类可信度与分享意愿评分（317名参与者），并使用8个LLM评估器进行直接询问和间接预测的对比实验。
Result: 对于每个评估器，可信度分数跟踪人类分享的准确性至少与分享分数一样高，而分享分数在预测未见场景时没有提供超出可信度的额外可检测收益。当问题分开或按相反顺序提问时，模式依然存在。
Conclusion: 直接询问目标响应不一定产生最有效的预测分数；比较直接分数与通过相关判断的间接路径可能揭示更有效的预测路线。决定问什么可能与如何问同样重要。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neural Global Optimization via Iterative Refinement from Noisy Samples
papers.abstract_en: Global optimization of black-box functions from noisy samples is a fundamental challenge in machine learning and scientific computing. Traditional methods such as Bayesian Optimization often converge to local minima on multi-modal functions, while gradient-free methods require many function evaluations. We present a novel neural approach that learns to find global minima through iterative refinement. Our model takes noisy function samples and their fitted spline representation as input, then iteratively refines an initial guess toward the true global minimum. Trained on randomly generated functions with ground truth global minima obtained via exhaustive search, our method achieves a mean error of 8.05 percent on challenging multi-modal test functions, compared to 36.24 percent for the spline initialization, a 28.18 percent improvement. The model successfully finds global minima in 72 percent of test cases with error below 10 percent, demonstrating learned optimization principles rather than mere curve fitting. Our architecture combines encoding of multiple modalities including function values, derivatives, and spline coefficients with iterative position updates, enabling robust global optimization without requiring derivative information or multiple restarts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经方法，通过从噪声样本中迭代优化来求解黑箱函数的全局最小值。方法使用样条表示和迭代改进，在复杂多模态测试函数上平均误差8.05%，较样条初始化的36.24%有显著提升。
Motivation: 传统贝叶斯优化在多模态函数上易陷入局部最优，无梯度方法需要大量函数评估，现有方法对噪声样本的全局优化能力不足。
Method: 模型以噪声函数样本及其样条拟合表示作为输入，通过迭代改进初始猜测，向真实全局最小值逼近。架构结合函数值、导数和样条系数等多种模态的编码，并进行迭代位置更新。
Result: 在随机生成的多模态测试函数上，方法平均误差8.05%，较样条初始化的36.24%提升28.18%。72%的测试用例误差低于10%。
Conclusion: 该方法展示了学习到的优化原理，无需导数信息或多个重启，即可实现鲁棒全局优化。

papers.title: Revealing Physical-World Semantic Vulnerabilities: Universal Adversarial Patch for Infrared Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Infrared vision-language models (IR-VLMs) are becoming important for semantic perception in low-visibility environments, yet their robustness to physical semantic attacks remains underexplored. Existing adversarial patch methods are mainly designed for red-green-blue (RGB) images or closed-set infrared detectors and do not directly address open-ended IR-VLM tasks, where one deployable artifact can affect classification, captioning, and visual question answering (VQA) simultaneously. We propose Universal Curved-Grid Patch, abbreviated UCGP, a universal physical adversarial patch framework tailored to IR-VLMs. UCGP represents the patch as a deployable low-frequency curved grid and optimizes it with a representation-driven objective over subspace departure, topology disruption, and local appearance regularization. Meta Differential Evolution (MetaDE) searches for patch parameters with two physical robustness augmentations: Expectation over Transformation (EOT) capture sampling for imaging variations and thin-plate spline (TPS) patch-deformation modeling for non-rigid local shape changes. Rather than manipulating labels or prompts, UCGP disrupts the clean-category manifold in visual representation space, which later appears as degraded cross-modal outputs. Experiments show that a single shared patch degrades classification, captioning, and VQA across diverse IR-VLM architectures while retaining measurable cross-model transfer, cross-dataset generalization, cross-category extensibility, and real-scene physical effectiveness under the evaluated conditions. These results reveal a robustness blind spot in current infrared multimodal systems. Code and reproducibility assets are available at https://github.com/dyx6663/UCGP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种通用物理对抗补丁框架UCGP，专门针对红外视觉-语言模型（IR-VLM）。该补丁采用低频曲线网格表示，通过表示驱动的目标函数优化（包括子空间偏离、拓扑破坏和局部外观正则化），并结合元差分进化搜索与物理鲁棒性增强（EOT采样和TPS变形）。实验表明，单个共享补丁能同时降低多种IR-VLM架构的分类、描述和VQA性能，并具有跨模型迁移、跨数据集泛化和真实场景物理有效性。
Motivation: 现有对抗补丁方法主要针对RGB图像或闭集红外检测器，未处理开放式的IR-VLM任务（如分类、描述和VQA的同时攻击），红外多模态系统的物理世界语义鲁棒性研究不足。
Method: UCGP框架：将补丁表示为可部署的低频曲线网格；优化目标包括子空间偏离、拓扑破坏和局部外观正则化；利用MetaDE搜索参数，并引入EOT捕获成像变化和TPS建模非刚性局部形状变形，以增强物理鲁棒性。
Result: 单个共享补丁在多种IR-VLM架构上同时降低分类、描述和VQA性能，并展现出跨模型迁移、跨数据集泛化、跨类别扩展性和真实场景物理有效性。
Conclusion: 结果揭示了当前红外多模态系统的鲁棒性盲点，代码和可复现资产已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CARV: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Compositional Analogical Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Analogical reasoning tests a fundamental aspect of human cognition: mapping the relation from one pair of objects to another. Existing evaluations of this ability in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) overlook the ability to compose rules from multiple sources, a critical component of higher-order intelligence. To close this gap, we introduce CARV (Compositional Analogical Reasoning in Vision), a novel task together with a 5,500-sample dataset as the first diagnostic benchmark. We extend the analogy from a single pair to multiple pairs, which requires MLLMs to extract symbolic rules from each pair and compose new transformations. Evaluation on the state-of-the-art MLLMs reveals a striking performance gap: even Gemini-2.5 Pro achieving only 40.4% accuracy, far below human-level performance of 100%. Diagnostic analysis shows two consistent failure modes: (1) decomposing visual changes into symbolic rules, and (2) maintaining robustness under diverse or complex settings, highlighting the limitations of current MLLMs on this task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CARV（视觉组合类比推理）基准，包含 5500 个样本，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）从多个对象对中提取符号规则并组合新变换的能力。评测显示最佳模型 Gemini-2.5 Pro 仅达 40.4% 准确率，远低于人类 100%，暴露了当前 MLLMs 在视觉变化分解和鲁棒性上的根本缺陷。
Motivation: 现有类比推理评测忽略从多源组合规则的能力，而这是高级智能的关键。
Method: 将类比推理从单一对象对扩展至多对，要求模型从每对中提取符号规则并组合成新变换，构建包含 5500 样本的诊断数据集。
Result: Gemini-2.5 Pro 仅达 40.4% 准确率，人类为 100%，且模型在分解视觉变化和应对复杂多样设置时普遍失败。
Conclusion: 当前 MLLMs 在组合类比推理上远非人类水平，需针对规则提取和鲁棒性进行改进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Thermal Topology Collapse: Universal Physical Patch Attacks on Infrared Vision Systems
papers.abstract_en: Infrared pedestrian detectors are increasingly deployed in all-weather perception systems, but their robustness against physical adversarial attacks remains insufficiently understood. Existing infrared physical attacks are mostly instance-specific, requiring perturbations to be optimized for particular samples, poses, or scenes, which limits scalability under changing deployment conditions. This paper proposes Universal Physical Patch Attack (UPPA), a universal cold-patch framework for infrared pedestrian detection. UPPA is built on the observation that infrared physical perturbations should exploit smooth, low-frequency thermal structures rather than visible-light texture patterns. It represents the attack carrier as topology-constrained Bézier Curved-Blocks, providing a compact and manufacturable geometric parameterization, and optimizes one shared perturbation with Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) under Thin Plate Spline (TPS) deformation and Expectation over Transformation (EOT) imaging transformations. The optimized pattern is then deployed as wearable cold patches without sample-specific re-optimization during deployment. Experiments on five infrared datasets and nine pedestrian detectors show consistent digital attack performance, strong cross-dataset and cross-model transferability, and a 92.59\% attack success rate in real-world physical experiments. Ablation, visualization, and defense analyses show that Curved-Blocks disrupt pedestrian thermal feature aggregation and remain difficult for image-restoration-style defenses to remove. These results reveal a practical universal physical vulnerability in current infrared pedestrian detection systems and provide a benchmark for robustness evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出通用冷补丁攻击框架UPPA，针对红外行人检测系统，利用拓扑约束的贝塞尔曲线块作为攻击载体，通过粒子群优化在形变和成像变换下生成通用扰动，物理实验成功率达92.59%。
Motivation: 现有红外物理攻击多是实例特定的，需要为每个样本、姿态或场景单独优化，限制了可扩展性。
Method: UPPA将攻击载体表示为拓扑约束的贝塞尔曲线块，使用粒子群优化（PSO）在薄板样条（TPS）变形和期望变换（EOT）下优化共享扰动，部署为可穿戴冷补丁，无需样本特定重优化。
Result: 在五个红外数据集和九个行人检测器上取得一致的数字攻击性能，跨数据集和跨模型迁移性强，真实物理实验攻击成功率达92.59%。
Conclusion: 实验揭示了当前红外行人检测系统存在实用的通用物理脆弱性，并为鲁棒性评估提供了基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Role of Initialization in 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become the method of choice for photo-realistic novel view synthesis (NVS), due to its efficiency and compelling visual quality. 3DGS represents the scene through a set of 3D Gaussians, parameterized by their position, spatial extent, and view-dependent color. Starting from an initial point cloud, 3DGS refines the Gaussians' parameters as to reconstruct a set of training images as accurately as possible. Typically, a sparse Structure-from-Motion point cloud is used as initialization. In order to obtain a full scene representation, 3DGS methods thus rely on a densification stage. In this paper, we systematically study how initialization affects 3DGS NVS performance and geometric quality, using several densification strategies. We show that dense initialization does not lead to consistent visual improvements when paired with strong densification. Despite that, it can help in generalization to off-trajectory views and significantly improves geometric consistency of the scene representation.
papers.comment: Sources are available at https://github.com/deivse/ivd_splat . Changes in this version: extended experiments, adjusted direction
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了初始化对3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）在新视图合成和几何质量中的影响。通过多种致密化策略的实验，发现密集初始化在搭配强致密化时不会带来一致的视觉提升，但有助于离轨视图泛化并显著改善场景表示的几何一致性。
Motivation: 3DGS的初始化通常依赖稀疏SfM点云，但缺乏对不同初始化策略影响的系统研究，这一问题对于场景表示质量和泛化能力至关重要。
Method: 采用多种致密化策略，系统比较稀疏与密集初始化在3DGS新视图合成和几何质量上的表现。
Result: 密集初始化与强致密化结合时，视觉质量无一致提升；但能改善离轨视图泛化能力，并显著提升几何一致性。
Conclusion: 初始化选择需权衡计算成本与效果：密集初始化不改善视觉结果，但对泛化和几何有益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NanoZK: Privacy-Preserving Verifiable Inference for Large Language Models via Layerwise Zero-Knowledge Proofs
papers.abstract_en: We present NanoZK, a zero-knowledge proof system for verifiable LLM inference: clients and third-party auditors check that a provider executed the advertised model on a committed input without learning weights or activations. NanoZK introduces a layerwise proof framework that decomposes transformer inference into independently provable layers linked by a SHA-256 commitment chain, yielding constant-size sub-circuit proofs (3.5-3.7 KB; about 83 KB total at L=12), comparable in total size to and substantially more parallelizable than prior ZKML's monolithic 101-126 KB proofs. We prove compositional soundness and zero-knowledge under standard assumptions, design 16-bit lookup-table approximations for softmax, GELU, and normalization with measured perplexity degradation below 1e-4 across six model/dataset combinations, and add a Fisher-information-guided audit-budget triage as an efficiency tool (full soundness still requires verifying every layer). On CPU the MLP sub-circuit proves in about 6.3 s prove-only (about 43 s setup plus prove) with about 22 ms verification at any width; attention prove-only time scales from 0.9 s (d=16) to 184 s (d=256); full-block end-to-end proofs are measured to d=128, with a projected GPU time of about 68 s per block at d=768 from measured O(d^2) MSM scaling and a conservative 15-30x GPU-MSM speedup range based on Icicle's published 30x result for n >= 2^20 and extrapolated to the smaller-n regime. Privacy scope: NanoZK hides weights and activations from verifiers and auditors but does not hide the prompt from the prover; this is complementary to HE/MPC.
papers.comment: Extended version. The first 12 pages correspond to the ICICS 2026 (Springer LNCS) camera-ready paper. This version supersedes the earlier ICLR 2026 VeriFAI Workshop preprint and adds full security proofs, Halo2 circuit details, lookup-table derivations, extended experiments, verifier-cost analysis, GPU scaling, reproducibility instructions, and appendices omitted from the proceedings

TL;DR: NanoZK 提出一种用于大语言模型 (LLM) 推理的零知识证明系统，支持客户端和第三方审计者验证推理正确性，同时隐藏模型权重和中间激活。该系统采用逐层证明框架，将 Transformer 推理分解为独立可证明的子电路，通过 SHA-256 承诺链连接，生成恒定大小（约 3.5-3.7 KB/层，总约 83 KB）的证明，比现有 ZKML 的单一证明（101-126 KB）更小且更可并行化。论文提供了基于标准假设的组合安全证明，设计了 16 位查找表近似 softmax、GELU 和归一化（困惑度下降低于 1e-4），并引入 Fisher 信息引导的审计预算分流工具。实验报告了 CPU 和 GPU 上的证明与验证时间。
Motivation: 现有 ZKML 系统（如 ZK-SNARKs 应用于完整模型）产生大尺寸证明，验证效率低，且缺乏并行性。需要一种更高效、可并行化的零知识证明方案来支持 LLM 推理的公开验证，同时保护模型隐私。
Method: 提出了逐层 (layerwise) 零知识证明框架，将 Transformer 的每一层（自注意力、MLP 等）分解为独立子电路，每个子电路生成恒定大小证明，并通过 SHA-256 承诺链连接各层。设计了 16 位定点查找表近似 softmax、GELU 和层归一化，并引入 Fisher 信息度量来指导审计预算分配。安全证明基于标准假设，使用 Halo2 实现。
Result: 证明大小：每子电路 3.5-3.7 KB，12 层模型总约 83 KB；CPU 上 MLP 子电路仅证明约 6.3 秒（设置+证明约 43 秒），验证约 22 毫秒；注意力证明时间从 d=16 的 0.9 秒到 d=256 的 184 秒；全块端到端证明到 d=128，投影 d=768 时每块约 68 秒（基于 GPU MSM 加速）。近似函数导致困惑度下降低于 1e-4。
Conclusion: NanoZK 实现了隐私保护的可验证 LLM 推理，证明尺寸小且高度并行化，但隐私范围限于隐藏权重和激活，不隐藏提示；与同态加密/多方安全计算互补。全文包含完整安全证明和实现细节。

papers.title: TinyGLASS: Real-Time Self-Supervised In-Sensor Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Anomaly detection plays a key role in industrial quality control, where defects must be identified despite the scarcity of labeled faulty samples. Recent self-supervised approaches, such as GLASS, learn normal visual patterns using only defect-free data and have shown strong performance on industrial benchmarks. However, their computational requirements limit their deployment on resource-constrained edge platforms, especially within in-sensor processing architectures. This work introduces TinyGLASS, a lightweight adaptation of the GLASS framework designed for real-time edge and in-sensor anomaly detection. The proposed architecture replaces the original WideResNet-50 backbone with a compact ResNet-18 and introduces deployment-based modifications that enable static graph tracing and INT8 quantization. We evaluate the proposed approach on the Sony IMX500 intelligent vision sensor, exploiting the in-sensor processor using the Sony Model Compression Toolkit. In addition to evaluating performance on the MVTec-AD benchmark, we investigate robustness to contaminated training data and introduce a custom industrial dataset, named MMS Dataset, for cross-device evaluation. Experimental results show that TinyGLASS achieves 8.6x parameter compression while maintaining competitive detection performance, reaching 94.2% image-level AUROC on MVTec-AD and operating at 20 FPS within the 8 MB memory constraints of the IMX500 platform. System profiling showcases low power consumption (4.0 mJ per inference), real-time end-to-end throughput (20 FPS), and high energy efficiency (470 GMAC/J). Furthermore, the model demonstrates stable performance under moderate levels of training data contamination.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 8th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence Circuits and Systems (AICAS) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TinyGLASS，一种轻量化的自监督异常检测框架，用于边缘和传感器内实时异常检测。通过将GLASS的WideResNet-50替换为紧凑的ResNet-18，并引入静态图追踪和INT8量化，在Sony IMX500智能视觉传感器上实现20 FPS和4.0 mJ每推理的能效，同时在MVTec-AD上达到94.2%图像级AUROC。
Motivation: 现有自监督异常检测方法如GLASS计算开销大，难以部署在资源受限的边缘平台和传感器内处理架构中。
Method: TinyGLASS将GLASS的骨干网络从WideResNet-50替换为ResNet-18，并采用静态图追踪和INT8量化以适应边缘部署，通过Sony Model Compression Toolkit在IMX500传感器上实现。
Result: 在MVTec-AD上达到94.2%图像级AUROC，参数压缩8.6倍，在IMX500上实现20 FPS，每推理功耗4.0 mJ，能效470 GMAC/J，且在训练数据污染下表现稳定。
Conclusion: TinyGLASS证明了轻量化自监督异常检测可以在传感器内实时运行，适用于工业质量控制的边缘场景。

papers.title: Time-Aware Prior Fitted Networks for Zero-Shot Forecasting with Exogenous Variables
papers.abstract_en: In many time series forecasting settings, the target time series is accompanied by exogenous covariates, such as promotions and prices in retail demand; temperature in energy load; calendar and holiday indicators for traffic or sales; and grid load or fuel costs in electricity pricing. Ignoring these exogenous signals can substantially degrade forecasting accuracy, particularly when they drive spikes, discontinuities, or regime and phase changes in the target series. Most current time series foundation models (e.g., Chronos, Sundial, TimesFM, TimeMoE, TimeLLM, and LagLlama) ignore exogenous covariates and make forecasts solely from the numerical time series history, thereby limiting their performance. In this paper, we develop ApolloPFN, a prior-data fitted network (PFN) that is time-aware (unlike prior PFNs) and that natively incorporates exogenous covariates (unlike prior univariate forecasters). Our design introduces two major advances: (i) a synthetic data generation framework that injects realistic temporal patterns, structural changes, and exogenous dependencies into the PFN prior; and (ii) time-aware architectural modifications that embed inductive biases needed to exploit temporal context. We demonstrate that ApolloPFN outperforms existing baselines across several forecasting benchmarks with exogenous information, including M5, electric price forecasting, UCI Air Quality, and Solar Energy datasets.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ApolloPFN，一种时间感知的先验数据拟合网络 (PFN)，能够原生地融入外生协变量，用于零样本预测。通过合成数据生成框架和时间感知架构修改，在多个包含外生信息的预测基准上超越现有基线。
Motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型（如 Chronos, TimesFM 等）大多忽略外生协变量，仅从数值历史预测，这在存在促销、温度、节假日等驱动因素时限制性能。
Method: ApolloPFN 包含两大创新：(i) 合成数据生成框架，注入现实时间模式、结构变化和外生依赖；(ii) 时间感知架构修改，嵌入利用时间上下文的归纳偏置。
Result: 在 M5、电力价格预测、UCI 空气质量、太阳能数据集等多个基准上，ApolloPFN 优于现有基线。
Conclusion: ApolloPFN 通过原生整合外生协变量和时间感知设计，显著提升了零样本预测的性能，尤其适用于协变量驱动的目标序列。

papers.title: L2GTX: From Local to Global Time Series Explanations
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models achieve high accuracy in time series classification, yet understanding their class-level decision behaviour remains challenging. Explanations for time series must respect temporal dependencies and identify patterns that recur across instances. Existing approaches face three limitations: model-agnostic XAI methods developed for images and tabular data do not readily extend to time series, global explanation synthesis for time series remains underexplored, and most existing global approaches are model-specific. We propose L2GTX, a model-agnostic framework that generates class-wise global explanations by aggregating local explanations from a representative set of instances. L2GTX extracts clusters of parameterised temporal event primitives, such as increasing or decreasing trends and local extrema, together with their importance scores from instance-level explanations produced by LOMATCE. These clusters are merged across instances to reduce redundancy, and an instance-cluster importance matrix is used to estimate global relevance. Under a user-defined instance selection budget, L2GTX selects representative instances that maximise coverage of influential clusters. Events from the selected instances are then aggregated into concise class-wise global explanations. Experiments on six benchmark time series datasets show that L2GTX produces compact and interpretable global explanations while maintaining stable global faithfulness measured as mean local surrogate fidelity.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the 4th World Conference on Explainable Artificial Intelligence (xAI 2026), 18 pages, 7 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出L2GTX，一种模型无关的全局时间序列解释框架，通过聚合局部解释生成类级全局解释。从LOMATCE获取实例级解释，提取参数化时间事件基元（趋势、局部极值）及其重要性分数，跨实例合并簇并利用重要性矩阵估计全局相关性，在预算下选择代表性实例聚合为简洁解释。在六个基准数据集上验证了紧凑性和全局忠实性。
Motivation: 现有时间序列可解释性方法存在三大局限：模型无关方法不易推广到时间序列、全局解释合成研究不足、多数全局方法模型特定。需要模型无关的全局解释框架。
Method: 提出L2GTX框架，从LOMATCE生成的实例级局部解释中提取参数化时间事件基元（趋势、局部极值）和重要性分数，跨实例合并冗余簇，构建实例-簇重要性矩阵估计全局相关性，在用户定义的选择预算下选取覆盖最大影响簇的代表性实例，聚合生成类级全局解释。
Result: 在六个基准时间序列数据集上，L2GTX生成紧凑可解释的全局解释，并保持稳定的全局忠实性（以平均局部代理忠实度衡量）。
Conclusion: L2GTX克服了现有时间序列全局解释的模型特定性和适用性局限，为模型无关的全局解释提供了有效途径。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Evolution Strategy-Based Calibration for Low-Bit Quantization of Speech Models
papers.abstract_en: Quantization has become essential for the efficient deployment of speech processing systems. Although widely studied, most existing quantization methods were developed for vision and NLP architectures, while the specific challenges of audio signals remain largely overlooked. In particular, we show that audio activations can exhibit large calibration ranges, leading to significant information loss when standard calibration techniques are applied. To address this, we propose ESC, an Evolution Strategy-based Calibration method that formulates activation scaling as an optimization problem and solves it using a two-step local-global scheme driven by an evolution strategy. ESC enables unaltered performance under full INT8 quantization and is the first calibration method to achieve near-lossless performance for full INT4 quantization across multiple speech tasks. Integrating ESC with PTQ methods further reduces performance loss, achieving a 1% relative accuracy degradation on the AST model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ESC（进化策略校准）方法，针对语音模型在低比特量化中激活值范围大导致信息损失的问题，通过两阶段局部-全局优化方案求解激活缩放因子。在INT8全量化下保持性能无损，首次在INT4量化下实现近无损性能，结合PTQ方法后AST模型仅降1%相对准确率。
Motivation: 现有量化方法多针对视觉和NLP架构，忽略了音频信号激活值范围大的特殊挑战，标准校准技术会导致显著信息损失。
Method: 将激活缩放建模为优化问题，采用进化策略驱动的两阶段局部-全局搜索方案（ESC）求解最优缩放因子。
Result: 在INT8全量化下性能无损；INT4量化下首次实现近无损性能；结合PTQ后AST模型相对准确率仅下降1%。
Conclusion: ESC是首个在多种语音任务上实现INT4近无损量化的校准方法，但需进一步验证在其他架构或更大模型上的泛化性。

papers.title: Preventing Learning Stagnation in PPO by Scaling to 1 Million Parallel Environments
papers.abstract_en: An agent's performance stagnating at a suboptimal level is a common problem in deep on-policy RL. Focusing on PPO, we show that plateaus in certain regimes arise not because of known exploration, capacity, or optimisation challenges, but because sample-based estimates of the loss eventually become poor proxies for the true objective over the course of training. Looking deeper, PPO alternates between sampling rollouts from several parallel environments online using the current policy (which we call the "outer loop") and performing repeated minibatch SGD steps against this offline dataset (the "inner loop"). In our work, we abstract away the inner loop, and conceptually model the outer loop as standard stochastic optimisation. The step size is then controlled by the regularisation strength towards the previous policy and the gradient noise by the number of samples collected between policy update steps. This framing predicts that, much like in SGD, if the outer step size is too large relative to the noise, updates become uninformative and lead to the policy thrashing around a local optimum instead of converging. Recasting PPO in this light makes it clear that there are two ways to address this particular type of learning stagnation: either reduce the step size or increase the number of samples collected between updates. We validate the predictions of our model and conclude that increasing the number of parallel environments is a simple way to avoid these plateaus by simultaneously altering both these factors. Applying our analysis and scaling PPO to more than 1M parallel environments enables monotonic performance improvement up to one trillion transitions and leads to vastly superior performance compared to prior baselines in a complex open-ended domain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究深度在线策略强化学习（以PPO为例）中性能停滞的问题，指出停滞并非源于探索、容量或优化挑战，而是样本损失估计在训练过程中逐渐成为真实目标的糟糕代理。作者将PPO的外循环建模为标准随机优化，预测外步长相对于噪声过大时更新会变得无信息，导致策略在局部最优附近震荡。验证模型后，提出增加并行环境数量（扩展到超过1M个并行环境）可同时减小步长和增加样本数，避免停滞，实现单调性能提升。
Motivation: 深度在线策略强化学习（如PPO）中性能停滞在次优水平是常见问题，现有解释（探索、容量、优化）不充分，需要新的理论理解。
Method: 将PPO的外循环（采样rollout）抽象为随机优化，步长由正则化强度控制，梯度噪声由样本数量控制。预测并验证了两种解决停滞的方法：减小步长或增加样本数（通过增加并行环境数量）。
Result: 将PPO扩展到超过100万个并行环境，可实现多达一万亿次转移的单调性能提升，在复杂开放领域显著优于先前基线。
Conclusion: 增加并行环境数量是避免学习停滞的简单有效方法，该发现通过理论模型验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Motion-aware Event Suppression for Event Cameras
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras report asynchronously per-pixel brightness changes with microsecond latency, encoding dynamic visual information as a sparse stream of events. However, their extreme temporal resolution floods perception systems with entangled events from ego-motion and independently moving objects (IMOs), which existing solutions fail to efficiently decouple, relying instead on prohibitive dense 3D reconstructions or limited hand-tuned filters. In this work, we introduce the first framework for Motion-aware Event Suppression, which learns to filter events triggered by IMOs and ego-motion in real time. Our model jointly segments IMOs in the current event stream while predicting their future motion, enabling anticipatory suppression of dynamic events before they occur. Our lightweight architecture achieves 173 Hz inference on consumer-grade GPUs with less than 1 GB of memory usage, outperforming previous state-of-the-art methods on the challenging EVIMO benchmark by 67\% in segmentation accuracy while operating at a 53\% higher inference rate. Moreover, we demonstrate significant benefits for downstream applications: our method accelerates Vision Transformer inference by 83\% via token pruning and improves event-based visual odometry accuracy, reducing Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE) by 13\%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个基于运动感知的事件抑制框架，通过学习实时过滤事件相机数据中由独立运动物体（IMO）和自运动触发的事件。轻量级架构在消费级GPU上达到173 Hz推理速度，内存占用低于1 GB，在EVIMO基准上分割精度提升67%，推理速率提升53%。下游任务中，视觉Transformer推理加速83%，视觉里程计绝对轨迹误差降低13%。
Motivation: 事件相机的高时间分辨率导致自运动与独立运动物体产生的事件相互纠缠，现有方法依赖密集3D重建或手工滤波器，难以高效解耦。
Method: 提出运动感知事件抑制框架，联合分割当前事件流中的IMO并预测其未来运动，实现动态事件的预判性抑制。采用轻量级架构，支持实时处理。
Result: 在EVIMO基准上，分割精度比先前最优方法提升67%，推理频率提高53%。将视觉Transformer推理加速83%，事件视觉里程计ATE降低13%。
Conclusion: 该工作首次实现事件相机中IMO和自运动事件的实时解耦，展示了对下游任务（视觉加速、里程计精度）的显著改善。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GradAlign: Gradient-Aligned Data Selection for LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a central post-training paradigm for large language models (LLMs), but its performance is highly sensitive to the quality of training problems. This sensitivity stems from the non-stationarity of RL: rollouts are generated by an evolving policy, and learning is shaped by exploration and reward feedback, unlike supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with fixed trajectories. As a result, prior work often relies on manual curation or simple heuristic filters (e.g., accuracy), which can admit incorrect or low-utility problems. We propose GradAlign, a gradient-aligned data selection method for LLM reinforcement learning that uses a small, trusted validation set to prioritize training problems whose policy gradients align with validation gradients, yielding an adaptive curriculum. We evaluate GradAlign across three challenging data regimes: unreliable reward signals, distribution imbalance, and low-utility training corpus, showing that GradAlign consistently outperforms existing baselines, underscoring the importance of directional gradient signals in navigating non-stationary policy optimization and yielding more stable training and improved final performance. We release our implementation at https://github.com/StigLidu/GradAlign
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GradAlign提出一种基于梯度对齐的LLM强化学习数据选择方法，通过小型验证集筛选与验证梯度方向一致的问题，形成自适应课程，在不稳定奖励、分布不平衡和低效用数据场景下优于基线。
Motivation: 强化学习对训练问题质量高度敏感，非平稳策略导致依赖手动或简单启发式（如准确率）过滤方法容易引入低效用问题，亟需更鲁棒的数据选择机制。
Method: 利用一个小型可信验证集，计算每个训练问题的策略梯度与验证集梯度的对齐程度（如余弦相似度），优先选择对齐度高的训练数据，构建自适应课程。
Result: 在三个挑战性数据场景（不可靠奖励、分布不平衡、低效用训练语料）中，GradAlign持续优于现有基线，训练更稳定且最终性能显著提升。
Conclusion: 强调了方向性梯度信号在非平稳策略优化中的重要性，验证了梯度对齐作为数据选择准则的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An interactive enhanced driving dataset for autonomous driving
papers.abstract_en: Driving interaction data are important for training and evaluating autonomous drivingVision-Language-Action (VLA) models, but existing datasets contain limited denseinteraction samples and weak alignment between trajectories, visual inputs, and languageannotations. This work presents the Interactive Enhanced Driving Dataset (IEDD), alarge-scale interaction-oriented dataset constructed from five naturalistic trajectory datasets:Lyft Level 5, Waymo, nuPlan, INTERACTION, and SIND. IEDD contains 7.31 millionego-centric interaction segments, including 6.66 million multi agents cases, covering head-on,car-following, merging, and crossing interactions. Each segment is associated withtrajectory-derived interaction metrics describing interaction intensity and efficiency. Based onthese annotations, IEDD-VQA further provides trajectory-reconstructed BEV videos,structured interaction semantics, and multi-turn question-answer pairs. The dataset cansupport interaction mining, long-tail scenario analysis, VLA instruction tuning, andhierarchical evaluation of perception, behavior description, physical quantification, andcounterfactual reasoning.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Scientific Data
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了交互增强驾驶数据集（IEDD），从Lyft Level 5、Waymo、nuPlan、INTERACTION和SIND五个自然轨迹数据集中构建，包含7.31百万自车交互片段，其中6.66百万为多智能体案例，覆盖正面、跟车、并道和交叉交互。每个片段附带轨迹衍生的交互指标，并提供轨迹重建的BEV视频、结构化交互语义和多轮问答对（IEDD-VQA）。数据集支持交互挖掘、长尾场景分析、VLA指令微调以及感知、行为描述、物理量化和反事实推理的分层评估。
Motivation: 现有驾驶交互数据集中密集交互样本有限，且轨迹、视觉输入和语言标注之间的对齐较弱，限制了VLA模型的训练和评估。
Method: 从五个公开的自然轨迹数据集（Lyft Level 5、Waymo、nuPlan、INTERACTION、SIND）中提取交互片段，计算交互强度和效率指标，并生成轨迹重建的BEV视频、结构化语义标签及多轮问答对。
Result: 数据集包含7.31百万自车交互片段，6.66百万多智能体案例，涵盖四种交互类型（正面、跟车、并道、交叉），每个片段附带定量交互指标。
Conclusion: 该数据集可服务于多种自动驾驶相关任务，包括交互挖掘、长尾场景分析、VLA指令微调及多层次评估。

papers.title: Exploiting Low-Rank Objective Structure in Discrete Quadratic Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of maximizing a complex-valued quadratic form over the $K^{\text{th}}$ roots of unity. We show that when the objective matrix $\mathbf{Q}^\star \in \mathbb{C}^{n \times n}$ of the quadratic has rank $r$, the global maximizer belongs to a candidate set of size $O(rn^{2r-1})$. This set can be constructed deterministically in $O(rn^{2r+1})$ time by enumerating the vertices of a hyperplane arrangement in $\mathbb{R}^{2r}.$ The algorithm is embarrassingly parallel; with~$P$ processors, the time complexity drops to $O(r n^{2r+1}/P)$. For approximately low-rank settings, where the objective matrix is a noise-perturbed variant of a rank-$r$ matrix, we prove that applying our framework to a spectral truncation yields a multiplicative $(1 - O(\left\|\mathbf{H}\right\|_2 / δ^{\star}))$-approximation guarantee, where $δ^{\star}$ denotes the eigengap of the underlying rank-$r$ matrix and $\mathbf{H}$ represents the perturbation. To scale to high-dimensional problems, we establish a randomized sampling variant. We prove that uniformly sampling $S \geq O(1/\varepsilon^{r-1})$ candidates achieves a $(1-\varepsilon)\cos^2(π/ K)$-approximation of the optimal rank-$r$ solution with high probability. Crucially, this sample size is entirely independent of $n$, reducing the overall runtime to $O(S \cdot n^2)$. Computational experiments on synthetic benchmarks and large-scale graphs for \textsc{Max-3-Cut} confirm that our algorithms match or exceed semi-definite programming solution quality on structured instances while enabling massive parallelization across heterogeneous hardware and scaling seamlessly to problems where $n \geq 10^6$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究复数域上K次单位根二次型最大化问题，利用目标矩阵的低秩结构，提出确定性候选集枚举算法和随机采样近似算法，理论保证候选集大小与n的多项式相关，随机采样复杂度与n无关。实验表明在Max-3-Cut等大规模图上性能优于或等于半定规划方法。
Motivation: 二次型优化问题在通信、量子物理等领域有广泛应用，但高维情形求解困难。现有方法如半定规划扩展性差，需要更高效的算法。
Method: 利用目标矩阵的低秩性质，将全局最优解限制在超平面排列的顶点上，提出确定性枚举算法（复杂度O(r n^{2r+1})），并针对大规模问题提出随机均匀采样算法，样本量S与n无关，仅依赖秩r和精度ε。
Result: 理论证明了确定性算法在精确低秩情况下的候选集大小为O(r n^{2r-1})，随机采样算法以高概率达到(1-ε)cos^2(π/K)近似比。实验在Max-3-Cut基准上达到或超过SDP质量，且支持并行化扩展到n≥10^6。
Conclusion: 论文提出的低秩结构化方法在离散二次优化上兼具理论保证和实际可扩展性，特别适合大规模图分割问题，但假设目标矩阵低秩或近似低秩。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Unified Physics-Informed Neural Network for Modeling Coupled Electro- and Elastodynamic Wave Propagation Using Three-Stage Loss Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Physics-Informed Neural Networks present a novel approach in SciML that integrates physical laws in the form of partial differential equations directly into the NN through soft constraints in the loss function. This work studies the application of PINNs to solve a one dimensional coupled electro-elastodynamic system modeling linear piezoelectricity in stress-charge form, governed by elastodynamic and electrodynamic equations. Our simulation employs a feedforward architecture, mapping space-time coordinates to mechanical displacement and electric potential. Our PINN model achieved global relative L2 errors of 2.34 and 4.87 percent for displacement and electric potential respectively. The results validate PINNs as effective mesh free solvers for coupled time-dependent PDE systems, though challenges remain regarding error accumulation and stiffness in coupled eigenvalue systems.
papers.comment: We are withdrawing this preprint due to critical flaws discovered in the underlying simulation code that compromise the final conclusions leading to gravely misleading implications for future work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文采用物理信息神经网络（PINN）求解一维耦合电-弹性动力学系统，模拟线性压电效应（应力-电荷形式），通过三层损失优化将弹性动力学和电动力学方程作为软约束。前馈网络将时空坐标映射为机械位移和电势，在测试中位移和电势的全局相对L2误差分别为2.34%和4.87%。
Motivation: 传统数值方法求解耦合时变偏微分方程组（如压电耦合问题）时存在网格依赖和刚度问题，而PINN提供无网格替代方案，但对其在耦合波传播中的应用研究不足。
Method: 采用前馈神经网络架构，输入空间-时间坐标，输出机械位移和电势；损失函数包含三个阶段的优化：先优化数据项，再引入PDE残差，最后平衡各项权重。
Result: 位移全局相对L2误差2.34%，电势误差4.87%，验证了PINN作为耦合时变PDE无网格求解器的有效性。
Conclusion: PINN能有效求解耦合电-弹性动力学系统，但误差累积和耦合特征值系统的刚性仍是挑战。

summary_sections.method: 采用前馈神经网络架构，输入空间-时间坐标，输出机械位移和电势；损失函数包含三个阶段的优化：先优化数据项，再引入PDE残差，最后平衡各项权重。
summary_sections.result: 位移全局相对L2误差2.34%，电势误差4.87%，验证了PINN作为耦合时变PDE无网格求解器的有效性。
summary_sections.conclusion: PINN能有效求解耦合电-弹性动力学系统，但误差累积和耦合特征值系统的刚性仍是挑战。

papers.title: Foundation Model-Driven Semantic Change Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing (RS) change detection is essential for interpreting surface dynamics. Semantic change detection (SCD) further enables pixel-level understanding of multi-class transitions, yet remains sensitive to pseudo-changes induced by imaging conditions. Recent RS foundation models extract semantically consistent features across temporal and environmental variations, which is critical for mitigating pseudo-changes. However, existing SCD methods are often rigid and backbone-specific, lacking the flexibility to integrate diverse multi-scale features from emerging foundation models. To this end, we introduce a modular Cascaded Gated Decoder (CG-Decoder) that bridges various backbones and SCD tasks, processing multi-scale features in a coarse-to-fine manner while enabling adaptive change extraction. Building upon the RS foundation model PerA, we present PerASCD, a unified SCD framework. We further propose a Soft Semantic Consistency Loss (SSCLoss) to mitigate numerical instability in mixed-precision training. Extensive experiments on SECOND and LandsatSCD show that PerASCD achieves new state-of-the-art Sek scores (26.11% and 65.21%), surpassing the previous best by 0.61% and 4.95%, respectively. It also demonstrates exceptional data efficiency (outperforming the full-data baseline with 50% data), seamless cross-backbone generalization, and enhanced interpretability. Our approach maintains robust semantic consistency under radiometric variations, providing a reliable SCD solution. Code: https://github.com/SathShen/PerASCD.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种模块化级联门控解码器（CG-Decoder），用于连接遥感基础模型与语义变化检测（SCD）任务。基于PerA基础模型构建PerASCD框架，并引入软语义一致性损失（SSCLoss）来稳定混合精度训练。在SECOND和LandsatSCD数据集上，PerASCD在Sek指标上分别达到26.11%和65.21%，超越此前最佳结果0.61%和4.95%，并展现出数据效率、跨骨干泛化能力和可解释性。
Motivation: 现有语义变化检测方法对成像条件导致的伪变化敏感，且通常与特定骨干网络绑定，难以灵活集成新兴基础模型的多尺度特征。
Method: 提出级联门控解码器（CG-Decoder），以粗到细的方式处理多尺度特征，实现自适应变化提取。结合PerA基础模型构建PerASCD框架，并设计软语义一致性损失（SSCLoss）以缓解混合精度训练中的数值不稳定性。
Result: 在SECOND数据集上Sek指标达26.11%，提升0.61%；在LandsatSCD数据集上Sek达65.21%，提升4.95%。仅用50%数据即可超越全数据基线，且支持跨骨干网络泛化。
Conclusion: 该方法在辐射变化下保持语义一致性，提供了可靠的变化检测方案，但主要针对遥感变化检测任务，未涉及天气相关应用。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Breaking the Factorization Barrier in Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models theoretically allow for efficient parallel generation but are practically hindered by the ``factorization barrier'': the assumption that simultaneously predicted tokens are independent. This limitation forces a trade-off: models must either sacrifice speed by resolving dependencies sequentially or suffer from incoherence due to factorization. We argue that this barrier arises not from limited backbone expressivity, but from a structural misspecification: models are restricted to fully factorized outputs because explicitly parameterizing a joint distribution would require the Transformer to output a prohibitively large number of parameters. We propose Coupled Discrete Diffusion (CoDD), a hybrid framework that breaks this barrier by replacing the fully-factorized output distribution with a lightweight, tractable probabilistic inference layer. This formulation yields a distribution family that is significantly more expressive than standard factorized priors, enabling the modeling of complex joint dependencies, yet remains compact enough to avoid the prohibitive parameter explosion associated with full joint modeling. Empirically, CoDD seamlessly enhances diverse diffusion language model architectures with negligible overhead, matching the reasoning performance of computationally intensive Reinforcement Learning baselines at a fraction of the training cost. Furthermore, it prevents performance collapse in few-step generation, enabling high-quality outputs at significantly reduced latencies. Code available at: https://github.com/liuanji/CoDD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出耦合离散扩散（CoDD），一种混合框架，通过轻量级可推理概率推断层替代全分解输出分布，打破扩散语言模型中的分解障碍，实现高效并行生成。摘要表明CoDD能无缝增强多种扩散语言模型架构，以极低开销匹配强化学习基线的推理性能，并在少步生成中防止性能崩溃。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型受限于分解障碍：同时预测的token被假设为独立，导致速度与连贯性之间的权衡。现有方法要么牺牲速度（顺序解码）要么牺牲质量（因分解产生不连贯）。
Method: CoDD用轻量级可推理概率推断层替代全分解输出分布，建模复杂联合依赖，同时避免全联合建模的参数爆炸。
Result: CoDD以极低开销匹配强化学习基线的推理性能，并在少步生成中防止性能崩溃，实现高质量低延迟生成。
Conclusion: 分解障碍源于结构错误设定而非骨干网络表达力不足，CoDD通过紧凑的可推理分布有效打破此限制。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SoMA: A Real-to-Sim Neural Simulator for Robotic Soft-body Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Simulating deformable objects under rich interactions remains a fundamental challenge for real-to-sim robot manipulation, with dynamics jointly driven by environmental effects and robot actions. Existing simulators rely on predefined physics or data-driven dynamics without robot-conditioned control, limiting accuracy, stability, and generalization. This paper presents SoMA, a 3D Gaussian Splat simulator for soft-body manipulation. SoMA couples deformable dynamics, environmental forces, and robot joint actions in a unified latent neural space for end-to-end real-to-sim simulation. Modeling interactions over learned Gaussian splats enables controllable, stable long-horizon manipulation and generalization beyond observed trajectories without predefined physical models. SoMA improves resimulation accuracy and generalization on real-world robot manipulation by 20%, enabling stable simulation of complex tasks such as long-horizon cloth folding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SoMA，一个基于3D高斯点云（3D Gaussian Splatting）的软体机器人操作模拟器。它在一个统一的潜在神经空间中耦合可变形动力学、环境力和机器人关节动作，实现端到端的实到虚模拟。该方法无需预定义物理模型，能够进行可控、稳定的长时程操作，并在真实机器人操作任务上将重模拟精度和泛化能力提升20%，例如长时程布料折叠。
Motivation: 现有模拟器依赖预定义物理模型或数据驱动动力学，缺乏机器人条件控制，限制了准确性、稳定性和泛化能力。
Method: SoMA将软体动力学、环境力和机器人关节动作统一建模到潜在神经空间，使用学习到的3D高斯点云表示交互，实现端到端的实到虚模拟。
Result: 在真实机器人操作任务上，重模拟精度和泛化能力提升20%，能稳定模拟如长时程布料折叠等复杂任务。
Conclusion: SoMA展示了无需预定义物理模型即可实现可控、稳定的软体操作模拟，为实到虚机器人操作提供了新的范式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tabular Foundation Models Can Do Survival Analysis
papers.abstract_en: While tabular foundation models have achieved remarkable success in classification and regression, adapting them to model time-to-event outcomes for survival analysis is non-trivial due to right-censoring, where data observations may end before the event of interest occurs. We utilize a classification-based framework that reformulates both static and dynamic survival analysis as a series of binary classification problems by discretizing event times. Censored observations are naturally handled as examples with missing labels at certain time points. This classification formulation enables existing tabular foundation models (TFMs) to perform survival analysis through in-context learning without explicit training. In contrast to classical approaches that use binary classifiers to model discrete-time hazards, our approach directly models cumulative failure probabilities, which we find empirically to be more robust to the number of discretization bins by avoiding multiplicative accumulation of per-bin errors. We prove that under standard censoring assumptions, minimizing our binary classification loss recovers the true survival probabilities as the training set size increases. We demonstrate through evaluation across 48 real-world datasets (43 static and 5 dynamic) that off-the-shelf TFMs with this classification formulation outperform classical and deep learning baselines on average over multiple survival metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将表格基础模型（TFM）用于生存分析，通过将时间-事件数据转化为一系列二分类问题，利用上下文学习（in-context learning）直接建模累积失败概率，无需显式训练。在48个数据集上，该方法平均优于经典与深度学习方法。
Motivation: 生存分析中的右删失（right-censoring）使得直接应用表格基础模型变得困难，现有方法多需专门训练或难以处理离散化误差。
Method: 基于分类框架，将静态与动态生存分析转化为离散时间点的二分类问题，直接建模累积失败概率（而非危险函数），并通过上下文学习让TFM进行预测。理论上证明在标准删失假设下损失最小化可恢复真实生存概率。
Result: 在48个数据集（43静态+5动态）上，使用现成TFM的该方法在多个生存指标上平均优于经典模型（如Cox回归）和深度学习基线。
Conclusion: 分类形式的生存分析框架能有效利用表格基础模型的上下文学习能力，无需专门训练即可处理删失数据，且对离散化分箱数更为鲁棒。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ReMIND: Orchestrating Modular Large Language Models for Controllable Serendipity A REM-Inspired System Design for Emergent Creative Ideation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used not only for problem solving but also for creative ideation; however, generating ideas that are both novel and coherent remains challenging. While high-temperature sampling can promote originality, it often compromises consistency and usefulness. Here, we propose ReMIND, a four-stage framework comprising wake, which establishes a stable semantic baseline through low-temperature generation; dream, which performs high-temperature exploratory generation; judge, which evaluates candidate outputs for consistency and extracts salient novel ideas; and rewake, which consolidates selected ideas into coherent final outputs. By assigning these functions to independent LLM modules, ReMIND explicitly separates exploration from stabilization. We systematically evaluated diverse model configurations using multiple creative ideation tasks. External evaluations showed that novelty enhancement could emerge through two separable stages: first from the wake to the dream phase through high-temperature exploration, and subsequently from the dream to the rewake phase through judge-mediated selection and consolidation. Notably, different LLM families exhibited distinct functional tendencies. These findings suggest that serendipitous ideation in LLMs is not solely a property of individual models but emerges from interactions among models assigned to specialized cognitive roles. ReMIND provides a general framework for investigating computational creativity and demonstrates how modular LLM orchestration can bridge exploratory generation and coherent idea formation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReMIND框架，通过四个阶段（wake、dream、judge、rewake）将大语言模型（LLM）模块化编排，以实现可控的意外发现式创意构思。实验表明，新颖性增强可通过高温探索和评判筛选两阶段分离地涌现，不同LLM家族表现出不同的功能倾向。
Motivation: 现有LLM在创意构思中难以兼顾新颖性与一致性，高温采样虽促进原创性但牺牲了连贯性和有用性。
Method: 提出ReMIND框架：wake阶段低温生成稳定语义基线；dream阶段高温探索生成；judge阶段评估一致性并提取新颖想法；rewake阶段将选定想法整合为连贯输出。各阶段由独立LLM模块执行。
Result: 外部评估显示，新颖性增强可通过两个可分离阶段涌现：从wake到dream的高温探索，以及从dream到rewake的评判选择与整合。不同LLM家族展现出不同的功能倾向。
Conclusion: LLM中的意外发现式构思并非仅由单个模型属性决定，而是源于分配给特定认知角色的模型之间的交互。ReMIND为研究计算创造力提供了通用框架。

papers.title: GlyRAG: Context-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Blood Glucose Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Accurate blood glucose forecasting using continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) data can support the early prediction of dysglycemic risk. However, current neural-network-based forecasting models treat CGM data as a purely numerical sequence without integrating the contextual information contained in CGM signal morphology. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for time-series forecasting, yet their role as agentic context extractors in diabetes care remains largely unexplored. In this study, we bridge glucose forecasting and LLM-based contextualization by developing GlyRAG, a context-aware, retrieval-augmented forecasting framework that uses an LLM as a contextualization agent to summarize glucose morphology directly from a timed CGM window. The generated CGM-only narrative is embedded and fused with patch-based glucose representations, while a retrieval module incorporates similar historical training episodes through cross-attention. We evaluate GlyRAG on the OhioT1DM and AZT1D datasets for 5-, 30-, and 60-minute forecasting horizons. Compared with strong CGM-only baselines, GPT-4 GlyRAG significantly improves long-horizon root mean square error (RMSE) over PatchTST on both datasets. For example, RMSE decreases from 13.8 to 10.6 at 30 minutes and from 23.1 to 20.2 at 60 minutes on OhioT1DM. LLaMA 3.1 produces smaller but significant long-horizon gains, suggesting that the contextualization pipeline is not limited to GPT-4. Clinical error-grid analyses further show that approximately 85 percent of predictions fall within the clinically acceptable Clarke Error Grid Zones A and B. These results suggest that CGM-derived linguistic context and case-based retrieval can improve long-horizon glucose forecasting without requiring additional sensing modalities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GlyRAG，一种上下文感知的检索增强框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）从连续血糖监测（CGM）信号中提取形态语义，并与基于补丁的血糖表示融合，通过检索模块引入相似历史病例进行跨注意力融合。在 OhioT1DM 和 AZT1D 数据集上，GPT-4 驱动的 GlyRAG 在 30 分钟和 60 分钟预测窗口上显著优于 PatchTST 等基线，RMSE 分别降低约 3.2 和 2.9。CLarke 误差网格分析显示约 85% 预测落在临床可接受区 A 和 B。
Motivation: 现有血糖预测模型将 CGM 视为纯数值序列，忽略了信号形态中的上下文信息；LLM 在时间序列预测中已显潜力，但其作为糖尿病管理中的上下文提取器尚未被探索。
Method: 设计 GlyRAG 框架：使用 LLM 作为上下文代理，将固定时间窗口的 CGM 波形直接总结为文本描述，嵌入后与基于补丁的数值表示拼接；同时通过检索模块从历史训练集中选取相似片段，利用交叉注意力融合。
Result: 在 OhioT1DM 数据集上，GPT-4 GlyRAG 的 30 分钟 RMSE 从 13.8 降至 10.6，60 分钟从 23.1 降至 20.2；LLaMA 3.1 也带来显著提升。临床误差网格分析中约 85% 预测落在 Zone A 和 B。
Conclusion: 通过 CGM 信号的语言化描述和基于病例的检索，可以在不依赖额外感知模态的情况下改善长期血糖预测性能，且该上下文提取管线不限于 GPT-4。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-modal cross-domain mixed fusion model with dual disentanglement for fault diagnosis under unseen working conditions
papers.abstract_en: Intelligent fault diagnosis has become an indispensable technique for ensuring machinery reliability. However, existing methods suffer significant performance decline in real-world scenarios where models are tested under unseen working conditions, while domain adaptation approaches are limited to their reliance on target domain samples. Moreover, most existing studies rely on single-modal sensing signals, overlooking the complementary nature of multi-modal information for improving model generalization. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a multi-modal cross-domain mixed fusion model with dual disentanglement for fault diagnosis. A dual disentanglement framework is developed to decouple modality-invariant and modality-specific features, as well as domain-invariant and domain-specific representations, enabling both comprehensive multi-modal representation learning and robust domain generalization. A cross-domain mixed fusion strategy is designed to randomly mix modality information across domains for modality and domain diversity augmentation. Furthermore, a triple-modal fusion mechanism is introduced to adaptively integrate multi-modal heterogeneous information. Extensive experiments are conducted on induction motor fault diagnosis under both unseen constant and time-varying working conditions. The results demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms advanced methods and comprehensive ablation studies further verify the effectiveness of each proposed component and multi-modal fusion. The code is available at: https://github.com/xiapc1996/MMDG.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有故障诊断方法在未见工况下性能下降、依赖目标域样本且通常使用单模态信号的问题，提出了一种多模态跨域混合融合模型，包含双解耦框架（解耦模态不变/特定特征和域不变/特定特征）、跨域混合融合策略以及三模态融合机制。在感应电机故障诊断实验中，该方法在恒定和时变未见工况下均优于先进方法，消融实验验证了各模块的有效性。
Motivation: 现有智能故障诊断方法在未见工况下性能显著下降，领域自适应方法依赖目标域样本，且大多数研究仅使用单模态信号，忽略了多模态信息的互补性。
Method: 提出双解耦框架分离模态不变/特定特征和域不变/特定特征；设计跨域混合融合策略随机混合跨域模态信息以增强多样性；引入三模态融合机制自适应集成多模态异构信息。
Result: 在感应电机故障诊断的未见恒定和时变工况实验中，该方法持续优于先进方法，综合消融研究验证了各提出组件和多模态融合的有效性。
Conclusion: 本文提出的多模态跨域混合融合模型通过双解耦和跨域混合增强，实现了对未见工况的鲁棒故障诊断，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。
