papers.title: Symmetry Matters: Auditing and Symmetrizing 3D Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Symmetry is a strong prior present in many object categories, yet standard benchmarks for 3D generative models rarely report whether this prior is preserved. We study symmetry preservation in unconditional point cloud generation. We first audit the symmetry of generated shapes by several 3D generative models and compute a normalized symmetry score based on the Chamfer Distance (CD). We show that although current 3D generative models achieve competitive results under standard evaluation, they reveal a persistent symmetry gap when a symmetry-aware evaluation protocol is applied. To test whether this gap is merely inherited from the training data, we evaluate these models over a mirrored-objects dataset derived from ShapeNet and analyze symmetry dynamics during training. Mechanism-inspired diagnostic tests were conducted at the sampling and latent-representation levels to further show that reflection symmetry is not reliably encoded in the learned generative process. Finally, to address this gap, we propose a data-centric symmetry-based intervention: training generative models on a half-objects dataset and reconstructing full objects by reflection during sampling. Across multiple backbones, this intervention substantially improves geometric consistency and visual plausibility while remaining competitive under standard metrics. These findings suggest that symmetry-aware evaluation is needed alongside standard benchmarks, and future 3D generative models should incorporate this prior explicitly, either during training or sampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究无条件点云生成中的对称性保持问题。作者审计了多个3D生成模型，发现它们虽然基准测试表现良好，但在对称性评估中存在持续差距。通过从ShapeNet导出的镜像物体数据集测试、训练中的对称性动态分析、采样与潜在表示层面的诊断，表明反射对称性未被模型可靠编码。提出数据中心的对称性干预：在半个物体数据集上训练，采样时通过反射重建完整物体，在多个骨干网络上改善了几何一致性和视觉合理性。
Motivation: 标准3D生成基准很少报告对称性这一强先验是否被保持，而当前模型存在对称性差距，且该差距是否来自训练数据尚不明确。
Method: 审计多个无条件点云生成模型的对称性，使用基于Chamfer距离的归一化对称分数；提出在半个物体数据集上训练，采样时通过反射重建完整物体。
Result: 当前3D生成模型在标准评估下表现良好，但对称性评估中存在差距；提出的数据干预方法在多个骨干网络上显著提升几何一致性和视觉合理性，同时标准指标仍具竞争力。
Conclusion: 对称性感知评估应作为标准基准的补充，未来3D生成模型应在训练或采样中显式纳入对称性先验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: REGLUE Your Latents with Global and Local Semantics for Entangled Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Latent diffusion models (LDMs) achieve state-of-the-art image synthesis, yet their reconstruction-style denoising objective provides only indirect semantic supervision: high-level semantics emerge slowly, requiring longer training and limiting sample quality. Recent works inject semantics from Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) either externally via representation alignment or internally by jointly modeling only a narrow slice of VFM features inside the diffusion process, under-utilizing the rich, nonlinear, multi-layer spatial semantics available. We introduce REGLUE (Representation Entanglement with Global-Local Unified Encoding), a unified latent diffusion framework that jointly models (i) VAE image latents, (ii) compact local (patch-level) VFM semantics, and (iii) a global (image-level) [CLS] token within a single SiT backbone. A lightweight convolutional semantic compressor nonlinearly aggregates multi-layer VFM features into a low-dimensional, spatially structured representation, which is entangled with the VAE latents in the diffusion process. An external alignment loss further regularizes internal representations toward frozen VFM targets. On ImageNet 256x256, REGLUE consistently improves FID and accelerates convergence over SiT-B/2 and SiT-XL/2 baselines, as well as over REPA, ReDi, and REG. Extensive experiments show that (a) spatial VFM semantics are crucial, (b) non-linear compression is key to unlocking their full benefit, and (c) global tokens and external alignment act as complementary, lightweight enhancements within our global-local-latent joint modeling framework. The code is available at https://github.com/giorgospets/reglue .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 REGLUE，一种统一的潜在扩散框架，联合建模 VAE 图像潜在、局部 VFM 语义和全局 [CLS] 标记。通过轻量卷积语义压缩器非线性聚合多层 VFM 特征，并与 VAE 潜在纠缠在扩散过程中，外部对齐损失进一步正则化内部表示。在 ImageNet 256x256 上，REGLUE 改进了 FID 并加速收敛。
Motivation: 潜在扩散模型的去噪目标提供间接语义监督，高层语义出现缓慢，需要更长训练且限制样本质量。现有方法要么外部对齐，要么仅建模 VFM 特征的狭窄切片，未充分利用丰富的多层空间语义。
Method: 引入 REGLUE 框架，在单个 SiT 骨干中联合建模 VAE 图像潜在、局部 VFM 语义和全局 [CLS] 标记。使用轻量卷积语义压缩器非线性聚合多层 VFM 特征，与 VAE 潜在纠缠；外部对齐损失正则化内部表示。
Result: 在 ImageNet 256x256 上，REGLUE 一致改进 FID 并加速收敛，优于 SiT-B/2、SiT-XL/2 基线以及 REPA、ReDi、REG。
Conclusion: 实验表明空间 VFM 语义关键，非线性压缩解锁其全部优势，全局标记和外部对齐在全局-局部-潜在联合建模框架中作为互补轻量增强。

papers.title: Computing Evolutionarily Stable Strategies in Imperfect-Information Games
papers.abstract_en: We present an algorithm for computing evolutionarily stable strategies (ESSs) in symmetric perfect-recall extensive-form games of imperfect information. Our main algorithm is for two-player games, and we describe how it can be extended to multiplayer games. The algorithm is sound and computes all ESSs in nondegenerate games and a subset of them in degenerate games which contain an infinite continuum of symmetric Nash equilibria. The algorithm is anytime and can be stopped early to find one or more ESSs. We experiment on an imperfect-information cancer signaling game as well as random games to demonstrate scalability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种在不完美信息对称完美回忆扩展式博弈中计算演化稳定策略（ESS）的算法。该算法适用于两人博弈，可扩展至多人博弈，在非退化博弈中能计算所有ESS，在退化博弈中能计算一个子集。实验在癌症信号博弈和随机博弈上验证了可扩展性。
Motivation: 演化稳定策略是博弈论中重要的均衡概念，但现有方法主要针对完美信息或矩阵博弈，缺乏在不完美信息扩展式博弈中计算ESS的通用算法。
Method: 提出一种任意时间算法，基于对称完美回忆扩展式博弈的结构，通过求解一系列线性约束来枚举和验证ESS。
Result: 算法在非退化博弈中能计算所有ESS，在退化博弈中能计算部分ESS；在癌症信号博弈和随机博弈上展示了可扩展性。
Conclusion: 该算法首次为不完美信息扩展式博弈提供了计算ESS的通用方法，但退化博弈中可能无法完全枚举。

papers.title: Parallel Decoder Transformer: Planner-Conditioned Latent Coordination for Model-Intrinsic Parallel Generation
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive language models expose one causal token frontier, even when the requested document contains sections that could be developed concurrently. Existing parallel-generation systems arrange external branches around an otherwise unchanged model. We instead formulate model-intrinsic parallel generation: a single trained architecture owns multiple causal frontiers and produces one next-token distribution for each frontier in every synchronized decoding round. The Parallel Decoder Transformer (PDT) retains a frozen shared lower knowledge trunk and replaces the upper trunk with three independently parameterized physical decoder stacks. A prompt-time set planner produces three unordered continuous outlines, each hard-routed to one decoder as persistent Plan-KV memory, while a finite product-quantized notes bus carries block-delayed latent messages among the decoders. Autoregression is preserved within each lane; same-round lane tokens are conditionally independent given the source, plans, private histories, and previously committed messages. We specify source-grounded supervision for long-form historical exposition with single-owner cited facts and token-aligned cross-lane dependencies, a composite objective, a staged curriculum, and preregistered causal evaluations: plan swap and removal, delayed-message ablation, a parameter-matched self-only control, dependency-token likelihood, and blinded human fact audits. The architecture and evaluation pipeline are implemented; scientific training and held-out evaluation are in progress. This paper presents the theory, design, and falsifiable protocol, not a positive empirical result.
papers.comment: Note: Updated to reflect revised architecture
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并行解码器Transformer（PDT），一种模型内在的并行生成架构，允许单个训练好的模型拥有多个因果前沿，并在每个同步解码轮次为每个前沿生成一个下一词分布。PDT保留冻结的共享下层知识主干，替换上层为三个独立参数化的物理解码器堆栈，通过提示时间集规划器产生三个无序连续提纲，硬路由到每个解码器作为持久Plan-KV记忆，同时使用有限乘积量化笔记总线在解码器之间传递块延迟的潜在消息。论文呈现了理论、设计和可验证协议，目前架构已实现但科学训练和评估正在进行中，尚无正面实验结果。
Motivation: 现有自回归语言模型只能顺序生成，即使是可并行开发的文档部分也被迫串行处理，而现有的并行生成系统仅围绕模型外部安排分支，未能实现模型内在的并行。
Method: 提出PDT架构：冻结共享下层知识主干，用三个独立参数化的物理解码器堆栈替换上层；通过提示时间集规划器生成三个无序连续提纲，硬路由到对应解码器作为持久Plan-KV记忆；使用有限乘积量化笔记总线在解码器间传递延迟潜在消息；每条道内保持自回归，同轮道词符在给定源、计划、私有历史和先前提交消息的条件下条件独立；指定了源监督、复合目标、分阶段课程以及预注册因果评估。
Result: 架构和评估管道已实现，科学训练和独立评估正在进行中，本文未报告正面实验结果。
Conclusion: 本文呈现了并行解码的理论、设计和可验证协议，强调这是蓝图而非实证结果，旨在为后续研究提供可证伪的评估框架。

papers.title: When Generative Replay Meets Evolving Deepfakes: Dual Confusion-Aware Regularization for Incremental Face Forgery Detection
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of face generation techniques has introduced an increasing variety of forgery methods, making incremental deepfake detection essential for maintaining robust detectors. While generative replay provides a promising solution to alleviate catastrophic forgetting without storing historical data, its effectiveness is hindered by \textbf{domain confusion} between generated samples and real data. We observe that replay samples fall into two categories: when the replay generator closely resembles the newly introduced forgery model, generated real samples overlap with the fake domain and become \textbf{domain-risky}; when the generator differs significantly, generated samples maintain clearer domain separation and can be treated as \textbf{domain-safe}. To address this challenge, we propose a Dual \textbf{C}onfusion-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{RE}gularization strategy, termed \textbf{Dual-CARE}. A Domain-aware Confusion Score (DC Score) is introduced to quantify domain confusion and \textbf{dual-modulate} the optimization of both replay generators and the incremental detector. Guided by DC Score, replay generators are updated to better approximate previous-task distributions, while the detector adopts different supervision strategies: domain-safe samples are directly supervised, whereas domain-risky samples are regulated using a Relative Separation Loss to balance supervision and confusion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Dual-CARE effectively exploits generative replay and improves incremental deepfake detection under evolving forgery scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对增量深度伪造检测中生成重放（generative replay）导致的域混淆问题，提出双混淆感知正则化策略Dual-CARE。通过域感知混淆分数（DC Score）量化混淆程度，并双重调节重放生成器和增量检测器的优化。实验表明该方法在伪造技术不断演变的场景下有效提升了增量检测性能。
Motivation: 现有生成重放方法在增量伪造检测中面临域混淆问题：生成样本可能与新伪造域重叠（域风险样本）或保持清晰分离（域安全样本），导致重放效果受限。
Method: 提出Dual-CARE，包含DC Score用于量化域混淆，并据此对重放生成器和检测器进行双重调节：生成器更新以更好逼近旧任务分布，检测器对域安全样本直接监督、对域风险样本使用相对分离损失（Relative Separation Loss）平衡监督与混淆。
Result: 大量实验表明Dual-CARE能有效利用生成重放，在演变伪造场景下提升增量深度伪造检测性能。
Conclusion: 论文强调所提双混淆感知正则化方法能解决生成重放中的域混淆问题，为增量伪造检测提供新思路。

papers.title: DSBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating External and In-Cabin Risks
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show great promise for autonomous driving, but their suitability for safety-critical scenarios is largely unexplored, raising safety concerns. This issue arises from the lack of comprehensive benchmarks that assess both external environmental risks and in-cabin driving behavior safety simultaneously. To bridge this critical gap, we introduce DSBench, the first comprehensive Driving Safety Benchmark designed to assess a VLM's awareness of various safety risks in a unified manner. DSBench encompasses two major categories: external environmental risks and in-cabin driving behavior safety, divided into 10 key categories and a total of 28 sub-categories. This comprehensive evaluation covers a wide range of scenarios, ensuring a thorough assessment of VLMs' performance in safety-critical contexts. Extensive evaluations across various mainstream open-source and closed-source VLMs reveal significant performance degradation under complex safety-critical situations, highlighting urgent safety concerns. To address this, we constructed a large dataset of 98K instances focused on in-cabin and external safety scenarios, showing that fine-tuning on this dataset significantly enhances the safety performance of existing VLMs and paves the way for advancing autonomous driving technology. The benchmark toolkit, code, and model checkpoints will be publicly accessible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DSBench 是首个统一评估视觉语言模型在自动驾驶中对外部环境风险和车内行为安全感知能力的基准，涵盖 10 个主类别和 28 个子类别，并在 98K 实例数据集上微调显著提升安全性能。
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶基准缺乏同时评估外部环境风险和车内驾驶行为安全的方法，导致视觉语言模型在安全关键场景下的性能未知，存在安全隐患。
Method: 构建了包含外部环境风险和车内驾驶行为安全两大类别、10 个主类别和 28 个子类别的基准 DSBench，并收集 98K 实例数据集用于微调主流开源和闭源视觉语言模型。
Result: 主流视觉语言模型在复杂安全关键场景下性能显著下降，存在紧迫安全问题；在 DSBench 数据集上微调可显著提升安全性能。
Conclusion: DSBench 为评估和提升视觉语言模型在自动驾驶中的安全性提供了统一基准，微调方法有效缓解了安全风险。

papers.title: InertialAR: Autoregressive 3D Molecule Generation with Inertial Frames
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based autoregressive models have emerged as a unifying paradigm across modalities such as text and images, but their extension to 3D molecule generation remains underexplored. The gap stems from two fundamental challenges: (1) how to tokenize molecules into a canonical 1D sequence of tokens that is invariant to both SE(3) transformations and atom index permutations, and (2) how to design an architecture capable of modeling hybrid atom-based tokens that couple discrete atom types with continuous 3D coordinates. To address these challenges, we introduce InertialAR. It first performs generation-oriented canonical tokenization by aligning each molecule to a canonical inertial frame and reordering atoms, thereby converting arbitrary 3D structures into a unique, SE(3)- and permutation-invariant sequence of tokens for autoregressive generation. Built upon this canonical tokenization, we propose geometric positional encoding (GeoPE), which endows Transformer attention with 3D geometric awareness. Finally, InertialAR utilizes a hierarchical autoregressive paradigm to decode the next atom, consecutively predicting the atom type and 3D coordinates via Diffusion Loss. Experimentally, InertialAR achieves state-of-the-art performance on 8 of the 10 evaluation metrics for unconditional generation across QM9, GEOM-Drugs, and B3LYP. Moreover, it significantly outperforms baselines in controllable generation for targeted chemical functionality, attaining state-of-the-art results across all 5 metrics. Code is available at github.com/HaoruiLi46/InertialAR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InertialAR，一种用于3D分子生成的自回归模型。通过将分子对齐到规范惯性参考系并重新排序原子，实现SE(3)和置换不变的令牌化。引入几何位置编码（GeoPE）使Transformer注意机制感知3D几何。采用层次化自回归范式，通过扩散损失依次预测原子类型和3D坐标。在QM9、GEOM-Drugs和B3LYP数据集上的无条件生成8/10指标达到SOTA，可控生成5/5指标SOTA。
Motivation: 基于Transformer的自回归模型在文本和图像领域成功，但扩展到3D分子生成面临两个挑战：如何将分子令牌化为对SE(3)变换和原子索引置换不变的1D序列，以及如何设计能建模离散原子类型与连续3D坐标混合的架构。
Method: 提出生成导向的规范令牌化（对齐到规范惯性系并重排原子），几何位置编码（GeoPE），以及层次化自回归解码（先预测原子类型，再通过扩散损失预测坐标）。
Result: 在QM9、GEOM-Drugs、B3LYP数据集上，无条件生成8/10指标达到SOTA；可控生成5/5指标显著超越基线。
Conclusion: InertialAR通过规范惯性系令牌化、GeoPE和扩散损失实现了3D分子自回归生成，实验表明其在分子生成任务上具有优势。

papers.title: OmniX: From Unified Panoramic Generation and Perception to Graphics-Ready 3D Scenes
papers.abstract_en: There are two prevalent ways for automatic 3D scene construction: procedural generation and 2D lifting. Among these, panorama-based 2D lifting has emerged as a promising technique, leveraging powerful 2D generative priors to produce immersive, realistic, and diverse 3D environments. In this work, we advance this technique to generate graphics-ready 3D scenes suitable for physically based rendering (PBR), relighting, and simulation. Our key insight is to repurpose 2D generative models for panorama perception of geometry, textures, and PBR materials. Unlike existing 2D lifting approaches that emphasize appearance generation and neglect the perception of intrinsic properties, we present OmniX, a versatile and unified framework for panorama generation, perception, and completion. Built upon cross-modal adapter structure and cyclic spatial operators, OmniX effectively repurposes pre-trained 2D flow matching priors for joint modeling of multimodal, seamless equirectangular representations. Furthermore, we construct a large-scale synthetic panorama dataset comprising high-quality multimodal panoramas from diverse indoor and outdoor scenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of OmniX as a unified framework for panorama generation and perception across geometry, lighting, and semantics, enabling graphics-ready 3D scene generation and opening new possibilities for immersive and physically realistic virtual world creation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OmniX，一个统一框架，用于全景图生成、感知和补全，利用2D生成先验生成可用于物理渲染（PBR）、重新光照和仿真的图形就绪3D场景。关键是通过跨模态适配器和循环空间算子将预训练的2D流匹配先比重用于多模态无缝等矩形表示的联合建模。还构建了大规模合成全景数据集。实验表明其在几何、光照和语义上的全景图生成和感知方面的有效性和通用性。
Motivation: 现有2D提升方法强调外观生成而忽视内在属性（如几何、材质）的感知，缺乏能够同时处理生成和感知的统一框架。
Method: 提出OmniX框架，基于跨模态适配器结构和循环空间算子，将预训练的2D流匹配先比重用于多模态、无缝的等矩形表示的联合建模，包括全景图生成、感知和补全。
Result: 该方法能够生成图形就绪的3D场景，适用于PBR、重新光照和仿真，并在几何、光照和语义的全景图生成和感知上表现出有效性和通用性。
Conclusion: 该工作为创建沉浸式、物理真实的虚拟世界开辟了新可能性。

papers.title: BBOPlace-Bench: Benchmarking Black-Box Optimization for Chip Placement
papers.abstract_en: Chip placement is a vital stage in modern chip design, and black-box optimization (BBO) has been applied to it for decades. Early BBO efforts, however, were limited by immature problem formulations and inefficient algorithm designs, leading to worse efficiency, quality, and scalability than mainstream analytical methods. Recent advances in BBO have shown strong potential, but a unified, BBO-specific benchmark for thoroughly assessing various problem formulations and BBO algorithms is lacking. To fill this gap, we propose BBOPlace-Bench, the first benchmark tailored for evaluating and developing BBO algorithms for chip placement. It integrates three BBO problem formulations and offers a modular, flexible framework that enables users to seamlessly implement, test, and compare their own algorithms. It aggregates representative modern chip cases and standardizes their formats, providing uniform and comprehensive information to support BBO optimization. Moreover, it integrates representative BBO algorithm families, including simulated annealing, population-based search (including GA, CMA-ES, and PSO), and Bayesian optimization, and systematically evaluates their performance across different problem formulations using key chip-placement metrics. We position these experiments primarily as illustrative case studies under a shared evaluation protocol, including common benchmark instances, metric definitions, evaluation pipeline, and search budgets. Under this protocol, some BBO configurations (e.g., GA under the mask-guided optimization formulation) are competitive with representative analytical and reinforcement learning baselines. BBOPlace-Bench not only facilitates the development of efficient BBO-driven solutions for chip placement but also broadens the practical application scenarios urgently needed by the BBO community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BBOPlace-Bench，首个专门用于评估和开发芯片布局黑盒优化算法的基准。它集成了三种黑盒优化问题形式化，提供了模块化灵活框架，聚合了代表性现代芯片案例并标准化格式，集成了模拟退火、种群搜索（包括GA、CMA-ES和PSO）和贝叶斯优化等算法族，并在统一评估协议下系统比较了不同问题形式的性能。实验表明某些黑盒优化配置（如掩码引导优化下的GA）可与分析方法和强化学习基线竞争。
Motivation: 现有黑盒优化在芯片布局中的应用受限于不成熟的问题形式和低效算法设计，且缺乏统一的黑盒优化特定基准来全面评估不同问题形式和算法。
Method: 提出BBOPlace-Bench基准，集成三种问题形式化，提供模块化框架，聚合标准化芯片案例，集成多种黑盒优化算法族，并建立统一评估协议。
Result: 在统一协议下，某些配置（如掩码引导优化下的GA）与代表性分析方法和强化学习基线竞争。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出BBOPlace-Bench，首个专门用于评估和开发芯片布局黑盒优化算法的基准。它集成了三种黑盒优化问题形式化，提供了模块化灵活框架，聚合了代表性现代芯片案例并标准化格式，集成了模拟退火、种群搜索（包括GA、CMA-ES和PSO）和贝叶斯优化等算法族，并在统一评估协议下系统比较了不同问题形式的性能。实验表明某些黑盒优化配置（如掩码引导优化下的GA）可与分析方法和强化学习基线竞争。

papers.title: OmniMotion-X: Versatile Multimodal Whole-Body Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces OmniMotion-X, a versatile multimodal framework for whole-body human motion generation, leveraging an autoregressive diffusion transformer in a unified sequence-to-sequence manner. OmniMotion-X efficiently supports diverse multimodal tasks, including text-to-motion, music-to-dance, speech-to-gesture, and global spatial-temporal control scenarios (e.g., motion prediction, in-betweening, completion, and joint/trajectory-guided synthesis), as well as flexible combinations of these tasks. Specifically, we propose the use of reference motion as a novel conditioning signal, substantially enhancing the consistency of generated content, style, and temporal dynamics crucial for realistic animations. To handle multimodal conflicts, we introduce a progressive weak-to-strong mixed-condition training strategy. To enable high-quality multimodal training, we construct OmniMoCap-X, the largest unified multimodal motion dataset to date, integrating 28 publicly available MoCap sources across 10 distinct tasks, standardized to the SMPL-X format at 30 fps. To ensure detailed and consistent annotations, we render sequences into videos and use GPT-4o to automatically generate structured and hierarchical captions, capturing both low-level actions and high-level semantics. Extensive experimental evaluations confirm that OmniMotion-X significantly surpasses existing methods, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance across multiple multimodal tasks and enabling the interactive generation of realistic, coherent, and controllable long-duration motions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OmniMotion-X，一个基于自回归扩散Transformer的多模态全身人体运动生成统一框架，支持文本到动作、音乐到舞蹈、语音到手势等多种任务，以及全局时空控制如运动预测、插值、补全等。引入参考运动作为条件信号增强生成内容的一致性，并采用渐进式弱到强混合条件训练策略处理多模态冲突。构建了目前最大的统一多模态运动数据集OmniMoCap-X，整合28个公开MoCap源，使用GPT-4o自动生成结构化层次化字幕。实验表明该方法在多个任务上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有方法通常只针对单一任务或条件，缺乏统一框架处理多种多模态运动生成任务，且高质量多模态运动数据集不足。
Method: 提出自回归扩散Transformer序列到序列框架，支持参考运动作为新条件信号，采用渐进式弱到强混合条件训练策略以处理多模态冲突。构建OmniMoCap-X数据集，整合28个公开MoCap源并统一为SMPL-X格式，使用GPT-4o自动生成结构化层次化字幕。
Result: 在文本到动作、音乐到舞蹈、语音到手势等多个任务上显著超越现有方法，实现最先进性能，支持生成长时间连贯可控的运动。
Conclusion: 统一框架可有效处理多种多模态运动生成任务，参考运动条件增强了生成内容的一致性和可控性，数据集构建和自动标注方法为未来研究提供了资源。

papers.title: Interpret Policies in Deep Reinforcement Learning using SILVER with RL-Guided Labeling: A Model-level Approach to High-dimensional and Multi-action Environments
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) achieves remarkable performance but lacks interpretability, limiting trust in policy behavior. The existing SILVER framework (Li, Siddique, and Cao 2025) explains RL policy via Shapley-based regression but remains restricted to low-dimensional, binary-action domains. We propose SILVER with RL-guided labeling, an enhanced variant that extends SILVER to multi-action and high-dimensional environments by incorporating the RL policy's own action outputs into the boundary points identification. Our method first extracts compact feature representations from image observations, performs SHAP-based feature attribution, and then employs RL-guided labeling to generate behaviorally consistent boundary datasets. Surrogate models, such as decision trees and regression-based functions, are subsequently trained to interpret RL policy's decision structure. We evaluate the proposed framework on two Atari environments using three deep RL algorithms and conduct human-subject study to assess the clarity and trustworthiness of the derived interpretable policy. Results show that our approach maintains competitive task performance while substantially improving transparency and human understanding of agent behavior. This work advances explainable RL by transforming SILVER into a scalable and behavior-aware framework for interpreting deep RL agents in high-dimensional, multi-action settings.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SILVER with RL-guided labeling，将原本仅适用于低维二值动作域的SILVER可解释性框架扩展到高维多动作环境。方法通过提取图像特征、SHAP归因和RL引导标注生成边界数据集，再训练决策树等代理模型来理解强化学习策略。在Atari环境上的实验表明该方法在保持任务性能的同时提升了透明度和人类对智能体行为的理解。
Motivation: 现有深度强化学习缺乏可解释性，而SILVER框架局限于低维二值动作域，无法处理高维多动作环境。
Method: 从图像观测中提取紧凑特征表示，进行SHAP特征归因，然后利用RL策略自身的动作输出进行RL引导标注来生成行为一致的边界数据集，最后训练决策树或回归函数作为代理模型。
Result: 在多个Atari环境上使用三种深度RL算法评估，任务性能与原始策略相当，但显著提升了可解释性和人类理解度，并通过人类受试者研究验证了清晰度和可信度。
Conclusion: 本工作将SILVER扩展为可扩展且行为感知的框架，适用于高维多动作环境下的深度RL策略解释，推动了可解释强化学习的发展。

papers.title: Analysis of kinetic Langevin Monte Carlo under the stochastic exponential Euler discretization from underdamped all the way to overdamped
papers.abstract_en: Simulating the kinetic Langevin dynamics is a popular approach for sampling from distributions, where only their unnormalized densities are available. Various discretizations of the kinetic Langevin dynamics have been considered, where the resulting algorithm is collectively referred to as the kinetic Langevin Monte Carlo (KLMC) or underdamped Langevin Monte Carlo. Specifically, the stochastic exponential Euler discretization, or exponential integrator for short, has previously been studied under strongly log-concave and log-Lipschitz smooth potentials via the synchronous Wasserstein coupling strategy. Existing analyses, however, impose restrictions on the parameters that do not explain the behavior of KLMC under various choices of parameters. In particular, all known results fail to hold in the overdamped regime, suggesting that the exponential integrator degenerates in the overdamped limit. In this work, we revisit the synchronous Wasserstein coupling analysis of KLMC with the exponential integrator. Our refined analysis results in Wasserstein contractions and bounds on the asymptotic bias that hold under weaker restrictions on the parameters, which assert that the exponential integrator is capable of stably simulating the kinetic Langevin dynamics in the overdamped regime, as long as proper time acceleration is applied.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新分析了使用随机指数欧拉离散化（exponential integrator）的动能朗之万蒙特卡洛（KLMC）方法，针对强对数凹和对数Lipschitz光滑势能，改进了同步Wasserstein耦合分析。新的分析在更宽松的参数条件下证明了Wasserstein收缩和渐近偏差界，表明该离散化在过阻尼区域也能稳定模拟动能朗之万动力学，前提是应用适当的时间加速。
Motivation: 现有KLMC的指数积分器分析对参数施加了限制，无法解释过阻尼区域的行为，且已知结果在过阻尼极限下失效。
Method: 重新审视同步Wasserstein耦合分析，通过更精细的推导得到在更弱参数条件下的Wasserstein收缩和渐近偏差界。
Result: 获得了在更宽松参数限制下的Wasserstein收缩和渐近偏差界，证明指数积分器在过阻尼区域仍能稳定模拟。
Conclusion: 指数积分器的KLMC在过阻尼区域仍然有效，但需要适当的时间加速（time acceleration）。

papers.title: Is "Knowing It's Malicious Enough?" Evaluating LLMs for Fine-Grained Malware Behavior Auditing
papers.abstract_en: Automated malware classifiers achieve strong detection performance, but auditing requires more than flagging a sample: analysts must explain malicious behaviors and justify them with code evidence. Traditional signature-based methods and learning-based XAI often fail to provide such support in a human-interpretable form. Large Language Models (LLMs) appear promising, yet their reliability for malware auditing remains unclear. Evaluation faces three challenges: (1) the lack of human-written behavioral ground truth; (2) real-world codebases that exceed current context limits; and (3) the lack of reliable mechanisms to verify whether generated claims are grounded in code evidence. These obstacles make benchmarking difficult and leave model capabilities and failure modes opaque. We introduce MalEval, a diagnostic framework for measuring the capability boundaries of LLMs in malware auditing. MalEval pairs real-world application codebases with expert-written audit reports to provide fine-grained behavior-level ground truth. It compresses large codebases into behavior-relevant program contexts through a context-driven intermediate representation that preserves call relations. Expert reports and model outputs are mapped, via constrained reasoning, into structured evidence chains linking code-level facts to high-level behaviors in a shared space. MalEval decomposes auditing into four stage-wise tasks, enabling each intermediate judgment to be verified under limited context windows. We evaluate seven LLMs and find that they rely on surface cues rather than verifiable evidence, struggle to compose dispersed facts into coherent attack chains, and are highly sensitive to context formulation. These findings shift attention from isolated outputs to reliable LLM and agentic workflows for malware auditing. MalEval is publicly available at https://github.com/ZhengXR930/MalEval.git

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MalEval 诊断框架，用于评估大语言模型在恶意软件行为审计中的能力边界。MalEval 将真实应用代码库与专家编写的审计报告配对，提供细粒度的行为级别真实参考，并通过上下文驱动的中间表示压缩代码库，将专家报告与模型输出映射到结构化的证据链。对七个 LLM 的评估显示，模型依赖表面线索而非可验证证据，难以组合分散事实形成连贯攻击链，且对上下文表述高度敏感。
Motivation: 现有自动化恶意软件分类器检测性能强，但审计需要解释恶意行为并提供代码证据，传统方法和可解释性方法难以提供人类可理解的解释。LLM 虽具潜力，但其可靠性尚不明确，且面临缺乏行为级真实参考、代码库超上下文限制、无法验证生成声明是否基于代码证据等挑战。
Method: 提出 MalEval 框架，包含三部分：1) 真实应用代码库与专家审计报告配对获得细粒度行为真实参考；2) 通过上下文驱动的中间表示压缩大代码库，保留调用关系；3) 通过约束推理将专家报告和模型输出映射到共享的证据链空间。审计任务被分解为四个阶段，便于在有限上下文窗口中验证中间判断。
Result: 评估七个 LLM 后发现：模型依赖表面线索而非可验证证据，难以将分散事实组合成连贯攻击链，且对上下文表述高度敏感。
Conclusion: 这些发现将关注点从孤立输出转向可靠的 LLM 及基于代理的工作流用于恶意软件审计。MalEval 已开源。

papers.title: NIRVANA: Structured Pruning Reimagined for Large Language Model Compression
papers.abstract_en: While structured pruning presents a highly effective pathway for accelerating Large Language Model (LLM) inference, existing methods frequently suffer from significant performance degradation and demand computationally retraining to recover capabilities. To overcome these barriers, we present NIRVANA, a novel, hardware-aware structured pruning framework designed to preserve both zero-shot performance and the optimization landscape for downstream fine-tuning. Departing from traditional loss-based heuristics, our approach evaluates structural importance through a first-order function-space saliency inspired by the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK), effectively safeguarding the model's critical training dynamics. To prevent structural collapse at high compression rates, we introduce a global unit-ranking strategy coupled with an analytically derived allocation mechanism, which optimally balances the pruning aggressiveness between attention heads and MLP neurons. Furthermore, we eliminate the instability typically associated with random data sampling by employing a lightweight, KL-divergence-driven calibration data selection process. Extensive evaluations across Llama3, Qwen, and T5 architectures demonstrate that NIRVANA consistently establishes new state-of-the-art results on different benchmarks, providing a theoretically sound and practical approach to LLM compression. The code is available at https://github.com/iDEA-iSAIL-Lab-UIUC/NIRVANA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NIRVANA，一种硬件感知的结构化剪枝框架，用于大语言模型（LLM）压缩。核心思想是利用神经正切核（NTK）进行一阶函数空间显著性评估，以保护模型训练动态；通过全局单元排名和解析分配机制平衡注意力头与MLP神经元的剪枝力度；并采用KL散度驱动的校准数据选择消除随机采样不稳定性。在Llama3、Qwen和T5架构上，NIRVANA在多个基准测试中均取得了新的最优结果。
Motivation: 现有的结构化剪枝方法在LLM上常常导致显著的性能下降，并且需要昂贵的重新训练来恢复能力，亟需一种既能保持零样本性能又能保留下游微调优化空间的压缩方法。
Method: 提出NIRVANA框架：利用基于NTK的一阶函数空间显著性评估结构重要性；采用全局单元排序与解析分配机制，在注意力头和MLP神经元之间最优分配剪枝比例；并通过KL散度驱动的轻量级校准数据选择流程替代随机数据采样，提高稳定性。
Result: 在Llama3、Qwen和T5等架构上，NIRVANA在多个基准测试中一致地建立了新的最优结果。
Conclusion: NIRVANA为LLM压缩提供了一条理论上合理且实用的路径，兼顾了零样本性能和后续微调的优化前景。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有的结构化剪枝方法在LLM上常常导致显著的性能下降，并且需要昂贵的重新训练来恢复能力，亟需一种既能保持零样本性能又能保留下游微调优化空间的压缩方法。
summary_sections.method: 提出NIRVANA框架：利用基于NTK的一阶函数空间显著性评估结构重要性；采用全局单元排序与解析分配机制，在注意力头和MLP神经元之间最优分配剪枝比例；并通过KL散度驱动的轻量级校准数据选择流程替代随机数据采样，提高稳定性。
summary_sections.result: 在Llama3、Qwen和T5等架构上，NIRVANA在多个基准测试中一致地建立了新的最优结果。
summary_sections.conclusion: NIRVANA为LLM压缩提供了一条理论上合理且实用的路径，兼顾了零样本性能和后续微调的优化前景。

papers.title: Feedback-Enhanced Online Multiple Testing with Applications to Conformal Selection
papers.abstract_en: This work studies online multiple testing with feedback, where decisions are made sequentially, and the true state of the hypothesis is revealed after decisions are made, either instantly or with a delay, and under either full or bandit feedback. We propose Generalized alpha-investing with feedback (GAIF) along with its adaptive variants, a feedback-enhanced framework that dynamically adjusts thresholds using revealed outcomes, ensuring finite-sample false discovery rate (FDR)/marginal FDR (mFDR) control. We further extend GAIF to online conformal testing by constructing valid conformal $p$-values and developing feedback-enhanced testing rules with finite-sample mFDR control. We also propose a feedback-driven score selection criterion to adaptively choose the candidate score that is most effective for the testing procedure, together with a theoretical analysis of its optimality.} Numerical simulations and real-data applications demonstrate the effectiveness of our methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带反馈的在线多重假设检验，提出广义带反馈的α-投资（GAIF）及其自适应变体，在有限样本下控制FDR/mFDR。进一步扩展到在线共形检验，构建有效的共形p值并开发带反馈的检验规则。数值模拟和实际数据验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 在线多重检验中，决策顺序进行且真实状态在决策后揭示（立即或延迟，全反馈或 bandit 反馈），现有方法未能充分利用反馈信息来控制错误发现率。
Method: 提出GAIF框架，动态利用已揭示结果调整阈值；扩展到在线共形检验，构建共形p值并设计反馈增强的检验规则；提出反馈驱动的得分选择准则以自适应选择最有效的候选得分。
Result: 数值模拟和实际数据应用表明提出的方法能有效控制FDR/mFDR，并提升检验效率。
Conclusion: 所提出的反馈增强框架在多种反馈类型下均能保证有限样本错误控制，具有理论最优性保证。

papers.title: Implicit Actor Critic Coupling via a Supervised Learning Framework for RLVR
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) have empowered large language models (LLMs) to tackle challenging reasoning tasks such as mathematics and programming, however existing RLVR methods often suffer from sparse reward signals and unstable policy gradient updates inherent to RL-based approaches. To address the challenges, we propose PACS, a novel RLVR framework that achieves imPlicit Actor Critic coupling via a Supervised learning framework. By treating the outcome reward as a predictable label, we reformulate the RLVR problem into a supervised learning task over a score function parameterized by the policy model and optimized using cross-entropy loss. A detailed gradient analysis shows that this supervised formulation inherently recovers the classical policy gradient update while providing more stable and efficient training. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PACS significantly outperforms strong open-source models and RLVR baselines, yielding substantial average gains of +8.26% (4B) and +9.57% (8B) over base models offering a promising avenue for LLMs post-training with verifiable rewards. Our code and data are available as open source at https://github.com/ritzz-ai/PACS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出PACS框架，将RLVR问题转化为监督学习任务，通过将结果奖励视为可预测标签，使用交叉熵损失优化策略模型参数。梯度分析显示该监督形式恢复了经典策略梯度更新，同时训练更稳定高效。实验在4B和8B模型上分别取得平均+8.26%和+9.57%的增益，显著优于开源模型和RLVR基线。
Motivation: 现有RLVR方法面临稀疏奖励信号和策略梯度更新不稳定的问题。
Method: 提出PACS框架，通过将结果奖励作为可预测标签，将RLVR重新表述为对评分函数的监督学习任务，使用交叉熵损失优化。
Result: 在多个推理任务上，PACS在4B和8B模型上分别取得平均+8.26%和+9.57%的增益，显著优于开源模型和RLVR基线。
Conclusion: PACS为LLM后训练提供了有前景的途径，代码和数据已开源。

papers.title: Unsupervised Incremental Learning Using Confidence-Based Pseudo-Labels
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models have achieved state-of-the-art performance in many computer vision tasks. However, in real-world scenarios, novel classes that were unseen during training often emerge, requiring models to acquire new knowledge incrementally. Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) methods enable a model to learn novel classes while retaining knowledge of previous classes. However, these methods make the strong assumption that the incremental dataset is fully labeled, which is unrealistic in practice. In this work, we propose an unsupervised Incremental Learning method using Confidence-based Pseudo-labels (ICPL), which replaces human annotations with pseudo-labels, enabling incremental learning from unlabeled datasets. We integrate these pseudo-labels into various CIL methods with confidence-based selection and evaluate performance degradation on CIFAR100 and ImageNet100. Then, we compare our approach to popular Class Incremental Novel Category Discovery (class-iNCD) methods addressing similar challenges. Additionally, we apply our method to fine-grained datasets to demonstrate its real-world practicality and measure its computational complexity to validate its suitability for resource-constrained environments. ICPL achieves competitive results compared to supervised methods and outperforms state-of-the-art class-iNCD methods by more than 5% in final accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于置信度伪标签的无监督增量学习方法ICPL，用伪标签替代人工标注，使模型能从无标签数据中逐步学习新类别。在CIFAR100和ImageNet100上，ICPL与有监督方法性能相当，且比最先进的类增量新类别发现方法（class-iNCD）最终准确率高出超过5%。
Motivation: 现有类增量学习方法通常假设增量数据集有完整标注，这在实际中难以满足。本文旨在解决无标签数据下的增量学习问题。
Method: 利用基于置信度的伪标签选择策略，将伪标签集成到多种类增量学习方法（CIL）中，实现无监督增量学习。
Result: 在CIFAR100和ImageNet100上，ICPL取得与有监督方法竞争的性能，并超越当前最优class-iNCD方法超过5%的最终准确率。
Conclusion: 该方法在细粒度数据集上验证了实际可行性，并通过计算复杂度分析表明适用于资源受限环境。

papers.title: AI sustains higher strategic tension than humans in chess
papers.abstract_en: Strategic decision-making requires balancing immediate opportunities against long-term objectives: a tension fundamental to competitive environments. We investigate this trade-off in chess by analyzing the dynamics of human and AI gameplay through a network-based metric that quantifies piece-to-piece interactions. Our analysis reveals that elite AI players sustain substantially higher levels of strategic tension for longer durations than top human grandmasters. We find that cumulative tension scales with algorithmic complexity in AI systems and increases linearly with skill level (Elo rating) in human play. Longer time controls are associated with higher tension in human games, reflecting the additional strategic complexity players can manage with more thinking time. The temporal profiles reveal contrasting approaches: highly competitive AI systems tolerate densely interconnected positions that balance offensive and defensive tactics over extended periods, while human players systematically limit tension and game complexity. These differences have broader implications for understanding how artificial and biological systems navigate complex strategic environments and for the deployment of AI in high-stakes competitive scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过构建棋子间交互的网络指标，量化了国际象棋对局中的战略张力。研究发现，精英AI系统（如Stockfish等）比顶级人类特级大师维持显著更高水平的战略张力，且持续时间更长。累积张力随AI算法复杂度增加而升高，在人类对局中则随Elo等级线性增长。较长的思考时间与更高的人类张力相关，而AI则能持续处理高度互联、攻防并存的复杂局面。
Motivation: 战略决策需要平衡即时收益与长期目标，这种张力在竞争环境中至关重要。现有研究未系统比较AI与人类在国际象棋中战略张力的动态差异。
Method: 提出基于网络分析的度量，通过计算棋子间交互的密度和持续时间来量化每步棋的战略张力，并对比AI与人类对局的时间序列。
Result: 精英AI的峰值和平均张力均高于顶级人类；张力随AI算法复杂度（如搜索深度）和人类Elo等级线性增加；人类在更长时限下能维持更高张力，但仍低于AI的典型水平。
Conclusion: AI和人类在处理战略张力上存在根本差异：AI容忍甚至利用高密度互联局面，而人类系统性限制复杂性。这对理解生物与人工系统中的战略决策及高风险AI部署具有启示。

papers.title: LogicIF: Towards Complex Logic Instruction Following
papers.abstract_en: Instruction following has catalyzed the recent era of Large Language Models (LLMs) and is the foundational skill underpinning more advanced capabilities such as reasoning and agentic behaviors. As tasks grow more challenging, the logic structures embedded in natural language instructions becomes increasingly intricate. However, how well LLMs perform on such logic-rich instructions remains under-explored. We propose LogicIFGen and LogicIFEval. LogicIFGen is a scalable, automated framework for generating verifiable instructions from code functions, which can naturally express rich logic such as conditions, loops, and function calls. We further curate a collection of complex code functions and use LogicIFGen to construct LogicIFEval, a benchmark comprising 426 verifiable logic-rich instructions. Our experiments demonstrate that current state-of-the-art LLMs still struggle to correctly follow the instructions in LogicIFEval. Most LLMs can only follow fewer than 60% of the instructions, revealing significant deficiencies in the instruction-following ability. Code and Benchmark: https://github.com/mianzhang/LogicIF
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLM）在复杂逻辑指令跟随上的表现不足，提出LogicIFGen和LogicIFEval。LogicIFGen是从代码函数自动生成可验证指令的框架，能表达条件、循环和函数调用等逻辑；LogicIFEval是基于该框架构建的基准，包含426条可验证的逻辑丰富指令。实验表明，当前最先进的LLM在LogicIFEval上的指令跟随成功率低于60%，揭示了显著的能力缺陷。
Motivation: 现有研究对LLM在自然语言指令中嵌入的复杂逻辑结构下的表现探索不足，随着任务难度增加，逻辑结构日益复杂，评估这一能力变得重要。
Method: 提出可扩展的自动化框架LogicIFGen，从代码函数中生成可验证的指令，这些指令自然包含条件、循环和函数调用等逻辑；并基于该框架构建了包含426条指令的基准LogicIFEval。
Result: 实验显示，当前SOTA LLM在LogicIFEval上只能正确跟随不到60%的指令，表明指令跟随能力存在显著缺陷。
Conclusion: 摘要强调LLM在复杂逻辑指令跟随上的不足，并开源了相关代码和基准以促进后续研究。

papers.title: Symmetric Behavior Regularized Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Behavior Regularized Policy Optimization (BRPO) leverages asymmetric divergence regularization to mitigate distribution shift in offline reinforcement learning. This paper is the first to study the open question of symmetric BRPO. Using didactic examples, we show that symmetric regularization can outperform asymmetric regularization in addressing one-sided bias, near-boundary policy updates, and projection geometry consistency. However, symmetric divergences do not fit BRPO naturally: they do not permit a closed-form solution when used as regularizers, and can lead to numerical instability when used as optimization objectives. We first introduce a universal BRPO framework using an infinite series of Pearson-Vajda divergences to represent any $f$-divergence, which includes both symmetric and asymmetric divergences. We use a finite-series approximation to obtain the following results for symmetric BRPO: (1) a closed-form optimal policy expression; (2) a numerically stable optimization surrogate; and (3) a tight upper bound on the approximation quality. On the D4RL benchmark and in didactic examples, we show that the proposed method achieves consistently strong results and is robust to the number of terms in the approximation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次研究对称行为正则化策略优化（BRPO）问题，指出对称散度正则化在缓解单侧偏差、近边界策略更新和投影几何一致性方面优于非对称正则化，但对称散度缺乏闭式解且数值不稳定。作者提出通用BRPO框架，利用Pearson-Vajda散度的无穷级数表示任意f-散度，通过有限级数近似获得对称BRPO的闭式最优策略、数值稳定的优化代理以及近似质量的紧上界。在D4RL基准和教学示例上，该方法取得一致强结果，且对近似项数鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有BRPO仅使用非对称散度正则化，而对称正则化在理论上可能更优，但其无闭式解和数值不稳定性阻碍了应用。
Method: 引入Pearson-Vajda散度的无穷级数表示任意f-散度，采用有限级数近似，从而为对称BRPO导出闭式最优策略、稳定的优化代理和近似误差的紧上界。
Result: 在D4RL基准和教学示例上，所提方法取得一致强结果，且对级数项数选择鲁棒。
Conclusion: 对称BRPO通过级数近似有效解决了对称散度在BRPO中的适用性问题，实现了稳定优化并保持了良好性能。

summary_sections.method: 引入Pearson-Vajda散度的无穷级数表示任意f-散度，采用有限级数近似，从而为对称BRPO导出闭式最优策略、稳定的优化代理和近似误差的紧上界。
summary_sections.result: 在D4RL基准和教学示例上，所提方法取得一致强结果，且对级数项数选择鲁棒。
summary_sections.conclusion: 对称BRPO通过级数近似有效解决了对称散度在BRPO中的适用性问题，实现了稳定优化并保持了良好性能。

papers.title: MMGraphRAG: Bridging Vision and Language with Interpretable Multimodal Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) suffer from hallucinations due to their static parametric knowledge. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and GraphRAG mitigate this issue by incorporating external knowledge and structured reasoning over knowledge graphs (KGs). However, existing approaches remain largely text-centric, as constructing fine-grained multimodal knowledge graphs (MMKGs) with explicit cross-modal semantics remains challenging. In this paper, we propose MMGraphRAG, a framework for building interpretable MMKGs that unify textual and visual knowledge. Our approach represents visual content as structured scene graphs and integrates them with textual KGs through a novel cross-modal entity linking method, SpecLink, which leverages spectral clustering to jointly model semantic similarity and graph structure. This design preserves explicit entities, relations, and reasoning paths across modalities, enabling structure-aware retrieval and generation. To support evaluation, we introduce the CMEL dataset, a benchmark for fine-grained cross-modal entity alignment. Experimental results on CMEL demonstrate improved entity linking accuracy, while evaluations on DocBench and MMLongBench show that MMGraphRAG achieves superior performance and stronger robustness, particularly in complex multimodal reasoning scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MMGraphRAG，一个构建可解释多模态知识图谱（MMKG）的框架，通过场景图表示视觉内容，并利用谱聚类方法SpecLink实现跨模态实体链接，统一文本与视觉知识。实验在CMEL数据集上展示了改进的实体链接精度，在DocBench和MMLongBench上表现出优越的性能和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有多模态知识图谱难以构建细粒度的跨模态语义链接，导致RAG和GraphRAG方法仍以文本为中心，缺乏结构化的视觉知识表示和推理。
Method: 提出MMGraphRAG框架：将视觉内容表示为结构化场景图，并通过SpecLink（基于谱聚类的跨模态实体链接方法）联合建模语义相似性和图结构，实现文本KG与视觉KG的统一。
Result: 在CMEL数据集上实体链接精度提升；在DocBench和MMLongBench上，MMGraphRAG在复杂多模态推理场景中取得更优性能和更强的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: MMGraphRAG通过显式保留跨模态的实体、关系和推理路径，实现了结构感知的检索与生成，为多模态知识推理提供了可解释的方案。

papers.title: LEGO Co-builder: Exploring Fine-Grained Vision-Language Modeling for Multimodal LEGO Assembly Assistants
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are facing the challenges of understanding and following multimodal assembly instructions, particularly when fine-grained spatial reasoning and precise object state detection are required. In this work, we explore LEGO Co-builder, a hybrid benchmark combining real-world LEGO assembly logic with programmatically generated multimodal scenes. The dataset captures stepwise visual states and procedural instructions, allowing controlled evaluation of instruction-following, object detection, and state detection. We introduce a unified framework and assess leading VLMs such as GPT-4o, Gemini, and Qwen-VL, under zero-shot and fine-tuned settings. We also evaluated the framework using a reasoning-focused model, GLM-4.1-thinking. Our results show that while object detection achieved high performance (98.16% with fine-tuned InstructBLIP), fine-grained scene understanding and assembly state detection remain challenging: Fine-tuned MiniGPT-v2 reached only 37.52% F1 for identifying theme entities, and even advanced models such as GPT-4o achieved just 40.54% F1 on state detection. This highlights gaps in fine-grained visual understanding among existing models. We release the benchmark, codebase, and generation pipeline to support future research on multimodal assembly assistants grounded in real-world workflows.
papers.comment: This version has been accepted by ICMI 2026 Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了LEGO Co-builder，一个结合真实乐高组装逻辑与程序生成场景的多模态基准测试，用于评估视觉语言模型在细粒度空间推理和状态检测方面的能力。评估了GPT-4o、Gemini、Qwen-VL等模型，发现物体检测准确率很高（98.16%），但细粒度场景理解和组装状态检测仍具挑战（如主题实体识别F1仅37.52%）。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在处理多模态组装指令时，缺乏对细粒度空间推理和精确物体状态检测的能力，缺少相应的基准测试。
Method: 提出LEGO Co-builder基准测试，包含真实乐高组装逻辑与程序生成场景，提供逐步视觉状态和程序指令。构建统一评估框架，在零样本和微调设置下评估多种模型。
Result: 物体检测方面，微调后的InstructBLIP达到98.16%准确率。但细粒度理解方面，微调MiniGPT-v2的主题实体识别F1仅37.52%，GPT-4o的状态检测F1仅40.54%，表明现有模型存在差距。
Conclusion: 强调了细粒度视觉理解的不足，并发布了基准测试、代码和生成流程以支持未来研究。

papers.title: PI-H2T: Enhancing Long-Tailed Visual Recognition with Permutation-Invariant and Head-to-Tail Feature Fusion
papers.abstract_en: The imbalanced distribution of long-tailed data presents a significant challenge for deep learning models, causing them to prioritize head classes while neglecting tail classes. Two key factors contributing to low recognition accuracy are the deformed representation space and a biased classifier, stemming from insufficient semantic information in tail classes. To address these issues, we propose permutation-invariant and head-to-tail feature fusion (PI-H2T), a highly adaptable method. PI-H2T enhances the representation space through permutation-invariant representation fusion (PIF), yielding more clustered features and automatic class margins. Additionally, it adjusts the biased classifier by transferring semantic information from head to tail classes via head-to-tail fusion (H2TF), improving tail class diversity. Theoretical analysis and experiments show that PI-H2T optimizes both the representation space and decision boundaries. Its plug-and-play design ensures seamless integration into existing methods, providing a straightforward path to further performance improvements. Extensive experiments on long-tailed benchmarks confirm the effectiveness of PI-H2T.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对长尾数据中头部类主导、尾部类识别率低的问题，提出一种即插即用的置换不变与头到尾特征融合方法PI-H2T。通过置换不变表示融合（PIF）优化特征空间，使特征更聚集；通过头到尾融合（H2TF）将头部类语义信息迁移至尾部类，增强尾部类多样性。理论分析与实验验证了该方法在长尾基准上的有效性。
Motivation: 长尾数据导致表示空间变形和分类器偏差，尾部类语义信息不足是识别精度低的关键原因。现有方法难以同时优化表示空间和决策边界。
Method: 提出PI-H2T，包含两个模块：置换不变表示融合（PIF）增强特征聚拢性并自动产生类间间隔；头到尾融合（H2TF）通过迁移头部类语义信息提升尾部类多样性。采用即插即用设计，可无缝集成已有方法。
Result: 在多个长尾基准数据集上验证有效性，具体数值见原论文。
Conclusion: PI-H2T能同时优化表示空间和决策边界，且即插即用的特性使其易于集成到现有方案中，进一步提升性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Data Balancing Strategies: A Systematic Survey of Resampling and Augmentation Methods
papers.abstract_en: Imbalanced datasets, where one class significantly outnumbers others, remain a persistent challenge in machine learning, often biasing predictions toward the majority class and degrading classifier performance. This paper provides a comprehensive, systematic review of data balancing methods, extending beyond foundational oversampling techniques such as the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE) and its variants (e.g., Borderline SMOTE, K-Means SMOTE, and Safe-Level SMOTE) to encompass advanced adaptive methods (MWMOTE, AMDO), deep generative models (generative adversarial networks, variational autoencoders, and diffusion models), undersampling techniques (NearMiss, Tomek Links), combination/hybrid methods (SMOTE-ENN, SMOTE-Tomek, and SMOTE+OCSVM), ensemble strategies (SMOTEBoost, RUSBoost, Balanced Random Forest, and One-Sided Selection), and specialized approaches for multi-label and clustered data. Beyond descriptive categorization, this review critically examines each method's underlying assumptions, operational mechanisms, and suitability for diverse data characteristics, including high dimensionality, mixed feature types, class overlap, and noise. Key findings demonstrate that no single method universally outperforms others; optimal selection depends critically on dataset characteristics, classifier choice, and evaluation metrics. The paper concludes by identifying emerging research directions, including self-supervised learning for imbalance, diffusion-based generative oversampling, distribution-preserving resampling, knowledge distillation for imbalanced deployment, and the adaptation of foundation models to skewed distributions, offering practical guidelines for practitioners and a roadmap for future methodological development.
papers.journal_ref: Machine Learning and Knowledge Extraction, 2026, 8(7), 211; https://www.mdpi.com/2504-4990/8/7/211
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对数据不平衡问题中的重采样与增强方法进行了系统性综述，覆盖了从经典SMOTE及其变体、自适应方法、深度生成模型（GAN、VAE、扩散模型）、欠采样技术、混合方法、集成策略到多标签与聚类数据专用方法。通过批判性分析各方法的假设、机制与适用场景，发现没有通用最优方法，选择取决于数据集特征、分类器与评估指标。最后指出了自监督学习、扩散生成过采样、分布保持重采样等未来方向。
Motivation: 不平衡数据集持续影响机器学习性能，现有方法缺乏系统比较与指导，导致实际应用中选择困难。
Method: 采用系统性综述方法，对各类重采样与增强方法进行归类、描述与批判性分析，涵盖SMOTE变体、自适应方法、深度生成模型、欠采样、混合、集成及多标签/聚类方法。
Result: 关键发现是没有任何单一方法能在所有场景下最优；方法选择高度依赖数据集特征（如高维、混合特征、类重叠、噪声）、分类器与评估指标。
Conclusion: 本文为实践者提供方法选择指南，并指出自监督学习、扩散生成过采样、分布保持重采样、知识蒸馏及基础模型适应等未来研究方向。

papers.title: Potential failures of physics-informed machine learning in traffic flow modeling: theoretical and experimental analysis
papers.abstract_en: This study investigates why physics-informed machine learning (PIML) can fail in macroscopic traffic flow modeling. We define failure as cases where a PIML model underperforms both purely data-driven and purely physics-based baselines by a given threshold. Unlike in other fields, physics residuals themselves do not hinder optimization in this setting. Instead, effective updates require both data and physics gradients to form acute angles with the true gradient, a condition difficult to satisfy with low-resolution loop data. In such cases, neural networks cannot accurately approximate density and speed, and the constructed physics residuals, already degraded by discrete sampling and temporal averaging, lose their ability to capture PDE dynamics, which directly leads to PIML failure. Theoretically, although LWR and ARZ solutions are weak solutions, for piecewise $C^k$ initial data they remain $C^k$ off the shock set under mild conditions, which has Lebesgue measure zero. Thus, almost all detector or collocation points lie in smooth regions where residuals are valid, and the MLP's inability to exactly represent discontinuities is immaterial. Finally, we establish MSE lower bounds of physics residuals: higher-order models such as ARZ have strictly larger consistency error bounds than LWR under mild conditions. This explains why LWR-based PIML can outperform ARZ-based PIML even with high-resolution data, with the gap shrinking as resolution increases, consistent with prior empirical findings.
papers.comment: Some errors about the error bound proofness
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论和实验角度分析物理信息机器学习（PIML）在宏观交通流建模中的失败原因。研究发现，失败并非由物理残差本身导致，而是由于低分辨率环路数据下数据梯度和物理梯度难以与真实梯度形成锐角，且离散采样和时间平均降低了物理残差捕捉偏微分方程动力学的能力。理论分析表明，在光滑区域残差有效，而多层感知器无法精确表示间断点无关紧要；同时，高阶模型（如ARZ）的一致性误差下界严格大于低阶模型（如LWR），解释了高分辨率数据下LWR-PIML优于ARZ-PIML的现象。
Motivation: 现有PIML方法虽在多个领域成功，但在宏观交通流建模中可能表现不佳，甚至不如纯数据驱动或纯物理方法，其背后机理尚未被充分理解。
Method: 通过定义PIML失败阈值，分析数据梯度和物理梯度方向与真实梯度的夹角条件，并结合LWR和ARZ模型的弱解性质及残差误差下界，从理论上解释失败原因。
Result: 摘要报告了理论结果：低分辨率数据下梯度条件难以满足，导致PIML失败；高阶模型（ARZ）的物理残差一致性误差下界严格大于低阶模型（LWR），且该差距随分辨率增加而缩小。
Conclusion: 摘要强调PIML在交通流中的失败源于数据分辨率和模型阶数导致的梯度与误差特性，而非传统认为的物理残差优化困难。

papers.title: Improving Diffusion Generative Models via Truncated Karhunen--Loève Expansion
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained diffusion models exhibit a well-known training-sampling mismatch, often attributed to exposure bias and related distribution-shift effects. We provide a quantitative interpretation of this phenomenon through the notion of an effective noise level: empirically, a pretrained denoiser behaves as if trained at a noise level slightly below the nominal schedule. Motivated by this observation, we introduce a training-free sampling strategy based on truncating the Karhunen--Loève (KL) expansion of the Brownian motion driving the forward stochastic differential equation. Truncation yields a finite-dimensional forward process with a reduced noise level that can be adjusted independently of the time discretization. We prove uniform convergence of the truncated process to the original diffusion. To explain the resulting behaviour, we analyse a toy model in which the denoiser is exact but operates at a reduced effective noise level. The analysis predicts a non-monotone response to the sampling noise with a unique interior optimum, located by a one-dimensional sweep over the truncation order. We implement the approach through corresponding truncated reverse-time and probability-flow equations, without modifying the network architecture. Across CIFAR-10, CelebA, ImageNet, and latent-space Stable Diffusion, the truncation order consistently reveals a sweet spot, improving pretrained models in nearly all tested configurations. Training from scratch at a matched truncation order makes that order the network's own sweet spot, accelerates convergence by about $2.8\times$, and lowers the generation error on CIFAR-10 (Fréchet Inception Distance 7.14 to 5.47 at matched epochs; best checkpoint 6.74 to 5.23). A Lévy--Ciesielski comparison confirms that finite expansion is broadly beneficial.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现预训练扩散模型的训练-采样不匹配可归因于有效噪声水平低于名义调度。作者提出一种基于截断布朗运动KL展开的免训练采样策略，通过调整截断阶数降低噪声水平，并证明截断过程的均匀收敛性。在CIFAR-10、CelebA、ImageNet和潜空间Stable Diffusion上，截断阶数存在最优值，显著提升预训练模型性能；从头训练时加速约2.8倍，CIFAR-10的FID从7.14降至5.47。
Motivation: 扩散模型的训练-采样不匹配（如曝光偏差）缺乏定量解释，现有方法需要修改网络或重新训练。
Method: 通过截断Brownian motion的Karhunen–Loève展开，构造有限维前向过程，其有效噪声水平可独立于时间离散化调整，并推导对应的截断反向时间与概率流方程。
Result: 在CIFAR-10上，截断阶数最优时预训练模型FID改善（7.14→5.47），从头训练加速2.8倍；ImageNet和Stable Diffusion上同样存在最优截断阶数。
Conclusion: KL展开截断是一种通用、免训练且有效的扩散模型改进方法，能系统性地缓解训练-采样不匹配，且截断阶数可作为网络本身的超参数。

papers.title: ExMAG: Learning of Maximally Ancestral Graphs
papers.abstract_en: In mixed graphs, there are both directed and bidirected edges. An extension of acyclicity to this mixed-graph setting is known as maximally ancestral graphs. This extension is of considerable interest in causal learning in the presence of confounders. There, directed edges represent a clear direction of causality, while bidirected edges represent confounding. We propose a branch-and-cut algorithm for learning maximally ancestral graphs using a formulation as a mixed-integer quadratic program. Empirically, our method achieves comparable or improved reconstruction quality while requiring an order of magnitude fewer samples than state-of-the-art approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于学习最大祖先图（Maximally Ancestral Graphs, MxAGs）的分支定界算法，将其建模为混合整数二次规划，在因果发现中处理混杂变量。实验表明，该方法在重建质量上与现有方法相当或更优，且所需样本量减少一个数量级。
Motivation: 因果学习中存在混杂变量时，有向无环图（DAG）不足以建模潜在混杂，需要扩展到混合图；现有方法样本效率较低，需更高效的算法。
Method: 提出分支定界算法，将学习MxAGs问题转化为混合整数二次规划（MIQP），通过分支定界优化求解。
Result: 该方法在重建质量上达到或超过现有技术水平，且所需样本量比现有方法少一个数量级。
Conclusion: 所提算法能有效学习MxAGs，在样本效率上具有显著优势，可应用于存在混杂的因果发现。

papers.title: Supervised Reward Inference
papers.abstract_en: Existing approaches to reward inference typically assume that humans provide demonstrations according to specific behavior models. However, humans often indicate their goals through a wide range of behaviors, from actions that are suboptimal due to poor planning or execution to behaviors intended to communicate goals rather than achieve them. One existing solution for inferring rewards from such behavior $\unicode{x2013}$ provided it is drawn from the same distribution at training and deployment $\unicode{x2013}$ is to construct a dataset of behavior paired with known rewards, and to learn the mapping from behavior to rewards; however, prior methods in this family face notable limitations, such as restrictions to tabular settings. Given such a dataset, we propose instead that supervised learning offers a parsimonious yet powerful solution, which we term Supervised Reward Inference (SRI). Theoretically, we prove that SRI is asymptotically Bayes-optimal under standard assumptions. Empirically, SRI achieves near-ceiling performance on a prior benchmark for reward inference from suboptimal behavior, while on Meta-World robotics tasks, it infers rewards from even arbitrarily suboptimal demonstrations as accurately as those demonstrations allow. Finally, we demonstrate our framework's universality with straightforward generalizations to action- and goal-prediction.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 8 figures. Updated with public code link
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出监督奖励推断（Supervised Reward Inference, SRI），利用监督学习从行为-奖励配对数据中学习行为到奖励的映射。理论证明SRI在标准假设下渐近贝叶斯最优；实验在次优行为基准和Meta-World机器人任务上达到接近天花板性能，且能从任意次优演示中准确推断奖励。方法还泛化到动作和目标预测。
Motivation: 现有奖励推断方法常假定人类演示遵循特定行为模型，但真实人类行为多样（次优、沟通性等），导致推断困难。同时，现有从行为-奖励配对学习的方法局限于表格设置。
Method: 提出监督奖励推断（SRI），直接使用监督学习从行为-奖励配对数据集学习行为到奖励的函数映射，不依赖特定行为模型。
Result: 在先前次优行为基准上SRI达到接近天花板性能；在Meta-World机器人任务上，能从任意次优演示中准确推断奖励，达到了演示允许的精度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调SRI是简洁且强大的解决方案，可处理多样的人类行为，并且理论上是渐近最优的。方法可泛化到动作和目标任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BADTV: Unveiling Backdoor Threats in Third-Party Task Vectors
papers.abstract_en: Task arithmetic in large-scale pre-trained models enables agile adaptation to diverse downstream tasks without extensive retraining. By leveraging task vectors (TVs), users can perform modular updates through simple arithmetic operations like addition and subtraction. Yet, this flexibility presents new security challenges. In this paper, we investigate how TVs are vulnerable to backdoor attacks, revealing how malicious actors can exploit them to compromise model integrity. By creating composite backdoors that are designed asymmetrically, we introduce BadTV, a backdoor attack specifically crafted to remain effective simultaneously under task learning, forgetting, and analogy operations. Extensive experiments show that BadTV achieves near-perfect attack success rates across diverse scenarios, posing a serious threat to models relying on task arithmetic. We also evaluate current defenses, finding they fail to detect or mitigate BadTV. Our results highlight the urgent need for robust countermeasures to secure TVs in real-world deployments.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted to the ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security (ACM CCS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究第三方任务向量（TV）中的后门威胁，提出BADTV攻击方法。该方法利用非对称设计的复合后门，能够在任务学习、遗忘和类比操作下同时保持高攻击成功率。大量实验表明BADTV在各种场景下达到近乎完美的攻击成功率，且现有防御措施无法检测或缓解，凸显了开发鲁棒反制措施的紧迫性。
Motivation: 任务向量使得大规模预训练模型能够灵活适应下游任务，但这种灵活性带来了新的安全挑战，现有工作未充分研究任务向量遭受后门攻击的脆弱性。
Method: 提出BADTV，一种非对称设计的复合后门攻击，专门针对任务算术中的学习、遗忘和类比操作，确保后门在不同任务操作下均有效。
Result: 实验显示BADTV在多种场景下达到近乎完美的攻击成功率，现有防御技术（如检测或缓解）均无法有效应对。
Conclusion: 必须开发针对任务向量的鲁棒防御措施，以保障实际部署中的模型安全。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Illusion-Illusion: Vision Language Models See Illusions Where There Are None
papers.abstract_en: Illusions are entertaining, but they are also a useful diagnostic tool in cognitive science, philosophy, and neuroscience. A typical illusion shows a gap between how something `really is' and how something `appears to be', and this gap helps us understand the mental processing that led to how something appears to be. Illusions are also useful for investigating artificial systems, and much research has examined whether computational models of perception fall prey to the same illusions as people. Here, I invert the standard use of perceptual illusions to examine basic processing errors in current vision language models. I present these models with illusory-illusions, neighbors of common illusions that should not elicit processing errors. These include such things as perfectly reasonable ducks, crooked lines that truly are crooked, circles that seem to have different sizes because they are, in fact, of different sizes, and so on. I show that many current vision language systems mistakenly see these illusion-illusions as illusions. I suggest that such failures are part of broader failures already discussed in the literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文反向使用错觉作为诊断工具，考察当前视觉语言模型（VLM）在非错觉图像上的处理错误。作者向模型呈现“错觉的错觉”——常见的错觉图像变体，这些变体本身不应引发错觉（如真实弯曲的线条、实际大小不同的圆等），发现许多VLM错误地将它们识别为错觉，并将其归因于文献中已讨论的模型更广泛的失败。
Motivation: 传统上，错觉被用于理解人类和人工系统的感知处理。本文反转这一用途，旨在通过探测模型对非错觉图像的错误响应，揭示视觉语言模型的基础处理缺陷。
Method: 构造“错觉的错觉”刺激集，包括正常鸭子、真正弯曲的线条、实际大小不同的圆等，这些图像是常见错觉的邻域但不应产生错觉，然后测试多个当前视觉语言模型的响应。
Result: 摘要显示，许多当前视觉语言模型错误地将这些非错觉图像视为错觉。
Conclusion: 作者认为这种失败是文献中已讨论的更广泛模型缺陷的一部分，暗示当前VLM在基本视觉推理上存在系统性不足。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Distributed solar generation forecasting using attention-based deep neural networks for cloud movement prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate forecasts of distributed solar generation are necessary to maintain grid stability amid the increased uptake of distributed solar photovoltaic (PV) systems. However, the high variability of solar generation over short time intervals (seconds to minutes) caused by cloud movement makes this forecasting task difficult. To address this, using cloud images, which capture the second-to-second changes in cloud cover affecting solar generation, has shown promise. Recently, deep neural networks with attention that focus on important regions of an image have been applied with success in many computer vision applications. However, whether such methods provide meaningful benefits for cloud movement forecasting, and how such improvements propagate through to downstream solar generation forecasting accuracy, remains under-explored. In this study, we conduct a large-scale empirical investigation of the impact of attention-based cloud forecasting on solar generation forecasting, addressing a gap that has been overlooked in the literature. To this end, we develop a pipeline that incorporates an attention-enhanced convolutional long short-term memory network and an existing self-attention-based video prediction method to forecast cloud movement using satellite imagery. The effectiveness of the resulting cloud forecasts is evaluated through their downstream impact on solar forecasting across 50 PV sites in Australia. We further provide insights into the cloud conditions under which attention-based cloud forecasting methods yield the most significant improvements in downstream solar forecasting accuracy. We find that for clouds at high altitudes, the cloud predictions obtained using attention-based methods result in solar forecast skill score improvements of 5.86% or more compared to non-attention-based methods.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the Energy journal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究利用注意力机制的深度神经网络预测云运动，以提升分布式太阳能发电的短期预报精度。作者构建了一个包含注意力增强卷积长短期记忆网络和自注意力视频预测方法的流水线，通过卫星图像预测云运动，并在澳大利亚50个光伏站点评估下游太阳能预报效果。实验表明，对于高空云，注意力方法可将太阳能预报技能评分提升5.86%以上。
Motivation: 分布式太阳能发电因云层运动导致短时间（秒到分钟）的高波动性，现有方法对注意力机制在云运动预测及下游太阳能预测中的贡献缺乏大规模实证研究。
Method: 提出一种流水线，结合注意力增强的卷积长短期记忆网络和现有自注意力视频预测方法，利用卫星图像预测云运动，并评估其对太阳能预测的影响。
Result: 注意力方法在高空云条件下可将太阳能预测技能评分提升5.86%以上（与无注意力方法相比）。
Conclusion: 注意力机制能有效改善云运动预测，进而提升分布式太阳能发电的短期预报精度，尤其在特定云类型下收益显著。
Relevance: 60

papers.title: Gradient Span Algorithms Make Predictable Progress in High Dimension
papers.abstract_en: We prove that all 'gradient span algorithms' have asymptotically deterministic behavior on scaled Gaussian random functions as the dimension tends to infinity. This is a functional generalization of similar results for random quadratic functions and spin glasses. They explain the counterintuitive phenomenon that different training runs of many large machine learning models result in approximately equal cost curves despite random initialization on a complicated non-convex landscape. This 'predictable progress' phenomenon is exploited by the AutoML community: Since the optimization progress of a single run is already representative, multiple retries with the same hyperparameters are not necessary.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明在高斯随机函数上，梯度跨度算法（gradient span algorithms）在高维极限下具有渐近确定性行为。这推广了随机二次函数和自旋玻璃的类似结果，解释了大型机器学习模型多次随机初始化训练后成本曲线近似相同的现象。该可预测进展被AutoML社区利用，因为单次运行即可代表优化进展。
Motivation: 大型机器学习模型在非凸损失函数上随机初始化多次训练，结果成本曲线却惊人地相似，这一反直觉现象缺乏理论解释。作者旨在从数学上阐明这种可预测进展的成因。
Method: 通过概率论与随机过程方法，在缩放高斯随机函数上分析梯度跨度算法的渐近行为，并推广到更一般的随机函数类。
Result: 严格证明了梯度跨度算法在维数趋于无穷时的渐近确定性，即不同随机初始化下的优化轨迹几乎必然收敛到同一成本曲线。
Conclusion: 论文为机器学习训练中的可预测进展提供了严格的数学基础，揭示了随机初始化在非凸优化中并不导致随机结果，而是产生确定性进展。该结论支持AutoML中无需重复调参的实践。

papers.title: Online-Score-Aided Federated Learning for Resource-Constrained Wireless Clients with Continual Data Arrival
papers.abstract_en: Heterogeneous system configurations of distributed clients connected to the central server (CS) via a time-varying wireless network pose significant challenges for popular distributed machine learning (ML) algorithms such as federated learning (FL). Although the limited (radio and computational) resources are widely acknowledged, two critical yet often ignored aspects are (a) client devices can only dedicate a small chunk of their limited storage for the FL task and (b) new training samples may arrive continually in many practical wireless applications. Therefore, we propose a new FL algorithm, online-score-aided federated learning (OSAFL), specifically designed for tasks with continual data arrival in resource-constrained environments. We first theoretically show how the convergence bound is affected by continual data distribution shifts, uncertain client participation, gradient quantization errors, and noise from stochastic gradients and statistical data heterogeneity across clients. We then show how to (sub-optimally) minimize these errors by choosing appropriate aggregation weights at the CS during global update. Our extensive simulation results across three popular image classification datasets and three ML models with different numbers of trainable parameters validate the effectiveness of the proposed OSAFL algorithm compared to (modified) state-of-the art FL baselines.
papers.comment: Updated aggregation rules - added gradient quantization and two-sided learning rates; main theorem is updated
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在线分数辅助联邦学习（OSAFL），专门针对资源受限无线客户端在持续数据到达场景下的联邦学习问题。算法理论分析了持续数据分布变化、客户端不确定性、梯度量化误差等因素对收敛界的影响，并通过全局更新时选择合适聚合权重来最小化这些误差。在三个图像分类数据集和三个ML模型上的仿真验证了OSAFL相比改进的先进FL基线的有效性。
Motivation: 现有联邦学习算法忽视了两个关键问题：客户端只能分配少量存储给FL任务，以及实际无线应用中新训练样本可能持续到达。本文旨在解决这些被忽略的挑战。
Method: 提出OSAFL算法，在中央服务器全局更新时，通过优化聚合权重来（次优地）最小化持续数据分布变化、不确定客户端参与、梯度量化误差以及随机梯度和统计异质性带来的噪声。
Result: 在三个图像分类数据集和三个不同参数量ML模型上的仿真验证了OSAFL相比（改进的）先进FL基线更有效。
Conclusion: OSAFL专为资源受限环境下持续数据到达的FL任务设计，理论分析和仿真共同表明其有效性。

papers.title: Unsupervised Multimodal Clustering for Semantics Discovery in Multimodal Utterances
papers.abstract_en: Discovering the semantics of multimodal utterances is essential for understanding human language and enhancing human-machine interactions. Existing methods manifest limitations in leveraging nonverbal information for discerning complex semantics in unsupervised scenarios. This paper introduces a novel unsupervised multimodal clustering method (UMC), making a pioneering contribution to this field. UMC introduces a unique approach to constructing augmentation views for multimodal data, which are then used to perform pre-training to establish well-initialized representations for subsequent clustering. An innovative strategy is proposed to dynamically select high-quality samples as guidance for representation learning, gauged by the density of each sample's nearest neighbors. Besides, it is equipped to automatically determine the optimal value for the top-$K$ parameter in each cluster to refine sample selection. Finally, both high- and low-quality samples are used to learn representations conducive to effective clustering. We build baselines on benchmark multimodal intent and dialogue act datasets. UMC shows remarkable improvements of 2-7\% scores in clustering metrics over state-of-the-art methods, marking the first successful endeavor in this domain. The complete code and data are available at https://github.com/thuiar/UMC.
papers.comment: Accepted by ACL 2024, Main Conference, Long Paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出无监督多模态聚类方法（UMC），用于多模态话语的语义发现。UMC通过构建多模态数据的增强视图进行预训练，并动态选择高质量样本引导表示学习，自动确定每个簇的top-K参数，最终利用高低质量样本学习聚类友好的表示。在基准意图和对话行为数据集上，聚类指标相比此前最优方法提升2-7%。
Motivation: 现有方法在无监督场景下难以有效利用非语言信息来辨别复杂语义，缺乏专门针对多模态话语的无监督聚类研究。
Method: 提出UMC：先对多模态数据构建增强视图进行预训练以获得良好初始化表示；再通过样本最近邻密度动态选择高质量样本作指导，并自动确定每个簇的top-K参数以优化样本选择；最后联合高低质量样本学习表示。
Result: 在基准多模态意图和对话行为数据集上，聚类指标相比此前最优方法提升2-7%，为该领域首次成功尝试。
Conclusion: UMC在无监督多模态聚类任务上取得显著改进，表明动态样本选择与自适应参数策略的有效性。

papers.title: Ghosts in Neural Networks: Existence, Structure and Role of Infinite-Dimensional Null Space
papers.abstract_en: We study parameter nonuniqueness in continuous-width depth-two fully connected neural networks. Our main contribution is a direct method for solving the neural-network equation $S[γ]=f$. Starting from the Fourier expression of the synthesis operator, separation of variables produces a ridgelet particular solution and identifies every homogeneous direction. To isolate the argument, we first prove an abstract reconstruction formula for unitary factorizations, yielding the adjoint, normalized right inverse, and orthogonal solution geometry. We then specialize this formula to neural-network synthesis: for tempered-distribution activations such as ReLU, we equip the activation class $A_{s,t}$ with a Hilbert structure, construct compatible coefficient and parameter Hilbert spaces $H_{s,t}$ and $G_{s,t}$, and prove that $S:G_{s,t}\to L^2(\mathbb R^m)$ is bounded. The resulting ridgelet expansion exhausts the null space and the complete solution set and identifies the unique minimum-norm parameter distribution. Concrete examples give adjoint ridgelet functions for standard activations. Further developments show that finite-measure null elements admit normalized width-$N$ discretizations with $O(N^{-1/2})$ output error and characterize how additive parameter perturbations can reveal information encoded in the null space. A Lean 4 blueprint for the main results is available at https://shosonoda.github.io/lean-ridgelet/ .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了连续宽度两层全连接神经网络中的参数非唯一性，通过傅里叶分析和脊波变换直接求解神经网络方程S[γ]=f，刻画了无限维零空间的结构，并证明了最小范数参数分布的唯一性。
Motivation: 神经网络参数非唯一性（即不同参数可产生相同输出）的理论理解不充分，特别是无限维零空间的存在性及其作用尚未被系统揭示。
Method: 从合成算子的傅里叶表达式出发，利用变量分离得到脊波特解和齐次方向；通过抽象重构公式推导出伴随算子、归一化右逆和正交解几何，并具体化到神经网络合成场景，为ReLU等激活函数构建希尔伯特空间结构。
Result: 证明合成算子S:G_{s,t}→L^2(R^m)有界；给出了脊波展开式穷尽了零空间和完整解集；识别出最小范数参数分布；有限测度零元素支持O(N^{-1/2})误差的宽度N离散化。
Conclusion: 该理论框架为理解神经网络参数冗余和零空间信息编码提供了数学基础，但结果局限于连续宽度两层网络，实际训练动力学中的作用有待进一步验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mitigating Compiler Fusion-Induced Power Bursts in Mobile NPU Inference as the Battery Depletes
papers.abstract_en: Mobile devices increasingly rely on real-time NPU inference for camera and perception workloads. Under low-voltage conditions, however, a single inference can induce an instantaneous voltage droop in the power-delivery network, causing the power management integrated circuit to invoke dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS) and increase latency. We present a measurement study of this effect on a commercial smartphone. We show that aggressive operator fusion in a mobile NPU compiler can create monolithic superlayers whose concentrated execution produces large peak-current bursts. These bursts shift the DVFS-onset voltage upward and reduce the low-voltage operating margin. We further evaluate a practical black-box mitigation: a measurement-guided, pre-compilation graph rewrite that inserts barriers at selected peak-to-average power ratio hot spots to prevent harmful superlayer merging in the vendor NPU compiler. On Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 with MobileNetV4 at 768 x 768 resolution on ImageNet-1k, this method reduces peak current from 3.12 A to 1.94 A with 3.76% latency overhead, preserves stable latency deeper into the low-voltage regime, and shifts the inferred DVFS margin by approximately 173 mV.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇论文研究了移动设备NPU推理在低电压条件下由编译器算子融合引起的瞬时电压降问题。测量表明，融合产生的超级层会导致大峰值电流，提升DVFS触发电压并减少工作裕度。提出一种黑盒缓解方法：通过测量指导的图重写插入屏障以防止有害融合。在Snapdragon 8 Gen 3上，该方法将峰值电流从3.12A降至1.94A，延迟开销3.76%，并改善低电压稳定性。
Motivation: 移动设备在低电压下进行NPU推理时，单次推理可能引起电源网络电压降，导致DVFS启动并增加延迟，现有工作未充分研究编译器融合对这一现象的影响。
Method: 通过测量研究商用手机中NPU推理的功率行为；提出一种黑盒缓解方法，基于测量指导的预编译图重写，在峰值功率比热点处插入屏障，阻止编译器进行有害的超级层融合。
Result: 在Snapdragon 8 Gen 3上，使用MobileNetV4 768x768分辨率，ImageNet-1k数据集，峰值电流从3.12A降至1.94A，延迟开销3.76%，在低电压区域保持稳定延迟，推断DVFS裕度移动约173mV。
Conclusion: 论文展示了编译器融合在低电压下对移动NPU推理的不利影响，并验证了所提图重写方法在缓解功率爆发方面的有效性。

papers.title: Capacity and Redundancy Trade-offs in Multi-Task Learning
papers.abstract_en: In multi-task learning (MTL) negative transfer is often considered as an optimization artifact, but it can also be viewed as a consequence of limited shared capacity and weak task redundancy. We investigate this effect through a Capacity--Redundancy (CR) identity that decomposes the sum of per-task predictive informations into joint predictive information that includes label redundancy defined via total correlation (TC), and a residual coupling term that quantifies interference left unresolved by the shared representation. Additionally, we show two key results: (i) a clustering-gap decomposition that gives a necessary and sufficient condition for clustered sharing to outperform global sharing, and (ii) a gradient--TC bridge in a Gaussian multi-task model that formally justifies gradient cosine similarity as a proxy for redundancy ordering. Empirically, we estimate the residual coupling $Δ$ from validation residual correlations, showing that clustered LoRA substantially reduces $\widehatΔ$, outperforms size-matched random partitions, and results in statistically significant gains with multi-seed confidence intervals.
papers.comment: Accepted in 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多任务学习（MTL）中负迁移现象，将其归因于有限共享容量和弱任务冗余。作者提出容量-冗余（CR）恒等式，将各任务预测信息之和分解为联合预测信息（包括通过总相关（TC）定义的标签冗余）和残差耦合项。进一步给出聚类差距分解，为聚类共享优于全局共享提供充要条件；并在高斯多任务模型中建立梯度-TC桥接，证明梯度余弦相似度可作为冗余排序的代理。实验通过验证残差相关性估计残差耦合Δ，发现聚类LoRA显著降低Δ，优于大小匹配的随机划分，并在多随机种子置信区间内具有统计显著性。
Motivation: 现有研究常将负迁移视为优化伪影，但作者认为其根源在于共享容量有限且任务间冗余不足。旨在从信息论角度量化冗余与干扰，并指导模型结构设计。
Method: 提出容量-冗余（CR）恒等式分解预测信息；推导聚类差距分解（必要充分条件）；在高斯多任务模型中建立梯度与总相关的理论关系。实验采用验证残差相关性估计残差耦合Δ，并比较聚类LoRA与随机划分。
Result: 聚类LoRA显著降低残差耦合Δ，优于大小匹配的随机划分，且具有统计显著性（多随机种子置信区间）。
Conclusion: 本文从信息论角度解释MTL中的负迁移，并为采用聚类结构（如聚类LoRA）提供了理论和实证支持。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究多任务学习（MTL）中负迁移现象，将其归因于有限共享容量和弱任务冗余。作者提出容量-冗余（CR）恒等式，将各任务预测信息之和分解为联合预测信息（包括通过总相关（TC）定义的标签冗余）和残差耦合项。进一步给出聚类差距分解，为聚类共享优于全局共享提供充要条件；并在高斯多任务模型中建立梯度-TC桥接，证明梯度余弦相似度可作为冗余排序的代理。实验通过验证残差相关性估计残差耦合Δ，发现聚类LoRA显著降低Δ，优于大小匹配的随机划分，并在多随机种子置信区间内具有统计显著性。

papers.title: Discrete Ricci Curvature on Protein Contact Graphs for Lightweight Fold Classification
papers.abstract_en: Protein fold classification can be approached via sequence-based representations or structural descriptors, but direct comparisons between lightweight handcrafted descriptors and pretrained protein language model embeddings remain limited. We investigate discrete Ricci curvature on Calpha contact graphs as a lightweight structural descriptor for fold classification. Each protein domain is represented by a 22-dimensional fixed-length feature derived from summary statistics and quantiles of Ollivier-Ricci and Forman-Ricci edge curvature distributions. We evaluate on CATH top-10 Topology classification and on the ASTRAL 40%-identity SCOPe top-10 Fold benchmark, comparing against geometry, contact-graph statistics, persistent homology, and mean-pooled ESM-2 (150M) baselines. On both datasets, lightweight structural descriptors substantially outperform mean-pooled ESM-2 embeddings, with a larger performance gap on the ASTRAL 40% SCOPe benchmark. Ricci alone uses 22 dimensions, or 3.4% of the ESM-2 baseline dimensionality, and already outperforms mean-pooled ESM-2 on both datasets. Combining Ricci with persistent homology yields the strongest performance, achieving macro-F1 of 0.71 on CATH and 0.68 on SCOPe with a 112-dimensional feature vector. These results identify a regime where lightweight interpretable graph descriptors offer a practical alternative to pretrained protein language model embeddings.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究离散Ricci曲率在Cα接触图上的应用，作为一种轻量级结构描述符进行蛋白质折叠分类。使用Ollivier-Ricci和Forman-Ricci边曲率分布的统计量和分位数，提取22维特征，在CATH和SCOPe基准上与ESM-2嵌入等基线对比。结果表明，22维Ricci特征即优于平均池化的ESM-2（150M）嵌入，且与持续同调结合可获得最佳性能（CATH上macro-F1=0.71，SCOPe上0.68）。
Motivation: 现有蛋白质折叠分类方法或依赖序列表示，或使用结构描述符，但轻量级手工特征与预训练蛋白质语言模型嵌入之间的直接比较尚不充分。本文旨在探索离散Ricci曲率作为轻量级结构描述符的有效性。
Method: 将每个蛋白质域表示为基于Cα接触图的Ollivier-Ricci和Forman-Ricci边曲率分布的统计量和分位数，生成22维固定长度特征向量。在CATH和SCOPe基准上，与几何特征、接触图统计、持续同调以及平均池化ESM-2（150M）嵌入基线进行比较。
Result: 在CATH Top-10拓扑分类和ASTRAL 40%同一性SCOPe Top-10折叠基准上，22维Ricci特征即优于平均池化ESM-2嵌入（维度为ESM-2的3.4%）。Ricci与持续同调组合的112维特征达到最佳：CATH上macro-F1=0.71，SCOPe上0.68。
Conclusion: 轻量级可解释图描述符在蛋白质折叠分类中可作为预训练蛋白质语言模型嵌入的实用替代方案，尤其在维度效率上具有优势。

papers.title: Projective Maximum Entropy: Universality and Acceptance-Region Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Maximum-entropy reference distributions are usually constructed on the normalized probability simplex. This formulation is less natural for unnormalized statistical models, in which positive multiples represent the same shape, and it does not directly explain how a prescribed admissible region should determine the deformation parameter of a bounded-support reference distribution. We formulate maximum entropy on the projective space of nonnegative measures and establish three results of statistical relevance. First, a universality theorem shows that every admissible monotone transform of the same normalized power functional has exactly the same optimizer under linear moment constraints. The result unifies the maximum-entropy implications of Tsallis and Rényi entropies, Hölder composite scores, pseudo-spherical scores, Bregman--Hölder constructions, and related homogeneous divergences without asserting a new distribution family. Second, the common optimizer is characterized as a $q$-exponential density; under mean and covariance constraints it is a compactly supported $q$-Gaussian for positive deformation and a Student-type density for negative deformation. Third, a prescribed Mahalanobis acceptance region with squared radius $R^2>d+2$ uniquely determines the deformation parameter $γ_R=2/(R^2-d-2)$. The resulting affine-equivariant reference density is the unique projective maximum-entropy solution, and its support coincides with the specified ellipsoid without an additional support constraint. This provides a principled method for constructing bounded-support statistical reference distributions from robust location and scatter estimates or from externally specified admissible regions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在非负测度的投影空间中重新表述最大熵，建立了通用性定理，证明在线性矩约束下所有可允许的单调变换具有相同的优化器，该优化器被表征为q-指数密度。此外，预先指定的马氏接受区域唯一确定变形参数，从而提供了一种从稳健位置和尺度估计构造有界支撑参考分布的方法。
Motivation: 标准最大熵在归一化概率单纯形上构建，对未归一化统计模型不自然，且未解释指定接受区域如何确定有界支撑参考分布的变形参数。
Method: 在非负测度的投影空间上定义最大熵，推导通用性定理，将优化器表征为q-指数密度，并通过马氏接受区域确定变形参数。
Result: 证明了Tsallis和Rényi熵等不同熵的最大熵含义统一于同一优化器；在均值和协方差约束下，正变形得到紧支撑q-高斯，负变形得到学生型密度；给定马氏接受区域半径R^2>d+2唯一确定变形参数。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一种有原则的方法，从稳健位置和尺度估计或外部指定接受区域构造有界支撑统计参考分布，其支撑与指定椭球一致。
Relevance: 0
