papers.title: Reliable Remediation Impact Prediction for Black-Box Security Ratings
papers.abstract_en: Security rating platforms summarize externally observable cyber exposure and are expected to help organizations prioritize remediation. A platform may want to tell an organization how a candidate remediation action would affect its score, but repeatedly exposing exact score responses can reveal information about the hidden scoring engine. We propose a surrogate based approach for remediation score impact prediction that is designed to respect this opacity constraint. The surrogate predicts scores from organization configurations while explicitly representing checkpoint (i.e., a security check) applicability and the observed checkpoint set. A main challenge is that such predictions are not uniformly reliable: they depend on the amount and structure of the observable checkpoint evidence available for a given configuration. To address this, the approach combines applicability-aware surrogate construction, sensitivity analysis under controlled checkpoint restriction, a reliability layer for identifying unstable predictions, and score-impact prediction for supported remediation actions. Explicit modeling of checkpoint applicability is central throughout: it improves score prediction and provides the feature basis used by the reliability layer to identify unstable cases. We evaluate the approach on a real-world dataset of 5,188 organization configurations from a commercial security rating platform. The results show that the applicability-aware surrogate improves score prediction over simpler feature representations. For remediation, the surrogate predicts the score impact of supported actions, while the reliability layer helps identify cases in which these predicted impacts should be interpreted cautiously.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对黑盒安全评级平台中修复操作对评分影响的可信预测问题，提出一种基于代理模型（surrogate）的方法。该方法显式建模检查点适用性（checkpoint applicability），结合敏感性分析与可靠性层，在保护评分引擎隐私的前提下预测修复影响。在包含5,188个组织配置的真实数据集上，适用性感知代理改进了评分预测，可靠性层帮助识别不可靠的预测。
Motivation: 安全评级平台需要向组织展示修复操作对评分的影响，但直接暴露精确评分响应可能泄露隐藏评分引擎的内部信息。现有方法无法在保持黑盒约束的同时提供可靠的修复影响预测。
Method: 提出代理模型方法，核心包括：适用性感知的代理构建（explicitly representing checkpoint applicability）、控制性检查点限制下的敏感性分析、用于识别不稳定预测的可靠性层（reliability layer），以及针对支持修复操作的评分影响预测。适用性建模贯穿始终，既改进评分预测，又为可靠性层提供特征基础。
Result: 在包含5,188个组织配置的真实安全评级平台数据集上，适用性感知代理相比简单特征表示提升了评分预测准确性。代理能预测支持修复操作的评分影响，可靠性层成功识别出预测可解释性较差的案例。
Conclusion: 该方法在维持黑盒评分引擎隐私约束的同时，实现了可靠的修复影响预测，并通过可靠性层增强了预测的可信度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PhysAgent: Reflective Agentic Physics Control for Physically Plausible Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in physics-grounded video generation leverage physics simulation as a physical prior to guide video synthesis toward physically plausible outcomes. The simulation process is controlled by physical specifications, which are typically generated by a vision-language model in a single pass. Such one-shot prediction often fails to accurately translate user intent into executable simulations, particularly for fine-grained object dynamics, complex motion trajectories, and temporally structured interactions. In this paper, we propose PhysAgent, a reflective agentic framework that closes the loop among physical program generation, physics simulation, stage-specific verification, and targeted program repair. Beyond improving the control of coupled physical parameters, our framework enables the agent to progressively realize complex trajectories, multi-stage interactions, and precise event outcomes by treating each physical program as an executable hypothesis. In addition, we design a set of physics-control APIs to support more stable and complex motion behaviors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PhysAgent produces more physically plausible videos, achieves better prompt alignment, and generalizes more effectively across diverse physical scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PhysAgent，一个反思式智能体框架，用于物理合理的视频生成。该框架通过闭环流程（物理程序生成、物理模拟、阶段验证和针对性程序修复）逐步实现复杂轨迹、多阶段交互和精确事件结果。实验表明，PhysAgent生成的视频更物理合理，提示对齐更好，且能泛化到多种物理场景。
Motivation: 现有方法使用视觉-语言模型单次生成物理规范，难以精确翻译用户意图为可执行的模拟，尤其在细粒度物体动力学、复杂运动轨迹和时间结构化交互上存在不足。
Method: 提出PhysAgent反思式智能体框架，包含物理程序生成、物理模拟、阶段验证和程序修复的闭环。设计了物理控制API以支持更稳定和复杂的运动行为。
Result: 大量实验表明PhysAgent生成更物理合理的视频，实现更好的提示对齐，并在多种物理场景下有效泛化。
Conclusion: PhysAgent通过迭代验证与修复机制提升了物理生成视频的准确性和鲁棒性。

papers.title: A Predict-then-Correct Loop Based on Few-Shot Continuous Contextual Bandit for Demand Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Retail demand forecasting remains difficult when demand shifts faster than static forecasting models can be retrained, especially in early demand cycles where newly observed labels are sparse. To address this, this study aims to improve adaptive retail forecasting by proposing a predict-then-correct (PtC) framework that retains a first-stage machine learning (ML) forecast and applies a few-shot continuous contextual bandit correction policy with similar-SKUs augmentation and top-p masked updating. Across Walmart retail data and an exclusive beverage dataset, PtC delivers statistically significant reductions in MAPE, MAE, and RMSE across stable & high volume, stable & low volume, and erratic & intermittent demand patterns, improves average RMSE by 9.52% over the ML-only baseline in the ablation study, and yields lower inventory costs than base-stock, proximal policy optimization, and soft actor-critic policies under the tested lead-time settings. These findings show that online forecast correction can bridge offline demand learning and real-time retail decision-making by adapting to sparse feedback without fully retraining the base forecasting model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种预测-校正（PtC）框架，用于零售需求预测。该框架保留第一阶段的机器学习预测，并通过少样本连续上下文强盗（few-shot continuous contextual bandit）策略进行在线校正，结合相似SKU增强和top-p遮蔽更新。在沃尔玛零售数据和饮料数据集上，PtC相比纯ML基线在MAPE、MAE和RMSE上取得统计显著的降低，平均RMSE改善9.52%，并在测试的提前期设置下，库存成本低于base-stock、PPO和SAC策略。
Motivation: 零售需求在早期周期中变化快且新标签稀疏，导致静态预测模型无法及时适应，亟需一种无需完全重训练即可在线校正预测的方法。
Method: 提出Predict-then-Correct (PtC)框架，第一阶段使用机器学习生成基准预测，第二阶段应用少样本连续上下文强盗校正策略，通过相似SKU数据增强和top-p遮蔽更新来稀疏地调整预测。
Result: 在沃尔玛数据和饮料数据集上，PtC在稳定高量、稳定低量以及间歇需求模式下均显著降低MAPE、MAE和RMSE；消融实验中平均RMSE相对纯ML基线提升9.52%；库存成本低于base-stock、PPO和SAC基线。
Conclusion: 在线预测校正能够桥接离线需求学习与实时零售决策，通过适应稀疏反馈来改进预测，而无需完全重训练基础模型。

papers.title: Clarify Before Executing: A Self-Evolving Agent for Resolving Intent Asymmetry in 3D Tool Orchestration
papers.abstract_en: A fundamental intent asymmetry plagues modern 3D asset creation: while state-of-the-art 3D toolchains demand precise, executable parameters, ordinary users typically provide vague, underspecified instructions. Current 3D agents treat this ambiguity as noise, defaulting to blind execution under a single-turn assumption. To address this limitation, we introduce CLARE, a clarification-aware and evolutionary 3D agent that treats intent asymmetry not as an execution error, but as an opportunity for strategic dialogue. By decoupling the generation pipeline into four specialized cognitive roles, CLARE intercepts and resolves underspecified instructions before invoking computationally expensive 3D tools to seamlessly execute tasks across five diverse domains: text-to-3D generation, single-view reconstruction, multi-view reconstruction, point cloud editing, and post-processing. Crucially, rather than relying on rigid manual rules, CLARE self-evolves its clarification policy via simulated multi-turn interactions. By optimizing a Multi-turn Reward, the agent internalizes the delicate balance between interaction efficiency and task completion. To rigorously test this, we construct 3D-Clarify, a comprehensive benchmark comprising 620 interaction scenarios with systematically injected ambiguity, missing information, and mistaken details. CLARE achieves state-of-the-art performance, with 60.40% and 43.34% success rates on single-step and multi-step tasks, respectively, more than doubling existing baselines. Both quantitative and qualitative results demonstrate that proactive clarification is the missing key to robust 3D execution. Code is available at https://github.com/xyzhu1225/CLARE.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026 (ACM MM 2026). 26 pages including appendix, 8 figures. Code: https://github.com/xyzhu1225/CLARE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CLARE，一个面向3D工具编排的自我进化代理，通过将生成管道解耦为四个认知角色，主动识别并解决用户指令中的意图不对称问题，在5个3D任务上超过现有方法。
Motivation: 现有3D代理将用户模糊指令视为噪声并盲目执行，导致成功率低，本文旨在通过主动澄清而非被动执行来解决意图不对称。
Method: CLARE采用四角色认知解耦（理解、澄清、执行、反馈），并通过模拟多轮交互优化多轮奖励函数，使澄清策略自我进化。
Result: 在自建基准3D-Clarify上，CLARE在单步和多步任务上分别达到60.40%和43.34%的成功率，超过现有方法两倍以上。
Conclusion: 主动澄清是提升3D工具编排鲁棒性的关键，CLARE通过自我进化的对话策略有效解决了意图不对称问题。

papers.title: Privacy-Aware Synthetic Video Benchmarking and Relational Evaluation for Worker-Under-Suspended-Load Detection
papers.abstract_en: Publicly shareable construction-video benchmarks remain scarce, especially for safety-critical hazards that are rare, dangerous to stage, and difficult to release. We study worker under suspended load, a relational hazard that depends on worker-load geometry and temporal persistence rather than object detection alone. We introduce SynthSite, a focused synthetic video benchmark of 55 clips spanning varied load configurations, viewpoints, clutter, occlusions, and surveillance conditions, together with a privacy-aware hybrid generation workflow that supports both publicly shareable benchmark creation and privacy-constrained synthetic video generation. We then ask whether worker appearance can be suppressed without undermining downstream hazard recognition. Under five whole-body privacy conditions, we evaluate worker and load retention, localization stability, and clip-level hazard recognition. We find that structure-preserving obfuscations retain substantially more downstream utility than appearance-smoothing baselines, and that preserving a raw visual reference alone does not guarantee the strongest agreement with human hazard labels. These findings suggest that privacy evaluation for construction safety analytics should assess not only appearance suppression, but also preservation of the geometric cues required for hazard reasoning. Our dataset and code are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/govtech/SynthSite .
papers.comment: Accepted at the 3rd Workshop on Synthetic Data for Computer Vision (SynData4CV), CVPR 2026. OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=dMfhFmDWsg . Dataset and code: https://huggingface.co/datasets/govtech/SynthSite
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对建筑安全中悬挂负载下工人检测任务，提出隐私感知的合成视频基准SynthSite（55个视频片段），并评估五种隐私条件对下游危害识别的影响。实验发现结构保留的模糊化比外观平滑基线保留更多下游效用，且仅保留原始视觉参考不能保证与人类标签最强一致性。
Motivation: 公共可共享的建筑视频基准稀缺，尤其是涉及罕见、危险且难以发布的危害场景，现有方法难以在隐私保护与下游任务表现之间取得平衡。
Method: 提出隐私感知混合生成工作流，构建SynthSite基准，包含55个视频片段，覆盖多种负载配置、视角、杂乱和遮挡条件；在五种全身隐私条件下评估工人与负载保留、定位稳定性和片段级危害识别。
Result: 结构保留的模糊化方法在保留下游危害识别效用上显著优于外观平滑基线；仅保留原始视觉参考未必产生最强的人类标签一致性。
Conclusion: 建筑安全分析的隐私评估应不仅考虑外观抑制，还需评估推理危害所需的几何线索的保留。

papers.title: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Sensor-based Activity Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Sensor-based human activity recognition (HAR) has achieved significant progressed in fully supervised learning settings. However, these supervised learning models rely on large amount of labeled data, which require labor-intensive collection and meticulous annotation. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture framework tailored for sensor-based HAR, designed to learn robust and generalizable representations from unlabeled datasets. The proposed framework features an encoder designed to explicitly model both the fine-grained local temporal representations within individual window and the long-term temporal sequence of adjacent windows. Furthermore, we introduce an improved Variance-Invariance-Covariance Regularization (VICReg) objective function that incorporates computationally lightweight norm term to stabilize the JEPA pre-training phase. This term balances variance, invariance and covariance constraints to prevent representation collapse. The proposed HAR-JEPA framework is evaluated using two benchmark continuously performed activity datasets. The results show that high-quality representations are successfully learned by the proposed framework. Furthermore, the representations learned by HAR-JEPA demonstrates superior generalization on minority, high variance transitional activities such as sit-to-stand and sit-to-lie where supervised learning tend to overfit due to limited support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于传感器的活动识别（HAR）中标签数据稀缺的问题，提出了一种联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），通过改进的VICReg正则化从无标签数据中学习鲁棒表示。在连续活动数据集上，该方法学会了高质量表示，并在少数、高方差过渡活动（如坐-站、坐-躺）上展现出优于监督学习的泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有监督HAR模型依赖大量标注数据，标注过程劳动密集且耗时，限制了实际应用。
Method: 提出HAR-JEPA框架，包含一个编码器，显式建模单个窗口内的细粒度局部时间表示和相邻窗口的长期时间序列；同时引入改进的VICReg目标函数，加入轻量级范数项以稳定预训练，平衡方差、不变性和协方差约束。
Result: 在两个连续活动数据集上，HAR-JEPA成功学习了高质量表示，在少数过渡活动（如sit-to-stand和sit-to-lie）上泛化能力优于监督学习方法。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确讨论局限，但框架在无监督表示学习方面展示了潜力，尤其针对数据稀疏的过渡活动。

papers.title: Boundary-Seeking GAN-Augmented TabTransformer for Adversarially Robust Intrusion Detection
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning-based intrusion detection systems (IDSs) often suffer from class imbalance and vulnerability to adversarial attacks, leading to degraded detection performance and reduced robustness. This study proposes a TabTransformer framework augmented by the Boundary-Seeking Generative Adversarial Network (BGAN) for flow-based intrusion detection using the CICIDS2017 dataset. BGAN serves a dual purpose by generating synthetic minority-class samples to mitigate data imbalance and producing adversarial samples to evaluate model robustness. Experimental results demonstrate that BGAN augmentation improves TabTransformer's Macro-F1 score from 82.96% to 86.50%, with the largest class-wise improvement observed for Web_Attack (F1 score: 0.29 to 0.61). Robustness evaluation shows that all non-augmented models experienced a 100% Performance Drop Rate (PDR) under adversarial testing, whereas all BGAN-augmented models achieved negative PDR values, indicating improved resilience. Furthermore, the augmented TabTransformer maintained stable and low False Triggered Rate (FTR) values (1.51%-2.92%) across all noise levels, compared with the BGAN-augmented Decision Tree, which reached 49.09% under benign perturbations. These findings demonstrate that BGAN consistently enhances both class balance and adversarial robustness, while the proposed BGAN-TabTransformer framework provides an effective and adaptive intrusion detection solution for adversarial network environments.
papers.comment: Preprint. Submitted to Kuwait Journal of Science
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出结合边界搜索生成对抗网络（BGAN）与TabTransformer的入侵检测框架，使用CICIDS2017数据集。BGAN同时生成合成少数类样本缓解类别不平衡，并生成对抗样本评估鲁棒性。实验表明BGAN增强将TabTransformer的Macro-F1从82.96%提升至86.50%，Web_Attack类的F1从0.29提升至0.61；所有非增强模型在对抗测试中性能下降率（PDR）为100%，而BGAN增强模型均取得负PDR，表明鲁棒性提升。
Motivation: 基于机器学习的入侵检测系统面临类别不平衡和对抗攻击脆弱性问题，导致检测性能下降和鲁棒性不足。现有方法难以同时解决这两方面挑战。
Method: 提出BGAN-TabTransformer框架：使用BGAN生成合成少数类样本以平衡数据集，同时生成对抗样本用于鲁棒性评估；采用TabTransformer作为分类器处理流式网络流量特征。
Result: BGAN增强使TabTransformer的Macro-F1从82.96%提升至86.50%；Web_Attack类F1从0.29提升至0.61。非增强模型在对抗测试中PDR为100%，而BGAN增强模型均获负PDR；BGAN增强TabTransformer在不同噪声水平下保持低错误触发率（1.51%-2.92%），优于BGAN增强决策树的49.09%。
Conclusion: BGAN能同时改善类别平衡和对抗鲁棒性，提出的BGAN-TabTransformer框架为对抗性网络环境提供了有效且自适应的入侵检测方案。

papers.title: Global Index on Responsible AI: 2026 Report
papers.abstract_en: Grounded in human rights-based frameworks such as the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI, the Global Index on Responsible AI (GIRAI) examines how countries translate responsible AI commitments into enforceable protections, institutional capacity, and redress mechanisms. GIRAI 2026 assesses these across five dimensions: Inclusion and Diversity, Ethics and Sustainability, Labour and Skills, Trust and Safety, and AI Use in Public Service. A global network of 135 country-level researchers collected and assessed 68,138 data points on 38 indicators organised across three pillars: government AI policy and implementation (17 indicators), civil society engagement (5), enabling conditions (15), and documented cases of government deployment of unacceptable-risk AI systems. The data covers November 2023 to September 2025. A score of 100 is derived from the indicators to rank all countries. Findings show that while responsible AI governance is expanding, with 126 of 135 countries having at least one government policy or initiative across the 17 AI Policy indicators, this does not often translate into meaningful protection. For instance, Global South countries account for 203 of 306 new cases of indicators with frameworks since the first edition, yet 78% of their frameworks remain non-binding compared with 42% in the Global North. Government commitment to AI governance also does not extend to their own algorithms: whereas Transparency and Explainability is one of the strongest performing indicators, with 58% of countries having some framework, only 18% require Public Disclosure of Government Algorithms. Credible evidence of government deployment of unacceptable-risk AI systems was also found in 35 countries. These findings show that responsible AI governance must move beyond framework adoption toward enforceable rights-based protections, resourced oversight institutions, and accessible redress.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 全球负责任AI指数（GIRAI）2026报告基于人权框架，评估135个国家在五个维度上的负责任AI落实状况，涵盖政府政策、民间社会参与、赋能条件及高风险AI系统部署。报告收集了68138个数据点，显示虽然负责任AI治理在扩展（126个国家有至少一项AI政策），但承诺与强制保护之间存在差距：全球南方国家78%的框架不具约束力，且仅18%的国家要求公开政府算法，发现35个国家部署了不可接受风险的AI系统。
Motivation: 现有AI治理评估多关注框架数量而非实际执行效果与保护机制，尤其缺少对全球南方国家以及政府自身算法部署的问责评估。
Method: 基于联合国教科文组织AI伦理建议等国际人权框架，构建三大支柱（政府AI政策与实施、民间社会参与、赋能条件）共38项指标，由135个国家的研究者收集2023年11月至2025年9月间的数据，最终综合打分（0-100）对所有国家排序。
Result: 126/135个国家有至少一项AI政策，但全球南方78%的框架不具约束力（全球北方42%）；透明度与可解释性指标表现最强（58%国家有框架），但仅18%要求政府算法公开披露；在35个国家发现政府部署不可接受风险AI系统的可信证据。

papers.title: VideoSEMA: a scalable and efficient Mamba-like attention for video understanding
papers.abstract_en: We present for video understanding (classification) a split space-time attention model, VideoSEMA, consisting of a scalable and efficient Mamba-like attention (SEMA) block in space and a softmax temporal attention in time. In each frame, SEMA attention applies a local window attention in parallel with a global averaging in a Mamba macro-architecture, which is called Mamba-like. Under certain rank conditions, we prove that the computationally cheaper split space-time attention is equivalent to full space-time attention. On benchmark K400 data sets, VideoSEMA out-performs heavier vision transformer and Mamba models. On benchmark SSv2 data, VideoSEMA leads in top-1 accuracy among models of similar parameter sizes. As image resolution scales up from standard $224^2$ to $1024^2$ on K400 and without fine-tuning, VideoSEMA degrades much more gracefully than VideoMamba in accuracy. It is promising to extend VideoSEMA to longer videos with a dilated/sparse temporal attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VideoSEMA，一种用于视频理解的分裂时空注意力模型，在空间上采用类似 Mamba 的可扩展高效注意力块（SEMA），在时间上使用 softmax 注意力。理论证明在秩条件下分裂时空注意力等价于全时空注意力。在 K400 和 SSv2 基准上，VideoSEMA 在相似参数量下优于更重的视觉 Transformer 和 Mamba 模型，且在高分辨率下精度下降更平缓。
Method: 空间分支使用 SEMA 块（局部窗口注意力与全局平均并行，类似 Mamba 宏架构），时间分支使用 softmax 注意力。在特定秩条件下证明分裂时空注意力与全时空注意力的等价性。
Result: 在 K400 数据集上，VideoSEMA 优于更重的 ViT 和 Mamba 模型；在 SSv2 上，在相似参数量下达到最高 top-1 准确率。分辨率从 224^2 缩放至 1024^2 时，精度下降比 VideoMamba 更平缓。
Conclusion: 该方法具有可扩展性，未来可结合膨胀/稀疏时间注意力推广到更长视频。

papers.title: 3D Scene Graph Prediction: Generating Hierarchical Models from Partially Observed Environments
papers.abstract_en: Generating realistic 3D indoor scenes is an area of growing interest in computer vision and robotics. Existing methods, often motivated by applications such as interior design, generally focus on object layout generation within a single room. The generation of high-level scene structure, such as room-level layout and traversability, remains underexplored despite its importance for robotics applications. In this paper, we consider the case where a robot has explored part of an environment and needs to predict the unexplored parts to support downstream tasks such as exploration or object search. We propose a top-down framework for synthesizing hierarchical 3D scene graphs, including a room layer -- describing the floor plan and traversability -- and an object layer modeling object layouts within each room. For the room layer, we propose a novel mixed-domain graph diffusion model jointly predicting room categories, floor boundaries, and traversability between rooms. Via corruption and masking, this model supports partial constraints such as incomplete floor plans, avoiding the need for partially observed training data. For the object layer, we integrate an existing mixed discrete-continuous diffusion model for joint prediction of object categories, locations, sizes, and orientations within each room given the floor plan. We compare our method with state-of-the-art occupancy-based and LLM-based floor plan generation methods on a standard benchmark. Compared with an occupancy-based learning baseline, our method generalizes substantially better to out-of-distribution partial floor plans. We also demonstrate our integrated prediction pipeline on real-world scenes from robot-collected data, enabling prediction beyond explored areas.
papers.comment: Accepted at IROS 2026. Main paper: 8 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Includes a supplementary appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自上而下的框架，用于从部分观测的环境中合成层次化3D场景图（scene graph），包括房间层（平面图与可穿越性）和对象层（室内物体布局）。房间层采用新型混合域图扩散模型（mixed-domain graph diffusion model）联合预测房间类别、边界及房间间可穿越性，支持不完整平面图的部分约束；对象层集成现有的混合离散-连续扩散模型预测物体类别、位置、尺寸和朝向。实验表明，该方法在标准基准上优于基于占用率的方法，并能在真实机器人采集数据上进行预测。
Motivation: 现有3D室内场景生成方法多关注单房间物体布局，忽略了机器人应用中重要的高层场景结构（如房间布局和可穿性），且缺乏从部分观测预测未知区域的能力。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：1）房间层：用混合域图扩散模型（mixed-domain graph diffusion model），通过损坏和掩码技术支持部分约束（如不完整平面图），联合预测房间类别、边界和房间间可穿越性；2）对象层：集成现有的混合离散-连续扩散模型，在给定平面图条件下联合预测物体类别、位置、尺寸和朝向。
Result: 在标准基准上，与基于占用率的基线相比，该方法对非分布的部分平面图泛化能力更强，并能在真实机器人采集数据上预测未探索区域。
Conclusion: 论文强调框架在部分观测环境下的预测能力，支持下游探索和物体搜索任务，但未讨论大规模场景或计算效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning-enabled Parameter Synthesis for Nonlinear Systems from Signal Temporal Logic
papers.abstract_en: Signal Temporal Logic (STL) is increasingly used to describe interpretable objectives and constraints for optimal control and learning methods, especially when no target time series data is available. In this work, we propose to synthesize parameters for nonlinear systems that robustly satisfy continuous-time STL specifications for uncertain initial conditions. To this end, we use gradient-based optimization along with set-based reachability verification to efficiently learn in high-dimensional parameter spaces while providing provable satisfaction guarantees for the optimized parameters. We demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of our method on three systems with up to 18 parameter dimensions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非线性系统在不确定初始条件下如何综合参数以满足连续时间信号时序逻辑（STL）规约的问题，提出了一种结合梯度优化和基于集合的可达性验证的方法。该方法能够高效搜索高维参数空间，同时为优化后的参数提供可证明的满足保证。在三个系统上（参数维度最高18）验证了有效性和可扩展性。
Motivation: 现有方法难以在非线性系统中为不确定初始条件提供参数综合的同时保证鲁棒满足STL规约，且高维参数空间下验证成本高。
Method: 采用梯度优化进行参数搜索，结合基于集合的可达性验证（set-based reachability verification）来评估并保证参数对STL规约的鲁棒满意度。
Result: 在三个非线性系统（参数维度最高18）上展示了方法能高效综合出满足STL规约的参数，并提供可证明的鲁棒性保证。
Conclusion: 所提方法将梯度优化与可达性分析结合，为非线性系统参数综合提供了可扩展且可证明的解决方案，适用于高维参数空间。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TRIAGE: Role-Typed Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Agentic reinforcement learning requires assigning credit to environment-facing actions such as searches, clicks, edits, navigation commands, and object interactions. Standard GRPO uses the final verifier outcome as a uniform advantage over all action tokens. This outcome signal is useful but structurally incomplete: it punishes useful exploration in failed rollouts and reinforces redundant or regressive actions in successful rollouts. We propose TRIAGE, a role-typed credit assignment framework that adds a semantic role axis to outcome credit. A structured judge classifies each segment as decisive progress, useful exploration, no-progress infrastructure, or regression, and a fixed role-conditioned rule maps these labels to bounded segment-level process rewards. This keeps verifier outcomes as the source of optimization direction while correcting the two main blind spots of outcome-only credit. We further show that the Bayes-optimal role-measurable correction is the L2 projection of the per-segment advantage residual onto the role variable, and that TRIAGE's fixed role constants approximate this projection, reducing advantage estimation error whenever the judge is reliable; we connect this to lower-variance policy gradients. Across ALFWorld, Search-QA, and WebShop, TRIAGE improves success rates over GRPO for two policy models and outperforms both a scalar judge-derived process reward and an outcome-supervised shared-backbone value baseline. Ablations show that the gain comes from role typing rather than merely adding dense rewards: reliable detection of regression inside successful trajectories is the dominant contributor, while exploration credit provides a consistent secondary gain; on completed ALFWorld and WebShop rollouts, TRIAGE also reduces environment-facing turns by an additional $10.4\%$ and $14.8\%$ relative to GRPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对智能体强化学习中仅使用最终验证结果作为动作令牌统一优势的结构缺陷，提出角色类型信用分配框架TRIAGE。该框架通过结构化法官将每个片段分类为决定性进展、有用探索、无进展基础设施或回归，并基于角色条件规则分配片段级过程奖励，以修正仅基于结果信用的两个盲点。在ALFWorld、Search-QA和WebShop上，TRIAGE在两种策略模型上均优于GRPO，并减少了环境交互步数。
Motivation: 标准GRPO仅使用最终验证结果作为所有动作令牌的统一优势，惩罚了失败轨迹中的有用探索，并在成功轨迹中强化了冗余或倒退动作，导致信用分配结构不完整。
Method: 提出TRIAGE框架，引入语义角色轴，通过结构化法官对片段进行角色分类，并应用固定的角色条件规则映射为有界的过程奖励，同时保持验证结果作为优化方向来源，实现贝叶斯最优的角色可测修正。
Result: 在ALFWorld、Search-QA和WebShop上，TRIAGE相对于GRPO提升了成功率，并在完成的ALFWorld和WebShop轨迹中分别减少了10.4%和14.8%的环境交互步数。消融实验表明，增益主要来自角色类型化而非仅增加密集奖励，其中成功轨迹中回归的可靠检测是主要贡献者。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，角色类型信用分配通过修正仅结果信用的盲点，提高了策略梯度估计的效率，并展示了在多种智能体任务中的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Native Active Perception as Reasoning for Omni-Modal Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Passive models for long video understanding typically rely on a "watch-it-all" paradigm, processing frames uniformly regardless of query difficulty, causing computational cost to grow with video duration. Although interactive frameworks have emerged, they often rely on global pre-scanning, and their context cost still scales with video length. We propose OmniAgent, the first native omni-modal agent that formulates video understanding as a POMDP-based iterative Observation-Thought-Action cycle. OmniAgent executes on-demand actions to selectively distill audio-visual cues into a persistent textual memory, effectively decoupling reasoning complexity from raw video duration. To operationalize this, we introduce (1) Agentic Supervised Fine-Tuning to bootstrap native active perception via best-of-N trajectory synthesis with dual-stage quality control, and (2) Agentic Reinforcement Learning with TAURA (Turn-aware Adaptive Uncertainty Rescaled Advantage), which leverages turn-level entropy to steer credit assignment toward pivotal discovery turns. Crucially, OmniAgent exhibits positive test-time scaling, where performance improves as the number of reasoning turns increases, validating the efficacy of active perception. Empirical results across ten benchmarks (e.g., VideoMME, LVBench) demonstrate that OmniAgent achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models. Notably, on LVBench, our 7B agent outperforms the 10$\times$ larger Qwen2.5-VL-72B (50.5% vs. 47.3%).
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. Code and models: https://github.com/harryhsing/omniagent
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniAgent，首个原生全模态智能体，将长视频理解建模为基于 POMDP 的迭代观察-思考-行动循环。通过选择性提取音视频线索到持久文本记忆，解耦推理复杂度与原始视频时长。在十个基准上达到开源 SOTA，LVBench 上 7B 模型超越 72B 模型。
Motivation: 现有被动视频理解模型计算成本随视频时长线性增长，交互式框架仍需全局预扫描，亟需解耦推理复杂度与视频时长的方法。
Method: 提出 OmniAgent，基于 POMDP 的迭代循环；引入 Agentic 监督微调（通过最佳 N 轨迹合成与双阶段质量引导）和 Agentic 强化学习（TAURA，利用逐轮熵指导信用分配）。
Result: 在 VideoMME、LVBench 等十个基准上达到开源 SOTA，LVBench 上 7B 模型以 50.5% 超越 10 倍大的 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 的 47.3%，并展现正向测试时缩放。
Conclusion: 主动感知框架有效，性能随推理步数增加而提升，验证了将视频理解作为推理过程方法的可行性。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 提出 OmniAgent，基于 POMDP 的迭代循环；引入 Agentic 监督微调（通过最佳 N 轨迹合成与双阶段质量引导）和 Agentic 强化学习（TAURA，利用逐轮熵指导信用分配）。
summary_sections.result: 在 VideoMME、LVBench 等十个基准上达到开源 SOTA，LVBench 上 7B 模型以 50.5% 超越 10 倍大的 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 的 47.3%，并展现正向测试时缩放。
summary_sections.conclusion: 主动感知框架有效，性能随推理步数增加而提升，验证了将视频理解作为推理过程方法的可行性。

papers.title: HairPort: In-context 3D-aware Hair Import and Transfer for Images
papers.abstract_en: Transferring hairstyles between images is an important but challenging task in computer graphics, computer vision, and visual effects. It enables users to explore new looks without physically altering their hair, with applications in virtual try-on systems, augmented reality, and entertainment. Most prior works operate best under small pose gaps, and they fall short under large viewpoint and scale differences, where missing hair content must be synthesized rather than transferred. We propose HairPort, a 3D-aware hairstyle transfer framework that attempts to solve these issues by explicitly separating hair removal from transfer and enforcing geometric consistency before synthesis. We introduce a Bald Converter, which produces realistic bald versions of faces through LoRA-based in-context adaptation of FLUX.1 Kontext. To train our Bald Converter, we introduce a new dataset, Baldy, containing 6,000 paired bald and original images across diverse identities and conditions. We also use a 3D-Aware Transfer Pipeline that reconstructs and re-renders the reference hairstyle from the target viewpoint before compositing it onto the source image. Being 3D aware, our method supports large pose and scale discrepancies between the source and target. Finally, a conditional flow-matching generator synthesizes the transferred result from the bald source and geometry-aligned reference guidance. Together, our method enables accurate, pose-consistent, and identity-preserving hairstyle transfer, outperforming existing methods both qualitatively and quantitatively.
papers.comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH 2026 (Conference Papers Track). 23 pages, 15 figures, 10 tables, including supplementary material as appendices. Project page: https://deepmancer.github.io/HairPort/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HairPort，一个基于 3D 感知的发型迁移框架，通过显式分离头发移除与迁移，并强制几何一致性，支持大姿态和尺度差异下的准确发型转移。方法包括 LoRA 适配的 Bald Converter（生成逼真秃头版本）和 3D 感知迁移流水线（重建并重新渲染参考发型），以及条件流匹配生成器。为训练 Bald Converter 贡献了包含 6000 对图像的 Baldy 数据集。实验表明，该方法在定性和定量上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有发型迁移方法在小姿态差异下表现良好，但在大视角和尺度差异下缺失的头发内容需要合成而非迁移，导致效果不佳。
Method: 引入 Bald Converter（基于 FLUX.1 Kontext 的 LoRA 适配生成逼真秃头版本），使用 Baldy 数据集训练；3D 感知迁移流水线将参考发型从目标视角重建并再渲染，再与秃头源图像合成；最后通过条件流匹配生成器得到最终结果。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在定性和定量上均优于现有方法，支持源和目标之间的大姿态和尺度差异。
Conclusion: HairPort 通过 3D 感知的几何一致性和分离式处理，实现了准确、姿态一致且保持身份的发型迁移。

papers.title: CyberGym-E2E: Scalable Real-World Benchmark for AI Agents' End-to-End Cybersecurity Capabilities
papers.abstract_en: AI has the potential to transform cybersecurity by enabling systems that can autonomously detect, analyze, and remediate software vulnerabilities. However, existing cybersecurity evaluations of AI systems are limited in scale or scope, and fail to capture the end-to-end lifecycle of real-world software vulnerability discovery and remediation. To address this gap, we propose CyberGym-E2E, a large-scale and realistic end-to-end cybersecurity benchmark that comprehensively evaluates AI agents' abilities across the full lifecycle of vulnerability discovery, PoC generation, and patch generation. CyberGym-E2E is comprehensive and scalable, as we build an automated, agent-enhanced pipeline for transforming open-source vulnerability data into realistic evaluation environments. Currently, the benchmark consists of 920 real-world vulnerabilities across 139 different open-source projects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CyberGym-E2E，一个大规模、真实的端到端网络安全基准，用于评估AI智能体在漏洞发现、PoC生成和补丁生成完整生命周期中的能力。该基准通过自动化、agent增强的管道将开源漏洞数据转化为真实评估环境，目前包含139个开源项目的920个真实漏洞。
Motivation: 现有网络安全AI评估在规模和范围上有限，未能覆盖真实软件漏洞发现与修复的端到端生命周期，缺乏全面且可扩展的基准测试。
Method: 构建自动化、agent增强的管道，从开源项目收集漏洞数据并转化为逼真的评估环境，支持漏洞发现、PoC生成和补丁生成三个环节的交互式评估。
Result: 基准包含920个真实漏洞，覆盖139个不同开源项目，提供大规模可复用的测试场景。
Conclusion: CyberGym-E2E填补了端到端网络安全能力评估的空白，但摘要未提及其在具体AI系统上的性能表现或局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CaloTrilogy: Toward a Breakthrough in One-Step, End-to-End, Physics-Guided Shower Generation for Modern Calorimeters
papers.abstract_en: High-precision calorimeter simulation at current and future colliders imposes rapidly growing computational demands, motivating the development of machine-learning surrogates for traditional Monte Carlo tools such as Geant4. Flow matching and diffusion-based generative models have become leading approaches for high-dimensional fast simulation because of their sample quality, but typically require ${\cal O}(100)$ function evaluations at inference and often rely on auxiliary networks to constrain global observables, compromising streamlined end-to-end generation. We introduce a unified framework that improves the balance between speed, shower quality, and physics fidelity. The method combines: (i) an average velocity field integrator that enables sampling in one or a few evaluations; (ii) a learned generative prior in shower space, constructed from data rather than random noise; and (iii) physics-guided loss terms that impose inductive biases on key observables during training. These elements are training time regularizers, preserving end-to-end inference with no additional cost. With only one or a few evaluation steps, the model achieves shower quality competitive with state-of-the-art flow and diffusion approaches, tested on several public high granularity calorimeter datasets. The results demonstrate inter-layer shower structure consistent with the underlying physics, providing a strong candidate for future fast simulation workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高精度量热仪模拟计算需求大的问题，提出一个统一框架，结合平均速度场积分器、数据驱动的生成先验和物理引导损失项，实现一步或几步评估即可生成与最先进流和扩散方法质量相当的簇射样本，并在多层簇射结构上符合物理。
Motivation: 传统蒙特卡洛工具如Geant4计算开销大，而现有生成模型需要多步推理或辅助网络，限制了端到端生成的速度和简洁性。
Method: 提出统一框架，包括：(i) 平均速度场积分器，支持单步或少步采样；(ii) 从数据学习而非随机噪声的生成先验；(iii) 训练时添加物理引导损失项，约束关键可观测量。这些方法作为训练正则化器，不增加推理成本。
Result: 在多个高颗粒度量热仪数据集上，仅用一步或几步评估即可达到与最先进流和扩散模型竞争的簇射质量，并展示出符合物理的层间结构。
Conclusion: 该方法为未来快速模拟工作流程提供了强有力的候选方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structure-Induced Information for Rerooting Levin Tree Search
papers.abstract_en: Subgoal-based policy tree search, which uses a policy to guide search, is effective for complex single-agent deterministic problems but often relies on explicit subgoal generation that can incur substantial overhead and hinders scalability. In this paper, we overcome these limitations by using a learned ``rerooter'' through the recently-introduced $\sqrt{\text{LTS}}$ algorithm. A rerooter implicitly decomposes the problem into soft subtasks. While previous work focused on the formal guarantees for given or handcrafted rerooters, in this work we propose three rerooter designs: (i) a clustering-based rerooter that exploits global state-space structure, (ii) a heuristic-based rerooter that leverages learned cost-to-go estimates, and (iii) a hybrid that combines both signals. Our framework avoids having to explicitly reconstruct and reason over generated subgoals, thereby enabling scalable allocation of search effort with significantly lower computational overhead. Empirically, our rerooting-based methods scale to complex environments where subgoal-based policy tree search fails, and achieve state-of-the-art online training efficiency on the domains tested.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于子目标的策略树搜索中显式子目标生成开销大的问题，提出三种重根器（rerooter）设计（聚类、启发式、混合），在√LTS算法框架下隐式分解问题为软子任务，避免显式重构子目标。实验表明，该方法在复杂环境中优于传统子目标策略树搜索，并取得最先进的在线训练效率。
Motivation: 现有子目标策略树搜索依赖显式子目标生成，计算开销大且限制可扩展性。本文旨在利用学习到的重根器隐式分解问题以克服这些限制。
Method: 基于√LTS算法，提出三种重根器设计：(i) 基于聚类的重根器利用全局状态空间结构；(ii) 基于启发式的重根器利用学习到的代价估计；(iii) 混合两者信号。框架避免显式重构子目标。
Result: 在复杂环境中，重根方法能扩展到子目标策略树搜索失败的任务，并在测试领域取得最先进的在线训练效率。
Conclusion: 本文证明通过隐式软子任务分解和重根器设计，可显著降低计算开销并提高Levin树搜索的可扩展性。

papers.title: Geometry Adaptive Counterfactual Distribution Learning with Diffusion-Guided Smoothing
papers.abstract_en: We study counterfactual distribution learning for high-dimensional outcomes whose laws may concentrate near lower-dimensional structure. Standard isotropic smoothing ignores this geometry, leading to unfavorable scaling and unstable local inference. We propose semiparametrically debiased, diffusion-guided estimators for smoothed counterfactual densities and their scores. These estimators combine causal nuisance adjustment with geometry-adaptive localization driven by a learned diffusion score, yielding second-order nuisance remainders while aligning smoothing with local outcome geometry. We derive asymptotic expansions, integrated risk bounds, and simultaneous inference for smoothed densities and Stein functionals, with extensions to ambient density and score targets under additional approximation conditions. The variance term in the risk bounds is governed by the concentration of the smoothing operator: suitable geometric conditions yield intrinsic rather than ambient scaling, while an explicit drift term quantifies the cost of estimating the geometry. CelebA-based semi-synthetic experiments show faster error decay and improved stability for geometry-adaptive one-step methods, illustrating their applicability to high-dimensional embeddings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究高维结果的反事实分布学习，其中分布可能集中在低维结构附近。标准各向同性平滑忽略了几何结构，导致不良缩放和不稳定局部推断。作者提出半参数去偏、扩散引导的估计器，用于平滑反事实密度及其得分，结合因果干扰调整和由学习扩散得分驱动的几何自适应定位，实现二阶干扰余项。基于CelebA的半合成实验显示几何自适应一步法具有更快的误差衰减和改进的稳定性。
Motivation: 标准各向同性平滑用于反事实分布学习时忽略高维结果的内在几何结构，导致缩放不利和局部推断不稳定。
Method: 提出半参数去偏、扩散引导的估计器，利用学习到的扩散得分进行几何自适应定位，结合因果干扰调整，实现二阶噪声余项。
Result: 推导了渐近展开、积分风险界和联合推断；基于CelebA的半合成实验显示几何自适应一步法误差衰减更快、稳定性更好。
Conclusion: 摘要强调几何自适应平滑可以改善高维反事实分布学习的缩放和稳定性，风险界由平滑算子的集中性决定。

papers.title: AQKA: Active Quantum Kernel Acquisition Under a Shot Budget
papers.abstract_en: Estimating an $N \times N$ quantum kernel from circuit fidelities requires $Θ(N^2 S)$ measurement shots, the dominant bottleneck for deployment on near-term hardware. Existing budget-saving methods (Nyström-QKE, ShoFaR, kernel-target alignment) sub-sample \emph{which} entries to measure but allocate shots \emph{uniformly} within their chosen subset, ignoring how much each entry drives the downstream classifier. We close this gap with two contributions. \textbf{First, a complete regime decomposition} for shot-budgeted quantum kernel learning: a principled menu of when each allocator wins. Our method, \emph{AQKA}, dominates the budget-limited regime ($B \lesssim 16 n_{\mathrm{pairs}}$) on sparse-sensitivity KRR, with the gap \emph{growing} from $+8$ to $+25$ pts over uniform as $N$ scales $225{\to}1000$ and reaching $+26$--$32$ pts on an \texttt{ibm\_pittsburgh} (156-qubit Heron) hardware kernel; Nyström-QKE wins at saturating budgets on planted-sparse via low-rank reconstruction; ShoFaR is competitive only at extreme low budgets. \textbf{Second, a closed-form pair-level acquisition theory}: $s_{ij}^{\star} \propto |g_{ij}|\sqrt{K_{ij}(1-K_{ij})}$ with explicit gradient $g_{ij}$ for KRR (Lemma~1, $|β_iα_j+β_jα_i|\sqrt{K_{ij}(1-K_{ij})}$) and SVM via the envelope theorem ($|η_i^*η_j^*|\sqrt{K_{ij}(1-K_{ij})}$); a \emph{corrected} sparsity-aware Cauchy--Schwarz rate $ρ\le 2m/N$ matching empirics (vs.\ the naive $m^2/N^2$); an explicit-constant plug-in regret bound (Theorem~2); and a tighter SVM ceiling $ρ^{\mathrm{SVM}} \le m_{\mathrm{sv}}^2/N^2$. We close with the first multi-seed live online adaptive shot allocation on quantum hardware: $+17.0 \pm 4.8$ pts at $N{=}20$ on \texttt{ibm\_aachen} ($3.5σ$, 5 seeds), with the advantage holding at $N{=}30$ at higher budget on \texttt{ibm\_berlin} ($+14.0 \pm 8.5$ pts, 5 seeds).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对量子核估计中测量预算有限的瓶颈，提出主动量子核获取方法（AQKA），在预算有限时优于均匀分配基线，并在量子硬件上验证了自适应分配的有效性。
Motivation: 现有预算节约方法（如Nyström-QKE）子采样核条目但均匀分配shots，忽略了各条目对下游分类器的贡献差异，导致预算利用率低。
Method: 提出AQKA，包含完整的预算区间分解和闭式逐对获取理论：最优分配比例$s_{ij}^* \propto |g_{ij}|\sqrt{K_{ij}(1-K_{ij})}$，其中$g_{ij}$对KRR和SVM分别给出显式梯度；同时推导了稀疏感知的Cauchy-Schwarz率$\rho \le 2m/N$及后悔界。
Result: 在预算有限区间（$B \lesssim 16 n_{\mathrm{pairs}}$）AQKA主导稀疏敏感KRR，与均匀分配相比差距随$N$从225增至1000而扩大（+8→+25pts），在ibm_pittsburgh硬件核上达+26–32pts；在ibm_aachen上$N=20$时提升$+17.0\pm4.8$pts（$3.5\sigma$），在ibm_berlin上$N=30$时提升$+14.0\pm8.5$pts。
Conclusion: 证明了在预算有限时主动分配shots可获得显著增益，并提供了完整的理论分析和硬件验证。

papers.title: FETS Benchmark: Foundation Models Enable Scalable and Generalizable Energy Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Driven by the transition towards a climate-neutral energy system, accurate energy time series forecasting is critical for planning and operations. Yet, it remains a dataset-specific task, requiring comprehensive training data, limiting scalability, and resulting in high model development and maintenance effort. Recently, foundation models aiming to learn generalizable patterns via extensive pretraining have shown strong performance in multiple prediction tasks. Despite their success and strong potential in energy forecasting, a systematic, use-case-differentiated evaluation is still missing. We address this gap by presenting the Foundation Models in Energy Time Series Forecasting (FETS) benchmark. We (1) provide a structured overview of energy forecasting use cases along three main dimensions, i.e., stakeholders, attributes, and data categories, (2) curate 54 datasets across 9 data categories, guided by typical stakeholder interests, and (3) benchmark foundation models against task-specific machine learning across different forecasting settings. In our benchmark study, covariate-informed zero-shot foundation models perform best in aggregate, with Chronos-2 attaining the lowest overall median NRMSE (0.472), closely followed by TiRex-2 (0.474). Both perform better than XGBoost (0.611) and random forest (0.696), although they were trained task-specifically on the full historic target data. Further analysis reveals a strong correlation between predictive performance and spectral entropy. Performance saturates beyond a certain context length and improves with aggregation level, e.g., for national load, district heating, and power grid data. Overall, with the lowest median error, limited data requirements, and low inference and hardware demands, foundation models reduce development and maintenance effort, emerging as scalable and generalizable energy forecasting solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FETS基准，系统评估基础模型在能源时间序列预测中的可扩展性和泛化能力。通过构建54个数据集和9个数据类别，对比基础模型与任务特定机器学习方法，发现协变量引导的零样本基础模型（如Chronos-2和TiRex-2）在总体中表现最佳，中位NRMSE分别为0.472和0.474，优于XGBoost（0.611）和随机森林（0.696），且性能与谱熵强相关，饱和于一定上下文长度并随聚合水平提升。基础模型降低了开发和维护成本，成为可扩展的能源预测方案。
Motivation: 现有能源时间序列预测任务依赖数据集特定训练，缺乏可扩展性和泛化性，且基础模型在该领域的系统评估尚缺失。
Method: 构建FETS基准，包括结构化能源预测用例维度（利益相关者、属性、数据类别）、54个多样化数据集，以及基础模型与任务特定机器学习（如XGBoost、随机森林）的对比实验。
Result: 协变量引导的零样本基础模型（Chronos-2中位NRMSE 0.472，TiRex-2 0.474）优于任务特定训练的XGBoost（0.611）和随机森林（0.696）；性能与谱熵强相关，上下文长度和聚合水平影响显著。
Conclusion: 基础模型在能源时间序列预测中展现出可扩展性和泛化性，降低了开发维护成本，但性能受谱熵、上下文长度和聚合水平影响。

papers.title: WP-MIP: An Artificial Intelligence, Hybrid, and Physically Based Model Intercomparison Project for Weather Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Rapid progress in the field of machine-learning for weather prediction has led to the emergence of algorithms whose forecasting skill can exceed that of traditional physically based models. This development represents an opportunity to improve the quality of forecasting services provided by operational centers, particularly given the speed at which machine-learning based models generate predictions. Despite the clear promise of these systems, questions remain about the ability of the current generation of machine-learning models to generate physically consistent predictions of the full suite of required forecast fields under all conditions. Answering these questions will require careful comparisons between the well-understood physically based models, current state-of-the-art machine-learning models, and the hybrid models that combine elements of these two archetypes. The Weather Prediction Model Intercomparison Project (WP-MIP) is a World Meteorological Organization-supported initiative whose initial goal is to create a centralized database of physically based, machine-learning, and hybrid model forecasts to enable a distributed assessment and evaluation effort. The first instance of WP-MIP focuses on global deterministic predictions using both center-specific and common initializations to facilitate sensitivity studies. Forecasts contributed by institutions across six continents will be used to develop AI-ready verification techniques that highlight the strengths and weaknesses of each class of prediction system, with the goal of establishing best-practice guidance to model developers and national weather centers. The broad engagement of the operational and forecast-evaluation communities in WP-MIP will ensure that the project results are highly relevant to the development and deployment of next-generation weather prediction systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WP-MIP 是世界气象组织支持的天气预测模型比较项目，旨在建立包含物理模型、机器学习模型和混合模型预报的集中式数据库，以促进分布式评估。初始阶段聚焦全球确定性预报，使用中心特定和通用初始化进行敏感性研究，来自六大洲的预报将用于开发 AI 就绪的验证技术，突出各类预测系统的优缺点。
Motivation: 机器学习在天气预测中快速发展，但当前模型的物理一致性仍有存疑，需要与传统物理模型和混合模型进行系统比较。
Method: 创建集中式数据库，收集物理模型、机器学习模型和混合模型的预报结果，采用中心特定和通用初始化，通过分布式评估开发验证技术。
Result: 项目将产出 AI 就绪的验证技术，识别各类预测系统的强弱项，并为模型开发者和国家气象中心提供最佳实践指导。
Conclusion: WP-MIP 通过广泛的操作和评估社区参与，确保结果对下一代天气预测系统的开发和部署具有高度相关性。
Relevance: 70

papers.title: Deterministic Hallucination Detection in Medical VQA via Confidence-Evidence Bayesian Gain
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for medical Visual Question Answering (VQA), yet they remain prone to hallucinations, defined as generating responses that contradict the input image, posing serious risks in clinical settings. Current hallucination detection methods, such as Semantic Entropy (SE) and Vision-Amplified Semantic Entropy (VASE), require 10 to 20 stochastic generations per sample together with an external natural language inference model for semantic clustering, making them computationally expensive and difficult to deploy in practice. We observe that hallucinated responses exhibit a distinctive signature directly in the model's own log-probabilities: inconsistent token-level confidence and weak sensitivity to visual evidence. Based on this observation, we propose Confidence-Evidence Bayesian Gain (CEBaG), a deterministic hallucination detection method that requires no stochastic sampling, no external models, and no task-specific hyperparameters. CEBaG combines two complementary signals: token-level predictive variance, which captures inconsistent confidence across response tokens, and evidence magnitude, which measures how much the image shifts per-token predictions relative to text-only inference. Evaluated across four medical MLLMs and three VQA benchmarks (16 experimental settings), CEBaG achieves the highest AUC in 13 of 16 settings and improves over VASE by 8 AUC points on average, while being fully deterministic and self-contained. https://github.com/masadi-99/CEBaG
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种确定性幻觉检测方法 Confidence-Evidence Bayesian Gain (CEBaG)，用于多模态大模型在医学视觉问答中的幻觉检测。该方法无需随机采样、外部模型或任务特定超参数，利用 token 级预测方差和证据幅值两个互补信号，在四个医学 MLLM 和三个 VQA 基准的 16 个实验设置中，13 个达到最高 AUC，平均比 VASE 提升 8 个 AUC 点。
Motivation: 现有幻觉检测方法如 Semantic Entropy (SE) 和 Vision-Amplified Semantic Entropy (VASE) 需要多次随机生成和外部自然语言推理模型，计算成本高且难以部署；而医学 VQA 中幻觉会带来临床风险，亟需高效且自包含的检测方法。
Method: 提出 CEBaG，组合两个互补信号：token 级预测方差（捕捉跨 token 的不一致置信度）和证据幅值（衡量图像相对于纯文本推理对逐 token 预测的偏移量），直接基于模型自身的 log-probability 计算，无需随机采样、外部模型或超参数。
Result: 在四个医学 MLLM 和三个 VQA 基准的 16 个实验设置中，CEBaG 在 13 个设置中取得最高 AUC，平均比 VASE 提高 8 个 AUC 点，且完全确定性和自包含。
Conclusion: CEBaG 提供了一种计算高效、无需外部资源的确定性幻觉检测方法，适用于医学 VQA，但其通用性仅限于多模态大模型的幻觉检测领域。

papers.title: FormulaCode: Evaluating Agentic Optimization on Large Codebases
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) coding agents increasingly operate at the repository level, motivating benchmarks that evaluate their ability to optimize entire codebases under realistic constraints. Existing code benchmarks largely rely on synthetic tasks, binary correctness signals, or single-objective evaluation, limiting their ability to assess holistic optimization behavior. We introduce FormulaCode, a benchmark for evaluating agentic optimization on large, real-world codebases with fine-grained, multi-objective performance metrics. FormulaCode comprises 957 performance bottlenecks mined from scientific Python repositories on GitHub, each paired with expert-authored patches and, on average, 264.6 community-maintained performance workloads per task, enabling the holistic ability of LLM agents to optimize codebases under realistic correctness and performance constraints. Our evaluations reveal that repository-scale, multi-objective optimization remains a major challenge for frontier LLM agents. Project website at: https://formula-code.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FormulaCode，一个用于评估LLM代码代理在大型真实代码库上进行多目标优化的基准。该基准包含957个从科学Python仓库中挖掘的性能瓶颈，每个任务附带专家修补和平均264.6个社区维护的性能工作负载。评估表明，仓库级多目标优化对前沿LLM代理仍是重大挑战。
Motivation: 现有代码基准多依赖合成任务、二元正确性信号或单目标评估，难以评估代理对大型代码库的全面优化行为，需要更真实、细粒度、多目标的评估基准。
Method: 从GitHub科学Python仓库中挖掘性能瓶颈，构建包含957个任务的基准，每个任务配有专家修补的补丁和平均264.6个社区维护的性能工作负载，用于细粒度多目标评估。
Result: 评估结果显示，仓库级多目标优化对前沿LLM代理仍是重大挑战。
Conclusion: FormulaCode基准揭示了当前LLM代理在现实代码优化中的不足，为未来研究提供了评估基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NEMO: Execution-Aware Optimization Modeling via Autonomous Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: We present NEMO, a system that translates Natural-language descriptions of decision problems into formal Executable Mathematical Optimization implementations using autonomous coding agents (ACAs). Existing approaches rely on specialized large language models (LLMs) or bespoke task-specific agents that are often brittle and frequently generate syntactically invalid or non-executable code. NEMO instead treats ACAs as a first-class abstraction analogous to API-based interaction with LLMs; their sandboxed execution guarantees code is executable by construction and supports automated validation and repair. We introduce novel coordination patterns including asymmetric validation loops between independently generated optimizer and simulator implementations, external memory for experience reuse, and robustness enhancements via minimum Bayes risk (MBR) decoding and self-consistency. Across nine established optimization benchmarks, NEMO achieves state-of-the-art performance on the majority of tasks with substantial margins on several datasets, demonstrating the power of execution-aware agentic architectures for automated optimization modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NEMO 是一个利用自主编码代理 (ACA) 将自然语言决策问题自动转化为可执行数学优化实现的系统。它通过沙盒执行保证代码可执行，并引入不对称验证循环、外部记忆和最小贝叶斯风险解码等新协调模式。在九个优化基准上，NEMO 在多数任务上达到最佳性能，并在若干数据集上显著领先。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖专用大语言模型或特定任务代理，往往生成语法无效或不可执行的代码，缺乏鲁棒性。
Method: 将自主编码代理作为一等抽象，类似于基于 API 的 LLM 交互；采用沙盒执行确保代码可执行，并设计不对称验证循环、外部记忆复用和最小贝叶斯风险 (MBR) 解码与自一致性增强鲁棒性。
Result: 在九个优化基准上，NEMO 在多数任务上取得最优性能，并在多个数据集上大幅领先。
Conclusion: 执行感知的代理架构在自动化优化建模中潜力巨大，NEMO 的设计原则可泛化至其他领域。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 执行感知的代理架构在自动化优化建模中潜力巨大，NEMO 的设计原则可泛化至其他领域。

papers.title: STARCaster: Spatio-Temporal AutoRegressive Video Diffusion for Identity- and View-Aware Talking Portraits
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents STARCaster, an identity-aware spatio-temporal video diffusion model that addresses both speech-driven portrait animation and dynamic viewpoint control, given an identity embedding or reference image, within a unified framework. Existing 2D speech-to-video diffusion models depend heavily on reference guidance, leading to limited motion diversity. At the same time, 3D-aware animation typically relies on inversion through pretrained tri-plane generators, which often leads to imperfect reconstructions and identity drift. We rethink reference- and geometry-based paradigms in two ways. First, we deviate from strict reference conditioning at pretraining by introducing softer identity constraints. Second, we address 3D awareness implicitly within the 2D video domain by leveraging the inherent multi-view nature of video data. STARCaster adopts a compositional approach progressing from ID-aware motion modeling, to audio-visual synchronization via lip reading-based supervision, and finally to novel view animation through temporal-to-spatial adaptation. To overcome the scarcity of 4D audio-visual data, we propose a decoupled learning approach in which view consistency and temporal coherence are trained independently. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that STARCaster generalizes effectively across tasks and identities, consistently surpassing prior approaches in different benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STARCaster 提出了一种统一的身份感知时空视频扩散模型，用于语音驱动的肖像动画和动态视角控制。该方法通过软身份约束、隐式3D意识（利用视频的多视角特性）以及解耦学习（分别训练视角一致性和时间连贯性）来克服现有方法的运动多样性不足和身份漂移问题。评估表明其在多个基准上超越先前方法。
Motivation: 现有2D语音驱动视频扩散模型过度依赖参考引导导致运动多样性有限，而3D感知动画依赖预训练三平面生成器导致重建不完美和身份漂移。需要一种无需严格参考条件且具有3D意识的统一框架。
Method: 提出组合式方法：从身份感知运动建模开始，通过唇读监督进行音视频同步，最后通过时空适配实现新视角动画。采用解耦学习分别训练视角一致性和时间连贯性以缓解4D音视频数据稀缺问题。
Result: 摘要报告STARCaster在多个基准上一致超越先前方法，且能有效跨任务和跨身份泛化。
Conclusion: 该工作表明通过软身份约束和隐式3D建模，可以统一语音驱动动画和视角控制，无需显式3D几何重建。

papers.title: Geometry Denoising with Preferred Normal Vectors
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a new paradigm for geometry denoising using prior knowledge about the surface normal vector. This prior knowledge comes in the form of a set of preferred normal vectors, which we refer to as label vectors. A segmentation problem is naturally embedded in the denoising process. The segmentation is based on the similarity of the normal vector to the elements of the set of label vectors. Regularization is achieved by a total variation term. We formulate a split Bregman (ADMM) approach to solve the resulting optimization problem. The vertex update step is based on second-order shape calculus. We present various examples including the denoising of an eroded medieval gravestone inscription.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用法向量先验知识的几何去噪新范式。先验知识以一组偏好法向量（称为标签向量）的形式给出，去噪过程中自然嵌入了基于法向量与标签向量集相似性的分割问题，并通过全变差项进行正则化。作者采用分裂布雷格曼（ADMM）方法求解优化问题，顶点更新步骤基于二阶形状导数，并在侵蚀的中世纪墓石铭文去噪等实例上展示了效果。
Motivation: 现有几何去噪方法通常仅依赖局部几何信息，缺乏对表面法向量方向的明确先验知识，难以处理复杂结构的分割与去噪耦合问题。
Method: 引入一组偏好法向量（标签向量），将分割问题嵌入去噪过程；通过测量法向量与标签向量的相似性进行分割，并用全变差项正则化；采用分裂布雷格曼（ADMM）算法求解，顶点更新基于二阶形状导数。
Result: 摘要报告了多个去噪实例，包括侵蚀的中世纪墓石铭文，表明方法能有效恢复带分割的几何形状。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了利用法向量先验进行几何去噪的可行性，并自然实现了分割与去噪的联合优化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multivariate Time Series Forecasting with Gate-Based Quantum Reservoir Computing on NISQ Hardware
papers.abstract_en: Quantum reservoir computing (QRC) offers a hardware-friendly approach to temporal learning, yet most studies target univariate signals and overlook near-term hardware constraints. This work introduces a gate-based QRC for multivariate time series (MTS-QRC) that pairs injection and memory qubits and uses a Trotterized nearest-neighbor transverse-field Ising evolution optimized for current device connectivity and depth. On Lorenz-63 and ENSO, the method achieves a mean square error (MSE) of 0.0087 and 0.0036, respectively, performing on par with classical reservoir computing on Lorenz and above learned RNNs on both, while NVAR and clustered ESN remain stronger on some settings. On IBM Heron R2, MTS-QRC sustains accuracy with realistic depths and, interestingly, outperforms a noiseless simulator on ENSO; singular value analysis indicates that device noise can concentrate variance in feature directions, acting as an implicit regularizer for linear readout in this regime. These findings support the practicality of gate-based QRC for MTS forecasting on NISQ hardware and motivate systematic studies on when and how hardware noise benefits QRC readouts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于门的量子储层计算方法（MTS-QRC），用于多变量时间序列预测。该方法通过注入和记忆量子比特配对，并使用Trotterized近邻横向场Ising演化以适应NISQ硬件约束。在Lorenz-63和ENSO数据集上，MSE分别达到0.0087和0.0036，性能优于学习型RNN，与经典储层计算相当。在IBM Heron R2硬件上，MTS-QRC在现实噪声下保持准确性，且噪声可作为隐式正则化器。
Motivation: 现有量子储层计算研究多集中于单变量信号，且未充分重视近期硬件的实际约束；本文旨在开发兼容NISQ硬件的多变量时间序列预测方法。
Method: 提出MTS-QRC架构，采用注入和记忆量子比特配对，利用Trotterized近邻横向场Ising演化（针对当前设备连接性和深度优化），并通过线性读出进行训练。
Result: 在Lorenz-63和ENSO上取得MSE 0.0087和0.0036；单变量任务中与经典RC持平，优于RNN；NVAR和聚类ESN在部分设置下更强。在IBM Heron R2上，真实噪声下精度保持，且ENSO上优于无噪声模拟器。
Conclusion: 该方法证明了门控QRC在NISQ硬件上进行多变量时间序列预测的实用性，硬件噪声可作为隐式正则化器；未来需系统研究噪声何时及如何有益于QRC读出。

papers.title: Benchmarking Agentic Newswriting via Journalistic Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in autonomous digital agents from industry (e.g., Manus AI and Gemini's research mode) highlight their potential for structured tasks through autonomous decision-making and task decomposition, but it remains unclear how well such systems support real-world information-intensive workflows. We study this question in journalism, where newswriting requires iterative planning, contextual reasoning, and active discovery of missing background to produce a coherent article. We introduce NEWSAGENT, a benchmark for evaluating how agents search raw materials, select relevant information, and iteratively revise drafts through core journalistic functions. Given a writing instruction and partial firsthand materials, agents must identify narrative perspectives, issue keyword-based queries, retrieve historical context, and generate complete news articles. Unlike typical summarization or retrieval tasks, essential context is not directly available and must be actively discovered, reflecting real-world reporting constraints. NEWSAGENT consists of 6k human-verified examples derived from real news. We evaluate open- and closed-sourced LLMs with commonly-used agentic frameworks on NEWSAGENT, which shows that agents are capable of retrieving relevant facts but struggling with planning and narrative integration. We believe that NEWSAGENT serves a realistic testbed for iterating and evaluating agent capabilities in terms of web data manipulation to real-world productivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 NEWSAGENT，一个评估自主智能体在新闻写作中执行信息密集型工作流能力的基准。该基准包含 6000 个人工验证的实例，要求智能体根据写作指令和部分一手资料，通过主动发现缺失背景、识别叙事角度、生成查询并迭代撰写完整新闻文章。评估显示，现有智能体能检索相关事实，但在规划与叙事整合方面存在困难。
Motivation: 现有自主智能体在结构化任务中表现出潜力，但在真实世界信息密集型工作流（如新闻写作）中的能力尚不明确。缺乏一个反映实际报道约束（主动发现缺失背景）的评估基准。
Method: 构建 NEWSAGENT 基准，包含 6000 个来源于真实新闻的示例。给定写作指令和部分一手资料，智能体需执行核心新闻功能：识别叙事角度、基于关键词查询、检索历史上下文、生成完整新闻文章。评估了开源和闭源 LLM 结合常见智能体框架的表现。
Result: 摘要报告智能体能检索相关事实，但在规划与叙事整合上表现不佳。
Conclusion: NEWSAGENT 可作为评估智能体在真实生产力场景中操控网络数据能力的现实测试平台。

papers.title: Neural Conditional Simulation for Complex Spatial Processes
papers.abstract_en: A key objective in spatial statistics is to simulate from the distribution of a spatial process at a selection of unobserved locations conditional on observations (i.e., a predictive distribution) to enable spatial prediction and uncertainty quantification. However, exact conditional simulation from this predictive distribution is intractable or inefficient for many spatial process models. In this paper, we propose neural conditional simulation (NCS), a general method for spatial conditional simulation that is based on neural diffusion models. Specifically, using spatial masks, we implement a conditional score-based diffusion model that evolves Gaussian noise into samples from a predictive distribution when given a partially observed spatial field and spatial process parameters as inputs. The diffusion model relies on a neural network that only requires unconditional samples from the spatial process for training. Once trained, the diffusion model is amortized with respect to the observations in the partially observed field, the number and locations of those observations, and the spatial process parameters, and can therefore be used to conditionally simulate from a broad class of predictive distributions without retraining the neural network. We assess the NCS-generated simulations against simulations from the true conditional distribution of a Gaussian process model, and against Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) simulations from a Brown--Resnick process model for spatial extremes. In the latter case, we show that it is more efficient and accurate to conditionally simulate using NCS than classical MCMC techniques. We also demonstrate the use of NCS to predict spatial extremes in the Red Sea. We conclude that NCS enables efficient and accurate conditional simulation from spatial predictive distributions that are challenging to sample from using traditional methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出神经条件模拟（NCS），一种基于神经扩散模型的空间条件模拟方法。该方法通过空间掩码实现条件得分扩散模型，仅需无条件样本训练，可对部分观测场、观测位置和参数进行摊销，无需重新训练。在布朗-雷斯尼克过程模型上，NCS比MCMC更高效准确，并用于红海空间极值预测。
Motivation: 精确的条件模拟在许多空间过程模型中难以处理或低效，传统方法（如MCMC）计算成本高，需要一种通用且高效的方法。
Method: 提出神经条件模拟（NCS），使用条件得分扩散模型，通过空间掩码将部分观测场和参数作为输入，从无条件样本训练，实现摊销条件模拟。
Result: 在布朗-雷斯尼克过程模型上，NCS比经典MCMC更高效准确；在红海极值预测中展示了实际应用。
Conclusion: NCS能高效准确地从传统方法难以采样的空间预测分布中进行条件模拟，具有通用性。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Can Interpretation Predict Behavior on Unseen Data?
papers.abstract_en: Interpretability research often predicts model responses to targeted mechanistic interventions. But can we predict responses to unseen input data? We propose and demonstrate this alternate objective by using model internals to predict their out-of-distribution (OOD) behavior. We train hundreds of Transformers on simple synthetic tasks, where perfect in-distribution accuracy is compatible with multiple OOD generalization rules. We successfully use attention patterns -- observed only on in-distribution data -- to predict which rule each model follows on OOD data. Our experiments decouple the mechanistic faithfulness of our interpretation from its predictive value; ablations reveal such internal patterns can suppress rather than support the rule they predict, showing observational analysis can forecast behavior even when causal analysis fails to support a simple cause-effect link. Our findings are a proof-of-concept for a new interpretability objective: understanding model internals to predict behavior and assess reliability under distribution shift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可解释性研究的新目标：利用模型内部表示（特别是注意力模式）来预测模型在未见过的分布外（OOD）数据上的行为。在简单合成任务上训练数百个Transformer，发现仅凭分布内数据上的注意力模式就能预测每个模型在OOD数据上遵循的泛化规则。实验将解释机制的忠实度与预测价值分离，表明观测分析即使在没有明确因果联系时也能预测行为。
Motivation: 现有可解释性研究通常预测模型对针对性干预的反应，但较少关注如何利用模型内部状态预测其对全新输入数据的响应，尤其是在分布偏移下评估模型可靠性。
Method: 在多种简单合成任务上训练数百个Transformer，确保训练精度完美但存在多种可能的OOD泛化规则；仅使用分布内数据上的注意力模式（attention patterns）作为特征，预测每个模型在OOD数据上遵循的特定规则。
Result: 成功仅凭分布内注意力模式预测了每个模型在OOD数据上的泛化规则；消融实验发现，这些注意力模式有时会抑制而非支持它们所预测的规则，表明观测分析可预测行为即使因果分析未能建立简单因果关系。
Conclusion: 本研究是概念验证，展示了一种新的可解释性目标：通过理解模型内部状态预测行为并评估分布偏移下的可靠性，且强调解释的预测价值可与因果忠实度解耦。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一个可解释性研究的新目标：利用模型内部表示（特别是注意力模式）来预测模型在未见过的分布外（OOD）数据上的行为。在简单合成任务上训练数百个Transformer，发现仅凭分布内数据上的注意力模式就能预测每个模型在OOD数据上遵循的泛化规则。实验将解释机制的忠实度与预测价值分离，表明观测分析即使在没有明确因果联系时也能预测行为。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有可解释性研究通常预测模型对针对性干预的反应，但较少关注如何利用模型内部状态预测其对全新输入数据的响应，尤其是在分布偏移下评估模型可靠性。
summary_sections.method: 在多种简单合成任务上训练数百个Transformer，确保训练精度完美但存在多种可能的OOD泛化规则；仅使用分布内数据上的注意力模式（attention patterns）作为特征，预测每个模型在OOD数据上遵循的特定规则。
summary_sections.result: 成功仅凭分布内注意力模式预测了每个模型在OOD数据上的泛化规则；消融实验发现，这些注意力模式有时会抑制而非支持它们所预测的规则，表明观测分析可预测行为即使因果分析未能建立简单因果关系。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本研究是概念验证，展示了一种新的可解释性目标：通过理解模型内部状态预测行为并评估分布偏移下的可靠性，且强调解释的预测价值可与因果忠实度解耦。

papers.title: Contour Errors: Ego-Centric Matching for 3D Multi-Object Tracking Performance Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Open-loop performance evaluation of 3D multi-object tracking in autonomous driving requires matching criteria that effectively penalize translational, shape, and orientation errors from the ego vehicle perspective. The prevailing criteria for determining true positives are Intersection over Union (IoU) and Centre-Point Distances (CPD). When IoU is extended from the 2D image plane to 3D volumetric overlap, it often falls below its acceptance threshold even with minor yaw misalignments, whereas CPD disregards orientation entirely. To address this limitation, we propose Contour Errors (CE) as an ego-centric criterion that employs Hausdorff-type reasoning to sparse bounding-box corner geometry by selecting the k-nearest ego-centric corners. This method provides a graded orientation sensitivity between the extremes of IoU, which overpenalizes, and CPD, which is orientation-blind. We evaluate Contour Errors against six baselines using the HOTA evaluation protocol on the nuScenes dataset, conditioned on proximity, yaw error, and a confidence threshold. At the standard IoU vehicle threshold, 47% of car and 75% of pedestrian CE-valid matches are rejected by IoU despite close contour proximity, while fewer than 0.1% of IoU-valid matches fail CE, resulting in a 4.2% higher match rate relative to total ground truth annotations. These results establish the ego-centric matching criterion as a primary factor for improving open-loop perception evaluation in safety-critical autonomous driving.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动驾驶中3D多目标跟踪的开放环路性能评估，提出一种以自我为中心的匹配准则Contour Errors (CE)，基于Hausdorff思想选择k近邻自我中心角点，在IoU（过度惩罚方位误差）和CPD（忽略方位）之间提供分级方位敏感性。在nuScenes数据集上使用HOTA评估协议，结果表明在标准IoU车辆阈值下，47%的汽车和75%的行人CE有效匹配被IoU拒绝，而IoU有效匹配中仅不到0.1%被CE拒绝，匹配率提高4.2%。
Motivation: 现有3D多目标跟踪评估中，IoU对微小偏航角过度惩罚，而中心点距离（CPD）完全忽略方向，缺乏有效的自我中心匹配准则。
Method: 提出Contour Errors (CE)，通过选择稀疏边界框角点几何的k近邻自我中心角点，采用Hausdorff类推理，提供介于IoU和CPD之间的分级方向敏感性。
Result: 在nuScenes数据集上，标准IoU车辆阈值下，47%的汽车和75%的行人CE有效匹配被IoU拒绝，而仅不到0.1%的IoU有效匹配被CE拒绝，匹配率提高4.2%。
Conclusion: 自我中心匹配准则可作为安全关键自动驾驶中开放环路感知评估的主要因素。

papers.title: Sign-SZPO: Provable Preference-based Reinforcement Learning with an Unknown Link Function
papers.abstract_en: The link function, which characterizes the relationship between the preference for two trajectories and their returns, is a crucial component in designing RL algorithms that learn from preference feedback. Most existing methods, both theoretical and empirical, assume that the link function is known (often a logistic function based on the Bradley-Terry model), which is arguably restrictive given the complex nature of preferences, especially those of humans. To avoid mis-specification, this paper studies preference-based RL with an unknown link function and proposes a novel zeroth-order policy optimization algorithm called Sign-SZPO. Unlike typical zeroth-order methods, which rely on the known link function to estimate the value function differences and form a gradient estimator, Sign-SZPO only estimates the sign of the value function difference. It then constructs a parameter update direction that is positively correlated with the true policy gradient, eliminating the need to know the link function exactly. Under mild conditions, Sign-SZPO provably converges to a stationary policy with a polynomial rate in the number of policy iterations and trajectories per iteration. Empirical evaluations further demonstrate the robustness of Sign-SZPO under link function mis-specifications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究链接函数未知的基于偏好的强化学习（preference-based RL），提出零阶策略优化算法Sign-SZPO。该算法仅估计值函数差的符号，而非准确值，从而无需知道链接函数的具体形式。理论证明在温和条件下，Sign-SZPO以多项式率收敛到平稳策略，实验展示了对链接函数误设的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有基于偏好的RL方法通常假设链接函数已知（如Bradley-Terry模型中的逻辑函数），但实际中人类偏好复杂，链接函数易误设。为此，本文研究链接函数未知时的偏好RL问题。
Method: 提出Sign-SZPO算法，它是一种零阶策略优化方法，通过仅估计值函数差的符号来构造与真实策略梯度正相关的参数更新方向，从而避免依赖链接函数的具体形式。
Result: 理论证明Sign-SZPO在策略迭代次数和每轮轨迹数上以多项式速率收敛到平稳策略。实验验证了在链接函数误设下算法的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: Sign-SZPO消除了对链接函数精确知识的需求，为实际偏好学习提供了更鲁棒的方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: STRATA: A Name-and-Geography Race Inference Model for Fair Lending and Housing Equity Applications
papers.abstract_en: Accurate imputation of race and ethnicity (R&E) is essential for fair lending compliance under ECOA, HMDA, and the Community Reinvestment Act, where up to 15% of mortgage applications carry missing race data and regulated institutions bear responsibility for identifying disparities on those records. Existing proxy methods, including Bayesian Improved Surname Geocoding (BISG), exhibit systematic misclassification biases linked to socioeconomic status that cause measured disparities to understate true levels. This paper introduces STRATA (Socioeconomic and Tract-Referenced Attribution for Algorithmic analysis), a race and ethnicity inference model that integrates character-level name sequences with census tract geolocation via stacked Bidirectional LSTM networks and XGBoost post-filtering. A central goal is reducing the socioeconomically correlated bias that causes non-White individuals to be misclassified as White: STRATA reduces this White False Positive Rate from 41.8% under BISG to 17.8% for the STRATA ensemble. On a held-out voter registration validation dataset, the STRATA base model achieves 88.7% accuracy, outperforming standalone LSTM (86.4%), BISG (82.9%), BIFSG (86.8%), and ZRP (85.8%); the STRATA ensemble (LSTM+XGBoost) reaches 89.2% accuracy. On a national Paycheck Protection Program loan validation dataset covering all 50 states, the STRATA ensemble achieves 84.8% accuracy versus 76.6% for name-only LSTM, confirming cross-state generalizability. A companion paper applies STRATA to 2.26 million New York City residential deed transactions. The authors caution that these models are appropriate for aggregate, population-level analysis and should not be used for individual-level transactional decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 STRATA 模型，通过整合字符级姓名序列与人口普查区地理信息，利用堆叠双向 LSTM 和 XGBoost 后过滤进行种族与族裔推断，旨在减少现有方法（如 BISG）中与社会经济地位相关的系统性误分类偏差，从而为公平贷款和住房权益合规提供更准确的群体层面分析工具。
Motivation: 在公平贷款法规（ECOA、HMDA、CRA）下，高达15%的抵押贷款申请缺少种族数据，而现有代理方法（如BISG）存在与社会经济地位相关的系统性误分类偏差，导致对实际种族差异的低估。
Method: STRATA 模型采用堆叠双向 LSTM 网络处理姓名序列，结合人口普查区地理定位，并通过 XGBoost 进行后过滤集成。
Result: 在选民登记验证数据集上，STRATA 基础模型准确率88.7%，集成模型达89.2%，优于 LSTM（86.4%）、BISG（82.9%）等。其将非白人误分类为白人的假阳性率从 BISG 的41.8%降至17.8%。在全国 PPP 贷款数据集上准确率84.8%，高于仅姓名 LSTM 的76.6%。
Conclusion: STRATA 在群体层面分析上表现优越，但作者强调不适用于个体层面的交易决策。

papers.title: On the Interpolation Effect of Score Smoothing in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable progress in various domains with an intriguing ability to produce new data that do not exist in the training set. In this work, we study the hypothesis that such creativity arises from the neural network backbone learning a smoothed version of the empirical score function, which guides the denoising dynamics to generate data points that interpolate the training data. Focusing mainly on settings where the training set lies uniformly in a one-dimensional subspace, we elucidate the interplay between score smoothing and the denoising dynamics with analytical solutions and numerical experiments, demonstrating how smoothing the score function can cause the denoised data samples to interpolate the training set along the subspace. Moreover, we present theoretical and empirical evidence that learning score functions with neural networks - either with or without explicit regularization - can naturally achieve a similar effect, including when the data belong to simple nonlinear manifolds.
papers.journal_ref: 14th International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散模型的创造性生成能力提出假设：该能力源于神经网络学习平滑的经验分数函数，引导去噪动力学生成插值训练数据的新样本。作者主要在训练数据均匀分布于一维子空间的设定下，通过解析解和数值实验阐明分数平滑与去噪动力学之间的相互作用，证明平滑分数函数会促使去噪数据沿子空间插值训练集。此外，还给出了理论和实验证据表明，无论是否显式正则化，用神经网络学习分数函数都能自然实现类似的插值效应，包括数据位于简单非线性流形时。
Motivation: 探索扩散模型能够生成训练集中不存在的新数据的创造性机制，提出并验证分数平滑导致插值效应的假说。
Method: 针对训练数据均匀分布于一维子空间的简化设定，利用解析解和数值实验研究分数平滑与去噪动力学的相互作用。
Result: 理论和实验表明，分数平滑导致去噪数据沿子空间插值训练集；且神经网络学习的分数函数（无论有无显式正则化）能自然实现类似效果，包括简单非线性流形上的数据。
Conclusion: 分数平滑是扩散模型生成插值数据的关键因素，为理解模型的创造性提供了理论基础。

papers.title: Lost in Transmission: An Information-Theoretic Account of Unsupervised Software Traceability
papers.abstract_en: Traceability remains a critical capability to ensure system reliability, maintainability, and compliance in modern software development. Although unsupervised Information Retrieval (IR) and Machine Learning (ML) techniques are widely adopted for automated trace link recovery, their effectiveness is often limited by the quality and structure of the underlying artifacts. In practice, these approaches assume that meaningful traceability signals are embedded in textual data, an assumption that rarely holds in industrial settings with sparse, inconsistent, or unbalanced documentation. Furthermore, conventional evaluation metrics (e.g., precision, recall, F1) can misrepresent performance when data characteristics are not explicitly considered. We introduce TraceXplainer, an information-theoretic framework for evaluating the reliability and limits of unsupervised traceability. Our approach leverages self-information and mutual information (MI) to quantify the informativeness and alignment of source and target artifacts. Through a comprehensive empirical analysis of industry datasets, we show that typical traceability corpora exhibit significant information imbalances, where the source code contains on average more information than the corresponding documentation. In addition, the observed levels of mutual information, loss, and noise reveal inherent constraints on the ability of unsupervised techniques to recover accurate trace links. These findings suggest that improving traceability in practice requires a shift to data-centric engineering, focusing on artifact quality, consistency, and information alignment; rather than solely advancing model sophistication (or complexity). Our results provide insights for practitioners to better assess traceability readiness and guide improvements in documentation and development workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TraceXplainer，一个基于信息论的框架，用于评估无监督软件可追溯性的可靠性和局限性。通过自信息和互信息量化工件的信息量和对齐程度，在行业数据集上发现源代码与文档之间存在显著信息不平衡，且互信息、损失和噪声限制了无监督技术恢复准确追溯链接的能力。结论强调应转向以数据为中心的工程，关注工件质量和信息对齐。
Motivation: 现有无监督追溯方法假设文本数据包含有意义的信号，但在工业场景中文档稀疏、不一致或不平衡，该假设常不成立；传统评估指标（如精确率、召回率、F1）在未考虑数据特性时可能误导性能判断。
Method: 提出 TraceXplainer，利用自信息（self-information）和互信息（mutual information）量化源工件（源代码）和目标工件（文档）的信息量及对齐程度，并通过信息失衡、互信息、损失和噪声等指标评估无监督追溯的可靠性。
Result: 在行业数据集的实证分析中，发现典型追溯语料库存在显著信息不平衡：源代码平均包含比对应文档更多的信息；此外，互信息、损失和噪声的水平揭示了无监督方法恢复准确追溯链接的内在限制。
Conclusion: 提高可追溯性需要转向数据中心工程，关注工件质量、一致性和信息对齐，而非仅提升模型复杂度。

summary_sections.result: 在行业数据集的实证分析中，发现典型追溯语料库存在显著信息不平衡：源代码平均包含比对应文档更多的信息；此外，互信息、损失和噪声的水平揭示了无监督方法恢复准确追溯链接的内在限制。
summary_sections.conclusion: 提高可追溯性需要转向数据中心工程，关注工件质量、一致性和信息对齐，而非仅提升模型复杂度。

papers.title: Posts of Peril: Detecting Information About Hazards in Text
papers.abstract_en: Socio-linguistic indicators of affectively-relevant phenomena, such as emotion or sentiment, are often extracted from text to better understand features of human-computer interactions, including on social media. However, an indicator that is often overlooked is the presence or absence of information concerning harms or hazards. Detecting such indicators in text is important because substantial research demonstrates that negative events are more likely to be attended to, and more likely to elicit a response. In addition, statements about hazards are often found to be more believable than statements about benefits. Here, we develop a new model to detect information concerning hazards, trained on a new collection of annotated X posts. We show that not only does this model perform well, but that the hazard information it extracts is not strongly correlated with such widely used indicators as moral outrage, sentiment, and emotions. To demonstrate the utility of our tool, we apply it to two datasets of X posts that discuss important geopolitical events, namely the 2023 Israel-Hamas war and the 2022 French national election. In both cases, we find that hazard information, especially information concerning conflict, is common. We extract accounts associated with information campaigns from each data set to explore how information about hazards could be used to attempt to influence geopolitical events. We find that inorganic accounts representing the viewpoints of weaker sides in a conflict often discuss hazards to civilians, potentially as a way to elicit aid for the weaker side. Moreover, the rate at which these hazards are mentioned differs markedly from organic accounts, likely reflecting information operators' efforts to frame the given geopolitical event for strategic purposes. These results are first steps towards exploring hazards within an information warfare environment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文开发了一个新模型，用于检测文本中关于危害（hazards）的信息，并在标注的X帖子数据集上训练。该模型性能良好，且提取的危害信息与道德愤怒、情感等常用指标相关性不强。应用于2023年以色列-哈马斯战争和2022年法国全国选举的X帖子数据集，发现危害信息常见，尤其涉及冲突；非有机账户（信息操作）更常讨论对平民的危害，试图影响地缘政治事件。
Motivation: 现有文本分析常关注情感、情绪等指标，但忽略危害信息。研究表明负面事件更易引起注意和回应，危害陈述更易被相信，因此检测危害信息对理解人机交互和社会媒体动态重要。
Method: 构建了一个新的标注数据集（X帖子），并训练了一个分类模型来检测文本中的危害信息。通过相关性分析验证该指标与现有指标（道德愤怒、情感、情绪）的独立性。
Result: 模型在标注数据集上表现良好；危害信息与道德愤怒、情感等指标不高度相关；在两组地缘政治事件数据集中，危害信息普遍存在；非有机账户（信息操作者）更频繁地讨论对平民的危害，与有机账户有显著差异。
Conclusion: 该工具可有效检测文本中的危害信息，并揭示信息操作中如何利用危害框架影响公众认知，为信息战环境中的危害研究提供初步步骤。

papers.title: Prompt-Guided Foundation Model Tuning for Pathology Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models have become pivotal in advancing computational pathology, particularly for whole slide image (WSI) classification. However, prevailing methodologies often rely on frozen, pre-trained models for feature extraction, overlooking the pronounced domain shift and task discrepancy between the pre-training and downstream tasks. To address this challenge, we propose PAMT, a novel Prompt-guided Adaptive Model Transformation framework that enables precise adaptation of general foundation models to the distinct domain of histopathology. To encapsulate the intricate distributions characteristic of histopathological data, we introduce Representative Patch Sampling (RPS) and Prototypical Visual Prompt (PVP), which reconstruct the input into compact yet highly informative representations. Further, to effectively bridge the domain gap, we incorporate Adaptive Model Transformation (AMT) via adapter modules within the feature extraction pipeline, facilitating the acquisition of domain-specific features by the foundation model. We conduct rigorous evaluation across 14 publicly available datasets and demonstrate consistent, substantial improvements in classification accuracy. These results establish PAMT as a compelling new benchmark for pathology image classification and underscore the critical value of targeted model adaptation within computational pathology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PAMT框架，通过提示引导的自适应模型变换（Prompt-guided Adaptive Model Transformation），将通用基础模型精确适配到病理组织学领域。方法包括代表性补丁采样（RPS）和原型视觉提示（PVP）来压缩输入表示，以及通过适配器模块进行自适应模型变换（AMT）来获取领域特定特征。在14个公开数据集上进行了评估，显示分类准确率的一致显著提升，成为病理图像分类的新基准。
Motivation: 现有方法通常使用冻结的预训练模型进行特征提取，忽视了预训练与下游任务之间的域偏移和任务差异，导致在病理图像分类中性能受限。
Method: 提出PAMT框架，包含三个关键组件：代表性补丁采样（RPS）选择信息丰富的图像块，原型视觉提示（PVP）将输入重建为紧凑表示，以及自适应模型变换（AMT）通过适配器模块微调基础模型以获取组织学特异性特征。
Result: 在14个公开病理图像数据集上，PAMT在分类准确率上取得一致且显著的提升，建立了新的基准性能。
Conclusion: 该工作强调了目标模型适配在计算病理学中的关键价值，为病理图像分类提供了一种有效的适应方法。
