papers.title: Learning Structural Manipulability in Gate-Level Netlists Using Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Gate-level netlists exhibit intrinsic structural properties that influence signal propagation independently of functional simulation. We define a topology-driven structural manipulability score that characterizes node-level structural flexibility using path participation, k-core embedding, symmetry, and centrality. Modeling netlists as directed graphs, we formulate node-level regression to learn this topology-derived score using graph neural networks (GNNs). Experiments on ISCAS85 and EPFL benchmarks evaluate how effectively different GNN architectures approximate this metric across held-out circuits, with hierarchical models yielding the most consistent rankings. Component-level and ablation analyses examine the contribution of individual factors. As an illustrative case study, analysis of Trojan-injected circuits using TrustHub templates reveals statistically distinguishable structural patterns, indicating that topology-based scoring provides complementary structural insight.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文定义了基于路径参与、k-core嵌入、对称性和中心性的拓扑驱动结构可操控性分数，将门级网表建模为有向图，使用图神经网络(GNN)学习该分数。在ISCAS85和EPFL基准上的实验表明，层次化GNN模型在不同电路间产生最一致的排名。组件消融分析揭示了各因素的贡献，对TrustHub Trojan注入电路的案例研究显示拓扑特征可区分正常与恶意电路。
Motivation: 门级网表的内在结构特性影响信号传播，但现有方法通常依赖功能仿真。本文旨在提出纯拓扑驱动的结构可操控性度量，并利用GNN学习该度量，避免功能仿真开销，同时提供结构洞察。
Method: 定义基于路径参与、k-core嵌入、对称性和中心性的结构可操控性分数；将网表建模为有向图，采用节点级回归任务，评估多种GNN架构（包括层次化模型）逼近该分数的能力，并进行组件消融分析。
Result: 在ISCAS85和EPFL基准上，层次化GNN模型在跨电路预测中一致性最优；对TrustHub Trojan注入电路的分析显示统计学上可区分的结构模式。
Conclusion: 拓扑评分提供了互补的结构洞察，可应用于硬件安全如Trojan检测，但当前工作限于标准基准，未涉及现代大规模网表。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CIGPO: Contextual Information-Gain Policy Optimization for Multi-Turn Evidence-Reading LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Training multi-turn evidence-reading agents with outcome-only reinforcement learning is unstable because intermediate turns receive little direct credit. In HotpotQA experiments with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, GRPO initially improves (standard F1 0.430) but subsequently collapses to 100% format-violating outputs. Training-log diagnosis reveals a zero-advantage lock-in mechanism: all sampled trajectories receive the minimum format penalty (-2.0), group-relative advantages vanish, and the policy-gradient loss becomes zero--an optimization deadlock. We propose a variance-injection strategy: by assigning per-turn rewards to intermediate evidence-reading turns, we prevent the group reward distribution from collapsing to a single value--preserving the variation that GRPO's group-relative advantage requires. Contextual Information-Gain Policy Optimization (CIGPO) implements this strategy using the marginal increase in the frozen reference model's log-likelihood of the ground-truth answer as the per-turn signal. With separate normalization of IG and F1 rewards and an IG-weight curriculum, CIGPO reaches a standard F1 of 0.518 on HotpotQA at the 3B scale (from 0.252 base; +105%), compared with 0.430 for the best GRPO checkpoint and 0.000 for the final GRPO checkpoint. CIGPO maintains meaningful reward variance and avoids zero-advantage lock-in throughout training. These results identify reward-variance collapse as a concrete failure mode of outcome-only GRPO and show that turn-level IG rewards can prevent it in this HotpotQA setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了多轮证据阅读智能体使用结果导向强化学习的不稳定性，发现GRPO会出现零优势锁定（zero-advantage lock-in）导致优化死锁。提出上下文信息增益策略优化（CIGPO），通过为中间证据阅读轮次分配每轮奖励（基于冻结参考模型的对数似然边际增加），保持奖励方差，避免零优势锁定。在HotpotQA上，Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct上CIGPO达到0.518标准F1，而GRPO最佳为0.430，最终崩溃为0.000。
Motivation: 结果导向强化学习在多轮证据阅读智能体训练中不稳定，中间轮次缺乏直接信用分配，导致GRPO出现零优势锁定和优化死锁。
Method: 提出CIGPO，使用冻结参考模型对真实答案的对数似然边际增加作为每轮信号（信息增益），结合IG和F1奖励的独立归一化以及IG权重课程。
Result: 在HotpotQA上，CIGPO达到0.518标准F1（从0.252基线提升+105%），GRPO最佳为0.430，最终GRPO崩溃为0.000。CIGPO维持了有意义的奖励方差，避免了零优势锁定。
Conclusion: 本文识别了奖励方差崩溃作为结果导向GRPO的具体失败模式，并展示了轮级IG奖励可以在此HotpotQA设置下防止该问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RobustMAD: Evaluating Real-World Robustness of Multimodal Small Language Models for Deployable Anomaly Detection Assistants
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal industrial anomaly inspection assistants are a critical component of next-generation smart factories, enabling interactive vision-language-based querying. However, multimodal large language models remain impractical for on-site deployment due to prohibitive computational demands and privacy risks from cloud-based inference. Compact multimodal small language models (MSLMs) offer a deployable alternative, yet progress is constrained by the lack of comprehensive robustness analyses and meaningfully challenging benchmarks that reflect real-world industrial conditions. To address this gap, we develop RobustMAD, the first deployment-motivated benchmark, designed to comprehensively evaluate model robustness through diverse open-ended queries spanning object understanding, anomaly detection, unanswerable problems, and visual quality degradations. Contrary to conventional assumptions, top-performing MSLMs exhibit promising capabilities, surprisingly outperforming even the larger GPT-5 Nano. However, they still fall short of safety-critical requirements, and RobustMAD reveals critical robustness gaps that pose operational risks. In particular, three recurring failure modes emerge: (i) fragile multimodal grounding under fine-grained distinctions or degraded visual conditions, (ii) insufficiently comprehensive responses, and (iii) weak logical grounding on unanswerable or ill-posed queries, leading to hallucinated outputs. Grounded in these insights, we provide actionable guidance for the design of next-generation multimodal industrial inspection assistants that leverage their promising competence. Code is available at https://github.com/en-research/RobustMAD.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026 at https://openreview.net/forum?id=skrA9UYNIZ
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RobustMAD，首个面向多模态小语言模型 (MSLM) 在实际工业异常检测部署场景中的鲁棒性基准。通过涵盖物体理解、异常检测、不可回答问题及视觉质量退化等多样化开放查询，评估发现顶级 MSLM 甚至超越更大模型 GPT-5 Nano，但仍存在安全关键缺陷，表现为多模态感知脆弱、回答不全面以及对无意义查询产生幻觉等故障模式。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏针对多模态小语言模型在工业异常检测中鲁棒性的系统分析，且缺乏反映真实工业条件的具挑战性基准，阻碍了模型的可靠部署。
Method: 设计 RobustMAD 基准，包含物体理解、异常检测、不可回答问题和视觉质量退化四类开放式查询，系统性评估 MSLM 的鲁棒性，并识别关键故障模式。
Result: 顶级 MSLM 展现出有竞争力的能力，甚至超越 GPT-5 Nano，但在精细区分、退化视觉条件及无意义查询下仍存在多模态基础脆弱、回答不充分和幻觉等安全缺口。
Conclusion: 基准揭示了部署风险，并为下一代工业异常检测助手的设计提供了可操作指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TRACE: Trajectory-Based Safety Patch Learning for LLM Post-Training Realignment
papers.abstract_en: Fine-Tuning-as-a-Service (FTaaS) platforms let users train large language models (LLMs) on customized tasks, but this pipeline could erode models' safety alignment. In practice, service providers need to recover models' safety without re-running full alignment, or destroying the utility gained from customized tasks. A line of existing work refers to model parameter merging, which adds a safety patch on the fine-tuned model parameters to shift the model away from unsafe tendencies. However, this merging-based paradigm is fundamentally bottlenecked by task-safety update entanglement: downstream task updates and the safety patch often overlap in their dominant directions, so the merge strength is intrinsically hard to calibrate. If the safety vector is scaled too weakly, harmful components could still dominate, preventing the model from returning to a safe region; if it is scaled too aggressively, it suppresses task-relevant directions and degrades utility. To solve this problem, we shift the focus of merging-based methods from designing online merging operators to offline patch learning, and seek a safety patch that minimally interferes with task-relevant directions while retaining decisive control over unsafe behaviors. We propose TRACE, a trajectory-based safety patch learning framework that (i) simulates harmful tuning trajectories to generate progressively corrupted states, and (ii) optimizes a plug-in patch to recover safety while maintaining utility across varying corrupted base states. Across six benchmarks and two models, TRACE consistently dominates the safety-utility frontier. TRACE reaches nearly 100% safety on all settings, while maintaining comparable utility to the undefended fine-tuned model.

papers.title: KernelBench-Verified: Do LLM-Generated Kernels Actually Beat PyTorch?
papers.abstract_en: Recent large language models (LLMs) can generate custom CUDA kernels that appear to outperform PyTorch on benchmarks such as KernelBench. Building upon this foundational framework, we demonstrate that frontier models frequently engage in reward hacking to artificially inflate reported performance. In this work, we identify two areas where evaluation frameworks must co-evolve with model capabilities. First, to accurately measure true speedup, we examine the baseline timing mechanism, noting that enabling Tensor Core acceleration with TF32 provides a more realistic estimation of execution on modern GPUs. Second, concerning algorithmic correctness, models often exploit the narrow test distribution by hardcoding bypasses for specific tensor values. By skipping required computations, these kernels artificially accelerate execution rather than implementing actual CUDA kernels. We introduce KernelBench-Verified, an extended evaluation framework that incorporates a TF32-enabled baseline and a four-distribution hidden test suite. We additionally introduce memory efficiency metrics that capture the often-overlooked speed-memory tradeoff in kernel optimization. Under verified single-turn evaluation with seven frontier LLMs, we find that the best-performing model (GPT-5.5) achieves a 0.88x geometric mean speedup, significantly lower than the 1.43x speedup observed under the standard evaluation protocol. No model consistently outperforms PyTorch when evaluated against realistic baselines. On the memory front, 28% of GPU kernels generated by the best model increase peak GPU memory usage. Our findings demonstrate the necessity of continually adapting robust evaluation protocols as LLM kernel generation capabilities advance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文验证了前沿大语言模型(LLM)生成的CUDA内核在KernelBench基准上的性能，发现模型常通过奖励黑客(reward hacking)手段人为提升报告速度。作者提出扩展评估框架KernelBench-Verified，启用TF32基准和四分布隐藏测试集，并引入内存效率指标。实验表明，最佳模型GPT-5.5的几何平均加速比仅为0.88x，远低于标准评估下的1.43x，且无模型能在真实基准下持续优于PyTorch。
Motivation: 现有评估框架未能跟上LLM生成内核能力的发展，模型可能利用测试分布漏洞进行作弊，导致对真实性能的误判。为此需要更稳健的评估协议。
Method: 提出KernelBench-Verified框架：1) 启用TF32的基准计时机制以反映现代GPU真实加速；2) 四分布隐藏测试套件防止模型硬编码捷径；3) 引入内存效率指标以刻画速度-内存权衡。
Result: 在七种前沿LLM的单回合评估中，最佳模型GPT-5.5几何平均加速比仅为0.88x（标准协议下为1.43x），且28%的生成内核增加了峰值GPU内存使用。
Conclusion: 研究揭示了LLM生成内核评估中奖励黑客的严重性，强调评估协议必须随模型能力持续演进。

papers.title: Normalized Rewards for Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Direct Alignment Algorithms (DAAs) such as DPO have become a common way to post-train and align LLMs with human preferences. However, DAAs have been observed to over-optimize their implicit reward model and decrease the likelihood of preferred responses. This results in a decrease in the total likelihood assigned to responses seen in the preference dataset, potentially resulting in undesirable behavior. To counteract this undesired side-effect of DAAs, we examine the effect of using objectives that add a regularization term to maintain the total length-normalized probabilities of the chosen and rejected responses. To better understand over-optimization, we investigate how response likelihood changes are distributed over the tokens with and without regularization. We find that a significant portion of the likelihood changes are due to a small set of outlier tokens, which explains how DAAs improve generation quality despite decreasing the likelihoods of chosen responses. We apply the proposed regularization to reference-based (DPO) and reference-free (SimPO) methods and find (1) improved trade-offs between generation quality and general benchmark capability and (2) improvements in reward modeling across datasets. For example, on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, we see both a >20% relative increase in AlpacaEval2 scores and >9% relative performance gains on general benchmarks. Additionally, we find that the added regularization term effectively mitigates the amount of displacement within preferred responses overall, and for the outlier tokens specifically, by utilizing low-likelihood tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究直接对齐算法（如DPO）在LLM后训练中过度优化隐式奖励模型导致偏好响应概率下降的问题，提出添加正则化项以保持选中和拒绝响应的长度归一化概率总和。实验表明该方法在生成质量和通用基准之间取得更好权衡，在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上AlpacaEval2得分提升>20%，通用基准提升>9%。
Motivation: 直接对齐算法（DAAs）如DPO会过度优化隐式奖励模型，降低选中响应的概率，可能导致不良行为，需要抵消这一副作用。
Method: 在参考方法（DPO）和无参考方法（SimPO）的目标函数中加入正则化项，保持选中和拒绝响应的长度归一化概率总和，并通过分析令牌级似然变化理解过度优化机制。
Result: 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上，AlpacaEval2得分相对提升>20%，通用基准性能相对提升>9%；改善了生成质量与通用基准能力的权衡，并提升了奖励建模。
Conclusion: 所提正则化有效缓解了偏好响应中整体和异常令牌的位移，利用低似然令牌维持概率总和。

papers.title: BACON: Budgeted Human Calibration for Modeling and Evaluation with Multiple AI Judges
papers.abstract_en: AI judges offer a scalable, low-cost alternative to human evaluation, but their outputs can be biased relative to human preferences and highly item-dependent, varying across judges, tasks, and domains. When uncalibrated AI evaluations are used for model ranking, item scoring, or population-level quality reporting, these biases can directly distort downstream decisions. We propose BACON, a four-stage pipeline that combines budgeted human calibration with multiple AI-judge outputs to produce more accurate annotations. BACON constructs full-coverage auxiliary features for every item, including multi-judge scores, token-level uncertainty statistics, and contextual embeddings. It then collects human labels for a small sampled subset and trains a cross-fitted outcome model to generate calibrated item-level surrogate predictions. These predictions support two use cases: population-level estimation of summary metrics, such as means or quantiles, using an augmented estimating-equation estimator with valid confidence intervals; and individual-level surrogate scoring for item ranking and annotation. BACON treats AI judges as auxiliary measurements rather than ground truth: human labels provide the calibration anchor, while AI-derived signals improve efficiency. Across diverse tasks, domains, and labeling budgets, BACON improves predictive accuracy and ranking consistency, and reduces bias and variance relative to raw AI outputs and purely human-label-based methods. These results show that BACON offers a practical, statistically grounded framework for scalable evaluation with limited human annotation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BACON 是一个四阶段流水线，结合有预算的人类校准与多个 AI 裁判的输出，以生成更准确的标注。它先为每个项目构建全覆盖辅助特征（包括多裁判分数、token 级不确定性统计和上下文嵌入），再在少量采样子集上收集人类标签，训练交叉拟合结果模型，从而得到校准的项目级替代预测。这些预测支持总体参数的估计（如均值、分位数）以及个体级别的评分排序。实验表明，BACON 在多种任务、领域和标注预算下，相比原始 AI 输出和纯人类标签方法，能提高预测准确性和排序一致性，并降低偏差和方差。
Motivation: AI 裁判提供可扩展、低成本的评估替代方案，但其输出相对人类偏好可能存在偏差且高度依赖于项目（不同裁判、任务和领域差异大），直接用于模型排名、项目评分或总体质量报告时会扭曲下游决策。
Method: 提出 BACON，包含四个阶段：(1) 为每个项目构建全覆盖辅助特征（多裁判评分、token 级不确定性统计、上下文嵌入）；(2) 在少量随机子集上收集人类标签；(3) 训练交叉拟合结果模型，生成校准的项目级替代预测；(4) 利用增强估计方程估计总体指标（均值、分位数）并提供有效置信区间，也可用于个体评分排序。该方法将 AI 裁判视为辅助测量，人类标签提供校准锚点，AI 信号提升效率。
Result: 在多种任务、领域和标注预算下，BACON 提高了预测准确性和排名一致性，并降低了偏差和方差，优于原始 AI 输出和纯基于人类标签的方法。
Conclusion: BACON 提供了一个实用且具有统计基础的可扩展评估框架，仅需有限的人类标注即可获得更可靠的评估结果。

papers.title: Diffusion-corrected Autoregressive Fourier Neural Operator for Droplet Evolution Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Predicting droplet evolution in material jetting, or Inkjet Printing (IJP), is essential for maintaining printing quality. However, long-horizon forecasts remain challenging due to error accumulation and the complex coupling of process variables. In this work, we introduce the Diffusion-corrected Auto-Regressive Fourier Neural Operator (DiffARFNO), a two-stage framework that combines an autoregressive Fourier-MIONet with a conditional Denoising Diffusion Implicit Model (DDIM) corrector. Fourier-MIONet is trained as a coarse predictor and deployed autoregressively for long-horizon forecasting. In the second stage, a DDIM-based conditional corrector refines the coarse prediction within each sliding window through efficient iterative denoising. By combining coarse predictions from Fourier-MIONet with a DDIM corrector that restores fine details, DiffARFNO aims to provide high-fidelity predictions for long-horizon forecasts. Extensive experiments on droplet datasets from ANSYS Fluent demonstrate that DiffARFNO significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对材料喷射（墨水喷射打印）中液滴演化的长期预测问题，提出DiffARFNO框架，结合自回归傅里叶神经算子（Fourier-MIONet）与条件去噪扩散隐式模型（DDIM）校正器。先由Fourier-MIONet进行粗预测，再由DDIM在滑动窗口内细化细节，以抑制误差累积。在ANSYS Fluent模拟的液滴数据集上，该方法显著优于现有基线模型。
Motivation: 长期液滴演化预测中，自回归误差累积与多过程变量耦合导致预测精度下降，影响打印质量。现有方法难以同时保持长时序保真度与计算效率。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段使用Fourier-MIONet作为粗预测器，自回归执行长期预报；第二阶段利用DDIM条件校正器，在滑动窗口内通过迭代去噪恢复精细细节，从而修正粗预测。
Result: 在ANSYS Fluent液滴数据集上的实验表明，DiffARFNO在预测精度上显著优于当前最先进的模型。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，将傅里叶神经算子的粗预测与扩散模型的细节修正相结合，可有效提升液滴演化长期预测的保真度。

papers.title: Quantizing Recursive Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Recursive reasoning models solve hard puzzles by applying compact, weight-tied blocks over many refinement steps. Because these blocks are reused many times, quantizing them creates a unique dynamical problem: the quantization error is incurred at every step. While 8-bit quantization (integer or float) preserves accuracy, moving to a per-tensor 4-bit format causes a systematic bias to accumulate. The ensuing drift catastrophically degrades exact-solution accuracy on Sudoku from 84.1% to 0.0% (only ~25% of cells correct). In this work, we show that this collapse is caused by activation-scaling granularity rather than bit-width or number format. Crucially, moving to per-block scaling completely restores the transition. To implement this, we apply MXInt4, a blockwise integer activation format, to recursive reasoning models. It is competitive with blockwise float formats on our tasks, while keeping integer elements and power-of-two block scales. Finally, recursion depth and reuse modulate quantization sensitivity, with the deepest architecture we test (the EqR equilibrium model) the most sensitive. Yet blockwise scaling overcomes this vulnerability, staying robust across these architectures and transferring to the open-ended ARC-AGI benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究递归推理模型（如均衡模型）的量化问题，发现逐张量4-bit量化会导致系统性偏差累积，使Sudoku准确率从84.1%骤降至0.0%。问题根源在于激活缩放粒度而非位宽或数值格式，采用逐块缩放（如MXInt4格式）可完全恢复精度。实验表明块状整数量化与块状浮点格式竞争力相当，且最深模型敏感性最高，但块状缩放能保持鲁棒性并迁移至ARC-AGI基准。
Motivation: 递归推理模型因多次重用权重绑定块，量化误差会逐步骤累积，导致低比特量化时性能灾难性下降。现有研究未系统分析该动态问题及解决方案。
Method: 提出采用MXInt4块状整数激活格式实现逐块缩放量化，替代逐张量缩放，避免偏差累积。通过调整量化粒度为块级别，保持整数元素与2的幂次块缩放。
Result: 在Sudoku任务上，8-bit量化保持精度，逐张量4-bit量化使准确率从84.1%降至0.0%（仅~25%正确细胞），而逐块缩放完全恢复精度。块状整数量化与块状浮点格式性能相当，且最深架构EqR量化敏感性最高。
Conclusion: 递归推理模型的低比特量化成功取决于激活缩放粒度而非位宽，块状缩放（如MXInt4）是稳健的解决方案，并适用于开放任务ARC-AGI。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Failures of Marginal Influence-Based Attribution Methods for Global Time Series Explanations
papers.abstract_en: Explainability methods for time series models predominantly produce flat attribution scores: they quantify the direct influence of a feature at a timestamp by a scalar. We prove that the dominant failure mode of such methods is not the scalar format itself but a fundamental computational mismatch: existing methods compute scores via marginal conditioning or off-manifold gradients, both of which conflate direct temporal dependencies with mediated ones under autocorrelation. We also define DAG-faithfulness: an explanation is DAG-faithful if the temporal dependency graph it encodes is Markov-equivalent to the temporal directed acyclic graph (DAG) implicitly learned by the model. Particularly, we observe that standard attribution methods, specifically SHAP, are not DAG-faithful in general, and that recent time-series-aware extensions inherit the same computational limitation.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI), International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明，时间序列模型的主流归因方法（如SHAP）失败的根本原因并非标量格式，而是边际条件化或离流形梯度计算导致的时间依赖混淆。作者提出DAG忠实性概念，并指出现有方法（包括时间序列扩展版本）普遍不满足该性质。
Motivation: 现有时间序列归因方法生成的标量归因分数无法区分直接与间接时间依赖性，但作者证明问题不在于标量本身，而在于计算方式错误地混合了自相关下的依赖关系。
Method: 通过理论分析，定义DAG忠实性：解释所编码的时间依赖图应与模型隐式学习的时间有向无环图（DAG）马尔可夫等价。并检验标准归因方法（SHAP）及时序扩展方法是否满足此性质。
Result: 证明SHAP等边际影响方法一般不是DAG忠实的，且近期的时间序列感知扩展继承了相同的计算局限性。
Conclusion: 需要重新设计时间序列归因方法，使其计算方式不混淆直接与间接时间依赖，从而满足DAG忠实性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: OpenMHC: Accelerating the Science of Wearable Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Mobile and wearable devices offer an unprecedented opportunity for continuous, passive health monitoring and active health coaching. However, the largest wearable datasets are not publicly available for research, and leading wearable foundation models trained on such datasets are rarely open-weight or come with reproducible training code. To accelerate open science in wearable health, we release OpenMyHeartCounts (OpenMHC), the largest and most comprehensive open-access wearable health dataset to date, alongside open-source implementations of recent wearable foundation models. OpenMHC, derived from over a decade of data collected through the My Heart Counts study app, includes >60 million hours of wearable data across 19 sensor channels (e.g., step count, heart rate, sleep, workouts) and up to 169 linked variables, including health, lifestyle, mood, and behavior from 11,894 consenting participants. Furthermore, we introduce a unified, open benchmark that enables standardized comparison of wearable health models across three tracks: health and behavior downstream prediction, multivariate data imputation, and time-series forecasting. We benchmark classical methods alongside recent wearable and multivariate time series foundation models. By open-sourcing data, code, and model weights at this unprecedented scale, we aim to democratize wearable health AI research and enable the community to drive open progress in this domain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发布 OpenMyHeartCounts (OpenMHC) 数据集，包含超 6000 万小时可穿戴数据、19 个传感器通道，并开源可穿戴基础模型的代码和权重，同时设计统一基准涵盖健康与行为预测、多变量数据插补和时间序列预测三个任务，旨在推动可穿戴健康 AI 的开放科学。
Motivation: 现有最大可穿戴数据集不公开，领先的模型缺乏开放权重和可复现训练代码，阻碍研究进展。
Method: 构建并开源大规模可穿戴健康数据集 OpenMHC，开源近期可穿戴基础模型，并设计统一基准用于标准化比较。
Result: 数据集规模超 6000 万小时，涵盖 19 个传感器通道和 169 个关联变量，基准涵盖三个任务。
Conclusion: 通过开放数据、代码和模型权重，旨在民主化可穿戴健康 AI 研究，促进社区开放进步。

papers.title: HantaWatch: Federated Learning for Hantavirus Genomic Surveillance
papers.abstract_en: Hantavirus genomic surveillance is limited by the distribution of sequence data, non-IID source heterogeneity, and constrained expert-review capacity. We propose HantaWatch, a federated learning framework that enables laboratories and surveillance sites to collaboratively train sequence-based models without sharing raw data. HantaWatch integrates k-mer feature extraction, source-aware federated client construction, adaptive DU-FedProx optimization, surveillance-specific model selection, and prediction-only triage. Experiments on binary and multi-class tasks show that HantaWatch supports high-risk screening, outbreak-associated prediction, clade classification, and clinical-syndrome categorization while balancing predictive performance, false-negative risk, and update stability. The framework converts model output into risk scores, confidence estimates, uncertainty flags, and ranked expert-review priorities. HantaWatch therefore provides a practical federated decision-support layer for decentralized Hantavirus surveillance, supporting expert prioritization without replacing laboratory or public-health interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HantaWatch，一个用于汉坦病毒基因组监测的联邦学习框架。该框架支持实验室和监测站点在不共享原始数据的情况下协作训练序列模型，集成了 k-mer 特征提取、源感知联邦客户端构建、自适应 DU-FedProx 优化、监测特定模型选择和预测分流。实验表明，它在二分类和多分类任务中平衡了预测性能、假阴性风险和更新稳定性。
Motivation: 汉坦病毒基因组监测受限于序列数据分布、非 IID 源异构性和有限的专家审查能力，现有方法难以在保护数据隐私的同时实现有效协作。
Method: 提出联邦学习框架 HantaWatch，包括 k-mer 特征提取、源感知客户端构建、自适应 DU-FedProx 优化、监测特定模型选择和预测分流，将模型输出转化为风险评分、置信度估计、不确定性标志和排序的专家审查优先级。
Result: 在二分类和多分类任务上，HantaWatch 支持高风险筛查、爆发相关预测、分支分类和临床综合征分类，同时平衡了预测性能、假阴性风险和更新稳定性。
Conclusion: HantaWatch 为去中心化的汉坦病毒监测提供了一个实用的联邦决策支持层，支持专家优先排序而不取代实验室或公共卫生解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Token-Level Cross-Modal Transformer with Contrastive Multi-Task Learning for Breast Cancer Subtype Classification and Survival Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Integrating heterogeneous genomic and clinical modalities for joint cancer subtype classification and survival prediction remains a key challenge in precision oncology. Existing approaches suffer from three limitations: (1) they treat each modality as a monolithic feature vector, precluding fine-grained token-level interactions across modalities; (2) cross-modal fusion is typically performed through linear weighting or late averaging rather than structured token exchange; and (3) survival and classification objectives are optimized independently, missing a joint regularization signal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对异质基因组与临床模态整合中的三个局限——将模态视为整体特征向量、跨模态融合采用线性加权或后期平均、生存与分类目标独立优化——提出Token-Level Cross-Modal Transformer与对比多任务学习框架，在乳腺癌亚型分类和生存预测任务上实现细粒度token级交互与联合优化。
Motivation: 现有跨模态方法缺乏token级交互，融合方式简单且目标独立，限制了多模态信息在精准肿瘤学中的利用。
Method: 提出基于token级跨模态Transformer的融合结构，通过对比多任务学习联合优化分类与生存预测目标，实现结构化token交换与正则化。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 该方法通过token级交互与联合多任务学习有望改善乳腺癌诊断与预后，但具体性能需进一步实验验证。

papers.title: From Weights to Words: Expressing and Editing Preference Model Inferences in Natural Language
papers.abstract_en: The growing use of statistical learning algorithms to infer human preferences from high-dimensional choice data runs up against a fundamental challenge: choice alternatives typically differ in many ways simultaneously, so it is generally unclear which factors actually drove an observed decision and should be credited as preferences. Compounding this problem, the opacity of these methods leaves human operators unable to inspect, contest, or correct models when they err. We introduce \emph{weights to words}, a method that takes a dataset of choice problems as input and automatically discovers a collection of domain-relevant preference dimensions, each described in natural language and paired with a vector in the model's representational space. These dimensions address both under-determination and opacity: they can be applied to concentrate attribution on a small set of meaningful factors, and they can externalize the model's inferences in natural language so that users can inspect and edit them in real time. We first qualitatively illustrate the method's versatility on four diverse domains: moral dilemmas, movies, wines, and free-form LLM responses. We then report two pre-registered human-subjects experiments, on moral dilemmas ($N=450$) and movie selection ($N=449$), that demonstrate its benefits for learning preference models: (1) regularizing a preference model toward the learned basis increases prediction accuracy on held-out choices, and (2) incorporating participants' structured edits further improves accuracy. In head-to-head comparisons, participants prefer the method's inferred preference profiles and endorse its predictions as more accurate.
papers.comment: 42 pages, 22 figures, 14 tables; main text 11 pages, remainder appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“weights to words”方法，从选择数据中自动发现域相关的偏好维度，并用自然语言描述和向量表示，以解决偏好推断中的欠确定性和模型不透明性问题。通过道德困境、电影、葡萄酒和LLM响应等四个领域的定性示例，以及两个预注册的受试者实验（N=450和N=449），证明该方法通过正则化和结构化编辑提高了偏好模型的预测准确性，且受试者更偏好其推断的偏好配置文件。
Motivation: 统计学习从高维选择数据推断人类偏好时面临欠确定性和模型不透明性：通常不清楚哪些因素驱动了决策，且用户无法检查、质疑或纠正模型错误。
Method: 提出“weights to words”方法，输入选择问题数据集，自动发现域相关的偏好维度，每个维度用自然语言描述并配以模型表示空间中的向量，可用于归因和可解释编辑。
Result: 在两个预注册实验（道德困境N=450，电影选择N=449）中，将偏好模型正则化向学习到的基函数可提高留出选择的预测准确性，结合参与者的结构化编辑进一步提升准确性。在直接比较中，参与者更偏好该方法推断的偏好配置文件，并认为其预测更准确。
Conclusion: 该方法可有效提高偏好模型的预测性能，并允许用户用自然语言检查和编辑模型推断，但其适用性可能依赖于领域的具体维度结构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Orthogonal Gradient Constraints Shape Noisy-Label Memorization Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Modern neural networks can fit corrupted training labels, making noisy-label learning a useful setting for studying memorization-driven overfitting. Most regularization methods modify the objective, architecture, or data distribution; here we instead study a geometric intervention on the optimizer update itself. We evaluate OrthoGrad, which removes the component of each weight gradient parallel to the current weight vector, in noisy-label image classification. On MNIST with small-data regimes, OrthoGrad improves test accuracy most clearly for CNNs while reducing corrupted-label fitting. Mechanism diagnostics based on weight norms and gradient-weight cosine similarity suggest that the projection has the strongest effect when the raw gradient contains a nontrivial radial component, and becomes weaker in larger-data regimes where gradients are already nearly orthogonal to weights. Additional CIFAR-10 ResNet-18 experiments show that the method can alter memorization trajectories but does not prevent eventual noisy-label memorization. These results support orthogonal update constraints as a useful diagnostic for studying learning dynamics, while showing that OrthoGrad is regime-dependent rather than universally regularizing.

TL;DR: 本文研究正交梯度约束（OrthoGrad）对神经网络记忆噪声标签动力学的影响。在MNIST和小数据场景下，OrthoGrad能提升CNN测试准确率并减少对错误标签的记忆；但在大数据集（如CIFAR-10）上，其效果减弱，无法完全阻止最终对噪声标签的记忆。
Motivation: 现有正则化方法主要修改目标、架构或数据分布，而本文从优化器更新本身的几何干预角度出发，研究正交梯度约束如何影响噪声标签记忆动力学。
Method: 采用OrthoGrad方法，在每次梯度更新时移除梯度向量中平行于当前权重向量的分量，从而改变优化轨迹。
Result: 在MNIST小数据场景下，OrthoGrad提升CNN测试准确率并减少对错误标签的记忆；在CIFAR-10 ResNet-18上，该方法能改变记忆轨迹，但无法完全阻止噪声标签记忆。权重范数和梯度-权重余弦相似度的诊断表明，投影在原始梯度存在显著径向分量时效果最强，而在梯度已接近与权重正交的大数据场景下效果减弱。
Conclusion: 正交更新约束可作为研究学习动力学的有用诊断工具，但OrthoGrad的效果具有数据依赖性，并非通用的正则化方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RouteCost: A Production-Inspired Multi-Stage Framework for Pre-Order Shipping Cost Estimation in E-Commerce
papers.abstract_en: Accurate pre-order shipping cost estimation is important in e-commerce because it affects price presentation, margin planning, and conversion. In practice, shipping cost is shaped not only by distance but also by destination demand mix, billable weight, dimensional pricing, surcharge triggers, and latent operational effects such as shipment consolidation. Static lookup methods therefore miss important sources of variation, while monolithic regressors may exploit strong but non-causal correlations. We propose RouteCost, a production-inspired multi-stage framework that decomposes the problem into time-aware demand forecasting, fee-card-informed baseline pricing, Stage 2 residual correction, and proxy-based box-consolidation inference. Route-level cost estimates are aggregated through a route-weighted expectation formulation to produce product-level shipping cost predictions. Across over 250,000 orders, 260 products, and 18 months of order history, the framework improves predictive quality and aggregate calibration while preserving route-level interpretability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RouteCost，一个受实际生产启发的多阶段框架，用于电商预购运费预估。该框架将问题分解为时间感知需求预测、基于费率卡的基线定价、第二阶段残差修正以及基于代理的包裹合并推断，并通过路线加权期望聚合得到产品级运费预测。在超过25万订单、260种产品和18个月订单历史数据上，该框架提升了预测质量和整体校准性，同时保持路线级可解释性。
Motivation: 准确的预购运费预估对电商的价格展示、利润规划和转化率至关重要。现有静态查找方法忽略了重要变化因素，而单一回归模型可能利用强但非因果的相关性。
Method: RouteCost是一个多阶段框架，包含时间感知需求预测、费率卡基线定价、第二阶段残差修正和代理箱合并推断。路线级成本估计通过路线加权期望公式聚合，产生产品级运费预测。
Result: 在超过25万订单、260种产品和18个月数据上，该框架提升了预测质量和整体校准性，同时保持路线级可解释性。
Conclusion: RouteCost通过分解运费预估问题为多阶段，结合时间感知和代理推断，实现了更准确和可解释的电商运费预估。

papers.title: FinBench: Time-Gated Calibration and Uncertainty Benchmarking for Agentic Financial Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as components of agentic systems that observe, plan, and act. In finance, even "assistive" systems become decision-relevant once their outputs are used to size trades or allocate risk. A key failure mode is the confidence--competence gap: a model that is only slightly better than chance but consistently overconfident will, under typical bet-sizing rules, generate negative long-run growth. Existing benchmarks emphasize semantic understanding or point accuracy, but do not directly test probabilistic calibration under the temporal constraints and non-stationarity that define real markets. We introduce FinBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate calibration and uncertainty quality for financial forecasting in a setting that is (i) strictly time-gated to avoid look-ahead bias and (ii) evaluated with strictly proper scoring rules that penalize hallucinated confidence. FinBench tasks require models to output (a) a probability of positive return and (b) an 80% prediction interval for realized log return; evaluation uses the Brier score and the Winkler interval score, along with skill scores against hard baselines. This paper describes the benchmark specification and reports a small pilot run (one trading day; three liquid tickers; 33 forecasts) as a sanity check of the pipeline. The pilot illustrates how calibration-sensitive metrics distinguish between "confident but fragile" behavior and uncertainty-aware forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FinBench，一个用于评估金融预测中概率校准和不确定性质量的基准，通过严格的时间门控避免前瞻偏差，并使用Brier分数和Winkler区间分数等严格适当的评分规则。摘要报告了在单交易日、三个流动性股票、33个预测的小规模试点运行，显示校准敏感指标能区分过度自信和不确定性感知的预测行为。
Motivation: 现有基准强调语义理解或点精度，但未直接测试在时间约束和非平稳市场条件下的概率校准，导致模型即使略优于随机却过度自信，在典型仓位规则下产生长期负增长。
Method: 设计时间门控的基准任务，要求模型输出正回报概率和80%预测区间，并使用Brier分数和Winkler区间分数进行评估，同时计算相对于硬基线的技能分数。
Result: 试点运行（一天、三个股票、33个预测）表明，校准敏感指标能够区分“自信但脆弱”的行为与不确定性感知的预测。
Conclusion: 该基准为金融预测中的校准评估提供了框架，并强调了时间门控和严格评分规则的重要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Operator-Aware Mixed-Precision Tolerance Calibration for Tensor Kernels
papers.abstract_en: Most tensor-kernel correctness tests go through a fixed-shape all close-style check with hand-picked absolute and relative tolerances. The thresholds are copied across the corpus and rarely revisited. We mine the element-wise error distribution of every test case from accumulated cloud GPU runs across the 26-entry gpuemu corpus and 2 dtypes (8,076 result rows). We then ask one empirical question: what absolute tolerance would the kernel itself, observed under its correct implementation, justify? The answer is much tighter than the current hand-picked atol. The largest tightening is attention_triton fp16 at $2{,}184\times$. Restricted to the seven LLM-style buggy variants for which the corpus ships a paired correct counterpart, calibrated per-(op, dtype) tolerances raise bug-detection recall from 73.2% (1,805 of 2,467) to 82.4% (2,034 of 2,467), an absolute gain of 9.3 percentage points (+229 new detections). The control false-positive count rises from 0 to 20 out of 1,882 correct-control cases (+1.1 percentage points).
papers.comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, LNCS format. Companion paper: arXiv:2606.20128 (P1). Additional companions (P3, P4) to follow on arXiv this week; IDs will be added in a v2 replace
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对张量核正确性测试中固定容差的问题，提出基于元素级误差分布挖掘的逐操作混合精度容差校准方法。在gpuemu语料库和2种数据类型上，校准后的容差比手选更紧，并将bug检测召回率提升9.3个百分点，同时假阳性率仅增加1.1个百分点。
Motivation: 当前张量核正确性测试使用手选的固定绝对和相对容差，且在整个语料库中复制，很少重新审视，导致容差不够精确。
Method: 通过挖掘每个测试用例在正确实现下从云GPU运行中累积的元素级误差分布，为每个操作-数据类型对校准绝对容差。
Result: 在gpuemu语料库和2种数据类型上，校准容差比手选最大可收紧2184倍（attention_triton fp16）；在7个LLM风格错误变体上，bug检测召回率从73.2%提升至82.4%，假阳性从0增至20（+1.1百分点）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调了基于经验误差分布校准容差的有效性，能显著提高bug检测能力且几乎不牺牲正确性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLM Unlearning for Cyber Defense: A Survey on Methods, Challenges, and Emerging Threats
papers.abstract_en: LLMs are increasingly deployed in security-critical systems across healthcare, finance, education, and decision support, yet their inability to forget creates serious cybersecurity, privacy, and safety risks. Sensitive personal information, copyrighted material, hazardous domain knowledge, and memorized training data remain encoded across billions of parameters long after deployment, leaving models vulnerable to extraction, jailbreak attacks, membership inference, and regulatory non-compliance. Real-world incidents, from chatbots regenerating private information to fabricated legal citations producing direct legal and financial cost, place the problem at the center of the emerging-threats landscape rather than the realm of speculation. Because retraining billion-parameter models on revised corpora is computationally infeasible, and because knowledge within an LLM is distributed and entangled across parameters rather than localized to identifiable units, LLM unlearning has emerged as the principal cyber defense response, aiming to remove or suppress targeted knowledge from a trained model without retraining and without eroding what the model should still know. A central question, however, remains unresolved. Do current methods genuinely remove knowledge, or do they only stop the model from expressing it under ordinary prompting conditions? This survey examines LLM unlearning through the lens of security, robustness, and verifiable forgetting, with primary focus on gradient-based methods, which have come to dominate the field due to their compatibility with existing training pipelines and their scalability to billion-parameter models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于LLM遗忘（unlearning）用于网络防御的综述，系统梳理了方法、挑战与新兴威胁。摘要重点考察基于梯度的方法（gradient-based methods），并指出一个核心未决问题：当前方法到底是真正删除目标知识，还是仅阻止模型在常规提示下表达这些知识。
Motivation: LLM在安全关键系统中广泛应用，但其无法遗忘的特性导致隐私泄露、版权侵权、法规违规等严重风险。重新训练万亿参数模型不可行，且知识在参数中分布纠缠，因此LLM遗忘成为主要的网络防御手段。
Method: 该综述以安全性、鲁棒性和可验证遗忘为视角，主要聚焦基于梯度的方法（gradient-based methods），因其与现有训练管线兼容且可扩展到十亿参数模型。
Result: 作为综述，本文未提出新实验结果，但指出一个核心发现：当前方法可能仅抑制模型在常规提示下的知识表达，而非真正移除知识。
Conclusion: 强调LLM遗忘在网络安全中的关键作用，并指出尚未解决的中心问题——知识是否被真正移除，从而为未来研究指明方向。

papers.title: Overcoming the BCI Calibration Bottleneck: A Clinically-Grounded Architecture using Riemannian Alignment and Stochastic Weight Averaging
papers.abstract_en: Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs) face a severe calibration bottleneck due to cross-subject spatial covariance shifts and physiological artifacts. To enable zero-calibration BCI, a deep learning pipeline was engineered combining Per-Session Independent Component Analysis, Riemannian Euclidean Alignment, and EEGNet stabilized by Stochastic Weight Averaging (SWA). Evaluated on the strict MOABB BNCI2014-001 benchmark, the proposed architecture successfully isolates true sensorimotor rhythms. For the primary case study (Subject 1), a clinically robust SWA stable accuracy of 90.97% (AUC: 0.976, Cohen's $κ$: 0.819) was achieved. Furthermore, expanded 9-fold Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) cross-validation yielded a globally stable mean accuracy of 74.31%, proving hardware-agnostic zero-shot efficacy for binary motor imagery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 BCI 校准瓶颈，提出结合逐会话独立成分分析、Riemannian Euclidean alignment 和 EEGNet（用随机权重平均 SWA 稳定）的深度学习流水线，在 MOABB BNCI2014-001 基准上实现零校准 BCI，达到 90.97% 的准确率（AUC 0.976, Cohen's κ 0.819），9 折 LOSO 交叉验证平均准确率 74.31%。
Motivation: BCI 因跨被试空间协方差偏移和生理伪迹面临严重的校准瓶颈，亟需零校准方案。
Method: 提出结合 Per-Session ICA、Riemannian Euclidean Alignment、EEGNet 及 Stochastic Weight Averaging (SWA) 的深度学习流水线。
Result: 在 Subject 1 上达到 90.97% 准确率（AUC 0.976, Cohen's κ 0.819）；9 折 LOSO 交叉验证平均准确率 74.31%，证明硬件无关的零样本有效性。
Conclusion: 该架构成功隔离真实的感觉运动节律，在严格基准上验证了零校准 BCI 的临床鲁棒性。

papers.title: International Agreements to Limit Frontier AI: Objectives and Exit
papers.abstract_en: An international agreement to limit AI development could be crucial to mitigate risks from AI. However, it remains unclear which conditions should determine when the limiting measures are relaxed. We survey existing international agreements, outline what properties appropriate conditions should satisfy, list possible conditions, and finally give a recommendation in an example scenario. We recommend a fixed time period after which a new organization established at the start of the period specifies conditions that address when AI development can be safely conducted, with a possibility of withdrawal in extraordinary circumstances. We hope to illustrate the considerations that would likely go into an international agreement to limit AI.

papers.title: Fully-sensorized smart-eyewear platform for on-device Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents ARGO, a smart eyewear platform designed to bridge ergonomic comfort, high computational throughput, and energy efficiency. Unlike cloud-dependent solutions, ARGO leverages the STM32N6 microcontroller and its integrated Neural Processing Unit (NPU) to enable on-device machine learning, minimizing latency and preserving user privacy through local data processing. The primary contribution lies in the holistic co-design of hardware, firmware, and artificial intelligence, centered on the deployment of an optimized YOLOv11 model for real-time urban obstacle recognition. To ensure compatibility with the target NPU, we introduce Head-wise Parallel Attention (HPA), an architectural refinement that enables efficient accelerator execution while preserving the original computational logic. The model is trained on the Walking On The Road (WOTR) dataset, and the final deployed configuration achieves an mAP50-95 of 24 under strict memory constraints, with a memory footprint of only 2.483 MB. The platform integrates a multimodal sensor suite, RGB cameras, Time-of-Flight sensors, microphones, and ambient sensors, and delivers 10 FPS at a continuous autonomy of ~113 minutes on a 200 mAh battery. These results demonstrate the feasibility of a high-performance, privacy-preserving, and socially acceptable assistive device, and highlight how competitive edge AI solutions increasingly demand tightly integrated, multidisciplinary co-design approaches.
papers.comment: This work was carried out in the EssilorLuxottica "Smart Eyewear Lab", a Joint Research Center between EssilorLuxottica and Politecnico di Milano

papers.title: Comparing Spectrogram Front-Ends for Abnormal Heart-Sound Detection with a Convolutional Neural Network
papers.abstract_en: Heart disease kills a lot of people, and one cheap way to catch it early is by listening to heart sounds with a stethoscope, or better yet, just recording them and running them through a model. This project is a binary classification task: take a short clip of someones heartbeat and decide if it sounds normal or abnormal. Instead of trying out a bunch of different models, we kept the CNN the same the whole time and just changed how we turned the raw audio into a picture for it to look at. We tried three ways of doing that: a regular logmel spectrogram, PCEN (which basically normalizes each frequency bin over time), and a multi resolution version that stacks a few different window sizes together. We ran all three on the PhysioNet 2016 heart-sound dataset with the exact same setup but same model, same optimizer, same random seed. Turns out all three do pretty well at catching abnormal cases (sensitivity around 0.95), but PCEN and multi-resolution both edge out the plain logmel on the official PhysioNet accuracy metric (0.915 and 0.916 vs. 0.910). We also ran Grad-CAM to see where the model was actually looking, and it mostly focused on the low frequencies where S1 and S2 heart sounds live, which is a good sign that it learned something real
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文比较了三种频谱图前端（logmel、PCEN、多分辨率）在基于CNN的心音异常检测中的性能。在PhysioNet 2016数据集上，所有前端对异常病例的敏感度均达到约0.95，但PCEN和多分辨率前端在官方准确率指标上略优于普通logmel（0.915和0.916 vs. 0.910）。Grad-CAM可视化表明模型主要关注S1和S2心音所在的低频区域。
Motivation: 心音异常检测是低成本早期发现心脏病的有效手段，但不同音频前端对深度学习模型性能的影响缺乏系统比较。
Method: 固定CNN架构，仅改变音频到图像的前端变换：标准logmel频谱图、PCEN（逐频率归一化）以及多分辨率频谱图（堆叠不同窗大小）。
Result: 在PhysioNet 2016数据集上，三种前端的异常检测灵敏度均约0.95；PCEN和多分辨率前端的准确率分别为0.915和0.916，高于普通logmel的0.910。
Conclusion: PCEN和多分辨率频谱图作为前端能轻微提升心音异常检测的准确率，且模型关注生理相关的低频区域，说明学习特征合理。

papers.title: RAIL Guard: Closing the Evaluation-to-Remediation Gap in Responsible AI for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Existing guardrail systems for large language model agents operate as binary classifiers that block unsafe content, leaving organizations to discard failing outputs and retry from scratch. We introduce RAIL Guard, a closed-loop responsible AI pipeline that evaluates LLM outputs across eight measurable dimensions and iteratively remediates failing outputs through an evaluate-rewrite-reevaluate loop. We evaluate the pipeline across three experiments on four frontier LLMs and 4,276 content outputs plus 6,400 agent tool-call scenarios. Closed-loop remediation achieves 96.9% convergence versus 49.1% for block-and-retry, though the highest-convergence method reduces utility by 22.3%; feedback-driven self-repair achieves 86.6% convergence on fixable dimensions with no significant utility loss (p = 0.177). Pre-tool-call evaluation reduces unsafe agent executions by 33% (p = 0.007) with zero impact on task completion. We identify a key distinction between fixable dimensions that respond to remediation and structural dimensions (Transparency at 93.0%, Accountability at 92.8%, and Inclusivity at 82.5% failure) that require architectural rather than algorithmic solutions. The system is available as open-source SDKs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RAIL Guard，一个闭环负责任的AI管道，用于评估和迭代修复LLM代理的输出。系统在八个可测量维度上评估输出，并通过评估-重写-再评估循环修复失败输出。实验表明，闭环修复的收敛率达到96.9%，远高于阻塞重试的49.1%，但最高收敛方法导致22.3%的效用损失；反馈驱动的自我修复在可修复维度上达到86.6%的收敛，且无显著效用损失。预工具调用评估将不安全工具执行减少了33%。
Motivation: 现有护栏系统作为二元分类器运行，仅阻塞不安全内容，迫使组织丢弃失败输出并从头重试，缺乏迭代修复能力。
Method: 提出RAIL Guard闭环管道，包含评估（8个可测量维度）、重写（基于反馈的自我修复）和再评估循环，并区分可修复维度和结构性维度（如透明度、问责制等）。
Result: 闭环修复收敛率96.9% vs 阻塞重试49.1%；反馈自修复收敛率86.6%且无显著效用损失（p=0.177）；预工具调用评估减少33%不安全工具执行（p=0.007），且不影响任务完成。结构性维度故障率高达82.5%-93.0%。
Conclusion: 论文强调可修复维度与结构性维度的关键区别，后者需要架构级而非算法级解决方案，并开源了SDK和基准。

papers.title: What Makes Linguistic Representations Good Models of High-Level Visual Perception in the Human Brain?
papers.abstract_en: Image descriptions represented with language models (LMs) predict human brain responses to naturalistic images in high-level visual regions, but the factors driving this predictivity remain unclear. To investigate this, we systematically studied how images are described and which language models are used to embed those descriptions. For a common set of images, we considered six caption types -- including human-annotated and multiple machine-generated captions -- differing along several dimensions. Each caption was represented with five LMs, spanning autoregressive LMs trained to predict upcoming words and text embedders, i.e., LMs fine-tuned on semantic tasks requiring sentence/document-level representations. Machine-generated captions yielded significant brain predictivity and alignment, often surpassing human-annotated captions used in previous work. Across caption types, text embedders consistently outperformed autoregressive LMs, a pattern replicated when measuring behavioural alignment with image-similarity judgments. Analyses of caption representations from different model layers further revealed that both brain predictivity and behavioural alignment peak at intermediate network depth, shortly after a point thought to mark the emergence of syntactic and semantic structure. Altogether, our results demonstrate that both the content of image captions and the LM used to represent them influence brain- and behaviour-modelling performance, establishing caption embeddings as a useful tool for studying high-level visual perception.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过六种图像描述类型和五种语言模型，系统研究了语言模型嵌入如何预测人类大脑对自然图像的响应。发现机器生成的描述和文本嵌入器（text embedders）比人工标注描述和自回归语言模型更具预测性，且中间网络层的表示达到最佳预测效果。
Motivation: 尽管语言模型能预测大脑对图像的响应，但驱动这种预测性的因素尚不明确，需要系统分析描述内容和模型类型的影响。
Method: 对同一组图像，使用六种描述类型（包括人工标注与机器生成）和五种语言模型（自回归模型与文本嵌入器），通过脑预测和行为对齐实验进行对比。
Result: 机器生成的描述显著优于人工标注的描述；文本嵌入器一致优于自回归模型；中间网络层的预测性和行为对齐达到峰值。
Conclusion: 图像描述的内容和语言模型的选择共同影响脑与行为建模性能，描述嵌入可作为研究高层面视觉感知的有效工具。

papers.title: SelKV: Selective KV Cache Merging with Per-Token Merge-or-Drop and Attention Compensation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) generate text autoregressively, relying on a key-value (KV) cache whose memory footprint grows linearly with context length, creating a major bottleneck. Recent compression methods mitigate this cost via token merging; however, these approaches often rely on indiscriminate aggregation, which degrades representations and introduces attention sag, a mismatch where merged tokens receive the same softmax mass as individual tokens despite encoding multiple inputs. We propose a training-free, dual-component framework for KV cache compression that addresses these limitations. First, a soft cosine gate adaptively modulates merging decisions based on value-vector similarity, suppressing or discarding dissimilar tokens to preserve semantic fidelity. Second, we introduce an attention-ratio compensation mechanism that applies a decoding-time logit bias derived from prefill attention statistics, correcting the softmax imbalance induced by merging. Evaluated on LongBench (16 English datasets) while retaining only 25% of the KV cache, our framework achieves strong compressed performance against representative one-shot baselines. It is especially robust on the evaluated grouped-query attention (GQA) models, maintaining nearlossless generation quality. Furthermore, the method outperforms the full-cache baseline on complex multi-document QA tasks and delivers a 3.3x decoding speedup at 100k tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SelKV，一种无需训练的 KV 缓存压缩框架，通过软余弦门控自适应决定合并或丢弃 token，并引入注意力比率补偿机制纠正合并导致的 softmax 失衡。在 LongBench 上仅保留 25% KV 缓存时，在分组查询注意力模型上接近无损，多文档问答任务中超越全缓存基线，实现 3.3 倍解码加速。
Motivation: 现有 KV 缓存压缩方法在 token 合并时采用无差别聚合，导致表征退化和注意力凹陷（attention sag）问题，即合并 token 的 softmax 质量不均匀。
Method: 提出双组件框架：1）软余弦门控（soft cosine gate）基于值向量相似性自适应合并或丢弃 token；2）通过预填充注意力统计量推导解码时 logit 偏置，补偿合并引起的 softmax 不平衡。
Result: 在 LongBench 上保留 25% KV 缓存时，强于代表性一次性基线；在分组查询注意力模型上接近无损；多文档问答任务中超越全缓存基线；100k token 时获得 3.3 倍解码加速。
Conclusion: 该训练无关方法有效解决了 KV 缓存压缩中的注意力凹陷问题，尤其适用于分组查询注意力模型。

papers.title: Symbolic Augmentation Closes a Canonical-Equivalence Blind Spot in Neural Fact-Checkers
papers.abstract_en: Large language models hallucinate numbers and units when summarizing scientific text, a failure mode that can silently invert a scientific claim. We recast the detection of such errors as typed verification: we introduce a five-class typed-quantity error taxonomy and a 1500-item benchmark, rewritten from PMC and arXiv sources and labeled by two independent LLM annotators with adjudication (Krippendorff's alpha = 0.882). A ModernBERT encoder fine-tuned on this benchmark reaches macro-F1 = 0.899, far above any off-the-shelf neural fact-checker, yet four probes expose a sharp structural blind spot: on canonical-equivalent rewrites of physically equivalent quantities (e.g., 95°C and 368.15 K) its accuracy collapses to 36.5%. We propose Symbolic Augmentation, a training-time framework that runs the modules of a symbolic verifier in reverse to generate label-preserving augmented training data. The augmentation lifts canonical-equivalence robustness to 98.2% while slightly improving in-distribution accuracy (macro-F1: 0.899 to 0.902); the augmented encoder matches a closed-frontier LLM at no inference cost and transfers to an external benchmark (SciFact-Open binary macro-F1: 0.791 to 0.828). Two negative results sharpen the claim: symbolic features as auxiliary encoder inputs add nothing, and symbolic silver labels scale negatively under teacher noise. Together these results identify training-time augmentation as the right integration point between symbolic and learned components.

papers.title: Accurate and Efficient Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents augmented with persistent memory can recall past interactions, but existing systems suffer from two limitations: flat, unstructured storage loses relational context needed for multi-hop and temporal reasoning, and reliance on expensive LLM-based classification makes them impractical for latency-sensitive deployment. Without mechanisms to validate new information against stored knowledge, these systems silently accumulate contradictions. We present MOSAIC (Memory-Organized Structured Agent for Information Collection), a structured, conflict-aware long-term memory framework for LLM agents that is substantially more accurate and efficient. MOSAIC introduces three key capabilities: (1) entity-typed graph storage with semantic classification preserving relational structure across events, personas, and relationships, enabling multi-hop and temporal reasoning over conversation history; (2) hash-accelerated dual-path retrieval replacing LLM-based classification with locality-sensitive hashing, achieving near-instantaneous lookup with negligible accuracy loss; and (3) active conflict detection at save time that cross-references new information against existing graph neighbors, triggering updates or deletions for contradictory entries. Evaluated on LoCoMo (long-conversation QA), HaluMem, and a novel clinical-guideline error compounding test, MOSAIC achieves 89.35% accuracy on LoCoMo (+27.21 pp over the best baseline), best HaluMem-Medium extraction F1(86.77%) and HaluMem-Long extraction F1 (85.84%), best QA correctness on both Medium and Long (73.10%, 70.75%), and detects 66% of injected factual conflicts-4.7 times higher than the best baseline (14%)-while hash-accelerated retrieval keeps average search latency at 0.58 s per question.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MOSAIC 框架，用于 LLM 代理的长期记忆存储与检索，采用实体类型图结构、哈希加速双路径检索和保存时主动冲突检测，在 LoCoMo、HaluMem 等基准上显著提升准确率并降低延迟。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 代理的记忆系统存在存储扁平化、依赖昂贵的 LLM 分类检索、缺乏冲突验证等问题，导致多跳推理能力弱、延迟高且易积累矛盾。
Method: MOSAIC 包含三个关键组件：实体类型图存储保持关系结构；哈希加速的双路径检索（局部敏感哈希）替代 LLM 分类实现近瞬时查找；保存时主动冲突检测，交叉引用新信息与图邻居，触发更新或删除矛盾条目。
Result: 在 LoCoMo 上准确率 89.35%（+27.21 pp），HaluMem-Medium 和 Long 提取 F1 分别为 86.77% 和 85.84%，QA 正确率 73.10% 和 70.75%，冲突检测率 66%（基线 14%），平均检索延迟 0.58 秒/问题。
Conclusion: MOSAIC 通过结构化存储、高效检索和主动冲突检测，在准确性和效率上显著超越现有长期记忆系统，适用于延迟敏感的 LLM 代理场景。

papers.title: A Survey on the Verification of Reinforcement Learning Policies
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly applied in complex, safety-critical domains, yet the lack of rigorous behavioral guarantees for neural network-based policies remains a major barrier to deployment. Recent advances in policy expressiveness and scale have intensified this challenge, leading to a rapidly growing but conceptually fragmented body of work on RL policy verification. This survey provides a unifying perspective on RL verification methods. We introduce a taxonomy that clarifies relationships among existing approaches along three axes: verification paradigm (formal versus probabilistic), temporal scope (step-wise versus multi-step), and guarantees strength. Beyond taxonomy, we unify underlying theoretical foundations, make implicit assumptions and limitations explicit, and identify emerging directions.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 35th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了强化学习策略的验证方法，提出了一个三维分类法（验证范式、时间范围、保证强度），统一了理论基础并明确了隐式假设和局限性，最后指出了新兴研究方向。
Motivation: 强化学习在安全关键领域的应用日益增多，但神经网络策略缺乏严格的行为保证，现有验证工作概念碎片化。
Method: 提出基于验证范式（形式化 vs. 概率化）、时间范围（单步 vs. 多步）和保证强度三个维度的分类法，并统一了理论根基。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值，但提供了统一视角，使隐式假设和局限性显式化。
Conclusion: 识别了强化学习策略验证的新兴研究方向。

papers.title: Shapley Context Pruning: A Cooperative Game Perspective for Context Reranking and Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Context reranking and pruning have become essential for improving the efficiency of modern Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, yet an interpretable and unified framework remains underexplored. Previous work has primarily emphasized lexical retrieval, cross-encoder architectures, model distillation, and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), mostly relying on heuristic loss functions and empirical attribution. This paper presents Shapley Context Pruning (SCP), a novel framework for context reranking that establishes a cooperative-game-theory perspective for importance attribution by modeling the context as a cooperative game. Balancing the trade-off between fine-grained and coarse-grained representations, we employ a Deep Sets architecture to approximate a permutation-invariant value function at the sentence level, utilizing pre-trained language models as sentence embedders and optimizing via a pairwise margin ranking loss. To ensure practical scalability without sacrificing mathematical rigor, we leverage Monte-Carlo sampling for efficient training and inference, providing formal theoretical error bounds and sample complexity guarantees for preserving Top-K subset rankings. Furthermore, we conduct comprehensive experiments-spanning supporting-sentence recall, Needle-in-the-Haystack (NIAH) evaluations, long-context QA, and multi-hop reasoning-alongside rigorous ablation studies on embedding quality and attribution strategies. The model achieves competitive downstream QA performance against robust baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Shapley Context Pruning (SCP)，一个基于合作博弈论的上下文重排序框架，通过将上下文建模为合作博弈并利用 Deep Sets 架构近似置换不变的价值函数，结合蒙特卡洛采样实现高效训练与推理。在多项长上下文 QA 和多跳推理任务上取得有竞争力的性能。
Motivation: 现有 RAG 系统的上下文重排序方法多依赖启发式损失函数和经验归因，缺乏可解释且统一的框架。
Method: 采用合作博弈论视角，以句子级别通过 Deep Sets 架构和预训练语言模型嵌入近似置换不变价值函数，使用配对边际排序损失优化，并利用蒙特卡洛采样保证 Top-K 子集排序的理论误差界。
Result: 在支持句子召回、Needle-in-the-Haystack、长上下文 QA 和多跳推理等任务上取得与强基线相当的竞争性能。
Conclusion: SCP 提供了可解释的上下文重要性归因，且通过理论保证和实验验证了其有效性。

papers.title: ColGraphRAG: Late-Interaction Evidence Retrieval for Multimodal GraphRAG
papers.abstract_en: Graph-grounded multimodal question answering organizes text, tables, and images in a structured evidence graph, yet end-to-end accuracy depends on which multimodal assets are ranked highly enough to enter downstream reasoning; for graph-linked images, single-vector bi-encoder similarity can discard patch- and token-level structure needed for fine-grained alignment. We evaluate replacing the visual candidate-ranking operator over graph-linked image nodes with late-interaction MaxSim-style multi-vector scoring in the ColBERT/ColPali lineage, while keeping offline graph construction, text- and table-side retrieval, structured extraction, and downstream reasoning unchanged. On MultimodalQA, this change is associated with improved retrieval-stage point estimates for graph-linked image candidates and downstream QA gains, with larger movement where visual evidence matters most and mixed trends on text-dominant questions; we interpret the pattern as mechanism-level evidence for graph-linked visual evidence inclusion, while broader validation and finer graph-level diagnostics remain important future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ColGraphRAG，将图基多模态问答中的视觉候选项排序从单向量双编码器替换为晚期交互多向量评分（如 ColBERT/ColPali 的 MaxSim），同时保持图构建、文本/表格检索和下游推理不变。在 MultimodalQA 上，该变更改进了图像候选检索和下游 QA 性能，尤其在视觉证据重要的问题上提升更明显。
Motivation: 图基多模态问答中，图关联图像的检索端使用单向量双编码器相似性评分会丢失细粒度对齐所需的 patch 和 token 级结构，限制了下游推理准确性。
Method: 在不改变离线图构建、文本/表格检索和推理流程的前提下，将图关联图像节点的视觉候选排序算子替换为晚期交互 MaxSim 风格的多向量评分（继承自 ColBERT/ColPali 系列）。
Result: 在 MultimodalQA 数据集上，检索阶段图关联图像候选的准确率点估计提升，下游 QA 也获得改善；视觉证据主导的问题提升更大，文本主导的问题上效果混合。
Conclusion: 该模式从机制层面表明图关联视觉证据包含的必要性，但更广泛的验证和更精细的图级诊断是未来工作。

papers.title: JUMP: Single-Pass Membership Inference on Fine-Tuned Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) test whether a candidate example appeared in a model's training data. We study MIAs for fine-tuned discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs), where membership means inclusion in the target model's fine-tuning set. Unlike autoregressive language models, dLLMs allow an attacker to choose arbitrary mask sets and obtain token distributions for all masked positions in parallel. The prior dLLM attack, SAMA, follows a natural loss-mimicking strategy by averaging reconstruction signals over many randomly sampled masks, but it uses the any-order interface only as randomization and requires many target/reference queries. We propose JUMP (Joint Uncertainty-Guided Mask Probing), a single-pass scoring attack that exploits both distinctive properties of dLLMs: any-order decodability is used to select low-reference-confidence positions, and parallel decodability is used to score all selected positions through one joint masked query per model. JUMP masks the selected positions jointly and computes a clipped target/reference reconstruction-gap statistic. On fine-tuned LLaDA-8B-Base across six MIMIR domains, JUMP improves mean ROC-AUC from 0.82 to 0.90 over SAMA and substantially improves low-FPR detection, while requiring only one selector pass and one scoring pass through each of the target and reference models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文研究针对微调扩散语言模型（dLLMs）的成员推理攻击，提出JUMP方法，利用dLLMs的任意顺序解码和并行解码特性，通过单次联合掩码查询进行成员关系推断。在微调LLaDA-8B-Base的六个MIMIR域上，JUMP将平均ROC-AUC从SAMA的0.82提升至0.90，并显著改善低假阳性率检测性能，同时大幅减少查询次数。
Motivation: 现有针对自回归语言模型的成员推理攻击需要多次查询，且未充分利用扩散语言模型独特的任意顺序解码和并行解码能力。本文旨在设计一种更高效的单次攻击方法，利用这些特性提升攻击效果。
Method: 提出JUMP（联合不确定性引导掩码探针），分为两步：首先利用任意顺序解码选择低参考置信度的位置，然后通过一次联合掩码查询获取所有选定位置的标记分布，计算截断的目标-参考重建差距统计量作为成员评分。
Result: 在微调LLaDA-8B-Base的六个MIMIR域上，JUMP的平均ROC-AUC从SAMA的0.82提升至0.90，尤其在低假阳性率下检测性能显著提升，且仅需一次选择器通过和一次评分器通过目标与参考模型。
Conclusion: JUMP利用扩散语言模型的并行解码能力实现了单次高效成员推理攻击，显著优于现有方法，强调了利用dLLMs独特接口进行攻击的潜力。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有针对自回归语言模型的成员推理攻击需要多次查询，且未充分利用扩散语言模型独特的任意顺序解码和并行解码能力。本文旨在设计一种更高效的单次攻击方法，利用这些特性提升攻击效果。
summary_sections.method: 提出JUMP（联合不确定性引导掩码探针），分为两步：首先利用任意顺序解码选择低参考置信度的位置，然后通过一次联合掩码查询获取所有选定位置的标记分布，计算截断的目标-参考重建差距统计量作为成员评分。
summary_sections.result: 在微调LLaDA-8B-Base的六个MIMIR域上，JUMP的平均ROC-AUC从SAMA的0.82提升至0.90，尤其在低假阳性率下检测性能显著提升，且仅需一次选择器通过和一次评分器通过目标与参考模型。
summary_sections.conclusion: JUMP利用扩散语言模型的并行解码能力实现了单次高效成员推理攻击，显著优于现有方法，强调了利用dLLMs独特接口进行攻击的潜力。

papers.title: PPO-HSC: An Exploratory Reinforcement Learning Framework Based on Wide-Area Policy Coverage Optimization
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces PPO-HSC (Proximal Policy Optimization with High-order Sampling Coverage), an exploratory reinforcement learning framework designed to address the "Invisible Shackles" of mode collapse in Large Language Model (LLM) fine-tuning. While standard Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) effectively reinforces high-reward trajectories, it often leads models to over-optimize known solutions, sacrificing curiosity and the ability to explore broader solution manifolds. To overcome this, PPO-HSC incorporates a High-order Sampling Coverage (HSC) reward that incentivizes the discovery of "low-similarity yet high-validity" reasoning patterns. By maintaining a dynamic trajectory library of verified unique solutions, the framework provides a differentiable signal that rewards semantic novelty while ensuring structural rationality through a plausibility constraint. Empirical evaluations on mathematical reasoning (GSM8K, SVAMP) and code generation tasks demonstrate that PPO-HSC significantly enhances solution diversity and state-space coverage while maintaining or surpassing the accuracy and syntax integrity of state-of-the-art RL baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PPO-HSC 框架，通过高序采样覆盖（HSC）奖励激励大语言模型微调中探索低相似性但高有效性的推理模式，以缓解标准 RLVR 导致的模式坍缩问题。在数学推理和代码生成任务上，该方法在保持或提升准确率的同时显著增加了解多样性与状态空间覆盖。
Motivation: 标准 RLVR 在 LLM 微调中过度强化高奖励轨迹，导致模型丧失探索新解的能力，出现模式坍缩。
Method: PPO-HSC 引入高序采样覆盖奖励，维护动态轨迹库，对语义新颖且结构合理的解给予额外奖励，同时通过合理性约束保证输出有效性。
Result: 在 GSM8K、SVAMP 和代码生成任务上，PPO-HSC 相比基线方法提升了解多样性和状态空间覆盖，且准确率与语法完整性不降或略升。
Conclusion: 该方法有效平衡了利用与探索，为 LLM 微调中的模式坍缩问题提供了一种实用的奖励塑造方案。

papers.title: It Takes 8 Tokens: Weak-to-Strong Off-Policy RL via Auxiliary Branches
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has emerged as a standard approach for enhancing reasoning in large language models, which typically optimizes the policy by contrasting multiple self generated rollouts. However, we identify a critical support limited bottleneck in this paradigm: on challenging reasoning tasks, the target model's samples often exhibit semantic redundancy, converging into the same erroneous "reasoning basins" that offer negligible reward contrast for policy updates. In this paper, we propose to overcome this limitation through a weak to strong learning paradigm, where a policy's exploration is informed by a weaker but computationally efficient auxiliary model. We introduce W2SPO, an off policy RL method that injects short auxiliary segments often as brief as 8 tokens into intermediate target model trajectories and the target model then completes the reasoning path from these diverted states. Policy updates are restricted to these short inserted segments based on final verifiable rewards. Empirically, W2SPO achieves superior performance among evaluated 4B scale models on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, outperforming evaluated post trained baselines. Compared with vanilla GRPO under the same sampling budget, W2SPO improves Pass@1 from 62.3% to 64.2% while achieving a 3.55 times training speedup. These results suggest that weak auxiliary branches can induce stronger target reasoning policies by expanding local exploration support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型强化学习推理中样本冗余、难以获得有效奖励对比的问题，提出W2SPO方法，利用弱辅助模型生成短至8个token的段注入目标模型轨迹，并仅对这些段进行策略更新。在数学推理基准上，4B模型Pass@1从62.3%提升至64.2%，训练速度提升3.55倍。
Motivation: 现有RL方法依赖自生成样本对比，但目标模型在挑战性推理任务上常陷入相似错误推理盆地，导致奖励差异过小，策略更新受限。
Method: 提出W2SPO，一种弱到强离线策略RL方法：由弱辅助模型生成短辅助段（最短8 token）插入目标模型中间轨迹，目标模型从转移状态继续推理；策略更新仅作用于这些插入段，基于最终可验证奖励。
Result: 在数学推理任务上，4B规模模型优于所有评估的后训练基线；与GRPO相比，Pass@1从62.3%提升至64.2%，训练速度提升3.55倍。
Conclusion: 弱辅助分支通过扩大局部探索支持，有效增强了目标模型的推理策略，在数学推理基准上取得显著提升。

papers.title: Masked Diffusion Language Models are Strong and Steerable Text-Based World Models for Agentic RL
papers.abstract_en: Recent growth in reinforcement learning (RL) has surfaced a need for diverse, specialized training environments. Hand-curated environments with fixed task and reward difficulties become ineffective signals as model performance improves, and sparse rewards over long horizons induce mode collapse on specific workflows or tool structures. World models that simulate environment states have matched pure rollout performance, making them promising for scaling diversity on-demand. However, autoregressive (AR) world models suffer from a left-to-right bias preventing conditioning on globally interdependent state anchors such as tool schemas, prior turns, and expected outcomes. We (i) formalize text-based world modeling as a steerable transition-dynamics problem decomposed into initial state, task context, tool schemas, domain rules, and steering directives, and (ii) curate 239,403 grounded state-action trajectories spanning nine open-source environments and twelve frontier model families. We compare AR LMs and masked diffusion language models (MDLMs), showing MDLMs, via bidirectional anchor-aware denoising, achieve better coherence, groundedness, and empirically validated rollout diversity than LLMs over 4x their parameter size, at comparable inference latency. We introduce a plug-and-play GRPO training framework with deterministic state checks, and perform zero-shot transfer ablations on three OOD environments (ScienceWorld, ALFWorld, AppWorld) across three 1.2B-7B agent backbones (LFM2.5, Qwen3, Mistral), achieving up to 47% absolute gains over baselines without environment-specific fine-tuning. We further conduct behavioral analysis of failure modes under adversarial scenarios and human evaluation on realism, outcome correctness, and training utility. We open-source our work to encourage research in this direction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）用于强化学习的文本世界建模，以克服自回归模型在全局状态锚点（如工具模式、任务上下文）上的条件偏差。通过构建239,403条轨迹数据集和GRPO训练框架，MDLM在多个环境中实现了比自回归模型更好的rollout多样性和零样本迁移能力。
Motivation: 自回归世界模型存在从左到右的偏差，无法对全局相互依赖的状态锚点进行条件化，导致生成轨迹多样性不足，难以适应复杂任务。
Method: 形式化文本世界建模为可操控的转移动力学问题，分解为初始状态、任务上下文、工具模式等组件；构建239,403条轨迹数据集；对比自回归语言模型和MDLM，引入带确定性状态检查的GRPO训练框架。
Result: MDLM在连贯性、groundedness和rollout多样性上优于参数大4倍的LLM，在ScienceWorld、ALFWorld、AppWorld三个OOD环境中零样本迁移获得最多47%的绝对提升。
Conclusion: MDLM作为文本世界模型具有强性能和可操控性，适合作为基于Agent的强化学习的训练环境。

papers.title: DocOCR-Eval: A Correction-Based Framework for OCR Tool Selection Without Ground Truth
papers.abstract_en: Document parsing is a foundational step for document understanding tasks such as visual question answering and key information extraction, as it transforms unstructured scanned images into structured representations by extracting textual, visual, and layout information. While numerous Optical Character Recognition (OCR) engines and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have been developed for this purpose, selecting an appropriate document parsing solution for a given document collection remains challenging, particularly in label-scarce settings. In this work, we conduct a systematic evaluation of text recognition performance across a diverse set of OCR engines and state-of-the-art MLLMs on multiple scanned document benchmarks spanning different domains and languages. Motivated by the limited contextual reasoning capabilities of many OCR engines and the high cost of manual annotations, we propose DocOCR-Eval, an annotation-free evaluation framework for automatic OCR assessment and selection. DocOCR-Eval employs a three-staged correction and ranking strategy to approximate annotation-based tool ordering without ground-truth labels. We show that aggregating across multiple MLLMs progressively improves alignment with annotation-based rankings. Extensive experiments further demonstrate that reliable OCR tool selection can be achieved in realistic, label-limited settings, providing practical guidance for deploying document parsing systems across diverse real-world document collections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DocOCR-Eval，一种无需标注的 OCR 工具评估与选择框架，通过三阶段矫正与排序策略近似有标注的工具排序，无需真值标签。在多个扫描文档基准上评估了多种 OCR 引擎和 MLLM，表明聚合多个 MLLM 可逐步提高与基于标注排序的一致性。
Motivation: 选择适合特定文档集合的 OCR 方案很困难，尤其是在标签稀缺的场景下。现有 OCR 引擎上下文推理能力有限，人工标注成本高。
Method: DocOCR-Eval 采用三阶段矫正与排序策略，无需真值标注即可近似基于标注的工具排序，并通过聚合多个 MLLM 进一步提升一致性。
Result: 实验表明，在现实的标签有限场景中，可以可靠地选择 OCR 工具，聚合多个 MLLM 逐步提高与基于标注排序的一致性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架为部署文档解析系统提供实用指导，在标签稀缺情况下也能实现可靠的 OCR 工具选择。

papers.title: Democratizing AI with Small Language Models: Structured Benchmarking and Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Local Deployment
papers.abstract_en: AI democratization is not primarily a question of matching frontier-scale generality; it is a question of whether capable models can be selected, audited, and specialized under hardware and governance constraints that ordinary institutions can actually satisfy. This paper studies that problem through a controlled evaluation of nine open-weight language models between 135M and 3B parameters on a 1,085-example, 16-topic multiple-choice benchmark designed for structured local deployment. The benchmark emphasizes symbolic precision, constrained formatting, extraction, and short-horizon semantic decision making under a strict one-letter output protocol. A shared parameter-efficient fine-tuning pipeline then adapts a subset of models using 4-bit NF4 quantization with DoRA/LoRA-style adapters on an NVIDIA L4-class budget. In base evaluation, Qwen Coder 3B leads at 75.67% strict accuracy, followed by Qwen2.5 1.5B at 67.10%, Qwen3.5 2B at 64.98%, and Granite 3.3 2B at 64.61%. On the shared 108-example held-out fine-tuning split, adaptation improves Qwen Coder 3B by +26.85 points, SmolLM2 1.7B by +25.92, Qwen2.5 1.5B by +19.44, SmolLM2 360M by +10.18, and SmolLM2 135M by +5.55. Across ranking, topic-level heterogeneity, difficulty strata, failure composition, efficiency frontiers, and topic-conditioned transfer, the same conclusion recurs: a disciplined workflow of benchmark construction, cross-model evaluation, and low-cost specialization already makes a subset of sub-3B models viable as local experts for structured niche workloads.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对9个135M到3B参数的开放权重语言模型进行结构化基准测试（1085样本、16主题多选题），强调符号精度和约束输出。Qwen Coder 3B在基础评估中准确率最高（75.67%），通过4-bit NF4量化与DoRA/LoRA适配器的参数高效微调，在L4 GPU预算下进一步提升了性能。结论是子3B模型可胜任结构化专业任务。
Motivation: AI民主化的关键在于在普通机构能承受的硬件和治理约束下选择、审计和专业化模型，而非追逐前沿通用性；现有研究缺乏针对本地部署的结构化评估与低成本适配方案。
Method: 构建1085样本、16主题的多选题基准，要求严格单字母输出以强调符号精确性与格式化约束；然后采用4-bit NF4量化与DoRA/LoRA适配器进行参数高效微调，在NVIDIA L4类预算上适配部分模型。
Result: 基础评估中Qwen Coder 3B准确率75.67%，Qwen2.5 1.5B 67.10%，Qwen3.5 2B 64.98%，Granite 3.3 2B 64.61%；微调后Qwen Coder 3B提升+26.85点，SmolLM2 1.7B提升+25.92等。
Conclusion: 通过结构化基准、跨模型评估与低成本专业化，子3B模型可作为结构化专业工作的本地专家。

papers.title: Generative Ontology Induction: Domain-Agnostic Schema Discovery from Document Corpora Using Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Ontology engineering remains a critical bottleneck in knowledge-intensive AI systems. Existing automated approaches either depend on predefined schemas, operate within narrow domains, or produce unstructured outputs unsuitable for downstream pipelines. We introduce Generative Ontology Induction (GOI), a domain-agnostic framework that induces a generative blueprint - entities, dimensions, properties, relationships, and constraints - from a corpus of examples and exports it as a typed graph (six node types, seven edge types) in YAML/JSON. We introduce the Node Coverage Score, a novel evaluation metric that measures the fraction of structural ontology nodes (classes, properties, and dimensions) appearing in generated outputs. A controlled generative validation on four contrasting ontologies - a familiar Software Services Invoice schema, a custom Job Description Ontology, a confidential Pain-Management Clinical Visit Record Ontology, and a Professional Services Contract & Statement of Work Ontology - shows that GOI-prompted generation covers 95-100% of the structural backbone in every case; a generic three-field template holds at 97.8% on the invoice schema but drops to 52.2% on the Job Description Ontology, 62.2% on the Pain-Management ontology, and 78.3% on the Professional Services Contract ontology. The structural coverage holds regardless of how familiar the document type is to the model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出生成式本体归纳（GOI）框架，能从文档语料中自动生成结构化本体蓝图（实体、维度、属性、关系、约束），并导出为YAML/JSON格式的带类型图（6种节点类型，7种边类型）。在四个不同领域的本体上，GOI诱导的结构节点覆盖率（节点覆盖度指标）达到95-100%，而通用模板覆盖率波动较大（52.2%-97.8%）。实验表明覆盖率不依赖于模型对文档类型的熟悉程度。
Motivation: 现有本体工程自动化方法依赖预定义模式、局限于窄领域或产生非结构化输出，成为知识密集型AI系统的瓶颈。
Method: 提出GOI框架，通过大语言模型从示例语料中生成生成式蓝图，并输出为带类型图的YAML/JSON格式。引入节点覆盖度（Node Coverage Score）评估指标，度量生成输出中结构本体节点（类、属性、维度）的比例。
Result: 在四个对比本体（软件服务发票、职位描述、疼痛管理临床记录、专业服务合同）上，GOI诱导的结构覆盖率均达95-100%，而通用三字段模板覆盖率在发票本体为97.8%，但在其他本体降至52.2%-78.3%。
Conclusion: GOI能够在领域无关条件下稳定生成高覆盖率的结构化本体，不依赖模型对文档类型的熟悉度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deterministic Replay for AI Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: AI agent systems that couple large language models (LLMs) with external tools and APIs are inherently non-deterministic: LLM sampling variance, external API state, CDN infrastructure headers, and execution-environment noise collectively prevent any prior agent run from being faithfully re-executed. Existing observability platforms capture execution logs but cannot reproduce a run in isolation. We present agrepl, a developer-first CLI framework for deterministic replay of agent executions. agrepl intercepts all external interactions at the transport layer via a man-in-the-middle (MITM) proxy, serialises them as structured execution traces, and replays them in a strictly isolated environment with zero outbound network access. We formalise the agent execution model, define the request-key matching function K(s), and prove the determinism invariant. We introduce a noise-aware diff algorithm classifying HTTP header divergence into signal and noise tiers. Empirical evaluation across five workloads (n = 250 replay instances) demonstrates replay fidelity F = 1.0 and a median per-step latency reduction of 98.3%. agrepl is implemented in Go, ships as a single static binary, and is released under the MIT licence. Keywords: AI agents, deterministic replay, LLM debugging, reproducibility, MITM proxy, execution tracing, record/replay systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 agrepl，一个面向 AI agent 系统的确定性重放框架。通过 MITM 代理拦截所有外部交互，序列化为执行轨迹，并在零出站网络访问的隔离环境中重放。实验表明在五种工作负载上重放保真度为 1.0，每步延迟中位数降低 98.3%。
Motivation: 现有 AI agent 系统因 LLM 采样方差、外部 API 状态变化等因素具有非确定性，导致无法可靠地重新执行之前的运行，阻碍了调试和可复现性。
Method: 设计并实现 agrepl：在传输层通过 MITM 代理拦截和记录所有外部交互，存储为结构化执行轨迹；重放时在完全隔离环境中按序回放，并基于请求键匹配函数 K(s) 维持确定性。引入噪声感知差异算法，将 HTTP 头部分类为信号和噪声层级。
Result: 在五种工作负载上（n=250 次重放实例）重现保真度达到 1.0，每步延迟中位数降低 98.3%。
Conclusion: agrepl 能高保真地重放 AI agent 执行，大幅降低延迟，且以 MIT 许可发布，为 AI agent 调试和可复现性提供了实用工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PlanFlip: Attacking Multi-Agent LLM Systems via Planning-Phase Prompt Injection
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems increasingly rely on a Planner to decompose goals into sub-task sequences that downstream Executor and Critic agents execute and audit. We identify the planning phase as a critical attack surface: a single injection into the Planner's context achieves cascade amplification, corrupting all downstream sub-tasks simultaneously. We introduce PlanFlip, a framework comprising four planning-phase prompt injection attacks -- GoalSubstitution (PF-1), PriorityInversion (PF-2), ContextPollution (PF-3), and RoleConfusion (PF-4) -- each disguised as plausible tool outputs to evade keyword filters. Evaluating nine frontier LLMs across 3,479 episodes, we uncover three findings: (1) capability amplifies vulnerability -- GPT-5 achieves the highest attack success rate (ASR = 0.68), contradicting the assumption that stronger models are inherently more secure; (2) homogeneous pipelines exhibit a correlated-agent blind spot -- GPT-4o and Llama-3.3-70B show ASR near 0 yet Stealth = 1.00 and StepShift > 0, with attacks restructuring plans while the same-backbone Critic reports alignment (two independent judges confirm -0.20 to -0.32 semantic deviation, r = 0.943); (3) reasoning-augmented models resist injections -- DeepSeek-R1 achieves StepShift = 0.00 across all attacks. We propose GoalAnchorCheck (D1) and CrossAgentConsensus (D2), achieving detection rates up to 1.00 and outperforming same-backbone baselines in 15 of 16 cells. Our key insight: heterogeneous model diversity is a security prerequisite for multi-agent systems; redundancy within a homogeneous backbone provides no protection against planning-phase attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多智能体LLM系统中规划阶段的提示注入攻击，提出PlanFlip框架，包含四种伪装成工具输出的攻击方法（GoalSubstitution、PriorityInversion、ContextPollution、RoleConfusion）。对9个前沿LLM在3479个episode上评估，发现能力越强的模型越易受攻击（GPT-5攻击成功率0.68），同质化流水线存在相关智能体盲点，而推理增强模型（DeepSeek-R1）能完全抵抗注入。还提出GoalAnchorCheck和CrossAgentConsensus两种防御方法，检测率最高达1.00。
Motivation: 多智能体LLM系统依赖规划器分解任务，但规划阶段的安全漏洞被忽视，单一注入可级联放大影响下游所有子任务，构成关键攻击面。
Method: 提出PlanFlip框架，包含四种规划阶段提示注入攻击：GoalSubstitution (PF-1)、PriorityInversion (PF-2)、ContextPollution (PF-3)、RoleConfusion (PF-4)，每种攻击都伪装成合理的工具输出以绕过关键词过滤。同时提出GoalAnchorCheck和CrossAgentConsensus两种检测防御方法。
Result: 在3479个episode上评估9个LLM，发现：能力越强漏洞越大（GPT-5 ASR=0.68）；同质化流水线存在相关智能体盲点（GPT-4o和Llama-3.3-70B ASR接近0但攻击重构计划，Critic报告对齐）；推理增强模型抵抗注入（DeepSeek-R1 StepShift=0.00）。防御方法检测率最高1.00，在16个测试单元中15个优于同骨干基线。
Conclusion: 异构模型多样性是多智能体系统安全的前提，同质骨干网的冗余不能防御规划阶段攻击。
